explanation: At the very moment of his birth, jackals with flaming mouths and other carnivorous animals moved in inauspicious anti-clockwise circles.

shloka_text: ववर्ष रुधिरं देवो मेघाश्च खरनिःस्वनाः । प्रबभौ न च सूर्यो वै महोल्काश्चापतन्भुवि ।। 7.9.30 ।।
transliteration: vavarṣa rudhiraṃ devo meghāśca kharaniḥsvanāḥ | prababhau na ca sūryo vai maholkāścāpatanbhuvi || 7.9.30 ||
translation: ववर्ष rained, रुधिरं blood, देवः the god, मेघाः clouds, च and, खरनिःस्वनाः roaring loudly, प्रबभौ shone, न not, च and, सूर्यः the sun, वै indeed, महोल्काः great meteors, च and, आपतन् fell, भुवि on the earth.
explanation: The sky rained blood, clouds roared harshly, the sun did not shine, and great meteors fell upon the earth.

shloka_text: चकम्पे जगती चैव ववुर्वाताः सुदारुणाः । अक्षोभ्यः क्षुभितश्चैव समुद्रः सरितां पतिः ।। 7.9.31 ।।
transliteration: cakampe jagatī caiva vavurvātāḥ sudāruṇāḥ | akṣobhyaḥ kṣubhitaścaiva samudraḥ saritāṃ patiḥ || 7.9.31 ||
translation: चकम्पे trembled, जगती the earth, चैव and, ववुः blew, वाताः winds, सुदारुणाः very fierce, अक्षोभ्यः unagitated, क्षुभितश्चैव and became agitated, समुद्रः the ocean, सरितां पतिः lord of rivers.
explanation: The earth trembled, very fierce winds blew, and even the unshakeable ocean, the lord of rivers, became agitated.

shloka_text: अथ नामाकरोत्तस्य पितामहसमः पिता । दशग्रीवः प्रसूतो ऽयं दशग्रीवो भविष्यति ।। 7.9.32 ।।
transliteration: atha nāmākarottasya pitāmahasamaḥ pitā | daśagrīvaḥ prasūto 'yaṃ daśagrīvo bhaviṣyati || 7.9.32 ||
translation: अथ then, नामाकरोत् named, तस्य his, पितामहसमः like his grandfather, पिता father, दशग्रीवः ten-necked, प्रसूतो ऽयम् this one born, दशग्रीवः ten-necked, भविष्यति will be.
explanation: Then his father, who was like his grandfather (Brahma), named him Daśagrīva, declaring that this newborn would indeed be Daśagrīva (ten-necked).

shloka_text: तस्य त्वनन्तरं जातः कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः । प्रमाणाद्यस्य विपुलं प्रमाणं नेह विद्यते ।। 7.9.33 ।।
transliteration: tasya tvanantaraṃ jātaḥ kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ | pramāṇādyasya vipulaṃ pramāṇaṃ neha vidyate || 7.9.33 ||
translation: तस्य his, तु indeed, अनन्तरम् subsequently, जातः was born, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, महाबलः immensely powerful, प्रमाणात् in measure, यस्य whose, विपुलम् vast, प्रमाणम् measure, न not, इह here, विद्यते exists.
explanation: After him, the immensely powerful Kumbhakarna was born, whose vast size and measure had no equal in this world.

shloka_text: ततः शूर्पणखा नाम सञ्जज्ञे विकृतानना । विभीषणश्च धर्मात्मा कैकस्याः पश्चिमः सुतः ।। 7.9.34 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā nāma sañjajñe vikṛtānanā | vibhīṣaṇaśca dharmātmā kaikasyāḥ paścimaḥ sutaḥ || 7.9.34 ||
translation: ततः then, शूर्पणखा Shurpanakha, नाम named, सञ्जज्ञे was born, विकृतानना with a deformed face, विभीषणश्च and Vibhishana, धर्मात्मा righteous-souled, कैकस्याः of Kaikasi, पश्चिमः last, सुतः son.
explanation: Then Shurpanakha, named for her deformed face, was born, followed by Vibhishana, the righteous-souled last son of Kaikasi.

shloka_text: तस्मिञ्जाते महासत्त्वे पुष्पवर्षं पपात ह ।। 7.9.35 ।।
transliteration: tasmiñjāte mahāsattve puṣpavarṣaṃ papāta ha || 7.9.35 ||
translation: तस्मिन् when he, जाते was born, महासत्त्वे the great being, पुष्पवर्षम् a shower of flowers, पपात fell, ह indeed.
explanation: Indeed, when that great being (Vibhishana) was born, a shower of flowers fell.

shloka_text: नभःस्थाने दुन्दुभयो देवानां प्राणदंस्तदा । वाक्यं चैवान्तरिक्षे च साधु साध्विति तत्तदा ।। 7.9.36 ।।
transliteration: nabhaḥsthāne dundubhayo devānāṃ prāṇadaṃstadā | vākyaṃ caivāntarikṣe ca sādhu sādhviti tattadā || 7.9.36 ||
translation: नभःस्थाने in the sky, दुन्दुभयो drums, देवानां of the gods, प्राणदंस्तदा then sounded, वाक्यं a voice, चैव and also, अन्तरिक्षे in the sky, च and, साधु साध्विति "Excellent! Excellent!", तत् that, तदा then.
explanation: Then, drums of the gods sounded in the sky, and a voice from the heavens exclaimed, "Excellent! Excellent!"

shloka_text: तौ तु तत्र महारण्ये ववृधाते महौजसौ । कुम्भकर्णदशग्रीवौ लोकोद्वेगकरौ तदा ।। 7.9.37 ।।
transliteration: tau tu tatra mahāraṇye vavṛdhāte mahaujasau | kumbhakarṇadaśagrīvau lokodvegakarau tadā || 7.9.37 ||
translation: तौ those two, तु indeed, तत्र there, महारण्ये in the great forest, ववृधाते grew up, महौजसौ very powerful, कुम्भकर्णदशग्रीवौ Kumbhakarna and Dashagriva, लोकोद्वेगकरौ causing distress to the world, तदा then.
explanation: Then, those two, Kumbhakarna and Dashagriva, grew up in that great forest, becoming exceedingly powerful and a cause of distress to the world.

shloka_text: कुम्भकर्णः प्रमत्तस्तु महर्षीन्धर्मवत्सलान् । त्रैलोक्यं भक्षयन्नित्यासन्तुष्टो विचचार ह ।। 7.9.38 ।।
transliteration: kumbhakarṇaḥ pramattastu maharṣīndharmavatsalān | trailokyaṃ bhakṣayannityāsantuṣṭo vicacāra ha || 7.9.38 ||
translation: कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, प्रमत्तस्तु but reckless, महर्षीन् great sages, धर्मवत्सलान् devoted to dharma, त्रैलोक्यं the three worlds, भक्षयन् devouring, नित्य always, असन्तुष्टो unsatisfied, विचचार roamed, ह indeed.
explanation: Kumbhakarna, reckless and ever unsatisfied, roamed about, devouring great sages devoted to dharma and causing havoc in the three worlds.

shloka_text: विभीषणस्तु धर्मात्मा नित्यं धर्मे व्यवस्थितः । स्वाध्यायनियताहार उवास विजितेन्द्रियः ।। 7.9.39 ।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇastu dharmātmā nityaṃ dharme vyavasthitaḥ | svādhyāyaniyatāhāra uvāsa vijitendriyaḥ || 7.9.39 ||
translation: विभीषणस्तु but Vibhishana, धर्मात्मा righteous-souled, नित्यं always, धर्मे in righteousness, व्यवस्थितः established, स्वाध्यायनियताहार with self-study and controlled diet, उवास lived, विजितेन्द्रियः with controlled senses.
explanation: In contrast, Vibhishana, a righteous soul, always remained steadfast in dharma, living with self-study, a controlled diet, and mastery over his senses.

shloka_text: अथ वैश्रवणो देवस्तत्र कालेन केनचित् । आगतः पितरं द्रष्टुं पुष्पकेण धनेश्वरः ।। 7.9.40 ।।
transliteration: atha vaiśravaṇo devastatra kālena kenacit | āgataḥ pitaraṃ draṣṭuṃ puṣpakeṇa dhaneśvaraḥ || 7.9.40 ||
translation: अथ then, वैश्रवणो Vaishravana, देवः the god, तत्र there, कालेन केनचित् after some time, आगतः came, पितरं father, द्रष्टुं to see, पुष्पकेण by Pushpaka (chariot), धनेश्वरः the lord of wealth.
explanation: Then, after some time, the god Vaishravana, the lord of wealth, came there in his Pushpaka chariot to see his father.

shloka_text: तं दृष्ट्वा कैकसी तत्र ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा । आगम्य राक्षसी तत्र दशग्रीवमुवाच ह ।। 7.9.41 ।।
transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā kaikasī tatra jvalantamiva tejasā | āgamya rākṣasī tatra daśagrīvamuvāca ha || 7.9.41 ||
translation: तम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, कैकसी Kaikasi, तत्र there, ज्वलन्तम् shining, इव as if, तेजसा with splendor, आगम्य having come, राक्षसी the demoness, तत्र there, दशग्रीवम् to Dashagriva, उवाच said, ह indeed
explanation: Having seen him (Kubera) shining with splendor there, Kaikasi, the demoness, came to Dashagriva (Ravana) and indeed spoke to him.

shloka_text: पुत्र वैश्रवणं पश्य भ्रातरं तेजसा वृतम् । भ्रातृभावे समे चापि पश्यात्मानं त्वमीदृशम् ।। 7.9.42 ।।
transliteration: putra vaiśravaṇaṃ paśya bhrātaraṃ tejasā vṛtam | bhrātṛbhāve same cāpi paśyātmānaṃ tvamīdṛśam || 7.9.42 ||
translation: पुत्र O son, वैश्रवणम् Vaishravana, पश्य behold, भ्रातरम् your brother, तेजसा with splendor, वृतम् endowed, भ्रातृभावे in brotherhood, समे equal, च and, अपि even, पश्य behold, आत्मानम् yourself, त्वम् you, ईदृशम् such
explanation: "O son, behold your brother Vaishravana, endowed with splendor, and even though you are equal in brotherhood, behold yourself in such a state."

shloka_text: दशग्रीव तथा यत्नं कुरुष्वामितविक्रम । यथा त्वमसि मे पुत्र भव र्वैश्रवणोपमः ।। 7.9.43 ।।
transliteration: daśagrīva tathā yatnaṃ kuruṣvāmitavikrama | yathā tvamasi me putra bhava rvaiśravaṇopamaḥ || 7.9.43 ||
translation: दशग्रीव O Dashagriva, तथा thus, यत्नम् effort, कुरुष्व make, अमितविक्रम O one of immeasurable valor, यथा so that, त्वम् you, असि are, मे my, पुत्र son, भव become, वैश्रवणोपमः equal to Vaishravana
explanation: "O Dashagriva, O one of immeasurable valor, make such an effort, my son, so that you become equal to Vaishravana."

shloka_text: मातुस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान् । अमर्षमतुलं लेभे प्रतिज्ञां चाकरोत्तदा ।। 7.9.44 ।।
transliteration: mātustadvacanaṃ śrutvā daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān | amarṣamatulaṃ lebhe pratijñāṃ cākarottadā || 7.9.44 ||
translation: मातुः of the mother, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रतापवान् valorous, अमर्षम् indignation, अतुलम् unequalled, लेभे obtained, प्रतिज्ञाम् a vow, च and, अकरोत् made, तदा then
explanation: Having heard that speech of his mother, the valorous Dashagriva felt unequalled indignation and then made a vow.

shloka_text: सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि भ्रातृतुल्यो ऽधिको ऽपि वा । भविष्याम्योजसा चैव सन्तापं त्यज हृद्गतम् ।। 7.9.45 ।।
transliteration: satyaṃ te pratijānāmi bhrātṛtulyo 'dhiko 'pi vā | bhaviṣyāmyojasā caiva santāpaṃ tyaja hṛdgatam || 7.9.45 ||
translation: सत्यम् truly, ते to you, प्रतिजानामि I promise, भ्रातृतुल्यः equal to brother, अधिकः superior, अपि even, वा or, भविष्यामि I shall become, ओजसा with might, च and, एव indeed, सन्तापम् sorrow, त्यज abandon, हृद्गतम् residing in the heart
explanation: "Truly, I promise you that I shall become either equal to or even superior to my brother in might; therefore, abandon the sorrow residing in your heart."

shloka_text: ततस्तेनैव कोपेन दशग्रीवः सहानुजः । चिकीर्षुर्दुष्करं कर्म तपसे धृतमानसः ।। 7.9.46 ।।
transliteration: tatastenaiva kopena daśagrīvaḥ sahānujaḥ | cikīrṣurduṣkaraṃ karma tapase dhṛtamānasaḥ || 7.9.46 ||
translation: ततः then, तेनैव by that very, कोपेन anger, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, सहानुजः with his younger brothers, चिकीर्षुः desiring to do, दुष्करं difficult, कर्म deed, तपसे for penance, धृतमानसः with a mind set
explanation: Then, filled with that very anger, Dashagriva, along with his younger brothers, set his mind on performing a difficult penance.

shloka_text: प्राप्स्यामि तपसा काममिति कृत्वा ऽध्यवस्य च । आगच्छदात्मसिद्ध्यर्थं गोकर्णस्याश्रमं शुभम् ।। 7.9.47 ।।
transliteration: prāpsyāmi tapasā kāmamiti kṛtvā 'dhyavasya ca | āgacchadātmasiddhyarthaṃ gokarṇasyāśramaṃ śubham || 7.9.47 ||
translation: प्राप्स्यामि I shall obtain, तपसा through penance, कामम् my desire, इति thus, कृत्वा having thought, अध्यवस्य having resolved, च and, आगच्छत् he came, आत्मसिद्ध्यर्थं for the accomplishment of his own purpose, गोकर्णस्य of Gokarna, आश्रमं hermitage, शुभम् auspicious
explanation: Having resolved that he would achieve his desires through penance, he then came to the auspicious hermitage of Gokarna for the accomplishment of his own purpose.

shloka_text: स राक्षसस्तत्र सहानुजस्तदा तपश्चकारातुलमुग्रविक्रमः । अतोषयच्चापि पितामहं विभुं ददौ स तुष्टश्च वराञ्जयावहान् ।। 7.9.48 ।।
transliteration: sa rākṣasastatra sahānujastadā tapaścakārātulamugravikramaḥ | atoṣayaccāpi pitāmahaṃ vibhuṃ dadau sa tuṣṭaśca varāñjayāvahān || 7.9.48 ||
translation: सः that, राक्षसः demon, तत्र there, सहानुजः with his younger brothers, तदा then, तपश्चकार performed penance, अतुलम् incomparable, उग्रविक्रमः of fierce prowess, अतोषयत् he pleased, च and, अपि also, पितामहं the grandfather (Brahma), विभुं the lord, ददौ he gave, सः he, तुष्टः pleased, च and, वरान् boons, जयावहान् bringing victory
explanation: That demon of fierce prowess, along with his younger brothers, then performed incomparable penance there, and he also pleased the lord Brahma, who, being pleased, granted him boons that brought victory. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे नवमः सर्गः ।। 9 ।। Thus ends the ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: अथाब्रवीन्मुनिं रामः कथं ते भ्रातरो वने । कीदृशं तु तदा ब्रह्मंस्तपस्तेपुर्महाबलाः ।। 7.10.1 ।।
transliteration: athābravīnmuniṃ rāmaḥ kathaṃ te bhrātaro vane | kīdṛśaṃ tu tadā brahmaṃstapastepurmahābalāḥ || 7.10.1 ||
translation: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, मुनिं to the sage, रामः Rama, कथं how, ते your, भ्रातरः brothers, वने in the forest, कीदृशं what kind, तु indeed, तदा then, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, तपः penance, तेपुः performed, महाबलाः the mighty ones
explanation: Then Rama asked the sage, "O Brahmana, how did your mighty brothers perform penance in the forest, and what kind of penance was it?"
comments: The brothers' penances -- Kumbhakarna's austerities amid the five fires, water and the Virasana, and Vibhishana standing on one foot worshipping the sun -- Ravana offers nine of his heads into the fire over nine thousand years until Brahma appears and grants him invulnerability to all divine and demonic beings (he scorns mere humans), restores his heads and the power to change form at will -- Vibhishana asks only for an ever-righteous mind and the Brahmastra and is granted immortality -- at the gods' plea Saraswati twists Kumbhakarna's tongue so that he begs for endless sleep.

shloka_text: अगस्त्यस्त्वब्रवीत्तत्र रामं सुप्रीतमानसम् । तांस्तान्धर्मविधींस्तत्र भ्रातरस्ते समाविशन् ।। 7.10.2 ।।
transliteration: agastyastvabravīttatra rāmaṃ suprītamānasam | tāṃstāndharmavidhīṃstatra bhrātaraste samāviśan || 7.10.2 ||
translation: अगस्त्यः Agastya, तु indeed, अब्रवीत् spoke, तत्र there, रामं to Rama, सुप्रीतमानसम् with a very pleased mind, तान् तान् those various, धर्मविधीन् religious observances, तत्र there, भ्रातरः brothers, ते your, समाविशन् undertook
explanation: Agastya, with a very pleased mind, then spoke to Rama there, explaining that his brothers had undertaken various religious observances in that place.

shloka_text: कुम्भकर्णस्ततो यत्तो नित्यं धर्मपथे स्थितः । तताप ग्रीष्मकाले तु पञ्चाग्नीन्परितः स्थितः ।। 7.10.3 ।।
transliteration: kumbhakarṇastato yatto nityaṃ dharmapathe sthitaḥ | tatāpa grīṣmakāle tu pañcāgnīnparitaḥ sthitaḥ || 7.10.3 ||
translation: कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, ततः then, यत्तः diligent, नित्यम् always, धर्मपथे on the path of righteousness, स्थितः situated, तताप performed penance, ग्रीष्मकाले in the summer season, तु indeed, पञ्चाग्नीन् five fires, परितः around, स्थितः standing.
explanation: Then, Kumbhakarna, always diligent and situated on the path of righteousness, performed penance by standing amidst five fires during the summer season.

shloka_text: मेघाम्बुसिक्तो वर्षासु वीरासनमसेवत । नित्यं च शिशिरे काले जलमध्यप्रतिश्रयः ।। 7.10.4 ।।
transliteration: meghāmbusikto varṣāsu vīrāsanamasevata | nityaṃ ca śiśire kāle jalamadhyapratiśrayaḥ || 7.10.4 ||
translation: मेघाम्बुसिक्तः drenched by rainwater, वर्षासु in the rainy season, वीरासनम् the hero's posture, असेवत he practiced, नित्यम् always, च and, शिशिरे in the cold, काले season, जलमध्यप्रतिश्रयः taking refuge in the middle of water.
explanation: In the rainy season, he practiced the Vīrāsana posture, drenched by rainwater, and always took refuge in the middle of water during the cold season.

shloka_text: एवं वर्षसहस्राणि दश तस्यातिचक्रमुः । धर्मे प्रयतमानस्य सत्पथे निष्ठितस्य च ।। 7.10.5 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi daśa tasyāticakramuḥ | dharme prayatamānasya satpathe niṣṭhitasya ca || 7.10.5 ||
translation: एवम् thus, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, दश ten, तस्य for him, अतिचक्रमुः passed by, धर्मे in righteousness, प्रयतमानस्य striving, सत्पथे on the path of truth, निष्ठितस्य established, च and.
explanation: Thus, ten thousand years passed for him, who was striving in righteousness and firmly established on the path of truth.

shloka_text: विभीषणस्तु धर्मात्मा नित्यं धर्मपरः शुचिः । पञ्चवर्षसहस्राणि पादेनैकेन तस्थिवान् ।। 7.10.6 ।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇastu dharmātmā nityaṃ dharmaparaḥ śuciḥ | pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi pādenaikena tasthivān || 7.10.6 ||
translation: विभीषणः Vibhishana, तु but, धर्मात्मा righteous-souled, नित्यम् always, धर्मपरः devoted to righteousness, शुचिः pure, पञ्चवर्षसहस्राणि five thousand years, पादेन with a foot, एकेन one, तस्थिवान् he stood.
explanation: But Vibhishana, righteous-souled, always devoted to righteousness, and pure, stood on one foot for five thousand years.

shloka_text: समाप्ते नियमे तस्य ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः । पपात पुष्पवर्षं च क्षुभिताश्चापि देवताः ।। 7.10.7 ।।
transliteration: samāpte niyame tasya nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ | papāta puṣpavarṣaṃ ca kṣubhitāścāpi devatāḥ || 7.10.7 ||
translation: तस्य his, नियमे vow, समाप्ते when completed, अप्सरोगणाः the hosts of apsaras, ननृतुः danced, पुष्पवर्षं च and a rain of flowers, पपात fell, देवताः the gods, क्षुभिताश्चापि were also stirred (with joy).
explanation: When his austerity was completed, the hosts of apsaras danced, a rain of flowers fell, and the gods too were stirred with joy.

shloka_text: पञ्चवर्षसहस्राणि सूर्यं चैवान्ववर्तत । तस्थौ चोर्ध्वशिरोबाहुः स्वाध्यायधृतमानसः ।। 7.10.8 ।।
transliteration: pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi sūryaṃ caivānvavartata | tasthau cordhvaśirobāhuḥ svādhyāyadhṛtamānasaḥ || 7.10.8 ||
translation: पञ्चवर्षसहस्राणि five thousand years, सूर्यम् the sun, च and, एव indeed, अन्ववर्तत he worshipped, तस्थौ he stood, च and, ऊर्ध्वशिरोबाहुः with head and arms raised, स्वाध्यायधृतमानसः with mind fixed on self-study.
explanation: For five thousand years, he worshipped the sun, and he stood with his head and arms raised, his mind fixed on self-study.

shloka_text: एवं विभीषणस्यापि स्वर्गस्थस्येव नन्दने । दशवर्षसहस्राणि गतानि नियतात्मनः ।। 7.10.9 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ vibhīṣaṇasyāpi svargasthasyeva nandane | daśavarṣasahasrāṇi gatāni niyatātmanaḥ || 7.10.9 ||
translation: एवं thus, विभीषणस्यापि of Vibhishana also, स्वर्गस्थस्येव like one residing in heaven, नन्दने in Nandana (garden of Indra), दशवर्षसहस्राणि ten thousand years, गतानि passed, नियतात्मनः of him whose self was controlled (self-controlled)
explanation: In this manner, ten thousand years passed for the self-controlled Vibhishana, as if he were residing in the Nandana garden of heaven.

shloka_text: दशवर्षसहस्रं तु निराहारो दशाननः । पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु शिरश्चाग्नौ जुहाव सः ।। 7.10.10 ।।
transliteration: daśavarṣasahasraṃ tu nirāhāro daśānanaḥ | pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu śiraścāgnau juhāva saḥ || 7.10.10 ||
translation: दशवर्षसहस्रं ten thousand years, तु indeed, निराहारो without food, दशाननः Dashanana (Ravana), पूर्णे when completed, वर्षसहस्रे a thousand years, तु indeed, शिरश्चाग्नौ and his head into the fire, जुहाव offered as oblation, सः he
explanation: Dashanana (Ravana) fasted for ten thousand years, and upon the completion of each thousand years, he offered one of his heads into the fire as an oblation.

shloka_text: एवं वर्षसहस्राणि नव तस्यातिचक्रमुः । शिरांसि नव चाप्यस्य प्रविष्टानि हुताशनम् ।। 7.10.11 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi nava tasyāticakramuḥ | śirāṃsi nava cāpyasya praviṣṭāni hutāśanam || 7.10.11 ||
translation: एवं thus, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, नव nine, तस्यातिचक्रमुः passed for him, शिरांसि heads, नव nine, चाप्यस्य and also of him, प्रविष्टानि entered, हुताशनम् the fire
explanation: In this manner, nine thousand years passed for him, and nine of his heads were offered into the fire.

shloka_text: अथ वर्षसहस्रे तु दशमे दशमं शिरः । छेत्तुकामे दशग्रीवे प्राप्तस्तत्र पितामहः ।। 7.10.12 ।।
transliteration: atha varṣasahasre tu daśame daśamaṃ śiraḥ | chettukāme daśagrīve prāptastatra pitāmahaḥ || 7.10.12 ||
translation: अथ then, वर्षसहस्रे in the thousand years, तु indeed, दशमे tenth, दशमं tenth, शिरः head, छेत्तुकामे desiring to cut off, दशग्रीवे when Dashagriva (Ravana), प्राप्तस्तत्र arrived there, पितामहः the grandfather (Brahma)
explanation: Then, in the tenth thousand-year period, as Dashagriva (Ravana) was about to cut off his tenth head, Lord Brahma arrived there.

shloka_text: पितामहस्तु सुप्रीतः सार्धं देवैरुपस्थितः । तव तावद्दशग्रीव प्रीतो ऽस्मीत्यभ्यभाषत ।। 7.10.13 ।।
transliteration: pitāmahastu suprītaḥ sārdhaṃ devairupasthitaḥ | tava tāvaddaśagrīva prīto 'smītyabhyabhāṣata || 7.10.13 ||
translation: पितामहस्तु but the grandfather (Brahma), सुप्रीतः very pleased, सार्धं together with, देवैरुपस्थितः appeared with the gods, तव to you, तावद्दशग्रीव O Dashagriva, प्रीतो pleased, अस्मीत्यभ्यभाषत I am, thus he spoke
explanation: The grandfather (Brahma), greatly pleased, appeared there with the gods and addressed Dashagriva (Ravana), saying, "O Dashagriva, I am pleased with you."

shloka_text: शीघ्रं वरय धर्मज्ञ वरो यस्ते ऽभिकाङ्क्षितः । कं ते कामं करोम्यद्य न वृथा ते परिश्रमः ।। 7.10.14 ।।
transliteration: śīghraṃ varaya dharmajña varo yaste 'bhikāṅkṣitaḥ | kaṃ te kāmaṃ karomyadya na vṛthā te pariśramaḥ || 7.10.14 ||
translation: शीघ्रं quickly, वरय choose, धर्मज्ञ O knower of dharma, वरः boon, यः which, ते your, अभिकाङ्क्षितः desired, कम् what, ते your, कामम् desire, करोमि I do, अद्य today, न not, वृथा in vain, ते your, परिश्रमः effort.
explanation: Brahma tells Ravana, "O righteous one, quickly choose the boon you desire; what wish of yours shall I fulfill today, for your effort will not be in vain."

shloka_text: अथाब्रवीदृशग्रीवः प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना । प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं हर्षगद्गदया गिरा ।। 7.10.15 ।।
transliteration: athābravīdṛśagrīvaḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā | praṇamya śirasā devaṃ harṣagadgadayā girā || 7.10.15 ||
translation: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रहृष्टेन with delighted, अन्तरात्मना inner self, प्रणम्य having bowed down, शिरसा with head, देवम् to the god, हर्षगद्गदया with a voice choked with joy, गिरा with speech.
explanation: Then, Dashagriva, with a joyful heart, bowed his head to the god and spoke with a voice choked with happiness.

shloka_text: भगवन्प्राणिनां नित्यं नान्यत्र मरणाद्भयम् । नास्ति मृत्युसमः शत्रुरमरत्वमहं वृणे ।। 7.10.16 ।।
transliteration: bhagavanprāṇināṃ nityaṃ nānyatra maraṇādbhayam | nāsti mṛtyusamaḥ śatruramaratvamahaṃ vṛṇe || 7.10.16 ||
translation: भगवन् O Lord, प्राणिनाम् of living beings, नित्यम् always, न not, अन्यत्र elsewhere, मरणात् from death, भयम् fear, न not, अस्ति is, मृत्युसमः equal to death, शत्रुः enemy, अमरत्वम् immortality, अहम् I, वृणे choose.
explanation: Ravana addressed Brahma, stating that living beings constantly fear nothing but death, for there is no enemy equal to death, and therefore he desired immortality.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तदा ब्रह्मा दशग्रीवमुवाच ह । नास्ति सर्वामरत्वं ते वरमन्यं वृणीष्व मे ।। 7.10.17 ।।
transliteration: evamuktastadā brahmā daśagrīvamuvāca ha | nāsti sarvāmaratvaṃ te varamanyaṃ vṛṇīṣva me || 7.10.17 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, तदा then, ब्रह्मा Brahma, दशग्रीवम् to Dashagriva, उवाच said, ह indeed, न not, अस्ति is, सर्वामरत्वम् complete immortality, ते for you, वरम् boon, अन्यम् another, वृणीष्व choose, मे from me.
explanation: When thus addressed, Brahma then said to Dashagriva that complete immortality was not possible for him, and he should choose another boon from him.

shloka_text: एवमुक्ते तदा राम ब्रह्मणा लोककर्तृणा । दशग्रीव उवाचेदं कृताञ्जलिरथाग्रतः ।। 7.10.18 ।।
transliteration: evamukte tadā rāma brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā | daśagrīva uvācedaṃ kṛtāñjalirathāgrataḥ || 7.10.18 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्ते when spoken, तदा then, राम O Rama, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, लोककर्तृणा by the creator of the worlds, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, उवाच said, इदम् this, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, अथ then, अग्रतः in front.
explanation: O Rama, when Brahma, the creator of the worlds, spoke thus, Dashagriva then, with folded hands before him, said the following.

shloka_text: सुपर्णनागयक्षाणां दैत्यदानवरक्षसाम् । अवध्यो ऽहं प्रजाध्यक्ष देवतानां च शाश्वत ।। 7.10.19 ।।
transliteration: suparṇanāgayakṣāṇāṃ daityadānavarakṣasām | avadhyo 'haṃ prajādhyakṣa devatānāṃ ca śāśvata || 7.10.19 ||
translation: सुपर्णनागयक्षाणां of Suparnas, Nagas, and Yakshas, दैत्यदानवरक्षसाम् of Daityas, Danavas, and Rakshasas, अवध्यो invulnerable, अहं I, प्रजाध्यक्ष O Lord of creatures, देवतानां of gods, च and, शाश्वत O Eternal One.
explanation: Ravana declares to Brahma that he is invulnerable to Suparnas, Nagas, Yakshas, Daityas, Danavas, Rakshasas, and gods.

shloka_text: नहि चिन्ता ममान्येषु प्राणिष्वमरपूजित । तृणभूता हि ते मन्ये प्राणिनो मानुषादयः ।। 7.10.20 ।।
transliteration: nahi cintā mamānyeṣu prāṇiṣvamarapūjita | tṛṇabhūtā hi te manye prāṇino mānuṣādayaḥ || 7.10.20 ||
translation: नहि not indeed, चिन्ता concern, मम my, अन्येषु in other, प्राणिषु creatures, अमरपूजित O worshipped by immortals, तृणभूता like grass, हि indeed, ते those, मन्ये I consider, प्राणिनो creatures, मानुषादयः humans and others.
explanation: Ravana states that he has no concern for other creatures, especially humans and the like, whom he considers as insignificant as grass.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु धर्मात्मा दशग्रीवेण रक्षसा । उवाच वचनं देवः सह देवैः पितामहः ।। 7.10.21 ।।
transliteration: evamuktastu dharmātmā daśagrīveṇa rakṣasā | uvāca vacanaṃ devaḥ saha devaiḥ pitāmahaḥ || 7.10.21 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तस्तु having been spoken to, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, दशग्रीवेण by Dashagriva, रक्षसा by the Rakshasa, उवाच spoke, वचनं words, देवः the god, सह with, देवैः the gods, पितामहः the grandfather.
explanation: Thus addressed by the Rakshasa Dashagriva, the righteous god Brahma, accompanied by other deities, spoke.

shloka_text: भविष्यत्येवमेतत्ते वचो राक्षसपुङ्गव । एवमुक्त्वा तु तं राम दशग्रीवं पितामहः ।। 7.10.22 ।।
transliteration: bhaviṣyatyevametatte vaco rākṣasapuṅgava | evamuktvā tu taṃ rāma daśagrīvaṃ pitāmahaḥ || 7.10.22 ||
translation: भविष्यति it will be, एवम् thus, एतत् this, ते your, वचो word, राक्षसपुङ्गव O chief of Rakshasas. एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, तु indeed, तं to him, राम O Rama, दशग्रीवं to Dashagriva, पितामहः the grandfather.
explanation: Brahma granted Ravana's wish, saying, "So shall it be, O chief of Rakshasas," and having thus spoken to Dashagriva, O Rama, the grandfather continued.

shloka_text: शृणु चापि वरो भूयः प्रीतस्येह शुभो मम । हुतानि यानि शीर्षाणि पूर्वमग्नौ त्वयानघ ।। 7.10.23 ।।
transliteration: śṛṇu cāpi varo bhūyaḥ prītasyeha śubho mama | hutāni yāni śīrṣāṇi pūrvamagnau tvayānagha || 7.10.23 ||
translation: शृणु listen, च and, अपि also, वरो boon, भूयः further, प्रीतस्य of the pleased one, इह here, शुभः auspicious, मम my. हुतानि offered, यानि which, शीर्षाणि heads, पूर्वम् formerly, अग्नौ in the fire, त्वया by you, अनघ O sinless one.
explanation: Brahma further offered an auspicious boon, asking Ravana to listen, regarding the heads he had previously offered into the fire.

shloka_text: पुनस्तानि भविष्यन्ति तथैव तव राक्षस । वितरामीह ते सौम्य वरं चान्यं दुरासदम् ।। 7.10.24 ।।
transliteration: punastāni bhaviṣyanti tathaiva tava rākṣasa | vitarāmīha te saumya varaṃ cānyaṃ durāsadam || 7.10.24 ||
translation: पुनः again, तानि those, भविष्यन्ति will be, तथैव just so, तव your, राक्षस O Rakshasa, वितरामि I grant, इह here, ते to you, सौम्य O gentle one, वरं boon, च and, अन्यं another, दुरासदम् difficult to obtain.
explanation: O Rakshasa, those (heads) will be yours again just as before, and here I grant you, O gentle one, another formidable boon.

shloka_text: छन्दतस्तव रूपं च मनसा यद्यथेप्सितम् । भविष्यति न सन्देहो मद्वरात्तवराक्षस ।। 7.10.25 ।।
transliteration: chandatastava rūpaṃ ca manasā yadyathepsitam | bhaviṣyati na sandeho madvarāttavarākṣasa || 7.10.25 ||
translation: छन्दतः according to your will, तव your, रूपं form, च and, मनसा by mind, यत् whatever, यथा as, ईप्सितम् desired, भविष्यति will be, न not, सन्देहः doubt, मद्वरात् from my boon, तव your, राक्षस O Rakshasa.
explanation: O Rakshasa, whatever form you desire in your mind will be yours according to your will, without a doubt, by virtue of my boon.

shloka_text: एवं पितामहोक्तस्य दशग्रीवस्य रक्षसः । अग्नौ हुतानि शीर्षाणि पुनस्तान्युत्थितानि वै ।। 7.10.26 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ pitāmahoktasya daśagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ | agnau hutāni śīrṣāṇi punastānyutthitāni vai || 7.10.26 ||
translation: एवं thus, पितामह by the grandfather, उक्तस्य spoken to, दशग्रीवस्य of Dashagriva, रक्षसः of the Rakshasa, अग्नौ in the fire, हुतानि offered, शीर्षाणि heads, पुनः again, तानि those, उत्थितानि arose, वै indeed.
explanation: Thus, to Dashagriva, the Rakshasa, who was addressed by the grandfather (Brahma), those heads that had been offered into the fire indeed arose again.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा तु तं राम दशग्रीवं पितामहः । विभीषणमथोवाच वाक्यं लोकपितामहः ।। 7.10.27 ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu taṃ rāma daśagrīvaṃ pitāmahaḥ | vibhīṣaṇamathovāca vākyaṃ lokapitāmahaḥ || 7.10.27 ||
translation: एवं thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, तु indeed, तं to him, राम O Rama, दशग्रीवं to Dashagriva, पितामहः the grandfather, विभीषणम् to Vibhishana, अथ then, उवाच spoke, वाक्यं words, लोकपितामहः the grandfather of the worlds.
explanation: O Rama, having thus spoken to Dashagriva, the grandfather of the worlds (Brahma) then spoke these words to Vibhishana.

shloka_text: विभीषण त्वया वत्स धर्मसंहितबुद्धिना । परितुष्टो ऽस्मि धर्मात्मन्वरं वरय सुव्रत ।। 7.10.28 ।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇa tvayā vatsa dharmasaṃhitabuddhinā | parituṣṭo 'smi dharmātmanvaraṃ varaya suvrata || 7.10.28 ||
translation: विभीषण O Vibhishana, त्वया by you, वत्स O dear child, धर्मसंहितबुद्धिना by one whose intellect is joined with righteousness, परितुष्टः greatly pleased, अस्मि I am, धर्मात्मन् O righteous-souled one, वरं boon, वरय choose, सुव्रत O virtuous one.
explanation: O Vibhishana, O dear child, I am greatly pleased by you, O righteous-souled one, whose intellect is aligned with dharma; therefore, O virtuous one, choose a boon.

shloka_text: विभीषणस्तु धर्मात्मा वचनं प्राह साञ्जलिः । वृतः सर्वगुणैर्नित्यं चन्द्रमा रश्मिभिर्यथा ।। 7.10.29 ।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇastu dharmātmā vacanaṃ prāha sāñjaliḥ | vṛtaḥ sarvaguṇairnityaṃ candramā raśmibhiryathā || 7.10.29 ||
translation: विभीषणस्तु Vibhishana, however, धर्मात्मा the righteous-souled one, वचनं words, प्राह spoke, साञ्जलिः with folded hands, वृतः surrounded, सर्वगुणैः by all good qualities, नित्यं always, चन्द्रमा the moon, रश्मिभिर्यथा as by its rays.
explanation: The righteous Vibhishana, always adorned with all virtues like the moon surrounded by its rays, spoke with folded hands.

shloka_text: भगवन्कृतकृत्यो ऽहं यन्मे लोकगुरुः स्वयम् । प्रीतेन यदि दातव्यो वरो मे शृणु सुव्रत ।। 7.10.30 ।।
transliteration: bhagavankṛtakṛtyo 'haṃ yanme lokaguruḥ svayam | prītena yadi dātavyo varo me śṛṇu suvrata || 7.10.30 ||
translation: भगवन् O Lord, कृतकृत्यो having accomplished my purpose, अहं I am, यन्मे because to me, लोकगुरुः the preceptor of the world, स्वयम् himself, प्रीतेन pleased, यदि if, दातव्यो is to be given, वरो a boon, मे to me, शृणु listen, सुव्रत O one of good vows.
explanation: O Lord of good vows, I am fulfilled because the preceptor of the world himself is pleased with me; if a boon is to be granted to me, please listen.

shloka_text: परमापद्गतस्यापि धर्मे मम मतिर्भवेत् । अशिक्षितं च ब्रह्मास्त्रं भगवन्प्रतिभातु मे ।। 7.10.31 ।।
transliteration: paramāpadgatasyāpi dharme mama matirbhavet | aśikṣitaṃ ca brahmāstraṃ bhagavanpratibhātu me || 7.10.31 ||
translation: परमापद्गतस्यापि even when fallen into extreme distress, धर्मे in righteousness, मम my, मतिर्भवेत् mind should be, अशिक्षितं untaught, च and, ब्रह्मास्त्रं the Brahmastra, भगवन् O Lord, प्रतिभातु may it appear/manifest, मे to me.
explanation: O Lord, may my mind always remain fixed on righteousness even in the greatest calamity, and may the Brahmastra manifest to me even without formal instruction.

shloka_text: या या मे जायते बुद्धिर्येषु येष्वाश्रमेषु च । सा सा भवतु धर्मिष्ठा तं तु धर्मं च पालये ।। 7.10.32 ।।
transliteration: yā yā me jāyate buddhiryeṣu yeṣvāśrameṣu ca | sā sā bhavatu dharmiṣṭhā taṃ tu dharmaṃ ca pālaye || 7.10.32 ||
translation: या या whatever, मे my, जायते arises, बुद्धिर् intellect/thought, येषु येष्वाश्रमेषु in whichever stages of life, च and, सा सा that, that (same), भवतु may it be, धर्मिष्ठा most righteous, तं तु that, however, धर्मं righteousness, च and, पालये may I protect/observe.
explanation: May whatever thoughts arise in my mind, in whichever stage of life, always be righteous, and may I always uphold that righteousness.

shloka_text: एष मे परमोदार वरः परमको मतः । नहि धर्माभिरक्तानां लोके किञ्चन दुर्लभम् ।। 7.10.33 ।।
transliteration: eṣa me paramodāra varaḥ paramako mataḥ | nahi dharmābhiraktānāṃ loke kiñcana durlabham || 7.10.33 ||
translation: एष this, मे my, परमोदार most noble, वरः boon, परमको supreme, मतः considered, नहि indeed not, धर्माभिरक्तानां for those devoted to righteousness, लोके in the world, किञ्चन anything, दुर्लभम् difficult to obtain.
explanation: This is considered my most noble and supreme boon, for indeed, nothing is difficult to obtain in this world for those who are devoted to righteousness.

shloka_text: पुनः प्रजापतिः प्रीतो विभीषणमुवाच ह । धर्मिष्ठस्त्वं यथा वत्स तथा चैतद्भविष्यति ।। 7.10.34 ।।
transliteration: punaḥ prajāpatiḥ prīto vibhīṣaṇamuvāca ha | dharmiṣṭhastvaṃ yathā vatsa tathā caitadbhaviṣyati || 7.10.34 ||
translation: पुनः again, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, प्रीतः pleased, विभीषणम् to Vibhishana, उवाच said, ह indeed, धर्मिष्ठः righteous, त्वम् you, यथा as, वत्स dear child, तथा so, च and, एतत् this, भविष्यति will be
explanation: Prajapati, being pleased, again said to Vibhishana, "As you are righteous, dear child, so shall this be."

shloka_text: यस्माद्राक्षसयोनौ ते जातस्यामित्रनाशन । नाधर्मे जायते बुद्धिरमरत्वं ददामि ते ।। 7.10.35 ।।
transliteration: yasmādrākṣasayonau te jātasyāmitranāśana | nādharme jāyate buddhiramaratvaṃ dadāmi te || 7.10.35 ||
translation: यस्मात् because, राक्षसयोनौ in the demon lineage, ते your, जातस्य having been born, अमित्रनाशन O destroyer of enemies, न not, अधर्मे in unrighteousness, जायते arises, बुद्धिः intellect, अमरत्वम् immortality, ददामि I give, ते to you
explanation: Because, O destroyer of enemies, though born in a demon lineage, your mind does not incline towards unrighteousness, I grant you immortality.

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा कुम्भकर्णाय वरं दातुमुपस्थितम् । प्रजापतिं सुराः सर्वे वाक्यं प्राञ्जलयो ऽब्रुवन् ।। 7.10.36 ।।
transliteration: ityuktvā kumbhakarṇāya varaṃ dātumupasthitam | prajāpatiṃ surāḥ sarve vākyaṃ prāñjalayo 'bruvan || 7.10.36 ||
translation: इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, कुम्भकर्णाय to Kumbhakarna, वरम् a boon, दातुम् to give, उपस्थितम् who was ready, प्रजापतिम् to Prajapati, सुराः gods, सर्वे all, वाक्यम् words, प्राञ्जलयः with folded hands, अब्रुवन् said
explanation: Having thus spoken, when Prajapati was about to grant a boon to Kumbhakarna, all the gods, with folded hands, spoke to him.

shloka_text: न तावत्कुम्भकर्णाय प्रदातव्यो वरस्त्वया । जानीषे हि यथा लोकांस्त्रासयत्येष दुर्मतिः ।। 7.10.37 ।।
transliteration: na tāvatkumbhakarṇāya pradātavyo varastvayā | jānīṣe hi yathā lokāṃstrāsayatyeṣa durmatiḥ || 7.10.37 ||
translation: न not, तावत् then, कुम्भकर्णाय to Kumbhakarna, प्रदातव्यः should be given, वरः a boon, त्वया by you, जानीषे you know, हि indeed, यथा how, लोकान् the worlds, त्रासयति frightens, एषः this, दुर्मतिः evil-minded one
explanation: "A boon should not be granted by you to Kumbhakarna at this time, for you indeed know how this evil-minded one terrorizes the worlds."

shloka_text: नन्दने ऽप्सरसः सप्त महेन्द्रानुचरा दश । अनेन भक्षिता ब्रह्मन्नृषयो मानुषास्तथा ।। 7.10.38 ।।
transliteration: nandane 'psarasaḥ sapta mahendrānucarā daśa | anena bhakṣitā brahmannṛṣayo mānuṣāstathā || 7.10.38 ||
translation: नन्दने in Nandana, अप्सरसः Apsaras, सप्त seven, महेन्द्रानुचराः followers of Mahendra, दश ten, अनेन by him, भक्षिताः devoured, ब्रह्मन् O Brahman, ऋषयः sages, मानुषाः humans, तथा and also
explanation: O Brahman, by him, seven Apsaras in Nandana, ten followers of Mahendra, as well as sages and humans, have been devoured.

shloka_text: अलब्धवरपूर्वेण यत्कृतं राक्षसेन तु । तदेष वरलब्धः स्याद्भक्षयेद्भुवनत्रयम् ।। 7.10.39 ।।
transliteration: alabdhavarapūrveṇa yatkṛtaṃ rākṣasena tu | tadeṣa varalabdhaḥ syādbhakṣayedbhuvanatrayam || 7.10.39 ||
translation: अलब्धवरपूर्वेण by one who had not previously obtained a boon, यत् whatever, कृतं was done, राक्षसेन by the demon, तु indeed, तत् that, एषः this one, वरलब्धः having obtained a boon, स्यात् would be, भक्षयेत् would devour, भुवनत्रयम् the three worlds.
explanation: Whatever was done by the demon before he obtained a boon, this demon, now having obtained a boon, would indeed devour the three worlds.

shloka_text: वरव्याजेन मोहो ऽस्मै दीयताममितप्रभ । लोकानां स्वस्ति चैवं स्याद्भवेदस्य च सन्नतिः ।। 7.10.40 ।।
transliteration: varavyājena moho 'smai dīyatāmamitaprabha | lokānāṃ svasti caivaṃ syādbhavedasya ca sannatiḥ || 7.10.40 ||
translation: वरव्याजेन by the pretext of a boon, मोहः delusion, अस्मै to him, दीयताम् let it be given, अमितप्रभ O one of immeasurable splendor, लोकानां for the worlds, स्वस्ति welfare, च and, एवं thus, स्यात् may it be, भवेत् may it be, अस्य his, च and, सन्नतिः downfall.
explanation: O one of immeasurable splendor, let delusion be given to him under the guise of a boon, and thus there would be welfare for the worlds and his downfall.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तः सुरैर्ब्रह्मा ऽचिन्तयत् पद्मसम्भवः । चिन्तिता चोपतस्थे ऽस्य पार्श्वं देवी सरस्वती ।। 7.10.41 ।।
transliteration: evamuktaḥ surairbrahmā 'cintayat padmasambhavaḥ | cintitā copatasthe 'sya pārśvaṃ devī sarasvatī || 7.10.41 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, सुरैः by the gods, ब्रह्मा Brahma, अचिन्तयत् thought, पद्मसम्भवः born from a lotus, चिन्तिता having been thought of, च and, उपतस्थे approached, अस्य his, पार्श्वं side, देवी goddess, सरस्वती Saraswati.
explanation: Thus addressed by the gods, Brahma, born from a lotus, pondered, and as he thought, the goddess Saraswati approached his side.

shloka_text: प्राञ्जलिः सा तु पार्श्वस्था प्राह वाक्यं सरस्वती । इयमस्म्यागता देव किं कार्यं करवाण्यहम् ।। 7.10.42 ।।
transliteration: prāñjaliḥ sā tu pārśvasthā prāha vākyaṃ sarasvatī | iyamasmyāgatā deva kiṃ kāryaṃ karavāṇyaham || 7.10.42 ||
translation: प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, सा she, तु indeed, पार्श्वस्था standing by the side, प्राह spoke, वाक्यं words, सरस्वती Saraswati, इयम् here, अस्मि I am, आगता arrived, देव O god, किं what, कार्यं task, करवाणि shall I do, अहम् I.
explanation: Standing by his side with folded hands, Saraswati spoke these words: "Here I am, O god, arrived; what task shall I perform?"

shloka_text: प्रजापतिस्तुं तां प्राप्तां प्राह वाक्यं सरस्वतीम् । वाणि त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भव या देवतेप्सिता ।। 7.10.43 ।।
transliteration: prajāpatistuṃ tāṃ prāptāṃ prāha vākyaṃ sarasvatīm | vāṇi tvaṃ rākṣasendrasya bhava yā devatepsitā || 7.10.43 ||
translation: प्रजापतिः the lord of creation, तु indeed, तां to her, प्राप्तां who had arrived, प्राह spoke, वाक्यं words, सरस्वतीम् to Saraswati, वाणि O Saraswati, त्वं you, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the king of demons, भव become, या who, देवता deity, ईप्सिता desired.
explanation: The lord of creation then spoke these words to Saraswati, who had arrived: "O Saraswati, you become the desired deity of the king of demons."

shloka_text: तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रविष्टा सा प्रजापतिरथाब्रवीत् । कुम्भकर्ण महाबाहो वरं वरय यो मतः ।। 7.10.44 ।।
transliteration: tathetyuktvā praviṣṭā sā prajāpatirathābravīt | kumbhakarṇa mahābāho varaṃ varaya yo mataḥ || 7.10.44 ||
translation: तथेति having said 'so be it', उक्त्वा having said, प्रविष्टा entered, सा she, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, कुम्भकर्ण O Kumbhakarna, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, वरम् a boon, वरय choose, यः which, मतः is desired.
explanation: After Saraswati entered, Prajapati Brahma then addressed Kumbhakarna, the mighty-armed one, telling him to choose whatever boon he desired.

shloka_text: कुम्भकर्णस्तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा वचनमब्रवीत् । स्वप्तुं वर्षाण्यनेकानि देवदेव ममेप्सितम् ।। 7.10.45 ।।
transliteration: kumbhakarṇastu tadvākyaṃ śrutvā vacanamabravīt | svaptuṃ varṣāṇyanekāni devadeva mamepsitam || 7.10.45 ||
translation: कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, तु indeed, तत् that, वाक्यम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, वचनम् a word, अब्रवीत् spoke, स्वप्तुम् to sleep, वर्षाणि years, अनेकानि many, देवदेव O God of gods, मम my, ईप्सितम् desired.
explanation: Hearing those words, Kumbhakarna then spoke, saying, "O God of gods, it is my desire to sleep for many years."

shloka_text: एवमस्त्विति तं चोक्त्वा प्रायाद्ब्रह्मा सुरैः समम् । देवी सरस्वती चैव राक्षसं तं जहौ पुनः ।। 7.10.46 ।।
transliteration: evamastviti taṃ coktvā prāyādbrahmā suraiḥ samam | devī sarasvatī caiva rākṣasaṃ taṃ jahau punaḥ || 7.10.46 ||
translation: एवम् thus, अस्तु let it be, इति thus, तम् him, च and, उक्त्वा having said, प्रायात् went away, ब्रह्मा Brahma, सुरैः with the gods, समम् together with, देवी Goddess, सरस्वती Saraswati, च and, एव indeed, राक्षसम् the demon, तम् him, जहौ abandoned, पुनः again.
explanation: Having said "So be it" to him, Brahma departed with the gods, and Goddess Saraswati then abandoned that demon.

shloka_text: ब्रह्मणा सह देवेषु गतेषु च नभःस्थलम् । विमुक्तो ऽसौ सरस्वत्या स्वां सञ्ज्ञां च ततो गतः ।। 7.10.47 ।।
transliteration: brahmaṇā saha deveṣu gateṣu ca nabhaḥsthalam | vimukto 'sau sarasvatyā svāṃ sañjñāṃ ca tato gataḥ || 7.10.47 ||
translation: ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, सह with, देवेषु when the gods, गतेषु had gone, च and, नभःस्थलम् to the sky, विमुक्तः released, असौ he, सरस्वत्या by Saraswati, स्वाम् his own, सञ्ज्ञाम् consciousness, च and, ततः then, गतः attained.
explanation: When Brahma and the gods had ascended to the sky, Kumbhakarna, released by Saraswati, then regained his own consciousness.

shloka_text: कुम्भकर्णस्तु दुष्टात्मा चिन्तयामास दुःखितः । ईदृशं किमिदं वाक्यं ममाद्य वदनाच्च्युतम् ।। 7.10.48 ।।
transliteration: kumbhakarṇastu duṣṭātmā cintayāmāsa duḥkhitaḥ | īdṛśaṃ kimidaṃ vākyaṃ mamādya vadanāccyutam || 7.10.48 ||
translation: कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, तु indeed, दुष्टात्मा the evil-minded one, चिन्तयामास thought, दुःखितः distressed, ईदृशम् such, किम् what, इदम् this, वाक्यम् word, मम my, अद्य today, वदनात् from the mouth, च्युतम् uttered.
explanation: The evil-minded Kumbhakarna, now distressed, pondered, "What kind of words have I uttered from my mouth today?"

shloka_text: अहं व्यामोहितो देवैरिति मन्ये तदा ऽ ऽगतैः । एवं लब्धवराः सर्वे भ्रातरो दीप्ततेजसः । श्लेष्मातकवनं गत्वा तत्र ते न्यवसन्सुखम् ।। 7.10.49 ।।
transliteration: ahaṃ vyāmohito devairiti manye tadā ' 'gataiḥ | evaṃ labdhavarāḥ sarve bhrātaro dīptatejasaḥ | śleṣmātakavanaṃ gatvā tatra te nyavasansukham || 7.10.49 ||
translation: अहं I, व्यामोहितो deluded, देवैः by the gods, इति thus, मन्ये I think, तदा then, आगतैः who had come, एवम् thus, लब्धवराः having obtained boons, सर्वे all, भ्रातरः brothers, दीप्ततेजसः of blazing splendor, श्लेष्मातकवनम् to the Shlesmataka forest, गत्वा having gone, तत्र there, ते they, न्यवसन् resided, सुखम् happily
explanation: I believe I was deluded by the gods who had come then; thus, all the brothers, having obtained boons and possessing blazing splendor, went to the Shlesmataka forest and resided there happily. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे दशमः सर्गः ।। 10 ।। Thus ends the tenth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: सुमाली वरलब्धांस्तु ज्ञात्वा चैतान्निशाचरान् । उदतिष्ठद्भयं त्यक्त्वा सानुगः स रसातलात् ।। 7.11.1 ।।
transliteration: sumālī varalabdhāṃstu jñātvā caitānniśācarān | udatiṣṭhadbhayaṃ tyaktvā sānugaḥ sa rasātalāt || 7.11.1 ||
translation: सुमाली Sumali, वरलब्धान् those who had obtained boons, तु indeed, ज्ञात्वा having known, च and, एतान् these, निशाचरान् night-wanderers, उदतिष्ठत् rose up, भयम् fear, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, सानुगः with his followers, सः he, रसातलात् from Rasatala
explanation: Sumali, having learned that these night-wanderers had obtained boons, rose up from Rasatala with his followers, abandoning all fear.
comments: Sumali rises from Rasatala and urges Ravana to wrest Lanka back from Kubera -- though Ravana first demurs out of respect for his elder brother, Prahasta persuades him, and an envoy is sent demanding the city -- consulting his father Vishravas, Kubera is counselled to yield to the boon-emboldened, cursed Ravana and withdraws to Mount Kailasa -- Ravana enters Lanka and is crowned its king.

shloka_text: मारीचश्च प्रहस्तश्च विरूपाक्षो महोदरः । उदतिष्ठन्सुसंरब्धाः सचिवास्तस्य रक्षसः ।। 7.11.2 ।।
transliteration: mārīcaśca prahastaśca virūpākṣo mahodaraḥ | udatiṣṭhansusaṃrabdhāḥ sacivāstasya rakṣasaḥ || 7.11.2 ||
translation: मारीचः Maricha, च and, प्रहस्तः Prahasta, च and, विरूपाक्षः Virupaksha, महोदरः Mahodara, उदतिष्ठन् rose up, सुसंरब्धाः greatly excited, सचिवाः ministers, तस्य his, रक्षसः of the Rakshasa
explanation: Maricha, Prahasta, Virupaksha, and Mahodara, who were the greatly excited ministers of that Rakshasa (Sumali), also rose up.

shloka_text: सुमाली सचिवैः सार्धं वृतो राक्षसपुङ्गवैः । अभिगम्य दशग्रीवं परिष्वज्येदमब्रवीत् ।। 7.11.3 ।।
transliteration: sumālī sacivaiḥ sārdhaṃ vṛto rākṣasapuṅgavaiḥ | abhigamya daśagrīvaṃ pariṣvajyedamabravīt || 7.11.3 ||
translation: सुमाली Sumali, सचिवैः with ministers, सार्धम् together, वृतः surrounded, राक्षसपुङ्गवैः by chief Rakshasas, अभिगम्य having approached, दशग्रीवम् Dashagriva, परिष्वज्य having embraced, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Sumali, surrounded by his ministers and other chief Rakshasas, approached Dashagriva, embraced him, and spoke these words.

shloka_text: दिष्ट्या ते वत्स सम्प्राप्तश्चिन्तितो ऽयं मनोरथः । यस्त्वं त्रिभुवनश्रेष्ठाल्लब्धवान्वरमुत्तमम् ।। 7.11.4 ।।
transliteration: diṣṭyā te vatsa samprāptaścintito 'yaṃ manorathaḥ | yastvaṃ tribhuvanaśreṣṭhāllabdhavānvaramuttamam || 7.11.4 ||
translation: दिष्ट्या fortunately, ते to you, वत्स O son, सम्प्राप्तः achieved, चिन्तितः thought of, अयम् this, मनोरथः desire, यत् that, त्वम् you, त्रिभुवनश्रेष्ठात् from the best of the three worlds, लब्धवान् have obtained, वरम् boon, उत्तमम् excellent
explanation: Fortunately, O son, this cherished desire of yours has been achieved, as you have obtained an excellent boon from the best of the three worlds (Brahma).

shloka_text: यत्कृते च वयं लङ्कां त्यकत्वा याता रसातलम् । तद्गतं नो महाबाहो महद्विष्णुकृतं भयम् ।। 7.11.5 ।।
transliteration: yatkṛte ca vayaṃ laṅkāṃ tyakatvā yātā rasātalam | tadgataṃ no mahābāho mahadviṣṇukṛtaṃ bhayam || 7.11.5 ||
translation: यत्कृते for whom, च and, वयम् we, लङ्काम् Lanka, त्यकत्वा having abandoned, याताः went, रसातलम् to Rasatala, तत् that, गतम् gone, नः our, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, महत् great, विष्णुकृतम् caused by Vishnu, भयम् fear.
explanation: O mighty-armed one, the great fear caused by Vishnu, for which we abandoned Lanka and went to Rasatala, has now departed from us.

shloka_text: असकृत्तद्भयाद्भीताः परित्यज्य स्वमालयम् । विद्रुताः सहिताः सर्वे प्रविष्टाः स्म रसातलम् ।। 7.11.6 ।।
transliteration: asakṛttadbhayādbhītāḥ parityajya svamālayam | vidrutāḥ sahitāḥ sarve praviṣṭāḥ sma rasātalam || 7.11.6 ||
translation: असकृत् repeatedly, तद्भयात् from that fear, भीताः frightened, परित्यज्य having abandoned, स्वम् our own, आलयम् abode, विद्रुताः fled, सहिताः together, सर्वे all, प्रविष्टाः entered, स्म (past tense indicator), रसातलम् Rasatala.
explanation: Frightened repeatedly by that fear, all of us together abandoned our own abode and fled, entering Rasatala.

shloka_text: अस्मदीया च लङ्केयं नगरी राक्षसोचिता । निवेशिता तव भ्रात्रा धनाध्यक्षेण धीमता ।। 7.11.7 ।।
transliteration: asmadīyā ca laṅkeyaṃ nagarī rākṣasocitā | niveśitā tava bhrātrā dhanādhyakṣeṇa dhīmatā || 7.11.7 ||
translation: अस्मदीया ours, च and, लङ्का Lanka, इयम् this, नगरी city, राक्षसोचिता suitable for Rakshasas, निवेशिता established, तव your, भ्रात्रा by brother, धनाध्यक्षेण by the lord of wealth, धीमता by the intelligent one.
explanation: This city of Lanka, suitable for Rakshasas, was established by your intelligent brother, the lord of wealth (Kubera), and belongs to us.

shloka_text: यदि नामात्र शक्यं स्यात्साम्ना दानेन वानघ । तरसा वा महाबाहो प्रत्यानेतुं कृतं भवेत् ।। 7.11.8 ।।
transliteration: yadi nāmātra śakyaṃ syātsāmnā dānena vānagha | tarasā vā mahābāho pratyānetuṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet || 7.11.8 ||
translation: यदि if, न not, अत्र here, शक्यम् possible, स्यात् it would be, साम्ना by conciliation, दानेन by giving, वा or, अनघ O sinless one, तरसा by force, वा or, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, प्रत्यानेतुम् to bring back, कृतम् done, भवेत् it would be.
explanation: O sinless and mighty-armed one, if it is not possible to bring it back by conciliation or by gifts, then it should be done by force.

shloka_text: त्वं तु लङ्केश्वरस्तात भविष्यसि न संशयः । त्वया राक्षसवंशो ऽयं निमग्नो ऽपि समुद्धृतः । सर्वेषां नः प्रभुश्चैव भविष्यसि महाबल ।। 7.11.9 ।।
transliteration: tvaṃ tu laṅkeśvarastāta bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ | tvayā rākṣasavaṃśo 'yaṃ nimagno 'pi samuddhṛtaḥ | sarveṣāṃ naḥ prabhuścaiva bhaviṣyasi mahābala || 7.11.9 ||
translation: त्वम् you, तु indeed, लङ्केश्वरः lord of Lanka, तात O dear one, भविष्यसि will be, न no, संशयः doubt, त्वया by you, राक्षसवंशः the Rakshasa race, अयम् this, निमग्नः submerged, अपि even, समुद्धृतः uplifted, सर्वेषाम् of all, नः us, प्रभुः lord, च and, एव indeed, भविष्यसि will be, महाबल O mighty one.
explanation: O dear and mighty one, you will undoubtedly be the lord of Lanka, for by you this Rakshasa race, even though submerged, has been uplifted, and you will indeed be the master of all of us.

shloka_text: अथाब्रवीद्दशग्रीवो मातामहमुपस्थितम् । वित्तेशो गुरुरस्माकं नार्हसे वक्तुमीदृशम् ।। 7.11.10 ।।
transliteration: athābravīddaśagrīvo mātāmahamupasthitam | vitteśo gururasmākaṃ nārhase vaktumīdṛśam || 7.11.10 ||
translation: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, दशग्रीवः Ravana, मातामहम् to his maternal grandfather, उपस्थितम् who was present, वित्तेशः Kubera (the lord of wealth), गुरुः preceptor, अस्माकम् our, न not, अर्हसे you ought, वक्तुम् to speak, ईदृशम् such (a thing).
explanation: Then Ravana spoke to his maternal grandfather, who was present, saying, "Kubera, the lord of wealth, is our preceptor; you ought not to speak such things."

shloka_text: साम्नापि राक्षसेन्द्रेण प्रत्याख्यातो गरीयसा । किञ्चिन्नाह तदा रक्षो ज्ञात्वा तस्य चकीर्षितम् ।। 7.11.11 ।।
transliteration: sāmnāpi rākṣasendreṇa pratyākhyāto garīyasā | kiñcinnāha tadā rakṣo jñātvā tasya cakīrṣitam || 7.11.11 ||
translation: साम्ना even with gentle words, अपि also, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the lord of Rakshasas, गरीयसा who was superior, प्रत्याख्यातः rejected, किञ्चित् anything, न not, आह said, तदा then, रक्षः the Rakshasa (grandfather), ज्ञात्वा having known, तस्य his (Ravana's), चिकीर्षितम् intention.
explanation: Even though the venerable maternal grandfather was rejected by the superior lord of Rakshasas (Ravana) with gentle words, the Rakshasa (grandfather) then said nothing, understanding Ravana's intention.

shloka_text: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य वसन्तं रावणं ततः । उक्तवन्तं तथा वाक्यं दशग्रीवं निशाचरः ।। 7.11.12 ।।
transliteration: kasyacittvatha kālasya vasantaṃ rāvaṇaṃ tataḥ | uktavantaṃ tathā vākyaṃ daśagrīvaṃ niśācaraḥ || 7.11.12 ||
translation: कस्यचित् of some, तु indeed, अथ then, कालस्य time, वसन्तम् residing, रावणम् to Ravana, ततः then, उक्तवन्तम् who had spoken, तथा such, वाक्यम् words, दशग्रीवम् to Ravana, निशाचरः the night-wanderer (Prahasta).
explanation: Then, after some time, while Ravana was residing there, the night-wanderer (Prahasta) addressed Ravana, who had spoken such words.

shloka_text: प्रहस्तः प्रश्रितं वाक्यमिदमाह स कारणम् ।। 7.11.13 ।।
transliteration: prahastaḥ praśritaṃ vākyamidamāha sa kāraṇam || 7.11.13 ||
translation: प्रहस्तः Prahasta, प्रश्रितम् humble, वाक्यम् words, इदम् these, आह said, सः he, कारणम् with reason.
explanation: Prahasta then spoke these humble and reasonable words.

shloka_text: दशग्रीव महाबाहो नार्हस्त्वं वक्तुमीदृशम् । सौभ्रात्रं नास्ति शूराणां शृणु चेदं वचो मम ।। 7.11.14 ।।
transliteration: daśagrīva mahābāho nārhastvaṃ vaktumīdṛśam | saubhrātraṃ nāsti śūrāṇāṃ śṛṇu cedaṃ vaco mama || 7.11.14 ||
translation: दशग्रीव O Ravana, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, न not, अर्हसि you ought, त्वम् you, वक्तुम् to speak, ईदृशम् such (a thing), सौभ्रात्रम् brotherhood, न not, अस्ति exists, शूराणाम् among heroes, शृणु listen, च and, इदम् this, वचः word, मम my.
explanation: O mighty-armed Ravana, you ought not to speak such things, for brotherhood does not exist among heroes; therefore, listen to my words.

shloka_text: अदितिश्च दितिश्चैव भगिन्यौ सहिते हि ते । भार्ये परमरूपिण्यौ कश्यपस्य प्रजापतेः ।। 7.11.15 ।।
transliteration: aditiśca ditiścaiva bhaginyau sahite hi te | bhārye paramarūpiṇyau kaśyapasya prajāpateḥ || 7.11.15 ||
translation: अदितिश्च Aditi and, दितिश्चैव Diti also, भगिन्यौ two sisters, सहिते together, हि indeed, ते they, भार्ये wives, परमरूपिण्यौ of supreme beauty, कश्यपस्य of Kashyapa, प्रजापतेः the Prajapati.
explanation: Aditi and Diti, two sisters of supreme beauty, were indeed the wives of Prajapati Kashyapa.

shloka_text: अदितिर्जनयामास देवांस्त्रिभुवनेश्वरान् । दितिस्त्वजनयत्पुत्रान्कश्यपस्यात्मसम्भवान् ।। 7.11.16 ।।
transliteration: aditirjanayāmāsa devāṃstribhuvaneśvarān | ditistvajanayatputrānkaśyapasyātmasambhavān || 7.11.16 ||
translation: अदितिः Aditi, जनयामास gave birth to, देवान् gods, त्रिभुवनेश्वरान् lords of the three worlds, दितिः Diti, तु but, अजनयत् gave birth to, पुत्रान् sons, कश्यपस्य of Kashyapa, आत्मसम्भवान् born from himself.
explanation: Aditi gave birth to the gods, who became the lords of the three worlds, while Diti bore sons who were also born from Kashyapa.

shloka_text: दैत्यानां किल धर्मज्ञ पुरीयं सवनार्णवा । सपर्वता मही वीर ते ऽभवन्प्रभविष्णवः ।। 7.11.17 ।।
transliteration: daityānāṃ kila dharmajña purīyaṃ savanārṇavā | saparvatā mahī vīra te 'bhavanprabhaviṣṇavaḥ || 7.11.17 ||
translation: दैत्यानां of the Daityas, किल indeed, धर्मज्ञ O knower of Dharma, पुरी realm, इयं this, सवनार्णवा with forests and oceans, सपर्वता with mountains, मही earth, वीर O hero, ते they, अभवन् became, प्रभविष्णवः powerful.
explanation: O knower of Dharma and O hero, this entire earth, with its forests, oceans, and mountains, was indeed the realm of the powerful Daityas.

shloka_text: निहत्य तांस्तु समरे विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना । देवानां वशमानीतं त्रैलोक्यमिदमव्ययम् ।। 7.11.18 ।।
transliteration: nihatya tāṃstu samare viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā | devānāṃ vaśamānītaṃ trailokyamidamavyayam || 7.11.18 ||
translation: निहत्य having killed, तान् them, तु but, समरे in battle, विष्णुना by Vishnu, प्रभविष्णुना the powerful, देवानां of the gods, वशम् under control, आनीतम् brought, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, इदम् this, अव्ययम् imperishable.
explanation: However, the powerful Vishnu, having slain them in battle, brought this imperishable three worlds under the control of the gods.

shloka_text: नैतदेको भवानेव करिष्यति विपर्ययम् । सुरासुरैराचरितं तत्कुरुष्व वचो मम ।। 7.11.19 ।।
transliteration: naitadeko bhavāneva kariṣyati viparyayam | surāsurairācaritaṃ tatkuruṣva vaco mama || 7.11.19 ||
translation: न not, एतत् this, एकः alone, भवान् you, एव only, करिष्यति will do, विपर्ययम् reversal, सुरासुरैः by gods and asuras, आचरितम् practiced, तत् that, कुरुष्व do, वचः word, मम my.
explanation: You alone will not be able to reverse this established order, which has been practiced by both gods and asuras, so please heed my advice.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना । चिन्तयित्वा मुहूर्तं वै बाढमित्येव सो ऽब्रवीत् ।। 7.11.20 ।।
transliteration: evamukto daśagrīvaḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā | cintayitvā muhūrtaṃ vai bāḍhamityeva so 'bravīt || 7.11.20 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रहृष्टेन delighted, अन्तरात्मना by his inner self, चिन्तयित्वा having thought, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, वै indeed, बाढम् very well, इति thus, एव only, सः he, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Thus addressed, Ravana, with his inner self delighted, thought for a moment and then said, "Very well."

shloka_text: स तु तेनैव हर्षेण तस्मिन्नहनि वीर्यवान् । वनं गतो दशग्रीवः सह तैः क्षणदाचरैः ।। 7.11.21 ।।
transliteration: sa tu tenaiva harṣeṇa tasminnahani vīryavān | vanaṃ gato daśagrīvaḥ saha taiḥ kṣaṇadācaraiḥ || 7.11.21 ||
translation: सः he, तु indeed, तेन by that, एव only, हर्षेण by joy, तस्मिन् on that, अहनि day, वीर्यवान् powerful, वनम् to the forest, गतः went, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, सह with, तैः those, क्षणदाचरैः night-wanderers.
explanation: Indeed, on that very day, the powerful Ravana, filled with that joy, went to the forest with those night-wanderers.

shloka_text: त्रिकूटस्थः स तु तदा दशग्रीवो निशाचरः । प्रेषयामास दौत्येन प्रहस्तं वाक्यकोविदम् ।। 7.11.22 ।।
transliteration: trikūṭasthaḥ sa tu tadā daśagrīvo niśācaraḥ | preṣayāmāsa dautyena prahastaṃ vākyakovidam || 7.11.22 ||
translation: त्रिकूटस्थः situated on Trikuta mountain, सः he, तु indeed, तदा then, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, प्रेषयामास sent, दौत्येन as an envoy, प्रहस्तम् Prahasta, वाक्यकोविदम् skilled in speech.
explanation: Then, Ravana, the night-wanderer, who was situated on Trikuta mountain, sent Prahasta, who was skilled in speech, as an envoy.

shloka_text: प्रहस्त शीघ्रं गच्छ त्वं ब्रूहि नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवम् । वचसा मम वित्तेशं सामपूर्वमिदं वचः ।। 7.11.23 ।।
transliteration: prahasta śīghraṃ gaccha tvaṃ brūhi nairṛtapuṅgavam | vacasā mama vitteśaṃ sāmapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ || 7.11.23 ||
translation: प्रहस्त O Prahasta, शीघ्रम् quickly, गच्छ go, त्वम् you, ब्रूहि tell, नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवम् to the chief of the Rakshasas, वचसा with the word, मम my, वित्तेशम् to the lord of wealth, सामपूर्वम् preceded by conciliation, इदम् this, वचः word.
explanation: "O Prahasta, go quickly and tell the lord of wealth, the chief of the Rakshasas, these conciliatory words from me."

shloka_text: इयं लङ्का पुरी राजन्राक्षसानां महात्मनाम् । त्वया निवेशिता सौम्य नैतद्युक्तं तवानघ ।। 7.11.24 ।।
transliteration: iyaṃ laṅkā purī rājanrākṣasānāṃ mahātmanām | tvayā niveśitā saumya naitadyuktaṃ tavānagha || 7.11.24 ||
translation: इयम् this, लङ्का Lanka, पुरी city, राजन् O King, राक्षसानाम् of the Rakshasas, महात्मनाम् great-souled, त्वया by you, निवेशिता established, सौम्य O gentle one, न not, एतत् this, युक्तम् proper, तव for you, अनघ O sinless one.
explanation: "O King, O gentle one, O sinless one, this city of Lanka, belonging to the great-souled Rakshasas, was established by you, but this is not proper for you."

shloka_text: तद्भवान्यदि नो ह्यद्य दद्यादतुलविक्रम । कृता भवेन्मम प्रीतिर्धुर्मश्चैवानुपालितः ।। 7.11.25 ।।
transliteration: tadbhavānyadi no hyadya dadyādatulavikrama | kṛtā bhavenmama prītirdhurmaścaivānupālitaḥ || 7.11.25 ||
translation: तत् therefore, भवान् you, यदि if, नः to us, हि indeed, अद्य today, दद्यात् would give, अतुलविक्रम O unequalled in valor, कृता done, भवेत् would be, मम my, प्रीतिः satisfaction, धर्मः duty, च and, एव indeed, अनुपालितः fulfilled.
explanation: O unequalled in valor, if you would indeed give it to us today, my satisfaction would be complete, and my duty would also be fulfilled.

shloka_text: स तु गत्वा पुरीं लङ्कां धनदेन सुरक्षिताम् । अब्रवीत्परमोदारं वित्तपालमिदं वचः ।। 7.11.26 ।।
transliteration: sa tu gatvā purīṃ laṅkāṃ dhanadena surakṣitām | abravītparamodāraṃ vittapālamidaṃ vacaḥ || 7.11.26 ||
translation: सः he, तु indeed, गत्वा having gone, पुरीम् to the city, लङ्काम् Lanka, धनदेन by Kubera, सुरक्षिताम् well-protected, अब्रवीत् spoke, परमोदारम् to the most generous, वित्तपालम् lord of wealth, इदम् this, वचः word.
explanation: Having arrived at the city of Lanka, which was well-protected by Kubera, the messenger then spoke these words to the most generous lord of wealth.

shloka_text: प्रेषितो ऽहं तव भ्रात्रा दशग्रीवेण सुव्रत । त्वत्समीपं महाबाहो सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वर ।। 7.11.27 ।।
transliteration: preṣito 'haṃ tava bhrātrā daśagrīveṇa suvrata | tvatsamīpaṃ mahābāho sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ vara || 7.11.27 ||
translation: प्रेषितः sent, अहम् I, तव your, भ्रात्रा by brother, दशग्रीवेण by Dashagriva, सुव्रत O one of good vows, त्वत्समीपम् to your presence, महाबाहो O mighty-armed, सर्वशस्त्रभृताम् among all weapon-bearers, वर O best.
explanation: O one of good vows, O mighty-armed, O best among all weapon-bearers, I have been sent to your presence by your brother, Dashagriva.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रूयतां महाप्राज्ञ सर्वशास्त्रविशारद । वचनं मम वित्तेश यद्ब्रवीति दशाननः ।। 7.11.28 ।।
transliteration: tacchrūyatāṃ mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada | vacanaṃ mama vitteśa yadbravīti daśānanaḥ || 7.11.28 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, महाप्राज्ञ O greatly wise one, सर्वशास्त्रविशारद O expert in all scriptures, वचनम् message, मम my, वित्तेश O lord of wealth, यत् which, ब्रवीति says, दशाननः Dashanana.
explanation: O greatly wise one, O expert in all scriptures, O lord of wealth, please listen to my message, which Dashanana (Ravana) conveys.

shloka_text: इयं किल पुरी रम्या सुमालिप्रमुखैः पुरा । भुक्तपूर्वा विशालाक्ष राक्षसैर्भीमविक्रमैः ।। 7.11.29 ।।
transliteration: iyaṃ kila purī ramyā sumālipramukhaiḥ purā | bhuktapūrvā viśālākṣa rākṣasairbhīmavikramaiḥ || 7.11.29 ||
translation: इयम् this, किल indeed, पुरी city, रम्य beautiful, सुमालिप्रमुखैः by Sumali and others, पुरा formerly, भुक्तपूर्वा previously enjoyed, विशालाक्ष O wide-eyed one, राक्षसैः by Rakshasas, भीमविक्रमैः of terrible valor.
explanation: O wide-eyed one, this beautiful city was indeed formerly inhabited by Rakshasas of terrible valor, led by Sumali and others.

shloka_text: तेन विज्ञाप्यते सो ऽयं साम्प्रतं विश्रवात्मज । तदेषा दीयतां तात याचतस्तस्य सामतः ।। 7.11.30 ।।
transliteration: tena vijñāpyate so 'yaṃ sāmprataṃ viśravātmaja | tadeṣā dīyatāṃ tāta yācatastasya sāmataḥ || 7.11.30 ||
translation: तेन by him, विज्ञाप्यते is being requested, सः he, अयम् this, साम्प्रतम् now, विश्रवात्मज O son of Vishrava, तत् therefore, एषा this (Lanka), दीयताम् let it be given, तात dear one, याचतः of him who is requesting, तस्य his, सामतः by peaceful means.
explanation: Prahasta requests Kubera, the son of Vishrava, to peacefully hand over Lanka to Ravana, who is now asking for it.

shloka_text: प्रहस्तादभिसंश्रुत्य देवो वैश्रवणो वचः । प्रत्युवाच प्रहस्तं तं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः ।। 7.11.31 ।।
transliteration: prahastādabhisaṃśrutya devo vaiśravaṇo vacaḥ | pratyuvāca prahastaṃ taṃ vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ || 7.11.31 ||
translation: प्रहस्तात् from Prahasta, अभिसंश्रुत्य having heard well, देवः the god, वैश्रवणः Vaishravana, वचः the words, प्रत्युवाच replied, प्रहस्तम् to Prahasta, तम् him, वाक्यम् words, वाक्यविशारदः skilled in speech.
explanation: The god Vaishravana, who was skilled in speech, having heard Prahasta's words, replied to him.

shloka_text: दत्ता ममेयं पित्रा तु लङ्का शून्या निशाचरैः । निवासिते च मे यक्षैर्दानमानादिभिर्गुणैः ।। 7.11.32 ।।
transliteration: dattā mameyaṃ pitrā tu laṅkā śūnyā niśācaraiḥ | nivāsite ca me yakṣairdānamānādibhirguṇaiḥ || 7.11.32 ||
translation: दत्ता given, मम to me, इयम् this, पित्रा by father, तु indeed, लङ्का Lanka, शून्या empty, निशाचरैः of night-wanderers, निवासिते settled, च and, मे by me, यक्षैः by Yakshas, दानमानादिभिः by gifts, honors, etc., गुणैः by means.
explanation: Kubera stated that his father had given him this Lanka, which was empty of Rakshasas, and he had settled it with Yakshas through various means like gifts and honors.

shloka_text: ब्रूहि गच्छ दशग्रीवं पुरं राज्यं च यन्मम । तवाप्येतन्महाबाहो भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यमकण्टकम् ।। 7.11.33 ।।
transliteration: brūhi gaccha daśagrīvaṃ puraṃ rājyaṃ ca yanmama | tavāpyetanmahābāho bhuṅkṣva rājyamakaṇṭakam || 7.11.33 ||
translation: ब्रूहि tell, गच्छ go, दशग्रीवम् to Dashagriva, पुरम् the city, राज्यम् the kingdom, च and, यत् which, मम is mine, तव yours, अपि also, एतत् this, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, भुङ्क्ष्व enjoy, राज्यम् the kingdom, अकण्टकम् unhindered.
explanation: Kubera instructed Prahasta to go and tell Ravana that the city and kingdom which were his, were now also Ravana's, and he should enjoy this unhindered kingdom, O mighty-armed one.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा धनाध्यक्षो जगाम पितुरन्तिकम् ।। 7.11.34 ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā dhanādhyakṣo jagāma piturantikam || 7.11.34 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, धनाध्यक्षः the lord of wealth, जगाम went, पितुः of his father, अन्तिकम् to the presence.
explanation: Having spoken thus, Kubera, the lord of wealth, went to his father's presence.

shloka_text: अभिवाद्य गुरुं प्राह रावणस्य यदीप्सितम् । एष तात दशग्रीवो दूतं प्रेषितवान्मम ।। 7.11.35 ।।
transliteration: abhivādya guruṃ prāha rāvaṇasya yadīpsitam | eṣa tāta daśagrīvo dūtaṃ preṣitavānmama || 7.11.35 ||
translation: अभिवाद्य having saluted, गुरुं the preceptor, प्राह he said, रावणस्य of Ravana, यदीप्सितम् what is desired, एष this, तात O father, दशग्रीवो Dashagriva, दूतं a messenger, प्रेषितवान्मम has sent to me.
explanation: Having saluted his father, Kubera informed him of Ravana's demand, saying, "O father, Dashagriva has sent a messenger to me with his desire."

shloka_text: दीयतां नगरी लङ्का पूर्वं रक्षोगणोषिता । मयात्र यदनुष्ठेयं तन्ममाचक्ष्व सुव्रत ।। 7.11.36 ।।
transliteration: dīyatāṃ nagarī laṅkā pūrvaṃ rakṣogaṇoṣitā | mayātra yadanuṣṭheyaṃ tanmamācakṣva suvrata || 7.11.36 ||
translation: दीयतां let it be given, नगरी the city, लङ्का Lanka, पूर्वं formerly, रक्षोगणोषिता inhabited by Rakshasas, मयात्र by me here, यदनुष्ठेयं what is to be done, तन्ममाचक्ष्व that tell me, सुव्रत O one of good vows.
explanation: Kubera further stated, "Let the city of Lanka, formerly inhabited by Rakshasas, be given to him; please tell me, O revered one, what I should do in this situation."

shloka_text: ब्रह्मर्षिस्त्वेवमुक्तो ऽसौ विश्रवा मुनिपुङ्गवः । प्राञ्जलिं धनदं प्राह शृणु पुत्र वचो मम ।। 7.11.37 ।।
transliteration: brahmarṣistvevamukto 'sau viśravā munipuṅgavaḥ | prāñjaliṃ dhanadaṃ prāha śṛṇu putra vaco mama || 7.11.37 ||
translation: ब्रह्मर्षिस्त्वेवमुक्तो the Brahmarshi, thus addressed, असौ he, विश्रवा Vishrava, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages, प्राञ्जलिं to the one with folded hands, धनदं to Kubera, प्राह said, शृणु listen, पुत्र O son, वचो words, मम my.
explanation: Thus addressed, the Brahmarshi Vishrava, the foremost among sages, spoke to Kubera, who stood with folded hands, saying, "Listen, O son, to my words."

shloka_text: दशग्रीवो महाबाहुरुक्तवान्मम सन्निधौ । मया निर्भर्त्सितश्चासीद्बहुशोक्तः सुदुर्मतिः ।। 7.11.38 ।।
transliteration: daśagrīvo mahābāhuruktavānmama sannidhau | mayā nirbhartsitaścāsīdbahuśoktaḥ sudurmatiḥ || 7.11.38 ||
translation: दशग्रीवो Dashagriva, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, उक्तवान्मम spoke to me, सन्निधौ in my presence, मया by me, निर्भर्त्सितश्चासीद् he was rebuked, बहुशोक्तः much admonished, सुदुर्मतिः the evil-minded one.
explanation: Vishrava recounted that the mighty-armed, evil-minded Dashagriva had spoken to him in his presence, and he had repeatedly rebuked and admonished him.

shloka_text: स क्रोधेन मया चोक्तो ध्वंसते च पुनः पुनः । श्रेयो ऽभियुक्तं धर्म्यं च शृणु पुत्र वचो मम ।। 7.11.39 ।।
transliteration: sa krodhena mayā cokto dhvaṃsate ca punaḥ punaḥ | śreyo 'bhiyuktaṃ dharmyaṃ ca śṛṇu putra vaco mama || 7.11.39 ||
translation: स he, क्रोधेन with anger, मया by me, चोक्तो was told, ध्वंसते he perishes, च and, पुनः पुनः again and again, श्रेयो welfare, अभियुक्तं connected with, धर्म्यं righteous, च and, शृणु listen, पुत्र O son, वचो words, मम my.
explanation: Vishrava continued, "Though I spoke to him with anger, warning him that he would repeatedly perish, now listen, O son, to my words which are conducive to your welfare and righteousness."

shloka_text: वरप्रदानसम्मूढो मान्या ऽमान्यान् स दुर्मतिः । न वेत्ति मम शापाच्च प्रकृतिं दारुणां गतः ।। 7.11.40 ।।
transliteration: varapradānasammūḍho mānyā 'mānyān sa durmatiḥ | na vetti mama śāpācca prakṛtiṃ dāruṇāṃ gataḥ || 7.11.40 ||
translation: वरप्रदानसम्मूढो bewildered by the granting of boons, मान्या those who are respectable, अमान्यान् those who are not respectable, सः he, दुर्मतिः evil-minded, न वेत्ति does not distinguish, मम my, शापात् from the curse, च and, प्रकृतिम् nature, दारुणाम् terrible, गतः attained.
explanation: Bewildered by the boons, that evil-minded one does not distinguish between the respectable and the disrespectful, and furthermore, he has attained a terrible nature due to my curse.

shloka_text: तस्माद्गच्छ महाबाहो कैलासं धरणीधरम् । निवेशय निवासार्थं त्यक्त्वा लङ्कां सहानुगः ।। 7.11.41 ।।
transliteration: tasmādgaccha mahābāho kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam | niveśaya nivāsārthaṃ tyaktvā laṅkāṃ sahānugaḥ || 7.11.41 ||
translation: तस्मात् therefore, गच्छ go, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, कैलासं to Kailasa, धरणीधरम् the mountain, निवेशय establish, निवासार्थं for residence, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, लङ्कां Lanka, सहानुगः with your followers.
explanation: Therefore, O mighty-armed one, go to the mountain Kailasa, abandon Lanka, and establish your residence there with your followers.

shloka_text: तत्र मन्दाकिनी रम्या नदीनामुत्तमा नदी । काञ्चनैः सूर्यसङ्काशैः पङ्कजैः संवृतोदका ।। 7.11.42 ।।
transliteration: tatra mandākinī ramyā nadīnāmuttamā nadī | kāñcanaiḥ sūryasaṅkāśaiḥ paṅkajaiḥ saṃvṛtodakā || 7.11.42 ||
translation: तत्र there, मन्दाकिनी Mandakini, रम्या beautiful, नदीनाम् among rivers, उत्तमा best, नदी river, काञ्चनैः with golden, सूर्यसङ्काशैः resembling the sun, पङ्कजैः with lotuses, संवृतोदका whose waters are covered.
explanation: There flows the beautiful Mandakini river, the best among rivers, whose waters are covered with golden lotuses shining like the sun.

shloka_text: कुमुदैरुत्पलैश्चैव तथा ऽन्यैश्च सुगन्धिभिः ।। 7.11.43 ।।
transliteration: kumudairutpalaiścaiva tathā 'nyaiśca sugandhibhiḥ || 7.11.43 ||
translation: कुमुदैः with white water lilies, उत्पलैः with blue lotuses, च and, एव also, तथा similarly, अन्यैः with other, च and, सुगन्धिभिः fragrant ones.
explanation: Its waters are also covered with white water lilies, blue lotuses, and other fragrant flowers.

shloka_text: तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाः साप्सरोरगकिंनराः । विहारशीलाः सततं रमन्ते सर्वदा ऽ ऽश्रिताः ।। 7.11.44 ।।
transliteration: tatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sāpsaroragakiṃnarāḥ | vihāraśīlāḥ satataṃ ramante sarvadā ' 'śritāḥ || 7.11.44 ||
translation: तत्र there, देवाः gods, सगन्धर्वाः with Gandharvas, साप्सरः with Apsaras, उरग serpents, किंनराः Kinnaras, विहारशीलाः fond of sport, सततम् constantly, रमन्ते they delight, सर्वदा always, आश्रिताः residing.
explanation: Gods, along with Gandharvas, Apsaras, Uragas, and Kinnaras, constantly reside there, always delighting in recreation.

shloka_text: न हि क्षमं तवानेन वैरं धनद रक्षसा । जानीषे हि यथा ऽनेन लब्धः परमको वरः ।। 7.11.45 ।।
transliteration: na hi kṣamaṃ tavānena vairaṃ dhanada rakṣasā | jānīṣe hi yathā 'nena labdhaḥ paramako varaḥ || 7.11.45 ||
translation: न not, हि indeed, क्षमं proper, तव for you, अनेन with this, वैरं enmity, धनद O Kubera, रक्षसा demon, जानीषे you know, हि indeed, यथा how, अनेन by him, लब्धः obtained, परमको supreme, वरः boon
explanation: O Kubera, it is indeed not proper for you to have enmity with this demon, for you know well how he has obtained a supreme boon.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो गृहीत्वा ऽ ऽशु तद्वचः पितृगौरवात् । सदारपुत्रः सामान्यः सवाहनधनो गतः ।। 7.11.46 ।।
transliteration: evamukto gṛhītvā ' 'śu tadvacaḥ pitṛgauravāt | sadāraputraḥ sāmānyaḥ savāhanadhano gataḥ || 7.11.46 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तो spoken, गृहीत्वा having taken, आशु quickly, तद्वचः his words, पितृगौरवात् out of respect for his father, सदारपुत्रः with wife and sons, सामान्यः with his retinue, सवाहनधनो with vehicles and wealth, गतः went
explanation: Thus spoken to, Kubera, out of respect for his father, quickly accepted his words and departed with his wife, sons, retinue, vehicles, and wealth.

shloka_text: प्रहस्तो ऽथ दशग्रीवं गत्वा वचनमब्रवीत् । प्रहृष्टात्मा महात्मानं सहामात्यं सहानुजम् ।। 7.11.47 ।।
transliteration: prahasto 'tha daśagrīvaṃ gatvā vacanamabravīt | prahṛṣṭātmā mahātmānaṃ sahāmātyaṃ sahānujam || 7.11.47 ||
translation: प्रहस्तो Prahasta, अथ then, दशग्रीवं to Dashagriva, गत्वा having gone, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, प्रहृष्टात्मा with a joyful heart, महात्मानं to the great-souled one, सहामात्यं with his ministers, सहानुजम् with his younger brothers
explanation: Then Prahasta, with a joyful heart, went to the great-souled Dashagriva, who was with his ministers and younger brothers, and spoke these words.

shloka_text: शून्या सा नगरी लङ्का त्यक्त्त्वैनां धनदो गतः । प्रविश्य तां सहास्माभिः स्वधर्मं प्रतिपालय ।। 7.11.48 ।।
transliteration: śūnyā sā nagarī laṅkā tyakttvaināṃ dhanado gataḥ | praviśya tāṃ sahāsmābhiḥ svadharmaṃ pratipālaya || 7.11.48 ||
translation: शून्या empty, सा that, नगरी city, लङ्का Lanka, त्यक्त्त्वा having abandoned, एनां this, धनदो Kubera, गतः has gone, प्रविश्य having entered, तां that, सहास्माभिः with us, स्वधर्मं your own duty, प्रतिपालय govern
explanation: That city of Lanka is now empty, as Kubera has abandoned it and departed; therefore, enter that city with us and govern according to your own duty.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः प्रहस्तेन महाबलः । विवेश नगरीं लङ्कां भ्रातृभिः सबलानुगैः ।। 7.11.49 ।।
transliteration: evamukto daśagrīvaḥ prahastena mahābalaḥ | viveśa nagarīṃ laṅkāṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ sabalānugaiḥ || 7.11.49 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तो spoken, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रहस्तेन by Prahasta, महाबलः the mighty one, विवेश entered, नगरीं city, लङ्कां Lanka, भ्रातृभिः with his brothers, सबलानुगैः with his army and followers
explanation: Thus spoken to by Prahasta, the mighty Dashagriva entered the city of Lanka with his brothers, army, and followers.

shloka_text: धनदेन परित्यक्तां सुविभक्तमहापथाम् । आरुरोह स देवारिः स्वर्गं देवाधिपो यथा ।। 7.11.50 ।।
transliteration: dhanadena parityaktāṃ suvibhaktamahāpathām | āruroha sa devāriḥ svargaṃ devādhipo yathā || 7.11.50 ||
translation: धनदेन by Kubera, परित्यक्ताम् abandoned, सुविभक्तमहापथाम् having well-divided great roads, आरुरोह ascended, सः he, देवारिः the enemy of gods, स्वर्गम् to the heaven-like city, देवाधिपः the lord of gods, यथा just as.
explanation: Ravana, the enemy of the gods, ascended to that city (Lanka), which had well-divided great roads and had been abandoned by Kubera, just as Indra ascends to heaven.

shloka_text: स चाभिषिक्तः क्षणदाचरैस्तदा निवेशयामास पुरीं दशाननः । निकामपूर्णा च बभूव सा पुरी निशाचरैर्नीलबलाहकोपमैः ।। 7.11.51 ।।
transliteration: sa cābhiṣiktaḥ kṣaṇadācaraistadā niveśayāmāsa purīṃ daśānanaḥ | nikāmapūrṇā ca babhūva sā purī niśācarairnīlabalāhakopamaiḥ || 7.11.51 ||
translation: सः he, च and, अभिषिक्तः having been crowned, क्षणदाचरैः by the night-wanderers, तदा then, निवेशयामास populated, पुरीम् the city, दशाननः Ravana, निकामपूर्णा completely filled, च and, बभूव became, सा that, पुरी city, निशाचरैः by night-wanderers, नीलबलाहकोपमैः resembling dark clouds.
explanation: After being crowned by the Rakshasas, Ravana then populated that city, and it became completely filled with night-wanderers resembling dark clouds.

shloka_text: धनेश्वरस्त्वथ पितृवाक्यगौरवान्न्यवेशयच्छशिविमले गिरौ पुरीम् । स्वलङ्कृतैर्भवनवरैर्विभूषितां पुरन्दरस्वेव तदा ऽमरावतीम् ।। 7.11.52 ।।
transliteration: dhaneśvarastvatha pitṛvākyagauravānnyaveśayacchaśivimale girau purīm | svalaṅkṛtairbhavanavarairvibhūṣitāṃ purandarasveva tadā 'marāvatīm || 7.11.52 ||
translation: धनेश्वरः Kubera, तु but, अथ then, पितृवाक्यगौरवात् out of respect for his father's words, न्यवेशयत् established, शशिविमले on the moon-bright, गिरौ mountain, पुरीम् a city, स्वलङ्कृतैः well-decorated, भवनवरैः with excellent mansions, विभूषिताम् adorned, पुरन्दरस्य of Indra, इव like, तदा then, अमरावतीम् Amaravati.
explanation: But then Kubera, out of respect for his father's words, established a city on the moon-bright mountain (Kailasa), adorned with well-decorated excellent mansions, just like Indra's Amaravati. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकादशः सर्गः ।। 11 ।। Thus ends the eleventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: राक्षसेन्द्रो ऽभिषिक्तस्तु भ्रातृभ्यां सहितस्तदा । ततः प्रदानं राक्षस्या भगिन्याः समचिन्तयत् ।। 7.12.1 ।।
transliteration: rākṣasendro 'bhiṣiktastu bhrātṛbhyāṃ sahitastadā | tataḥ pradānaṃ rākṣasyā bhaginyāḥ samacintayat || 7.12.1 ||
translation: राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of Rakshasas, अभिषिक्तः having been crowned, तु but, भ्रातृभ्याम् with his two brothers, सहितः accompanied, तदा then, ततः thereafter, प्रदानम् the giving, राक्षस्याः of the Rakshasi, भगिन्याः of his sister, समचिन्तयत् thought about.
explanation: The lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, having been crowned and accompanied by his two brothers, then thought about giving his Rakshasi sister in marriage.
comments: Ravana gives his sister Shurpanakha to the Danava Vidyujjihva -- while hunting he meets Maya, who gladly weds his daughter Mandodari (born of the apsara Hema) to him and bestows the infallible spear that later strikes Lakshmana -- Ravana marries Kumbhakarna to Vajrajvala and Vibhishana to Sarama -- Mandodari bears a son whose thunderous birth-cry earns him the name Meghanada, later known as Indrajit.

shloka_text: स्वसारं कालकेयाय दानवेन्द्राय राक्षसीम् । ददौ शूर्पणखां नाम विद्युज्जिह्वाय नामतः ।। 7.12.2 ।।
transliteration: svasāraṃ kālakeyāya dānavendrāya rākṣasīm | dadau śūrpaṇakhāṃ nāma vidyujjihvāya nāmataḥ || 7.12.2 ||
translation: स्वसारम् his sister, कालकेयाय to Kalakeya, दानवेन्द्राय to the lord of Danavas, राक्षसीम् the Rakshasi, ददौ he gave, शूर्पणखाम् Surpanakha, नाम named, विद्युज्जिह्वाय to Vidyujjihva, नामतः by name.
explanation: He gave his Rakshasi sister, named Surpanakha, to Vidyujjihva, who was a lord among the Danavas of the Kalakeya clan.

shloka_text: अथ दत्त्वा स्वयं रक्षो मृगयामटते स्म तत् । तत्रापश्यत्ततो राम मयं नाम दितेः सुतम् ।। 7.12.3 ।।
transliteration: atha dattvā svayaṃ rakṣo mṛgayāmaṭate sma tat | tatrāpaśyattato rāma mayaṃ nāma diteḥ sutam || 7.12.3 ||
translation: अथ then, स्वयं himself, रक्षो the demon (Ravana), दत्त्वा having given, तत् there, मृगयाम् for hunting, अटते स्म wandered, ततः then, राम O Rama, तत्र there, दितेः of Diti, नाम named, मयम् Maya, सुतम् son, अपश्यत् he saw.
explanation: Then, Ravana himself, having given (leave to others), wandered for hunting, and there, O Rama, he saw Maya, the son of Diti.

shloka_text: कन्यासहायं तं दृष्ट्वा दशग्रीवो निशाचरः । अपृच्छत्को भवानेको निर्मनुष्यमृगे वने । अनया मृगशावाक्ष्या किमर्थं सह तिष्ठसि ।। 7.12.4 ।।
transliteration: kanyāsahāyaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā daśagrīvo niśācaraḥ | apṛcchatko bhavāneko nirmanuṣyamṛge vane | anayā mṛgaśāvākṣyā kimarthaṃ saha tiṣṭhasi || 7.12.4 ||
translation: कन्यासहायम् accompanied by a maiden, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, अपृच्छत् asked, कः who, भवान् you, एकः alone, निर्मनुष्यमृगे devoid of humans and animals, वने in the forest, अनया with this, मृगशावाक्ष्या fawn-eyed maiden, किमर्थम् for what purpose, सह with, तिष्ठसि you stay.
explanation: Seeing him accompanied by a maiden, Ravana, the night-wanderer, asked, "Who are you, alone in this forest devoid of humans and animals, and for what purpose do you stay with this fawn-eyed maiden?"

shloka_text: मयस्तथाब्रवीद्राम पृच्छन्तं तं निशाचरम् । श्रूयतां सर्वमाख्यास्ये यथावृत्तमिदं मम ।। 7.12.5 ।।
transliteration: mayastathābravīdrāma pṛcchantaṃ taṃ niśācaram | śrūyatāṃ sarvamākhyāsye yathāvṛttamidaṃ mama || 7.12.5 ||
translation: मयः Maya, तथा thus, अब्रवीत् spoke, राम O Rama, पृच्छन्तम् to the one asking, तम् him, निशाचरम् the night-wanderer, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, सर्वम् all, इदम् this, मम my, यथावृत्तम् as it happened, आख्यास्ये I shall narrate.
explanation: O Rama, Maya thus spoke to the inquiring night-wanderer, "Listen, I shall narrate all that has happened concerning me."

shloka_text: हेमा नामाप्सरास्तात श्रुतपूर्वा यदि त्वया । दैवतैर्मम सा दत्ता पौलोमीव शतक्रतोः ।। 7.12.6 ।।
transliteration: hemā nāmāpsarāstāta śrutapūrvā yadi tvayā | daivatairmama sā dattā paulomīva śatakratoḥ || 7.12.6 ||
translation: तात O dear one, हेमा Hema, नाम named, अप्सराः an Apsara, यदि if, त्वया by you, श्रुतपूर्वा heard before, सा she, दैवतैः by the gods, मम to me, दत्ता was given, शतक्रतोः to Shakra (Indra), पौलोमी Paulomi, इव like.
explanation: O dear one, if you have heard of an Apsara named Hema before, she was given to me by the gods, just as Paulomi was given to Indra.

shloka_text: तस्यां सक्तमनास्तात पञ्चवर्षशतान्यहम् । सा च दैवतकार्येण त्रयोदश समा गताः ।। 7.12.7 ।।
transliteration: tasyāṃ saktamanāstāta pañcavarṣaśatānyaham | sā ca daivatakāryeṇa trayodaśa samā gatāḥ || 7.12.7 ||
translation: तात O dear one, अहम् I, तस्याम् in her, सक्तमनाः with mind attached, पञ्चवर्षशतानि five hundred years (spent), च and, सा she, दैवतकार्येण for a divine purpose, त्रयोदश thirteen, समाः years, गताः has gone.
explanation: O dear one, I was devoted to her for five hundred years, and she has now been gone for thirteen years for a divine purpose.
