shloka_text: वर्षं चतुर्दशं चैव ततो हेममयं पुरम् । वज्रवैडूर्यचित्रं च मायया निर्मितं मया ।। 7.12.8 ।।
transliteration: varṣaṃ caturdaśaṃ caiva tato hemamayaṃ puram | vajravaiḍūryacitraṃ ca māyayā nirmitaṃ mayā || 7.12.8 ||
translation: वर्षं year, चतुर्दशं fourteenth, चैव and indeed, ततो then, हेममयं golden, पुरम् city, वज्रवैडूर्यचित्रं adorned with diamonds and lapis lazuli, च and, मायया by illusion, निर्मितं created, मया by me,
explanation: Then, for the fourteenth year, a golden city, adorned with diamonds and lapis lazuli, was created by me through illusion.

shloka_text: तत्राहमवसं दीनस्तया हीनः सुदुःखितः ।। 7.12.9 ।।
transliteration: tatrāhamavasaṃ dīnastayā hīnaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ || 7.12.9 ||
translation: तत्र there, अहम् I, अवसं resided, दीनः miserable, तया by her, हीनः deprived, सुदुःखितः very sorrowful,
explanation: There I resided, miserable, deprived of her, and exceedingly sorrowful.

shloka_text: तस्मात्पुराद्दुहितरं गृहीत्वा वनमागतः । इयं ममात्मजा राजंस्तस्याः कुक्षौ विवर्धिता ।। 7.12.10 ।।
transliteration: tasmātpurādduhitaraṃ gṛhītvā vanamāgataḥ | iyaṃ mamātmajā rājaṃstasyāḥ kukṣau vivardhitā || 7.12.10 ||
translation: तस्मात्पुरात् from that city, दुहितरं daughter, गृहीत्वा having taken, वनम् to the forest, आगतः came, इयम् this, मम my, आत्मजा daughter, राजन् O King, तस्याः her, कुक्षौ in the womb, विवर्धिता grew,
explanation: Having taken my daughter from that city, I came to the forest; this is my daughter, O King, who grew in her womb.

shloka_text: भर्तारमनया सार्धमस्याः प्राप्तो ऽस्मि मार्गितुम् । कन्यापितृत्वं दुःखं हि सर्वेषां मानकाङ्क्षिणाम् ।। 7.12.11 ।।
transliteration: bhartāramanayā sārdhamasyāḥ prāpto 'smi mārgitum | kanyāpitṛtvaṃ duḥkhaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ mānakāṅkṣiṇām || 7.12.11 ||
translation: भर्तारम् husband, अनया with her, सार्धम् together, अस्याः for her, प्राप्तः अस्मि I have come, मार्गितुम् to seek, कन्यापितृत्वं fatherhood of a daughter, दुःखं sorrow, हि indeed, सर्वेषां for all, मानकाङ्क्षिणाम् those desiring honor,
explanation: I have come with her to seek a husband for her, for indeed, the fatherhood of a daughter is a sorrow for all who desire honor.

shloka_text: कन्या हि द्वे कुले नित्यं संशये स्थाप्य तिष्ठति । पुत्रद्वयं ममाप्यस्यां भार्यायां सम्बभूव ह ।। 7.12.12 ।।
transliteration: kanyā hi dve kule nityaṃ saṃśaye sthāpya tiṣṭhati | putradvayaṃ mamāpyasyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ sambabhūva ha || 7.12.12 ||
translation: कन्या a daughter, हि indeed, द्वे two, कुले families, नित्यं always, संशये in doubt, स्थाप्य having placed, तिष्ठति remains, पुत्रद्वयं two sons, मम my, अपि also, अस्यां in this, भार्यायां wife, सम्बभूव were born, ह indeed,
explanation: Indeed, a daughter always keeps two families in a state of uncertainty; also, two sons were born to me from this wife.

shloka_text: मायावी प्रथमस्तात दुन्दुभिस्तदनन्तरः । एवं ते सर्वमाख्यातं याथातथ्येन पृच्छतः ।। 7.12.13 ।।
transliteration: māyāvī prathamastāta dundubhistadanantaraḥ | evaṃ te sarvamākhyātaṃ yāthātathyena pṛcchataḥ || 7.12.13 ||
translation: मायावी Mayavi, प्रथमः the first, तात O dear one, दुन्दुभिः Dundubhi, तदनन्तरः thereafter. एवम् thus, ते to you, सर्वम् all, आख्यातम् has been told, याथातथ्येन truthfully, पृच्छतः to one who asks.
explanation: O dear one, Mayavi was the first, and Dundubhi came after him; thus, everything has been truthfully told to you who asked.

shloka_text: त्वामिदानीं कथं तात जानीयां को भवानिति । एवमुक्तस्तु तद्रक्षो विनीतमिदमब्रवीत् ।। 7.12.14 ।।
transliteration: tvāmidānīṃ kathaṃ tāta jānīyāṃ ko bhavāniti | evamuktastu tadrakṣo vinītamidamabravīt || 7.12.14 ||
translation: त्वाम् you, इदानीम् now, कथम् how, तात dear one, जानीयाम् shall I know, कः who, भवान् you, इति thus, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु but, तत् that, रक्षः demon, विनीतम् humbly, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: "How shall I know you now, dear one, who are you?" When thus spoken to, that demon humbly replied this.

shloka_text: अहं पौलस्त्यतनयो दशग्रीवश्च नामतः । मुनेर्विश्रवसो यस्तु तृतीयो ब्रह्मणो ऽभवत् ।। 7.12.15 ।।
transliteration: ahaṃ paulastyatanayo daśagrīvaśca nāmataḥ | munerviśravaso yastu tṛtīyo brahmaṇo 'bhavat || 7.12.15 ||
translation: अहम् I, पौलस्त्यतनयः the son of Pulastya, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, च and, नामतः by name. मुनेः of the sage, विश्रवसः Vishrava, यः who, तु indeed, तृतीयः the third, ब्रह्मणः from Brahma, अभवत् was born.
explanation: "I am the son of Pulastya, named Dashagriva, and I am the son of Sage Vishrava, who was the third (generation) from Brahma."

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तदा राम राक्षसेन्द्रेण दानवः । महर्षेस्तनयं ज्ञात्वा मयो हर्षमुपागतः । दातुं दुहितरं तस्मै रोचयामास यत्र वै ।। 7.12.16 ।।
transliteration: evamuktastadā rāma rākṣasendreṇa dānavaḥ | maharṣestanayaṃ jñātvā mayo harṣamupāgataḥ | dātuṃ duhitaraṃ tasmai rocayāmāsa yatra vai || 7.12.16 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तदा then, राम O Rama, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the king of demons, दानवः the Danava (Maya), महर्षेः of the great sage, तनयम् the son, ज्ञात्वा having known, मयः Maya, हर्षम् joy, उपागतः attained. दातुम् to give, दुहितरम् his daughter, तस्मै to him, रोचयामास desired, यत्र वै indeed.
explanation: O Rama, when the king of demons spoke thus, Maya, the Danava, felt joy upon knowing him to be the son of the great sage, and indeed desired to give his daughter to him.

shloka_text: करेण तु करं तस्या ग्राहयित्वा मयस्तदा । प्रहसन्प्राह दैत्येन्द्रो राक्षसेन्द्रमिदं वचः ।। 7.12.17 ।।
transliteration: kareṇa tu karaṃ tasyā grāhayitvā mayastadā | prahasanprāha daityendro rākṣasendramidaṃ vacaḥ || 7.12.17 ||
translation: करेण with his hand, तु and, करम् the hand, तस्याः of her (daughter), ग्राहयित्वा having caused to grasp, मयः Maya, तदा then, प्रहसन् laughing, प्राह said, दैत्येन्द्रः the king of Daityas, राक्षसेन्द्रम् to the king of Rakshasas, इदम् this, वचः word.
explanation: Then, Maya, the king of Daityas, having made the king of Rakshasas grasp his daughter's hand with his own, laughed and spoke these words to him.

shloka_text: इयं ममात्मजा राजन्हेमया ऽप्सरसा धृता । कन्या मन्दोदरी नाम पत्न्यर्थं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ।। 7.12.18 ।।
transliteration: iyaṃ mamātmajā rājanhemayā 'psarasā dhṛtā | kanyā mandodarī nāma patnyarthaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 7.12.18 ||
translation: इयम् this, मम my, आत्मजा daughter, राजन् O King, हेमया by Hema, अप्सरसा Apsara, धृता borne, कन्या maiden, मन्दोदरी Mandodari, नाम named, पत्नी wife, अर्थम् for the purpose of, प्रतिगृह्यताम् let her be accepted.
explanation: O King, this is my daughter, born of the Apsara Hema, named Mandodari; let her be accepted as your wife.

shloka_text: बाढमित्येव तं राम दशग्रीवो ऽभ्यभाषत । प्रज्चाल्य तत्र चैवाग्निमकरोत्पाणिसङ्ग्रहम् ।। 7.12.19 ।।
transliteration: bāḍhamityeva taṃ rāma daśagrīvo 'bhyabhāṣata | prajcālya tatra caivāgnimakarotpāṇisaṅgraham || 7.12.19 ||
translation: बाढम् certainly, इति thus, एव indeed, तम् him, राम O Rama, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, अभ्यभाषत spoke to, प्रज्चाल्य having kindled, तत्र there, च and, एव indeed, अग्निम् fire, अकरोत् he performed, पाणिसङ्ग्रहम् the taking of the hand.
explanation: O Rama, Dashagriva indeed said "Agreed" to him, and having kindled a fire there, he performed the marriage ceremony.

shloka_text: स हि तस्य मयो राम शापाभिज्ञस्तपोधनात् । विदित्वा तेन सा दत्ता तस्य पैतामहं कुलम् ।। 7.12.20 ।।
transliteration: sa hi tasya mayo rāma śāpābhijñastapodhanāt | viditvā tena sā dattā tasya paitāmahaṃ kulam || 7.12.20 ||
translation: सः he, हि indeed, तस्य his, मयः Maya, राम O Rama, शाप curse, अभिज्ञः knowing, तपोधनात् from the ascetic, विदित्वा having known, तेन by him, सा she, दत्ता given, तस्य his, पैतामहम् paternal grandfather's, कुलम् lineage.
explanation: O Rama, Maya, indeed knowing of the curse from the ascetic regarding Ravana's paternal grandfather's lineage, gave his daughter to him.

shloka_text: अमोघां तस्य शक्तिं च प्रददौ परमाद्भुताम् । परेण तपसा लब्धां जघ्निवाँल्लक्ष्मणं यया ।। 7.12.21 ।।
transliteration: amoghāṃ tasya śaktiṃ ca pradadau paramādbhutām | pareṇa tapasā labdhāṃ jaghnivāँllakṣmaṇaṃ yayā || 7.12.21 ||
translation: अमोघाम् unfailing, तस्य to him, शक्तिम् spear, च and, प्रददौ he gave, परम supremely, अद्भुताम् wonderful, परेण by great, तपसा penance, लब्धाम् obtained, जघ्निवाँल् one who struck, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, यया by which.
explanation: And he also gave him the supremely wonderful and unfailing spear, obtained through great penance, by which Lakshmana was struck.

shloka_text: एवं सीकृतदारो वै लङ्काया ईश्वरः प्रभुः । गत्वा तु नगरीं भार्ये भ्रातृभ्यां समुपाहरत् ।। 7.12.22 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ sīkṛtadāro vai laṅkāyā īśvaraḥ prabhuḥ | gatvā tu nagarīṃ bhārye bhrātṛbhyāṃ samupāharat || 7.12.22 ||
translation: एवं thus, सीकृतदारो having taken wives, वै indeed, लङ्कायाः of Lanka, ईश्वरः the lord, प्रभुः the mighty one, गत्वा having gone, तु and, नगरीं to the city, भार्ये two wives, भ्रातृभ्यां for his brothers, समुपाहरत् he presented.
explanation: Thus, the mighty lord of Lanka, Ravana, having taken wives for himself, went to the city and presented two wives to his brothers.

shloka_text: वैरोचनस्य दौहित्रीं वज्रज्वालेति नामतः । तां भार्यां कुम्भकर्णस्य रावणः समकल्पयत् ।। 7.12.23 ।।
transliteration: vairocanasya dauhitrīṃ vajrajvāleti nāmataḥ | tāṃ bhāryāṃ kumbhakarṇasya rāvaṇaḥ samakalpayat || 7.12.23 ||
translation: वैरोचनस्य of Virochana, दौहित्रीं the granddaughter, वज्रज्वालेति named Vajrajvala, नामतः by name, तां her, भार्यां as wife, कुम्भकर्णस्य of Kumbhakarna, रावणः Ravana, समकल्पयत् arranged.
explanation: Ravana arranged for Vajrajvala, the granddaughter of Virochana, to be Kumbhakarna's wife.

shloka_text: गन्धर्वराजस्य सुतां शैलूषस्य महात्मनः । सरमां नाम धर्मज्ञां लेभे भार्यां विभीषणः ।। 7.12.24 ।।
transliteration: gandharvarājasya sutāṃ śailūṣasya mahātmanaḥ | saramāṃ nāma dharmajñāṃ lebhe bhāryāṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ || 7.12.24 ||
translation: गन्धर्वराजस्य of the king of Gandharvas, सुतां the daughter, शैलूषस्य of Shailusha, महात्मनः the great-souled, सरमां Sarama, नाम named, धर्मज्ञां knowing dharma, लेभे obtained, भार्यां as wife, विभीषणः Vibhishana.
explanation: Vibhishana obtained as his wife Sarama, the righteous daughter of the great-souled Gandharva king Shailusha.

shloka_text: तीरे तु सरसो वै तु सञ्जज्ञे मानसस्य हि । सरस्तदा मानसं तु ववृधे जलदागमे ।। 7.12.25 ।।
transliteration: tīre tu saraso vai tu sañjajñe mānasasya hi | sarastadā mānasaṃ tu vavṛdhe jaladāgame || 7.12.25 ||
translation: तीरे on the bank, तु indeed, सरसः of the lake, वै truly, तु and, सञ्जज्ञे she was born, मानसस्य of Manasa, हि indeed; सरः the lake, तदा then, मानसं Manasa, तु but, ववृधे grew, जलदागमे at the arrival of clouds.
explanation: She was born on the bank of Lake Manasa, and at that time, during the rainy season, Lake Manasa was overflowing.

shloka_text: मात्रा तु तस्याः कन्यायाः स्नेहेनाक्रन्दितं वचः । सरो मा वर्धयस्वेति ततः सा सरमा ऽभवत् ।। 7.12.26 ।।
transliteration: mātrā tu tasyāḥ kanyāyāḥ snehenākranditaṃ vacaḥ | saro mā vardhayasveti tataḥ sā saramā 'bhavat || 7.12.26 ||
translation: मात्रा by the mother, तु and, तस्याः of that, कन्यायाः girl, स्नेहेन with affection, आक्रन्दितं cried out, वचः words, सरः O lake, मा do not, वर्धयस्व grow, इति thus; ततः from that, सा she, सरमा Sarama, अभवत् became.
explanation: And with affection, the mother of that girl cried out, "O lake, do not grow!", and from that incident, she became known as Sarama.

shloka_text: एवं ते कृतदारा वै रेमिरे तत्र राक्षसाः । स्वां स्वां भार्यामुपागम्य गन्धर्वा इव नन्दने ।। 7.12.27 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ te kṛtadārā vai remire tatra rākṣasāḥ | svāṃ svāṃ bhāryāmupāgamya gandharvā iva nandane || 7.12.27 ||
translation: एवं thus, ते they, कृतदाराः having taken wives, वै indeed, रेमिरे enjoyed, तत्र there, राक्षसाः the Rakshasas, स्वां स्वां their respective, भार्याम् wife, उपागम्य having approached, गन्धर्वाः Gandharvas, इव like, नन्दने in Nandana.
explanation: Thus, having taken wives, those Rakshasas indeed enjoyed themselves there, approaching their respective wives, just like Gandharvas in the Nandana garden.

shloka_text: ततो मन्दोदरी पुत्रं मेघनादमजीजनत् । स एष इन्द्रजिन्नाम युष्माभिरभिधीयते ।। 7.12.28 ।।
transliteration: tato mandodarī putraṃ meghanādamajījanat | sa eṣa indrajinnāma yuṣmābhirabhidhīyate || 7.12.28 ||
translation: ततो then, मन्दोदरी Mandodari, पुत्रं a son, मेघनादम् Meghanada, अजीजनत् gave birth to; सः he, एषः this, इन्द्रजित्नाम named Indrajit, युष्माभिः by you all, अभिधीयते is called.
explanation: Mandodari then gave birth to a son named Meghanada, who is known to you all as Indrajit.

shloka_text: जातमात्रेण हि पुरा तेन रावणसूनुना । रुदता सुमहान्मुक्तो नादो जलधरोपमः ।। 7.12.29 ।।
transliteration: jātamātreṇa hi purā tena rāvaṇasūnunā | rudatā sumahānmukto nādo jaladharopamaḥ || 7.12.29 ||
translation: जातमात्रेण immediately after birth, हि indeed, पुरा formerly, तेन by him, रावणसूनुना by Ravana's son, रुदता while crying, सुमहान् a very great, मुक्तः was emitted, नादः sound/roar, जलधरोपमः like a thundercloud.
explanation: Indeed, immediately after his birth, Ravana's son, while crying, emitted a tremendous roar resembling a thundercloud.

shloka_text: जडीकृता च सा लङ्का तस्य नादेन राघव । पिता तस्याकरोन्नाम मेघनाद इति स्वयम् ।। 7.12.30 ।।
transliteration: jaḍīkṛtā ca sā laṅkā tasya nādena rāghava | pitā tasyākaronnāma meghanāda iti svayam || 7.12.30 ||
translation: जडीकृता was stunned, च and, सा that, लङ्का Lanka, तस्य his, नादेन by the sound/roar, राघव O Raghava; पिता father, तस्य his, अकरोत् made/gave, नाम name, मेघनाद Meghanada, इति thus, स्वयम् himself.
explanation: O Raghava, that Lanka was stunned by his roar, and his father himself named him Meghanada.

shloka_text: सो ऽवर्धत तदा राम रावणान्तःपुरे शुभे । रक्ष्यमाणो वरस्त्रीभिश्छन्नः काष्ठैरिवानलः ।। 7.12.31 ।।
transliteration: so 'vardhata tadā rāma rāvaṇāntaḥpure śubhe | rakṣyamāṇo varastrībhiśchannaḥ kāṣṭhairivānalaḥ || 7.12.31 ||
translation: सः he, अवर्धत grew up, तदा then, राम O Rama, रावणान्तःपुरे in Ravana's inner palace, शुभे auspicious/beautiful, रक्ष्यमाणः being protected, वरस्त्रीभिः by excellent women, छन्नः covered/hidden, काष्ठैः by wood, इव like, अनलः fire.
explanation: O Rama, he then grew up in Ravana's beautiful inner palace, protected by excellent women, like a fire hidden by wood.

shloka_text: मातापित्रोर्महाहर्षं जनयन्रावणात्मजः ।। 7.12.32 ।।
transliteration: mātāpitrormahāharṣaṃ janayanrāvaṇātmajaḥ || 7.12.32 ||
translation: मातापित्रोः of his mother and father, महाहर्षं great joy, जनयन् causing/generating, रावणात्मजः Ravana's son.
explanation: Ravana's son was causing great joy to his mother and father. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्वादशः सर्गः ।। 12 ।। Thus ends the twelfth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: अथ लोकेश्वरोत्सृष्टा तत्र कालेन केनचित् । निद्रा समभवत्तीव्रा कुम्भकर्णस्य रूपिणी ।। 7.13.1 ।।
transliteration: atha lokeśvarotsṛṣṭā tatra kālena kenacit | nidrā samabhavattīvrā kumbhakarṇasya rūpiṇī || 7.13.1 ||
translation: अथ then, लोकेश्वरोत्सृष्टा sent forth by the Lord of the worlds, तत्र there, कालेन केनचित् after some time, निद्रा sleep, समभवत् arose, तीव्रा intense, कुम्भकर्णस्य of Kumbhakarna, रूपिणी embodied.
explanation: Then, after some time, an intense, embodied sleep, sent forth by the Lord of the worlds, arose there for Kumbhakarna.
comments: Overcome by his boon of sleep, Kumbhakarna has a vast dwelling built and sinks into his long slumber, while Ravana ravages the worlds, slaying gods and sages and laying waste their gardens -- Kubera sends a messenger urging him to abandon unrighteousness, recounting his own penance and friendship with Shiva -- enraged, Ravana slays the messenger, feeds him to the rakshasas, and sets out to make war on Kubera.

shloka_text: ततो भ्रातरमासीनं कुम्भकर्णो ऽब्रवीद्वचः । निद्रा मां बाधते राजन्कारयस्व ममालयम् ।। 7.13.2 ।।
transliteration: tato bhrātaramāsīnaṃ kumbhakarṇo 'bravīdvacaḥ | nidrā māṃ bādhate rājankārayasva mamālayam || 7.13.2 ||
translation: ततः then, भ्रातरम् to his brother, आसीनम् seated, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, अब्रवीत् spoke, वचः words, निद्रा sleep, माम् me, बाधते afflicts, राजन् O King, कारयस्व cause to be built, मम my, आलयम् dwelling.
explanation: Then, Kumbhakarna spoke to his seated brother, saying, "O King, sleep afflicts me; please have a dwelling built for me."

shloka_text: विनियुक्तास्ततो राज्ञा शिल्पिनो विश्वकर्मवत् । विस्तीर्णं योजनं शुभ्रं ततो द्विगुणमायतम् ।। 7.13.3 ।।
transliteration: viniyuktāstato rājñā śilpino viśvakarmavat | vistīrṇaṃ yojanaṃ śubhraṃ tato dviguṇamāyatam || 7.13.3 ||
translation: विनियुक्ताः appointed, ततः then, राज्ञा by the king, शिल्पिनः artisans, विश्वकर्मवत् like Vishvakarma, विस्तीर्णम् wide, योजनम् a yojana, शुभ्रम् splendid, ततः from that, द्विगुणम् double, आयतम् long.
explanation: Then, artisans like Vishvakarma were appointed by the king to construct a splendid dwelling, one yojana wide and twice that in length.

shloka_text: दर्शनीयं निराबाधं कुम्भकर्णस्य चक्रिरे । स्फाटिकैः काञ्चनैश्चित्रैः स्तम्भैः सर्वत्र शोभितम् ।। 7.13.4 ।।
transliteration: darśanīyaṃ nirābādhaṃ kumbhakarṇasya cakrire | sphāṭikaiḥ kāñcanaiścitraiḥ stambhaiḥ sarvatra śobhitam || 7.13.4 ||
translation: दर्शनीयम् beautiful to behold, निराबाधम् unobstructed, कुम्भकर्णस्य for Kumbhakarna, चक्रिरे they made, स्फाटिकैः with crystal, काञ्चनैः with gold, चित्रैः variegated, स्तम्भैः with pillars, सर्वत्र everywhere, शोभितम् adorned.
explanation: They built for Kumbhakarna a beautiful and unobstructed dwelling, adorned everywhere with variegated pillars of crystal and gold.

shloka_text: वैडूर्यकृतसोपानं किङ्किणीजालकं तथा । दान्ततोरणविन्यस्तं वज्रस्फटिकवेदिकम् ।। 7.13.5 ।।
transliteration: vaiḍūryakṛtasopānaṃ kiṅkiṇījālakaṃ tathā | dāntatoraṇavinyastaṃ vajrasphaṭikavedikam || 7.13.5 ||
translation: वैडूर्यकृतसोपानं having steps made of lapis lazuli, किङ्किणीजालकं a network of small bells, तथा and, दान्ततोरणविन्यस्तं adorned with ivory archways, वज्रस्फटिकवेदिकम् having platforms of diamond and crystal.
explanation: The structure featured steps made of lapis lazuli, a network of small bells, ivory archways, and platforms of diamond and crystal.

shloka_text: मनोहरं सर्वसुखं कारयामास राक्षसः । सर्वत्र सुखदं नित्यं मेरोः पुण्यां गुहामिव ।। 7.13.6 ।।
transliteration: manoharaṃ sarvasukhaṃ kārayāmāsa rākṣasaḥ | sarvatra sukhadaṃ nityaṃ meroḥ puṇyāṃ guhāmiva || 7.13.6 ||
translation: मनोहरं charming, सर्वसुखं providing all comforts, कारयामास caused to be made, राक्षसः the demon, सर्वत्र everywhere, सुखदं giving comfort, नित्यं always, मेरोः of Mount Meru, पुण्यां sacred, गुहामिव like a cave.
explanation: The demon (Ravana) had a charming and universally comfortable dwelling built, which was always pleasant, like a sacred cave on Mount Meru.

shloka_text: तत्र निद्रां समाविष्टः कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः । बहून्यब्दसहस्राणि शयानो न प्रबुद्ध्यते ।। 7.13.7 ।।
transliteration: tatra nidrāṃ samāviṣṭaḥ kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ | bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi śayāno na prabuddhyate || 7.13.7 ||
translation: तत्र there, निद्रां sleep, समाविष्टः overcome by, कुम्भकर्णो Kumbhakarna, महाबलः the greatly powerful, बहून्यब्दसहस्राणि for many thousands of years, शयानो sleeping, न not, प्रबुद्ध्यते awakens.
explanation: There, the greatly powerful Kumbhakarna, overcome by sleep, remained sleeping for many thousands of years without awakening.

shloka_text: निद्राभिभूते तु तदा कुम्भकर्णे दशाननः । देवर्षियक्षगन्धर्वान्सञ्जघ्ने हि निरङ्कुशः ।। 7.13.8 ।।
transliteration: nidrābhibhūte tu tadā kumbhakarṇe daśānanaḥ | devarṣiyakṣagandharvānsañjaghne hi niraṅkuśaḥ || 7.13.8 ||
translation: निद्राभिभूते when overcome by sleep, तु indeed, तदा then, कुम्भकर्णे Kumbhakarna, दशाननः Dashanana (Ravana), देवर्षियक्षगन्धर्वान् gods, sages, Yakshas, and Gandharvas, सञ्जघ्ने killed, हि indeed, निरङ्कुशः unrestrained.
explanation: When Kumbhakarna was overcome by sleep, the unrestrained Dashanana (Ravana) then indeed killed gods, sages, Yakshas, and Gandharvas.

shloka_text: उद्यानानि च चित्राणि नन्दनादीनि यानि च । तानि गत्वा सुसङक्रुद्धो भिनत्ति स्म दशाननः ।। 7.13.9 ।।
transliteration: udyānāni ca citrāṇi nandanādīni yāni ca | tāni gatvā susaṅakruddho bhinatti sma daśānanaḥ || 7.13.9 ||
translation: उद्यानानि gardens, च and, चित्राणि beautiful, नन्दनादीनि Nandana and others, यानि which, च and, तानि those, गत्वा having gone, सुसङक्रुद्धो very enraged, भिनत्ति broke, स्म (past tense indicator), दशाननः Dashanana (Ravana).
explanation: Dashanana (Ravana), having gone to those beautiful gardens, including Nandana and others, very enraged, proceeded to destroy them.

shloka_text: नदीं गज इव क्रीडन्वृक्षान्वायुरिव क्षिपन् । नगान्व्रज्र इवोत्सृष्टो विध्वंसयति राक्षसः ।। 7.13.10 ।।
transliteration: nadīṃ gaja iva krīḍanvṛkṣānvāyuriva kṣipan | nagānvrajra ivotsṛṣṭo vidhvaṃsayati rākṣasaḥ || 7.13.10 ||
translation: नदीं river, गज इव like an elephant, क्रीडन् playing, वृक्षान् trees, वायुर् इव like wind, क्षिपन् throwing down, नगान् mountains, व्रज्र इव like a thunderbolt, उत्सृष्टो hurled, विध्वंसयति destroys, राक्षसः the demon.
explanation: The demon destroys everything, playing with rivers like an elephant, throwing down trees like the wind, and shattering mountains like a hurled thunderbolt.

shloka_text: तथावृत्तं तु विज्ञाय दशग्रीवं धनेश्वरः । कुलानुरूपं धर्मज्ञो वृत्तं संस्मृत्य चात्मनः ।। 7.13.11 ।।
transliteration: tathāvṛttaṃ tu vijñāya daśagrīvaṃ dhaneśvaraḥ | kulānurūpaṃ dharmajño vṛttaṃ saṃsmṛtya cātmanaḥ || 7.13.11 ||
translation: तथावृत्तं such conduct, तु indeed, विज्ञाय having known, दशग्रीवं Daśagrīva's, धनेश्वरः the lord of wealth (Kubera), कुलानुरूपं befitting the family, धर्मज्ञो knowing righteousness, वृत्तं conduct, संस्मृत्य having remembered, च and, आत्मनः his own.
explanation: Kubera, the lord of wealth and a knower of righteousness, having learned of Daśagrīva's conduct and remembering his own family's appropriate behavior, decided to act.

shloka_text: सौभ्रात्रदर्शनार्थं तु दूतं वैश्रवणस्तदा । लङ्कां सम्प्रेषयामास दशग्रीवस्य वै हितम् ।। 7.13.12 ।।
transliteration: saubhrātradarśanārthaṃ tu dūtaṃ vaiśravaṇastadā | laṅkāṃ sampreṣayāmāsa daśagrīvasya vai hitam || 7.13.12 ||
translation: सौभ्रात्रदर्शनार्थं for the sake of showing brotherly affection, तु indeed, दूतं a messenger, वैश्रवणस्तदा Vaiśravaṇa (Kubera) then, लङ्कां to Lanka, सम्प्रेषयामास sent, दशग्रीवस्य of Daśagrīva, वै indeed, हितम् beneficial.
explanation: Then, Kubera, wishing to demonstrate brotherly affection and for Daśagrīva's welfare, sent a messenger to Lanka.

shloka_text: स गत्वा नगरीं लङ्कामाससाद विभीषणम् । मानितस्तेन धर्मेण पृष्टश्चागमनं प्रति ।। 7.13.13 ।।
transliteration: sa gatvā nagarīṃ laṅkāmāsasāda vibhīṣaṇam | mānitastena dharmeṇa pṛṣṭaścāgamanaṃ prati || 7.13.13 ||
translation: स he (the messenger), गत्वा having gone, नगरीं to the city, लङ्कां Lanka, आससाद met, विभीषणम् Vibhīṣaṇa, मानितस्तेन honored by him, धर्मेण properly, पृष्टश्चागमनं and questioned about his arrival, प्रति regarding.
explanation: Having arrived in the city of Lanka, the messenger met Vibhīṣaṇa, who honored him properly and inquired about the purpose of his visit.

shloka_text: पृष्ट्वा च कुशलं राज्ञो ज्ञातीनां च बिभीषणः । सभायां दर्शयामास तमासीनं दशाननम् ।। 7.13.14 ।।
transliteration: pṛṣṭvā ca kuśalaṃ rājño jñātīnāṃ ca bibhīṣaṇaḥ | sabhāyāṃ darśayāmāsa tamāsīnaṃ daśānanam || 7.13.14 ||
translation: पृष्ट्वा having asked, च and, कुशलं welfare, राज्ञो of the king, ज्ञातीनां of the relatives, च and, बिभीषणः Vibhīṣaṇa, सभायां in the assembly, दर्शयामास showed, तमासीनं him seated, दशाननम् Daśānana (Rāvaṇa).
explanation: After inquiring about the welfare of the king and his relatives, Vibhīṣaṇa led the messenger to the assembly hall where Daśānana was seated.

shloka_text: स दृष्ट्वा तत्र राजानं दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा । जयेति वाचा सम्पूज्य तूष्णीं समभिवर्तत ।। 7.13.15 ।।
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā tatra rājānaṃ dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā | jayeti vācā sampūjya tūṣṇīṃ samabhivartata || 7.13.15 ||
translation: स he (the messenger), दृष्ट्वा having seen, तत्र there, राजानं the king, दीप्यमानं shining, स्वतेजसा with his own splendor, जयेति "Victory!", वाचा with words, सम्पूज्य having honored, तूष्णीं silently, समभिवर्तत stood.
explanation: Upon seeing the king shining with his own splendor, the messenger honored him with words of "Victory!" and then stood silently.

shloka_text: तं तत्रोत्तमपर्यङ्के वरास्तरणशोभिते । उपविष्टं दशग्रीवं दूतो वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।। 7.13.16 ।।
transliteration: taṃ tatrottamaparyaṅke varāstaraṇaśobhite | upaviṣṭaṃ daśagrīvaṃ dūto vākyamathābravīt || 7.13.16 ||
translation: तम् him, तत्र there, उत्तमपर्यङ्के on an excellent couch, वरास्तरणशोभिते adorned with excellent coverings, उपविष्टम् seated, दशग्रीवम् Dashagriva (Ravana), दूतः the messenger, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: The messenger then spoke words to Dashagriva, who was seated there on an excellent couch adorned with fine coverings.

shloka_text: राजन्वदामि ते सर्वं भ्राता तव यदब्रवीत् । उभयोः सदृशं वीर वृत्तस्य च कुलस्य च ।। 7.13.17 ।।
transliteration: rājanvadāmi te sarvaṃ bhrātā tava yadabravīt | ubhayoḥ sadṛśaṃ vīra vṛttasya ca kulasya ca || 7.13.17 ||
translation: राजन् O King, वदामि I tell, ते you, सर्वम् all, भ्राता brother, तव your, यत् what, अब्रवीत् spoke, उभयोः of both (of us), सदृशम् befitting, वीर O hero, वृत्तस्य of conduct, च and, कुलस्य of lineage, च and.
explanation: O King, I will tell you everything that your brother spoke, which is befitting of the conduct and lineage of both of us, O hero.

shloka_text: साधु पर्याप्तमेतावत्कृतश्चारित्रसङ्ग्रहः । साधु धर्मे व्यवस्थानं क्रियतां यदि शक्यते ।। 7.13.18 ।।
transliteration: sādhu paryāptametāvatkṛtaścāritrasaṅgrahaḥ | sādhu dharme vyavasthānaṃ kriyatāṃ yadi śakyate || 7.13.18 ||
translation: साधु enough, पर्याप्तम् enough, एतावत् this much, कृतः done, चारित्रसङ्ग्रहः accumulation of character (deeds), साधु proper, धर्मे in righteousness, व्यवस्थानम् adherence, क्रियताम् let it be done, यदि if, शक्यते it is possible.
explanation: Enough of this accumulation of deeds; it is proper that adherence to righteousness be established, if it is possible.

shloka_text: दृष्टं मे नन्दनं भग्नमृषयो निहताः श्रुताः । देवतानां समुद्योगस्त्वत्तो राजन्मम श्रुतः ।। 7.13.19 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭaṃ me nandanaṃ bhagnamṛṣayo nihatāḥ śrutāḥ | devatānāṃ samudyogastvatto rājanmama śrutaḥ || 7.13.19 ||
translation: दृष्टम् seen, मे by me, नन्दनम् Nandana (garden), भग्नम् destroyed, ऋषयः sages, निहताः killed, श्रुताः heard, देवतानाम् of the gods, समुद्योगः preparation, त्वत्तः from you, राजन् O King, मम by me, श्रुतः heard.
explanation: I have seen the Nandana garden destroyed, I have heard that sages were killed, and I have heard from you, O King, about the gods' preparations.

shloka_text: निराकृतश्च बहुशस्त्वया ऽहं राक्षसाधिप । अपराद्धा हि बाल्याच्च रमणीयाः स्वबान्धवाः ।। 7.13.20 ।।
transliteration: nirākṛtaśca bahuśastvayā 'haṃ rākṣasādhipa | aparāddhā hi bālyācca ramaṇīyāḥ svabāndhavāḥ || 7.13.20 ||
translation: निराकृतः rejected, च and, बहुशः many times, त्वया by you, अहम् I, राक्षसाधिप O lord of Rakshasas, अपराद्धाः those who have erred, हि indeed, बाल्यात् due to childishness, च and, रमणीयाः should be cherished, स्वबान्धवाः one's own relatives.
explanation: O lord of Rakshasas, I have been disregarded by you many times, yet one's own relatives, even if they have erred due to childishness, should indeed be cherished.

shloka_text: अहं तु हिमवत्पृष्ठं गतो धर्ममुपासितुम् । रौद्रं व्रत्तं समास्थाय नियतो नियतेन्द्रियः ।। 7.13.21 ।।
transliteration: ahaṃ tu himavatpṛṣṭhaṃ gato dharmamupāsitum | raudraṃ vrattaṃ samāsthāya niyato niyatendriyaḥ || 7.13.21 ||
translation: अहं I, तु indeed, हिमवत्पृष्ठं to the peak of Himavat, गतो went, धर्मम् dharma, उपासितुम् to practice, रौद्रं fierce, व्रत्तं vow, समास्थाय having undertaken, नियतः self-controlled, नियतेन्द्रियः with controlled senses.
explanation: I indeed went to the peak of the Himalayas to practice dharma, having undertaken a severe vow, disciplined and with my senses controlled.

shloka_text: तत्र देवो मया दृष्टः सह देव्या मया प्रभुः । सव्यं चक्षुर्मया दैवात्तत्र देव्यां निपातितम् ।। 7.13.22 ।।
transliteration: tatra devo mayā dṛṣṭaḥ saha devyā mayā prabhuḥ | savyaṃ cakṣurmayā daivāttatra devyāṃ nipātitam || 7.13.22 ||
translation: तत्र there, देवः the god, मया by me, दृष्टः was seen, सह with, देव्या the goddess, मया by me, प्रभुः the lord, सव्यं left, चक्षुः eye, मया by me, दैवात् by chance, तत्र there, देव्यां on the goddess, निपातितम् was cast.
explanation: There, I saw the Lord, the god Shiva, with the goddess Parvati, and by chance, my left eye fell upon the goddess.

shloka_text: का न्वियं स्यादिति शुभा न खल्वन्येन हेतुना । रूपं ह्यनुपमं कृत्वा रुद्राणी तत्र तिष्ठति ।। 7.13.23 ।।
transliteration: kā nviyaṃ syāditi śubhā na khalvanyena hetunā | rūpaṃ hyanupamaṃ kṛtvā rudrāṇī tatra tiṣṭhati || 7.13.23 ||
translation: का who, नु indeed, इयं this, स्यात् might be, इति thus, शुभा beautiful one, न not, खलु indeed, अन्येन by another, हेतुना reason, रूपं form, हि indeed, अनुपमं incomparable, कृत्वा having assumed, रुद्राणी Rudra's consort, तत्र there, तिष्ठति stands.
explanation: I wondered, "Who might this beautiful one be?" and not for any other reason, for Rudra's consort, Parvati, stood there having assumed an incomparable form.

shloka_text: देव्या दिव्यप्रभावेण दग्धं सव्यं ममेक्षणम् । रेणुध्वस्तमिव ज्योतिः पिङ्गुलत्वमुपागतम् ।। 7.13.24 ।।
transliteration: devyā divyaprabhāveṇa dagdhaṃ savyaṃ mamekṣaṇam | reṇudhvastamiva jyotiḥ piṅgulatvamupāgatam || 7.13.24 ||
translation: देव्या by the goddess, दिव्यप्रभावेण by divine power, दग्धं burnt, सव्यं left, मम my, ईक्षणम् eye, रेणुध्वस्तम् dust-covered, इव like, ज्योतिः light, पिङ्गुलत्वम् yellowish-brown color, उपागतम् attained.
explanation: By the divine power of the goddess, my left eye was burnt, and it became yellowish-brown, like a flame obscured by dust.

shloka_text: ततो ऽहमन्यद्विस्तीर्णं गत्वा तस्य गिरेस्तटम् । तूष्णीं वर्षशतान्यष्टौ समाधारं महाव्रतम् ।। 7.13.25 ।।
transliteration: tato 'hamanyadvistīrṇaṃ gatvā tasya girestaṭam | tūṣṇīṃ varṣaśatānyaṣṭau samādhāraṃ mahāvratam || 7.13.25 ||
translation: ततः then, अहं I, अन्यत् another, विस्तीर्णं expansive, गत्वा having gone, तस्य of that, गिरेः mountain's, तटम् slope, तूष्णीं silently, वर्षशतानि hundreds of years, अष्टौ eight, समाधारं observed, महाव्रतम् great vow.
explanation: Then, I went to another expansive slope of that mountain and silently observed a great vow for eight hundred years.

shloka_text: समाप्ते नियमे तस्मिंस्तत्र देवो महेश्वरः । प्रीतः प्रीतेन मनसा प्राह वाक्यमिदं प्रभुः ।। 7.13.26 ।।
transliteration: samāpte niyame tasmiṃstatra devo maheśvaraḥ | prītaḥ prītena manasā prāha vākyamidaṃ prabhuḥ || 7.13.26 ||
translation: तस्मिन् that, नियमे vow, समाप्ते when completed, तत्र there, प्रभुः the lord, देवो महेश्वरः god Maheshvara, प्रीतः pleased, प्रीतेन मनसा with a gladdened mind, इदं वाक्यं these words, प्राह spoke.
explanation: When that austerity was completed, the lord Maheshvara, well pleased, spoke these words there with a gladdened mind.

shloka_text: पैङ्गल्यं यदवाप्तं हि देव्या रूपनिरीक्षणात् । प्रीतो ऽस्मि तव धर्मज्ञ तपसा नेन सुव्रत ।। 7.13.27 ।।
transliteration: paiṅgalyaṃ yadavāptaṃ hi devyā rūpanirīkṣaṇāt | prīto 'smi tava dharmajña tapasā nena suvrata || 7.13.27 ||
translation: पैङ्गल्यं yellowness, यत् which, अवाप्तं obtained, हि indeed, देव्या by the goddess, रूपनिरीक्षणात् from seeing (her) form, प्रीतो ऽस्मि I am pleased, तव your, धर्मज्ञ O knower of dharma, तपसा by penance, अनेन by this, सुव्रत O one of good vows.
explanation: O knower of dharma, O one of good vows, I am indeed pleased by this penance of yours, which resulted in the yellowness (of your eye) from gazing upon the goddess's form.

shloka_text: मया चैतद्व्रतं चीर्णं त्वया चैव धनाधिप । तृतीयः पुरुषो नास्ति यश्चरेव्रतमीदृशम् ।। 7.13.28 ।।
transliteration: mayā caitadvrataṃ cīrṇaṃ tvayā caiva dhanādhipa | tṛtīyaḥ puruṣo nāsti yaścarevratamīdṛśam || 7.13.28 ||
translation: मया च and by me, एतद् व्रतं this vow, चीर्णं performed, त्वया च एव and by you alone, धनाधिप O lord of wealth, तृतीयः a third, पुरुषो person, न अस्ति there is not, यः who, चरेत् would perform, व्रतम् a vow, ईदृशम् such.
explanation: O lord of wealth, this vow has been performed by me and by you alone, for there is no third person who could perform such a vow.

shloka_text: व्रतं सुनिश्चयं ह्येतन्मया ह्युत्पादितं पुरा । तत्सखित्वं मया सौम्य रोचयस्व धनेश्वर ।। 7.13.29 ।।
transliteration: vrataṃ suniścayaṃ hyetanmayā hyutpāditaṃ purā | tatsakhitvaṃ mayā saumya rocayasva dhaneśvara || 7.13.29 ||
translation: व्रतं vow, सुनिश्चयं very firm, हि indeed, एतत् this, मया हि indeed by me, उत्पादितं originated, पुरा formerly, तत् therefore, सखित्वं friendship, मया with me, सौम्य O gentle one, रोचयस्व desire, धनेश्वर O lord of wealth.
explanation: This very firm vow was indeed originated by me in the past, therefore, O gentle lord of wealth, desire friendship with me.

shloka_text: तपसा निर्जितश्चैव सखा भव ममानघ । देव्या दग्धं प्रभावेण यच्च सव्यं तवेक्षणम् ।। 7.13.30 ।।
transliteration: tapasā nirjitaścaiva sakhā bhava mamānagha | devyā dagdhaṃ prabhāveṇa yacca savyaṃ tavekṣaṇam || 7.13.30 ||
translation: तपसा by penance, निर्जितः च एव conquered and indeed, सखा friend, भव become, मम my, अनघ O sinless one, देव्या by the goddess, दग्धं burnt, प्रभावेण by the power, यत् च and which, सव्यं left, तव your, ईक्षणम् eye.
explanation: O sinless one, having been conquered by your penance, become my friend, especially since your left eye was burnt by the power of the goddess.

shloka_text: एकाक्षिपिङ्गलेत्येव नाम स्थास्यति शाश्वतम् । एवं तेन सखित्वं च प्राप्यानुज्ञां च शङ्करात् ।। 7.13.31 ।।
transliteration: ekākṣipiṅgaletyeva nāma sthāsyati śāśvatam | evaṃ tena sakhitvaṃ ca prāpyānujñāṃ ca śaṅkarāt || 7.13.31 ||
translation: एकाक्षिपिङ्गलेति Ekakshipingala, एव indeed, नाम name, स्थास्यति will remain, शाश्वतम् eternal, एवम् thus, तेन by him, सखित्वम् friendship, च and, प्राप्य having obtained, अनुज्ञाम् permission, च and, शङ्करात् from Shankara.
explanation: Thus, the name Ekakshipingala will remain eternal, and having obtained friendship and permission from Lord Shankara, Kubera spoke.

shloka_text: आगत्य च श्रुतो ऽयं मे तव पापविनिश्चयः ।। 7.13.32 ।।
transliteration: āgatya ca śruto 'yaṃ me tava pāpaviniścayaḥ || 7.13.32 ||
translation: आगत्य having come, च and, श्रुतः heard, अयम् this, मे by me, तव your, पापविनिश्चयः sinful resolve.
explanation: And having come here, I have heard of this sinful resolve of yours.

shloka_text: तदधर्मिष्ठसंयोगान्निवर्त कुलदूषणात् । चिन्त्यते हि वधोपायः सर्षिसङ्घैः सुरैस्तव ।। 7.13.33 ।।
transliteration: tadadharmiṣṭhasaṃyogānnivarta kuladūṣaṇāt | cintyate hi vadhopāyaḥ sarṣisaṅghaiḥ suraistava || 7.13.33 ||
translation: तत् therefore, अधर्मिष्ठसंयोगात् from unrighteous union, निवर्त turn back, कुलदूषणात् from disgracing your family, चिन्त्यते is being thought of, हि indeed, वधोपायः means of killing, सर्षिसङ्घैः by the sages along with their groups, सुरैः by the gods, तव your.
explanation: Therefore, desist from this unrighteous union which disgraces your family, for indeed, the gods along with the groups of sages are contemplating a means to kill you.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः क्रुद्धसंरक्तलोचनः । हस्तौ दन्तांश्च सम्पीड्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.13.34 ।।
transliteration: evamukto daśagrīvaḥ kruddhasaṃraktalocanaḥ | hastau dantāṃśca sampīḍya vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.13.34 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, क्रुद्धसंरक्तलोचनः with eyes red with anger, हस्तौ hands, दन्तान् teeth, च and, सम्पीड्य having pressed/gnashed, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.
explanation: Thus addressed, Dashagriva, with eyes red with anger, gnashed his teeth and spoke these words.

shloka_text: विज्ञातं ते मया दूत वाक्यं यस्य प्रभाषसे । नैतत्त्वमसि नैवासौ भ्रात्रा येनासि चोदितः ।। 7.13.35 ।।
transliteration: vijñātaṃ te mayā dūta vākyaṃ yasya prabhāṣase | naitattvamasi naivāsau bhrātrā yenāsi coditaḥ || 7.13.35 ||
translation: विज्ञातम् understood, ते your, मया by me, दूत O messenger, वाक्यम् words, यस्य whose, प्रभाषसे you speak, न not, एतत् this, त्वम् you, असि are, न not, एव indeed, असौ he, भ्रात्रा by the brother, येन by whom, असि you are, चोदितः instigated.
explanation: O messenger, I have understood your words which you speak and whose message it is; you are not this person, nor is he the brother by whom you claim to be instigated.

shloka_text: हितं नैष ममैतद्धि ब्रवीति धनरक्षकः । महेश्वरसखित्वं तु मूढ श्रावयते किल ।। 7.13.36 ।।
transliteration: hitaṃ naiṣa mamaitaddhi bravīti dhanarakṣakaḥ | maheśvarasakhitvaṃ tu mūḍha śrāvayate kila || 7.13.36 ||
translation: हितं beneficial, न not, एष this (one), मम my, एतत् this, हि indeed, ब्रवीति speaks, धनरक्षकः the protector of wealth (Kubera), महेश्वरसखित्वं friendship with Maheśvara (Shiva), तु but, मूढ foolish one, श्रावयते makes (me) hear, किल indeed.
explanation: This protector of wealth (Kubera) is not speaking what is beneficial for me; rather, this fool is indeed making me hear about his friendship with Maheśvara.

shloka_text: न चेदं क्षमणीयं मे यदेतद्भाषितं त्वया । यदेतावन्मया कालं दूत तस्य तु मर्षितम् ।। 7.13.37 ।।
transliteration: na cedaṃ kṣamaṇīyaṃ me yadetadbhāṣitaṃ tvayā | yadetāvanmayā kālaṃ dūta tasya tu marṣitam || 7.13.37 ||
translation: न not, च and, इदं this, क्षमणीयं to be forgiven, मे by me, यत् that which, एतत् this, भाषितं spoken, त्वया by you, यत् that which, एतावत् so much, मया by me, कालं time, दूत O messenger, तस्य his, तु but, मर्षितम् endured.
explanation: O messenger, what you have spoken is not to be forgiven by me, though I have endured his (Kubera's) actions for so long.

shloka_text: न हन्तव्यो गुरुर्ज्येष्ठो मया ऽयमिति मन्यते । तस्य त्विदानीं श्रुत्वा मे वाक्यमेषा कृता मतिः ।। 7.13.38 ।।
transliteration: na hantavyo gururjyeṣṭho mayā 'yamiti manyate | tasya tvidānīṃ śrutvā me vākyameṣā kṛtā matiḥ || 7.13.38 ||
translation: न not, हन्तव्यो to be killed, गुरुः preceptor, ज्येष्ठो elder brother, मया by me, अयं this (one), इति thus, मन्यते (he) thinks, तस्य his, तु but, इदानीं now, श्रुत्वा having heard, मे my, वाक्यं word, एषा this, कृता made, मतिः decision.
explanation: He (Kubera) thinks that this elder brother, my preceptor, should not be killed by me, but having now heard my words, this decision has been made by me.

shloka_text: त्रीँल्लोकानपि जेष्यामि बाहुवीर्यमुपाश्रितः ।। 7.13.39 ।।
transliteration: trīँllokānapi jeṣyāmi bāhuvīryamupāśritaḥ || 7.13.39 ||
translation: त्रीँल् three, लोकान् worlds, अपि even, जेष्यामि I shall conquer, बाहुवीर्यम् strength of arms, उपाश्रितः having resorted to.
explanation: Relying on the strength of my arms, I shall conquer even the three worlds.

shloka_text: एतन्मुहूर्तमेवाहं तस्यैकस्य तु वै कृते । चतुरो लोकपालांस्तान्नयिष्यामि यमक्षयम् ।। 7.13.40 ।।
transliteration: etanmuhūrtamevāhaṃ tasyaikasya tu vai kṛte | caturo lokapālāṃstānnayiṣyāmi yamakṣayam || 7.13.40 ||
translation: एतत् this, मुहूर्तम् moment, एव only, अहं I, तस्य his, एकस्य one (Kubera's), तु but, वै indeed, कृते for the sake of, चतुरो four, लोकपालांस् world-protectors, तान् those, नयिष्यामि I shall lead, यमक्षयम् to Yama's abode.
explanation: Indeed, for the sake of that one (Kubera) alone, I shall, in this very moment, lead those four world-protectors to Yama's abode.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा तु लङ्केशो दूतं खड्गेन जघ्निवान् । ददौ भक्षयितुं ह्येनं राक्षसानां दुरात्मनाम् ।। 7.13.41 ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu laṅkeśo dūtaṃ khaḍgena jaghnivān | dadau bhakṣayituṃ hyenaṃ rākṣasānāṃ durātmanām || 7.13.41 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, तु indeed, लङ्केशो the lord of Lanka (Ravana), दूतं the messenger, खड्गेन with a sword, जघ्निवान् killed, ददौ gave, भक्षयितुं to devour, हि indeed, एनं him, राक्षसानां to the Rākṣasas, दुरात्मनाम् wicked.
explanation: Having spoken thus, Ravana, the lord of Lanka, killed the messenger with his sword and gave him to the wicked Rākṣasas to be devoured.

shloka_text: एवं कृतस्वस्त्ययनो रथमारुह्य रावणः । त्रैलोक्यविजयाकाङ्क्षी ययौ यत्र धनेश्वरः ।। 7.13.42 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ kṛtasvastyayano rathamāruhya rāvaṇaḥ | trailokyavijayākāṅkṣī yayau yatra dhaneśvaraḥ || 7.13.42 ||
translation: एवं thus, कृतस्वस्त्ययनो one who had performed auspicious rites, रथम् chariot, आरुह्य having ascended, रावणः Ravana, त्रैलोक्यविजयाकाङ्क्षी desirous of conquering the three worlds, ययौ went, यत्र where, धनेश्वरः the lord of wealth.
explanation: Having thus performed auspicious rites and mounted his chariot, Ravana, desirous of conquering the three worlds, went to where Kubera, the lord of wealth, resided. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रयोदशः सर्गः ।। 13 ।। Thus ends the thirteenth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततस्तु सचिवैः सार्धं षड्भिर्नित्यं बलोद्धतैः । महोदरप्रहस्ताभ्यां मारीचशुकसारणैः ।। 7.14.1 ।।
transliteration: tatastu sacivaiḥ sārdhaṃ ṣaḍbhirnityaṃ baloddhataiḥ | mahodaraprahastābhyāṃ mārīcaśukasāraṇaiḥ || 7.14.1 ||
translation: ततस्तु then, सचिवैः with ministers, सार्धम् together with, षड्भिः six, नित्यम् always, बलोद्धतैः arrogant with strength, महोदरप्रहस्ताभ्याम् by Mahodara and Prahasta, मारीचशुकसारणैः by Maricha, Shuka, and Sarana.
explanation: Then, accompanied by six powerful ministers, including Mahodara, Prahasta, Maricha, Shuka, and Sarana, he proceeded.
comments: Ravana with his ministers marches on Kailasa and gives battle to Kubera's Yakshas -- the rakshasa lords slaughter the host, and Ravana, unharmed by their weapons through Brahma's boon, breaks through -- the doorkeeper Suryabhanu bars his way, but Ravana uproots the gateway and reduces him to ashes, routing the Yakshas.

shloka_text: धूम्राक्षेण च वीरेण नित्यं समरगृध्नुना । वृतः संप्रययौ श्रीमान्क्रोधाल्लोकान्दहन्निव ।। 7.14.2 ।।
transliteration: dhūmrākṣeṇa ca vīreṇa nityaṃ samaragṛdhnunā | vṛtaḥ saṃprayayau śrīmānkrodhāllokāndahanniva || 7.14.2 ||
translation: धूम्राक्षेण by Dhūmrākṣa, च and, वीरेण by the brave one, नित्यम् always, समरगृध्नुना eager for battle, वृतः surrounded, संप्रययौ he set out, श्रीमान् the glorious one, क्रोधात् from anger, लोकान् the worlds, दहन्निव as if burning.
explanation: Accompanied by the brave Dhūmrākṣa, who was always eager for battle, the glorious Ravana set out, as if burning the worlds with his rage.

shloka_text: पुराणि स नदीः शैलान्वनान्युपवनानि च । अतिक्रम्य मुहूर्तेन कैलासं गिरिमागमत् ।। 7.14.3 ।।
transliteration: purāṇi sa nadīḥ śailānvanānyupavanāni ca | atikramya muhūrtena kailāsaṃ girimāgamat || 7.14.3 ||
translation: पुराणि cities, स he, नदीः rivers, शैलान् mountains, वनानि forests, उपवनानि groves, च and, अतिक्रम्य having crossed, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, कैलासम् Kailasa, गिरिम् mountain, आगमत् he reached.
explanation: He swiftly crossed cities, rivers, mountains, forests, and groves, reaching Mount Kailasa in a short time.

shloka_text: सन्निविष्टं गिरौ तस्मिन्राक्षसेन्द्रं निशम्य तु । युद्धे ऽत्यर्थकृतोत्साहं दुरात्मानं समन्त्रिणम् ।। 7.14.4 ।।
transliteration: sanniviṣṭaṃ girau tasminrākṣasendraṃ niśamya tu | yuddhe 'tyarthakṛtotsāhaṃ durātmānaṃ samantriṇam || 7.14.4 ||
translation: सन्निविष्टम् settled, गिरौ on the mountain, तस्मिन् on that, राक्षसेन्द्रम् the lord of Rakshasas, निशम्य having perceived, तु indeed, युद्धे in battle, अत्यर्थकृतोत्साहम् extremely enthusiastic, दुरात्मानम् the evil-minded one, समन्त्रिणम् with his ministers.
explanation: The lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, was perceived to be settled on that mountain with his ministers, an evil-minded one extremely enthusiastic for battle.

shloka_text: यक्षा न शेकुः संस्थातुं प्रमुखे तस्य रक्षसः । राज्ञो भ्रातेति विज्ञाय गता यत्र धनेश्वरः ।। 7.14.5 ।।
transliteration: yakṣā na śekuḥ saṃsthātuṃ pramukhe tasya rakṣasaḥ | rājño bhrāteti vijñāya gatā yatra dhaneśvaraḥ || 7.14.5 ||
translation: यक्षा the Yakṣas, न not, शेकुः were able, संस्थातुं to stand, प्रमुखे in the presence, तस्य of that, रक्षसः Rākṣasa (Ravana), राज्ञो of the king (Kubera), भ्राता brother, इति thus, विज्ञाय having known, गता went, यत्र where, धनेश्वरः the lord of wealth (Kubera).
explanation: The Yakṣas were unable to stand before that Rākṣasa (Ravana), and knowing him to be the king's (Kubera's) brother, they went to where Kubera, the lord of wealth, was.

shloka_text: ते गत्वा सर्वमाचख्युर्भ्रातुस्तस्य चिकीर्षितम् । अनुज्ञाता ययुर्हष्टा युद्धाय धनदेन ते ।। 7.14.6 ।।
transliteration: te gatvā sarvamācakhyurbhrātustasya cikīrṣitam | anujñātā yayurhaṣṭā yuddhāya dhanadena te || 7.14.6 ||
translation: ते they, गत्वा having gone, सर्वम् all, आचख्युर् reported, भ्रातुस् of the brother, तस्य his, चिकीर्षितम् intention, अनुज्ञाता permitted, ययुर् went, हष्टा joyful, युद्धाय for battle, धनदेन by Kubera, ते they.
explanation: Having gone, they reported all of his brother's intentions, and being permitted by Kubera, they joyfully went forth to battle.

shloka_text: ततो बलानां सङ्क्षोभो व्यवर्धत महोदधेः । तस्य नैर्ऋतराजस्य शैलं सञ्चालयन्निव ।। 7.14.7 ।।
transliteration: tato balānāṃ saṅkṣobho vyavardhata mahodadheḥ | tasya nairṛtarājasya śailaṃ sañcālayanniva || 7.14.7 ||
translation: ततो then, बलानां of the armies, सङ्क्षोभो the commotion, व्यवर्धत increased, महोदधेः like the great ocean, तस्य of that, नैर्ऋतराजस्य king of Rākṣasas (Ravana), शैलं a mountain, सञ्चालयन् shaking, इव as if.
explanation: Then, the commotion of the armies of that king of Rākṣasas (Ravana) grew like the great ocean, as if shaking a mountain.

shloka_text: ततो युद्धं समभवद्यक्षराक्षससङ्कुलम् । व्यथिताश्चाभवंस्तत्र सचिवा राक्षसस्य ते ।। 7.14.8 ।।
transliteration: tato yuddhaṃ samabhavadyakṣarākṣasasaṅkulam | vyathitāścābhavaṃstatra sacivā rākṣasasya te || 7.14.8 ||
translation: ततो then, युद्धं a battle, समभवद् occurred, यक्षराक्षससङ्कुलम् crowded with Yakṣas and Rākṣasas, व्यथिताश् distressed, च and, अभवंस् became, तत्र there, सचिवा the ministers, राक्षसस्य of the Rākṣasa (Ravana), ते those.
explanation: Then a battle ensued, crowded with Yakṣas and Rākṣasas, and there the ministers of the Rākṣasa (Ravana) became distressed.

shloka_text: स दृष्ट्वा तादृशं सैन्यं दशग्रीवो निशाचरः । हर्षनादान्बहून्कृत्वा स क्रोधादभ्यधावत ।। 7.14.9 ।।
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ sainyaṃ daśagrīvo niśācaraḥ | harṣanādānbahūnkṛtvā sa krodhādabhyadhāvata || 7.14.9 ||
translation: सः He, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तादृशं such a, सैन्यं army, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, हर्षनादान् roars of joy, बहून् many, कृत्वा having made, सः he, क्रोधात् from anger, अभ्यधावत rushed towards.
explanation: Seeing such a vast army, the demon Dashagriva, after uttering many roars of joy, rushed forward in a fit of rage.

shloka_text: ये तु ते राक्षसेन्द्रस्य सचिवा घोरविक्रमाः । तेषां सहस्रमेकैकं यक्षाणां समयोधयन् ।। 7.14.10 ।।
transliteration: ye tu te rākṣasendrasya sacivā ghoravikramāḥ | teṣāṃ sahasramekaikaṃ yakṣāṇāṃ samayodhayan || 7.14.10 ||
translation: ये those, तु indeed, ते those, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the king of demons, सचिवाः ministers, घोरविक्रमाः of terrible prowess, तेषां of them, सहस्रम् a thousand, एकैकं each one, यक्षाणां of the Yakshas, समयोधयन् fought.
explanation: Each of those ministers of the king of demons, who were of terrible prowess, fought against a thousand Yakshas.

shloka_text: ततो गदाभिर्मुसलैरसिभिः शक्तितोमरैः । हन्यमानो दशग्रीवस्तत्सैन्यं समगाहत ।। 7.14.11 ।।
transliteration: tato gadābhirmusalairasibhiḥ śaktitomaraiḥ | hanyamāno daśagrīvastatsainyaṃ samagāhata || 7.14.11 ||
translation: ततः then, गदाभिः with maces, मुसलैः with clubs, असिभिः with swords, शक्तितोमरैः with spears and javelins, हन्यमानः being struck, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, तत् that, सैन्यं army, समगाहत plunged into.
explanation: Then, even while being struck by maces, clubs, swords, spears, and javelins, Dashagriva plunged into that army.

shloka_text: स निरुच्छ्वासवत्तत्र वध्यमानो दशाननः । वर्षद्भिरिव जीमूतैर्धाराभिरवरुध्यत ।। 7.14.12 ।।
transliteration: sa nirucchvāsavattatra vadhyamāno daśānanaḥ | varṣadbhiriva jīmūtairdhārābhiravarudhyata || 7.14.12 ||
translation: सः he, निरुच्छ्वासवत् as if breathless, तत्र there, वध्यमानः being struck down, दशाननः Dashanana, वर्षद्भिः by raining, इव as if, जीमूतैः by clouds, धाराभिः by streams of rain, अवरुध्यत was obstructed.
explanation: There, Dashanana, being struck down as if breathless, was obstructed by the continuous onslaught of weapons, much like clouds pouring down streams of rain.

shloka_text: न चकार व्यथां चैव यक्षशस्त्रैः समाहतः । महीधर इवाम्भोदैर्धाराशतसमुक्षितः ।। 7.14.13 ।।
transliteration: na cakāra vyathāṃ caiva yakṣaśastraiḥ samāhataḥ | mahīdhara ivāmbhodairdhārāśatasamukṣitaḥ || 7.14.13 ||
translation: न not, चकार did he feel, व्यथां pain, च and, एव indeed, यक्षशस्त्रैः by the weapons of the Yakshas, समाहतः struck, महीधरः a mountain, इव like, अम्भोदैः by clouds, धाराशतसमुक्षितः drenched by hundreds of streams of rain.
explanation: Even though struck by the weapons of the Yakshas, he felt no pain, just like a mountain remains unaffected when drenched by hundreds of streams of rain from clouds.

shloka_text: स दुरात्मा समुद्यम्य कालदण्डोपमां गदाम् । प्रविवेश ततः सैन्यं नयन्यक्षान्यमक्षयम् ।। 7.14.14 ।।
transliteration: sa durātmā samudyamya kāladaṇḍopamāṃ gadām | praviveśa tataḥ sainyaṃ nayanyakṣānyamakṣayam || 7.14.14 ||
translation: सः he, दुरात्मा the evil-minded one, समुद्यम्य having raised, कालदण्डोपमां resembling the staff of Yama (Death), गदाम् mace, प्रविवेश entered, ततः then, सैन्यं the army, नयन् leading, यक्षान् the Yakshas, यमक्षयम् to the abode of Yama (death)
explanation: The evil-minded one, having raised his mace resembling the staff of Yama, then entered the army, leading the Yakshas to their death.

shloka_text: स कक्षमिव विस्तीर्णं शुष्केन्धनमिवाकुलम् । वातेनाग्निरिवायत्तो यक्षसैन्यं ददाह तत् ।। 7.14.15 ।।
transliteration: sa kakṣamiva vistīrṇaṃ śuṣkendhanamivākulam | vātenāgnirivāyatto yakṣasainyaṃ dadāha tat || 7.14.15 ||
translation: सः he, कक्षमिव like a dry forest, विस्तीर्णं vast, शुष्केन्धनमिव like dry fuel, आकुलम् crowded/filled, वातेन by the wind, अग्निः fire, इव like, आयत्तः empowered/driven, यक्षसैन्यं the Yaksha army, ददाह burned, तत् that
explanation: He, like a fire empowered by the wind, burned that vast Yaksha army, which was crowded like a dry forest filled with dry fuel.

shloka_text: तैस्तु तत्र महामात्यैर्महोदरशुकादिभिः । अल्पावशेषास्ते यक्षाः कृता वातैरिवाम्बुदाः ।। 7.14.16 ।।
transliteration: taistu tatra mahāmātyairmahodaraśukādibhiḥ | alpāvaśeṣāste yakṣāḥ kṛtā vātairivāmbudāḥ || 7.14.16 ||
translation: तैः by them, तु indeed, तत्र there, महामात्यैः by the great ministers, महोदरशुकादिभिः like Mahodara, Shuka, and others, अल्पावशेषाः few remaining, ते those, यक्षाः Yakshas, कृताः were made, वातैः by winds, इव like, अम्बुदाः clouds
explanation: There, those Yakshas were reduced to a few remaining, like clouds scattered by winds, by those great ministers such as Mahodara and Shuka.

shloka_text: केचित्समाहता भग्नाः पतिताः समरक्षितौ । ओष्ठांश्च दशनैस्तीक्ष्णैरदशन्कुपिता रणे ।। 7.14.17 ।।
transliteration: kecitsamāhatā bhagnāḥ patitāḥ samarakṣitau | oṣṭhāṃśca daśanaistīkṣṇairadaśankupitā raṇe || 7.14.17 ||
translation: केचित् some, समाहताः struck down, भग्नाः broken/defeated, पतिताः fallen, समरक्षितौ on the battlefield, ओष्ठांश्च and their lips, दशनैः with teeth, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, अदशन् bit, कुपिताः enraged, रणे in battle
explanation: Some, struck down and defeated, fell on the battlefield, while others, enraged in battle, bit their lips with sharp teeth.

shloka_text: श्रान्ताश्चान्योन्यमालिङ्ग्य भ्रष्टशस्त्रा रणाजिरे । सीदन्ति च तदा यक्षाः कूला इव जलेन ह ।। 7.14.18 ।।
transliteration: śrāntāścānyonyamāliṅgya bhraṣṭaśastrā raṇājire | sīdanti ca tadā yakṣāḥ kūlā iva jalena ha || 7.14.18 ||
translation: श्रान्ताः exhausted, च and, अन्योन्यम् each other, आलिङ्ग्य embracing, भ्रष्टशस्त्राः with lost weapons, रणाजिरे on the battlefield, सीदन्ति sank/collapsed, च and, तदा then, यक्षाः the Yakshas, कूलाः riverbanks, इव like, जलेन by water, ह indeed
explanation: Exhausted and with their weapons lost, the Yakshas then collapsed on the battlefield, embracing each other, like riverbanks eroded by water.

shloka_text: हतानां गच्छतां स्वर्गं युध्यतां पृथिवीतले । प्रेक्षतामृषिसङ्घानां न बभूवान्तरं दिवि ।। 7.14.19 ।।
transliteration: hatānāṃ gacchatāṃ svargaṃ yudhyatāṃ pṛthivītale | prekṣatāmṛṣisaṅghānāṃ na babhūvāntaraṃ divi || 7.14.19 ||
translation: हतानां of those killed, गच्छतां of those going, स्वर्गं to heaven, युध्यतां of those fighting, पृथिवीतले on the surface of the earth, प्रेक्षताम् of those watching, ऋषिसङ्घानां of the groups of sages, न not, बभूव there was, अन्तरं space, दिवि in the sky.
explanation: There was no space left in the sky due to the multitude of those killed going to heaven, those fighting on earth, and the groups of sages watching.

shloka_text: भग्नांस्तु तान्समालक्ष्य यक्षेन्द्रांस्तु महाबलान् । धनाध्यक्षो महाबाहुः प्रेषयामास यक्षकान् ।। 7.14.20 ।।
transliteration: bhagnāṃstu tānsamālakṣya yakṣendrāṃstu mahābalān | dhanādhyakṣo mahābāhuḥ preṣayāmāsa yakṣakān || 7.14.20 ||
translation: भग्नांस्तु but those defeated, तान् them, समालक्ष्य having seen, यक्षेन्द्रांस्तु and the great Yaksha chiefs, महाबलान् very powerful, धनाध्यक्षो the lord of wealth, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, प्रेषयामास sent, यक्षकान् other Yakshas.
explanation: Seeing those powerful Yaksha chiefs defeated, the mighty-armed Kubera, the lord of wealth, dispatched other Yakshas.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम विस्तीर्णबलवाहनः । प्रेषितो न्यपतद्यक्षो नाम्ना संयोधकण्टकः ।। 7.14.21 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare rāma vistīrṇabalavāhanaḥ | preṣito nyapatadyakṣo nāmnā saṃyodhakaṇṭakaḥ || 7.14.21 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, राम O Rama, विस्तीर्णबलवाहनः with extensive army and vehicles, प्रेषितो sent, न्यपतत् fell upon, यक्षो a Yaksha, नाम्ना by name, संयोधकण्टकः Samyodhakantaka.
explanation: O Rama, at that very moment, a Yaksha named Samyodhakantaka, sent with a vast army and chariots, attacked.

shloka_text: तेन चक्रेण मारीचो विष्णुनेव रणे हतः । पतितो भूतले शैलात्क्षीणपुण्य इव ग्रहः ।। 7.14.22 ।।
transliteration: tena cakreṇa mārīco viṣṇuneva raṇe hataḥ | patito bhūtale śailātkṣīṇapuṇya iva grahaḥ || 7.14.22 ||
translation: तेन by that, चक्रेण discus, मारीचो Maricha, विष्णुनेव as if by Vishnu, रणे in battle, हतः killed, पतितो fallen, भूतले on the ground, शैलात् from a mountain, क्षीणपुण्य one whose merit is exhausted, इव like, ग्रहः a planet.
explanation: Maricha was struck down in battle by that discus, as if by Vishnu, and fell to the earth like a planet whose merits are exhausted falling from a mountain.

shloka_text: ससञ्ज्ञस्तु मुहूर्तेन स विश्रम्य निशाचरः । तं यक्षं योधयामास स च भग्नः प्रदुद्रुवे ।। 7.14.23 ।।
transliteration: sasañjñastu muhūrtena sa viśramya niśācaraḥ | taṃ yakṣaṃ yodhayāmāsa sa ca bhagnaḥ pradudruve || 7.14.23 ||
translation: ससञ्ज्ञस्तु but having regained consciousness, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, स he, विश्रम्य having rested, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, तं that, यक्षं Yaksha, योधयामास fought, स he, च and, भग्नः defeated, प्रदुद्रुवे fled.
explanation: However, the night-wanderer Maricha regained consciousness in a moment, rested, and then fought that Yaksha, who was subsequently defeated and fled.

shloka_text: ततः काञ्चनचित्राङ्गं वैडूर्यरजसोक्षितम् । मर्यादां प्रतिहाराणां तोरणान्तरमाविशत् ।। 7.14.24 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kāñcanacitrāṅgaṃ vaiḍūryarajasokṣitam | maryādāṃ pratihārāṇāṃ toraṇāntaramāviśat || 7.14.24 ||
translation: ततः then, काञ्चनचित्राङ्गं whose body was adorned with gold, वैडूर्यरजसोक्षितम् sprinkled with sapphire dust, मर्यादां the boundary, प्रतिहाराणां of the doorkeepers, तोरणान्तरम् inside the archway, आविशत् he entered.
explanation: Then, he entered the archway, which was the boundary of the doorkeepers, adorned with gold and sprinkled with sapphire dust.

shloka_text: तं तु राजन्दशग्रीवं प्रविशन्तं निशाचरम् । सूर्यभानुरिति ख्यातो द्वारपालो न्यवारयत् ।। 7.14.25 ।।
transliteration: taṃ tu rājandaśagrīvaṃ praviśantaṃ niśācaram | sūryabhānuriti khyāto dvārapālo nyavārayat || 7.14.25 ||
translation: तं him, तु indeed, राजन् O King, दशग्रीवं Dashagriva, प्रविशन्तं entering, निशाचरम् the night-wanderer, सूर्यभानुरिति by the name Suryabhanu, ख्यातो known, द्वारपालो the doorkeeper, न्यवारयत् obstructed.
explanation: O King, the doorkeeper known as Suryabhanu obstructed that Dashagriva, the night-wanderer, as he was entering.

shloka_text: स वार्यमाणो यक्षेण प्रविवेश निशाचरः । यदा तु वारितो राम न व्यतिष्ठत्स राक्षसः ।। 7.14.26 ।।
transliteration: sa vāryamāṇo yakṣeṇa praviveśa niśācaraḥ | yadā tu vārito rāma na vyatiṣṭhatsa rākṣasaḥ || 7.14.26 ||
translation: स he, वार्यमाणो being obstructed, यक्षेण by the Yaksha, प्रविवेश entered, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, यदा when, तु but, वारितो obstructed, राम O Rama, न व्यतिष्ठत् did not stop, स that, राक्षसः demon.
explanation: Though obstructed by the Yaksha, the night-wanderer entered, and O Rama, when that demon was stopped, he did not halt.

shloka_text: ततस्तोरणमुत्पाट्य तेन यक्षेण ताडितः । रुधिरं प्रस्रवन्भाति शैलो धातुस्रवैरिव ।। 7.14.27 ।।
transliteration: tatastoraṇamutpāṭya tena yakṣeṇa tāḍitaḥ | rudhiraṃ prasravanbhāti śailo dhātusravairiva || 7.14.27 ||
translation: ततः then, तोरणम् the archway, उत्पाट्य having uprooted, तेन by that, यक्षेण Yaksha, ताडितः struck, रुधिरं blood, प्रस्रवन् flowing, भाति appears, शैलो a mountain, धातुस्रवैरिव like streams of minerals.
explanation: Then, having uprooted the archway, he was struck by that Yaksha, and with blood flowing, he appeared like a mountain with streams of minerals.

shloka_text: स शैलशिखराभेण तोरणेन समाहतः । जगाम न क्षतिं वीरो वरदानात्स्वयम्भुवः ।। 7.14.28 ।।
transliteration: sa śailaśikharābheṇa toraṇena samāhataḥ | jagāma na kṣatiṃ vīro varadānātsvayambhuvaḥ || 7.14.28 ||
translation: स he, शैलशिखराभेण resembling a mountain peak, तोरणेन by the archway, समाहतः struck, जगाम न did not suffer, क्षतिं harm, वीरो the hero, वरदानात् due to the boon, स्वयम्भुवः of Svayambhu (Brahma).
explanation: Though struck by the archway resembling a mountain peak, the hero suffered no harm due to the boon granted by Svayambhu (Brahma).

shloka_text: तेनैव तोरणेनाथ यक्षस्तेनाभिताडितः । नादृश्यत तदा यक्षो भस्मीकृततनुस्तदा ।। 7.14.29 ।।
transliteration: tenaiva toraṇenātha yakṣastenābhitāḍitaḥ | nādṛśyata tadā yakṣo bhasmīkṛtatanustadā || 7.14.29 ||
translation: तेनैव by that very, तोरणेन by the archway, अथ then, यक्षः the Yaksha, तेन by him, अभिताडितः struck, न not, अदृश्यत was seen, तदा then, यक्षः the Yaksha, भस्मीकृततनुः having his body turned to ashes, तदा then.
explanation: The Yaksha, struck by Ravana with that very archway, was then not seen, his body having been reduced to ashes.

shloka_text: ततः प्रदुद्रुवुः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा रक्षःपराक्रमम् । ततो नदीर्गुहाश्चैव विविशुर्भयपीडिताः । त्यक्तप्रहरणाः श्रान्ता विवर्णवदनास्तदा ।। 7.14.30 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pradudruvuḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā rakṣaḥparākramam | tato nadīrguhāścaiva viviśurbhayapīḍitāḥ | tyaktapraharaṇāḥ śrāntā vivarṇavadanāstadā || 7.14.30 ||
translation: ततः then, प्रदुद्रुवुः fled, सर्वे all, दृष्ट्वा having seen, रक्षःपराक्रमम् the prowess of the Rakshasa, ततः then, नदीः into rivers, गुहाः into caves, च and, एव indeed, विविशुः they entered, भयपीडिताः afflicted by fear, त्यक्तप्रहरणाः having abandoned their weapons, श्रान्ताः exhausted, विवर्णवदनाः with pale faces, तदा then.
explanation: Then, all of them fled, having witnessed the Rakshasa's prowess, and, afflicted by fear, exhausted, with pale faces, and having abandoned their weapons, they then entered rivers and caves. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुर्दशः सर्गः ।। 14 ।। Thus ends the fourteenth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततस्ताँल्लक्ष्य वित्रस्तान्यक्षेन्द्रांश्च सहस्रशः । धनाध्यक्षो महायक्षं माणिचारमथाब्रवीत् ।। 7.15.1 ।।
transliteration: tatastāँllakṣya vitrastānyakṣendrāṃśca sahasraśaḥ | dhanādhyakṣo mahāyakṣaṃ māṇicāramathābravīt || 7.15.1 ||
translation: ततः then, तान् them, लक्ष्य having seen, वित्रस्तान् terrified, यक्षेन्द्रान् the chief Yakshas, च and, सहस्रशः by thousands, धनाध्यक्षः the lord of wealth, महायक्षम् to the great Yaksha, माणिचारम् Manichara, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Then, the lord of wealth, having seen those thousands of terrified chief Yakshas, spoke to the great Yaksha Manichara.
comments: Kubera sends Manibhadra and fresh Yaksha forces, but they are slain in thousands -- Manibhadra duels Ravana and knocks his crown askew -- Kubera himself comes, rebukes Ravana with counsel on righteousness and fights him, but Ravana, resorting to illusion, fells him with a mace -- victorious, Ravana seizes the Pushpaka chariot and, swollen with pride, descends from Kailasa believing he has conquered the three worlds.

shloka_text: रावणं जहि यक्षेन्द्र दुर्वृत्तं पापचेतसम् । शरणं भव वीराणां यक्षाणां युद्धशालिनाम् ।। 7.15.2 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇaṃ jahi yakṣendra durvṛttaṃ pāpacetasam | śaraṇaṃ bhava vīrāṇāṃ yakṣāṇāṃ yuddhaśālinām || 7.15.2 ||
translation: रावणम् Ravana, जहि kill, यक्षेन्द्र O chief of Yakshas, दुर्वृत्तम् ill-behaved, पापचेतसम् evil-minded, शरणम् refuge, भव be, वीराणाम् for the brave ones, यक्षाणाम् for the Yakshas, युद्धशालिनाम् who are skilled in battle.
explanation: O chief of Yakshas, kill the ill-behaved and evil-minded Ravana, and be a refuge for these brave Yakshas skilled in battle.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो महाबाहुर्माणिभद्रः सुदुर्जयः । वृतो यक्षसहस्रैस्तु चतुर्भिः समयोधयत् ।। 7.15.3 ।।
transliteration: evamukto mahābāhurmāṇibhadraḥ sudurjayaḥ | vṛto yakṣasahasraistu caturbhiḥ samayodhayat || 7.15.3 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, माणिभद्रः Manibhadra, सुदुर्जयः very difficult to conquer, वृतः surrounded, यक्षसहस्रैः by thousands of Yakshas, तु indeed, चतुर्भिः by four (thousands), समयोधयत् he fought.
explanation: Thus addressed, the mighty-armed Manibhadra, who was very difficult to conquer, surrounded by four thousand Yakshas, then engaged in battle.

shloka_text: ते गदामुसलप्रासैः शक्तितोमरमुद्गरैः । अभिघ्नन्तस्तदा यक्षा राक्षसान्समुपाद्रवन् ।। 7.15.4 ।।
transliteration: te gadāmusalaprāsaiḥ śaktitomaramudgaraiḥ | abhighnantastadā yakṣā rākṣasānsamupādravan || 7.15.4 ||
translation: ते they, गदामुसलप्रासैः with maces, pestles, and spears, शक्तितोमरमुद्गरैः with lances, javelins, and hammers, अभिघ्नन्तः striking, तदा then, यक्षाः the Yakshas, राक्षसान् towards the Rakshasas, समुपाद्रवन् rushed
explanation: Then, the Yakshas, striking with maces, pestles, spears, lances, javelins, and hammers, rushed towards the Rakshasas.

shloka_text: कुर्वन्तस्तुमुलं युद्धं चरन्तः श्येनवल्लघु । बाढं प्रयच्छन्नेच्छामि दीयतामिति भाषिणः ।। 7.15.5 ।।
transliteration: kurvantastumulaṃ yuddhaṃ carantaḥ śyenavallaghu | bāḍhaṃ prayacchannecchāmi dīyatāmiti bhāṣiṇaḥ || 7.15.5 ||
translation: कुर्वन्तः doing, तुमुलम् tumultuous, युद्धम् battle, चरन्तः moving, श्येनवत् like a hawk, लघु swiftly, बाढम् fiercely, प्रयच्छन् giving (blows), न not, इच्छामि I wish (to stop), दीयताम् let it be given (the fight), इति thus, भाषिणः speaking
explanation: They engaged in a tumultuous battle, moving swiftly like hawks, giving fierce blows and speaking as if to say, "I do not wish to stop, let the fight be given!"

shloka_text: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वा ऋषयो ब्रह्मवादिनः । दृष्ट्वा तत्तुमुलं युद्धं परं विस्मयमागमन् ।। 7.15.6 ।।
transliteration: tato devāḥ sagandharvā ṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ | dṛṣṭvā tattumulaṃ yuddhaṃ paraṃ vismayamāgaman || 7.15.6 ||
translation: ततः then, देवाः the gods, सगन्धर्वाः with Gandharvas, ऋषयः the sages, ब्रह्मवादिनः who expound the Vedas, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तत् that, तुमुलम् tumultuous, युद्धम् battle, परम् great, विस्मयम् wonder, आगमन् attained
explanation: Then, the gods along with the Gandharvas, and the sages who expound the Vedas, having witnessed that tumultuous battle, were filled with great wonder.

shloka_text: यक्षाणां तु प्रहस्तेन सहस्रं निहतं रणे । महोदरेण चानिन्द्यं सहस्रमपरं हतम् ।। 7.15.7 ।।
transliteration: yakṣāṇāṃ tu prahastena sahasraṃ nihataṃ raṇe | mahodareṇa cānindyaṃ sahasramaparaṃ hatam || 7.15.7 ||
translation: यक्षाणाम् of the Yakshas, तु indeed, प्रहस्तेन by Prahasta, सहस्रम् a thousand, निहतम् slain, रणे in battle, महोदरेण by Mahodara, च and, अनिन्द्यम् blameless (warriors), सहस्रम् a thousand, अपरम् another, हतम् slain
explanation: Indeed, a thousand Yakshas were slain in battle by Prahasta, and another thousand blameless (excellent) Yaksha warriors were slain by Mahodara.

shloka_text: क्रुद्धेन च तदा राजन्मारीचेन युयुत्सुना । निमेषान्तरमात्रेण द्वे सहस्रे निपातिते ।। 7.15.8 ।।
transliteration: kruddhena ca tadā rājanmārīcena yuyutsunā | nimeṣāntaramātreṇa dve sahasre nipātite || 7.15.8 ||
translation: क्रुद्धेन by the enraged, च and, तदा then, राजन् O King, मारीचेन by Maricha, युयुत्सुना who desired to fight, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in merely the twinkling of an eye, द्वे सहस्रे two thousand, निपातिते struck down
explanation: And then, O King, by the enraged Maricha, who desired to fight, two thousand (Yakshas) were struck down in merely the twinkling of an eye.

shloka_text: क्व च यक्षार्जवं युद्धं क्व च मायाबलाश्रयम् । रक्षसां पुरुषव्याघ्र तेन ते ऽभ्यधिका युधि ।। 7.15.9 ।।
transliteration: kva ca yakṣārjavaṃ yuddhaṃ kva ca māyābalāśrayam | rakṣasāṃ puruṣavyāghra tena te 'bhyadhikā yudhi || 7.15.9 ||
translation: क्व च where also, यक्षार्जवं the straightforwardness of the Yakshas, युद्धं battle, क्व च where also, मायाबलाश्रयम् reliance on illusory power, रक्षसां of the Rakshasas, पुरुषव्याघ्र O tiger among men, तेन by that, ते they, अभ्यधिका superior, युधि in battle.
explanation: O tiger among men, how can the straightforward battle of the Yakshas compare with the Rakshasas' reliance on magical power, which is why the Rakshasas are superior in war.

shloka_text: धूम्राक्षेण समागम्य माणिभद्रो महारणे । मुसलेनोरसि क्रोधात्तडितो न च कम्पितः ।। 7.15.10 ।।
transliteration: dhūmrākṣeṇa samāgamya māṇibhadro mahāraṇe | musalenorasi krodhāttaḍito na ca kampitaḥ || 7.15.10 ||
translation: धूम्राक्षेण by Dhūmrākṣa, समागम्य having met, माणिभद्रो Maṇibhadra, महारणे in the great battle, मुसलेन with a mace, उरसि on the chest, क्रोधात् with anger, ताडितो struck, न च and not, कम्पितः trembled.
explanation: In the great battle, Maṇibhadra, having encountered Dhūmrākṣa, was struck on the chest with a mace by him in anger, yet he did not even tremble.

shloka_text: ततो गदां समाविध्य माणिभद्रेण राक्षसः । धूम्राक्षस्ताडितो मूर्ध्नि विह्वलः स पपात ह ।। 7.15.11 ।।
transliteration: tato gadāṃ samāvidhya māṇibhadreṇa rākṣasaḥ | dhūmrākṣastāḍito mūrdhni vihvalaḥ sa papāta ha || 7.15.11 ||
translation: ततो then, गदां a mace, समाविध्य having brandished, माणिभद्रेण by Maṇibhadra, राक्षसः the Rakshasa, धूम्राक्षः Dhūmrākṣa, ताडितो struck, मूर्ध्नि on the head, विह्वलः bewildered, स he, पपात ह indeed fell.
explanation: Then, Maṇibhadra, having brandished his mace, struck the Rakshasa Dhūmrākṣa on the head, and he, bewildered, indeed fell.

shloka_text: धूम्राक्षं ताडितं दृष्ट्वा पतितं शोणितोक्षितम् । अभ्यधावत सङ्ग्रामे माणिभद्रं दशाननः ।। 7.15.12 ।।
transliteration: dhūmrākṣaṃ tāḍitaṃ dṛṣṭvā patitaṃ śoṇitokṣitam | abhyadhāvata saṅgrāme māṇibhadraṃ daśānanaḥ || 7.15.12 ||
translation: धूम्राक्षं Dhūmrākṣa, ताडितं struck, दृष्ट्वा having seen, पतितं fallen, शोणितोक्षितम् drenched in blood, अभ्यधावत rushed towards, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, माणिभद्रं Maṇibhadra, दशाननः Daśānana.
explanation: Having seen Dhūmrākṣa struck, fallen, and drenched in blood, Daśānana rushed towards Maṇibhadra in battle.

shloka_text: तं क्रुद्धमभिधावन्तं माणिभद्रो दशाननम् । शक्तिभिस्ताडयामास तिसृभिर्यक्षपुङ्गवः ।। 7.15.13 ।।
transliteration: taṃ kruddhamabhidhāvantaṃ māṇibhadro daśānanam | śaktibhistāḍayāmāsa tisṛbhiryakṣapuṅgavaḥ || 7.15.13 ||
translation: तं him, क्रुद्धम् angry, अभिधावन्तं rushing towards, माणिभद्रो Maṇibhadra, दशाननम् Daśānana, शक्तिभिः with spears, ताडयामास struck, तिसृभिः with three, यक्षपुङ्गवः the foremost among Yakshas.
explanation: The foremost among Yakshas, Maṇibhadra, struck that angry Daśānana, who was rushing towards him, with three spears.

shloka_text: ताडितो माणिभद्रस्य मुकुटे प्राहरद्रणे । तस्य तेन प्रहारेम मुकुटं पार्श्वमागतम् ।। 7.15.14 ।।
transliteration: tāḍito māṇibhadrasya mukuṭe prāharadraṇe | tasya tena prahārema mukuṭaṃ pārśvamāgatam || 7.15.14 ||
translation: ताडितो being struck, माणिभद्रस्य of Manibhadra, मुकुटे on the crown, प्राहरत् he struck, रणे in battle, तस्य his, तेन by that, प्रहारेण by the blow, मुकुटं the crown, पार्श्वम् to the side, आगतम् came.
explanation: Being struck, he then struck Manibhadra's crown in battle, and by that blow, his crown was knocked to the side.

shloka_text: ततः संयुध्यमानेन विष्टब्धो न व्यकम्पत । तदाप्रभृति यक्षो ऽसौ पार्श्वमौलिरिति स्मृतः । सन्नादः सुमहान्राजंस्तस्मिन्शैले ऽभ्यवर्तत ।। 7.15.15 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ saṃyudhyamānena viṣṭabdho na vyakampata | tadāprabhṛti yakṣo 'sau pārśvamauliriti smṛtaḥ | sannādaḥ sumahānrājaṃstasminśaile 'bhyavartata || 7.15.15 ||
translation: ततः then, संयुध्यमानेन by one who was fighting, विष्टब्धो firm, न not, व्यकम्पत he trembled, तदाप्रभृति from that time onwards, यक्षो the Yaksha, असौ that, पार्श्वमौलिः one with a side-tilted crown, इति thus, स्मृतः is known, सन्नादः a great roar, सुमहान् very great, राजन् O King, तस्मिन् on that, शैले mountain, अभ्यवर्तत resounded.
explanation: Then, though fighting, he remained firm and did not tremble, and from that time onwards, that Yaksha became known as Pārśvamauli (one with a side-tilted crown); O King, a very great roar resounded on that mountain.

shloka_text: ततो दूरात्प्रददृशे धनाध्यक्षो गदाधरः । शुक्रप्रौष्ठपदाभ्यां च पद्मशङ्खसमावृतः ।। 7.15.16 ।।
transliteration: tato dūrātpradadṛśe dhanādhyakṣo gadādharaḥ | śukraprauṣṭhapadābhyāṃ ca padmaśaṅkhasamāvṛtaḥ || 7.15.16 ||
translation: ततः then, दूरात् from afar, प्रददृशे was seen, धनाध्यक्षो the lord of wealth, गदाधरः the mace-wielder, शुक्रप्रौष्ठपदाभ्यां by Shukra and Praushthapada, च and, पद्मशङ्खसमावृतः surrounded by Padma and Shankha.
explanation: Then, from afar, the mace-wielding lord of wealth (Kubera) was seen, accompanied by Shukra and Praushthapada, and surrounded by Padma and Shankha.

shloka_text: स दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरं सङ्ख्ये शापाद्विभ्रष्टगौरवम् । उवाच वचनं धीमान्युक्तं पैतामहे कुले ।। 7.15.17 ।।
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā bhrātaraṃ saṅkhye śāpādvibhraṣṭagauravam | uvāca vacanaṃ dhīmānyuktaṃ paitāmahe kule || 7.15.17 ||
translation: सः he, दृष्ट्वा having seen, भ्रातरं his brother, सङ्ख्ये in battle, शापात् due to a curse, विभ्रष्टगौरवम् whose glory was lost, उवाच spoke, वचनं words, धीमान् the wise one, युक्तं appropriate, पैतामहे in the paternal, कुले family.
explanation: Having seen his brother in battle, whose glory was lost due to a curse, the wise Kubera spoke words appropriate for their paternal lineage.

shloka_text: यन्मया वार्यमाणस्त्वं नावगच्छसि दुर्मते । पश्चादस्य फलं प्राप्य ज्ञास्यसे निरयं गतः ।। 7.15.18 ।।
transliteration: yanmayā vāryamāṇastvaṃ nāvagacchasi durmate | paścādasya phalaṃ prāpya jñāsyase nirayaṃ gataḥ || 7.15.18 ||
translation: यत् because, मया by me, वार्यमाणः being restrained, त्वं you, न not, अवगच्छसि understand, दुर्मते O evil-minded one, पश्चात् afterwards, अस्य of this, फलं the fruit, प्राप्य having obtained, ज्ञास्यसे you will know, निरयं to hell, गतः having gone.
explanation: O evil-minded one, because you do not understand even when restrained by me, you will realize the consequence of this after having gone to hell.

shloka_text: यो हि मोहाद्विषं पीत्वा नावगच्छति दुर्मतिः । स तस्य परिणामान्ते जानीते कर्मणः फलम् ।। 7.15.19 ।।
transliteration: yo hi mohādviṣaṃ pītvā nāvagacchati durmatiḥ | sa tasya pariṇāmānte jānīte karmaṇaḥ phalam || 7.15.19 ||
translation: यः who, हि indeed, मोहात् from delusion, विषम् poison, पीत्वा having drunk, न not, अवगच्छति understands, दुर्मतिः the evil-minded one, सः he, तस्य its, परिणामान्ते at the end of the consequence, जानीते knows, कर्मणः of the action, फलम् the fruit.
explanation: An evil-minded person who, out of delusion, drinks poison and does not understand its nature, will only realize the consequence of that action at its ultimate fruition.

shloka_text: देवता नाभिनन्दन्ति धर्मयुक्तेन केनचित् । येन त्वमीदृशं भावं नीतस्सन्नावबुद्ध्यसे ।। 7.15.20 ।।
transliteration: devatā nābhinandanti dharmayuktena kenacit | yena tvamīdṛśaṃ bhāvaṃ nītassannāvabuddhyase || 7.15.20 ||
translation: देवताः gods, न not, अभिनन्दन्ति approve, धर्मयुक्तेन by one endowed with righteousness, केनचित् by anyone, येन by which, त्वम् you, ईदृशम् such, भावम् state, नीतः सन् having been brought, न not, अवबुद्ध्यसे understand.
explanation: The gods do not approve of such a state, nor does any righteous person, by which you have been brought to this condition and yet do not understand it.

shloka_text: मातरं पितरं यो हि आचार्यं चावमन्यते । स पश्यति फलं तस्य प्रेतराजवशं गतः ।। 7.15.21 ।।
transliteration: mātaraṃ pitaraṃ yo hi ācāryaṃ cāvamanyate | sa paśyati phalaṃ tasya pretarājavaśaṃ gataḥ || 7.15.21 ||
translation: मातरम् mother, पितरम् father, यः who, हि indeed, आचार्यम् teacher, च and, अवमन्यते disrespects, सः he, पश्यति sees, फलम् the fruit, तस्य of that, प्रेतराजवशम् under the sway of the king of the dead, गतः having gone.
explanation: Indeed, whoever disrespects their mother, father, and teacher will see the consequences of such actions after falling under the dominion of Yama, the king of the dead.

shloka_text: अध्रुवे हि शरीरे यो न करोति तपोर्जनम् । स पश्चात्तप्यते मूढो मृतो दृष्ट्वा ऽ ऽत्मनो गतिम् ।। 7.15.22 ।।
transliteration: adhruve hi śarīre yo na karoti taporjanam | sa paścāttapyate mūḍho mṛto dṛṣṭvā ' 'tmano gatim || 7.15.22 ||
translation: अध्रुवे in the impermanent, हि indeed, शरीरे body, यः who, न not, करोति does, तपः अर्जनम् acquisition of penance, सः he, पश्चात् afterwards, तप्यते repents, मूढः the foolish one, मृतः having died, दृष्ट्वा having seen, आत्मनः of oneself, गतिम् the destination.
explanation: Indeed, the foolish person who does not accumulate merit through penance in this impermanent body will repent later, after death, upon seeing their own ultimate destination.

shloka_text: धर्माद्राज्यं धनं सौख्यमधर्माद्दुःखमेव च । तस्माद्धर्मं सुखार्थाय कुर्यात्पापं विसर्जयेत् ।। 7.15.23 ।।
transliteration: dharmādrājyaṃ dhanaṃ saukhyamadharmādduḥkhameva ca | tasmāddharmaṃ sukhārthāya kuryātpāpaṃ visarjayet || 7.15.23 ||
translation: धर्मात् from righteousness, राज्यम् kingdom, धनम् wealth, सौख्यम् happiness, अधर्मात् from unrighteousness, दुःखम् sorrow, एव only, च and, तस्मात् therefore, धर्मम् righteousness, सुखार्थाय for the sake of happiness, कुर्यात् one should do, पापम् sin, विसर्जयेत् one should abandon.
explanation: From righteousness come kingdom, wealth, and happiness, while from unrighteousness comes only sorrow; therefore, one should practice righteousness for the sake of happiness and abandon sin.

shloka_text: पापस्य हि फलं दुःखं तद्भोक्तव्यमिहात्मना । तस्मादात्मापघातार्थं मूढः पापं करिष्यति ।। 7.15.24 ।।
transliteration: pāpasya hi phalaṃ duḥkhaṃ tadbhoktavyamihātmanā | tasmādātmāpaghātārthaṃ mūḍhaḥ pāpaṃ kariṣyati || 7.15.24 ||
translation: पापस्य of sin, हि indeed, फलम् the fruit, दुःखम् is sorrow, तत् that, भोक्तव्यम् must be experienced, इह here, आत्मना by oneself; तस्मात् therefore, आत्म self, अपघातार्थम् for the destruction, मूढः a fool, पापम् sin, करिष्यति will commit.
explanation: Indeed, the fruit of sin is sorrow, which one must experience oneself in this world; therefore, only a fool would commit sin for the purpose of self-destruction.

shloka_text: कस्य चिन्न हि दुर्बुद्धेश्छन्दतो जायते मतिः । देवं चेष्टयते सर्वं हतो दैवेन हन्यते । यादृशं कुरुते कर्म तादृशं फलमश्नुते ।। 7.15.25 ।।
transliteration: kasya cinna hi durbuddheśchandato jāyate matiḥ | devaṃ ceṣṭayate sarvaṃ hato daivena hanyate | yādṛśaṃ kurute karma tādṛśaṃ phalamaśnute || 7.15.25 ||
translation: कस्यचित् of anyone, न not, हि indeed, दुर्बुद्धेः of an evil-minded person, छन्दतः by one's own will, जायते arises, मतिः the intellect; दैवम् destiny, चेष्टयते directs, सर्वम् everything; हतः one who is struck, दैवेन by fate, हन्यते is destroyed; यादृशम् whatever kind of, कुरुते one performs, कर्म action, तादृशम् that kind of, फलम् fruit, अश्नुते one obtains.
explanation: Indeed, the intellect of an evil-minded person does not arise by their own will, for destiny directs everything, and one struck by fate is destroyed, ultimately receiving the fruit corresponding to the actions one performs.

shloka_text: बुद्धिरूपं फलं पुत्राञ्छौर्यं धीरत्वमेव च । प्राप्नुवन्ति नरा लोके निर्जितं पुण्यकर्मभिः ।। 7.15.26 ।।
transliteration: buddhirūpaṃ phalaṃ putrāñchauryaṃ dhīratvameva ca | prāpnuvanti narā loke nirjitaṃ puṇyakarmabhiḥ || 7.15.26 ||
translation: बुद्धि intellect, रूपम् beauty, फलम् prosperity, पुत्रान् sons, शौर्यम् valor, धीरत्वम् steadfastness, एव indeed, च and, प्राप्नुवन्ति obtain, नराः men, लोके in the world, निर्जितम् acquired, पुण्यकर्मभिः by meritorious deeds.
explanation: Men in this world obtain intellect, beauty, prosperity, sons, valor, and steadfastness, all of which are acquired through meritorious deeds.

shloka_text: एवं निरयगामी त्वं यस्य ते मतिरीदृशी । न त्वां समभिभाषिष्ये ऽसद्वृत्तेष्वेव निर्णयः ।। 7.15.27 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ nirayagāmī tvaṃ yasya te matirīdṛśī | na tvāṃ samabhibhāṣiṣye 'sadvṛtteṣveva nirṇayaḥ || 7.15.27 ||
translation: एवम् thus, निरयगामी one who goes to hell, त्वम् you, यस्य whose, ते your, मतिः intellect, ईदृशी is such; न not, त्वाम् to you, समभिभाषिष्ये I will speak; असद्वृत्तेषु among those of bad conduct, एव indeed, निर्णयः is the judgment.
explanation: You are destined for hell, as your intellect is of such a nature; I will not speak to you, for such is the judgment for those of bad conduct.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तास्ततस्तेन तस्यामात्याः समाहताः । मारीचप्रमुखाः सर्वे विमुखा विप्रदुद्रुवुः ।। 7.15.28 ।।
transliteration: evamuktāstatastena tasyāmātyāḥ samāhatāḥ | mārīcapramukhāḥ sarve vimukhā vipradudruvuḥ || 7.15.28 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्ताः spoken to, ततः then, तेन by him, तस्य his, अमात्याः ministers, समाहताः rebuked, मारीचप्रमुखाः Maricha and others, सर्वे all, विमुखाः with averted faces, विप्रदुद्रुवुः fled in all directions.
explanation: Thus rebuked by him, all his ministers, led by Maricha, turned their faces away and fled in all directions.

shloka_text: ततस्तेन दशग्रीवो यक्षेन्द्रेण महात्मना । गदयाभिहतो मूर्ध्नि न च स्थानात्प्रकम्पितः ।। 7.15.29 ।।
transliteration: tatastena daśagrīvo yakṣendreṇa mahātmanā | gadayābhihato mūrdhni na ca sthānātprakampitaḥ || 7.15.29 ||
translation: ततः then, तेन by him, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, यक्षेन्द्रेण by the lord of Yakshas, महात्मना by the great-souled one, गदया with a mace, अभिहतः struck, मूर्ध्नि on the head, न not, च and, स्थानात् from his place, प्रकम्पितः shaken
explanation: Then, the great-souled lord of Yakshas struck Dashagriva on the head with a mace, but Ravana was not shaken from his position.

shloka_text: ततस्तौ राम निघ्नन्तौ तदान्योन्यं महामृधे । न विह्वलौ न च श्रान्तौ बभूवतुरमर्षणौ ।। 7.15.30 ।।
transliteration: tatastau rāma nighnantau tadānyonyaṃ mahāmṛdhe | na vihvalau na ca śrāntau babhūvaturamarṣaṇau || 7.15.30 ||
translation: ततः then, तौ those two, राम O Rama, निघ्नन्तौ striking, तदा then, अन्योन्यम् each other, महामृधे in the great battle, न not, विह्वलौ distressed, न not, च and, श्रान्तौ weary, बभूवतुः became, अमर्षणौ furious
explanation: O Rama, then those two, striking each other in that great battle, became neither distressed nor weary, but remained furious.

shloka_text: आग्नेयमस्त्रं तस्मै स मुमोच धनदस्तदा । राक्षसेन्द्रो वारुणेन तदस्त्रं प्रत्यवारयत् ।। 7.15.31 ।।
transliteration: āgneyamastraṃ tasmai sa mumoca dhanadastadā | rākṣasendro vāruṇena tadastraṃ pratyavārayat || 7.15.31 ||
translation: आग्नेयम् fiery, अस्त्रम् weapon, तस्मै at him, सः he, मुमोच released, धनदः Dhanada, तदा then, राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of Rakshasas, वारुणेन with the Varuna weapon, तत् that, अस्त्रम् weapon, प्रत्यवारयत् countered
explanation: Then Dhanada released the fiery weapon at him, but the lord of Rakshasas countered that weapon with the Varuna weapon.
