transliteration: te tasya tejasā dagdhāḥ sainyā vaivasvatasya tu | raṇe tasminnipatitā dāvadagdhā nagā iva || 7.21.45 ||
translation: ते they, तस्य his (enemy's), तेजसा by the power, दग्धाः burnt, सैन्याः armies, वैवस्वतस्य of Vaivasvata (Yama), तु indeed, रणे in the battle, तस्मिन् in that, निपतिताः fallen down, दावदग्धाः burnt by forest fire, नगाः trees, इव like.
explanation: Yama's armies, burnt by the enemy's power in that battle, fell down like trees consumed by a forest fire.

shloka_text: ततस्तु सिचवैः सार्धं राक्षसो भीमविक्रमः । ननाद सुमहानादं कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम् ।। 7.21.46 ।।
transliteration: tatastu sicavaiḥ sārdhaṃ rākṣaso bhīmavikramaḥ | nanāda sumahānādaṃ kampayanniva medinīm || 7.21.46 ||
translation: ततः then, तु indeed, सिचवैः with attendants, सार्धम् together, राक्षसः the demon (Ravana), भीमविक्रमः of terrible prowess, ननाद roared, सुमहानादम् a very great roar, कम्पयन् shaking, इव as if, मेदिनीम् the earth.
explanation: Then, the demon of terrible prowess, Ravana, along with his attendants, let out a very great roar, as if shaking the earth. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकविंशः सर्गः ।। 21 ।। Thus ends the twenty-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: स तस्य तु महानादं श्रुत्वा वैवस्वतः प्रभुः । शत्रुं विजयिनं मेने स्वबलस्य च सङ्क्षयम् ।। 7.22.1 ।।
transliteration: sa tasya tu mahānādaṃ śrutvā vaivasvataḥ prabhuḥ | śatruṃ vijayinaṃ mene svabalasya ca saṅkṣayam || 7.22.1 ||
translation: सः he (Yama), तस्य his (Ravana's), तु indeed, महानादम् great roar, श्रुत्वा having heard, वैवस्वतः Vaivasvata (Yama), प्रभुः the lord, शत्रुम् the enemy, विजयिनम् victorious, मेने considered, स्वबलस्य of his own army, च and, सङ्क्षयम् destruction.
explanation: Having heard that great roar, Lord Yama considered the enemy victorious and his own army destroyed.
comments: Yama himself takes the field, Death and the staff of Time at his side, and battles Ravana for seven nights -- as he lifts his unfailing rod to slay him, Brahma appears and forbids it, for the rod's fall would falsify the boon protecting Ravana -- Yama withdraws and vanishes, and Ravana proclaims his victory and departs.

shloka_text: स हि योधान्हतान्मत्वा क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः । अब्रवीत्त्वरितं सूतं रथो ऽयमुपनीयताम् ।। 7.22.2 ।।
transliteration: sa hi yodhānhatānmatvā krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ | abravīttvaritaṃ sūtaṃ ratho 'yamupanīyatām || 7.22.2 ||
translation: सः he (Yama), हि indeed, योधान् the warriors, हतान् killed, मत्वा having considered, क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः with eyes reddened by anger, अब्रवीत् said, त्वरितम् quickly, सूतम् to the charioteer, रथः chariot, अयम् this, उपनीयताम् be brought near.
explanation: Indeed, he (Yama), considering his warriors killed and his eyes reddened with anger, quickly told his charioteer, "Bring this chariot near."

shloka_text: तस्य सूतस्तदा दिव्यमुपस्थाप्य महारथम् । स्थितः स च महातेजा ह्यध्यारोहत तं रथम् । प्राशमुद्गरहस्तश्च मृत्युस्तस्याग्रतः स्थितः ।। 7.22.3 ।।
transliteration: tasya sūtastadā divyamupasthāpya mahāratham | sthitaḥ sa ca mahātejā hyadhyārohata taṃ ratham | prāśamudgarahastaśca mṛtyustasyāgrataḥ sthitaḥ || 7.22.3 ||
translation: तस्य his (Yama's), सूतः charioteer, तदा then, दिव्यम् divine, उपस्थाप्य having brought near, महारथम् the great chariot, स्थितः stood, सः he (Yama), च and, महातेजाः of great splendor, हि indeed, अध्यारोहत ascended, तम् that, रथम् chariot, प्राशमुद्गरहस्तः with a spear and mace in hand, च and, मृत्युः Death, तस्य his, अग्रतः in front, स्थितः stood.
explanation: Then, his charioteer, having brought near the divine great chariot, stood ready, and Yama, of great splendor, indeed ascended that chariot, while Death, holding a spear and mace, stood before him.

shloka_text: येन सङ्क्षिप्यते सर्वं त्रैलोक्यमिदमव्ययम् । कालदण्डस्तु पार्श्वस्थो मूर्तिमानस्य चाभवत् । यमप्रहरणं दिव्यं तेजसा ज्वलदग्निमत् ।। 7.22.4 ।।
transliteration: yena saṅkṣipyate sarvaṃ trailokyamidamavyayam | kāladaṇḍastu pārśvastho mūrtimānasya cābhavat | yamapraharaṇaṃ divyaṃ tejasā jvaladagnimat || 7.22.4 ||
translation: येन by whom, सङ्क्षिप्यते is contracted, सर्वम् all, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, इदम् this, अव्ययम् imperishable, कालदण्डः the staff of Time, तु indeed, पार्श्वस्थः standing by the side, मूर्तिमान् embodied, अस्य of him, च and, अभवत् became, यमप्रहरणम् Yama's weapon, दिव्यम् divine, तेजसा with splendor, ज्वलत् blazing, अग्निमत् fiery.
explanation: The imperishable three worlds are brought to an end by him, and the staff of Time, Yama's divine, blazing, fiery weapon, appeared personified by his side.

shloka_text: तस्य पार्श्वेषु निच्छिद्राः कालपाशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः ।। 7.22.5 ।।
transliteration: tasya pārśveṣu nicchidrāḥ kālapāśāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 7.22.5 ||
translation: तस्य of him, पार्श्वेषु on the sides, निच्छिद्राः inescapable, कालपाशाः the nooses of Time, प्रतिष्ठिताः stood.
explanation: On his sides were placed the inescapable nooses of Time.

shloka_text: पावकस्पर्शसङ्काशः स्थितो मूर्तश्च मुद्गरः ।। 7.22.6 ।।
transliteration: pāvakasparśasaṅkāśaḥ sthito mūrtaśca mudgaraḥ || 7.22.6 ||
translation: पावकस्पर्शसङ्काशः resembling the touch of fire, स्थितः stood, मूर्तश्च and embodied, मुद्गरः a mace.
explanation: An embodied mace, whose touch was like fire, also stood there.

shloka_text: ततो लोकत्रयं क्षुब्धमकम्पन्त दिवौकसः । कालं दृष्ट्वा तथा क्रुद्धं सर्वलोकभयावहम् ।। 7.22.7 ।।
transliteration: tato lokatrayaṃ kṣubdhamakampanta divaukasaḥ | kālaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathā kruddhaṃ sarvalokabhayāvaham || 7.22.7 ||
translation: ततः then, लोकत्रयम् the three worlds, क्षुब्धम् agitated, अकम्पन्त trembled, दिवौकसः the gods, कालम् Time, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तथा thus, क्रुद्धम् enraged, सर्वलोकभयावहम् terrifying to all worlds.
explanation: Then, having seen Time thus enraged and terrifying to all worlds, the three worlds were agitated and the gods trembled.

shloka_text: ततः प्रचोदयन्सूतस्तानश्वान्रुचिरप्रभान् । प्रययौ भीमसन्नादो यत्र रक्षःपतिः स्थितः ।। 7.22.8 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pracodayansūtastānaśvānruciraprabhān | prayayau bhīmasannādo yatra rakṣaḥpatiḥ sthitaḥ || 7.22.8 ||
translation: ततः then, प्रचोदयन् urging, सूतः the charioteer, तान् those, अश्वान् horses, रुचिरप्रभान् of beautiful splendor, प्रययौ proceeded, भीमसन्नादः with a terrible roar, यत्र where, रक्षःपतिः the lord of Rakshasas, स्थितः was situated.
explanation: Then, the charioteer, urging those brightly shining horses, proceeded with a terrible roar to where the lord of Rakshasas was situated.

shloka_text: मुहूर्तेन यमं ते तु हया हरिहयोपमाः । प्रापयन्मनसस्तुल्या यत्र तत्प्रस्तुतं रणम् ।। 7.22.9 ।।
transliteration: muhūrtena yamaṃ te tu hayā harihayopamāḥ | prāpayanmanasastulyā yatra tatprastutaṃ raṇam || 7.22.9 ||
translation: मुहूर्तेन in a moment, यमम् Yama, ते those, तु indeed, हयाः horses, हरिहयोपमाः resembling the horses of Indra, प्रापयन् made to reach, मनसस्तुल्याः swift as thought, यत्र where, तत् that, प्रस्तुतम् commenced, रणम् battle
explanation: In an instant, those horses, swift as thought and resembling Indra's steeds, brought Yama to the place where the battle had begun.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा तथैव विकृतं रथं मृत्युसमन्वितम् । सचिवा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य सहसा विप्रदुद्रुवुः ।। 7.22.10 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tathaiva vikṛtaṃ rathaṃ mṛtyusamanvitam | sacivā rākṣasendrasya sahasā vipradudruvuḥ || 7.22.10 ||
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, तथैव just so, विकृतम् terrifying, रथम् chariot, मृत्युसमन्वितम् accompanied by death, सचिवाः ministers, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the lord of rakshasas, सहसा suddenly, विप्रदुद्रुवुः fled in all directions
explanation: Upon seeing that terrifying chariot, which seemed to embody death itself, the ministers of Ravana immediately fled in every direction.

shloka_text: लघुसत्त्वतया ते हि नष्टसञ्ज्ञा भयार्दिताः । नेह योद्धुं समर्थाः स्म इत्युक्त्वा प्रययुर्दिशः ।। 7.22.11 ।।
transliteration: laghusattvatayā te hi naṣṭasañjñā bhayārditāḥ | neha yoddhuṃ samarthāḥ sma ityuktvā prayayurdiśaḥ || 7.22.11 ||
translation: लघुसत्त्वतया due to faint-heartedness, ते they, हि indeed, नष्टसञ्ज्ञाः having lost their senses, भयार्दिताः tormented by fear, न not, इह here, योद्धुम् to fight, समर्थाः capable, स्म are, इत्युक्त्वा having said thus, प्रययुर्दिशः fled in all directions
explanation: Overwhelmed by fear and having lost their senses due to their weak courage, they declared, "We are not capable of fighting here," and fled in all directions.

shloka_text: स तु तं तादृशं दृष्ट्वा रथं लोकभयावहम् । नाक्षुभ्यत दशग्रीवो न चापि भयमाविशत् ।। 7.22.12 ।।
transliteration: sa tu taṃ tādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā rathaṃ lokabhayāvaham | nākṣubhyata daśagrīvo na cāpi bhayamāviśat || 7.22.12 ||
translation: सः he, तु but, तम् that, तादृशम् such a, दृष्ट्वा having seen, रथम् chariot, लोकभयावहम् terrifying to the world, न not, अक्षुभ्यत was disturbed, दशग्रीवः Ravana, न not, च and, अपि even, भयम् fear, आविशत् entered
explanation: But Ravana, upon seeing that chariot which struck terror into the world, was neither disturbed nor did fear enter his heart.

shloka_text: स तु रावणमासाद्य व्यसृजच्छक्तितोमरान् । यमो मर्माणि सङ्क्रुद्धो रावणस्योपकृन्तत ।। 7.22.13 ।।
transliteration: sa tu rāvaṇamāsādya vyasṛjacchaktitomarān | yamo marmāṇi saṅkruddho rāvaṇasyopakṛntata || 7.22.13 ||
translation: सः he, तु but, रावणम् Ravana, आसाद्य having approached, व्यसृजत् discharged, शक्तितोमरान् spears and javelins, यमः Yama, मर्माणि vital spots, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, रावणस्य of Ravana, उपकृन्तत pierced
explanation: Yama, greatly enraged, approached Ravana and hurled spears and javelins, piercing Ravana's vital spots.

shloka_text: रावणस्तु ततः स्वस्थः शरवर्षं मुमोच ह । तस्मिन्वैवस्वतरथे तोयवर्षमिवाम्बुदः ।। 7.22.14 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇastu tataḥ svasthaḥ śaravarṣaṃ mumoca ha | tasminvaivasvatarathe toyavarṣamivāmbudaḥ || 7.22.14 ||
translation: रावणस्तु Ravana, but, ततः then, स्वस्थः composed, शरवर्षं a rain of arrows, मुमोच released, ह indeed, तस्मिन् on that, वैवस्वतरथे chariot of Yama, तोयवर्षम् a rain of water, इव like, अम्बुदः a cloud
explanation: Ravana, having regained his composure, then released a shower of arrows upon Yama's chariot, much like a cloud pouring down rain.

shloka_text: ततो महाशक्तिशरैः पात्यमानैर्महोरसि (पात्यमानो) । नाशक्नोत्प्रतिकर्तुं स राक्षसः शल्यपीडितः ।। 7.22.15 ।।
transliteration: tato mahāśaktiśaraiḥ pātyamānairmahorasi (pātyamāno) | nāśaknotpratikartuṃ sa rākṣasaḥ śalyapīḍitaḥ || 7.22.15 ||
translation: ततः then, महाशक्तिशरैः by arrows of great power, पात्यमानैः being struck down, महोरसि on his great chest, न not, अशक्नोत् was able, प्रतिकर्तुं to retaliate, स that, राक्षसः demon, शल्यपीडितः afflicted by arrows
explanation: Then, as powerful arrows struck his broad chest, that demon, afflicted by the shafts, was unable to retaliate.

shloka_text: एवं नानाप्रहरणैर्यमेनामित्रकर्षिणा । सप्तरात्रं कृतः सङ्ख्ये विसञ्ज्ञो विमुखो रिपुः ।। 7.22.16 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ nānāpraharaṇairyamenāmitrakarṣiṇā | saptarātraṃ kṛtaḥ saṅkhye visañjño vimukho ripuḥ || 7.22.16 ||
translation: एवं thus, नानाप्रहरणैः by various weapons, यमेन by Yama, अमित्रकर्षिणा the tormentor of enemies, सप्तरात्रं for seven nights, कृतः made, सङ्ख्ये in battle, विसञ्ज्ञः unconscious, विमुखः turned away, रिपुः the enemy
explanation: Thus, for seven nights in battle, the enemy Ravana was rendered senseless and turned away by Yama, the tormentor of foes, using various weapons.

shloka_text: तदासीत्तुमुलं युद्धं यमराक्षसयोर्द्वयोः । जयमाकाङ्क्षतोर्वीर समरेष्वनिवर्तिनोः ।। 7.22.17 ।।
transliteration: tadāsīttumulaṃ yuddhaṃ yamarākṣasayordvayoḥ | jayamākāṅkṣatorvīra samareṣvanivartinoḥ || 7.22.17 ||
translation: तदा then, आसीत् was, तुमुलं a tumultuous, युद्धं battle, यमराक्षसयोः between Yama and the demon, द्वयोः of the two, जयम् victory, आकाङ्क्षतोः desiring, वीर O hero, समरेषु in battles, अनिवर्तिनोः unyielding
explanation: Then, a fierce battle ensued between Yama and the demon, both unyielding warriors desiring victory in their fight.

shloka_text: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः । प्रजापतिं पुरस्कृत्य समेतास्तद्रणाजिरम् ।। 7.22.18 ।।
transliteration: tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ | prajāpatiṃ puraskṛtya sametāstadraṇājiram || 7.22.18 ||
translation: ततः then, देवाः the gods, सगन्धर्वाः with Gandharvas, सिद्धाः Siddhas, च and, परमर्षयः great sages, प्रजापतिं Prajapati, पुरस्कृत्य having placed in front, समेताः assembled, तत् that, रणाजिरम् battlefield
explanation: Then, the gods, along with Gandharvas, Siddhas, and great sages, assembled at that battlefield, led by Prajapati Brahma.

shloka_text: संवर्त इव लोकानां क्रुध्यतोरभवत्तदा । राक्षसानां च मुख्यस्य प्रेतानामीश्वरस्य च ।। 7.22.19 ।।
transliteration: saṃvarta iva lokānāṃ krudhyatorabhavattadā | rākṣasānāṃ ca mukhyasya pretānāmīśvarasya ca || 7.22.19 ||
translation: संवर्त इव like the cosmic dissolution, लोकानां of the worlds, क्रुध्यतोः of the two who were enraged, अभवत् it became, तदा then, राक्षसानां च and of the Rākṣasas, मुख्यस्य of the chief, प्रेतानाम् of the departed spirits, ईश्वरस्य च and of the lord.
explanation: Then, the battle between the chief of the Rākṣasas and the lord of the departed spirits became like the cosmic dissolution of the worlds.

shloka_text: राक्षसेन्द्रो ऽपि विस्फार्य चापमिन्द्राशनिप्रभम् । निरन्तरमिवाकाशं कुर्वन्बाणांस्ततो ऽसृजत् ।। 7.22.20 ।।
transliteration: rākṣasendro 'pi visphārya cāpamindrāśaniprabham | nirantaramivākāśaṃ kurvanbāṇāṃstato 'sṛjat || 7.22.20 ||
translation: राक्षसेन्द्रो ऽपि the lord of Rākṣasas also, विस्फार्य having stretched, चापम् his bow, इन्द्राशनिप्रभम् shining like Indra's thunderbolt, निरन्तरम् इव as if without gaps, आकाशं the sky, कुर्वन् making, बाणान् arrows, ततः then, असृजत् he released.
explanation: The lord of Rākṣasas, drawing his bow which shone like Indra's thunderbolt, then released arrows, making the sky appear as if it had no gaps.

shloka_text: मृत्युं चतुर्भिर्विशिखैः सूतं सप्तभिरार्दयत् । यमं शतसहस्रेण शीघ्रं मर्मस्वताडयत् ।। 7.22.21 ।।
transliteration: mṛtyuṃ caturbhirviśikhaiḥ sūtaṃ saptabhirārdayat | yamaṃ śatasahasreṇa śīghraṃ marmasvatāḍayat || 7.22.21 ||
translation: मृत्युं Death, चतुर्भिः with four, विशिखैः sharp arrows, सूतं the charioteer, सप्तभिः with seven, आर्दयत् he afflicted, यमं Yama, शतसहस्रेण with a hundred thousand, शीघ्रं quickly, मर्मसु in the vital spots, अताडयत् he struck.
explanation: Rāvaṇa wounded Death with four sharp arrows, afflicted the charioteer with seven, and quickly struck Yama in his vital spots with a hundred thousand arrows.

shloka_text: ततः क्रुद्धस्य वदनाद्यमस्य समजायत । ज्वालामाली सनिःश्वासः सधूमः कोपपावकः ।। 7.22.22 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kruddhasya vadanādyamasya samajāyata | jvālāmālī saniḥśvāsaḥ sadhūmaḥ kopapāvakaḥ || 7.22.22 ||
translation: ततः then, क्रुद्धस्य of the enraged one, वदनात् from the face, यमस्य of Yama, समजायत arose, ज्वालामाली garlanded with flames, सनिःश्वासः with breath, सधूमः with smoke, कोपपावकः the fire of anger.
explanation: Then, from the enraged Yama's face, a fire of anger arose, garlanded with flames, accompanied by his breath and smoke.

shloka_text: तदाश्चर्यमथो दृष्ट्वा देवदानवसन्निधौ । प्रहर्षितौ सुसंरब्धौ मृत्युकालौ बभूवतुः ।। 7.22.23 ।।
transliteration: tadāścaryamatho dṛṣṭvā devadānavasannidhau | praharṣitau susaṃrabdhau mṛtyukālau babhūvatuḥ || 7.22.23 ||
translation: तत् that, आश्चर्यम् wonder, अथ then, दृष्ट्वा having seen, देवदानवसन्निधौ in the presence of gods and Dānavas, प्रहर्षितौ greatly delighted, सुसंरब्धौ greatly agitated, मृत्युकालौ Death and Kāla, बभूवतुः they became.
explanation: Then, having witnessed that marvel in the presence of gods and Dānavas, Death and Kāla became greatly delighted and exceedingly furious.

shloka_text: ततो मृत्युः क्रुद्धतरो वैवस्वतमभाषत । मुञ्च मां समरे यावद्धन्मीमं पापराक्षसम् । नैषा रक्षो भवेदद्य मर्यादा हि निसर्गतः ।। 7.22.24 ।।
transliteration: tato mṛtyuḥ kruddhataro vaivasvatamabhāṣata | muñca māṃ samare yāvaddhanmīmaṃ pāparākṣasam | naiṣā rakṣo bhavedadya maryādā hi nisargataḥ || 7.22.24 ||
translation: ततः then, मृत्युः Death, क्रुद्धतरः more enraged, वैवस्वतम् to Vaivasvata (Yama), अभाषत spoke, मुञ्च release, माम् me, समरे in battle, यावत् until, हन्मि I kill, इमम् this, पापरक्षसम् sinful demon, न not, एषा this, रक्षः demon, भवेत् should be, अद्य today, मर्यादा a limit/boundary, हि indeed, निसर्गतः by nature/inherently
explanation: Then, Death, even more enraged, spoke to Yama, saying, "Release me in battle so that I may kill this sinful demon, for by nature, this demon should not exist today as a boundary."

shloka_text: हिरण्यकशिपुः श्रीमान्नमुचिः शम्बरस्तथा । विसन्धिर्धूमकेतुश्च बलिर्वैरोचनो ऽपि च ।। 7.22.25 ।।
transliteration: hiraṇyakaśipuḥ śrīmānnamuciḥ śambarastathā | visandhirdhūmaketuśca balirvairocano 'pi ca || 7.22.25 ||
translation: हिरण्यकशिपुः Hiranyakashipu, श्रीमान् glorious, नमुचिः Namuchi, शम्बरः Shambara, तथा and, विसन्धिः Visandhi, धूमकेतुः Dhumaketu, च and, बलिः Bali, वैरोचनः Vairochana, अपि also, च and
explanation: The glorious Hiranyakashipu, Namuchi, Shambara, Visandhi, Dhumaketu, and Bali Vairochana were among them.

shloka_text: दम्भुर्दैत्यमहाराजो वृत्रो बाणस्तथैव च । राजर्षयः शास्त्रविदो गन्धर्वाः समहोरगाः ।। 7.22.26 ।।
transliteration: dambhurdaityamahārājo vṛtro bāṇastathaiva ca | rājarṣayaḥ śāstravido gandharvāḥ samahoragāḥ || 7.22.26 ||
translation: दम्भुः Dambhu, दैत्यमहाराजः the great king of Daityas, वृत्रः Vritra, बाणः Bana, तथा and, एव indeed, च and, राजर्षयः royal sages, शास्त्रविदः knowers of scriptures, गन्धर्वाः Gandharvas, समहोरगाः along with great serpents
explanation: Dambhu, the great king of Daityas, Vritra, and Bana, along with royal sages who knew the scriptures, Gandharvas, and great serpents, were also present.

shloka_text: ऋषयः पन्नगा दैत्या यक्षाश्चाप्यप्सरोगणाः । युगान्तपरिवर्ते च पृथिवी समहार्णवा ।। 7.22.27 ।।
transliteration: ṛṣayaḥ pannagā daityā yakṣāścāpyapsarogaṇāḥ | yugāntaparivarte ca pṛthivī samahārṇavā || 7.22.27 ||
translation: ऋषयः sages, पन्नगाः serpents, दैत्याः Daityas, यक्षाः Yakshas, च and, अपि also, अप्सरोगणाः groups of Apsaras, युगान्तपरिवर्ते at the change of a Yuga (end of an age), च and, पृथिवी the earth, समहार्णवा along with great oceans
explanation: Sages, serpents, Daityas, Yakshas, and groups of Apsaras, along with the earth and its great oceans at the end of an age, were all present.

shloka_text: क्षयं नीता महाराज सपर्वतसरिद्द्रुमा । एते चान्ये च बहवो बलवन्तो दुरासदाः ।। 7.22.28 ।।
transliteration: kṣayaṃ nītā mahārāja saparvatasariddrumā | ete cānye ca bahavo balavanto durāsadāḥ || 7.22.28 ||
translation: क्षयम् to destruction, नीताः led/brought, महाराज O great king, सपर्वतसरिद्द्रुमाः along with mountains, rivers, and trees, एते these, च and, अन्ये others, च and, बहवः many, बलवन्तः powerful, दुरासदाः difficult to approach/overcome
explanation: O great king, these and many other powerful and formidable beings, along with mountains, rivers, and trees, were all brought to destruction.

shloka_text: विनिपन्ना मया दृष्टाः किमुतायं निशाचरः ।। 7.22.29 ।।
transliteration: vinipannā mayā dṛṣṭāḥ kimutāyaṃ niśācaraḥ || 7.22.29 ||
translation: विनिपन्ना fallen, मया by me, दृष्टाः seen, किमुत how much more, अयं this, निशाचरः demon.
explanation: I have seen many fallen, so what to say of this demon?

shloka_text: मुञ्चं मां साधु धर्मज्ञ यावदेनं निहन्म्यहम् । नहि कश्चिन्मया दृष्टो बलवानपि जीवति ।। 7.22.30 ।।
transliteration: muñcaṃ māṃ sādhu dharmajña yāvadenaṃ nihanmyaham | nahi kaścinmayā dṛṣṭo balavānapi jīvati || 7.22.30 ||
translation: मुञ्चं release, मां me, साधु properly, धर्मज्ञ O knower of dharma, यावत् until, एनं this one, निहन्मि I kill, अहम् I, न हि certainly not, कश्चित् anyone, मया by me, दृष्टो seen, बलवानपि even if powerful, जीवति lives.
explanation: O knower of dharma, release me so I may kill this one, for no one seen by me, however powerful, has ever lived.

shloka_text: बलं मम न खल्वेतन्मर्यादैषा निसर्गतः । स दृष्टो न मया कालं मुहुर्तमापि जीवति ।। 7.22.31 ।।
transliteration: balaṃ mama na khalvetanmaryādaiṣā nisargataḥ | sa dṛṣṭo na mayā kālaṃ muhurtamāpi jīvati || 7.22.31 ||
translation: बलं strength, मम my, न खलु certainly not, एतत् this, मर्यादा rule, एषा this, निसर्गतः by nature, सः he, दृष्टो seen, न not, मया by me, कालं for time, मुहुर्तमापि even for a moment, जीवति lives.
explanation: This is not merely my strength, but a natural rule that anyone seen by me does not live even for a moment.

shloka_text: तस्यैवं वचनं श्रुत्वा धर्मराजः प्रतापवान् । अब्रवीत्तत्र तं मुत्युं त्वं तिष्ठैनं निहन्म्यहम् ।। 7.22.32 ।।
transliteration: tasyaivaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā dharmarājaḥ pratāpavān | abravīttatra taṃ mutyuṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭhainaṃ nihanmyaham || 7.22.32 ||
translation: तस्य his, एवं thus, वचनं words, श्रुत्वा having heard, धर्मराजः Dharmaraja, प्रतापवान् powerful, अब्रवीत् said, तत्र there, तं to him, मृत्युं to Death, त्वं you, तिष्ठ wait, एनं this one, निहन्मि I kill, अहम् I.
explanation: Having heard his words, the powerful Dharmaraja then said to Death, "You wait, I will kill this one."

shloka_text: ततः संरक्तनयनः क्रुद्धो वैवस्वतः प्रभुः । कालदण्डममोघं तु तोलयामास पाणिना ।। 7.22.33 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ saṃraktanayanaḥ kruddho vaivasvataḥ prabhuḥ | kāladaṇḍamamoghaṃ tu tolayāmāsa pāṇinā || 7.22.33 ||
translation: ततः then, संरक्तनयनः with blood-red eyes, क्रुद्धो enraged, वैवस्वतः Yama, प्रभुः lord, कालदण्डम् the rod of time/death, अमोघं unfailing, तु indeed, तोलयामास lifted, पाणिना with his hand.
explanation: Then, the enraged Lord Yama, with blood-red eyes, indeed lifted his unfailing rod of death with his hand.

shloka_text: यस्य पार्श्वेषु निखिला कालपाशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः । पावकाशनिसङ्काशो मुद्गरो मूर्तिमान्स्थितः ।। 7.22.34 ।।
transliteration: yasya pārśveṣu nikhilā kālapāśāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ | pāvakāśanisaṅkāśo mudgaro mūrtimānsthitaḥ || 7.22.34 ||
translation: यस्य whose, पार्श्वेषु on the sides, निखिला all, कालपाशाः nooses of Death, प्रतिष्ठिताः are established, पावकाशनिसङ्काशो like fire and lightning, मुद्गरो a mace, मूर्तिमान् embodied, स्थितः stands.
explanation: On whose sides all the nooses of Death are established, and an embodied mace, resembling fire and lightning, stands.

shloka_text: दर्शनादेव यः प्राणान्प्राणिनामपकर्षति । किं पुनः स्पृश्यमानस्य पात्यमानस्य वा पुनः ।। 7.22.35 ।।
transliteration: darśanādeva yaḥ prāṇānprāṇināmapakarṣati | kiṃ punaḥ spṛśyamānasya pātyamānasya vā punaḥ || 7.22.35 ||
translation: दर्शनादेव merely by seeing, यः who, प्राणान् lives, प्राणिनाम् of living beings, अपकर्षति draws away, किं what, पुनः moreover, स्पृश्यमानस्य of one being touched, पात्यमानस्य of one being struck down, वा or, पुनः again.
explanation: What more can be said of one who is touched or struck down, when merely by sight it draws away the lives of living beings?

shloka_text: स ज्वालापरिवारस्तु निर्दहन्निव राक्षसम् । तेन स्पृष्टो बलवता महाप्रहरणो ऽस्फुरत् ।। 7.22.36 ।।
transliteration: sa jvālāparivārastu nirdahanniva rākṣasam | tena spṛṣṭo balavatā mahāpraharaṇo 'sphurat || 7.22.36 ||
translation: स that, ज्वालापरिवारस्तु surrounded by flames, निर्दहन्निव as if burning, राक्षसम् the demon, तेन by him, स्पृष्टो touched, बलवता by the powerful one, महाप्रहरणो the great weapon, अस्फुरत् trembled.
explanation: That great weapon, surrounded by flames as if burning the demon, trembled when touched by the powerful Yama.

shloka_text: ततो विदुद्रुवुः सर्वे तस्मात्रस्ता रणाजिरे । सुराश्च क्षुभिताः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा दण्डोद्यतं यमम् ।। 7.22.37 ।।
transliteration: tato vidudruvuḥ sarve tasmātrastā raṇājire | surāśca kṣubhitāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā daṇḍodyataṃ yamam || 7.22.37 ||
translation: ततो then, विदुद्रुवुः fled, सर्वे all, तस्मात् from that, त्रस्ता terrified, रणाजिरे on the battlefield, सुराश्च and the gods, क्षुभिताः agitated, सर्वे all, दृष्ट्वा having seen, दण्डोद्यतं with the mace raised, यमम् Yama.
explanation: Then all those on the battlefield, terrified by that, fled, and all the gods were agitated upon seeing Yama with his mace raised.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्प्रहर्तुकामे तु यमे दण्डेन रावणम् । यमं पितामहः साक्षाद्दर्शयित्वेदमब्रवीत् ।। 7.22.38 ।।
transliteration: tasminprahartukāme tu yame daṇḍena rāvaṇam | yamaṃ pitāmahaḥ sākṣāddarśayitvedamabravīt || 7.22.38 ||
translation: तस्मिन् when that, प्रहर्तुकामे desirous of striking, तु indeed, यमे Yama, दण्डेन with the mace, रावणम् Ravana, यमं to Yama, पितामहः the grandfather (Brahma), साक्षात् directly, दर्शयित्वा having appeared, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: When Yama was indeed desirous of striking Ravana with his mace, the grandfather Brahma directly appeared before Yama and spoke these words.

shloka_text: वैवस्वत महाबाहो न खल्वमितविक्रम । न हन्तव्यस्त्वया तेन दण्डेनैव निशाचरः ।। 7.22.39 ।।
transliteration: vaivasvata mahābāho na khalvamitavikrama | na hantavyastvayā tena daṇḍenaiva niśācaraḥ || 7.22.39 ||
translation: वैवस्वत O son of Vivasvat, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, न not, खलु indeed, अमितविक्रम O one of immeasurable prowess, न not, हन्तव्यः to be killed, त्वया by you, तेन by that, दण्डेनैव by the staff alone, निशाचरः the night-wanderer (demon).
explanation: O mighty-armed Yama, son of Vivasvat, you of immeasurable prowess, indeed that demon should not be killed by your staff alone.

shloka_text: वरः खलु मयैतस्मै दत्तस्त्रिदशपुङ्गव । स त्वया नानृतः कार्यो यन्मया व्याहृतं वचः ।। 7.22.40 ।।
transliteration: varaḥ khalu mayaitasmai dattastridaśapuṅgava | sa tvayā nānṛtaḥ kāryo yanmayā vyāhṛtaṃ vacaḥ || 7.22.40 ||
translation: वरः a boon, खलु indeed, मया by me, एतस्मै to him, दत्तः given, त्रिदशपुङ्गव O chief among gods, सः that, त्वया by you, न not, अनृतः false, कार्यः to be made, यत् which, मया by me, व्याहृतं spoken, वचः word.
explanation: O chief among gods, indeed a boon has been given by me to him, and that word spoken by me should not be made false by you.

shloka_text: यो हि मामनृतं कुर्याद्देवो वा मानुषो ऽपि वा । त्रैलोक्यमनृतं तेन कृतं स्यान्नात्र संशयः ।। 7.22.41 ।।
transliteration: yo hi māmanṛtaṃ kuryāddevo vā mānuṣo 'pi vā | trailokyamanṛtaṃ tena kṛtaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 7.22.41 ||
translation: यः whoever, हि indeed, माम् me, अनृतं false, कुर्यात् would make, देवः a god, वा or, मानुषः a human, अपि even, वा or, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, अनृतं false, तेन by him, कृतं made, स्यात् would be, न not, अत्र here, संशयः doubt.
explanation: Whoever, be it a god or even a human, would make my word false, by him the three worlds would indeed be made false, there is no doubt about this.

shloka_text: क्रुद्धेन विप्रमुक्तो ऽयं निर्विशेषं प्रियाप्रिये । प्रजाः संहरते रौद्रो लोकत्रयभयावहः ।। 7.22.42 ।।
transliteration: kruddhena vipramukto 'yaṃ nirviśeṣaṃ priyāpriye | prajāḥ saṃharate raudro lokatrayabhayāvahaḥ || 7.22.42 ||
translation: क्रुद्धेन by the angry one, विप्रमुक्तः released, अयम् this, निर्विशेषं without distinction, प्रियाप्रिये between dear and not dear, प्रजाः creatures, संहरते destroys, रौद्रः terrible, लोकत्रयभयावहः causing fear to the three worlds.
explanation: This terrible staff, when released by an angry one, destroys creatures without distinction between dear and not dear, causing fear to all three worlds.

shloka_text: अमोघो ह्येष सर्वेषां प्राणिनाममितप्रभः । कालदण्डो मया सृष्टः पूर्वं मृत्युपुरस्कृतः ।। 7.22.43 ।।
transliteration: amogho hyeṣa sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmamitaprabhaḥ | kāladaṇḍo mayā sṛṣṭaḥ pūrvaṃ mṛtyupuraskṛtaḥ || 7.22.43 ||
translation: अमोघः unfailing, हि indeed, एषः this, सर्वेषां of all, प्राणिनाम् living beings, अमितप्रभः of immeasurable power, कालदण्डः the staff of time/death, मया by me, सृष्टः created, पूर्वं formerly, मृत्युपुरस्कृतः preceded by Death.
explanation: Indeed, this unfailing staff of Time, of immeasurable power for all living beings, was created by me long ago, with Death as its foremost aspect.

shloka_text: तन्न खल्वेष ते सौम्य पात्यो रावणमूर्धनि । नह्यस्मिन्पतिते कश्चिन्मुहूर्तमपि जीवति ।। 7.22.44 ।।
transliteration: tanna khalveṣa te saumya pātyo rāvaṇamūrdhani | nahyasminpatite kaścinmuhūrtamapi jīvati || 7.22.44 ||
translation: तत् that, न not, खलु indeed, एष this, ते by you, सौम्य O gentle one, पात्यो to be cast, रावणमूर्धनि on Ravana's head । नहि indeed not, अस्मिन् on this, पतिते having fallen, कश्चित् anyone, मुहूर्तमपि even for a moment, जीवति lives ।।
explanation: O gentle one (Yama), this rod of yours should certainly not be cast upon Ravana's head, for indeed, no one survives even for a moment once this rod has fallen.

shloka_text: यदि ह्यन्मिन्निपतिते न म्रियेतैष राक्षसः । म्रियते वा दशग्रीवस्तदाप्युभयतो ऽनृतम् ।। 7.22.45 ।।
transliteration: yadi hyanminnipatite na mriyetaiṣa rākṣasaḥ | mriyate vā daśagrīvastadāpyubhayato 'nṛtam || 7.22.45 ||
translation: यदि if, हि indeed, अस्मिन् on this, निपतिते having fallen, न not, म्रियेत dies, एष this, राक्षसः demon । म्रियते dies, वा or, दशग्रीवः Ravana, तदापि then even, उभयतो from both sides, अनृतम् untruth ।।
explanation: If this demon (Ravana) does not die even after this rod has fallen, or if Ravana dies, then in either case, it would be a falsehood (regarding the boon of immortality).

shloka_text: तन्निवर्तय लङ्केशं द्दण्डमेतं समुद्यतम् । सत्यं च मां कुरुष्वाद्य लोकांस्त्वं यद्यवेक्षसे ।। 7.22.46 ।।
transliteration: tannivartaya laṅkeśaṃ ddaṇḍametaṃ samudyatam | satyaṃ ca māṃ kuruṣvādya lokāṃstvaṃ yadyavekṣase || 7.22.46 ||
translation: तत् therefore, निवर्तय withdraw, लङ्केशं from Ravana, दण्डम् rod, एतम् this, समुद्यतम् uplifted । सत्यं true, च and, मां me, कुरुष्व make, अद्य now, लोकान् worlds, त्वं you, यदि if, अवेक्षसे regard ।।
explanation: Therefore, withdraw this uplifted rod from Ravana and make my words true now, if you indeed care for the worlds.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु धर्मात्मा प्रत्युवाच यमस्तदा । एष व्यावर्तितो दण्डः प्रभविष्णुर्हि नो भवान् ।। 7.22.47 ।।
transliteration: evamuktastu dharmātmā pratyuvāca yamastadā | eṣa vyāvartito daṇḍaḥ prabhaviṣṇurhi no bhavān || 7.22.47 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, प्रत्युवाच replied, यमः Yama, तदा then । एष this, व्यावर्तितः withdrawn, दण्डः rod, प्रभविष्णुः powerful lord, हि indeed, नः our, भवान् you ।।
explanation: Thus spoken to, the righteous Yama then replied, "This rod has been withdrawn, for indeed, you are our powerful lord."

shloka_text: किं न्विदानीं मया शक्यं कर्तुं रणगतेन हि । न मया यद्ययं शक्यो हन्तुं वरपुरस्कृतः ।। 7.22.48 ।।
transliteration: kiṃ nvidānīṃ mayā śakyaṃ kartuṃ raṇagatena hi | na mayā yadyayaṃ śakyo hantuṃ varapuraskṛtaḥ || 7.22.48 ||
translation: किं नु what indeed, इदानीं now, मया by me, शक्यं possible, कर्तुं to do, रणगतेन having gone to battle, हि indeed । न not, मया by me, यदि if, अयम् this, शक्यः possible, हन्तुं to kill, वरपुरस्कृतः protected by a boon ।।
explanation: What indeed can I do now, having come to battle, if this one (Ravana) cannot be killed by me because he is protected by a boon?

shloka_text: एष तस्मात्प्रणश्यामि दर्शनादस्य रक्षसः । इत्युक्त्वा सरथः साश्वस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ।। 7.22.49 ।।
transliteration: eṣa tasmātpraṇaśyāmi darśanādasya rakṣasaḥ | ityuktvā sarathaḥ sāśvastatraivāntaradhīyata || 7.22.49 ||
translation: एष this, तस्मात् therefore, प्रणश्यामि I disappear, दर्शनात् from the sight, अस्य of this, रक्षसः demon, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, सरथः with his chariot, साश्वः with his horses, तत्रैव right there, अन्तरधीयत disappeared.
explanation: Having said, "Therefore, I disappear from the sight of this demon," he vanished right there with his chariot and horses.

shloka_text: दशग्रीवस्तु तं जित्वा नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः । आरुह्य पुष्पकं भूयो निष्क्रान्तो यमसादनात् ।। 7.22.50 ।।
transliteration: daśagrīvastu taṃ jitvā nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ | āruhya puṣpakaṃ bhūyo niṣkrānto yamasādanāt || 7.22.50 ||
translation: दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, तु and, तम् him, जित्वा having conquered, नाम name, विश्राव्य having proclaimed, च and, आत्मनः his own, आरुह्य having ascended, पुष्पकम् the Pushpaka, भूयः again, निष्क्रान्तः departed, यमसादनात् from Yama's abode.
explanation: Dashagriva, having conquered him and proclaimed his own name, ascended the Pushpaka chariot again and departed from Yama's abode.

shloka_text: स तु वैवस्वतो देवैः सह ब्रह्मपुरोगमैः । जगाम त्रिदिवं हृष्टो नारदश्च महामुनिः ।। 7.22.51 ।।
transliteration: sa tu vaivasvato devaiḥ saha brahmapurogamaiḥ | jagāma tridivaṃ hṛṣṭo nāradaśca mahāmuniḥ || 7.22.51 ||
translation: सः he, तु and, वैवस्वतः Vaivasvata (Yama), देवैः with the gods, सह together, ब्रह्मपुरोगमैः with Brahma as their leader, जगाम went, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, हृष्टः delighted, नारदः Narada, च and, महामुनिः the great sage.
explanation: And Vaivasvata (Yama), delighted, went to heaven along with the gods led by Brahma, as did the great sage Narada. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्वाविंशः सर्गः ।। 22 ।। Thus ends the twenty-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततो जित्वा दशग्रीवो यमं त्रिदशपुङ्गवम् । रावणस्तु रणश्लाघी स्वसहायान्ददर्श ह ।। 7.23.1 ।।
transliteration: tato jitvā daśagrīvo yamaṃ tridaśapuṅgavam | rāvaṇastu raṇaślāghī svasahāyāndadarśa ha || 7.23.1 ||
translation: ततः then, जित्वा having conquered, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, यमम् Yama, त्रिदशपुङ्गवम् the chief among the gods, रावणः Ravana, तु and, रणश्लाघी one who boasts of his prowess in battle, स्वसहायान् his own companions, ददर्श saw, ह indeed.
explanation: Then, having conquered Yama, the chief among the gods, Ravana, who boasted of his prowess in battle, indeed saw his own companions.
comments: Ravana descends to the nether ocean, subdues the Nagas at Bhogavati, and at Brahma's word makes a pact of friendship with the Nivatakavachas -- he slays the Kalakeyas and his brother-in-law Vidyujjihva, then storms Varuna's abode -- Varuna being away in Brahma's world, his sons give battle but are defeated by Ravana and his minister Mahodara -- proclaiming victory, Ravana returns toward Lanka.

shloka_text: ततो रुधिरसिक्ताङ्गं प्रहारैर्जर्जरीकृतम् । रावणं राक्षसा दृष्ट्वा ह्यष्टवत् समुपागमन् ।। 7.23.2 ।।
transliteration: tato rudhirasiktāṅgaṃ prahārairjarjarīkṛtam | rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasā dṛṣṭvā hyaṣṭavat samupāgaman || 7.23.2 ||
translation: ततः then, रुधिरसिक्ताङ्गम् whose body was drenched in blood, प्रहारैः by blows, जर्जरीकृतम् shattered, रावणम् Ravana, राक्षसाः the demons, दृष्ट्वा having seen, हि indeed, अष्टवत् auspiciously, समुपागमन् approached.
explanation: Then, having seen Ravana, whose body was drenched in blood and shattered by blows, the demons indeed approached him auspiciously.

shloka_text: जयेन वर्धयित्वा च मारीचप्रमुखास्ततः । पुष्पकं भेजिरे सर्वे सान्त्विता रावणेन तु ।। 7.23.3 ।।
transliteration: jayena vardhayitvā ca mārīcapramukhāstataḥ | puṣpakaṃ bhejire sarve sāntvitā rāvaṇena tu || 7.23.3 ||
translation: जयेन by victory, वर्धयित्वा having increased (celebrated), च and, मारीचप्रमुखाः Maricha and others (chiefs), ततः then, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka (chariot), भेजिरे resorted to (boarded), सर्वे all, सान्त्विताः consoled, रावणेन by Ravana, तु indeed
explanation: After Ravana had consoled them and celebrated their victory, Maricha and the other chiefs all boarded the Pushpaka chariot.

shloka_text: ततो रसातलं गच्छन् प्रविष्टः पयसां निधिम् । दैत्योरगगणाध्युष्टं वरुणेन सुरक्षितम् ।। 7.23.4 ।।
transliteration: tato rasātalaṃ gacchan praviṣṭaḥ payasāṃ nidhim | daityoragagaṇādhyuṣṭaṃ varuṇena surakṣitam || 7.23.4 ||
translation: ततः then, रसातलं Rasatala (the lowest netherworld), गच्छन् going, प्रविष्टः entered, पयसाम् of waters, निधिम् the ocean (abode), दैत्योरगगणाध्युष्टम् inhabited by hosts of Daityas and Nagas (serpents), वरुणेन by Varuna, सुरक्षितम् well-protected
explanation: Then, proceeding to Rasatala, he entered the ocean, which was inhabited by hosts of Daityas and Nagas and well-protected by Varuna.

shloka_text: स तु भोगवतीं गत्वा पुरीं वासुकिपालिताम् । कृत्वा नागान्वशे हृष्टो ययौ मणिमयीं पुरीम् ।। 7.23.5 ।।
transliteration: sa tu bhogavatīṃ gatvā purīṃ vāsukipālitām | kṛtvā nāgānvaśe hṛṣṭo yayau maṇimayīṃ purīm || 7.23.5 ||
translation: सः he, तु indeed, भोगवतीम् Bhogavati (city name), गत्वा having gone, पुरीम् city, वासुकिपालिताम् protected by Vasuki, कृत्वा having made, नागान् the Nagas (serpents), वशे under control, हृष्टः delighted, ययौ went, मणिमयीम् gem-studded, पुरीम् city
explanation: Having gone to the city of Bhogavati, protected by Vasuki, and having brought the Nagas under his control, he, delighted, proceeded to the gem-studded city.

shloka_text: निवातकवचास्तत्र दैत्या लब्धवरा वसन् । राक्षसान्तान्समागम्य युद्धाय समुपाह्वयत् ।। 7.23.6 ।।
transliteration: nivātakavacāstatra daityā labdhavarā vasan | rākṣasāntānsamāgamya yuddhāya samupāhvayat || 7.23.6 ||
translation: निवातकवचाः Nivātakavachas, तत्र there, दैत्याः Daityas, लब्धवराः who had obtained boons, वसन् lived, राक्षसान् the Rakshasa (Ravana), तान् them (the Nivātakavachas), समागम्य having approached, युद्धाय for battle, समुपाह्वयत् challenged
explanation: There lived the Nivātakavachas, Daityas who had obtained boons, and Ravana, having approached them, challenged them to battle.

shloka_text: ते तु सर्वे सुविक्रान्ता दैतेया बलशालिनः । नानाप्रहरणास्तत्र प्रहृष्टा युद्धदुर्मदाः ।। 7.23.7 ।।
transliteration: te tu sarve suvikrāntā daiteyā balaśālinaḥ | nānāpraharaṇāstatra prahṛṣṭā yuddhadurmadāḥ || 7.23.7 ||
translation: ते they, तु indeed, सर्वे all, सुविक्रान्ताः very mighty (valiant), दैतेयाः Daityas, बलशालिनः powerful, नानाप्रहरणाः having various weapons, तत्र there, प्रहृष्टाः delighted (overjoyed), युद्धदुर्मदाः intoxicated with battle (fierce in battle)
explanation: All those Daityas were indeed very mighty, powerful, equipped with various weapons, and overjoyed and fierce in battle.

shloka_text: शूलैस्त्रिशूलैः कुलिशैः पट्टिशासिपरश्वधैः । अन्योन्यं बिभिदुः क्रुद्धा राक्षसा दानवास्तथा ।। 7.23.8 ।।
transliteration: śūlaistriśūlaiḥ kuliśaiḥ paṭṭiśāsiparaśvadhaiḥ | anyonyaṃ bibhiduḥ kruddhā rākṣasā dānavāstathā || 7.23.8 ||
translation: शूलैः with spears, त्रिशूलैः with tridents, कुलिशैः with thunderbolts, पट्टिशासिपरश्वधैः with sharp-edged spears, swords, and axes, अन्योन्यं each other, बिभिदुः pierced, क्रुद्धाः enraged, राक्षसाः the Rakshasas, दानवाः the Danavas, तथा and.
explanation: The enraged Rakshasas and Danavas fiercely pierced each other with spears, tridents, thunderbolts, sharp-edged spears, swords, and axes.

shloka_text: तेषां तु युध्यमानानां साग्रः संवत्सरो गतः । न चान्यतरयोस्तत्र विजयो वा क्षयो ऽपि वा ।। 7.23.9 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ tu yudhyamānānāṃ sāgraḥ saṃvatsaro gataḥ | na cānyatarayostatra vijayo vā kṣayo 'pi vā || 7.23.9 ||
translation: तेषां of them, तु indeed, युध्यमानानां who were fighting, साग्रः more than, संवत्सरः a year, गतः passed, न not, च and, अन्यतरयोः of either of the two, तत्र there, विजयो victory, वा or, क्षयो destruction, अपि even, वा or.
explanation: As they continued to fight, more than a year passed, yet neither side achieved victory nor suffered complete destruction.

shloka_text: ततः पितामहस्तत्र त्रैलोक्यगतिरव्ययः । आजगाम द्रुतं देवो विमानवरमास्थितः ।। 7.23.10 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pitāmahastatra trailokyagatiravyayaḥ | ājagāma drutaṃ devo vimānavaramāsthitaḥ || 7.23.10 ||
translation: ततः then, पितामहः the grandfather (Brahma), तत्र there, त्रैलोक्यगतिः the resort of the three worlds, अव्ययः the imperishable, आजगाम came, द्रुतं quickly, देवो the god, विमानवरम् on an excellent aerial car, आस्थितः seated.
explanation: Then, the imperishable god Brahma, the lord of the three worlds, quickly arrived there, seated in his magnificent aerial chariot.

shloka_text: निवातकवचानां तु निवार्य रणकर्म तत् । वृद्धः पितामहो वाक्यमुवाच विदितार्थवत् ।। 7.23.11 ।।
transliteration: nivātakavacānāṃ tu nivārya raṇakarma tat | vṛddhaḥ pitāmaho vākyamuvāca viditārthavat || 7.23.11 ||
translation: निवातकवचानां of the Nivatakavachas, तु indeed, निवार्य having stopped, रणकर्म the act of war, तत् that, वृद्धः the old, पितामहः grandfather (Brahma), वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke, विदितार्थवत् meaningful.
explanation: Having stopped that act of war involving the Nivatakavachas, the wise grandfather Brahma spoke meaningful words.

shloka_text: नह्ययं रावणो युद्धे शक्यो जेतुं सुरासुरैः । न भवन्तः क्षयं नेतुमपि सामरदानवैः ।। 7.23.12 ।।
transliteration: nahyayaṃ rāvaṇo yuddhe śakyo jetuṃ surāsuraiḥ | na bhavantaḥ kṣayaṃ netumapi sāmaradānavaiḥ || 7.23.12 ||
translation: न not, हि indeed, अयं this, रावणो Ravana, युद्धे in battle, शक्यो possible, जेतुं to conquer, सुरासुरैः by gods and asuras, न not, भवन्तः you, क्षयं to destruction, नेतुम् to lead, अपि even, सामरदानवैः by gods and Danavas.
explanation: Indeed, this Ravana cannot be conquered in battle by gods and asuras, nor can you (Nivatakavachas) be led to destruction even by gods and Danavas.

shloka_text: राक्षसस्य सखित्वं च भवद्भिः सह रोचते । अविभक्ताश्च सर्वार्थाः सुहृदां नात्र संशयः ।। 7.23.13 ।।
transliteration: rākṣasasya sakhitvaṃ ca bhavadbhiḥ saha rocate | avibhaktāśca sarvārthāḥ suhṛdāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 7.23.13 ||
translation: राक्षसस्य of a Rakshasa, सखित्वं friendship, च and, भवद्भिः with you, सह together, रोचते is pleasing. अविभक्ताः undivided, च and, सर्वार्थाः all interests, सुहृदां of friends, न not, अत्र here, संशयः doubt.
explanation: Friendship with you Rakshasas is agreeable, and there is no doubt that all interests of friends are undivided.

shloka_text: ततो ऽग्निसाक्षिकं सख्यं कृतवांस्तत्र रावणः । निवातकवचैः सार्धं प्रीतिमानभवत्तदा ।। 7.23.14 ।।
transliteration: tato 'gnisākṣikaṃ sakhyaṃ kṛtavāṃstatra rāvaṇaḥ | nivātakavacaiḥ sārdhaṃ prītimānabhavattadā || 7.23.14 ||
translation: ततो then, अग्निसाक्षिकं with fire as witness, सख्यं friendship, कृतवान् made, तत्र there, रावणः Ravana. निवातकवचैः with the Nivātakavachas, सार्धं together with, प्रीतिमान् delighted, अभवत् became, तदा then.
explanation: Then, Ravana established a friendship with the Nivātakavachas, with fire as witness, and became delighted at that time.

shloka_text: अर्थतस्तैर्यथान्यायं संवत्सरमथोषितः । स्वपुरान्निर्विशेषं च प्रियं प्राप्तो दशाननः ।। 7.23.15 ।।
transliteration: arthatastairyathānyāyaṃ saṃvatsaramathoṣitaḥ | svapurānnirviśeṣaṃ ca priyaṃ prāpto daśānanaḥ || 7.23.15 ||
translation: अर्थतः properly, तैः by them, यथान्यायं according to justice, संवत्सरम् for a year, अथ then, उषितः resided. स्वपुरात् from his own city, निर्विशेषं without distinction, च and, प्रियं affection, प्राप्तः obtained, दशाननः Dashanana.
explanation: Ravana then resided there for a year, treated properly and justly by them, receiving affection as if he were in his own city.

shloka_text: ततोपधार्य मायानां शतमेकं समाप्तवान् । सलिलेन्द्रपुरान्वेषी भ्रमति स्म रसातलम् ।। 7.23.16 ।।
transliteration: tatopadhārya māyānāṃ śatamekaṃ samāptavān | salilendrapurānveṣī bhramati sma rasātalam || 7.23.16 ||
translation: ततः then, मायानां of magic arts, शतम् एकं one full hundred, उपधार्य having mastered, समाप्तवान् he completed (learning them), सलिलेन्द्रपुरान्वेषी seeking the city of the lord of waters, रसातलम् in the netherworld, भ्रमति स्म he wandered.
explanation: Then, having mastered a full hundred magic arts, Ravana wandered through the netherworld in search of the city of Varuna, the lord of waters.

shloka_text: ततो ऽश्मनगरं नाम कालकेयैरधिष्ठितम् । गत्वा तु कालकेयांश्च हत्वा तत्र बलोत्कटान् ।। 7.23.17 ।।
transliteration: tato 'śmanagaraṃ nāma kālakeyairadhiṣṭhitam | gatvā tu kālakeyāṃśca hatvā tatra balotkaṭān || 7.23.17 ||
translation: ततो then, अश्मनगरं Ashmanagara, नाम named, कालकेयैः by the Kalakeyas, अधिष्ठितम् inhabited. गत्वा having gone, तु indeed, कालकेयान् the Kalakeyas, च and, हत्वा having killed, तत्र there, बलोत्कटान् the mighty ones.
explanation: Then, having gone to the city named Ashmanagara, which was inhabited by the Kalakeyas, Ravana killed the exceedingly strong Kalakeyas there.

shloka_text: शूर्पणख्याश्च भर्तारमसिना प्राच्छिनत्तदा । श्यालं च बलवन्तं च विद्युज्जिह्वं बलोत्कटम् । जिह्वया संलिहन्तं च राक्षसं समरे तथा ।। 7.23.18 ।।
transliteration: śūrpaṇakhyāśca bhartāramasinā prācchinattadā | śyālaṃ ca balavantaṃ ca vidyujjihvaṃ balotkaṭam | jihvayā saṃlihantaṃ ca rākṣasaṃ samare tathā || 7.23.18 ||
translation: शूर्पणख्याः of Shurpanakha, च and, भर्तारम् husband, असिना with a sword, प्राच्छिनत् cut off, तदा then. श्यालं brother-in-law, च and, बलवन्तं mighty, च and, विद्युज्जिह्वं Vidyujjihva, बलोत्कटम् exceedingly strong. जिह्वया with his tongue, संलिहन्तं licking, च and, राक्षसं Rakshasa, समरे in battle, तथा thus.
explanation: Then, Ravana cut off Shurpanakha's husband, his mighty and exceedingly strong brother-in-law named Vidyujjihva, who was a Rakshasa licking (blood/wounds) with his tongue in battle, with his sword.

shloka_text: तं विजित्य मुहूर्तेन जघ्ने दैत्यांश्चतुःशतम् ।। 7.23.19 ।।
transliteration: taṃ vijitya muhūrtena jaghne daityāṃścatuḥśatam || 7.23.19 ||
translation: तम् him, विजित्य having conquered, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, जघ्ने he killed, दैत्यान् demons, चतुःशतम् four hundred,
explanation: Having conquered him, he killed four hundred demons in an instant.

shloka_text: ततः पाण्डुरमेघाभं कैलासमिव भास्वरम् । वरुणस्यालयं दिव्यमपश्यद्राक्षसाधिपः ।। 7.23.20 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pāṇḍurameghābhaṃ kailāsamiva bhāsvaram | varuṇasyālayaṃ divyamapaśyadrākṣasādhipaḥ || 7.23.20 ||
translation: ततः then, पाण्डुरमेघाभम् resembling white clouds, कैलासमिव like Mount Kailasa, भास्वरम् shining, वरुणस्य of Varuna, आलयम् abode, दिव्यम् divine, अपश्यत् he saw, राक्षसाधिपः the lord of rakshasas,
explanation: Then, the lord of rakshasas saw the divine abode of Varuna, which resembled white clouds and shone like Mount Kailasa.

shloka_text: क्षरन्तीं च पयस्तत्र सुरभिं गामवस्थिताम् । यस्याः पयोभिनिष्यन्दात्क्षीरोदो नाम सागरः ।। 7.23.21 ।।
transliteration: kṣarantīṃ ca payastatra surabhiṃ gāmavasthitām | yasyāḥ payobhiniṣyandātkṣīrodo nāma sāgaraḥ || 7.23.21 ||
translation: क्षरन्तीम् flowing, च and, पयः milk, तत्र there, सुरभिम् Surabhi, गाम् cow, अवस्थिताम् standing, यस्याः from whose, पयोभिनिष्यन्दात् from the flowing of milk, क्षीरोदः Kshiroda, नाम named, सागरः ocean,
explanation: There he saw the divine cow Surabhi, standing and continuously flowing milk, from whose abundant milk flow the ocean named Kshiroda originated.

shloka_text: ददर्श रावणस्तत्र गोवृषेन्द्रवरारणिम् । यस्माच्चन्द्रः प्रभवति शीतरश्मिर्निशाकरः ।। 7.23.22 ।।
transliteration: dadarśa rāvaṇastatra govṛṣendravarāraṇim | yasmāccandraḥ prabhavati śītaraśmirniśākaraḥ || 7.23.22 ||
translation: ददर्श he saw, रावणः Ravana, तत्र there, गोवृषेन्द्रवरारणिम् the best source of cows, bulls, and excellent things, यस्मात् from which, चन्द्रः the moon, प्रभवति originates, शीतरश्मिः cool-rayed, निशाकरः night-maker,
explanation: There Ravana saw the ocean, the best source of cows, bulls, and excellent things, from which the cool-rayed moon, the maker of night, originated.

shloka_text: यं समाश्रित्य जीवन्ति फेनपाः परमर्षयः । अमृतं यत्र चोत्पन्नं स्वधा च स्वधभोजिनाम् ।। 7.23.23 ।।
transliteration: yaṃ samāśritya jīvanti phenapāḥ paramarṣayaḥ | amṛtaṃ yatra cotpannaṃ svadhā ca svadhabhojinām || 7.23.23 ||
translation: यम् which, समाश्रित्य depending on, जीवन्ति live, फेनपाः foam-drinkers, परमर्षयः great sages, अमृतम् nectar, यत्र where, च and, उत्पन्नम् originated, स्वधा Svadhā, च and, स्वधभोजिनाम् for those who partake of Svadhā,
explanation: Great sages known as foam-drinkers subsist by depending on this ocean, and it is also where nectar and Svadhā, the offering for ancestors, originated.

shloka_text: यां ब्रुवन्ति नरा लोके सुरभिं नाम नामतः । प्रदक्षिणं तु तां कृत्वा रावणः परमाद्भुताम् ।। 7.23.24 ।।
transliteration: yāṃ bruvanti narā loke surabhiṃ nāma nāmataḥ | pradakṣiṇaṃ tu tāṃ kṛtvā rāvaṇaḥ paramādbhutām || 7.23.24 ||
translation: यां which, ब्रुवन्ति call, नरा men, लोके in the world, सुरभिं Surabhi, नाम by name, नामतः by name, प्रदक्षिणं circumambulation, तु indeed, तां her, कृत्वा having done, रावणः Ravana, परमाद्भुताम् exceedingly wonderful,
explanation: Ravana, having circumambulated the exceedingly wonderful Surabhi, whom people in the world call by that name, then proceeded.

shloka_text: प्रविवेश महाघोरं गुप्तं बहुविधैर्बलैः । ततो धाराशताकीर्णं शारदाभ्रनिभं तदा । नित्यप्रहृष्टं ददृशे वरुणस्य गृहोत्तमम् ।। 7.23.25 ।।
transliteration: praviveśa mahāghoraṃ guptaṃ bahuvidhairbalaiḥ | tato dhārāśatākīrṇaṃ śāradābhranibhaṃ tadā | nityaprahṛṣṭaṃ dadṛśe varuṇasya gṛhottamam || 7.23.25 ||
translation: प्रविवेश entered, महाघोरं very dreadful, गुप्तं guarded, बहुविधैर्बलैः by various kinds of forces, ततो then, धाराशताकीर्णं filled with hundreds of streams, शारदाभ्रनिभं resembling an autumn cloud, तदा then, नित्यप्रहृष्टं always joyful, ददृशे he saw, वरुणस्य of Varuna, गृहोत्तमम् the excellent house,
explanation: He then entered a very dreadful place, guarded by various forces, and there he saw Varuna's excellent abode, which was filled with hundreds of streams, resembled an autumn cloud, and was always joyful.

shloka_text: ततो हत्वा बलाध्यक्षान्समरे तैश्च ताडितः । अब्रवीच्च ततो योधान्राजा शीघ्रं निवेद्यताम् ।। 7.23.26 ।।
transliteration: tato hatvā balādhyakṣānsamare taiśca tāḍitaḥ | abravīcca tato yodhānrājā śīghraṃ nivedyatām || 7.23.26 ||
translation: ततो then, हत्वा having killed, बलाध्यक्षान् the commanders of the army, समरे in battle, तैश्च and by them, ताडितः struck, अब्रवीच्च and he said, ततो then, योधान् to the warriors, राजा the king, शीघ्रं quickly, निवेद्यताम् let it be announced,
explanation: Then, having killed the commanders of the army in battle and being struck by them, Ravana said to the warriors, "Let the king (Varuna) be quickly informed."

shloka_text: युद्धार्थी रावणः प्राप्तस्तस्य युद्धं प्रदीयताम् । वद वा न भयं ते ऽस्ति निर्जितो ऽस्मीति साञ्जलिः ।। 7.23.27 ।।
transliteration: yuddhārthī rāvaṇaḥ prāptastasya yuddhaṃ pradīyatām | vada vā na bhayaṃ te 'sti nirjito 'smīti sāñjaliḥ || 7.23.27 ||
translation: युद्धार्थी desirous of battle, रावणः Ravana, प्राप्तः has arrived, तस्य to him, युद्धं battle, प्रदीयताम् let it be given, वद or say, वा or, न not, भयं fear, ते to you, अस्ति is, निर्जितो conquered, अस्मि I am, इति thus, साञ्जलिः with folded hands,
explanation: "Ravana, desirous of battle, has arrived; let battle be given to him, or else, with folded hands, say 'I am conquered' if you have no fear."

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धा वरुणस्य महात्मनः । पुत्राः पौत्राश्च निष्क्रामन्गौश्च पुष्कर एव च ।। 7.23.28 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare kruddhā varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ | putrāḥ pautrāśca niṣkrāmangauśca puṣkara eva ca || 7.23.28 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् at this, अन्तरे moment, क्रुद्धा enraged, वरुणस्य of Varuna, महात्मनः the great-souled, पुत्राः sons, पौत्राश्च and grandsons, निष्क्रामन् came out, गौश्च and Gau, पुष्कर Pushkara, एव indeed, च and,
explanation: At this moment, the enraged sons and grandsons of the great-souled Varuna, including Gau and Pushkara, came out.

shloka_text: ते तु वीर्यगुणोपेता बलैः परिवृताः स्वकैः । युङ्क्त्वा रथान्कामगमानुद्यद्भास्वरवर्चसः ।। 7.23.29 ।।
transliteration: te tu vīryaguṇopetā balaiḥ parivṛtāḥ svakaiḥ | yuṅktvā rathānkāmagamānudyadbhāsvaravarcasaḥ || 7.23.29 ||
translation: ते they, तु indeed, वीर्यगुणोपेताः endowed with valorous qualities, बलैः by forces, परिवृताः surrounded, स्वकैः their own, युङ्क्त्वा having yoked, रथान् chariots, कामगमान् moving at will, उद्यद्भास्वरवर्चसः with rising brilliant splendor,
explanation: Endowed with valorous qualities and surrounded by their own forces, they yoked their chariots, which moved at will, shining with brilliant splendor.

shloka_text: ततो युद्धं समभवद्दारुणं रोमहर्षणम् । सलिलेन्द्रस्य पुत्राणां रावणस्य च धीमतः ।। 7.23.30 ।।
transliteration: tato yuddhaṃ samabhavaddāruṇaṃ romaharṣaṇam | salilendrasya putrāṇāṃ rāvaṇasya ca dhīmataḥ || 7.23.30 ||
translation: ततः then, युद्धम् battle, समभवत् occurred, दारुणम् terrible, रोमहर्षणम् hair-raising, सलिलेन्द्रस्य of the lord of waters, पुत्राणाम् of the sons, रावणस्य of Ravana, च and, धीमतः intelligent,
explanation: Then, a terrible and hair-raising battle ensued between the sons of Varuna, the lord of waters, and the intelligent Ravana.

shloka_text: अमात्यैश्च महावीर्यैर्दशग्रीवस्य रक्षसः । वारुणं तद्बलं कृत्स्नं क्षणेन विनिपातितम् ।। 7.23.31 ।।
transliteration: amātyaiśca mahāvīryairdaśagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ | vāruṇaṃ tadbalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ kṣaṇena vinipātitam || 7.23.31 ||
translation: अमात्यैः by ministers, च and, महावीर्यैः very powerful, दशग्रीवस्य of Dashagriva, रक्षसः the Rakshasa, वारुणम् belonging to Varuna, तत् that, बलम् army, कृत्स्नम् entire, क्षणेन in a moment, विनिपातितम् was destroyed,
explanation: And by the very powerful ministers of the Rakshasa Dashagriva, that entire army of Varuna was destroyed in a moment.

shloka_text: समीक्ष्य स्वबलं सङ्ख्ये वरुणस्य सुतास्तदा । अर्दिताः शरजालेन निवृत्ता रणकर्मणः ।। 7.23.32 ।।
transliteration: samīkṣya svabalaṃ saṅkhye varuṇasya sutāstadā | arditāḥ śarajālena nivṛttā raṇakarmaṇaḥ || 7.23.32 ||
translation: समीक्ष्य having seen, स्वबलम् their own army, सङ्ख्ये in battle, वरुणस्य of Varuna, सुताः sons, तदा then, अर्दिताः afflicted, शरजालेन by a shower of arrows, निवृत्ताः retreated, रणकर्मणः from the act of battle,
explanation: Then, seeing their own army afflicted by a shower of arrows in battle, the sons of Varuna retreated from the fight.

shloka_text: महीतलगतास्ते तु रावणं दृश्य पुष्पके । आकाशमाशु विविशुः स्यन्दनैः शीघ्रगामिभिः ।। 7.23.33 ।।
transliteration: mahītalagatāste tu rāvaṇaṃ dṛśya puṣpake | ākāśamāśu viviśuḥ syandanaiḥ śīghragāmibhiḥ || 7.23.33 ||
translation: महीतलगताः situated on the ground, ते they, तु indeed, रावणम् Ravana, दृश्य having seen, पुष्पके in the Pushpaka (chariot), आकाशम् sky, आशु quickly, विविशुः entered, स्यन्दनैः by chariots, शीघ्रगामिभिः swift-moving,
explanation: Indeed, they, who were on the ground, having seen Ravana in the Pushpaka chariot, quickly ascended into the sky with their swift-moving chariots.

shloka_text: महादासीत्ततस्तेषां तुल्यं स्थानमवाप्य तत् । आकाशयुद्धं तुमुलं देवदानवयोरिव ।। 7.23.34 ।।
transliteration: mahādāsīttatasteṣāṃ tulyaṃ sthānamavāpya tat | ākāśayuddhaṃ tumulaṃ devadānavayoriva || 7.23.34 ||
translation: महादासीत् it was great, ततस्तेषां then for them, तुल्यं equal, स्थानमवाप्य having obtained a place, तत् that, आकाशयुद्धं sky-battle, तुमुलं tumultuous, देवदानवयोरिव like that of gods and demons.
explanation: After obtaining an equal position in the sky, a great and tumultuous battle ensued among them, resembling the fierce combat between gods and demons.

shloka_text: ततस्ते रावणं युद्धे शरैः पावकसन्निभैः । विमुखीकृत्य सन्तुष्टा विनेदुर्विविधान्रवान् ।। 7.23.35 ।।
transliteration: tataste rāvaṇaṃ yuddhe śaraiḥ pāvakasannibhaiḥ | vimukhīkṛtya santuṣṭā vinedurvividhānravān || 7.23.35 ||
translation: ततस्ते then they, रावणं Ravana, युद्धे in battle, शरैः with arrows, पावकसन्निभैः resembling fire, विमुखीकृत्य having turned away, सन्तुष्टा satisfied, विनेदुर्विविधान्रवान् they roared various sounds.
explanation: Then, having turned Ravana away in battle with their fire-like arrows, they were satisfied and roared various sounds.

shloka_text: ततो महोदरः क्रुद्धो राजानं दृश्य धर्षितम् । त्यक्त्वा मृत्युभयं वीरो युद्धकाङ्क्षी व्यलोकयत् ।। 7.23.36 ।।
transliteration: tato mahodaraḥ kruddho rājānaṃ dṛśya dharṣitam | tyaktvā mṛtyubhayaṃ vīro yuddhakāṅkṣī vyalokayat || 7.23.36 ||
translation: ततो then, महोदरः Mahodara, क्रुद्धो enraged, राजानं the king, दृश्य having seen, धर्षितम् humiliated, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, मृत्युभयं fear of death, वीरो the hero, युद्धकाङ्क्षी desirous of battle, व्यलोकयत् he looked (at the enemy).
explanation: Then, the enraged hero Mahodara, seeing his king humiliated, abandoned all fear of death and, desirous of battle, looked towards the enemy.

shloka_text: तेन ते दारुणा युद्धे कामगाः पवनोपमाः । महोदरेण गदया हता वै प्रययुः क्षितिम् ।। 7.23.37 ।।
transliteration: tena te dāruṇā yuddhe kāmagāḥ pavanopamāḥ | mahodareṇa gadayā hatā vai prayayuḥ kṣitim || 7.23.37 ||
translation: तेन by him, ते those, दारुणा fierce, युद्धे in battle, कामगाः moving at will, पवनोपमाः resembling wind, महोदरेण by Mahodara, गदया with a mace, हता struck, वै indeed, प्रययुः they went, क्षितिम् to the earth.
explanation: In that fierce battle, those who moved at will and resembled the wind were indeed struck by Mahodara with his mace and fell to the earth.

shloka_text: तेषां वरुणपुत्राणां हत्वा योधान्हयाञ्छतान् । मुमोचाशु महानादं विरथान्प्रेक्ष्य तान्स्थितान् ।। 7.23.38 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ varuṇaputrāṇāṃ hatvā yodhānhayāñchatān | mumocāśu mahānādaṃ virathānprekṣya tānsthitān || 7.23.38 ||
translation: तेषां of them, वरुणपुत्राणां of the sons of Varuna, हत्वा having killed, योधान्हयाञ्छतान् hundreds of warriors and horses, मुमोचाशु quickly he let out, महानादं a great roar, विरथान्प्रेक्ष्य having seen them chariot-less, तान्स्थितान् standing.
explanation: Having killed hundreds of warriors and horses belonging to the sons of Varuna, Mahodara quickly let out a great roar upon seeing them standing dismounted from their chariots.

shloka_text: ते तु तेषां रथाः साश्वाः सह सारथिभिर्हतैः । महोदरेण निहताः पतिताः पृथिवीतले ।। 7.23.39 ।।
transliteration: te tu teṣāṃ rathāḥ sāśvāḥ saha sārathibhirhataiḥ | mahodareṇa nihatāḥ patitāḥ pṛthivītale || 7.23.39 ||
translation: ते those, तु indeed, तेषां their, रथाः chariots, साश्वाः with horses, सह along with, सारथिभिः charioteers, हतैः killed, महोदरेण by Mahodara, निहताः struck down, पतिताः fell, पृथिवीतले on the ground
explanation: Mahodara struck down their chariots, which, along with their horses and slain charioteers, fell to the ground.

shloka_text: ते तु त्यक्त्वा रथान्पुत्रा वरुणस्य महात्मनः । आकाशे विष्ठिताः शूराः स्वप्रभावान्न विव्यथुः ।। 7.23.40 ।।
transliteration: te tu tyaktvā rathānputrā varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ | ākāśe viṣṭhitāḥ śūrāḥ svaprabhāvānna vivyathuḥ || 7.23.40 ||
translation: ते those, तु but, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, रथान् chariots, पुत्राः sons, वरुणस्य of Varuna, महात्मनः the great-souled, आकाशे in the sky, विष्ठिताः stood, शूराः brave ones, स्वप्रभावात् due to their own power, न not, विव्यथुः were distressed
explanation: But those brave sons of the great-souled Varuna, having abandoned their chariots, stood in the sky and were not distressed due to their inherent power.

shloka_text: धनूंषि कृत्वा सज्जानि विनिर्भिद्य महोदरम् । रावणं समरे क्रुद्धाः सहिताः समभिद्रवन् ।। 7.23.41 ।।
transliteration: dhanūṃṣi kṛtvā sajjāni vinirbhidya mahodaram | rāvaṇaṃ samare kruddhāḥ sahitāḥ samabhidravan || 7.23.41 ||
translation: धनूंषि bows, कृत्वा having made, सज्जानि ready, विनिर्भिद्य having pierced, महोदरम् Mahodara, रावणं Ravana, समरे in battle, क्रुद्धाः enraged, सहिताः together, समभिद्रवन् attacked
explanation: Enraged, they made their bows ready, pierced Mahodara, and together attacked Ravana in battle.

shloka_text: सायकैश्चापविभ्रष्टैर्वज्रकल्पैः सुदारुणैः । दारयन्ति स्म सङ्क्रुद्धा मेघा इव महागिरिम् ।। 7.23.42 ।।
transliteration: sāyakaiścāpavibhraṣṭairvajrakalpaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ | dārayanti sma saṅkruddhā meghā iva mahāgirim || 7.23.42 ||
translation: सायकैः with arrows, च and, आपविभ्रष्टैः released from bows, वज्रकल्पैः like thunderbolts, सुदारुणैः very terrible, दारयन्ति स्म they tore apart, सङ्क्रुद्धाः greatly enraged, मेघाः clouds, इव like, महागिरिम् a great mountain
explanation: Greatly enraged, they tore him apart with very terrible arrows, released from their bows and resembling thunderbolts, just as clouds tear apart a great mountain.

shloka_text: ततः क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवः कालाग्निरिव निर्गतः । शरवर्षैर्महाघोरैस्तेषां मर्मस्वताडयत् ।। 7.23.43 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kruddho daśagrīvaḥ kālāgniriva nirgataḥ | śaravarṣairmahāghoraisteṣāṃ marmasvatāḍayat || 7.23.43 ||
translation: ततः then, क्रुद्धः enraged, दशग्रीवः the ten-necked (Ravana), कालाग्निः the fire of destruction, इव like, निर्गतः emerged, शरवर्षैः with showers of arrows, महाघोरैः very dreadful, तेषां their, मर्मसु vital spots, अताडयत् struck
explanation: Then, the enraged Ravana, appearing like the fire of destruction, struck their vital spots with very dreadful showers of arrows.

shloka_text: ततस्तेनैव सहसा सीदन्ति स्म पदातयः । मुसलानि विचित्राणि ततो भल्लशतानि च ।। 7.23.44 ।।
transliteration: tatastenaiva sahasā sīdanti sma padātayaḥ | musalāni vicitrāṇi tato bhallaśatāni ca || 7.23.44 ||
translation: ततः then, तेनैव by him alone, सहसा suddenly, सीदन्ति स्म were sinking, पदातयः the foot-soldiers, मुसलानि maces, विचित्राणि various, ततः then, भल्लशतानि hundreds of spears, च and.
explanation: Then, by him alone, the foot-soldiers suddenly began to collapse under the impact of various maces and hundreds of spears.

shloka_text: पट्टिशांश्चैव शक्तीश्च शतघ्नीस्तोमरांस्तथा । पातयामास दुर्धर्षस्तेषामुपरि विष्ठितः ।। 7.23.45 ।।
transliteration: paṭṭiśāṃścaiva śaktīśca śataghnīstomarāṃstathā | pātayāmāsa durdharṣasteṣāmupari viṣṭhitaḥ || 7.23.45 ||
translation: पट्टिशान् sharp-edged spears, च and, एव indeed, शक्तीः lances, च and, शतघ्नीः 'hundred-killers' (a type of weapon), तोमरान् javelins, तथा and also, पातयामास he hurled, दुर्धर्षः the irresistible one (Ravana), तेषाम् upon them, उपरि above, विष्ठितः standing.
explanation: The irresistible Ravana, positioned above them, hurled down sharp-edged spears, lances, 'hundred-killers', and javelins upon them.

shloka_text: अपविद्धास्तु ते वीरा विनिष्पेतुः पदातयः । महापङ्कमिवासाद्य कुञ्जराष्षष्टिहायनाः ।। 7.23.46 ।।
transliteration: apaviddhāstu te vīrā viniṣpetuḥ padātayaḥ | mahāpaṅkamivāsādya kuñjarāṣṣaṣṭihāyanāḥ || 7.23.46 ||
translation: अपविद्धाः struck down, तु but, ते those, वीराः brave ones, विनिष्पेतुः they fled, पदातयः the foot-soldiers, महापङ्कम् a great mud-pit, इव like, आसाद्य having fallen into, कुञ्जराः elephants, षष्टिहायनाः sixty years old.
explanation: Those brave foot-soldiers, struck down, scattered and fled like sixty-year-old elephants that have fallen into a deep mud-pit.

shloka_text: सीदमानान्सुतान्दृष्ट्वा विह्वलान्सुमहौजसः । ननाद रावणो हर्षान्महानम्बुधरो यथा ।। 7.23.47 ।।
transliteration: sīdamānānsutāndṛṣṭvā vihvalānsumahaujasaḥ | nanāda rāvaṇo harṣānmahānambudharo yathā || 7.23.47 ||
translation: सीदमानान् sinking, सुतान् sons (enemies), दृष्ट्वा having seen, विह्वलान् distressed, सुमहौजसः very mighty ones, ननाद roared, रावणः Ravana, हर्षात् from joy, महान् a great, अम्बुधरः cloud, यथा like.
explanation: Seeing his very mighty enemies (literally 'sons') collapsing and distressed, Ravana roared with joy like a great thundercloud.

shloka_text: ततो रक्षो महानादान्मुक्त्वा हन्ति स्म वारुणान् । नानाप्रहरणोपेतैर्धारापातैरिवाम्बुदः ।। 7.23.48 ।।
transliteration: tato rakṣo mahānādānmuktvā hanti sma vāruṇān | nānāpraharaṇopetairdhārāpātairivāmbudaḥ || 7.23.48 ||
translation: ततः then, रक्षः the Rakshasa (Ravana), महानादान् great roars, मुक्त्वा having uttered, हन्ति स्म he struck, वारुणान् the followers of Varuna (Devas), नानाप्रहरणोपेतैः with various weapons, धारापातैः with torrents of rain (showers of weapons), इव like, अम्बुदः a cloud.
explanation: Then, the Rakshasa Ravana, having uttered great roars, struck down the followers of Varuna (Devas) with showers of various weapons, just like a cloud pours down torrents of rain.

shloka_text: ततस्ते विमुखाः सर्वे पतिता धरणीतले । रणात्स्वपुरुषैः शीघ्रं गृहाण्येव प्रवेशिताः ।। 7.23.49 ।।
transliteration: tataste vimukhāḥ sarve patitā dharaṇītale | raṇātsvapuruṣaiḥ śīghraṃ gṛhāṇyeva praveśitāḥ || 7.23.49 ||
translation: ततः then, ते they, विमुखाः turned away (defeated), सर्वे all, पतिताः fallen, धरणीतले on the ground, रणात् from the battle, स्वपुरुषैः by their own men, शीघ्रं quickly, गृहाणि into their homes, एव indeed, प्रवेशिताः were brought.
explanation: Then, all of them, defeated and fallen to the ground, were quickly brought back into their homes by their own men from the battlefield.

shloka_text: तानब्रवीत्ततो रक्षो वरुणाय निवेद्यताम् ।। 7.23.50 ।।
transliteration: tānabravīttato rakṣo varuṇāya nivedyatām || 7.23.50 ||
translation: तान् to them, अब्रवीत् said, ततः then, रक्षो the demon (Ravana), वरुणाय to Varuna, निवेद्यताम् let it be announced.
explanation: Then the demon Ravana said to them, "Let this be announced to Varuna."

shloka_text: रावणं त्वब्रवीन्मन्त्री प्रहस्तो (प्रहसो) नाम वारुणः । गतः खलु महाराजो ब्रह्मलोकं जलेश्वरः ।। 7.23.51 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇaṃ tvabravīnmantrī prahasto (prahaso) nāma vāruṇaḥ | gataḥ khalu mahārājo brahmalokaṃ jaleśvaraḥ || 7.23.51 ||
translation: रावणं to Ravana, तु indeed, अब्रवीत् said, मन्त्री the minister, प्रहस्तो Prahasta, नाम named, वारुणः of Varuna, गतः gone, खलु indeed, महाराजो the great king, ब्रह्मलोकं to the world of Brahma, जलेश्वरः the lord of waters (Varuna).
explanation: Then a minister of Varuna named Prahasta (or Prahasa) said to Ravana, "Indeed, the great king, the lord of waters Varuna, has gone to the world of Brahma."

shloka_text: गान्धर्वं वरुणः श्रोतुं यं त्वमाह्वयसे युधि । तत्किं तव वृथा वीर परिश्रम्य गते नृपे । ये तु सन्निहिता वीराः कुमारास्ते पराजिताः ।। 7.23.52 ।।
transliteration: gāndharvaṃ varuṇaḥ śrotuṃ yaṃ tvamāhvayase yudhi | tatkiṃ tava vṛthā vīra pariśramya gate nṛpe | ye tu sannihitā vīrāḥ kumārāste parājitāḥ || 7.23.52 ||
translation: गान्धर्वं Gandharva (music/art), वरुणः Varuna, श्रोतुं to hear, यं whom, त्वं you, आह्वयसे challenge, युधि in battle, तत् therefore, किं what (is the use), तव your, वृथा in vain, वीर O hero, परिश्रम्य having exerted, गते when gone, नृपे the king; ये those who, तु but, सन्निहिताः present, वीराः heroes, कुमाराः princes, ते they, पराजिताः defeated.
explanation: Varuna, whom you challenge in battle, has gone to hear Gandharva music; therefore, O hero, what is the use of your vain exertion when the king is absent, and those princes who were present here have already been defeated?

shloka_text: राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः । हर्षान्नादं विमुञ्चन्वै निष्क्रान्तो वरुणालयात् ।। 7.23.53 ।।
transliteration: rākṣasendrastu tacchrutvā nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ | harṣānnādaṃ vimuñcanvai niṣkrānto varuṇālayāt || 7.23.53 ||
translation: राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of demons (Ravana), तु indeed, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, नाम name, विश्राव्य having proclaimed, च and, आत्मनः his own, हर्षात् from joy, नादं a roar, विमुञ्चन् releasing, वै indeed, निष्क्रान्तः departed, वरुणालयात् from Varuna's abode.
explanation: Having heard that, the lord of demons Ravana, proclaiming his own name and uttering a joyful roar, indeed departed from Varuna's abode.

shloka_text: आगतस्तु पथा येन तेनैव विनिवृत्य सः । लङ्कामभिमुखो रक्षो नभस्तलगतो ययौ ।। 7.23.54 ।।
transliteration: āgatastu pathā yena tenaiva vinivṛtya saḥ | laṅkāmabhimukho rakṣo nabhastalagato yayau || 7.23.54 ||
translation: आगतस्तु having come, पथा by the path, येन by which, तेनैव by that very, विनिवृत्य having returned, सः he, लङ्कामभिमुखो facing Lanka, रक्षो the demon, नभस्तलगतो moving in the sky, ययौ went.
explanation: Having arrived by a certain path, the demon Ravana returned by that very path, flying through the sky towards Lanka. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रयोविंशः सर्गः ।। 23 ।। Thus ends the twenty-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: निवर्तमानः संहृष्टो रावणस्सुदुरात्मवान् । जह्रे पथि नरेन्द्रर्षिदेवगन्धर्वकन्यकाः ।। 7.24.1 ।।
transliteration: nivartamānaḥ saṃhṛṣṭo rāvaṇassudurātmavān | jahre pathi narendrarṣidevagandharvakanyakāḥ || 7.24.1 ||
translation: निवर्तमानः while returning, संहृष्टो greatly delighted, रावणस् Ravana, सुदुरात्मवान् the exceedingly wicked one, जह्रे seized, पथि on the way, नरेन्द्रर्षिदेवगन्धर्वकन्यकाः maidens of kings, sages, gods, and gandharvas.
explanation: While returning, the exceedingly wicked Ravana, greatly delighted, abducted maidens of kings, sages, gods, and gandharvas along his path.
comments: On his return Ravana carries off maidens of every race, filling the Pushpaka with weeping women who curse that he shall perish on account of a woman -- at Lanka his widowed sister, whose husband Vidyujjihva he had slain, laments, and Ravana consoles her -- he sets her brother Khara, with Dushana and fourteen thousand rakshasas, to guard the Dandaka forest, where Shurpanakha goes to dwell.

shloka_text: दर्शनीयां हि रक्षः स कन्यां स्त्रीं वापि पश्यति । हत्वा बन्धुजनं तस्या विमाने तां रुरोध ह ।। 7.24.2 ।।
transliteration: darśanīyāṃ hi rakṣaḥ sa kanyāṃ strīṃ vāpi paśyati | hatvā bandhujanaṃ tasyā vimāne tāṃ rurodha ha || 7.24.2 ||
translation: दर्शनीयां beautiful, हि indeed, रक्षः the demon, स he, कन्यां a maiden, स्त्रीं a woman, वापि or even, पश्यति sees, हत्वा having killed, बन्धुजनं the relatives, तस्या her, विमाने in the aerial car, तां her, रुरोध confined, ह indeed.
explanation: Whenever that demon saw a beautiful maiden or woman, he would kill her relatives and then confine her in his aerial car.

shloka_text: एवं पन्नगकन्याश्च राक्षसासुरमानुषीः । यक्षदानवकन्याश्च विमाने सो ऽध्यरोपयत् ।। 7.24.3 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ pannagakanyāśca rākṣasāsuramānuṣīḥ | yakṣadānavakanyāśca vimāne so 'dhyaropayat || 7.24.3 ||
translation: एवं thus, पन्नगकन्याश्च serpent-maidens and, राक्षसासुरमानुषीः demon, asura, and human women, यक्षदानवकन्याश्च yaksha and danava maidens and, विमाने in the aerial car, सो he, अध्यरोपयत् made to ascend.
explanation: In this manner, he also made serpent-maidens, demonesses, asura women, human women, and yaksha and danava maidens ascend into his aerial car.

shloka_text: ताश्च सर्वाः समं दुःखान्मुमुचुर्बाष्पजं जलम् । तुल्यमग्न्यर्चिषां तत्र शोकाग्निभयसम्भवम् ।। 7.24.4 ।।
transliteration: tāśca sarvāḥ samaṃ duḥkhānmumucurbāṣpajaṃ jalam | tulyamagnyarciṣāṃ tatra śokāgnibhayasambhavam || 7.24.4 ||
translation: ताश्च and they, सर्वाः all, समं together, दुःखान् from sorrow, मुमुचुर् shed, बाष्पजं tears, जलम् water, तुल्यम् resembling, अग्न्यर्चिषां flames of fire, तत्र there, शोकाग्निभयसम्भवम् arising from the fire of sorrow and fear.
explanation: All of them simultaneously shed tears born of sorrow, which resembled flames of fire, arising from the intense sorrow and fear they experienced.

shloka_text: ताभिः सर्वानवद्याभिर्नदीभिरिव सागरः । आपूरितं विमानं तद्भयशोकाशिवाश्रुभिः ।। 7.24.5 ।।
transliteration: tābhiḥ sarvānavadyābhirnadībhiriva sāgaraḥ | āpūritaṃ vimānaṃ tadbhayaśokāśivāśrubhiḥ || 7.24.5 ||
translation: ताभिः by them, सर्वानवद्याभिः by all blameless ones, नदीभिः by rivers, इव like, सागरः the ocean, आपूरितम् filled, विमानम् the aerial car, तत् that, भयशोकाशिवाश्रुभिः with tears of fear, sorrow, and inauspiciousness.
explanation: That aerial car was filled with the tears of fear, sorrow, and inauspiciousness from those blameless women, just as the ocean is filled by rivers.

shloka_text: नागगन्धर्वकन्याश्च महर्षितनयाश्च याः । दैत्यदानवकन्याश्च विमाने शतशो ऽरुदन् ।। 7.24.6 ।।
transliteration: nāgagandharvakanyāśca maharṣitanayāśca yāḥ | daityadānavakanyāśca vimāne śataśo 'rudan || 7.24.6 ||
translation: नागगन्धर्वकन्याः daughters of Nagas and Gandharvas, च and, महर्षितनयाः daughters of great sages, च and, याः who, दैत्यदानवकन्याः daughters of Daityas and Danavas, च and, विमाने in the aerial car, शतशः by hundreds, अरुदन् cried.
explanation: Hundreds of daughters of Nagas, Gandharvas, great sages, Daityas, and Danavas were weeping in the aerial car.

shloka_text: दीर्घकेश्यः सुचार्वङ्ग्यः पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाः । पीनस्तन्यस्तथा वज्रवेदिमध्यसमप्रभाः ।। 7.24.7 ।।
transliteration: dīrghakeśyaḥ sucārvaṅgyaḥ pūrṇacandranibhānanāḥ | pīnastanyastathā vajravedimadhyasamaprabhāḥ || 7.24.7 ||
translation: दीर्घकेश्यः with long hair, सुचार्वङ्ग्यः with very beautiful limbs, पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाः with faces resembling the full moon, पीनस्तन्यः with full breasts, तथा and, वज्रवेदिमध्यसमप्रभाः with waists slender like the middle of a sacrificial altar.
explanation: These women possessed long hair, very beautiful limbs, faces like the full moon, full breasts, and waists slender like the middle of a sacrificial altar.

shloka_text: रथकूबरसङ्काशैः श्रोणिदेशैर्मनोहराः । स्त्रियः सुराङ्गनाप्रख्या निष्टप्तकनकप्रभाः ।। 7.24.8 ।।
transliteration: rathakūbarasaṅkāśaiḥ śroṇideśairmanoharāḥ | striyaḥ surāṅganāprakhyā niṣṭaptakanakaprabhāḥ || 7.24.8 ||
translation: रथकूबरसङ्काशैः with hips resembling the pole of a chariot, श्रोणिदेशैः with hip regions, मनोहराः charming, स्त्रियः women, सुराङ्गनाप्रख्याः resembling celestial nymphs, निष्टप्तकनकप्रभाः with the radiance of refined gold.
explanation: These charming women, resembling celestial nymphs, had hip regions broad like chariot poles and shone with the radiance of refined gold.

shloka_text: शोकदुःखभयत्रस्ता विह्वलाश्च सुमध्यमाः । तासां निश्वासवातेन सर्वतः सम्प्रदीपितम् ।। 7.24.9 ।।
transliteration: śokaduḥkhabhayatrastā vihvalāśca sumadhyamāḥ | tāsāṃ niśvāsavātena sarvataḥ sampradīpitam || 7.24.9 ||
translation: शोकदुःखभयत्रस्ताः distressed by sorrow, misery, and fear, विह्वलाः agitated, च and, सुमध्यमाः slender-waisted ones, तासाम् of them, निश्वासवातेन by the wind of their sighs, सर्वतः everywhere, सम्प्रदीपितम् was inflamed.
explanation: These slender-waisted women, distressed by sorrow, misery, and fear, were so agitated that the very atmosphere around them was inflamed by the wind of their sighs.

shloka_text: अग्निहोत्रमिवाभाति सन्निरुद्धाग्निपुष्पकम् । दशग्रीववशं प्राप्तास्तास्तु शोकाकुलाः स्त्रियः ।। 7.24.10 ।।
transliteration: agnihotramivābhāti sanniruddhāgnipuṣpakam | daśagrīvavaśaṃ prāptāstāstu śokākulāḥ striyaḥ || 7.24.10 ||
translation: अग्निहोत्रम् Agnihotra, इव like, आभाति appears, सन्निरुद्धाग्निपुष्पकम् with its fire and flowers restrained, दशग्रीववशम् the control of Daśagrīva, प्राप्ताः having attained, ताः those, तु indeed, शोकाकुलाः distressed with sorrow, स्त्रियः women.
explanation: Those women, having fallen under the sway of Daśagrīva, appeared like an Agnihotra ritual whose fire and flowers have been extinguished, overwhelmed by sorrow.

shloka_text: दीनवक्रेक्षणाः श्यामा मृग्यः सिंहवशा इव । काचिच्चिन्तयती तत्र किं नु मां भक्षयिष्यति ।। 7.24.11 ।।
transliteration: dīnavakrekṣaṇāḥ śyāmā mṛgyaḥ siṃhavaśā iva | kāciccintayatī tatra kiṃ nu māṃ bhakṣayiṣyati || 7.24.11 ||
translation: दीनवक्रेक्षणाः with sad, curved glances, श्यामाः young women, मृग्यः does, सिंहवशाः the control of a lion, इव like, काचित् some, चिन्तयती thinking, तत्र there, किम् what, नु indeed, माम् me, भक्षयिष्यति will he devour?
explanation: These young women, with their sad, curved glances, were like does under the control of a lion, and some among them wondered if he would devour them.

shloka_text: काचिद्दध्यौ सुदुःखार्ता अपि मां मारयेदयम् । इति मातृपितऽन्स्मृत्वा भर्तऽन्भ्रातऽंस्तथैव च । दुःखशोकसमाविष्टा विलेपुः सहिताः स्त्रियः ।। 7.24.12 ।।
transliteration: kāciddadhyau suduḥkhārtā api māṃ mārayedayam | iti mātṛpita'nsmṛtvā bharta'nbhrāta'ṃstathaiva ca | duḥkhaśokasamāviṣṭā vilepuḥ sahitāḥ striyaḥ || 7.24.12 ||
translation: काचित् some, दध्यौ thought, सुदुःखार्ता greatly distressed by sorrow, अपि perhaps, माम् me, मारयेत् might kill, अयम् this one, इति thus, मातृपितॄन् mothers and fathers, स्मृत्वा remembering, भर्तॄन् husbands, भ्रातॄन् brothers, तथैव च and similarly, दुःखशोकसमाविष्टाः overcome by pain and sorrow, विलेपुः lamented, सहिताः together, स्त्रियः women.
explanation: Some, greatly distressed, wondered if Rāvaṇa would kill them, and thus, remembering their mothers, fathers, husbands, and brothers, all the women together lamented, overcome by pain and sorrow.

shloka_text: कथं नु खलु मे पुत्रो भविष्यति मया विना । कथं माता कथं भ्राता निमग्नाः शोकसागरे ।। 7.24.13 ।। ।
transliteration: kathaṃ nu khalu me putro bhaviṣyati mayā vinā | kathaṃ mātā kathaṃ bhrātā nimagnāḥ śokasāgare || 7.24.13 || |
translation: कथम् how, नु indeed, खलु certainly, मे my, पुत्रः son, भविष्यति will be, मया without me, विना without, कथम् how, माता mother, कथम् how, भ्राता brother, निमग्नाः immersed, शोकसागरे in the ocean of sorrow.
explanation: They lamented, "How will my son fare without me? How will my mother and brother, immersed in an ocean of sorrow, endure?"

shloka_text: हा कथं नु करिष्यामि भर्तुस्तस्मादहं विना । मृत्यो प्रसादयामि त्वां नय मां दुःखभागिनीम् ।। 7.24.14 ।।
transliteration: hā kathaṃ nu kariṣyāmi bhartustasmādahaṃ vinā | mṛtyo prasādayāmi tvāṃ naya māṃ duḥkhabhāginīm || 7.24.14 ||
translation: हा alas, कथम् how, नु indeed, करिष्यामि shall I do/live, भर्तुः husband, तस्मात् from that, अहम् I, विना without, मृत्यो O Death, प्रसादयामि I propitiate, त्वाम् you, नय take, माम् me, दुःखभागिनीम् the one sharing sorrow.
explanation: "Alas, how shall I live without that husband? O Death, I implore you, take me, who am burdened with such sorrow."

shloka_text: किन्नु तद्दुष्कृतं कर्म पुरा देहान्तरे कृतम् ।। 7.24.15 ।।
transliteration: kinnu tadduṣkṛtaṃ karma purā dehāntare kṛtam || 7.24.15 ||
translation: किन्नु what indeed, तत् that, दुष्कृतं evil, कर्म deed, पुरा previously, देहान्तरे in another body, कृतम् done,
explanation: What evil deed did we indeed commit in a previous life?

shloka_text: एवं स्म दुःखिताः सर्वाः पतिताः शोकसागरे । न खल्विदानीं पश्यामो दुःखस्यास्यान्तमात्मनः ।। 7.24.16 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ sma duḥkhitāḥ sarvāḥ patitāḥ śokasāgare | na khalvidānīṃ paśyāmo duḥkhasyāsyāntamātmanaḥ || 7.24.16 ||
translation: एवं thus, स्म indeed, दुःखिताः distressed, सर्वाः all, पतिताः fallen, शोकसागरे into the ocean of sorrow, न not, खलु indeed, इदानीं now, पश्यामो we see, दुःखस्य of sorrow, अस्य this, अन्तम् end, आत्मनः of ourselves,
explanation: Thus, all of us are distressed and fallen into an ocean of sorrow, and we indeed see no end to this suffering of ours now.

shloka_text: अहो धिङ्मानुषं लोकं नास्ति खल्वधमः परः । यद्दुर्बला बलवता भर्तारो रावणेन नः ।। 7.24.17 ।।
transliteration: aho dhiṅmānuṣaṃ lokaṃ nāsti khalvadhamaḥ paraḥ | yaddurbalā balavatā bhartāro rāvaṇena naḥ || 7.24.17 ||
translation: अहो alas, धिङ् shame upon, मानुषं human, लोकं world, न not, अस्ति there is, खलु indeed, अधमः lower, परः than, यत् that, दुर्बला weak, बलवता by the strong, भर्तारो husbands, रावणेन by Ravana, नः our,
explanation: Alas, shame upon the human race, for there is indeed nothing lower than this, that our husbands are weak before the mighty Ravana.

shloka_text: सूर्येणोदयता काले नक्षत्राणीव नाशिताः । अहो सुबलवद्रक्षो वधोपायेषु युज्यते ।। 7.24.18 ।।
transliteration: sūryeṇodayatā kāle nakṣatrāṇīva nāśitāḥ | aho subalavadrakṣo vadhopāyeṣu yujyate || 7.24.18 ||
translation: सूर्येण by the sun, उदयता rising, काले at the time, नक्षत्राणीव as if stars, नाशिताः destroyed, अहो alas, सुबलवत् very strong, रक्षो demon, वधोपायेषु in means of killing, युज्यते is engaged,
explanation: Just as stars are destroyed by the rising sun, so too are our husbands, and alas, the very strong demon Ravana is engaged in means of killing.

shloka_text: अहो दुर्वृत्तमास्थाय नात्मानं वैजुगुप्सते । सर्वथा सदृशस्तावद्विक्रमो ऽस्य दुरात्मनः ।। 7.24.19 ।।
transliteration: aho durvṛttamāsthāya nātmānaṃ vaijugupsate | sarvathā sadṛśastāvadvikramo 'sya durātmanaḥ || 7.24.19 ||
translation: अहो alas, दुर्वृत्तम् evil conduct, आस्थाय having resorted to, न not, आत्मानं himself, वै indeed, जुगुप्सते he despises, सर्वथा in every way, सदृशः fitting, तावत् indeed, विक्रमः valor, अस्य his, दुरात्मनः of the wicked one,
explanation: Alas, having resorted to evil conduct, he indeed does not despise himself, and in every way, the valor of this wicked one is indeed fitting.

shloka_text: इदं त्वसदृशं कर्म परदाराभिमर्शनम् । यस्मादेष परक्यासु रमते राक्षसाधमः ।। 7.24.20 ।।
transliteration: idaṃ tvasadṛśaṃ karma paradārābhimarśanam | yasmādeṣa parakyāsu ramate rākṣasādhamaḥ || 7.24.20 ||
translation: इदं this, तु indeed, असदृशं unseemly, कर्म act, परदाराभिमर्शनम् molesting other's wives, यस्मात् because, एष this (one), परक्यासु in other's wives, रमते delights, राक्षसाधमः vilest of Rākṣasas,
explanation: This act of molesting other men's wives is indeed unseemly, because this vilest of Rākṣasas delights in other women.

shloka_text: तस्माद्वै स्त्रीकृतेनैव प्राप्स्यते दुर्मतिर्वधम् । सतीभिर्वरनारीभिरेवं वाक्ये ऽभ्युदीरिते ।। 7.24.21 ।।
transliteration: tasmādvai strīkṛtenaiva prāpsyate durmatirvadham | satībhirvaranārībhirevaṃ vākye 'bhyudīrite || 7.24.21 ||
translation: तस्मात् therefore, वै indeed, स्त्रीकृतेन by a woman, एव only, प्राप्स्यते will obtain, दुर्मतिः the evil-minded one, वधम् death, सतीभिः by chaste women, वरनारीभिः by excellent women, एवं thus, वाक्ये when the words, अभ्युदीरिते were uttered,
