explanation: Therefore, this evil-minded one will indeed meet his death only on account of a woman, thus spoke the chaste and excellent women.

shloka_text: नेदुर्दुन्दुभयः खस्थाः पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात च । शप्तः स्त्रीभिः स तु समं हतौजा इव निष्प्रभः ।। 7.24.22 ।।
transliteration: nedurdundubhayaḥ khasthāḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca | śaptaḥ strībhiḥ sa tu samaṃ hataujā iva niṣprabhaḥ || 7.24.22 ||
translation: नेदुः resounded, दुन्दुभयः drums, खस्थाः celestial, पुष्पवृष्टिः shower of flowers, पपात fell, च and, शप्तः cursed, स्त्रीभिः by the women, सः he, तु indeed, समं at the same time, हतौजाः one whose vigor is lost, इव as if, निष्प्रभः lusterless,
explanation: Celestial drums resounded and a shower of flowers fell, and he, cursed by the women, became lusterless as if his vigor was lost.

shloka_text: पतिव्रताभिः साध्वीभिर्बभूव विमना इव । एवं विलपितं तासां शृण्वन्राक्षसपुङ्गवः । प्रविवेश पुरीं लङ्कां पूज्यमानो निशाचरैः ।। 7.24.23 ।।
transliteration: pativratābhiḥ sādhvībhirbabhūva vimanā iva | evaṃ vilapitaṃ tāsāṃ śṛṇvanrākṣasapuṅgavaḥ | praviveśa purīṃ laṅkāṃ pūjyamāno niśācaraiḥ || 7.24.23 ||
translation: पतिव्रताभिः by chaste wives, साध्वीभिः by virtuous women, बभूव became, विमनाः disheartened, इव as if, एवं thus, विलपितं lamentation, तासां of those (women), शृण्वन् listening, राक्षसपुङ्गवः the foremost of Rākṣasas, प्रविवेश entered, पुरीं the city, लङ्कां Lanka, पूज्यमानः being honored, निशाचरैः by the night-wanderers,
explanation: He became as if disheartened by the chaste and virtuous women; listening to their lamentation, the foremost of Rākṣasas entered the city of Lanka, being honored by the night-wanderers.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे घोरा राक्षसी कामरूपिणी । सहसा पतिता भूमौ भगिनी रावणस्य सा ।। 7.24.24 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare ghorā rākṣasī kāmarūpiṇī | sahasā patitā bhūmau bhaginī rāvaṇasya sā || 7.24.24 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, घोरा terrible, राक्षसी Rākṣasī, कामरूपिणी assuming any form at will, सहसा suddenly, पतिता fell, भूमौ on the ground, भगिनी sister, रावणस्य of Rāvaṇa, सा she,
explanation: In the meantime, that terrible Rākṣasī, Rāvaṇa's sister, who could assume any form at will, suddenly fell on the ground.

shloka_text: तां स्वसारं समुत्थाप्य रावणः परिसान्त्वयन् । अब्रवीत्किमिदं भद्रे वक्तुकामा ऽसि मे द्रुतम् ।। 7.24.25 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ svasāraṃ samutthāpya rāvaṇaḥ parisāntvayan | abravītkimidaṃ bhadre vaktukāmā 'si me drutam || 7.24.25 ||
translation: तां her, स्वसारं sister, समुत्थाप्य having raised up, रावणः Ravana, परिसान्त्वयन् consoling, अब्रवीत् said, किम् what, इदं this, भद्रे O gentle one, वक्तुकामा desirous of speaking, असि you are, मे to me, द्रुतम् quickly,
explanation: Ravana, having raised his sister up and consoled her, asked her what she quickly wished to tell him.

shloka_text: सा बाष्पपरिरुद्धाक्षी रक्ताक्षी वाक्यमब्रवीत् । कृता ऽस्मि विधवा राजंस्त्वया बलवता बलात् ।। 7.24.26 ।।
transliteration: sā bāṣpapariruddhākṣī raktākṣī vākyamabravīt | kṛtā 'smi vidhavā rājaṃstvayā balavatā balāt || 7.24.26 ||
translation: सा she, बाष्पपरिरुद्धाक्षी with eyes obstructed by tears, रक्ताक्षी with red eyes, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, कृता made, अस्मि I am, विधवा a widow, राजन् O king, त्वया by you, बलवता powerful one, बलात् by force,
explanation: With her eyes red and obstructed by tears, she spoke, saying, "O king, I have been forcibly made a widow by you, the powerful one."

shloka_text: एते राजंस्त्वया वीरा दैत्या विनिहता रणे । कालकेया इति ख्याताः सहस्राणि चतुर्दश ।। 7.24.27 ।।
transliteration: ete rājaṃstvayā vīrā daityā vinihatā raṇe | kālakeyā iti khyātāḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa || 7.24.27 ||
translation: एते these, राजन् O king, त्वया by you, वीराः brave ones, दैत्याः Daityas, विनिहताः killed, रणे in battle, कालकेयाः Kalakeyas, इति thus, ख्याताः known, सहस्राणि thousands, चतुर्दश fourteen,
explanation: O king, these brave Daityas, known as the fourteen thousand Kalakeyas, were killed by you in battle.

shloka_text: प्राणेभ्यो ऽपि गरीयान्मे तत्र भर्ता महाबलः ।। 7.24.28 ।।
transliteration: prāṇebhyo 'pi garīyānme tatra bhartā mahābalaḥ || 7.24.28 ||
translation: प्राणेभ्यः than life, अपि even, गरीयान् dearer, मे to me, तत्र there, भर्ता husband, महाबलः mighty-armed,
explanation: Among them was my mighty-armed husband, who was dearer to me even than my own life.

shloka_text: सो ऽपि त्वया हतस्तात रिपुणा भ्रातृगृध्नुना । त्वया ऽस्मि निहता राजन्स्वयमेव हि बन्धुना ।। 7.24.29 ।।
transliteration: so 'pi tvayā hatastāta ripuṇā bhrātṛgṛdhnunā | tvayā 'smi nihatā rājansvayameva hi bandhunā || 7.24.29 ||
translation: सः he, अपि even, त्वया by you, हतः killed, तात O dear one, रिपुणा by an enemy, भ्रातृगृध्नुना hostile to kinsmen, त्वया by you, अस्मि I am, निहता killed, राजन् O king, स्वयम् myself, एव indeed, हि certainly, बन्धुना by a kinsman,
explanation: O dear one, even he was killed by you, an enemy hostile to your own kin; O king, I myself have certainly been destroyed by you, my own kinsman.

shloka_text: राजन्वैधव्यशब्दं च भोक्ष्यामि त्वत्कृते ह्यहम् । ननु नाम त्वया रक्ष्यो जामाता समरेष्वपि । स त्वया निहतो युद्धे स्वयमेव न लज्जसे ।। 7.24.30 ।।
transliteration: rājanvaidhavyaśabdaṃ ca bhokṣyāmi tvatkṛte hyaham | nanu nāma tvayā rakṣyo jāmātā samareṣvapi | sa tvayā nihato yuddhe svayameva na lajjase || 7.24.30 ||
translation: राजन् Rajan (O King), वैधव्यशब्दं vaidhavyaśabdaṃ (the word 'widowhood'), च ca (and), भोक्ष्यामि bhokṣyāmi (I shall experience), त्वत्कृते tvatkṛte (because of you), हि hi (indeed), अहम् aham (I); ननु nanu (surely), नाम nāma (indeed), त्वया tvayā (by you), रक्ष्यो rakṣyo (to be protected), जामाता jāmātā (a son-in-law), समरेष्वपि samareṣvapi (even in battles); स sa (he), त्वया tvayā (by you), निहतो nihato (was killed), युद्धे yuddhe (in battle), स्वयमेव svayameva (by yourself), न na (not), लज्जसे lajjase (are you ashamed).
explanation: The speaker laments that she will become a widow because of the king's actions, questioning how he could kill his own son-in-law in battle, whom he was supposed to protect, without any shame.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवो भगिन्या क्रोशमानया । अब्रवीत्सान्त्वयित्वा तां सामपूर्वमिदं वचः ।। 7.24.31 ।।
transliteration: evamukto daśagrīvo bhaginyā krośamānayā | abravītsāntvayitvā tāṃ sāmapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ || 7.24.31 ||
translation: एवम् evam (thus), उक्तो ukto (addressed), दशग्रीवो daśagrīvo (Dashagriva, Ravana), भगिन्या bhaginyā (by his sister), क्रोशमानया krośamānayā (who was wailing), अब्रवीत् abravīt (spoke), सान्त्वयित्वा sāntvayitvā (having consoled), तां tāṃ (her), सामपूर्वम् sāmapūrvam (with soothing words), इदं idaṃ (this), वचः vacaḥ (speech).
explanation: Thus addressed by his wailing sister, Ravana consoled her and spoke these soothing words.

shloka_text: अलं वत्से रुदित्वा ते न भेतव्यं च सर्वशः । दानमानप्रसादैस्त्वां तोषयिष्यामि यत्नतः ।। 7.24.32 ।।
transliteration: alaṃ vatse ruditvā te na bhetavyaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ | dānamānaprasādaistvāṃ toṣayiṣyāmi yatnataḥ || 7.24.32 ||
translation: अलम् alam (enough), वत्से vatse (O child), रुदित्वा ruditvā (by weeping), ते te (for you); न na (not), भेतव्यं bhetavyaṃ (to be feared), च ca (and), सर्वशः sarvaśaḥ (in any way); दानमानप्रसादैः dānamānaprasādaiḥ (with gifts, honors, and favors), त्वां tvāṃ (you), तोषयिष्यामि toṣayiṣyāmi (I shall satisfy), यत्नतः yatnataḥ (with effort).
explanation: Ravana told her to stop weeping and not to fear, promising to satisfy her with great effort through gifts, honors, and favors.

shloka_text: युद्धप्रमत्तो व्याक्षिप्तो जयाकाङ्क्षी क्षिपञ्छरान् । नावगच्छामि युद्धेषु स्वान्परान्वाप्यहं शुभे ।। 7.24.33 ।।
transliteration: yuddhapramatto vyākṣipto jayākāṅkṣī kṣipañcharān | nāvagacchāmi yuddheṣu svānparānvāpyahaṃ śubhe || 7.24.33 ||
translation: युद्धप्रमत्तो yuddhapramatto (intoxicated by battle), व्याक्षिप्तो vyākṣipto (distracted), जयाकाङ्क्षी jayākāṅkṣī (desiring victory), क्षिपञ्छरान् kṣipañcharān (hurling arrows), न na (not), अवगच्छामि avagacchāmi (I distinguish), युद्धेषु yuddheṣu (in battles), स्वान् svān (my own people), परान् parānvā (or enemies), अपि api (even), अहं ahaṃ (I), शुभे śubhe (O auspicious one).
explanation: Ravana explained that in the heat of battle, intoxicated and distracted by the desire for victory while showering arrows, he cannot distinguish between his own people and enemies.

shloka_text: जामातरं न जाने स्म प्रहरन्युद्धदुर्मदः । तेनासौ निहतः सङ्ख्ये मया भर्ता तव स्वसः ।। 7.24.34 ।।
transliteration: jāmātaraṃ na jāne sma praharanyuddhadurmadaḥ | tenāsau nihataḥ saṅkhye mayā bhartā tava svasaḥ || 7.24.34 ||
translation: जामातरं jāmātaraṃ (the son-in-law), न na (not), जाने jāne (I knew), स्म sma (indeed), प्रहरन् praharan (while striking), युद्धदुर्मदः yuddhadurmadaḥ (intoxicated by the frenzy of battle); तेन tena (therefore), असौ asau (he), निहतः nihataḥ (was killed), सङ्ख्ये saṅkhye (in battle), मया mayā (by me), भर्ता bhartā (the husband), तव tava (your), स्वसः svasaḥ (O sister).
explanation: Ravana confessed that, maddened by the battle, he did not recognize his son-in-law while striking and thus inadvertently killed her husband in the conflict.

shloka_text: अस्मिन्काले तु यत्प्राप्तं तत्करिष्यामि ते हितम् । भ्रातुरैश्वर्ययुक्तस्य खरस्य वस पार्श्वतः ।। 7.24.35 ।।
transliteration: asminkāle tu yatprāptaṃ tatkariṣyāmi te hitam | bhrāturaiśvaryayuktasya kharasya vasa pārśvataḥ || 7.24.35 ||
translation: अस्मिन्काले in this time, तु indeed, यत्प्राप्तं whatever is appropriate, तत्करिष्यामि that I will do, ते for you, हितम् beneficial. भ्रातुः of the brother, ऐश्वर्ययुक्तस्य endowed with power, खरस्य of Khara, वस dwell, पार्श्वतः by the side.
explanation: At this time, I will do what is beneficial for you; dwell by the side of your brother Khara, who is endowed with power.

shloka_text: चतुर्दशानां भ्राता ते सहस्राणां भविष्यति । प्रभुः प्रयाणे दाने च राक्षसानां महाबलः ।। 7.24.36 ।।
transliteration: caturdaśānāṃ bhrātā te sahasrāṇāṃ bhaviṣyati | prabhuḥ prayāṇe dāne ca rākṣasānāṃ mahābalaḥ || 7.24.36 ||
translation: चतुर्दशानां of fourteen, सहस्राणां of thousands, ते your, भ्राता brother, भविष्यति will be. प्रभुः the lord, प्रयाणे in marching, दाने in giving, च and, राक्षसानां of rakshasas, महाबलः very powerful.
explanation: Your brother will be the lord of fourteen thousand very powerful Rakshasas, commanding them in expeditions and bestowing gifts.

shloka_text: तत्र मातृष्वसेयस्ते भ्राता ऽयं वै खरः प्रभुः । भविष्यति तवादेशं सदा कुर्वन्निशाचरः ।। 7.24.37 ।।
transliteration: tatra mātṛṣvaseyaste bhrātā 'yaṃ vai kharaḥ prabhuḥ | bhaviṣyati tavādeśaṃ sadā kurvanniśācaraḥ || 7.24.37 ||
translation: तत्र there, ते your, मातृष्वसेयः cousin (son of mother's sister), अयं this, वै indeed, भ्राता brother, खरः Khara, प्रभुः the lord, भविष्यति will be, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, सदा always, तवादेशं your command, कुर्वन् executing.
explanation: There, your cousin and brother Khara, the lordly night-wanderer, will always execute your commands.

shloka_text: शीघ्रं गच्छत्वयं वीरो दण्डकान्परिरक्षितुम् । दूषणो ऽस्य बलाध्यक्षो भविष्यति महाबलः ।। 7.24.38 ।।
transliteration: śīghraṃ gacchatvayaṃ vīro daṇḍakānparirakṣitum | dūṣaṇo 'sya balādhyakṣo bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ || 7.24.38 ||
translation: शीघ्रं quickly, अयं this, वीरः hero, दण्डकान् to the Dandaka forest, परिरक्षितुम् to protect, गच्छतु let him go. दूषणः Dushana, अस्य his, बलाध्यक्षः commander of forces, भविष्यति will be, महाबलः very powerful.
explanation: Let this hero quickly go to protect the Dandaka forest, and the very powerful Dushana will be his commander of forces.

shloka_text: तत्र ते वचनं शूरः करिष्यति सदा खरः । रक्षसां कामरूपाणां प्रभुरेष भविष्यति ।। 7.24.39 ।।
transliteration: tatra te vacanaṃ śūraḥ kariṣyati sadā kharaḥ | rakṣasāṃ kāmarūpāṇāṃ prabhureṣa bhaviṣyati || 7.24.39 ||
translation: तत्र there, शूरः the brave, खरः Khara, ते your, वचनं command, सदा always, करिष्यति will execute. एषः this one, कामरूपाणां who can change form at will, रक्षसां of rakshasas, प्रभुः the lord, भविष्यति will be.
explanation: There, the brave Khara will always execute your commands, and he will be the lord of the Rakshasas who can change their form at will.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा दशग्रीवः सैन्यमस्यादिदेश ह । चतुर्दश सहस्राणि रक्षसां वीर्यशालिनाम् ।। 7.24.40 ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā daśagrīvaḥ sainyamasyādideśa ha | caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasāṃ vīryaśālinām || 7.24.40 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), सैन्यम् army, अस्य to him (Khara), आदिदेश ordered, ह indeed, चतुर्दश fourteen, सहस्राणि thousands, रक्षसाम् of Rakshasas, वीर्यशालिनाम् valorous.
explanation: Having spoken thus, Dashagriva (Ravana) indeed ordered an army of fourteen thousand valorous Rakshasas for Khara.

shloka_text: स तैः परिवृतस्सर्वै राक्षसैर्घोरदर्शनैः । आगच्छत खरः शीघ्रं दण्डकानकुतोभयः ।। 7.24.41 ।।
transliteration: sa taiḥ parivṛtassarvai rākṣasairghoradarśanaiḥ | āgacchata kharaḥ śīghraṃ daṇḍakānakutobhayaḥ || 7.24.41 ||
translation: सः he (Khara), तैः by them, परिवृतः surrounded, सर्वैः all, राक्षसैः by Rakshasas, घोरदर्शनैः of terrible appearance, आगच्छत came, खरः Khara, शीघ्रम् quickly, दण्डकान् to Dandaka forest, अकुतोभयः fearless.
explanation: Surrounded by all those Rakshasas of terrible appearance, Khara quickly and fearlessly came to the Dandaka forest.

shloka_text: स तत्र कारयामास राज्यं निहतकण्टकम् । सा च शूर्पणखा तत्र न्यवसद्दण्डकावने ।। 7.24.42 ।।
transliteration: sa tatra kārayāmāsa rājyaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam | sā ca śūrpaṇakhā tatra nyavasaddaṇḍakāvane || 7.24.42 ||
translation: सः he (Khara), तत्र there, कारयामास established, राज्यम् kingdom, निहतकण्टकम् free from enemies, सा she, च and, शूर्पणखा Shurpanakha, तत्र there, न्यवसत् resided, दण्डकावने in the Dandaka forest.
explanation: Khara established a kingdom free from enemies there, and Shurpanakha also resided in the Dandaka forest. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुर्विंशः सर्गः ।। 24 ।। Thus ends the twenty-fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: स तु दत्त्वा दशग्रीवो वनं घोरं स्वरस्य तत् । भगिनीं च समाश्वास्य हृष्टः स्वस्थतरो ऽभवत् ।। 7.25.1 ।।
transliteration: sa tu dattvā daśagrīvo vanaṃ ghoraṃ svarasya tat | bhaginīṃ ca samāśvāsya hṛṣṭaḥ svasthataro 'bhavat || 7.25.1 ||
translation: सः he, तु indeed, दत्त्वा having given, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), वनम् forest, घोरम् terrible, खरस्य to Khara, तत् that, भगिनीम् sister, च and, समाश्वास्य having consoled, हृष्टः delighted, स्वस्थतरः more at ease, अभवत् became.
explanation: Having given that terrible forest to Khara and having consoled his sister, Dashagriva became delighted and more at ease.
comments: At Lanka Ravana finds his son Meghanada (Indrajit) completing seven great sacrifices, having won from Shiva a sky-faring chariot, the illusion Tamasi, and inexhaustible weapons -- Vibhishana reveals that the demon Madhu has meanwhile carried off their kinswoman Kumbhinasi -- Ravana marches on Madhupura, but Kumbhinasi, now Madhu's wife, begs him to spare her husband, and Madhu joins his campaign as they encamp at Kailasa.

shloka_text: ततो निकुम्भिला नाम लङ्कोपवनमुत्तमम् । तद्राक्षसेन्द्रो बलवान्प्रविवेश सहानुगः ।। 7.25.2 ।।
transliteration: tato nikumbhilā nāma laṅkopavanamuttamam | tadrākṣasendro balavānpraviveśa sahānugaḥ || 7.25.2 ||
translation: ततः then, निकुम्भिला Nikumbhila, नाम named, लङ्का of Lanka, उपवनम् pleasure grove, उत्तमम् excellent, तत् that, राक्षसेन्द्रः king of Rakshasas (Ravana), बलवान् powerful, प्रविवेश entered, सह with, अनुगः followers.
explanation: Then, the powerful king of Rakshasas, Ravana, entered that excellent pleasure grove of Lanka named Nikumbhila, along with his followers.

shloka_text: ततो यूपशताकीर्णं सौम्यचैत्योपशोभितम् । ददर्श विष्ठितं यज्ञं श्रिया सम्प्रज्वलन्निव ।। 7.25.3 ।।
transliteration: tato yūpaśatākīrṇaṃ saumyacaityopaśobhitam | dadarśa viṣṭhitaṃ yajñaṃ śriyā samprajvalanniva || 7.25.3 ||
translation: ततः then, यूपशताकीर्णम् filled with hundreds of sacrificial posts, सौम्यचैत्योपशोभितम् adorned with auspicious altars, ददर्श he saw, विष्ठितम् established, यज्ञम् the sacrifice, श्रिया with splendor, सम्प्रज्वलन्निव as if blazing forth.
explanation: Then, he saw the established sacrifice, which was filled with hundreds of sacrificial posts and adorned with auspicious altars, appearing as if it was blazing forth with splendor.

shloka_text: ततः कृष्णाजिनधरं कमण्डलुशिखाध्वजम् । ददर्श स्वसुतं तत्र मेघनादं भयावहम् ।। 7.25.4 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kṛṣṇājinadharaṃ kamaṇḍaluśikhādhvajam | dadarśa svasutaṃ tatra meghanādaṃ bhayāvaham || 7.25.4 ||
translation: ततः then, कृष्णाजिनधरम् wearing a black deer skin, कमण्डलुशिखाध्वजम् with a water-pot and a top-knot as his emblem, ददर्श he saw, स्वसुतम् his own son, तत्र there, मेघनादम् Meghanada, भयावहम् formidable.
explanation: Then, he saw his own formidable son, Meghanada, there, wearing a black deer skin and distinguished by his water-pot and top-knot.

shloka_text: तं समासाद्य लङ्केशः परिष्वज्वाथ बाहुभिः । अब्रवीत्किमिदं वत्स वर्तसे ब्रूहि तत्त्वतः ।। 7.25.5 ।।
transliteration: taṃ samāsādya laṅkeśaḥ pariṣvajvātha bāhubhiḥ | abravītkimidaṃ vatsa vartase brūhi tattvataḥ || 7.25.5 ||
translation: तम् him, समासाद्य having approached, लङ्केशः the lord of Lanka, परिष्वज्वाथ and having embraced, बाहुभिः with his arms, अब्रवीत् he said, किमिदम् what is this, वत्स my son, वर्तसे you are doing, ब्रूहि tell me, तत्त्वतः truly.
explanation: Having approached and embraced him with his arms, Ravana, the lord of Lanka, asked, "My son, what is this you are doing? Tell me the truth."

shloka_text: उशना त्वब्रवीत्तत्र यज्ञसम्पत्समृद्धये । रावणं राक्षसश्रेष्ठं द्विजश्रेष्ठो महातपाः ।। 7.25.6 ।।
transliteration: uśanā tvabravīttatra yajñasampatsamṛddhaye | rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasaśreṣṭhaṃ dvijaśreṣṭho mahātapāḥ || 7.25.6 ||
translation: उशना Ushana, तु indeed, अब्रवीत् he said, तत्र there, यज्ञसम्पत्समृद्धये for the prosperity of the sacrificial wealth, रावणम् to Ravana, राक्षसश्रेष्ठम् the best of Rakshasas, द्विजश्रेष्ठः the best of Brahmins, महातपाः of great penance.
explanation: There, Ushana, the best of Brahmins and of great penance, spoke to Ravana, the best of Rakshasas, regarding the successful completion of the sacrifice.

shloka_text: अहमाख्यामि ते राजञ्छ्रूयतां सर्वमेव तत् । यज्ञास्ते सप्त पुत्रेण प्राप्तास्सुबहुविस्तराः ।। 7.25.7 ।।
transliteration: ahamākhyāmi te rājañchrūyatāṃ sarvameva tat | yajñāste sapta putreṇa prāptāssubahuvistarāḥ || 7.25.7 ||
translation: अहम् I, आख्यामि will tell, ते to you, राजन् O King, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, सर्वम् all, एव indeed, तत् that, यज्ञाः sacrifices, ते your, सप्त seven, पुत्रेण by your son, प्राप्ताः attained, सुबहुविस्तराः very extensive.
explanation: Ushana then said, "O King, I will tell you all about it; listen, for your son has completed seven very extensive sacrifices."

shloka_text: अग्निष्टोमो ऽश्वमेधश्च यज्ञो बहुसुवर्णकः । राजसूयस्तथा यज्ञो गोमेधो वैष्ववस्तथा ।। 7.25.8 ।।
transliteration: agniṣṭomo 'śvamedhaśca yajño bahusuvarṇakaḥ | rājasūyastathā yajño gomedho vaiṣvavastathā || 7.25.8 ||
translation: अग्निष्टोमः Agnishtoma, अश्वमेधः Ashwamedha, च and, यज्ञः sacrifice, बहुसुवर्णकः Bahusuvarnaka, राजसूयः Rajasuya, तथा and also, यज्ञः sacrifice, गोमेधः Gomedha, वैष्ववः Vaishvava, तथा and also.
explanation: The Agnishtoma, Ashwamedha, Bahusuvarnaka, Rajasuya, Gomedha, and Vaishvava are all types of sacrifices.

shloka_text: माहेश्वरे प्रवृत्ते तु यज्ञे पुम्भिः सुदुर्लभे । वरांस्ते लब्धवान्पुत्रः साक्षात्पशुपतेरिह ।। 7.25.9 ।।
transliteration: māheśvare pravṛtte tu yajñe pumbhiḥ sudurlabhe | varāṃste labdhavānputraḥ sākṣātpaśupateriha || 7.25.9 ||
translation: माहेश्वरे in the Maheswara, प्रवृत्ते when commenced, तु indeed, यज्ञे sacrifice, पुम्भिः by men, सुदुर्लभे very difficult to perform, वरान् boons, ते your, लब्धवान् obtained, पुत्रः son, साक्षात् directly, पशुपतेः from Pashupati, इह here.
explanation: When the Maheswara sacrifice, which is very difficult for men to perform, was commenced, your son directly obtained boons from Pashupati (Lord Shiva) here.

shloka_text: कामगं स्यन्दनं दिव्यमन्तरिक्षचरं ध्रुवम् । मायां च तामसीं नाम यया सम्पद्यते तमः ।। 7.25.10 ।।
transliteration: kāmagaṃ syandanaṃ divyamantarikṣacaraṃ dhruvam | māyāṃ ca tāmasīṃ nāma yayā sampadyate tamaḥ || 7.25.10 ||
translation: कामगम् moving at will, स्यन्दनम् a chariot, दिव्यम् divine, अन्तरिक्षचरम् moving in the sky, ध्रुवम् firm, मायाम् illusion, च and, तामसीम् Tamasi, नाम named, यया by which, सम्पद्यते is produced, तमः darkness.
explanation: He obtained a divine chariot that moves at will, travels in the sky, and is firm, and also an illusion named Tamasi, by which darkness is produced.

shloka_text: एतया किल सङ्ग्रामे मायया राक्षसेश्वर । प्रयुक्तया गतिः शक्या नहि ज्ञातुं सुरासुरैः ।। 7.25.11 ।।
transliteration: etayā kila saṅgrāme māyayā rākṣaseśvara | prayuktayā gatiḥ śakyā nahi jñātuṃ surāsuraiḥ || 7.25.11 ||
translation: एतया by this, किल indeed, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, मायया by illusion, राक्षसेश्वर O Lord of Rakshasas, प्रयुक्तया when employed, गतिः movement, शक्या possible, न not, हि indeed, ज्ञातुम् to know, सुरासुरैः by gods and asuras.
explanation: O Lord of Rakshasas, it is said that when this illusion is employed in battle, its movement cannot indeed be ascertained by even gods and asuras.

shloka_text: अक्षयाविषुधी बाणैश्चापं चापि सुदुर्जयम् । अस्त्रं च बलवद्राजञ्छत्रुविध्वंसनं रणे ।। 7.25.12 ।।
transliteration: akṣayāviṣudhī bāṇaiścāpaṃ cāpi sudurjayam | astraṃ ca balavadrājañchatruvidhvaṃsanaṃ raṇe || 7.25.12 ||
translation: अक्षयाविषुधी two inexhaustible quivers, बाणैः with arrows, चापम् a bow, च and, अपि also, सुदुर्जयम् very difficult to conquer, अस्त्रम् a weapon, च and, बलवत् powerful, राजन् O King, शत्रुविध्वंसनम् destroyer of enemies, रणे in battle.
explanation: O King, he also obtained two inexhaustible quivers with arrows, a bow that is very difficult to conquer, and a powerful weapon that destroys enemies in battle.

shloka_text: एतान्सर्वान्वरांल्लब्ध्वा पुत्रस्ते ऽयं दशानन । अद्य यज्ञसमाप्तौ च त्वां दिदृक्षुस्स्थितो ह्यहम् ।। 7.25.13 ।।
transliteration: etānsarvānvarāṃllabdhvā putraste 'yaṃ daśānana | adya yajñasamāptau ca tvāṃ didṛkṣussthito hyaham || 7.25.13 ||
translation: दशानन O Dashanana, एतान् सर्वान् all these, वरान् boons, लब्ध्वा having obtained, ते अयं पुत्रः this son of yours, अद्य today, यज्ञसमाप्तौ at the conclusion of the sacrifice, त्वां you, दिदृक्षुः desiring to see, स्थितः हि अहम् I indeed stand here.
explanation: Having obtained all these boons, O Dashanana, your son, now that the sacrifice is concluded, and I myself, stand here eager to behold you.

shloka_text: ततो ऽब्रवीदृशग्रीवो न शोभनमिदं कृतम् । पूजिताः शत्रवो यस्माद्द्रव्यैरिन्द्रपुरोगमाः ।। 7.25.14 ।।
transliteration: tato 'bravīdṛśagrīvo na śobhanamidaṃ kṛtam | pūjitāḥ śatravo yasmāddravyairindrapurogamāḥ || 7.25.14 ||
translation: ततः then, अब्रवीत् spoke, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, न not, शोभनम् good, इदम् this, कृतम् done, पूजिताः worshipped, शत्रवः enemies, यस्मात् because, द्रव्यैः with wealth, इन्द्रपुरोगमाः Indra and others.
explanation: Then Dashagriva spoke, saying that this was not good because the enemies, led by Indra, had been honored with wealth.

shloka_text: एहीदानीं कृतं विद्धि सुकृतं तन्न संशयः । आगच्छ सौम्य गच्छामः स्वमेव भवनं प्रति ।। 7.25.15 ।।
transliteration: ehīdānīṃ kṛtaṃ viddhi sukṛtaṃ tanna saṃśayaḥ | āgaccha saumya gacchāmaḥ svameva bhavanaṃ prati || 7.25.15 ||
translation: एहि come, इदानीम् now, कृतम् done, विद्धि know, सुकृतम् well-done, तत् that, न no, संशयः doubt, आगच्छ come, सौम्य O gentle one, गच्छामः let us go, स्वम् own, एव indeed, भवनम् house, प्रति towards.
explanation: Come now, know that what is done is well done, there is no doubt about it; come, O gentle one, let us go to our own abode.

shloka_text: ततो गत्वा दशग्रीवः सपुत्रः सविभीषणः । स्त्रियो ऽवतारयामास सर्वास्ता बाष्पगद्गदाः ।। 7.25.16 ।।
transliteration: tato gatvā daśagrīvaḥ saputraḥ savibhīṣaṇaḥ | striyo 'vatārayāmāsa sarvāstā bāṣpagadgadāḥ || 7.25.16 ||
translation: ततः then, गत्वा having gone, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, सपुत्रः with his sons, सविभीषणः with Vibhishana, स्त्रियः women, अवतारयामास made to descend, सर्वाः all, ताः those, बाष्पगद्गदाः choked with tears.
explanation: Then, having gone, Dashagriva, along with his sons and Vibhishana, brought down all those women who were choked with tears.

shloka_text: लक्षिण्यो रत्नभूताश्च देवदानवरक्षसाम् । तस्य तासु मतिं ज्ञात्वा धर्मत्मा वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। 7.25.17 ।।
transliteration: lakṣiṇyo ratnabhūtāśca devadānavarakṣasām | tasya tāsu matiṃ jñātvā dharmatmā vākyamabravīt || 7.25.17 ||
translation: लक्षिण्यः auspicious, रत्नभूताः jewel-like, च and, देवदानवरक्षसाम् of gods, Danavas, and Rakshasas, तस्य his, तासु in them, मतिम् intention, ज्ञात्वा having known, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Knowing his intention towards those auspicious, jewel-like women of gods, Danavas, and Rakshasas, the righteous one (Vibhishana) spoke these words.

shloka_text: ईदृशैस्त्वं समाचारैर्यशोर्थकुलनाशनैः । धर्षणं ज्ञातिनां ज्ञात्वा स्वमतेन विचेष्टसे ।। 7.25.18 ।।
transliteration: īdṛśaistvaṃ samācārairyaśorthakulanāśanaiḥ | dharṣaṇaṃ jñātināṃ jñātvā svamatena viceṣṭase || 7.25.18 ||
translation: ईदृशैः with such, त्वम् you, समाचारैः actions, यशः fame, अर्थ wealth, कुल family, नाशनैः destroying, धर्षणम् insult, ज्ञातिनाम् of relatives, ज्ञात्वा having known, स्वमतेन by your own will, विचेष्टसे you act.
explanation: You act by your own will with such conduct that destroys fame, wealth, and family, even though you know it is an outrage to your kinsmen.

shloka_text: ज्ञातींस्तान्धर्षयित्वेमास्त्वया ऽ ऽनीता वराङ्गनाः । त्वामतिक्रम्य मधुना राजन्कुम्भीनसी हृता ।। 7.25.19 ।।
transliteration: jñātīṃstāndharṣayitvemāstvayā ' 'nītā varāṅganāḥ | tvāmatikramya madhunā rājankumbhīnasī hṛtā || 7.25.19 ||
translation: ज्ञातीन् relatives, तान् those, धर्षयित्वा having humiliated, इमाः these, त्वया by you, आनीताः brought, वराङ्गनाः beautiful women, त्वाम् you, अतिक्रम्य having transgressed, मधुना by Madhu, राजन् O King, कुम्भीनसी Kumbhinasi, हृता abducted.
explanation: O King, while you brought these beautiful women after humiliating their kinsmen, Madhu has abducted Kumbhinasi, disregarding your authority.

shloka_text: रावणस्त्वब्रवीद्वाक्यं नावगच्छामि किं त्विदम् । को ऽयं यस्तु त्वया ऽ ऽख्यातो मधुरित्येव नामतः ।। 7.25.20 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇastvabravīdvākyaṃ nāvagacchāmi kiṃ tvidam | ko 'yaṃ yastu tvayā ' 'khyāto madhurityeva nāmataḥ || 7.25.20 ||
translation: रावणः Ravana, तु but, अब्रवीत् said, वाक्यम् a word, न not, अवगच्छामि I understand, किम् what, तु indeed, इदम् this, कः who, अयम् this, यः who, तु indeed, त्वया by you, आख्यातः mentioned, मधुः Madhu, इति thus, एव indeed, नामतः by name.
explanation: Ravana then spoke, saying, "I do not understand what this is; who is this person named Madhu whom you have mentioned?"

shloka_text: विभीषणस्तु सङ्क्रुद्धो भ्रातरं वाक्यमब्रवीत् । श्रूयतामस्य पापस्य कर्मणः फलमागतम् ।। 7.25.21 ।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇastu saṅkruddho bhrātaraṃ vākyamabravīt | śrūyatāmasya pāpasya karmaṇaḥ phalamāgatam || 7.25.21 ||
translation: विभीषणः Vibhishana, तु but, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, भ्रातरम् to his brother, वाक्यम् a word, अब्रवीत् said, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, अस्य of this, पापस्य sinful, कर्मणः deed, फलम् fruit, आगतम् arrived.
explanation: But Vibhishana, greatly enraged, spoke to his brother, saying, "Listen, the consequence of this sinful deed has arrived."

shloka_text: मातामहस्य यो भ्राता ज्येष्ठो भ्राता सुमालिनः । माल्यवानिति विख्यातो वृद्धः प्राज्ञो निशाचरः ।। 7.25.22 ।।
transliteration: mātāmahasya yo bhrātā jyeṣṭho bhrātā sumālinaḥ | mālyavāniti vikhyāto vṛddhaḥ prājño niśācaraḥ || 7.25.22 ||
translation: मातामहस्य of the maternal grandfather, यः who, भ्राता brother, ज्येष्ठः elder, भ्राता brother, सुमालिनः of Sumali, माल्यवान् Malyavan, इति thus, विख्यातः renowned, वृद्धः old, प्राज्ञः wise, निशाचरः night-wanderer.
explanation: Malyavan, the elder brother of Sumali, who is our maternal grandfather's brother, is a renowned, old, and wise Rakshasa.

shloka_text: पिता ज्येष्ठो जनन्या नो ह्यस्माकं चार्यको ऽभवत् । तस्य कुम्भीनसी नाम दुहितुर्दुहिता ऽभवत् ।। 7.25.23 ।।
transliteration: pitā jyeṣṭho jananyā no hyasmākaṃ cāryako 'bhavat | tasya kumbhīnasī nāma duhiturduhitā 'bhavat || 7.25.23 ||
translation: पिता father, ज्येष्ठः elder, जनन्याः of mother, नः our, हि indeed, अस्माकम् our, च and, आर्यकः maternal grandfather, अभवत् was, तस्य his, कुम्भीनसी Kumbhinasi, नाम named, दुहितुः of the daughter, दुहिता daughter, अभवत् was.
explanation: He was indeed the elder father of our mother, and thus our maternal grandfather, and his daughter's daughter was named Kumbhinasi.

shloka_text: मातृष्वसुरथास्माकं सा च कन्या ऽनलोद्भवा । भवत्यस्माकमेवैषा भ्रातृणां धर्मतः स्वसा ।। 7.25.24 ।।
transliteration: mātṛṣvasurathāsmākaṃ sā ca kanyā 'nalodbhavā | bhavatyasmākamevaiṣā bhrātṛṇāṃ dharmataḥ svasā || 7.25.24 ||
translation: मातृष्वसुः of our mother's sister, अथ and, अस्माकम् our, सा she, च and, कन्या daughter, अनलोद्भवा born of Anala, भवति becomes, अस्माकम् our, एव indeed, एषा this, भ्रातृणाम् of brothers, धर्मतः by dharma, स्वसा sister.
explanation: She, the daughter born of Anala, is our mother's sister's daughter, and thus by dharma, she is indeed our sister.

shloka_text: सा हृता, मधुना राजन्राक्षसेन बलीयसा । यज्ञप्रवृत्ते पुत्रे तु मयि चान्तर्जलोषिते ।। 7.25.25 ।।
transliteration: sā hṛtā, madhunā rājanrākṣasena balīyasā | yajñapravṛtte putre tu mayi cāntarjaloṣite || 7.25.25 ||
translation: सा She, हृता was abducted, मधुना by Madhu, राजन् O King, राक्षसेन by the demon, बलीयसा powerful, यज्ञप्रवृत्ते engaged in a sacrifice, पुत्रे when my son (was), तु but, मयि I (was), च and, अन्तर्जलोषिते dwelling inside water.
explanation: O King, she was abducted by the powerful demon Madhu while my son was engaged in a sacrifice and I was dwelling in penance underwater.

shloka_text: कुम्भकर्णे महाराज निद्रामनुभवत्यथ । निहत्य राक्षसश्रेष्ठानमात्यानिह सम्मतान् ।। 7.25.26 ।।
transliteration: kumbhakarṇe mahārāja nidrāmanubhavatyatha | nihatya rākṣasaśreṣṭhānamātyāniha sammatān || 7.25.26 ||
translation: कुम्भकर्णे when Kumbhakarna (was), महाराज O great king, निद्राम् sleep, अनुभवति experiencing, अथ then, निहत्य having killed, राक्षसश्रेष्ठान् the best of demons, अमात्यान् ministers, इह here, सम्मतान् respected.
explanation: O great king, at that time, while Kumbhakarna was experiencing his long sleep, Madhu killed the best and most respected demon ministers here.

shloka_text: धर्षयित्वा हृता सा तु सुप्ताप्यन्तःपुरे तव । श्रुत्वा ऽपि तन्महाराज क्षान्तमेव हतो न सः ।। 7.25.27 ।।
transliteration: dharṣayitvā hṛtā sā tu suptāpyantaḥpure tava | śrutvā 'pi tanmahārāja kṣāntameva hato na saḥ || 7.25.27 ||
translation: धर्षयित्वा having violated, हृता was abducted, सा she, तु but, सुप्ता sleeping, अपि even, अन्तःपुरे in the inner chambers, तव your, श्रुत्वा having heard, अपि even, तत् that, महाराज O great king, क्षान्तम् forgiven, एव indeed, हतः killed, न not, सः he.
explanation: She was abducted after being violated, even while sleeping in your inner chambers, yet, O great king, even after hearing of that, he was indeed forgiven and not killed.

shloka_text: यस्मादवश्यं दातव्या कन्या भर्त्रे हि भ्रातृभिः । तदेतत्कर्मणो ह्यस्य फलं पापस्य दुर्मते ।। 7.25.28 ।।
transliteration: yasmādavaśyaṃ dātavyā kanyā bhartre hi bhrātṛbhiḥ | tadetatkarmaṇo hyasya phalaṃ pāpasya durmate || 7.25.28 ||
translation: यस्मात् because, अवश्यम् certainly, दातव्या to be given, कन्या a daughter, भर्त्रे to the husband, हि indeed, भ्रातृभिः by brothers, तत् that, एतत् this, कर्मणः of the action, हि indeed, अस्य his, फलम् fruit, पापस्य of the sinful, दुर्मते O evil-minded one.
explanation: Because a daughter must indeed be given to her husband by her brothers, this, O evil-minded one, is truly the consequence of his sinful act.

shloka_text: अस्मिन्नेवाभिसम्प्राप्तं लोके विदितमस्तु ते । विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रः स रावणः । दौरात्म्येनात्मनोद्धूतस्तप्ताम्भ इव सागरः ।। 7.25.29 ।।
transliteration: asminnevābhisamprāptaṃ loke viditamastu te | vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā rākṣasendraḥ sa rāvaṇaḥ | daurātmyenātmanoddhūtastaptāmbha iva sāgaraḥ || 7.25.29 ||
translation: अस्मिन् in this, एव indeed, अभिसम्प्राप्तम् arrived, लोके in the world, विदितम् known, अस्तु let it be, ते to you, विभीषणवचः Vibhishana's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, राक्षसेन्द्रः king of demons, सः that, रावणः Ravana, दौरात्म्येन by wickedness, आत्मना by himself, उद्धूतः agitated, तप्ताम्भः hot water, इव like, सागरः ocean.
explanation: Let it be known to you that upon hearing Vibhishana's words, that king of demons Ravana was agitated by his own wickedness, like an ocean stirred by hot water.

shloka_text: ततो ऽब्रवीदृशग्रीवः क्रुद्धः संरक्तलोचनः । कल्प्यतां मे रथः शीघ्रं शूराः सज्जीभवन्तु नः ।। 7.25.30 ।।
transliteration: tato 'bravīdṛśagrīvaḥ kruddhaḥ saṃraktalocanaḥ | kalpyatāṃ me rathaḥ śīghraṃ śūrāḥ sajjībhavantu naḥ || 7.25.30 ||
translation: ततः then, अब्रवीत् spoke, दशग्रीवः Ravana, क्रुद्धः enraged, संरक्तलोचनः with reddened eyes, कल्प्यताम् let it be prepared, मे my, रथः chariot, शीघ्रम् quickly, शूराः brave warriors, सज्जीभवन्तु let them be ready, नः our.
explanation: Then, Ravana, enraged and with reddened eyes, spoke, saying, "Let my chariot be prepared quickly, and let our brave warriors be ready."

shloka_text: भ्राता मे कुम्भकर्णश्च ये च मुख्या निशाचराः । वाहनान्यधिरोहन्तु नानाप्रहरणायुधाः ।। 7.25.31 ।।
transliteration: bhrātā me kumbhakarṇaśca ye ca mukhyā niśācarāḥ | vāhanānyadhirohantu nānāpraharaṇāyudhāḥ || 7.25.31 ||
translation: भ्राता brother, मे my, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, च and, ये who, च and, मुख्याः chief, निशाचराः demons, वाहनानि mounts, अधिरोहन्तु let them mount, नानाप्रहरणायुधाः armed with various weapons.
explanation: My brother Kumbhakarna and the other chief demons, armed with various weapons, should mount their vehicles.

shloka_text: अद्य तं समरे हत्वा मधुं रावणनिर्भयम् । सुरलोकं गमिष्यामि युद्धकाङ्क्षी सुहृद्वृतः ।। 7.25.32 ।।
transliteration: adya taṃ samare hatvā madhuṃ rāvaṇanirbhayam | suralokaṃ gamiṣyāmi yuddhakāṅkṣī suhṛdvṛtaḥ || 7.25.32 ||
translation: अद्य today, तम् him, समरे in battle, हत्वा having killed, मधुम् Madhu, रावणनिर्भयम् fearless of Ravana, सुरलोकम् to the world of gods, गमिष्यामि I shall go, युद्धकाङ्क्षी desirous of battle, सुहृद्वृतः surrounded by friends.
explanation: Today, having killed Madhu in battle, who is fearless of Ravana, I shall go to the world of gods, desirous of battle and surrounded by my friends.

shloka_text: अक्षौहिणीसहस्राणि चत्वार्यग्र्याणि रक्षसाम् । नानाप्रहरणान्याशु निर्ययुर्युद्धकाङ्क्षिणाम् ।। 7.25.33 ।।
transliteration: akṣauhiṇīsahasrāṇi catvāryagryāṇi rakṣasām | nānāpraharaṇānyāśu niryayuryuddhakāṅkṣiṇām || 7.25.33 ||
translation: अक्षौहिणीसहस्राणि thousands of Akshauhinis, चत्वारि four, अग्र्याणि foremost, रक्षसाम् of demons, नानाप्रहरणानि with various weapons, आशु quickly, निर्ययुः set out, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणाम् desirous of battle.
explanation: Four thousand foremost Akshauhinis of demons, armed with various weapons and eager for battle, quickly set out.

shloka_text: इन्द्रजित्त्वग्रतः (अग्रतः) सैन्यात्सैनिकान्परिगृह्य च । जगाम रावणो मध्ये कुम्भकर्णश्च पृष्ठतः ।। 7.25.34 ।।
transliteration: indrajittvagrataḥ (agrataḥ) sainyātsainikānparigṛhya ca | jagāma rāvaṇo madhye kumbhakarṇaśca pṛṣṭhataḥ || 7.25.34 ||
translation: इन्द्रजित् Indrajit, तु and, अग्रतः in front, सैन्यात् from the army, सैनिकान् soldiers, परिगृह्य having gathered, च and, जगाम went, रावणः Ravana, मध्ये in the middle, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, च and, पृष्ठतः at the back.
explanation: Indrajit led the army from the front, Ravana marched in the middle, and Kumbhakarna followed at the rear.

shloka_text: विभीषणश्च धर्मात्मा लङ्कायां धर्मामाचरत् । शोषाः सर्वे महाभागा ययुर्मधुपुरं प्रति ।। 7.25.35 ।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇaśca dharmātmā laṅkāyāṃ dharmāmācarat | śoṣāḥ sarve mahābhāgā yayurmadhupuraṃ prati || 7.25.35 ||
translation: विभीषणः Vibhishana, च and, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, लङ्कायां in Lanka, धर्मम् righteousness, आचरत् practiced, शेषाः the remaining ones, सर्वे all, महाभागाः illustrious ones, ययुः went, मधुपुरं to Madhupura, प्रति towards.
explanation: The righteous Vibhishana remained in Lanka practicing dharma, while all the other illustrious remaining ones went towards Madhupura.

shloka_text: खरैरुष्ट्रैर्हयैर्दीप्तैः शिंशुमारैर्महोरगैः । राक्षसाः प्रययुः सर्वे कृत्वा ऽ ऽकाशं निरन्तरम् ।। 7.25.36 ।।
transliteration: kharairuṣṭrairhayairdīptaiḥ śiṃśumārairmahoragaiḥ | rākṣasāḥ prayayuḥ sarve kṛtvā ' 'kāśaṃ nirantaram || 7.25.36 ||
translation: खरैः with donkeys, उष्ट्रैः with camels, हयैः with horses, दीप्तैः splendid, शिंशुमारैः with porpoises, महोरगैः with great serpents, राक्षसाः the Rakshasas, प्रययुः went forth, सर्वे all, कृत्वा having made, आकाशं the sky, निरन्तरम् completely filled.
explanation: All the Rakshasas set forth, mounted on donkeys, camels, splendid horses, porpoises, and great serpents, completely filling the sky.

shloka_text: दैत्याश्च शतशस्तत्र कृतवैराश्च दैवतैः । रावणं प्रेक्ष्य गच्छन्तमन्वगच्छन्हि पृष्ठतः ।। 7.25.37 ।।
transliteration: daityāśca śataśastatra kṛtavairāśca daivataiḥ | rāvaṇaṃ prekṣya gacchantamanvagacchanhi pṛṣṭhataḥ || 7.25.37 ||
translation: दैत्याः Daityas, च and, शतशः by hundreds, तत्र there, कृतवैराः who had enmity, च and, दैवतैः with the gods, रावणं Ravana, प्रेक्ष्य having seen, गच्छन्तम् going, अन्वगच्छन् followed, हि indeed, पृष्ठतः from behind.
explanation: Hundreds of Daityas, who had long-standing enmity with the gods, saw Ravana going and indeed followed him from behind.

shloka_text: स तु गत्वा मधुपुरं प्रविश्य च दशाननः । न ददर्श मधुं तत्र भगिनीं तत्र दृष्टवान् ।। 7.25.38 ।।
transliteration: sa tu gatvā madhupuraṃ praviśya ca daśānanaḥ | na dadarśa madhuṃ tatra bhaginīṃ tatra dṛṣṭavān || 7.25.38 ||
translation: सः He, तु indeed, गत्वा having gone, मधुपुरं to Madhupura, प्रविश्य having entered, च and, दशाननः Ravana, न not, ददर्श saw, मधुं Madhu, तत्र there, भगिनीं his sister, तत्र there, दृष्टवान् saw.
explanation: Having gone to Madhupura and entered it, Ravana did not find Madhu there, but instead saw his sister.

shloka_text: सा च प्रह्वाञ्जलिर्भूत्वा शिरसा चरणौ गता ।। 7.25.39 ।।
transliteration: sā ca prahvāñjalirbhūtvā śirasā caraṇau gatā || 7.25.39 ||
translation: सा she, च and, प्रह्वाञ्जलिर्भूत्वा having become humble with folded hands, शिरसा with her head, चरणौ (his) feet, गता reached.
explanation: And she, becoming humble with folded hands, touched his feet with her head.

shloka_text: तस्य राक्षसराजस्य त्रस्ता कुम्भीनसी तदा । तां समुत्थापयामास न भेतव्यमिति ब्रुवन् ।। 7.25.40 ।।
transliteration: tasya rākṣasarājasya trastā kumbhīnasī tadā | tāṃ samutthāpayāmāsa na bhetavyamiti bruvan || 7.25.40 ||
translation: तस्य of that, राक्षसराजस्य king of Rakshasas, त्रस्ता frightened, कुम्भीनसी Kumbhinasi, तदा then, ताम् her, समुत्थापयामास made to rise, न not, भेतव्यम् to be feared, इति thus, ब्रुवन् saying.
explanation: Then, Kumbhinasi, frightened by that king of Rakshasas, made her rise, saying, "You should not be afraid."

shloka_text: रावणो राक्षसश्रेष्ठः किं चापि करवाणि ते । साब्रवीद्यदि मे राजन्प्रसन्नस्त्वं महाभुज । भर्तारं न ममेहाद्य हन्तुर्महसि मानद ।। 7.25.41 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇo rākṣasaśreṣṭhaḥ kiṃ cāpi karavāṇi te | sābravīdyadi me rājanprasannastvaṃ mahābhuja | bhartāraṃ na mamehādya hanturmahasi mānada || 7.25.41 ||
translation: रावणो Ravana, राक्षसश्रेष्ठः O best of Rakshasas, किम् what, च and, अपि also, करवाणि shall I do, ते for you? साब्रवीत् she said, यदि if, मे to me, राजन् O king, प्रसन्नस्त्वम् you are pleased, महाभुज O mighty-armed one, भर्तारम् husband, न not, मम my, इह here, अद्य today, हन्तुम् to kill, अर्हसि you ought, मानद O giver of honor.
explanation: Ravana, O best of Rakshasas, asked, "What else shall I do for you?" She replied, "If you are pleased with me, O king, O mighty-armed one, O giver of honor, then you should not kill my husband here today."

shloka_text: न हीदृशं भयं किञ्चित्कुलस्त्रीणामिहोच्यते । भयानामपि सर्वेषां वैधव्यं व्यसनं महत् ।। 7.25.42 ।।
transliteration: na hīdṛśaṃ bhayaṃ kiñcitkulastrīṇāmihocyate | bhayānāmapi sarveṣāṃ vaidhavyaṃ vyasanaṃ mahat || 7.25.42 ||
translation: न not, हि indeed, ईदृशम् such, भयम् fear, किञ्चित् any, कुलस्त्रीणाम् for noble women, इह here, उच्यते is said. भयानाम् of fears, अपि even, सर्वेषाम् all, वैधव्यम् widowhood, व्यसनम् calamity, महत् great.
explanation: Indeed, no such fear is spoken of for noble women in this world, for among all fears, widowhood is the greatest calamity.

shloka_text: सत्यवाग्भव राजेन्द्र मामवेक्षस्व याचतीम् । त्वयाप्युक्तं महाराज न भेतव्यमिति स्वयम् ।। 7.25.43 ।।
transliteration: satyavāgbhava rājendra māmavekṣasva yācatīm | tvayāpyuktaṃ mahārāja na bhetavyamiti svayam || 7.25.43 ||
translation: सत्यवाग्भव be truthful in speech, राजेन्द्र O king of kings, माम् me, अवेक्षस्व consider, याचतीम् who is begging. त्वयापि by you also, उक्तम् was said, महाराज O great king, न not, भेतव्यम् to be feared, इति thus, स्वयम् yourself.
explanation: O king of kings, be truthful in your word and consider me, who is begging, for you yourself, O great king, said, "You should not be afraid."

shloka_text: रावणस्त्वब्रवीद्धृष्टः स्वसारं तत्र संस्थिताम् । क्व चासौ तव भर्ता वै मम शीघ्रं निवेद्यताम् ।। 7.25.44 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇastvabravīddhṛṣṭaḥ svasāraṃ tatra saṃsthitām | kva cāsau tava bhartā vai mama śīghraṃ nivedyatām || 7.25.44 ||
translation: रावणः Ravana, तु indeed, अब्रवीत् said, धृष्टः impudent, स्वसारं to his sister, तत्र there, संस्थिताम् standing, क्व where, च and, असौ that, तव your, भर्ता husband, वै indeed, मम to me, शीघ्रं quickly, निवेद्यताम् let him be reported.
explanation: Impudent Ravana said to his sister, who was standing there, "Where is your husband? Show him to me quickly."

shloka_text: सह तेन गमिष्यामि सुरलोकं जयावहे । तव कारुण्यसौहार्दान्निवृत्तो ऽस्मि मधोर्वधात् ।। 7.25.45 ।।
transliteration: saha tena gamiṣyāmi suralokaṃ jayāvahe | tava kāruṇyasauhārdānnivṛtto 'smi madhorvadhāt || 7.25.45 ||
translation: सह with, तेन him, गमिष्यामि I shall go, सुरलोकं to the world of gods, जयावहे for victory, तव your, कारुण्यसौहार्दात् due to compassion and friendship, निवृत्तः stopped, अस्मि I am, मधोः of Madhu, वधात् from killing.
explanation: I will go with him to conquer the world of the gods, and because of your compassion and friendship, I have refrained from killing Madhu.

shloka_text: इत्युक्ता सा समुत्थाप्य प्रसुप्तं तं निशाचरम् । अब्रवीत्सम्प्रहृष्टेव राक्षसी सा पतिं वचः ।। 7.25.46 ।।
transliteration: ityuktā sā samutthāpya prasuptaṃ taṃ niśācaram | abravītsamprahṛṣṭeva rākṣasī sā patiṃ vacaḥ || 7.25.46 ||
translation: इति thus, उक्ता addressed, सा she, समुत्थाप्य having awakened, प्रसुप्तं sleeping, तं that, निशाचरम् night-wanderer, अब्रवीत् spoke, सम्प्रहृष्टा as if greatly delighted, राक्षसी the female demon, सा she, पतिं to her husband, वचः words.
explanation: Thus addressed, she, the female demon, awakened her sleeping husband, the night-wanderer, and spoke words to him as if greatly delighted.

shloka_text: एष प्राप्तो दशग्रीवो मम भ्राता महाबलः । सुरलोकजयाकाङ्क्षी साहाय्ये त्वां वृणोति च ।। 7.25.47 ।।
transliteration: eṣa prāpto daśagrīvo mama bhrātā mahābalaḥ | suralokajayākāṅkṣī sāhāyye tvāṃ vṛṇoti ca || 7.25.47 ||
translation: एषः this, प्राप्तः arrived, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, मम my, भ्राता brother, महाबलः very powerful, सुरलोकजयाकाङ्क्षी desirous of conquering the world of gods, साहाय्ये for help, त्वां you, वृणोति chooses, च and.
explanation: My very powerful brother Dashagriva has arrived, desirous of conquering the world of the gods, and he requests your assistance.

shloka_text: तदस्य त्वं सहायार्थं सबन्धुर्गच्छ राक्षस । स्निग्धस्य भजमानस्य युक्तमर्थाय कल्पितुम् ।। 7.25.48 ।।
transliteration: tadasya tvaṃ sahāyārthaṃ sabandhurgaccha rākṣasa | snigdhasya bhajamānasya yuktamarthāya kalpitum || 7.25.48 ||
translation: तत् therefore, अस्य his, त्वं you, सहायार्थं for the purpose of help, सबन्धुः with your relatives, गच्छ go, राक्षस O Rakshasa, स्निग्धस्य of an affectionate one, भजमानस्य who seeks (help), युक्तम् it is proper, अर्थाय for the purpose, कल्पितुम् to provide.
explanation: Therefore, O Rakshasa, you should go with your relatives to help him, for it is proper to provide assistance to an affectionate one who seeks it.

shloka_text: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा तथेत्याह मधुर्वचः ।। 7.25.49 ।।
transliteration: tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā tathetyāha madhurvacaḥ || 7.25.49 ||
translation: तस्याः her, तत् that, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, तथा so be it, इति thus, आह said, मधुः Madhu, वचः words.
explanation: Having heard her words, Madhu replied, "So be it."

shloka_text: ददर्श राक्षसश्रेष्ठं यथान्यायमुपेत्य सः । पूजयमास धर्मेण रावणं राक्षसाधिपम् ।। 7.25.50 ।।
transliteration: dadarśa rākṣasaśreṣṭhaṃ yathānyāyamupetya saḥ | pūjayamāsa dharmeṇa rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhipam || 7.25.50 ||
translation: ददर्श he saw, राक्षसश्रेष्ठं the best of Rakshasas, यथान्यायम् according to custom, उपेत्य having approached, सः he, पूजयमास worshipped, धर्मेण righteously, रावणं Ravana, राक्षसाधिपम् the lord of Rakshasas.
explanation: He approached Ravana, the best and lord of Rakshasas, and worshipped him according to custom and righteousness.

shloka_text: प्राप्य पूजां दशग्रीवो मधुवेश्मानि वीर्यवान् । तत्र चैकां निशामुष्य गमनायोपचक्रमे ।। 7.25.51 ।।
transliteration: prāpya pūjāṃ daśagrīvo madhuveśmāni vīryavān | tatra caikāṃ niśāmuṣya gamanāyopacakrame || 7.25.51 ||
translation: प्राप्य having received, पूजां worship, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), मधुवेश्मानि in Madhu's abode, वीर्यवान् the powerful one, तत्र there, च and, एकाम् one, निशाम् night, उष्य having stayed, गमनाय for departure, उपचक्रमे began.
explanation: The powerful Ravana, having received worship in Madhu's abode and stayed there for one night, then prepared for his departure.

shloka_text: ततः कैलासमासाद्य शैलं वैश्रवणालयम् । राक्षसेन्द्रो महेन्द्राभः सेनामुपनिवेशयत् ।। 7.25.52 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kailāsamāsādya śailaṃ vaiśravaṇālayam | rākṣasendro mahendrābhaḥ senāmupaniveśayat || 7.25.52 ||
translation: ततः then, कैलासम् Kailasa, आसाद्य having reached, शैलं mountain, वैश्रवणालयम् the abode of Vaishravana (Kubera), राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of Rakshasas, महेन्द्राभः resembling Mahendra (Indra), सेनाम् army, उपनिवेशयत् encamped.
explanation: Then, the lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, who resembled Mahendra, reached Mount Kailasa, the abode of Kubera, and encamped his army there.

shloka_text: स तु तत्र दशग्रीवः सह सैन्येन वीर्यवान् । अस्तं प्राप्ते दिनकरे निवासं समरोचयत् ।। 7.26.1 ।।
transliteration: sa tu tatra daśagrīvaḥ saha sainyena vīryavān | astaṃ prāpte dinakare nivāsaṃ samarocayat || 7.26.1 ||
translation: सः he, तु indeed, तत्र there, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), सह with, सैन्येन his army, वीर्यवान् the powerful one, अस्तम् setting, प्राप्ते having reached, दिनकरे the sun, निवासम् residence, समरोचयत् chose.
explanation: There, the powerful Ravana, along with his army, chose to reside as the sun was setting.
comments: Encamped at Kailasa on a moonlit, spring-laden night, the lust-struck Ravana seizes the apsara Rambha, who pleads that she is his daughter-in-law, betrothed to Kubera's son Nalakubara -- he violates her nonetheless -- told of the outrage, Nalakubara curses that if Ravana ever forces an unwilling woman his head shall split into seven pieces, and the gods rejoice, for the curse will one day shield Sita.

shloka_text: उदिते विमले चन्द्रे तुल्यपर्वतवर्चसि । प्रसुप्तं सुमहत्सैन्यं नानाप्रहरणायुधम् ।। 7.26.2 ।।
transliteration: udite vimale candre tulyaparvatavarcasi | prasuptaṃ sumahatsainyaṃ nānāpraharaṇāyudham || 7.26.2 ||
translation: उदिते having risen, विमले pure, चन्द्रे the moon, तुल्यपर्वतवर्चसि having splendor equal to a mountain, प्रसुप्तं sleeping, सुमहत्सैन्यं a very large army, नानाप्रहरणायुधम् with various weapons and arms.
explanation: As the pure moon, shining with the brilliance of a mountain, rose, a vast army equipped with diverse weapons lay asleep.

shloka_text: रावणस्तु महावीर्यो निषण्णः शैलमूर्धनि । स ददर्श गुणांस्तत्र चन्द्रपादपशोभितान् ।। 7.26.3 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇastu mahāvīryo niṣaṇṇaḥ śailamūrdhani | sa dadarśa guṇāṃstatra candrapādapaśobhitān || 7.26.3 ||
translation: रावणस्तु but Ravana, महावीर्यो very powerful, निषण्णः seated, शैलमूर्धनि on the mountain peak, सः he, ददर्श saw, गुणांस्तत्र the beauties there, चन्द्रपादपशोभितान् adorned by moonlit trees.
explanation: But the mighty Ravana, seated on the mountain peak, beheld the beautiful features of that place, enhanced by trees illuminated by the moonlight.

shloka_text: कर्णिकारवनैर्दीप्तैः कदम्बगहनैस्तथा । पद्मिनीभिश्च फुल्लाभिर्मन्दाकिन्या जलैरपि ।। 7.26.4 ।।
transliteration: karṇikāravanairdīptaiḥ kadambagahanaistathā | padminībhiśca phullābhirmandākinyā jalairapi || 7.26.4 ||
translation: कर्णिकारवनैः by forests of Karnikara trees, दीप्तैः shining, कदम्बगहनैः by dense Kadamba groves, तथा and also, पद्मिनीभिश्च and by lotus ponds, फुल्लाभिः full-blown, मन्दाकिन्या of the Mandakini river, जलैरपि and by waters.
explanation: He saw the beauty created by radiant Karnikara forests, dense Kadamba groves, blooming lotus ponds, and the waters of the Mandakini river.

shloka_text: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागमन्दारतरुभिस्तथा । चूतपाटललोध्रैश्च प्रियङ्ग्वर्जुनकेतकैः । तगरैर्नारिकैलैश्च प्रियालपनसैस्तथा ।। 7.26.5 ।।
transliteration: campakāśokapunnāgamandāratarubhistathā | cūtapāṭalalodhraiśca priyaṅgvarjunaketakaiḥ | tagarairnārikailaiśca priyālapanasaistathā || 7.26.5 ||
translation: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागमन्दारतरुभिः by trees like Champaka, Ashoka, Punnaga, and Mandara, तथा and also, चूतपाटललोध्रैश्च and by Mango, Patala, and Lodhra trees, प्रियङ्ग्वर्जुनकेतकैः by Priyangu, Arjuna, and Ketaka trees, तगरैः by Tagara trees, नारिकैलैश्च and by Narikela (coconut) trees, प्रियालपनसैः by Priyala and Panasa (jackfruit) trees, तथा and also.
explanation: The scene was further adorned by trees such as Champaka, Ashoka, Punnaga, Mandara, Mango, Patala, Lodhra, Priyangu, Arjuna, Ketaka, Tagara, Narikela, Priyala, and Panasa.

shloka_text: आरग्वधैस्तमालैश्च प्रियालवकुलैरपि । एतैरन्यैश्च तरुभिरुद्भासितवनान्तरे । किन्नरा मदनेनार्ता रक्ता मधुरकण्ठिनः ।। 7.26.6 ।।
transliteration: āragvadhaistamālaiśca priyālavakulairapi | etairanyaiśca tarubhirudbhāsitavanāntare | kinnarā madanenārtā raktā madhurakaṇṭhinaḥ || 7.26.6 ||
translation: आरग्वधैः by Aragvadha trees, तमालैश्च and by Tamala trees, प्रियालवकुलैरपि and also by Priyala and Bakula trees, एतैः by these, अन्यैश्च and by other, तरुभिः trees, उद्भासितवनान्तरे in the forest region made radiant, किन्नरा Kinnaras, मदनेनार्ता afflicted by love, रक्ता passionate, मधुरकण्ठिनः having sweet voices.
explanation: In that forest region, illuminated by these and other trees like Aragvadha, Tamala, Priyala, and Bakula, Kinnaras, tormented by love, sang passionately with their sweet voices.

shloka_text: समं सम्प्रजगुर्यत्र मनस्तुष्टिविवर्धनम् ।। 7.26.7 ।।
transliteration: samaṃ samprajaguryatra manastuṣṭivivardhanam || 7.26.7 ||
translation: समं equally, सम्प्रजगुः they sang well, यत्र where, मनस्तुष्टिविवर्धनम् increasing the satisfaction of the mind.
explanation: Where they sang together in unison, their songs greatly increased the satisfaction of the mind.

shloka_text: भिरुद्भासितवनान्तरे । विद्याधरा मदक्षीबा मदरक्तान्तलोचनाः । योषिद्भिः सह सङ्क्रान्ताश्चिक्रीडुर्जहृषुश्च वै ।। 7.26.8 ।।
transliteration: bhirudbhāsitavanāntare | vidyādharā madakṣībā madaraktāntalocanāḥ | yoṣidbhiḥ saha saṅkrāntāścikrīḍurjahṛṣuśca vai || 7.26.8 ||
translation: भिरुद्भासितवनान्तरे in the brightly lit forest interior, विद्याधराः Vidyadharas, मदक्षीबाः intoxicated, मदरक्तान्तलोचनाः with eyes red from intoxication, योषिद्भिः with women, सह together, सङ्क्रान्ताः having assembled, चिक्रीडुः they played, जहृषुः they rejoiced, च and, वै indeed.
explanation: In the brightly lit forest interior, the Vidyadharas, intoxicated and with eyes red from drink, assembled with their women and indeed played and rejoiced.

shloka_text: घण्टानामिव सन्नादः शुश्रुवे मधुरस्वरः । अप्सरोगणसङ्घानां गायतां धनदालये ।। 7.26.9 ।।
transliteration: ghaṇṭānāmiva sannādaḥ śuśruve madhurasvaraḥ | apsarogaṇasaṅghānāṃ gāyatāṃ dhanadālaye || 7.26.9 ||
translation: घण्टानाम् of bells, इव like, सन्नादः a sound, शुश्रुवे was heard, मधुरस्वरः a sweet sound, अप्सरोगणसङ्घानाम् of groups of Apsaras, गायताम् singing, धनदालये in the abode of Kubera.
explanation: In Kubera's abode, a sweet sound was heard, like the ringing of bells, from the singing groups of Apsaras.

shloka_text: पुष्पवर्षाणि मुञ्चन्तो नगाः पवनताडिताः । शैलं तं वासयन्तीव मधुमाधवगन्धिनः ।। 7.26.10 ।।
transliteration: puṣpavarṣāṇi muñcanto nagāḥ pavanatāḍitāḥ | śailaṃ taṃ vāsayantīva madhumādhavagandhinaḥ || 7.26.10 ||
translation: पुष्पवर्षाणि showers of flowers, मुञ्चन्तः releasing, नगाः trees, पवनताडिताः struck by the wind, शैलम् the mountain, तम् that, वासयन्तीव as if perfuming, मधुमाधवगन्धिनः fragrant with the scent of spring flowers.
explanation: The trees, swayed by the wind, released showers of flowers, as if perfuming that mountain with the fragrance of spring blossoms.

shloka_text: मधुपुष्परजःपृक्तं गन्धमादाय पुष्कलम् । प्रववौ वर्धयन्कामं रावणस्य सुखो ऽनिलः ।। 7.26.11 ।।
transliteration: madhupuṣparajaḥpṛktaṃ gandhamādāya puṣkalam | pravavau vardhayankāmaṃ rāvaṇasya sukho 'nilaḥ || 7.26.11 ||
translation: मधुपुष्परजःपृक्तम् mixed with the pollen of spring flowers, गन्धम् fragrance, आदाय taking, पुष्कलम् abundant, प्रववौ blew, वर्धयन् increasing, कामम् desire, रावणस्य of Ravana, सुखः pleasant, अनिलः wind.
explanation: A pleasant wind blew, carrying the abundant fragrance mixed with the pollen of spring flowers, thereby increasing Ravana's desire.

shloka_text: गेयात्पुष्पसमृद्ध्या च शैत्याद्वायोर्गिरेर्गुणात् । प्रवृत्तायां रजन्यां च चन्द्रस्योदयनेन च ।। 7.26.12 ।।
transliteration: geyātpuṣpasamṛddhyā ca śaityādvāyorgirerguṇāt | pravṛttāyāṃ rajanyāṃ ca candrasyodayanena ca || 7.26.12 ||
translation: गेयात् from singing, पुष्पसमृद्ध्या by the abundance of flowers, च and, शैत्यात् from the coolness, वायोः of the wind, गिरेः of the mountain, गुणात् from the quality, प्रवृत्तायाम् having begun, रजन्याम् in the night, च and, चन्द्रस्य of the moon, उदयनेन by the rising, च and.
explanation: The night had set in, enhanced by the melodious music, the profusion of flowers, the cool mountain breeze, and the rising of the moon.

shloka_text: रावणस्तु महावीर्यः कामस्य वशमागतः । विनिःश्वस्य विनिःश्वस्य शशिनं समवैक्षत ।। 7.26.13 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇastu mahāvīryaḥ kāmasya vaśamāgataḥ | viniḥśvasya viniḥśvasya śaśinaṃ samavaikṣata || 7.26.13 ||
translation: रावणस्तु but Ravana, महावीर्यः of great valor, कामस्य of desire, वशम् under the sway, आगतः having come, विनिःश्वस्य sighing deeply, विनिःश्वस्य sighing deeply, शशिनम् at the moon, समवैक्षत looked intently.
explanation: Ravana, despite his great might, had fallen under the sway of desire and repeatedly sighed deeply as he gazed at the moon.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र दिव्याभरणभूषिता । सर्वाप्सरोवरा रम्भा दिव्यपुष्पविभूषिता ।। 7.26.14 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare tatra divyābharaṇabhūṣitā | sarvāpsarovarā rambhā divyapuṣpavibhūṣitā || 7.26.14 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् at this, अन्तरे moment, तत्र there, दिव्याभरणभूषिता adorned with divine ornaments, सर्वाप्सरोवरा the best of all Apsaras, रम्भा Rambha, दिव्यपुष्पविभूषिता adorned with divine flowers.
explanation: At that very moment, Rambha, the foremost of all Apsaras, appeared there, adorned with divine ornaments and divine flowers.

shloka_text: दिव्यचन्दनलिप्ताङ्गी मन्दारकृतमूर्धजा । दिव्योत्सवकृतारम्भा पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना ।। 7.26.15 ।।
transliteration: divyacandanaliptāṅgī mandārakṛtamūrdhajā | divyotsavakṛtārambhā pūrṇacandranibhānanā || 7.26.15 ||
translation: दिव्यचन्दनलिप्ताङ्गी whose limbs were smeared with divine sandalwood paste, मन्दारकृतमूर्धजा whose hair was adorned with Mandara flowers, दिव्योत्सवकृतारम्भा who had begun a divine celebration, पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना whose face resembled the full moon.
explanation: Her body was smeared with divine sandalwood, her hair adorned with Mandara flowers, she had initiated a divine celebration, and her face shone like the full moon.

shloka_text: चक्षुर्मनोहरं पीनं मेखलादामभूषितम् । समुद्वहन्ती जघनं रतिप्राभृतमुत्तमम् ।। 7.26.16 ।।
transliteration: cakṣurmanoharaṃ pīnaṃ mekhalādāmabhūṣitam | samudvahantī jaghanaṃ ratiprābhṛtamuttamam || 7.26.16 ||
translation: चक्षुर्मनोहरम् charming to the eyes and mind, पीनम् plump, मेखलादामभूषितम् adorned with a girdle of bells, समुद्वहन्ती bearing, जघनम् hips, रतिप्राभृतम् a gift for love, उत्तमम् excellent.
explanation: She bore her hips, which were plump, charming to the eyes and mind, adorned with a girdle of bells, and an excellent offering for love.

shloka_text: कृतैर्विशेषकैरार्द्रैः षडर्तुकुसुमोद्भवैः ।। 7.26.17 ।।
transliteration: kṛtairviśeṣakairārdraiḥ ṣaḍartukusumodbhavaiḥ || 7.26.17 ||
translation: कृतैः made, विशेषकैः with special marks/decorations, आर्द्रैः fresh, षडर्तु of six seasons, कुसुम flowers, उद्भवैः produced from
explanation: She was adorned with fresh, special marks made from flowers of all six seasons.

shloka_text: बभावन्यतमेव श्रीकान्तिद्युतिमतिह्रियाम् । नीलं सतोयमेघाभं वस्त्रं समवकुण्ठिता ।। 7.26.18 ।।
transliteration: babhāvanyatameva śrīkāntidyutimatihriyām | nīlaṃ satoyameghābhaṃ vastraṃ samavakuṇṭhitā || 7.26.18 ||
translation: बभाव she appeared, अन्यतमेव as if another (form), श्री of beauty, कान्ति of splendor, द्युति of radiance, मति of intelligence, ह्रियाम् of modesty, नीलं blue, सतोय with water, मेघाभं cloud-like, वस्त्रं garment, समवकुण्ठिता covered
explanation: She appeared as if another embodiment of beauty, splendor, radiance, intelligence, and modesty, covered in a blue garment resembling a water-laden cloud.

shloka_text: यस्या वक्त्रं शशिनिभं भ्रुवौ चापनिभे शुभे । ऊरू करिकराकारौ करौ पल्लवकोमलौ । सैन्यमध्येन गच्छन्ती रावणेनोपवीक्षिता ।। 7.26.19 ।।
transliteration: yasyā vaktraṃ śaśinibhaṃ bhruvau cāpanibhe śubhe | ūrū karikarākārau karau pallavakomalau | sainyamadhyena gacchantī rāvaṇenopavīkṣitā || 7.26.19 ||
translation: यस्याः whose, वक्त्रं face, शशिनिभं moon-like, भ्रुवौ eyebrows, चापनिभे bow-like, शुभे beautiful, ऊरू thighs, करिकराकारौ elephant's trunk-like, करौ hands, पल्लवकोमलौ tender like sprouts, सैन्यमध्येन through the midst of the army, गच्छन्ती going, रावणेन by Ravana, उपवीक्षिता was seen
explanation: Her face was like the moon, her beautiful eyebrows like bows, her thighs like elephant trunks, and her hands soft as new leaves; as she walked through the army, she was observed by Ravana.

shloka_text: तां समुत्थाय गच्छन्तीं कामबाणवशं गतः । करे गृहीत्वा लज्जन्तीं स्मयमानो ऽभ्यभाषत ।। 7.26.20 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ samutthāya gacchantīṃ kāmabāṇavaśaṃ gataḥ | kare gṛhītvā lajjantīṃ smayamāno 'bhyabhāṣata || 7.26.20 ||
translation: तां her, समुत्थाय having risen, गच्छन्तीं going, कामबाणवशं under the sway of Cupid's arrows, गतः fallen, करे by the hand, गृहीत्वा having seized, लज्जन्तीं blushing, स्मयमानः smiling, अभ्यभाषत he spoke to
explanation: Having risen, Ravana, fallen under the sway of Cupid's arrows, seized her hand as she was going, and smiling, spoke to the blushing woman.

shloka_text: क्व गच्छसि वरारोहे कां सिद्धिं भजसे स्वयम् । कस्याभ्युदयकालो ऽयं यस्त्वां समुपभोक्ष्यते ।। 7.26.21 ।।
transliteration: kva gacchasi varārohe kāṃ siddhiṃ bhajase svayam | kasyābhyudayakālo 'yaṃ yastvāṃ samupabhokṣyate || 7.26.21 ||
translation: क्व where, गच्छसि you go, वरारोहे O lady with beautiful hips, कां what, सिद्धिं accomplishment, भजसे you seek, स्वयम् yourself, कस्य whose, अभ्युदयकालः time of prosperity, अयं this, यः who, त्वां you, समुपभोक्ष्यते will enjoy
explanation: "Where do you go, O lady of beautiful hips, what accomplishment do you seek for yourself, and whose time of prosperity is this, that he will enjoy you?"

shloka_text: त्वदाननरसस्याद्य पद्मोत्पलसुगन्धिनः । सुधामृतरसस्येव को ऽद्य तृप्तिं गमिष्यति ।। 7.26.22 ।।
transliteration: tvadānanarasasyādya padmotpalasugandhinaḥ | sudhāmṛtarasasyeva ko 'dya tṛptiṃ gamiṣyati || 7.26.22 ||
translation: त्वदाननरसस्य of the essence of your face, अद्य today, पद्मोत्पलसुगन्धिनः fragrant like lotus and water-lily, सुधामृतरसस्य of the essence of divine nectar, इव like, कः who, अद्य today, तृप्तिं satisfaction, गमिष्यति will attain.
explanation: Who today will ever be satisfied with the essence of your face, fragrant like lotuses and water-lilies, which is like the essence of divine nectar?

shloka_text: स्वर्णकुम्भनिभौ पीनौ शुभौ भीरु निरन्तरौ । कस्योरस्थलसंस्पर्शं दास्यतस्ते कुचाविमौ ।। 7.26.23 ।।
transliteration: svarṇakumbhanibhau pīnau śubhau bhīru nirantarau | kasyorasthalasaṃsparśaṃ dāsyataste kucāvimau || 7.26.23 ||
translation: स्वर्णकुम्भनिभौ resembling golden pitchers, पीनौ plump, शुभौ beautiful, भीरु O timid one, निरन्तरौ close-set, कस्य whose, उरस्थलसंस्पर्शं contact with the chest, दास्यतः will give, ते your, कुचाविमौ these two breasts.
explanation: O timid one, whose chest will these two plump, beautiful, close-set breasts of yours, resembling golden pitchers, touch?

shloka_text: सुवर्णचक्रप्रतिमं स्वर्णदामचितं पृथु । अध्यारोहति कस्ते ऽद्य जघनं स्वर्गरूपिणम् ।। 7.26.24 ।।
transliteration: suvarṇacakrapratimaṃ svarṇadāmacitaṃ pṛthu | adhyārohati kaste 'dya jaghanaṃ svargarūpiṇam || 7.26.24 ||
translation: सुवर्णचक्रप्रतिमं resembling a golden disc, स्वर्णदामचितं adorned with golden chains, पृथु broad, अध्यारोहति will ascend, कः who, ते your, अद्य today, जघनं hips, स्वर्गरूपिणम् having the form of heaven.
explanation: Who today will ascend your broad hips, which resemble a golden disc, are adorned with golden chains, and are like heaven itself?

shloka_text: मद्विशिष्टः पुमान्को ऽद्य शक्रो विष्णुरथाश्विनौ । मामतीत्य हि यं च त्वं यासि भीरु न शोभनम् ।। 7.26.25 ।।
transliteration: madviśiṣṭaḥ pumānko 'dya śakro viṣṇurathāśvinau | māmatītya hi yaṃ ca tvaṃ yāsi bhīru na śobhanam || 7.26.25 ||
translation: मद्विशिष्टः superior to me, पुमान् man, कः who, अद्य today, शक्रः Indra, विष्णुः Vishnu, अथ or, अश्विनौ the Ashvins, माम् me, अतीत्य surpassing, हि indeed, यं whom, च and, त्वं you, यासि go, भीरु O timid one, न not, शोभनम् proper.
explanation: Who is that man superior to me today, be it Indra, Vishnu, or the Ashvins, whom you, O timid one, would go to, leaving me behind, for that would not be proper?

shloka_text: विश्रम त्वं पृथुश्रोणि शिलातलमिदं शुभम् ।। 7.26.26 ।।
transliteration: viśrama tvaṃ pṛthuśroṇi śilātalamidaṃ śubham || 7.26.26 ||
translation: विश्रम rest, त्वं you, पृथुश्रोणि O broad-hipped one, शिलातलम् rock surface, इदं this, शुभम् beautiful.
explanation: O broad-hipped one, you should rest on this beautiful rock surface.

shloka_text: त्रैलोक्ये यः प्रभुश्चैव मदन्यो नैव विद्यते ।। 7.26.27 ।।
transliteration: trailokye yaḥ prabhuścaiva madanyo naiva vidyate || 7.26.27 ||
translation: त्रैलोक्ये in the three worlds, यः who, प्रभुः lord, च and, एव indeed, मदन्यः other than me, न not, एव indeed, विद्यते exists.
explanation: There is no lord in the three worlds other than me.

shloka_text: तदेवं प्राञ्जलिः प्रह्वो याचते त्वां दशाननः । भर्तुर्भर्ता विधाता च त्रैलोक्यस्य भजस्व माम् ।। 7.26.28 ।।
transliteration: tadevaṃ prāñjaliḥ prahvo yācate tvāṃ daśānanaḥ | bharturbhartā vidhātā ca trailokyasya bhajasva mām || 7.26.28 ||
translation: तत् therefore, एवम् thus, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रह्वः bowed down, याचते begs, त्वाम् you, दशाननः the ten-headed one (Ravana), भर्तुः of the husband, भर्ता the husband (lord), विधाता the creator, च and, त्रैलोक्यस्य of the three worlds, भजस्व worship, माम् me.
explanation: Therefore, the ten-headed Ravana, bowing down with folded hands, begs you, "Worship me, for I am the lord of lords and the creator of the three worlds."

shloka_text: एवमुक्ता ऽब्रवीद्रम्भा वेपमाना कृताञ्जलिः । प्रसीद नार्हसे वक्तुमीदृशं त्वं हि मे गुरुः ।। 7.26.29 ।।
transliteration: evamuktā 'bravīdrambhā vepamānā kṛtāñjaliḥ | prasīda nārhase vaktumīdṛśaṃ tvaṃ hi me guruḥ || 7.26.29 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्ता spoken to, अब्रवीत् said, रम्भा Rambha, वेपमाना trembling, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रसीद be pleased (have mercy), न not, अर्हसे you ought, वक्तुम् to speak, ईदृशम् such a thing, त्वम् you, हि indeed, मे my, गुरुः elder/revered one.
explanation: Thus addressed, Rambha, trembling and with folded hands, replied, "Please have mercy; you should not speak such words, for you are indeed like an elder to me."

shloka_text: अन्येभ्यो हि त्वया रक्ष्या प्राप्नुयां धर्षणं यदि । तद्धर्मतः स्नुषा ते ऽहं तत्त्वमेव ब्रवीमि ते ।। 7.26.30 ।।
transliteration: anyebhyo hi tvayā rakṣyā prāpnuyāṃ dharṣaṇaṃ yadi | taddharmataḥ snuṣā te 'haṃ tattvameva bravīmi te || 7.26.30 ||
translation: अन्येभ्यः from others, हि indeed, त्वया by you, रक्ष्या to be protected, प्राप्नुयाम् I might obtain, धर्षणम् molestation/violation, यदि if, तत् therefore, धर्मतः by dharma/righteously, स्नुषा daughter-in-law, ते your, अहम् I, तत्त्वम् the truth, एव indeed, ब्रवीमि I tell, ते to you.
explanation: You are indeed the one who should protect me from molestation by others, and by dharma, I am your daughter-in-law; I tell you this truth.

shloka_text: अथाब्रवीद्दशग्रीवश्चरणाधोमुखीं स्थिताम् । रोमहर्षमनुप्राप्तां दृष्टमात्रेण तां तदा ।। 7.26.31 ।।
transliteration: athābravīddaśagrīvaścaraṇādhomukhīṃ sthitām | romaharṣamanuprāptāṃ dṛṣṭamātreṇa tāṃ tadā || 7.26.31 ||
translation: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, दशग्रीवः the ten-necked one (Ravana), चरणाधोमुखीम् with face turned downwards towards the feet, स्थिताम् standing, रोमहर्षम् goosebumps/horripilation, अनुप्राप्ताम् having obtained, दृष्टमात्रेण by merely seeing, ताम् her, तदा then.
explanation: Then Ravana spoke to her, who was standing with her face turned downwards towards his feet, having gotten goosebumps merely upon seeing him.

shloka_text: सुतस्य यदि मे भार्या ततस्त्वं हि स्नुषा भवेः । बाढमित्येव सा रम्भा प्राह रावणमुत्तरम् ।। 7.26.32 ।।
transliteration: sutasya yadi me bhāryā tatastvaṃ hi snuṣā bhaveḥ | bāḍhamityeva sā rambhā prāha rāvaṇamuttaram || 7.26.32 ||
translation: सुतस्य of the son, यदि if, मे my, भार्या wife, ततस् then, त्वं you, हि indeed, स्नुषा daughter-in-law, भवेः would be, बाढम् "Indeed", इति एव thus, सा she, रम्भा Rambha, प्राह said, रावणम् to Ravana, उत्तरम् in reply.
explanation: Rambha replied to Ravana, saying, "If I were the wife of your son, then you would indeed be my father-in-law."

shloka_text: धर्मतस्ते सुतस्याहं भार्या राक्षसपुङ्गव । पुत्रः प्रियतरः प्राणैर्भ्रातुर्वैश्रवणस्य ते । विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु नलकूबर इत्ययम् ।। 7.26.33 ।।
transliteration: dharmataste sutasyāhaṃ bhāryā rākṣasapuṅgava | putraḥ priyataraḥ prāṇairbhrāturvaiśravaṇasya te | vikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu nalakūbara ityayam || 7.26.33 ||
translation: धर्मतस् by religious law, ते your, सुतस्य of the son, अहम् I, भार्या wife, राक्षसपुङ्गव O best of Rakshasas, पुत्रः son, प्रियतरः dearer, प्राणैः than life, भ्रातुः of the brother, वैश्रवणस्य of Vaishravana (Kubera), ते your, विख्यातस् renowned, त्रिषु in three, लोकेषु worlds, नलकूबरः Nalakubara, इति अयम् thus this one.
explanation: O best of Rakshasas, I am rightfully the wife of your son, Nalakubara, who is dearer to your brother Vaishravana (Kubera) than life itself and is renowned in all three worlds.

shloka_text: धर्मतो यो भवेद्विप्रः क्षत्रियो वीर्यतो भवेत् । क्रोधाद्यश्च भवेदग्निः क्षान्त्या च वसुधासमः ।। 7.26.34 ।।
transliteration: dharmato yo bhavedvipraḥ kṣatriyo vīryato bhavet | krodhādyaśca bhavedagniḥ kṣāntyā ca vasudhāsamaḥ || 7.26.34 ||
translation: धर्मतस् by righteousness, यः who, भवेत् would be, विप्रः a Brahmin, क्षत्रियः a Kshatriya, वीर्यतस् by valor, भवेत् would be, क्रोधात् from anger, यः च and who, भवेत् would be, अग्निः fire, क्षान्त्या by patience, च and, वसुधासमः equal to the earth.
explanation: He (Nalakubara) is like a Brahmin by righteousness, a Kshatriya by valor, fire by his anger, and equal to the earth in patience.

shloka_text: तस्यास्मि कृतसङ्केता लोकपालसुतस्य वै । तमुद्दिश्य तु मे सर्वं विभूषणमिदं कृतम् ।। 7.26.35 ।।
transliteration: tasyāsmi kṛtasaṅketā lokapālasutasya vai | tamuddiśya tu me sarvaṃ vibhūṣaṇamidaṃ kṛtam || 7.26.35 ||
translation: तस्य of him, अस्मि I am, कृतसङ्केता one who has made a promise, लोकपालसुतस्य of the son of a Lokapala, वै indeed, तम् him, उद्दिश्य intending, तु but, मे my, सर्वम् all, विभूषणम् ornaments, इदम् this, कृतम् made.
explanation: I am indeed promised to him, the son of a Lokapala, and all these ornaments I wear are for his sake.

shloka_text: तथा तस्य हि नान्यस्य भावो मां प्रति तिष्ठति ।। 7.26.36 ।।
transliteration: tathā tasya hi nānyasya bhāvo māṃ prati tiṣṭhati || 7.26.36 ||
translation: तथा thus, तस्य of him, हि indeed, न not, अन्यस्य of another, भावः feeling, माम् me, प्रति towards, तिष्ठति exists.
explanation: Thus, my affection is indeed for him alone, and not for anyone else.

shloka_text: तेन सत्येन मां राजन्मोक्तुमर्हस्यरिन्दम ।। 7.26.37 ।।
transliteration: tena satyena māṃ rājanmoktumarhasyarindama || 7.26.37 ||
translation: तेन by that, सत्येन truth, माम् me, राजन् O king, मोक्तुम् to release, अर्हसि you ought, अरिन्दम O destroyer of enemies
explanation: O King, destroyer of enemies, by that truth, you ought to release me.

shloka_text: स हि तिष्ठति धर्मात्मा मां प्रतीक्ष्य समुत्सुकः । तत्र विघ्नं सुतस्येह कर्तुं नार्हसि मुञ्च माम् ।। 7.26.38 ।।
transliteration: sa hi tiṣṭhati dharmātmā māṃ pratīkṣya samutsukaḥ | tatra vighnaṃ sutasyeha kartuṃ nārhasi muñca mām || 7.26.38 ||
translation: सः he, हि indeed, तिष्ठति waits, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, माम् me, प्रतीक्ष्य waiting for, समुत्सुकः very eager, तत्र there, विघ्नम् an obstacle, सुतस्य for the son, इह here, कर्तुम् to create, न not, अर्हसि you ought, मुञ्च release, माम् me
explanation: Indeed, that righteous one waits for me, very eager; you ought not to create an obstacle for your son in this matter, so release me.

shloka_text: सद्भिराचरितं मार्गं गच्छ राक्षसुपुङ्गव । माननीयो मम त्वं हि पालनीया तथा ऽस्मि ते ।। 7.26.39 ।।
transliteration: sadbhirācaritaṃ mārgaṃ gaccha rākṣasupuṅgava | mānanīyo mama tvaṃ hi pālanīyā tathā 'smi te || 7.26.39 ||
translation: सद्भिः by the good people, आचरितम् practiced, मार्गम् path, गच्छ follow, राक्षसपुङ्गव O best of Rakshasas, माननीयः worthy of respect, मम to me, त्वम् you, हि indeed, पालनीया to be protected, तथा similarly, अस्मि I am, ते by you
explanation: O best of Rakshasas, follow the path practiced by the good; you are indeed worthy of respect to me, and I am similarly to be protected by you.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः प्रत्युवाच विनीतवत् । स्नुषा ऽस्मि यदवोचस्त्वमेकपत्नीष्वयं क्रमः । देवलोकस्थितिरियं सुराणां शाश्वती मता ।। 7.26.40 ।।
transliteration: evamukto daśagrīvaḥ pratyuvāca vinītavat | snuṣā 'smi yadavocastvamekapatnīṣvayaṃ kramaḥ | devalokasthitiriyaṃ surāṇāṃ śāśvatī matā || 7.26.40 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रत्युवाच replied, विनीतवत् as if humbly, स्नुषा daughter-in-law, अस्मि I am, यत् that which, अवोचः you said, त्वम् you, एकपत्नीषु among those with one husband, अयम् this, क्रमः custom, देवलोकस्थितिः the custom of the divine world, इयम् this, सुराणाम् of the gods, शाश्वती eternal, मता considered
explanation: Thus addressed, Dashagriva replied as if humbly, saying that what she spoke about being a daughter-in-law and the custom of having one husband applies only to women with a single spouse, and that this custom of the divine world for gods is considered eternal.

shloka_text: पतिरप्सरसां नास्ति न चैकस्त्रीपरिग्रहः ।। 7.26.41 ।।
transliteration: patirapsarasāṃ nāsti na caikastrīparigrahaḥ || 7.26.41 ||
translation: पतिः husband, अप्सरसाम् of Apsaras, न not, अस्ति exists, न nor, च and, एकस्त्रीपरिग्रहः the custom of having one wife
explanation: There is no single husband for Apsaras, nor is there a custom of having only one wife.

shloka_text: अस्मि यदवोचस्त्वमेकपत्नीष्वयं क्रमः । एवमुक्त्वा स तां रक्षो निवेश्य च शिलातले । कामभोगाभिसंसक्तो मैथुनायोपचक्रमे ।। 7.26.42 ।।
transliteration: asmi yadavocastvamekapatnīṣvayaṃ kramaḥ | evamuktvā sa tāṃ rakṣo niveśya ca śilātale | kāmabhogābhisaṃsakto maithunāyopacakrame || 7.26.42 ||
translation: अस्मि I am, यत् what, अवोचः you said, त्वम् you, एकपत्नीषु among chaste wives, अयम् this, क्रमः rule, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, सः he, ताम् her, रक्षः the demon, निवेश्य having placed, च and, शिलातले on a rock surface, कामभोगाभिसंसक्तः deeply engrossed in sensual pleasures, मैथुनाय for sexual union, उपचक्रमे began.
explanation: Having said, "I am what you said, this is the rule among chaste wives," the demon Ravana, deeply engrossed in sensual pleasures, placed her on a rock surface and proceeded to engage in sexual union.

shloka_text: सा विमुक्ता ततो रम्भा भ्रष्टमाल्यविभूषणा । गजेन्द्राक्रीडमथिता नदीवाकुलतां गता ।। 7.26.43 ।।
transliteration: sā vimuktā tato rambhā bhraṣṭamālyavibhūṣaṇā | gajendrākrīḍamathitā nadīvākulatāṃ gatā || 7.26.43 ||
translation: सा she, विमुक्ता released, ततः then, रम्भा Rambha, भ्रष्टमाल्यविभूषणा with fallen garlands and ornaments, गजेन्द्राक्रीडमथिता churned by the sport of a lordly elephant, नदी a river, इव like, आकुलताम् agitation, गता attained.
explanation: Rambha, thus released, with her garlands and ornaments fallen, became agitated like a river churned by the sport of a lordly elephant.

shloka_text: लुलिताकुलकेशान्ता करवेपितपल्लवा । पवनेनावधूतेव लता कुसुमशालिनी ।। 7.26.44 ।।
transliteration: lulitākulakeśāntā karavepitapallavā | pavanenāvadhūteva latā kusumaśālinī || 7.26.44 ||
translation: लुलिताकुलकेशान्ता with disheveled and scattered hair, करवेपितपल्लवा with trembling hands (like trembling sprouts), पवनेन by the wind, अवधूता shaken, इव like, लता a creeper, कुसुमशालिनी adorned with flowers.
explanation: Her hair was disheveled and scattered, and her hands trembled like sprouts, resembling a flower-laden creeper shaken by the wind.

shloka_text: सा वेपमाना लज्जन्ती भीता करकृताञ्जलिः । नलकूबरमासाद्य पादयोर्निपपात ह ।। 7.26.45 ।।
transliteration: sā vepamānā lajjantī bhītā karakṛtāñjaliḥ | nalakūbaramāsādya pādayornipapāta ha || 7.26.45 ||
translation: सा she, वेपमाना trembling, लज्जन्ती feeling ashamed, भीता frightened, करकृताञ्जलिः with hands joined in supplication, नलकूबरम् Nalakubara, आसाद्य having approached, पादयोः at the feet, निपपात fell down, ह indeed.
explanation: Trembling, ashamed, and frightened, she approached Nalakubara with folded hands and fell at his feet.

shloka_text: तदवस्थां च तां दृष्ट्वा महात्मा नलकूबरः । अब्रवीत्किमिदं भद्रे पादयोः पतिता ऽसि मे ।। 7.26.46 ।।
transliteration: tadavasthāṃ ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mahātmā nalakūbaraḥ | abravītkimidaṃ bhadre pādayoḥ patitā 'si me || 7.26.46 ||
translation: तत् that, अवस्थाम् state, च and, ताम् her, दृष्ट्वा having seen, महात्मा the great-souled, नलकूबरः Nalakubara, अब्रवीत् said, किम् what, इदम् this, भद्रे O gentle one, पादयोः at the feet, पतिता fallen, असि you are, मे my.
explanation: Seeing her in that state, the great-souled Nalakubara asked, "O gentle one, what is this, that you have fallen at my feet?"

shloka_text: सा वै निःश्वसमाना तु वेपमाना कृताञ्जलिः । तस्मै सर्वं यथातत्त्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे ।। 7.26.47 ।।
transliteration: sā vai niḥśvasamānā tu vepamānā kṛtāñjaliḥ | tasmai sarvaṃ yathātattvamākhyātumupacakrame || 7.26.47 ||
translation: सा she, वै indeed, निःश्वसमाना sighing deeply, तु and, वेपमाना trembling, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, तस्मै to him, सर्वं all, यथातत्त्वम् as it truly happened, आख्यातुम् to narrate, उपचक्रमे began.
explanation: Trembling and sighing deeply, she, with folded hands, began to narrate everything to him exactly as it had happened.

shloka_text: एष देव दशग्रीवः प्राप्तो गन्तुं त्रिविष्टपम् । तेन सैन्यसहायेन निशेयं परिणामिता ।। 7.26.48 ।।
transliteration: eṣa deva daśagrīvaḥ prāpto gantuṃ triviṣṭapam | tena sainyasahāyena niśeyaṃ pariṇāmitā || 7.26.48 ||
translation: एष this, देव O god, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्राप्तः arrived, गन्तुम् to go, त्रिविष्टपम् to heaven, तेन by him, सैन्यसहायेन with the help of his army, निशा इयम् this night, परिणामिता was passed.
explanation: O god, this Dashagriva arrived here to go to heaven, and with the help of his army, he spent this night.

shloka_text: आयन्ती तेन दृष्टा ऽस्मि त्वत्सकाशमरिन्दम । गृहीता तेन पृष्टा ऽस्मि कस्य त्वमिति रक्षसा ।। 7.26.49 ।।
transliteration: āyantī tena dṛṣṭā 'smi tvatsakāśamarindama | gṛhītā tena pṛṣṭā 'smi kasya tvamiti rakṣasā || 7.26.49 ||
translation: आयन्ती while coming, तेन by him, दृष्टा seen, अस्मि I am, त्वत्सकाशम् to your presence, अरिन्दम O destroyer of enemies, गृहीता seized, तेन by him, पृष्टा asked, अस्मि I am, कस्य whose, त्वम् you, इति thus, रक्षसा by the Rakshasa.
explanation: O destroyer of enemies, I was seen by him while coming to your presence, and I was seized and asked by that Rakshasa, "Whose are you?"

shloka_text: मया तु सर्वं यत्सत्यं तस्मै सर्वं निवेदितम् । काममोहाभिभूतात्मा नाश्रौषीत्तद्वचो मम ।। 7.26.50 ।।
transliteration: mayā tu sarvaṃ yatsatyaṃ tasmai sarvaṃ niveditam | kāmamohābhibhūtātmā nāśrauṣīttadvaco mama || 7.26.50 ||
translation: मया by me, तु but, सर्वं all, यत् सत्यम् which was true, तस्मै to him, सर्वं all, निवेदितम् was reported, काममोहाभिभूतात्मा whose mind was overcome by lust and delusion, न not, अश्रौषीत् heard, तत् that, वचः word, मम my.
explanation: But I reported everything truly to him, yet his mind, overcome by lust and delusion, did not listen to my words.

shloka_text: याच्यमानो मया देव स्नुषा ते ऽहमिति प्रभो । तत्सर्वं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा बलात्तेनास्मि धर्षिता ।। 7.26.51 ।।
transliteration: yācyamāno mayā deva snuṣā te 'hamiti prabho | tatsarvaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā balāttenāsmi dharṣitā || 7.26.51 ||
translation: याच्यमानः being implored, मया by me, देव O god, स्नुषा daughter-in-law, ते your, अहम् I, इति thus, प्रभो O lord, तत् सर्वम् all that, पृष्ठतः कृत्वा having put aside, बलात् by force, तेन by him, अस्मि I am, धर्षिता violated.
explanation: O god, O lord, despite being implored by me that I am your daughter-in-law, he disregarded all that and forcibly violated me.

shloka_text: एवं त्वमपराधं मे क्षन्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत । न हि तुल्यं बलं सौम्य स्त्रियाश्च पुरुषस्य च ।। 7.26.52 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ tvamaparādhaṃ me kṣantumarhasi suvrata | na hi tulyaṃ balaṃ saumya striyāśca puruṣasya ca || 7.26.52 ||
translation: एवम् thus, त्वम् you, अपराधम् offense, मे my, क्षन्तुम् to forgive, अर्हसि ought, सुव्रत O one of good vows, न not, हि indeed, तुल्यम् equal, बलम् strength, सौम्य O gentle one, स्त्रियाः of a woman, च and, पुरुषस्य of a man, च and,
explanation: O virtuous and gentle one, you ought to forgive my offense, for indeed, the strength of a woman and a man is not equal.

shloka_text: एतछुत्वा तु सङ्क्रुद्धस्तदा वैश्रवणात्मजः । धर्षणां तां परां श्रुत्वा ध्यानं सम्प्रविवेश ह ।। 7.26.53 ।।
transliteration: etachutvā tu saṅkruddhastadā vaiśravaṇātmajaḥ | dharṣaṇāṃ tāṃ parāṃ śrutvā dhyānaṃ sampraviveśa ha || 7.26.53 ||
translation: एतत् this, श्रुत्वा having heard, तु but, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, तदा then, वैश्रवणात्मजः the son of Vaishravana, धर्षणाम् outrage, ताम् that, पराम् extreme, श्रुत्वा having heard, ध्यानम् deep thought, सम्प्रविवेश entered completely, ह indeed,
explanation: Having heard this, the son of Vaishravana (Kubera) became greatly enraged and, upon hearing of that extreme outrage, he entered into deep contemplation.

shloka_text: तस्य तत्कर्म विज्ञाय तदा वैश्रवणात्मजः । मुहूर्तात्क्रोधताम्राक्षस्तोयं जग्राह पाणिना ।। 7.26.54 ।।
transliteration: tasya tatkarma vijñāya tadā vaiśravaṇātmajaḥ | muhūrtātkrodhatāmrākṣastoyaṃ jagrāha pāṇinā || 7.26.54 ||
translation: तस्य his, तत् that, कर्म deed, विज्ञाय having understood, तदा then, वैश्रवणात्मजः the son of Vaishravana, मुहूर्तात् in a moment, क्रोधताम्राक्षः with eyes red from anger, तोयम् water, जग्राह took, पाणिना with his hand,
explanation: Having understood that deed of his, the son of Vaishravana (Kubera) instantly, with eyes red from anger, took water in his hand.

shloka_text: गृहीत्वा सलिलं सर्वमुपस्पृश्य यथाविधि । उत्ससर्ज यथा शापं राक्षसेन्द्राय दारुणम् ।। 7.26.55 ।।
transliteration: gṛhītvā salilaṃ sarvamupaspṛśya yathāvidhi | utsasarja yathā śāpaṃ rākṣasendrāya dāruṇam || 7.26.55 ||
