translation: गृहीत्वा having taken, सलिलम् water, सर्वम् all, उपस्पृश्य having touched, यथाविधि according to the ritual, उत्ससर्ज he released, यथा as, शापम् a curse, राक्षसेन्द्राय to the king of Rakshasas, दारुणम् terrible,
explanation: Having taken the water and performed the ritual purification, he then uttered a terrible curse upon the king of Rakshasas (Ravana).

shloka_text: अकामा तेन यस्मात्त्वं बलाद्भद्रे प्रधर्षिता । तस्मात्स युवतीमन्यां नाकामामुपयास्यति ।। 7.26.56 ।।
transliteration: akāmā tena yasmāttvaṃ balādbhadre pradharṣitā | tasmātsa yuvatīmanyāṃ nākāmāmupayāsyati || 7.26.56 ||
translation: अकामा unwilling, तेन by him, यस्मात् because, त्वम् you, बलात् by force, भद्रे O auspicious one, प्रधर्षिता molested, तस्मात् therefore, सः he, युवतीम् a young woman, अन्याम् another, न not, अकामाम् unwilling, उपयास्यति will approach,
explanation: O auspicious one, because you were molested by him by force against your will, therefore he will not approach another young woman who is unwilling.

shloka_text: यदा ह्यकामां कामार्तो धर्षयिष्यति योषितम् । मूर्धा तु सप्तधा तस्य शकलीभविता तदा ।। 7.26.57 ।।
transliteration: yadā hyakāmāṃ kāmārto dharṣayiṣyati yoṣitam | mūrdhā tu saptadhā tasya śakalībhavitā tadā || 7.26.57 ||
translation: यदा when, हि indeed, अकामां an unwilling, कामार्तः lust-struck, धर्षयिष्यति will violate, योषितम् a woman, मूर्धा head, तु but, सप्तधा into seven parts, तस्य his, शकलीभविता will be shattered, तदा then.
explanation: When a lust-struck man violates an unwilling woman, his head will indeed shatter into seven pieces.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्नुदाहृते शापे ज्वलिताग्निसमप्रभे । देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिश्च खाच्च्युता । पितामहमुखाश्चैव सर्वे देवाः प्रहर्षिताः ।। 7.26.58 ।।
transliteration: tasminnudāhṛte śāpe jvalitāgnisamaprabhe | devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiśca khāccyutā | pitāmahamukhāścaiva sarve devāḥ praharṣitāḥ || 7.26.58 ||
translation: तस्मिन् upon that, उदाहृते having been uttered, शापे curse, ज्वलिताग्निसमप्रभे shining like a blazing fire, देवदुन्दुभयः divine drums, नेदुः resounded, पुष्पवृष्टिः a shower of flowers, च and, खात् from the sky, च्युता fell, पितामहमुखाः led by Brahma, च and, एव indeed, सर्वे all, देवाः gods, प्रहर्षिताः greatly delighted.
explanation: Upon the utterance of that curse, which shone like a blazing fire, divine drums resounded, a shower of flowers fell from the sky, and all the gods, led by Brahma, were greatly delighted.

shloka_text: ज्ञात्वा लोकगतिं सर्वां तस्य मृत्युं च रक्षसः । ऋषयः पितरश्चैव प्रीतिमापुरनुत्तमाम् ।। 7.26.59 ।।
transliteration: jñātvā lokagatiṃ sarvāṃ tasya mṛtyuṃ ca rakṣasaḥ | ṛṣayaḥ pitaraścaiva prītimāpuranuttamām || 7.26.59 ||
translation: ज्ञात्वा having known, लोकगतिं the course of the world, सर्वां all, तस्य his, मृत्युं death, च and, रक्षसः of the demon, ऋषयः sages, पितरः ancestors, च and, एव indeed, प्रीतिम् joy, आपुः attained, अनुत्तमाम् unsurpassed.
explanation: Understanding the entire course of the world and the demon's impending death, the sages and ancestors indeed experienced unsurpassed joy.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा तु स दशग्रीवस्तं शापं रोमहर्षणम् । नारीषु मैथुने भावं नाकामास्वभ्यरोचयत् ।। 7.26.60 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu sa daśagrīvastaṃ śāpaṃ romaharṣaṇam | nārīṣu maithune bhāvaṃ nākāmāsvabhyarocayat || 7.26.60 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु but, स he, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, तं that, शापं curse, रोमहर्षणम् hair-raising, नारीषु among women, मैथुने in sexual intercourse, भावं inclination, न not, अकामासु unwilling, अभ्यरोचयत् he approved.
explanation: But having heard that terrifying, hair-raising curse, Dashagriva no longer desired sexual intimacy with unwilling women.

shloka_text: तेन नीताः स्त्रियः प्रीतिमापुः सर्वाः पतिव्रताः । नलकूबरनिर्मुक्तं शापं श्रुत्वा मनःप्रियम् ।। 7.26.61 ।।
transliteration: tena nītāḥ striyaḥ prītimāpuḥ sarvāḥ pativratāḥ | nalakūbaranirmuktaṃ śāpaṃ śrutvā manaḥpriyam || 7.26.61 ||
translation: तेन by that, नीताः taken, स्त्रियः women, प्रीतिम् joy, आपुः attained, सर्वाः all, पतिव्रताः chaste, नलकूबरनिर्मुक्तं uttered by Nalakubara, शापं curse, श्रुत्वा having heard, मनःप्रियम् pleasing to the mind.
explanation: All the chaste women who had been abducted by him attained great joy upon hearing that delightful curse uttered by Nalakubara. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षड्वविंशः सर्गः ।। 26 ।। Thus ends the twenty-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: कैलासं लङ्घयित्वाथ दशग्रीवः स रावणः । आससाद महातेजा इन्द्रलोकं निशाचरः ।। 7.27.1 ।।
transliteration: kailāsaṃ laṅghayitvātha daśagrīvaḥ sa rāvaṇaḥ | āsasāda mahātejā indralokaṃ niśācaraḥ || 7.27.1 ||
translation: कैलासं Kailasam, Kailasa mountain, लङ्घयित्वाथ laṅghayitvā atha, having crossed, then, दशग्रीवः daśagrīvaḥ, ten-necked, स sa, that, रावणः rāvaṇaḥ, Ravana, आससाद āsasāda, reached, महातेजा mahātejā, greatly powerful, इन्द्रलोकं indralokaṃ, Indra's world, निशाचरः niśācaraḥ, night-wanderer.
explanation: After crossing the Kailasa mountain, that greatly powerful ten-necked demon Ravana reached the world of Indra.
comments: Ravana reaches Indra's heaven -- the fearful Indra seeks Vishnu's aid, but Vishnu, declining to fight the boon-protected Ravana now, vows to be the cause of his death in time -- the gods sally forth and battle is joined -- Ravana's grandfather Sumali rampages through the divine host until the Vasu Savitra crushes him to ashes with his mace, and the rakshasas flee.

shloka_text: तस्य राक्षससैन्यस्य समन्तादुपयास्यतः । देवलोकं ययौ शब्दो मथ्यमानार्णवोपमः ।। 7.27.2 ।।
transliteration: tasya rākṣasasainyasya samantādupayāsyataḥ | devalokaṃ yayau śabdo mathyamānārṇavopamaḥ || 7.27.2 ||
translation: तस्य tasya, of that, राक्षससैन्यस्य rākṣasasainyasya, of the demon army, समन्तादुपयास्यतः samantādupayāsyataḥ, approaching from all sides, देवलोकं devalokaṃ, to the world of gods, ययौ yayau, went, शब्दो śabdo, sound, मथ्यमानार्णवोपमः mathyamānārṇavopamaḥ, like the churning ocean.
explanation: The sound of that demon army approaching from all sides reached the world of the gods, resembling the roar of a churning ocean.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा तु रावणं प्राप्तमिन्द्रश्चलित आसनात् । अब्रवीत्तत्र तान् देवान् सर्वानेव समागतान् ।। 7.27.3 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu rāvaṇaṃ prāptamindraścalita āsanāt | abravīttatra tān devān sarvāneva samāgatān || 7.27.3 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा śrutvā, having heard, तु tu, indeed, रावणं rāvaṇaṃ, Ravana, प्राप्तम् prāptam, arrived, इन्द्रश्चलित indraścalita, Indra moved, आसनात् āsanāt, from his seat, अब्रवीत्तत्र abravīttatra, spoke there, तान् tān, to those, देवान् devān, gods, सर्वानेव sarvāneva, all indeed, समागतान् samāgatān, assembled.
explanation: Having heard that Ravana had arrived, Indra moved from his seat and spoke to all the assembled gods there.

shloka_text: आदित्यान्सवसून्रुद्रान्विश्वान्साध्यान्मरुद्गणान् । सज्जीभवत युद्धार्थं रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ।। 7.27.4 ।।
transliteration: ādityānsavasūnrudrānviśvānsādhyānmarudgaṇān | sajjībhavata yuddhārthaṃ rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ || 7.27.4 ||
translation: आदित्यान्सवसून्रुद्रान्विश्वान्साध्यान्मरुद्गणान् ādityānsavasūnrudrānviśvānsādhyānmarudgaṇān, Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Vishvas, Sadhyas, Maruts, सज्जीभवत sajjībhavata, be ready, युद्धार्थं yuddhārthaṃ, for battle, रावणस्य rāvaṇasya, of Ravana, दुरात्मनः durātmanaḥ, the evil-minded.
explanation: He commanded the Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Vishvas, Sadhyas, and Maruts to prepare for battle against the evil-minded Ravana.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तास्तु शक्रेण देवाः शक्रसमा युधि । सन्नह्य सुमहासत्त्वा युद्धश्रद्धासमन्विताः ।। 7.27.5 ।।
transliteration: evamuktāstu śakreṇa devāḥ śakrasamā yudhi | sannahya sumahāsattvā yuddhaśraddhāsamanvitāḥ || 7.27.5 ||
translation: एवमुक्तास्तु evamuktāstu, thus spoken indeed, शक्रेण śakreṇa, by Indra, देवाः devāḥ, gods, शक्रसमा śakrasamā, equal to Indra, युधि yudhi, in battle, सन्नह्य sannahya, having armored themselves, सुमहासत्त्वा sumahāsattvā, very great-spirited, युद्धश्रद्धासमन्विताः yuddhaśraddhāsamanvitāḥ, filled with eagerness for battle.
explanation: Thus addressed by Indra, the gods, who were as mighty as Indra in battle and possessed great courage, armored themselves, filled with eagerness for the fight.

shloka_text: स तु दीनः परित्रस्तो महेन्द्रो रावणं प्रति । विष्णोः समीपमागत्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.27.6 ।।
transliteration: sa tu dīnaḥ paritrasto mahendro rāvaṇaṃ prati | viṣṇoḥ samīpamāgatya vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.27.6 ||
translation: सः he, तु indeed, दीनः distressed, परित्रस्तः greatly frightened, महेन्द्रः Mahendra (Indra), रावणं Ravana, प्रति towards, विष्णोः of Vishnu, समीपम् near, आगत्य having come, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.
explanation: Distressed and greatly frightened by Ravana, Indra indeed approached Vishnu and spoke these words.

shloka_text: विष्णो कथं करिष्यामि महावीर्यपराक्रमः । असौ हि बलवद्रक्षो युद्धार्थमभिवर्तते ।। 7.27.7 ।।
transliteration: viṣṇo kathaṃ kariṣyāmi mahāvīryaparākramaḥ | asau hi balavadrakṣo yuddhārthamabhivartate || 7.27.7 ||
translation: विष्णो O Vishnu, कथं how, करिष्यामि shall I act, महावीर्यपराक्रमः of great valor and might, असौ this one, हि indeed, बलवत् powerful, रक्षः demon, युद्धार्थम् for battle, अभिवर्तते approaches.
explanation: O Vishnu, how shall I act, for this demon of great valor and might, this powerful Rakshasa, is indeed approaching for battle.

shloka_text: वरप्रदानाद्बलवान्न खल्वन्येन हेतुना । तत्तु सत्यवचः कार्यं यदुक्तं पद्मयोनिना ।। 7.27.8 ।।
transliteration: varapradānādbalavānna khalvanyena hetunā | tattu satyavacaḥ kāryaṃ yaduktaṃ padmayoninā || 7.27.8 ||
translation: वरप्रदानात् due to the boon, बलवान् powerful, न not, खलु indeed, अन्येन by any other, हेतुना reason, तत् that, तु indeed, सत्यवचः true word, कार्यं should be made, यत् which, उक्तं was spoken, पद्मयोनिना by Brahma.
explanation: He is powerful due to the boon granted, and not for any other reason; therefore, that true word spoken by Brahma must indeed be fulfilled.

shloka_text: तद्यथा नमुचिर्वृत्रो बलिर्नरकशम्बरौ । त्वद्बलं समवष्टभ्य मया दग्धास्तथा कुरु ।। 7.27.9 ।।
transliteration: tadyathā namucirvṛtro balirnarakaśambarau | tvadbalaṃ samavaṣṭabhya mayā dagdhāstathā kuru || 7.27.9 ||
translation: तत् therefore, यथा just as, नमुचिः Namuchi, वृत्रः Vritra, बलिः Bali, नरक Naraka, शम्बरौ and Shambara, त्वद्बलं your strength, समवष्टभ्य having relied upon, मया by me, दग्धाः were destroyed, तथा so, कुरु do.
explanation: Therefore, just as Namuchi, Vritra, Bali, Naraka, and Shambara were destroyed by me with the support of your strength, so too act now.

shloka_text: नह्यन्यो देवदेवेश त्वामृते मधुसूदन । गतिः परायणं नास्ति त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे ।। 7.27.10 ।।
transliteration: nahyanyo devadeveśa tvāmṛte madhusūdana | gatiḥ parāyaṇaṃ nāsti trailokye sacarācare || 7.27.10 ||
translation: न not, हि indeed, अन्यः another, देवदेवेश O Lord of gods, त्वाम् you, ऋते without, मधुसूदन O Madhusudana, गतिः refuge, परायणं ultimate resort, न not, अस्ति is, त्रैलोक्ये in the three worlds, सचराचरे with all moving and non-moving beings.
explanation: Indeed, O Lord of gods, O Madhusudana, there is no other refuge or ultimate resort in the three worlds, with all their moving and non-moving beings, except for you.

shloka_text: त्वं हि नारायणः श्रीमान्पद्मनाभः सनातनः । त्वयेमे स्थापिता लोकाः शक्रश्चाहं सुरेश्वरः ।। 7.27.11 ।।
transliteration: tvaṃ hi nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmānpadmanābhaḥ sanātanaḥ | tvayeme sthāpitā lokāḥ śakraścāhaṃ sureśvaraḥ || 7.27.11 ||
translation: त्वं you, हि indeed, नारायणः Narayana, श्रीमान् glorious, पद्मनाभः lotus-navelled, सनातनः eternal, त्वया by you, इमे these, स्थापिताः established, लोकाः worlds, शक्रः Indra, च and, अहं I, सुरेश्वरः lord of gods.
explanation: Indra acknowledges Rama as the glorious, eternal Narayana, the lotus-navelled one, by whom all these worlds, including Indra himself as the lord of gods, were established.

shloka_text: त्वया सृष्टमिदं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । त्वामेव भगवन्सर्वे प्रविशन्ति युगक्षये ।। 7.27.12 ।।
transliteration: tvayā sṛṣṭamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram | tvāmeva bhagavansarve praviśanti yugakṣaye || 7.27.12 ||
translation: त्वया by you, सृष्टम् created, इदं this, सर्वं all, त्रैलोक्यं three worlds, सचराचरम् with moving and non-moving beings, त्वाम् into you, एव indeed, भगवन् O Lord, सर्वे all, प्रविशन्ति enter, युगक्षये at the dissolution of the age.
explanation: Indra further states that all these three worlds, with their moving and non-moving beings, were created by the Lord, and at the end of an age, all beings ultimately merge back into Him.

shloka_text: तदाचक्ष्व यथा तत्त्वं देवदेव मम स्वयम् । अपि चक्रसहायस्त्वं योत्स्यसे रावणं प्रभो ।। 7.27.13 ।।
transliteration: tadācakṣva yathā tattvaṃ devadeva mama svayam | api cakrasahāyastvaṃ yotsyase rāvaṇaṃ prabho || 7.27.13 ||
translation: तत् therefore, आचक्ष्व tell, यथा how, तत्त्वं truly, देवदेव O God of gods, मम to me, स्वयम् yourself, अपि whether, चक्रसहायः aided by your discus, त्वं you, योत्स्यसे will fight, रावणं Ravana, प्रभो O Lord.
explanation: Indra implores the Lord of gods to reveal truly how He, even with the aid of His discus, intends to fight Ravana.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तः स शक्रेण देवो नारायणः प्रभुः । अब्रवीन्न परित्रासः कर्तव्यः श्रूयतां च मे ।। 7.27.14 ।।
transliteration: evamuktaḥ sa śakreṇa devo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | abravīnna paritrāsaḥ kartavyaḥ śrūyatāṃ ca me || 7.27.14 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, सः that, शक्रेण by Indra, देवः god, नारायणः Narayana, प्रभुः the Lord, अब्रवीत् said, न not, परित्रासः great fear, कर्तव्यः should be entertained, श्रूयतां let it be heard, च and, मे by me.
explanation: Thus addressed by Indra, the Lord Narayana replied that there was no need for such great fear, and asked Indra to listen to His words.

shloka_text: न तावदेष दुष्टात्मा शक्यो जेतुं सुरासुरैः । हन्तुं चापि समासाद्य वरदानेन दुर्जयः ।। 7.27.15 ।।
transliteration: na tāvadeṣa duṣṭātmā śakyo jetuṃ surāsuraiḥ | hantuṃ cāpi samāsādya varadānena durjayaḥ || 7.27.15 ||
translation: न not, तावत् indeed, एषः this, दुष्टात्मा evil-souled one, शक्यः possible, जेतुम् to conquer, सुरासुरैः by gods and asuras, हन्तुं to kill, च and, अपि even, समासाद्य having approached, वरदानेन by the boon, दुर्जयः unconquerable.
explanation: The Lord explained that this evil-souled Ravana is currently unconquerable by gods or asuras, and cannot be killed even if approached, due to the boon he has received.

shloka_text: सर्वथा तु महत्कर्म करिष्यति बलोत्कटः । राक्षसः पुत्रसहितो दृष्टमेतन्निसर्गतः ।। 7.27.16 ।।
transliteration: sarvathā tu mahatkarma kariṣyati balotkaṭaḥ | rākṣasaḥ putrasahito dṛṣṭametannisargataḥ || 7.27.16 ||
translation: सर्वथा certainly, तु indeed, महत्कर्म a great deed, करिष्यति will perform, बलोत्कटः exceedingly powerful, राक्षसः the demon, पुत्रसहितो along with his sons, दृष्टम् seen, एतत् this, निसर्गतः by nature.
explanation: It is inherently observed that this exceedingly powerful demon, along with his sons, will certainly perform a great deed.

shloka_text: यत्तु मां त्वमभाषिष्ठ युद्ध्यस्वेति सुरेश्वर । नाहं तं प्रतियोत्स्यामि रावणं राक्षसं युधि ।। 7.27.17 ।।
transliteration: yattu māṃ tvamabhāṣiṣṭha yuddhyasveti sureśvara | nāhaṃ taṃ pratiyotsyāmi rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasaṃ yudhi || 7.27.17 ||
translation: यत् that which, तु but, माम् me, त्वम् you, अभाषिष्ठ spoke, युद्ध्यस्व fight, इति thus, सुरेश्वर O lord of gods, न not, अहम् I, तम् him, प्रतियोत्स्यामि will fight against, रावणम् Ravana, राक्षसम् the demon, युधि in battle.
explanation: O lord of gods, regarding what you told me to fight, I will not fight against that demon Ravana in battle.

shloka_text: नाहत्वा समरे शत्रुं विष्णुः प्रतिनिवर्तते । दुर्लभश्चैव कामो ऽद्य वरगुप्ताद्धि रावणात् ।। 7.27.18 ।।
transliteration: nāhatvā samare śatruṃ viṣṇuḥ pratinivartate | durlabhaścaiva kāmo 'dya varaguptāddhi rāvaṇāt || 7.27.18 ||
translation: न not, अहत्वा without killing, समरे in battle, शत्रुम् the enemy, विष्णुः Vishnu, प्रतिनिवर्तते returns, दुर्लभः difficult to obtain, च and, एव indeed, कामः the desire, अद्य now, वरगुप्तात् protected by boons, हि indeed, रावणात् from Ravana.
explanation: Vishnu does not return from battle without killing the enemy, and indeed, it is difficult to fulfill this desire now because Ravana is protected by boons.

shloka_text: प्रतिजाने च देवेन्द्र त्वत्समीपे शतक्रतो । भविता ऽस्मि यथा ऽस्याहं रक्षसो मृत्युकारणम् ।। 7.27.19 ।।
transliteration: pratijāne ca devendra tvatsamīpe śatakrato | bhavitā 'smi yathā 'syāhaṃ rakṣaso mṛtyukāraṇam || 7.27.19 ||
translation: प्रतिजाने I promise, च and, देवेन्द्र O king of gods, त्वत्समीपे in your presence, शतक्रतो O Shatakratu, भविता will be, अस्मि I am, यथा as, अस्य of this, अहम् I, रक्षसः of the demon, मृत्युकारणम् the cause of death.
explanation: And O king of gods, O Shatakratu, I promise in your presence that I shall indeed be the cause of this demon's death.

shloka_text: अहमेव निहन्ता ऽस्मि रावणं सपुरःसरम् । देवता नन्दयिष्यामि ज्ञात्वा कालमुपागतम् । एतत्ते कथितं तत्त्वं देवराज शचीपते ।। 7.27.20 ।।
transliteration: ahameva nihantā 'smi rāvaṇaṃ sapuraḥsaram | devatā nandayiṣyāmi jñātvā kālamupāgatam | etatte kathitaṃ tattvaṃ devarāja śacīpate || 7.27.20 ||
translation: अहम् I, एव alone, निहन्ता the killer, अस्मि I am, रावणम् Ravana, सपुरःसरम् along with his followers, देवताः the gods, नन्दयिष्यामि I will gladden, ज्ञात्वा having known, कालम् the time, उपागतम् arrived, एतत् this, ते to you, कथितम् told, तत्त्वम् the truth, देवराज O king of gods, शचीपते O husband of Shachi.
explanation: I alone will be the killer of Ravana along with his followers, and I will gladden the gods, knowing that the time has come; this truth has been told to you, O king of gods, husband of Shachi.

shloka_text: युद्ध्यस्व विगतत्रासः सर्वैः सार्धं महाबल ।। 7.27.21 ।।
transliteration: yuddhyasva vigatatrāsaḥ sarvaiḥ sārdhaṃ mahābala || 7.27.21 ||
translation: युद्ध्यस्व fight, विगतत्रासः fearless, सर्वैः with all, सार्धम् together, महाबल O mighty one.
explanation: O mighty one, fight fearlessly together with all.

shloka_text: यामि ज्ञात्वा कालमुपागतम् । ततो रुद्राः सहादित्या वसवो मरुतो ऽश्वनौ । सन्नद्धा निर्ययुस्तूर्णं राक्षसानभितः पुरात् ।। 7.27.22 ।।
transliteration: yāmi jñātvā kālamupāgatam | tato rudrāḥ sahādityā vasavo maruto 'śvanau | sannaddhā niryayustūrṇaṃ rākṣasānabhitaḥ purāt || 7.27.22 ||
translation: यामि I go, ज्ञात्वा having known, कालम् time, उपागतम् arrived. ततः then, रुद्राः the Rudras, सह with, आदित्याः the Adityas, वसवः the Vasus, मरुतः the Maruts, अश्वनौ the two Ashvins, सन्नद्धाः ready for battle, निर्ययुः went forth, तूर्णम् quickly, राक्षसान् towards the Rakshasas, अभितः around, पुरात् from the city.
explanation: Knowing that the time had come, I depart; then, the Rudras along with the Adityas, Vasus, Maruts, and the two Ashvins, arrayed for battle, quickly sallied forth from the city towards the Rakshasas.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे नादः शुश्रुवे रजनीक्षये । तस्य रावणसैन्यस्य प्रयुद्धस्य समन्ततः ।। 7.27.23 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare nādaḥ śuśruve rajanīkṣaye | tasya rāvaṇasainyasya prayuddhasya samantataḥ || 7.27.23 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, नादः a sound, शुश्रुवे was heard, रजनीक्षये at the end of the night, तस्य of that, रावणसैन्यस्य of Ravana's army, प्रयुद्धस्य fighting, समन्ततः from all sides.
explanation: In the meantime, at the end of the night, a roar was heard from all sides from Ravana's army, which was engaged in battle.

shloka_text: ते प्रयुद्धा महावीर्या ह्यन्योन्यमभिवीक्ष्य वै । सङ्ग्राममेवाभिमुखा ह्यभवर्तन्त हृष्टवत् ।। 7.27.24 ।।
transliteration: te prayuddhā mahāvīryā hyanyonyamabhivīkṣya vai | saṅgrāmamevābhimukhā hyabhavartanta hṛṣṭavat || 7.27.24 ||
translation: ते they, प्रयुद्धाः fighting, महावीर्याः of great valor, हि indeed, अन्योन्यम् each other, अभिवीक्ष्य having looked at, वै indeed, सङ्ग्रामम् battle, एव only, अभिमुखाः facing, हि indeed, अभवर्तन्त they advanced, हृष्टवत् joyfully.
explanation: Those mighty heroes, engaged in battle, looked at each other and advanced joyfully, intent only on the fight.

shloka_text: ततो दैवतसैन्यनां सङ्क्षोभः समजायत । तदक्षयं महासैन्यं दृष्ट्वा समरमूर्धनि ।। 7.27.25 ।।
transliteration: tato daivatasainyanāṃ saṅkṣobhaḥ samajāyata | tadakṣayaṃ mahāsainyaṃ dṛṣṭvā samaramūrdhani || 7.27.25 ||
translation: ततः then, दैवतसैन्यानाम् of the armies of the gods, सङ्क्षोभः agitation, समजायत arose, तत् that, अक्षयम् inexhaustible, महासैन्यम् great army, दृष्ट्वा having seen, समरमूर्धनि at the forefront of the battle.
explanation: Then, seeing that immense and inexhaustible great army at the forefront of the battle, agitation arose among the armies of the gods.

shloka_text: ततो युद्धं समभवेद्देवदानवरक्षसाम् । घोरं तुमुलनिर्ह्रादं नानाप्रहरणोद्यतम् ।। 7.27.26 ।।
transliteration: tato yuddhaṃ samabhaveddevadānavarakṣasām | ghoraṃ tumulanirhrādaṃ nānāpraharaṇodyatam || 7.27.26 ||
translation: ततो then, युद्धं a battle, समभवेत् occurred, देवदानवरक्षसाम् of gods, demons, and rakshasas, घोरं terrible, तुमुलनिर्ह्रादं with tumultuous roars, नानाप्रहरणोद्यतम् with various weapons raised.
explanation: Then, a terrible battle ensued among the gods, demons, and rakshasas, marked by tumultuous roars and the brandishing of various weapons.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरा राक्षसा घोरदर्शनाः । युद्धार्थं समवर्तन्त सचिवा रावणस्य ते ।। 7.27.27 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare śūrā rākṣasā ghoradarśanāḥ | yuddhārthaṃ samavartanta sacivā rāvaṇasya te || 7.27.27 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, शूराः valiant, राक्षसाः rakshasas, घोरदर्शनाः of terrible appearance, युद्धार्थं for battle, समवर्तन्त assembled, सचिवाः ministers, रावणस्य of Ravana, ते they.
explanation: In the meantime, Ravana's valiant ministers, the rakshasas of terrible appearance, assembled for battle.

shloka_text: मारीचश्च प्रहस्तश्च महापार्श्वमहोदरौ । अकम्पनो निकुम्भश्च शुकः सारण एव च ।। 7.27.28 ।।
transliteration: mārīcaśca prahastaśca mahāpārśvamahodarau | akampano nikumbhaśca śukaḥ sāraṇa eva ca || 7.27.28 ||
translation: मारीचः Maricha, च and, प्रहस्तः Prahasta, च and, महापार्श्वमहोदरौ Mahaparshva and Mahodara, अकम्पनः Akampana, निकुम्भः Nikumbha, च and, शुकः Shuka, सारणः Sarana, एव indeed, च and.
explanation: Maricha, Prahasta, Mahaparshva, Mahodara, Akampana, Nikumbha, Shuka, and Sarana were among them.

shloka_text: संह्लादो धूमकेतुश्च महादंष्ट्रो घटोदरः । जम्बुमाली महाह्रादो विरूपाक्षश्च राक्षसः ।। 7.27.29 ।।
transliteration: saṃhlādo dhūmaketuśca mahādaṃṣṭro ghaṭodaraḥ | jambumālī mahāhrādo virūpākṣaśca rākṣasaḥ || 7.27.29 ||
translation: संह्लादः Samhlada, धूमकेतुः Dhumaketu, च and, महादंष्ट्रः Mahadamshtra, घटोदरः Ghatodara, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, महाह्रादः Mahahrada, विरूपाक्षः Virupaksha, च and, राक्षसः rakshasa.
explanation: Also present were Samhlada, Dhumaketu, Mahadamshtra, Ghatodara, Jambumali, Mahahrada, and the rakshasa Virupaksha.

shloka_text: सुप्तघ्नो यज्ञकोपश्च दुर्मुखो दूषणः खरः । त्रिशिराः करवीराक्षः सूर्यशत्रुश्च राक्षसः ।। 7.27.30 ।।
transliteration: suptaghno yajñakopaśca durmukho dūṣaṇaḥ kharaḥ | triśirāḥ karavīrākṣaḥ sūryaśatruśca rākṣasaḥ || 7.27.30 ||
translation: सुप्तघ्नः Suptaghna, यज्ञकोपः Yajnakopa, च and, दुर्मुखः Durmukha, दूषणः Dushana, खरः Khara, त्रिशिराः Trishira, करवीराक्षः Karaviraksha, सूर्यशत्रुः Suryashatru, च and, राक्षसः rakshasa.
explanation: Among the other rakshasas were Suptaghna, Yajnakopa, Durmukha, Dushana, Khara, Trishira, Karaviraksha, and Suryashatru.

shloka_text: महाकायो ऽतिकायश्च देवान्तकनरान्तकौ । एतैः सर्वैः परिवृतो महावीर्यो महाबलः ।। 7.27.31 ।।
transliteration: mahākāyo 'tikāyaśca devāntakanarāntakau | etaiḥ sarvaiḥ parivṛto mahāvīryo mahābalaḥ || 7.27.31 ||
translation: महाकायो Mahakaya, अतिकायश्च Atikaya, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devantaka and Narantaka, एतैः by these, सर्वैः all, परिवृतो surrounded, महावीर्यो of great valor, महाबलः of great strength.
explanation: Surrounded by all these, namely Mahakaya, Atikaya, Devantaka, and Narantaka, was one of immense valor and strength.

shloka_text: रावणस्यार्यकः सैन्यं सुमाली प्रविवेश ह । स दैवतगणान्सर्वान्नानाप्रहरणैः शितैः । व्यध्वंसयत्सुसङ्क्रुद्धो वायुर्जलधरानिव ।। 7.27.32 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇasyāryakaḥ sainyaṃ sumālī praviveśa ha | sa daivatagaṇānsarvānnānāpraharaṇaiḥ śitaiḥ | vyadhvaṃsayatsusaṅkruddho vāyurjaladharāniva || 7.27.32 ||
translation: रावणस्य Ravana's, आर्यकः grandfather, सैन्यं army, सुमाली Sumali, प्रविवेश entered, ह indeed, स He, दैवतगणान् hosts of gods, सर्वान् all, नानाप्रहरणैः with various weapons, शितैः sharp, व्यध्वंसयत् destroyed, सुसङ्क्रुद्धो greatly enraged, वायुर् wind, जलधरानिव like clouds.
explanation: Indeed, Sumali, Ravana's grandfather, entered the army and, greatly enraged, destroyed all the hosts of gods with sharp, various weapons, just as the wind scatters clouds.

shloka_text: तद्दैवतबलं राम हन्यमानं निशाचरैः । प्रणुन्नं सर्वतो दिग्भ्यः सिंहनुन्ना मृगा इव ।। 7.27.33 ।।
transliteration: taddaivatabalaṃ rāma hanyamānaṃ niśācaraiḥ | praṇunnaṃ sarvato digbhyaḥ siṃhanunnā mṛgā iva || 7.27.33 ||
translation: तत् That, दैवतबलं army of gods, राम O Rama, हन्यमानं being killed, निशाचरैः by the night-wanderers, प्रणुन्नं driven away, सर्वतो from all, दिग्भ्यः directions, सिंहनुन्ना driven by lions, मृगा deer, इव like.
explanation: O Rama, that army of gods, being killed by the night-wanderers, was driven away from all directions, just like deer are scattered by lions.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरो वसूनामष्टमो वसुः । सावित्र इति विख्यातः प्रविवेश रणाजिरम् ।। 7.27.34 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare śūro vasūnāmaṣṭamo vasuḥ | sāvitra iti vikhyātaḥ praviveśa raṇājiram || 7.27.34 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् In this, अन्तरे interval, शूरो brave, वसूनाम् among the Vasus, अष्टमो eighth, वसुः Vasu, सावित्र Savitra, इति thus, विख्यातः renowned, प्रविवेश entered, रणाजिरम् the battlefield.
explanation: In this interval, the brave eighth Vasu, renowned as Savitra, entered the battlefield.

shloka_text: तथा ऽ ऽदित्यौ महावीर्यौ त्वष्टा पूषा च दंशितौ । निंर्भयौ सह सैन्येन तदा प्राविशतां रणे ।। 7.27.35 ।।
transliteration: tathā ' 'dityau mahāvīryau tvaṣṭā pūṣā ca daṃśitau | niṃrbhayau saha sainyena tadā prāviśatāṃ raṇe || 7.27.35 ||
translation: तथा Likewise, आदित्यौ the two Adityas, महावीर्यौ of great valor, त्वष्टा Tvashta, पूषा Pushan, च and, दंशितौ armored, निंर्भयौ fearless, सह with, सैन्येन their army, तदा then, प्राविशतां entered, रणे into battle.
explanation: Likewise, the two Adityas of great valor, Tvashta and Pushan, armored and fearless, then entered the battle with their army.

shloka_text: ततो युद्धं समभवत्सुराणां सह राक्षसैः । क्रुद्धानां रक्षसां कीर्तिं समरेष्वनिवर्तिनाम् ।। 7.27.36 ।।
transliteration: tato yuddhaṃ samabhavatsurāṇāṃ saha rākṣasaiḥ | kruddhānāṃ rakṣasāṃ kīrtiṃ samareṣvanivartinām || 7.27.36 ||
translation: ततः then, युद्धम् battle, समभवत् occurred, सुराणाम् of the gods, सह with, राक्षसैः the demons, क्रुद्धानाम् of the enraged, रक्षसाम् of the demons, कीर्तिम् fame, समरेषु in battles, अनिवर्तिनाम् of those who do not retreat.
explanation: Then a battle took place between the gods and the demons, who were enraged and renowned for never retreating from combat.

shloka_text: ततस्ते राक्षसाः सर्वे विबुधान्समरे स्थितान् । नानाप्रहरणैर्घोरैर्जघ्नुः शतसहस्रशः ।। 7.27.37 ।।
transliteration: tataste rākṣasāḥ sarve vibudhānsamare sthitān | nānāpraharaṇairghorairjaghnuḥ śatasahasraśaḥ || 7.27.37 ||
translation: ततः then, ते those, राक्षसाः demons, सर्वे all, विबुधान् the gods, समरे in battle, स्थितान् standing, नानाप्रहरणैः with various weapons, घोरैः terrible, जघ्नुः struck, शतसहस्रशः by hundreds of thousands.
explanation: Then all those demons, using dreadful and various weapons, struck down the gods arrayed in battle by hundreds of thousands.

shloka_text: देवाश्च राक्षसान्घोरान्महाबलपराक्रमान् । समरे विमलैः शस्त्रैरुपनिन्युर्यमक्षयम् ।। 7.27.38 ।।
transliteration: devāśca rākṣasānghorānmahābalaparākramān | samare vimalaiḥ śastrairupaninyuryamakṣayam || 7.27.38 ||
translation: देवाः the gods, च and, राक्षसान् the demons, घोरान् dreadful, महाबलपराक्रमान् of great strength and valor, समरे in battle, विमलैः with pure, शस्त्रैः weapons, उपनिन्युः led, यमक्षयम् to Yama's abode.
explanation: And the gods, in battle, with their pure weapons, led the dreadful demons of great strength and valor to the abode of Yama.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम सुमाली नाम राक्षसः । नानाप्रहरणैः क्रुद्धस्तत्सैन्यं सो ऽभ्यवर्तत ।। 7.27.39 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare rāma sumālī nāma rākṣasaḥ | nānāpraharaṇaiḥ kruddhastatsainyaṃ so 'bhyavartata || 7.27.39 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, राम O Rama, सुमाली Sumali, नाम named, राक्षसः demon, नानाप्रहरणैः with various weapons, क्रुद्धः enraged, तत् that, सैन्यम् army, सः he, अभ्यवर्तत attacked.
explanation: O Rama, in the meantime, a demon named Sumali, enraged and wielding various weapons, attacked that army.

shloka_text: स दैवतबलं सर्वं नानाप्रहणैः शितैः । व्यध्वंसयत सङ्क्रुद्धो वायुर्जलधरं यथा ।। 7.27.40 ।।
transliteration: sa daivatabalaṃ sarvaṃ nānāprahaṇaiḥ śitaiḥ | vyadhvaṃsayata saṅkruddho vāyurjaladharaṃ yathā || 7.27.40 ||
translation: सः he, दैवतबलम् the army of gods, सर्वम् all, नानाप्रहणैः with various weapons, शितैः sharp, व्यध्वंसयत destroyed, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, वायुः wind, जलधरम् a cloud, यथा just as.
explanation: Greatly enraged, he destroyed the entire army of gods with his sharp, various weapons, just as the wind scatters a cloud.

shloka_text: ते महाबाणवर्षैश्च शूलप्रासैः सुदारुणैः । हन्यमानाः सुराः सर्वे न व्यतिष्ठन्त संहताः ।। 7.27.41 ।।
transliteration: te mahābāṇavarṣaiśca śūlaprāsaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ | hanyamānāḥ surāḥ sarve na vyatiṣṭhanta saṃhatāḥ || 7.27.41 ||
translation: ते they, महाबाणवर्षैः by great showers of arrows, च and, शूलप्रासैः by spears and javelins, सुदारुणैः very terrible, हन्यमानाः being struck, सुराः gods, सर्वे all, न not, व्यतिष्ठन्त stood firm, संहताः united.
explanation: All the gods, being struck by the very terrible great showers of arrows and spears and javelins, could not stand firm together.

shloka_text: ततो विद्राव्यमाणेषु दैवतेषु सुमालिना । वसूनामष्टमः क्रुद्धः सावित्रो वै व्यवस्थितः ।। 7.27.42 ।।
transliteration: tato vidrāvyamāṇeṣu daivateṣu sumālinā | vasūnāmaṣṭamaḥ kruddhaḥ sāvitro vai vyavasthitaḥ || 7.27.42 ||
translation: ततः then, विद्राव्यमाणेषु while being put to flight, दैवतेषु the gods, सुमालिना by Sumali, वसूनाम् among the Vasus, अष्टमः the eighth, क्रुद्धः enraged, सावित्रः Savitra, वै indeed, व्यवस्थितः stood firm.
explanation: Then, as the gods were being put to flight by Sumali, Savitra, the eighth among the Vasus, enraged, stood firm.

shloka_text: संवृतः स्वैरथानीकैः प्रहरन्तं निशाचरम् । विक्रमेण महातेजा वारयामास संयुगे ।। 7.27.43 ।।
transliteration: saṃvṛtaḥ svairathānīkaiḥ praharantaṃ niśācaram | vikrameṇa mahātejā vārayāmāsa saṃyuge || 7.27.43 ||
translation: संवृतः surrounded, स्वैरथानीकैः by his own chariot divisions, प्रहरन्तं striking, निशाचरम् the night-ranger, विक्रमेण with valor, महातेजा the greatly effulgent one, वारयामास checked, संयुगे in battle.
explanation: The greatly effulgent Savitra, surrounded by his own chariot divisions, checked the attacking demon with his valor in battle.

shloka_text: ततस्तयोर्महायुद्धमभवद्रोमहर्षणम् ।। 7.27.44 ।।
transliteration: tatastayormahāyuddhamabhavadromaharṣaṇam || 7.27.44 ||
translation: ततः then, तयोः between those two, महायुद्धम् a great battle, अभवत् occurred, रोमहर्षणम् hair-raising.
explanation: Then, a great and hair-raising battle occurred between those two.

shloka_text: सुमालिनो वसोश्चैव समरेष्वनिवर्तिनोः । ततस्तस्य महाबाणैर्वसुना सुमहात्मना । निहतः पन्नगरथः क्षणेन विनिपातितः ।। 7.27.45 ।।
transliteration: sumālino vasoścaiva samareṣvanivartinoḥ | tatastasya mahābāṇairvasunā sumahātmanā | nihataḥ pannagarathaḥ kṣaṇena vinipātitaḥ || 7.27.45 ||
translation: सुमालिनः of Sumali, वसोः of Vasu, च and, एव indeed, समरेषु in battles, अनिवर्तिनोः who do not retreat, ततः then, तस्य his (Sumali's), महाबाणैः by great arrows, वसुना by Vasu, सुमहात्मना by the very great-souled one, निहतः struck down, पन्नगरथः whose chariot was drawn by serpents, क्षणेन in a moment, विनिपातितः was overthrown.
explanation: Then, in a moment, the chariot of Sumali, who, along with Vasu, did not retreat in battles, was struck down and overthrown by the great arrows of the very great-souled Vasu.

shloka_text: हत्वा तु संयुगे तस्य रथं बाणशतैश्चितम् । गदां तस्य वधार्थाय वसुर्जग्राह पाणिना ।। 7.27.46 ।।
transliteration: hatvā tu saṃyuge tasya rathaṃ bāṇaśataiścitam | gadāṃ tasya vadhārthāya vasurjagrāha pāṇinā || 7.27.46 ||
translation: हत्वा having destroyed, तु indeed, संयुगे in battle, तस्य his, रथं chariot, बाणशतैश्चितम् covered with hundreds of arrows, गदां mace, तस्य his, वधार्थाय for the purpose of killing, वसुः Vasu, जग्राह took, पाणिना with his hand.
explanation: Vasu, having destroyed Sumali's chariot which was covered with hundreds of arrows in battle, then took up his mace with his hand for the purpose of killing him.

shloka_text: ततः प्रगृह्य दीप्ताग्रां कालदण्डोपमां गदाम् । तां मूर्ध्नि पातयामास सावित्रो वै सुमालिनः ।। 7.27.47 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pragṛhya dīptāgrāṃ kāladaṇḍopamāṃ gadām | tāṃ mūrdhni pātayāmāsa sāvitro vai sumālinaḥ || 7.27.47 ||
translation: ततः then, प्रगृह्य having grasped, दीप्ताग्रां having a blazing tip, कालदण्डोपमां resembling the staff of Yama, गदाम् mace, तां that, मूर्ध्नि on the head, पातयामास he struck down, सावित्रो Savitri's son (Vasu), वै indeed, सुमालिनः of Sumali.
explanation: Then, Savitri's son Vasu, having firmly grasped that mace with its blazing tip resembling the staff of Yama, struck it down upon Sumali's head.

shloka_text: सा तस्योपरि चोल्काभा पतन्तीव बभौ गदा । इन्द्रप्रमुक्ता गर्जन्ती गिराविव महाशनिः ।। 7.27.48 ।।
transliteration: sā tasyopari colkābhā patantīva babhau gadā | indrapramuktā garjantī girāviva mahāśaniḥ || 7.27.48 ||
translation: सा that, तस्योपरि upon him, च and, उल्काभा resembling a meteor, पतन्तीव as if falling, बभौ shone, गदा mace, इन्द्रप्रमुक्ता released by Indra, गर्जन्ती roaring, गिराविव as if on a mountain, महाशनिः a great thunderbolt.
explanation: That mace, resembling a falling meteor, shone as it descended upon him, like a great thunderbolt released by Indra roaring down upon a mountain.

shloka_text: तस्य नैवास्थि न शिरो न मांसं ददृशे तदा । गदया भस्मतां नीतं निहतस्य रणाजिरे ।। 7.27.49 ।।
transliteration: tasya naivāsthi na śiro na māṃsaṃ dadṛśe tadā | gadayā bhasmatāṃ nītaṃ nihatasya raṇājire || 7.27.49 ||
translation: तस्य his, नैव neither, अस्थि bone, न nor, शिरो head, न nor, मांसं flesh, ददृशे was seen, तदा then, गदया by the mace, भस्मतां to ashes, नीतं brought, निहतस्य of the one killed, रणाजिरे in the battlefield.
explanation: Then, neither his bone, nor head, nor flesh was seen, as the mace had reduced the slain Sumali to ashes on the battlefield.

shloka_text: तं दृष्ट्वा निहतं सङ्ख्ये राक्षसास्ते समन्ततः । व्यद्रवन्सहिताः सर्वे क्रोशमानाः परस्परम् । विद्राव्यमाणा वसुना राक्षसा नावतस्थिरे ।। 7.27.50 ।।
transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā nihataṃ saṅkhye rākṣasāste samantataḥ | vyadravansahitāḥ sarve krośamānāḥ parasparam | vidrāvyamāṇā vasunā rākṣasā nāvatasthire || 7.27.50 ||
translation: तं him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, निहतं killed, सङ्ख्ये in battle, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, ते those, समन्ततः from all sides, व्यद्रवन् they fled, सहिताः together, सर्वे all, क्रोशमानाः crying out, परस्परम् to each other, विद्राव्यमाणा being put to flight, वसुना by Vasu, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, न not, अवतस्थिरे stood firm.
explanation: Having seen Sumali killed in battle, all those Rakshasas fled together from all sides, crying out to each other, and being driven away by Vasu, they could not stand firm.

shloka_text: सुमालिनं हतं दृष्ट्वा वसुना भस्मसात्कृतम् । स्वसैन्यं विद्रुतं चापि लक्षयित्वा ऽर्दितं सुरैः ।। 7.28.1 ।।
transliteration: sumālinaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā vasunā bhasmasātkṛtam | svasainyaṃ vidrutaṃ cāpi lakṣayitvā 'rditaṃ suraiḥ || 7.28.1 ||
translation: सुमालिनं Sumalin, हतं killed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, वसुना by Vasu, भस्मसात्कृतम् reduced to ashes, स्वसैन्यं his own army, विद्रुतं fled, च and, अपि also, लक्षयित्वा having observed, अर्दितं tormented, सुरैः by the gods.
explanation: Having seen Sumalin killed and reduced to ashes by Vasu, and observing his own army fleeing and tormented by the gods, (Meghanada reacted).
comments: Meghanada (Indrajit) rallies the routed rakshasas and drives the gods back, spreading darkness with his weapons -- he overpowers Indra's son Jayanta, who is carried off and hidden in the ocean by his grandfather Puloma -- Indra mounts his chariot to advance, and Ravana too takes the field in a chariot built by Vishvakarma, as the great battle of gods and rakshasas rages on with Kumbhakarna fighting amid the Rudras and Maruts.

shloka_text: ततः स बलवान्क्रुद्धो रावणस्य सुतस्तदा । निवर्त्य राक्षसान्सर्वान्मेघनादो व्यवस्थितः ।। 7.28.2 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa balavānkruddho rāvaṇasya sutastadā | nivartya rākṣasānsarvānmeghanādo vyavasthitaḥ || 7.28.2 ||
translation: ततः then, सः he, बलवान् powerful, क्रुद्धः enraged, रावणस्य Ravana's, सुतः son, तदा at that time, निवर्त्य having turned back/stopped, राक्षसान् the rakshasas, सर्वान् all, मेघनादः Meghanada, व्यवस्थितः stood firm/prepared.
explanation: Then, that powerful son of Ravana, Meghanada, enraged, stopped all the fleeing rakshasas and stood firm.

shloka_text: सुरथेनाग्निवर्णेन कामगेन महारथः । अभिदुद्राव सेनां तां वनान्यग्निरिव ज्वलन् ।। 7.28.3 ।।
transliteration: surathenāgnivarṇena kāmagena mahārathaḥ | abhidudrāva senāṃ tāṃ vanānyagniriva jvalan || 7.28.3 ||
translation: सुरथेन with a beautiful chariot, अग्निवर्णेन of fiery color, कामगेन moving at will, महारथः the great charioteer (Meghanada), अभिदुद्राव rushed towards, सेनां the army, तां that, वनानि forests, अग्निः fire, इव like, ज्वलन् burning.
explanation: The great charioteer, Meghanada, with his beautiful, fiery-colored chariot that moved at will, rushed towards that army, burning like a fire consuming forests.

shloka_text: ततः प्रविशतस्तस्य विविधायुधधारिणः । विदुद्रुवुर्दिशः सर्वा दर्शनादेव देवताः ।। 7.28.4 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ praviśatastasya vividhāyudhadhāriṇaḥ | vidudruvurdiśaḥ sarvā darśanādeva devatāḥ || 7.28.4 ||
translation: ततः then, प्रविशतः as he entered, तस्य his, विविधायुधधारिणः bearing various weapons, विदुद्रुवुः fled, दिशः directions, सर्वाः all, दर्शनात् from the sight, एव merely, देवताः the gods.
explanation: Then, as he, bearing various weapons, entered the battle, the gods fled in all directions merely at his sight.

shloka_text: न बभूव तदा कश्चिद्युयुत्सोरस्य सम्मुखे । सर्वानाविद्ध्य वित्रस्तांस्ततः शक्रो ऽब्रवीत्सुरान् ।। 7.28.5 ।।
transliteration: na babhūva tadā kaścidyuyutsorasya sammukhe | sarvānāviddhya vitrastāṃstataḥ śakro 'bravītsurān || 7.28.5 ||
translation: न not, बभूव was, तदा then, कश्चित् anyone, युयुत्सोः wishing to fight, अस्य his, सम्मुखे in front of, सर्वान् all, आविद्ध्य having pierced/wounded, वित्रस्तान् terrified ones, ततः then, शक्रः Indra, अब्रवीत् spoke, सुरान् to the gods.
explanation: Then, no one dared to stand before him, who was eager to fight, and after he had wounded all the terrified gods, Indra spoke to them.

shloka_text: न भेतव्यं न गन्तव्यं निवर्तध्वं रणे सुराः । एष गच्छति पुत्रो मे युद्धार्थमपराजितः ।। 7.28.6 ।।
transliteration: na bhetavyaṃ na gantavyaṃ nivartadhvaṃ raṇe surāḥ | eṣa gacchati putro me yuddhārthamaparājitaḥ || 7.28.6 ||
translation: न not, भेतव्यं to be feared, न not, गन्तव्यं to be gone, निवर्तध्वं retreat, रणे in battle, सुराः O gods, एष this, गच्छति goes, पुत्रो son, मे my, युद्धार्थम् for battle, अपराजितः unconquered.
explanation: Indra instructs the gods not to fear or retreat from battle, as his unconquered son is now advancing to fight.

shloka_text: ततः शक्रसुतो देवो जयन्त इति विश्रुतः । रथेनाद्भुतकल्पेन सङ्ग्रामे सो ऽभ्यवर्तत ।। 7.28.7 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ śakrasuto devo jayanta iti viśrutaḥ | rathenādbhutakalpena saṅgrāme so 'bhyavartata || 7.28.7 ||
translation: ततः then, शक्रसुतो Indra's son, देवो the god, जयन्त Jayanta, इति thus, विश्रुतः renowned, रथेन by chariot, अद्भुतकल्पेन wonderfully made, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, सो he, अभ्यवर्तत advanced.
explanation: Then, the renowned god Jayanta, son of Indra, advanced into battle with his wonderfully designed chariot.

shloka_text: ततस्ते त्रिदशाः सर्वे परिवार्य शचीसुतम् । रावणस्य सुतं युद्धे समासाद्य प्रजघ्निरे ।। 7.28.8 ।।
transliteration: tataste tridaśāḥ sarve parivārya śacīsutam | rāvaṇasya sutaṃ yuddhe samāsādya prajaghnire || 7.28.8 ||
translation: ततस्ते then they, त्रिदशाः the gods, सर्वे all, परिवार्य surrounding, शचीसुतम् Shachi's son, रावणस्य Ravana's, सुतं son, युद्धे in battle, समासाद्य having approached, प्रजघ्निरे they attacked.
explanation: Then all the gods, surrounding Shachi's son Jayanta, approached Ravana's son in battle and attacked him.

shloka_text: तेषां युद्धं समभवत्सदृशं देवरक्षसाम् । महेन्द्रस्य च पुत्रस्य राक्षसेन्द्रसुतस्य च ।। 7.28.9 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ yuddhaṃ samabhavatsadṛśaṃ devarakṣasām | mahendrasya ca putrasya rākṣasendrasutasya ca || 7.28.9 ||
translation: तेषां their, युद्धं battle, समभवत् occurred, सदृशं similar, देवरक्षसाम् of gods and Rakshasas, महेन्द्रस्य of Mahendra, च and, पुत्रस्य of the son, राक्षसेन्द्रसुतस्य of the son of the lord of Rakshasas, च and.
explanation: A battle then ensued between them, resembling the conflicts of gods and Rakshasas, specifically between Mahendra's son (Jayanta) and the son of the lord of Rakshasas (Meghanada).

shloka_text: ततो मातलिपुत्रे तु गोमुखे राक्षसात्मजः । सारथौ पातयामास शरान्कनकभूषणान् ।। 7.28.10 ।।
transliteration: tato mātaliputre tu gomukhe rākṣasātmajaḥ | sārathau pātayāmāsa śarānkanakabhūṣaṇān || 7.28.10 ||
translation: ततो then, मातलिपुत्रे on Matali's son, तु indeed, गोमुखे Gomukha, राक्षसात्मजः the son of the Rakshasa, सारथौ on the charioteer, पातयामास he shot, शरान् arrows, कनकभूषणान् gold-embellished.
explanation: Then, the son of the Rakshasa (Meghanada) shot gold-embellished arrows at Matali's son, Gomukha, who was the charioteer.

shloka_text: शचीसुतश्चापि तथा जयन्तस्तस्य सारथिम् । तं चापि रावणिः क्रुद्धः समन्तात्प्रत्यविध्यत ।। 7.28.11 ।।
transliteration: śacīsutaścāpi tathā jayantastasya sārathim | taṃ cāpi rāvaṇiḥ kruddhaḥ samantātpratyavidhyata || 7.28.11 ||
translation: शचीसुतः Shachi's son, च and, अपि also, तथा similarly, जयन्तः Jayanta, तस्य his, सारथिम् charioteer, तम् him, च and, अपि also, रावणिः Ravana's son, क्रुद्धः enraged, समन्तात् from all sides, प्रत्यविध्यत pierced.
explanation: Enraged, Ravana's son Indrajit pierced Jayanta, the son of Shachi, and also Indra's charioteer from all sides.

shloka_text: स हि क्रोधसमाविष्टो बली विस्फारितेक्षणः । रावणिः शक्रतनयं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ।। 7.28.12 ।।
transliteration: sa hi krodhasamāviṣṭo balī visphāritekṣaṇaḥ | rāvaṇiḥ śakratanayaṃ śaravarṣairavākirat || 7.28.12 ||
translation: सः He, हि indeed, क्रोधसमाविष्टः filled with rage, बली powerful, विस्फारितेक्षणः with wide-open eyes, रावणिः Ravana's son, शक्रतनयम् Indra's son, शरवर्षैः with showers of arrows, अवाकिरत् covered.
explanation: Indeed, that powerful son of Ravana, filled with rage and with wide-open eyes, showered Indra's son Jayanta with a volley of arrows.

shloka_text: ततो नानाप्रहरणाञ्छितधारान्सहस्रशः । पातयामास सङ्क्रुद्धः सुरसैन्येषु रावणिः ।। 7.28.13 ।।
transliteration: tato nānāpraharaṇāñchitadhārānsahasraśaḥ | pātayāmāsa saṅkruddhaḥ surasainyeṣu rāvaṇiḥ || 7.28.13 ||
translation: ततः Then, नानाप्रहरणान् various weapons, शितधारान् sharp-edged, सहस्रशः by thousands, पातयामास hurled, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, सुरसैन्येषु upon the armies of the gods, रावणिः Ravana's son.
explanation: Then, greatly enraged, Ravana's son hurled thousands of various sharp-edged weapons upon the armies of the gods.

shloka_text: शतघ्नीमुसलप्रासगदाखड्गपरश्वधान् । महान्ति गिरिशृङ्गाणि पातयामास रावणिः ।। 7.28.14 ।।
transliteration: śataghnīmusalaprāsagadākhaḍgaparaśvadhān | mahānti giriśṛṅgāṇi pātayāmāsa rāvaṇiḥ || 7.28.14 ||
translation: शतघ्नीम् a weapon killing hundreds, मुसल mace, प्रास spear, गदा club, खड्ग sword, परश्वधान् axes, महान्ति huge, गिरिशृङ्गाणि mountain peaks, पातयामास hurled, रावणिः Ravana's son.
explanation: Ravana's son hurled hundreds of weapons, maces, spears, clubs, swords, axes, and even huge mountain peaks.

shloka_text: ततः प्रव्यथिता लोकाः सञ्जज्ञे च तमो ऽभवत् । तस्य रावणपुत्रस्य शत्रुसैन्यानि निघ्नतः ।। 7.28.15 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pravyathitā lokāḥ sañjajñe ca tamo 'bhavat | tasya rāvaṇaputrasya śatrusainyāni nighnataḥ || 7.28.15 ||
translation: ततः Then, प्रव्यथिताः greatly distressed, लोकाः worlds, सञ्जज्ञे arose, च and, तमः darkness, अभवत् occurred, तस्य his, रावणपुत्रस्य Ravana's son's, शत्रुसैन्यानि enemy armies, निघ्नतः while destroying.
explanation: Then, as Ravana's son destroyed the enemy armies, the worlds became greatly distressed, and darkness enveloped everything.

shloka_text: ततस्तद्दैवतबलं समन्तात्तं शचीसुतम् । बहुप्रकारमस्वस्थमभवच्छरपीडितम् ।। 7.28.16 ।।
transliteration: tatastaddaivatabalaṃ samantāttaṃ śacīsutam | bahuprakāramasvasthamabhavaccharapīḍitam || 7.28.16 ||
translation: ततः then, तत् that, दैवतबलम् divine army, समन्तात् all around, तम् him, शचीसुतम् son of Shachi, बहुप्रकारम् in many ways, अस्वस्थम् distressed, अभवत् became, शरपीडितम् afflicted by arrows.
explanation: Then, that divine army surrounding the son of Shachi became distressed in many ways, being afflicted by arrows.

shloka_text: नाभ्यजानन्त चान्योन्यं रक्षो वा देवता ऽथवा । तत्र तत्र विपर्यस्तं समन्तात्परिधावति ।। 7.28.17 ।।
transliteration: nābhyajānanta cānyonyaṃ rakṣo vā devatā 'thavā | tatra tatra viparyastaṃ samantātparidhāvati || 7.28.17 ||
translation: न not, अभ्यजानन्त recognized, च and, अन्योन्यम् each other, रक्षः a demon, वा or, देवता a god, अथवा or, तत्र तत्र here and there, विपर्यस्तम् confused, समन्तात् all around, परिधावति ran about.
explanation: They could not recognize each other, whether they were demons or gods, and in their confusion, they ran about everywhere.

shloka_text: देवा देवान्निजघ्नुस्ते राक्षसान्राक्षसास्तथा । सम्मूढास्तमसाच्छन्ना व्यद्रवन्नपरे तथा ।। 7.28.18 ।।
transliteration: devā devānnijaghnuste rākṣasānrākṣasāstathā | sammūḍhāstamasācchannā vyadravannapare tathā || 7.28.18 ||
translation: देवाः gods, देवान् gods, निजघ्नुः killed, ते they, राक्षसान् demons, राक्षसाः demons, तथा similarly, सम्मूढाः utterly bewildered, तमसा by darkness, आच्छन्नाः covered, व्यद्रवन् fled, अपरे others, तथा similarly.
explanation: The gods killed other gods, and similarly, the demons killed other demons, while others, utterly bewildered and enveloped in confusion, fled.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरः पुलोमा नाम वीर्यवान् । दैत्येन्द्रस्तेन सङ्गृह्य शचीपुत्रो ऽपवाहितः ।। 7.28.19 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare vīraḥ pulomā nāma vīryavān | daityendrastena saṅgṛhya śacīputro 'pavāhitaḥ || 7.28.19 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, वीरः brave, पुलोमा Puloma, नाम named, वीर्यवान् powerful, दैत्येन्द्रः king of Daityas, तेन by him, सङ्गृह्य having seized, शचीपुत्रः son of Shachi, अपवाहितः carried away.
explanation: In this interval, the brave and powerful Daitya king named Puloma seized the son of Shachi and carried him away.

shloka_text: सङ्गृह्य तं तु दौहित्रं प्रविष्टः सागरं तदा । आर्यकः स हि तस्यासीत्पुलोमा येन सा शची ।। 7.28.20 ।।
transliteration: saṅgṛhya taṃ tu dauhitraṃ praviṣṭaḥ sāgaraṃ tadā | āryakaḥ sa hi tasyāsītpulomā yena sā śacī || 7.28.20 ||
translation: सङ्गृह्य having seized, तम् him, तु indeed, दौहित्रम् grandson, प्रविष्टः entered, सागरम् ocean, तदा then, आर्यकः maternal grandfather, सः he, हि indeed, तस्य his, आसीत् was, पुलोमा Puloma, येन by whom, सा she, शची Shachi.
explanation: Having seized his grandson, Puloma then entered the ocean, for he was indeed the maternal grandfather of Jayanta, as Shachi was his daughter.

shloka_text: ज्ञात्वा प्रणाशं तु तदा जयन्तस्याथ देवताः । अप्रहृष्टास्ततः सर्वा व्यथिताः सम्प्रदुद्रुवुः ।। 7.28.21 ।।
transliteration: jñātvā praṇāśaṃ tu tadā jayantasyātha devatāḥ | aprahṛṣṭāstataḥ sarvā vyathitāḥ sampradudruvuḥ || 7.28.21 ||
translation: ज्ञात्वा having known, प्रणाशं defeat, तु indeed, तदा then, जयन्तस्य of Jayanta, अथ then, देवताः the gods, अप्रहृष्टाः unhappy, ततः then, सर्वाः all, व्यथिताः distressed, सम्प्रदुद्रुवुः fled.
explanation: Knowing then of Jayanta's defeat, all the gods became unhappy and distressed, and then they fled.

shloka_text: रावणिस्त्वथ सङ्क्रुद्धो बलैः परिवृतः स्वकैः । अभ्यधावत देवांस्तान्मुमोच च महास्वनम् ।। 7.28.22 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇistvatha saṅkruddho balaiḥ parivṛtaḥ svakaiḥ | abhyadhāvata devāṃstānmumoca ca mahāsvanam || 7.28.22 ||
translation: रावणिः Ravana's son, तु indeed, अथ then, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, बलैः by forces, परिवृतः surrounded, स्वकैः by his own, अभ्यधावत rushed towards, देवांस्तान् those gods, मुमोच uttered, च and, महास्वनम् a great roar.
explanation: Then, Ravana's son, greatly enraged and surrounded by his own forces, rushed towards those gods and uttered a mighty roar.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा प्रणाशं पुत्रस्य दैवतेषु च विद्रुतम् । मातलिं चाह देवेशो रथः समुपनीयताम् ।। 7.28.23 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā praṇāśaṃ putrasya daivateṣu ca vidrutam | mātaliṃ cāha deveśo rathaḥ samupanīyatām || 7.28.23 ||
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, प्रणाशं defeat, पुत्रस्य of the son, दैवतेषु among the gods, च and, विद्रुतम् the flight, मातलिं to Matali, च and, आह said, देवेशः the lord of gods, रथः the chariot, समुपनीयताम् let it be brought forth.
explanation: Having seen the defeat of his son and the flight of the gods, the lord of gods then said to Matali, "Let the chariot be brought forth."

shloka_text: स तु दिव्यो महाभीमः सज्ज एव महारथः । उपस्थितो मातलिना वाह्यमानो महाजवः ।। 7.28.24 ।।
transliteration: sa tu divyo mahābhīmaḥ sajja eva mahārathaḥ | upasthito mātalinā vāhyamāno mahājavaḥ || 7.28.24 ||
translation: सः that, तु indeed, दिव्यः divine, महाभीमः very formidable, सज्जः ready, एव indeed, महारथः great chariot, उपस्थितः appeared, मातलिना by Matali, वाह्यमानः being driven, महाजवः of great speed.
explanation: That divine, very formidable, and indeed ready great chariot, of immense speed, was then brought forth by Matali.

shloka_text: ततो मेघा रथे तस्मिंस्तडित्त्वन्तो महाबलाः । अग्रतो वायुचपला नेदुः परमनिःस्वनाः ।। 7.28.25 ।।
transliteration: tato meghā rathe tasmiṃstaḍittvanto mahābalāḥ | agrato vāyucapalā neduḥ paramaniḥsvanāḥ || 7.28.25 ||
translation: ततः then, मेघाः clouds, रथे in the chariot, तस्मिन् that, तडित्त्वन्तः with lightning, महाबलाः very powerful, अग्रतः in front, वायुचपलाः swift as wind, नेदुः roared, परमनिःस्वनाः with mighty sounds.
explanation: Then, very powerful clouds, bearing lightning and swift as the wind, roared with mighty sounds in front of that chariot.

shloka_text: नानावाद्यानि वाद्यन्त गन्धर्वाश्च समाहिताः । ननृतुश्चाप्सरःसङ्घा निर्याते त्रिदशेश्वरे ।। 7.28.26 ।।
transliteration: nānāvādyāni vādyanta gandharvāśca samāhitāḥ | nanṛtuścāpsaraḥsaṅghā niryāte tridaśeśvare || 7.28.26 ||
translation: नानावाद्यानि various musical instruments, वाद्यन्त were played, गन्धर्वाश्च and Gandharvas, समाहिताः attentive, ननृतुश्चाप्सरःसङ्घा and groups of Apsaras danced, निर्याते when he departed, त्रिदशेश्वरे the lord of the gods.
explanation: As the lord of the gods, Indra, departed, various musical instruments were played, Gandharvas sang attentively, and groups of Apsaras danced.

shloka_text: रुद्रैर्वसुभिरादित्यैस्साध्यैश्च समरुद्गणैः । वृतो नानाप्रहरणैर्निर्ययौ त्रिदशाधिपः ।। 7.28.27 ।।
transliteration: rudrairvasubhirādityaissādhyaiśca samarudgaṇaiḥ | vṛto nānāpraharaṇairniryayau tridaśādhipaḥ || 7.28.27 ||
translation: रुद्रैः by Rudras, वसुभिः by Vasus, आदित्यैः by Adityas, साध्यैश्च and by Sadhyas, समरुद्गणैः along with the Marut groups, वृतो surrounded, नानाप्रहरणैः with various weapons, निर्ययौ departed, त्रिदशाधिपः the lord of the gods.
explanation: The lord of the gods, surrounded by Rudras, Vasus, Adityas, Sadhyas, and groups of Maruts, all bearing various weapons, then departed.

shloka_text: निर्गच्छतस्तु शक्रस्य परुषं पवनो ववौ । भास्करो निष्प्रभश्चासीन्महोल्काश्च प्रपेदिरे ।। 7.28.28 ।।
transliteration: nirgacchatastu śakrasya paruṣaṃ pavano vavau | bhāskaro niṣprabhaścāsīnmaholkāśca prapedire || 7.28.28 ||
translation: निर्गच्छतस्तु but as he was departing, शक्रस्य of Shakra, परुषं harsh, पवनो wind, ववौ blew, भास्करो the sun, निष्प्रभश्चासीत् and became lusterless, महोल्काश्च and great meteors, प्रपेदिरे fell.
explanation: However, as Shakra departed, a harsh wind blew, the sun became dim, and large meteors fell, indicating ill omens.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरो दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान् । आरुरोह रथं दिव्यं निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा ।। 7.28.29 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare śūro daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān | āruroha rathaṃ divyaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā || 7.28.29 ||
translation: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे in the meantime, शूरो the brave, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रतापवान् mighty, आरुरोह ascended, रथं chariot, दिव्यं divine, निर्मितं constructed, विश्वकर्मणा by Vishvakarma.
explanation: At that very moment, the brave and mighty Dashagriva (Ravana) ascended a divine chariot that had been crafted by Vishvakarma.

shloka_text: पन्नगैः सुमहाकार्यैर्वेष्टितं रोमहर्षणैः । तेषां निःश्वासवातेन प्रदीप्तमिव संयुगे ।। 7.28.30 ।।
transliteration: pannagaiḥ sumahākāryairveṣṭitaṃ romaharṣaṇaiḥ | teṣāṃ niḥśvāsavātena pradīptamiva saṃyuge || 7.28.30 ||
translation: पन्नगैः by serpents, सुमहाकार्यैः of very great bodies, वेष्टितं entwined, रोमहर्षणैः terrifying, तेषां their, निःश्वासवातेन by the breath-wind, प्रदीप्तमिव as if blazing, संयुगे in battle.
explanation: This chariot was entwined by terrifying serpents of immense size, whose breath-like wind made it appear as if blazing in battle.

shloka_text: दैत्यैर्निशाचरैश्चैव स रथः परिवारितः । समराभिमुखो दैत्यो महेन्द्रं सो ऽभ्यवर्तत ।। 7.28.31 ।।
transliteration: daityairniśācaraiścaiva sa rathaḥ parivāritaḥ | samarābhimukho daityo mahendraṃ so 'bhyavartata || 7.28.31 ||
translation: दैत्यैः by demons, निशाचरैः by night-wanderers, च and, एव indeed, सः that, रथः chariot, परिवारितः surrounded, समराभिमुखः facing the battle, दैत्यः the demon, महेन्द्रम् towards Mahendra, सः he, अभ्यवर्तत advanced.
explanation: Surrounded by demons and night-wanderers, that chariot, with the demon facing the battle, advanced towards Mahendra.

shloka_text: पुत्रं तं वारयित्वा तु स्वयमेव व्यवस्थितः । सो ऽपि युद्धाद्विनिष्क्रम्य रावणिः समुपाविशत् ।। 7.28.32 ।।
transliteration: putraṃ taṃ vārayitvā tu svayameva vyavasthitaḥ | so 'pi yuddhādviniṣkramya rāvaṇiḥ samupāviśat || 7.28.32 ||
translation: पुत्रम् son, तम् him, वारयित्वा having restrained, तु but, स्वयम् himself, एव indeed, व्यवस्थितः stood, सः he, अपि also, युद्धात् from the battle, विनिष्क्रम्य having exited, रावणिः Ravani, समुपाविशत् sat down.
explanation: Having restrained his son, he himself took his position, while Ravani, having exited the battle, also sat down.

shloka_text: ततो युद्धं प्रवृत्तं तु सुराणां राक्षसैः सह । शस्त्राणि वर्षतां घोरं मेघानामिव संयुगे ।। 7.28.33 ।।
transliteration: tato yuddhaṃ pravṛttaṃ tu surāṇāṃ rākṣasaiḥ saha | śastrāṇi varṣatāṃ ghoraṃ meghānāmiva saṃyuge || 7.28.33 ||
translation: ततः then, युद्धम् battle, प्रवृत्तम् commenced, तु indeed, सुराणाम् of the gods, राक्षसैः with the rakshasas, सह together with, शस्त्राणि weapons, वर्षताम् showering, घोरम् terrible, मेघानाम् of clouds, इव like, संयुगे in battle.
explanation: Then, a terrible battle commenced between the gods and the rakshasas, with weapons showering down like clouds in a fight.

shloka_text: कुम्भकर्णस्तु दुष्टात्मा नानाप्रहरणोद्यतः । नाज्ञायत तदा युद्धे सह केनाप्ययुध्यत ।। 7.28.34 ।।
transliteration: kumbhakarṇastu duṣṭātmā nānāpraharaṇodyataḥ | nājñāyata tadā yuddhe saha kenāpyayudhyata || 7.28.34 ||
translation: कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, तु but, दुष्टात्मा evil-minded, नानाप्रहरणोद्यतः ready with various weapons, न not, अज्ञायत was known, तदा then, युद्धे in battle, सह with, केन whom, अपि even, अयुध्यत he fought.
explanation: The evil-minded Kumbhakarna, ready with various weapons, was then not known with whom he was fighting in the battle.

shloka_text: दन्तैः भुजाभ्यां पद्मां च शक्तितोमरसायकैः । येन केनैव संरब्धस्ताडयामास वै सुरान् ।। 7.28.35 ।।
transliteration: dantaiḥ bhujābhyāṃ padmāṃ ca śaktitomarasāyakaiḥ | yena kenaiva saṃrabdhastāḍayāmāsa vai surān || 7.28.35 ||
translation: दन्तैः with teeth, भुजाभ्याम् with two arms, पद्मां lotus, च and, शक्तितोमरसायकैः with shaktis, tomaras, and arrows, येन केन by whatever, एव indeed, संरब्धः enraged, ताडयामास he struck, वै indeed, सुरान् the gods.
explanation: Enraged, he indeed struck the gods with teeth, with two arms, a lotus, and with shaktis, tomaras, and arrows, by whatever means possible.

shloka_text: ततो रुद्रैर्महाघोरैः सङ्गम्याथ निशाचरः । प्रयुद्धस्तैश्च सङ्ग्रामे क्षतः शस्त्रैर्निरन्तरम् ।। 7.28.36 ।।
transliteration: tato rudrairmahāghoraiḥ saṅgamyātha niśācaraḥ | prayuddhastaiśca saṅgrāme kṣataḥ śastrairnirantaram || 7.28.36 ||
translation: ततः then, रुद्रैः by the Rudras, महाघोरैः extremely terrible, सङ्गम्य having encountered, अथ and, निशाचरः the night-wanderer (Kumbhakarna), प्रयुद्धः fought, तैः by them, च and, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, क्षतः wounded, शस्त्रैः by weapons, निरन्तरम् continuously.
explanation: Then, the night-wanderer Kumbhakarna, having encountered and fought with the extremely terrible Rudras in battle, was continuously wounded by their weapons.

shloka_text: बभौ शस्त्राचिततनुः कुम्भकर्णः क्षरन्नसृक् । विद्युत्स्तनितनिर्घोषो धारवानिव तोयदः ।। 7.28.37 ।।
transliteration: babhau śastrācitatanuḥ kumbhakarṇaḥ kṣarannasṛk | vidyutstanitanirghoṣo dhāravāniva toyadaḥ || 7.28.37 ||
translation: बभौ shone, शस्त्राचिततनुः whose body was covered with weapons, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, क्षरन् flowing, असृक् blood, विद्युत्स्तनितनिर्घोषः with the roar of thunder and lightning, धारवानिव like a rain-bearing, तोयदः cloud.
explanation: Kumbhakarna, with his body covered in weapons and oozing blood, appeared like a rain-bearing cloud accompanied by the roar of thunder and lightning.

shloka_text: ततस्तद्राक्षसं सैन्यं प्रयुद्धं समरुद्गणैः । रणे विद्रावितं सर्वं नानाप्रहरणैः शितैः ।। 7.28.38 ।।
transliteration: tatastadrākṣasaṃ sainyaṃ prayuddhaṃ samarudgaṇaiḥ | raṇe vidrāvitaṃ sarvaṃ nānāpraharaṇaiḥ śitaiḥ || 7.28.38 ||
translation: ततः then, तत् that, राक्षसं Rakshasa, सैन्यं army, प्रयुद्धं having fought, समरुद्गणैः with the Marut hosts, रणे in battle, विद्रावितं dispersed, सर्वं all, नानाप्रहरणैः by various weapons, शितैः sharp.
explanation: Then, that entire Rakshasa army, having fought with the Marut hosts, was routed in battle by their sharp and various weapons.

shloka_text: केचिद्विनिहताः कृत्ताश्चेष्टन्ति स्म महीतले । वाहनेष्ववसक्ताश्च स्थिता एवापरे रणे ।। 7.28.39 ।।
transliteration: kecidvinihatāḥ kṛttāśceṣṭanti sma mahītale | vāhaneṣvavasaktāśca sthitā evāpare raṇe || 7.28.39 ||
translation: केचित् some, विनिहताः killed, कृत्ताः cut down, च and, चेष्टन्ति स्म were writhing, महीतले on the ground, वाहनेषु on their vehicles, अवसक्ताः clinging, च and, स्थिताः remained, एव indeed, अपरे others, रणे in battle.
explanation: Some were killed and cut down, writhing on the ground, while others remained stuck on their vehicles in the battle.

shloka_text: रथान्नागान्खरानुष्ट्रान्पन्नगांस्तुरगान् रणे । शिंशुमारान्वराहांश्च पिशाचवदनान्तथा ।। 7.28.40 ।।
transliteration: rathānnāgānkharānuṣṭrānpannagāṃsturagān raṇe | śiṃśumārānvarāhāṃśca piśācavadanāntathā || 7.28.40 ||
translation: रथान् chariots, नागान् elephants, खरान् donkeys, उष्ट्रान् camels, पन्नगान् serpents, तुरगान् horses, रणे in battle, शिंशुमारान् porpoises, वराहांश्च and boars, पिशाचवदनान् and those with demon-like faces, तथा similarly.
explanation: In the battle, there were chariots, elephants, donkeys, camels, serpents, horses, porpoises, boars, and creatures with demon-like faces.

shloka_text: तान्समालिङ्ग्य बाहुभ्यां विष्टब्धाः केचिदुच्छ्रुताः । देवैस्तु शस्त्रसम्भिन्ना मम्रिरे च निशाचराः ।। 7.28.41 ।।
transliteration: tānsamāliṅgya bāhubhyāṃ viṣṭabdhāḥ keciducchrutāḥ | devaistu śastrasambhinnā mamrire ca niśācarāḥ || 7.28.41 ||
translation: तान् them, समालिङ्ग्य embracing, बाहुभ्याम् with two arms, विष्टब्धाः obstructed/paralyzed, केचित् some, उच्छ्रुताः raised high, देवैः by the gods, तु but, शस्त्रसम्भिन्नाः pierced by weapons, मम्रिरे died, च and, निशाचराः night-wanderers.
explanation: Some night-wanderers, embracing others with their arms, were paralyzed and raised high, while others, pierced by the weapons of the gods, died.

shloka_text: चित्रकर्म इवाभाति स तेषां रणसम्प्लवः । निहतानां प्रमत्तानां राक्षसानां महीतले ।। 7.28.42 ।।
transliteration: citrakarma ivābhāti sa teṣāṃ raṇasamplavaḥ | nihatānāṃ pramattānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ mahītale || 7.28.42 ||
translation: चित्रकर्म a painting, इव like, आभाति appears, सः that, तेषाम् of them, रणसम्प्लवः battle-commotion, निहतानाम् of the slain, प्रमत्तानाम् of the heedless, राक्षसानाम् of the Rakshasas, महीतले on the surface of the earth.
explanation: That scene of the slain and heedless Rakshasas on the earth, amidst the battle's chaos, appeared like a painting.

shloka_text: शोणितोदकनिष्पन्दकङ्कगृध्रसमाकुला । प्रवृत्ता संयुगमुखे शस्त्रग्राहवती नदी ।। 7.28.43 ।।
transliteration: śoṇitodakaniṣpandakaṅkagṛdhrasamākulā | pravṛttā saṃyugamukhe śastragrāhavatī nadī || 7.28.43 ||
translation: शोणितोदकनिष्पन्द flowing with blood as water, कङ्कगृध्रसमाकुला crowded with vultures and eagles, प्रवृत्ता flowed forth, संयुगमुखे at the forefront of the battle, शस्त्रग्राहवती having weapons as alligators, नदी a river.
explanation: At the forefront of the battle, a river flowed forth, its waters of blood, crowded with vultures and eagles, and having weapons as its alligators.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान् । निरीक्ष्य तद्बलं कृत्स्नं दैवतैर्विनिपातितम् ।। 7.28.44 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare kruddho daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān | nirīkṣya tadbalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ daivatairvinipātitam || 7.28.44 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, क्रुद्धः enraged, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रतापवान् mighty, निरीक्ष्य having seen, तत् that, बलम् army, कृत्स्नम् entire, दैवतैः by the gods, विनिपातितम् destroyed.
explanation: In the meantime, the mighty Dashagriva, enraged upon seeing his entire army destroyed by the gods, reacted fiercely.

shloka_text: स तं प्रति विगाह्याशु प्रवृद्धं सैन्यसागरम् । त्रिदशान्समरे निघ्नञ्छक्रमेवाभ्यवर्तत ।। 7.28.45 ।।
transliteration: sa taṃ prati vigāhyāśu pravṛddhaṃ sainyasāgaram | tridaśānsamare nighnañchakramevābhyavartata || 7.28.45 ||
translation: सः he, तम् that, प्रति towards, विगाह्य having plunged into, आशु quickly, प्रवृद्धम् swollen, सैन्यसागरम् ocean of army, त्रिदशान् the gods, समरे in battle, निघ्नन् striking, शक्रम् Indra, एव indeed, अभ्यवर्तत attacked.
explanation: He quickly plunged into that swollen ocean of the enemy army, striking down the gods in battle, and advanced directly towards Indra.

shloka_text: आगाच्छक्रो महच्चापं विस्फार्य सुमहास्वनम् । यस्य विस्फारघोषेण स्तनन्ति स्म दिशो दश ।। 7.28.46 ।।
transliteration: āgācchakro mahaccāpaṃ visphārya sumahāsvanam | yasya visphāraghoṣeṇa stananti sma diśo daśa || 7.28.46 ||
translation: आगात् came, शक्रः Indra, महत् great, चापम् bow, विस्फार्य having stretched, सुमहास्वनम् with a very great sound, यस्य whose, विस्फारघोषेण by the sound of stretching (the bow), स्तनन्ति स्म were thundering, दिशः directions, दश ten
explanation: Indra arrived, drawing his mighty bow with a tremendous sound, the reverberations of which caused the ten directions to thunder.

shloka_text: तद्विकृष्य महच्चापमिन्द्रो रावणमूर्धनि । निपातयामास शरान्पावकादित्यवर्चसः ।। 7.28.47 ।।
transliteration: tadvikṛṣya mahaccāpamindro rāvaṇamūrdhani | nipātayāmāsa śarānpāvakādityavarcasaḥ || 7.28.47 ||
translation: तत् that, विकृष्य having drawn, महत् great, चापम् bow, इन्द्रः Indra, रावणमूर्धनि on Ravana's head, निपातयामास rained down, शरान् arrows, पावकादित्यवर्चसः having the brilliance of fire and the sun
explanation: Drawing that great bow, Indra rained down arrows on Ravana's head, arrows that shone with the brilliance of fire and the sun.

shloka_text: तथैव च महाबाहुर्दशग्रीवो व्यवस्थितः । शक्रं कार्मुकविभ्रष्टैः शरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ।। 7.28.48 ।।
transliteration: tathaiva ca mahābāhurdaśagrīvo vyavasthitaḥ | śakraṃ kārmukavibhraṣṭaiḥ śaravarṣairavākirat || 7.28.48 ||
translation: तथैव just so, च and, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), व्यवस्थितः stood firm, शक्रम् Indra, कार्मुकविभ्रष्टैः released from his bow, शरवर्षैः with showers of arrows, अवाकिरत् covered
explanation: And similarly, the mighty-armed Dashagriva stood firm and covered Indra with showers of arrows released from his bow.

shloka_text: प्रयुध्यतोरथ तयोर्बाणवर्षैः समन्ततः । न ज्ञायते तदा किञ्चित्सर्वं हि तमसा वृतम् ।। 7.28.49 ।।
transliteration: prayudhyatoratha tayorbāṇavarṣaiḥ samantataḥ | na jñāyate tadā kiñcitsarvaṃ hi tamasā vṛtam || 7.28.49 ||
translation: प्रयुध्यतोः as they fought, अथ then, तयोः of those two, बाणवर्षैः with showers of arrows, समन्ततः all around, न not, ज्ञायते was known, तदा then, किञ्चित् anything, सर्वम् everything, हि indeed, तमसा by darkness, वृतम् covered
explanation: As those two fought with showers of arrows all around, nothing could be discerned then, for everything was indeed covered by darkness. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टाविंशः सर्गः ।। 28 ।। Thus ends the twenty-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततस्तमसि सञ्जाते सर्वे ते देवराक्षसाः । अयुद्ध्यन्त बलोन्मत्ताः सूदयन्तः परस्परम् ।। 7.29.1 ।।
transliteration: tatastamasi sañjāte sarve te devarākṣasāḥ | ayuddhyanta balonmattāḥ sūdayantaḥ parasparam || 7.29.1 ||
translation: ततः then, तमसि in the darkness, सञ्जाते having arisen, सर्वे all, ते those, देवराक्षसाः gods and demons, अयुद्ध्यन्त fought, बलोन्मत्ताः intoxicated with strength, सूदयन्तः slaying, परस्परम् each other
explanation: Then, with the darkness having arisen, all those gods and demons, intoxicated with their strength, fought, slaying each other.
comments: In the darkened battle Indra resolves to take Ravana alive, since the boon forbids his death, and seizes him -- but Indrajit, wielding his won illusion of invisibility, binds Indra himself and bears him off captive -- the dismayed gods cease fighting, and Ravana, exulting in his son's feat, has the bound Indra carried to Lanka.

shloka_text: ततस्तु देवसैन्येन राक्षसानां बृहद्बलम् । दशांशं स्थापितं युद्धे शेषं नीतं यमक्षयम् ।। 7.29.2 ।।
transliteration: tatastu devasainyena rākṣasānāṃ bṛhadbalam | daśāṃśaṃ sthāpitaṃ yuddhe śeṣaṃ nītaṃ yamakṣayam || 7.29.2 ||
translation: ततस्तु then indeed, देवसैन्येन by the army of gods, राक्षसानां of the Rākṣasas, बृहद्बलम् the great army, दशांशं one-tenth, स्थापितं remained, युद्धे in the battle, शेषं the rest, नीतं was led, यमक्षयम् to the abode of Yama.
explanation: Then, by the army of gods, only one-tenth of the great Rākṣasa army remained in the battle, while the rest were sent to the abode of Yama.

shloka_text: तस्मिंस्तु तामसे युद्धे सर्वे ते देवराक्षसाः । अन्योन्यं नाभ्यजानन्त युध्यमानाः परस्परम् ।। 7.29.3 ।।
transliteration: tasmiṃstu tāmase yuddhe sarve te devarākṣasāḥ | anyonyaṃ nābhyajānanta yudhyamānāḥ parasparam || 7.29.3 ||
translation: तस्मिंस्तु in that indeed, तामसे dark, युद्धे battle, सर्वे all, ते those, देवराक्षसाः gods and Rākṣasas, अन्योन्यं each other, नाभ्यजानन्त did not recognize, युध्यमानाः fighting, परस्परम् each other.
explanation: In that dark and chaotic battle, all those gods and Rākṣasas, fighting each other, could not recognize one another.

shloka_text: इन्द्रश्च रावणश्चैव रावणिश्च महाबलः । तस्मिंस्तमोजालवृते मोहमीयुर्न ते त्रयः ।। 7.29.4 ।।
transliteration: indraśca rāvaṇaścaiva rāvaṇiśca mahābalaḥ | tasmiṃstamojālavṛte mohamīyurna te trayaḥ || 7.29.4 ||
translation: इन्द्रश्च Indra and, रावणश्चैव Rāvaṇa and indeed, रावणिश्च Rāvaṇi (Indrajit) and, महाबलः the mighty, तस्मिंस्तमोजालवृते in that enveloped in a net of darkness, मोहम् delusion, ईयुः attained, न not, ते those, त्रयः three.
explanation: However, Indra, Rāvaṇa, and the mighty Indrajit, these three, did not fall into delusion in that battle enveloped by a net of darkness.

shloka_text: स तु दृष्ट्वा बलं सर्वं रावणो निहतं क्षणात् । क्रोधमभ्यगमत्तीव्रं महानादं च मुक्तवान् ।। 7.29.5 ।।
transliteration: sa tu dṛṣṭvā balaṃ sarvaṃ rāvaṇo nihataṃ kṣaṇāt | krodhamabhyagamattīvraṃ mahānādaṃ ca muktavān || 7.29.5 ||
translation: स He, तु indeed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, बलं the army, सर्वं all, रावणो Rāvaṇa, निहतं destroyed, क्षणात् in an instant, क्रोधम् anger, अभ्यगमत attained, तीव्रं intense, महानादं a great roar, च and, मुक्तवान् uttered.
explanation: Seeing his entire army destroyed in an instant, Rāvaṇa indeed became intensely angry and let out a great roar.

shloka_text: क्रोधात्सूतं च दुर्धर्षः स्यन्दनस्थमुवाच ह । परसैन्यस्य मध्येन यावदन्तो नयस्व माम् ।। 7.29.6 ।।
transliteration: krodhātsūtaṃ ca durdharṣaḥ syandanasthamuvāca ha | parasainyasya madhyena yāvadanto nayasva mām || 7.29.6 ||
translation: क्रोधात् From anger, सूतं to the charioteer, च and, दुर्धर्षः the formidable one, स्यन्दनस्थम् situated in the chariot, उवाच spoke, ह indeed, परसैन्यस्य of the enemy's army, मध्येन through the middle, यावत् until, अन्तः the end, नयस्व lead, माम् me.
explanation: In his anger, the formidable Rāvaṇa spoke to his charioteer, who was in the chariot, instructing him to drive him through the middle of the enemy's army until its complete destruction.

shloka_text: अद्यैतान् त्रिदशान्सर्वान्विक्रमैः समरे स्वयम् । नानाशस्त्रैर्महाघोरैर्नयामि यमसादनम् ।। 7.29.7 ।।
transliteration: adyaitān tridaśānsarvānvikramaiḥ samare svayam | nānāśastrairmahāghorairnayāmi yamasādanam || 7.29.7 ||
translation: अद्य today, एतान् these, त्रिदशान् gods, सर्वान् all, विक्रमैः with valor, समरे in battle, स्वयम् myself, नानाशस्त्रैः with various weapons, महाघोरैः very terrible, नयामि I shall lead, यमसादनम् to the abode of Yama.
explanation: Today, I myself shall lead all these gods to the abode of Yama, in battle, with my valor and very terrible, various weapons.

shloka_text: अहमिन्द्रं वधिष्यामि धनदं वरुणं यमम् । त्रिदशान्विनिहत्याथ स्वयं स्थास्याम्यथोपरि । विषादो न च कर्तव्यः शीघ्रं वाहय मे रथम् ।। 7.29.8 ।।
transliteration: ahamindraṃ vadhiṣyāmi dhanadaṃ varuṇaṃ yamam | tridaśānvinihatyātha svayaṃ sthāsyāmyathopari | viṣādo na ca kartavyaḥ śīghraṃ vāhaya me ratham || 7.29.8 ||
translation: अहम् I, इन्द्रम् Indra, वधिष्यामि I shall kill, धनदम् Kubera, वरुणम् Varuna, यमम् Yama, त्रिदशान् gods, विनिहत्य having killed completely, अथ then, स्वयम् myself, स्थास्यामि I shall stand, अथोपरि supreme, विषादः sorrow, न not, च and, कर्तव्यः should be done, शीघ्रम् quickly, वाहय drive, मे my, रथम् chariot.
explanation: I shall kill Indra, Kubera, Varuna, and Yama, and having completely slain all the gods, I myself shall then stand supreme; therefore, do not despair, but quickly drive my chariot.

shloka_text: द्विः खलु त्वां ब्रवीम्यद्य यावदन्तो नयस्व माम् ।। 7.29.9 ।।
transliteration: dviḥ khalu tvāṃ bravīmyadya yāvadanto nayasva mām || 7.29.9 ||
translation: द्विः twice, खलु indeed, त्वाम् to you, ब्रवीमि I say, अद्य today, यावदन्तः to the very end, नयस्व take, माम् me.
explanation: Indeed, I tell you twice today, take me to the very end (of the journey).

shloka_text: अयं स नन्दनोद्देशो यत्र वर्तामहे वयम् । नय मामद्य तत्र त्वमुदयो यत्र पर्वतः ।। 7.29.10 ।।
transliteration: ayaṃ sa nandanoddeśo yatra vartāmahe vayam | naya māmadya tatra tvamudayo yatra parvataḥ || 7.29.10 ||
translation: अयम् this, सः that, नन्दनोद्देशः region of Nandana, यत्र where, वर्तामहे we are, वयम् we, नय take, माम् me, अद्य today, तत्र there, त्वम् you, उदयः Udaya, यत्र where, पर्वतः mountain.
explanation: This is that region of Nandana where we are now; today, you take me to that place where the Udaya mountain is.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा तुरगान्स मनोजवान् । आदिदेशाथ शत्रणां मध्येनैव च सारथिः ।। 7.29.11 ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā turagānsa manojavān | ādideśātha śatraṇāṃ madhyenaiva ca sārathiḥ || 7.29.11 ||
translation: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, तुरगान् horses, सः he, मनोजवान् swift as thought, आदिदेश commanded, अथ then, शत्रूणाम् of the enemies, मध्येन through the midst, एव indeed, च and, सारथिः the charioteer.
explanation: Having heard his command, the charioteer then commanded the horses, swift as thought, to proceed directly through the midst of the enemies.

shloka_text: तस्य तं निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा शक्रो देवेश्वरस्तदा । रथस्थः समरस्थस्तान्देवान्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।। 7.29.12 ।।
transliteration: tasya taṃ niścayaṃ jñātvā śakro deveśvarastadā | rathasthaḥ samarasthastāndevānvākyamathābravīt || 7.29.12 ||
translation: तस्य his, तं that, निश्चयं resolve, ज्ञात्वा having known, शक्रः Indra, देवेश्वरः the lord of gods, तदा then, रथस्थः standing in his chariot, समरस्थः standing in battle, तान् those, देवान् gods, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Then, Indra, the lord of gods, having understood his (Ravana's) determination, spoke these words to the gods who were also present in the battlefield, while he stood in his chariot.

shloka_text: सुराः शृणुत मद्वाक्यं यत्तावन्मम रोचते । जीवन्नेव दशग्रीवः साधु रक्षो निगृह्यताम् ।। 7.29.13 ।।
transliteration: surāḥ śṛṇuta madvākyaṃ yattāvanmama rocate | jīvanneva daśagrīvaḥ sādhu rakṣo nigṛhyatām || 7.29.13 ||
translation: सुराः O gods, शृणुत listen, मद्वाक्यं to my words, यत् which, तावत् indeed, मम to me, रोचते is pleasing, जीवन् living, एव only, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, साधु properly, रक्षः the demon, निगृह्यताम् let him be captured.
explanation: O gods, listen to my words, which seem good to me: this demon Dashagriva should be captured alive.

shloka_text: एष ह्यतिबलः सैन्यै रथेन पवनौजसा । गमिष्यति प्रवृद्धोर्मिः समुद्र इव पर्वणि ।। 7.29.14 ।।
transliteration: eṣa hyatibalaḥ sainyai rathena pavanaujasā | gamiṣyati pravṛddhormiḥ samudra iva parvaṇi || 7.29.14 ||
translation: एषः this one, हि indeed, अतिबलः very powerful, सैन्यैः with his armies, रथेन with his chariot, पवनौजसा having the speed of wind, गमिष्यति will proceed, प्रवृद्धोर्मिः with rising waves, समुद्रः an ocean, इव like, पर्वणि on a full moon day.
explanation: This Ravana, indeed very powerful with his armies and his wind-swift chariot, will advance like an ocean with surging waves on a full moon day.

shloka_text: नह्येष हन्तुं शक्यो ऽद्य वरदानात्सुनिर्भयः । तद्ग्रहीष्यामहे रक्षो यत्ता भवत संयुगे ।। 7.29.15 ।।
transliteration: nahyeṣa hantuṃ śakyo 'dya varadānātsunirbhayaḥ | tadgrahīṣyāmahe rakṣo yattā bhavata saṃyuge || 7.29.15 ||
translation: न not, हि indeed, एषः this one, हन्तुं to kill, शक्यः is possible, अद्य today, वरदानात् due to the boon, सुनिर्भयः very fearless, तत् therefore, ग्रहीष्यामहे we shall capture, रक्षः the demon, यत्ताः prepared, भवत be, संयुगे in battle.
explanation: Indeed, it is not possible to kill him today because he is very fearless due to the boon, therefore, let us capture this demon, and be prepared in battle.

shloka_text: यथा बलौ निरुद्धे च त्रैलोक्यं भुज्यते मया । एवमेतस्य पापस्य निरोधो मम रोचते ।। 7.29.16 ।।
transliteration: yathā balau niruddhe ca trailokyaṃ bhujyate mayā | evametasya pāpasya nirodho mama rocate || 7.29.16 ||
translation: यथा just as, बलौ Bali, निरुद्धे having been restrained, च and, त्रैलोक्यं the three worlds, भुज्यते are enjoyed, मया by me, एवम् similarly, एतस्य of this, पापस्य wicked one, निरोधः the restraint, मम to me, रोचते is pleasing.
explanation: Just as the three worlds are enjoyed by me after Bali was restrained, similarly, the restraint of this wicked one is pleasing to me.

shloka_text: ततो ऽन्यं देशमास्थाय शक्रः सन्त्यज्य रावणम् । अयुध्यत महाराज राक्षसांस्त्रासयन्रणे ।। 7.29.17 ।।
transliteration: tato 'nyaṃ deśamāsthāya śakraḥ santyajya rāvaṇam | ayudhyata mahārāja rākṣasāṃstrāsayanraṇe || 7.29.17 ||
translation: ततः then, अन्यम् another, देशम् place, आस्थाय having resorted to, शक्रः Indra, सन्त्यज्य having abandoned, रावणम् Ravana, अयुध्यत fought, महाराज O great king, राक्षसान् the Rakshasas, त्रासयन् terrifying, रणे in battle,
explanation: Then, O great king, Indra, leaving Ravana, took up another position and fought, terrifying the Rakshasas in battle.

shloka_text: उत्तरेण दशग्रीवः प्रविवेशानिवर्तकः । दक्षिणेन तु पार्श्वेन प्रविवेश शतक्रतुः ।। 7.29.18 ।।
transliteration: uttareṇa daśagrīvaḥ praviveśānivartakaḥ | dakṣiṇena tu pārśvena praviveśa śatakratuḥ || 7.29.18 ||
translation: उत्तरेण by the northern side, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva (Ravana), प्रविवेश entered, अनिवर्तकः without retreating, दक्षिणेन by the southern, तु but, पार्श्वेन side, प्रविवेश entered, शतक्रतुः Shatakratu (Indra),
explanation: Dashagriva entered from the northern side without retreating, while Shatakratu entered from the southern side.

shloka_text: ततः स योजनशतं प्रविष्टो राक्षसाधिपः । देवतानां बलं सर्वं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ।। 7.29.19 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa yojanaśataṃ praviṣṭo rākṣasādhipaḥ | devatānāṃ balaṃ sarvaṃ śaravarṣairavākirat || 7.29.19 ||
translation: ततः then, स he, योजनशतम् a hundred yojanas, प्रविष्टः having advanced, राक्षसाधिपः the lord of Rakshasas, देवतानाम् of the gods, बलम् army, सर्वम् all, शरवर्षैः with showers of arrows, अवाकिरत् covered,
explanation: Then, having advanced a hundred yojanas, the lord of Rakshasas covered the entire army of the gods with showers of arrows.

shloka_text: ततः शक्रो निरीक्ष्याथ प्रनष्टं तु स्वकं बलम् । न्यवर्तयदसम्भ्रान्तः समावृत्य दशाननम् ।। 7.29.20 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ śakro nirīkṣyātha pranaṣṭaṃ tu svakaṃ balam | nyavartayadasambhrāntaḥ samāvṛtya daśānanam || 7.29.20 ||
translation: ततः then, शक्रः Indra, निरीक्ष्य having seen, अथ then, प्रनष्टम् routed, तु indeed, स्वकम् his own, बलम् army, न्यवर्तयत् turned back (to face), असम्भ्रान्तः unperturbed, समावृत्य having turned towards, दशाननम् Dashanana (Ravana),
explanation: Then, seeing his own army routed, Indra, unperturbed, turned back to face Dashanana.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे नादो मुक्तो दानवराक्षसैः । हा हताः स्म इति ग्रस्तं दृष्ट्वा शक्रेण रावणम् ।। 7.29.21 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare nādo mukto dānavarākṣasaiḥ | hā hatāḥ sma iti grastaṃ dṛṣṭvā śakreṇa rāvaṇam || 7.29.21 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, नादः a cry, मुक्तः was let out, दानवराक्षसैः by the Danavas and Rakshasas, हा alas, हताः killed, स्म indeed, इति thus, ग्रस्तम् seized, दृष्ट्वा having seen, शक्रेण by Indra, रावणम् Ravana,
explanation: In the meantime, the Danavas and Rakshasas, seeing Ravana seized by Indra, let out a cry of "Alas, we are indeed killed!"

shloka_text: ततो रथं समास्थाय रावणिः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः । तत्सैन्यमतिसङ्क्रुद्धः प्रविवेश सुदारुणम् ।। 7.29.22 ।।
transliteration: tato rathaṃ samāsthāya rāvaṇiḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ | tatsainyamatisaṅkruddhaḥ praviveśa sudāruṇam || 7.29.22 ||
translation: ततः then, रथम् chariot, समास्थाय having mounted, रावणिः Ravana's son (Indrajit), क्रोधमूर्च्छितः overcome with rage, तत्सैन्यम् that army, अतिसङ्क्रुद्धः extremely enraged, प्रविवेश entered, सुदारुणम् very terrible (army)
explanation: Then, Indrajit, consumed by extreme rage, mounted his chariot and furiously entered that formidable army.

shloka_text: तां प्रविश्य महामायां प्राप्तां गोपतिना पुरा । प्रविवेश सुसंरब्धस्तत्सैन्यं समभिद्रवत् ।। 7.29.23 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ praviśya mahāmāyāṃ prāptāṃ gopatinā purā | praviveśa susaṃrabdhastatsainyaṃ samabhidravat || 7.29.23 ||
translation: ताम् that, प्रविश्य having entered, महामायां great illusion, प्राप्ताम् obtained, गोपतिना by the lord of cows (Indra), पुरा formerly, प्रविवेश entered, सुसंरब्धः greatly agitated, तत्सैन्यम् that army, समभिद्रवत् attacked
explanation: Having entered that great illusion, which was formerly obtained by Indra, Indrajit, greatly agitated, entered and attacked that army.

shloka_text: स सर्वा देवतास्त्यक्त्वा शक्रमेवाभ्यधावत । महेन्द्रश्च महातेजा नापश्यच्च सुतं रिपोः ।। 7.29.24 ।।
transliteration: sa sarvā devatāstyaktvā śakramevābhyadhāvata | mahendraśca mahātejā nāpaśyacca sutaṃ ripoḥ || 7.29.24 ||
