translation: सः he (Indrajit), सर्वाः all, देवताः gods, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, शक्रम् Indra, एव only, अभ्यधावत rushed towards, महेन्द्रः Mahendra (Indra), च and, महातेजाः greatly effulgent, न not, अपश्यत् saw, च and, सुतम् son, रिपोः of the enemy (Indrajit)
explanation: Indrajit, disregarding all other gods, rushed only towards Indra, but the greatly effulgent Mahendra could not see the enemy's son.

shloka_text: विमुक्तकवचस्तत्र वध्यमानो ऽपि रावणिः । त्रिदशैः सुमहावीर्यैर्न चकार च किञ्चन ।। 7.29.25 ।।
transliteration: vimuktakavacastatra vadhyamāno 'pi rāvaṇiḥ | tridaśaiḥ sumahāvīryairna cakāra ca kiñcana || 7.29.25 ||
translation: विमुक्तकवचः without armor, तत्र there, वध्यमानः being struck, अपि even, रावणिः Ravana's son (Indrajit), त्रिदशैः by the gods, सुमहावीर्यैः of great valor, न not, चकार did, च and, किञ्चन anything (to him)
explanation: Even though Indrajit was without armor and being struck there by the exceedingly valiant gods, he did not suffer any harm.

shloka_text: स मातलिं समायान्तं ताडयित्वा शरोत्तमैः । महेन्द्रं बाणवर्षेण भूय एवाभ्यवाकिरत् ।। 7.29.26 ।।
transliteration: sa mātaliṃ samāyāntaṃ tāḍayitvā śarottamaiḥ | mahendraṃ bāṇavarṣeṇa bhūya evābhyavākirat || 7.29.26 ||
translation: सः he (Indrajit), मातलिम् Matali (Indra's charioteer), समायान्तम् approaching, ताडयित्वा having struck, शरोत्तमैः with excellent arrows, महेन्द्रम् Mahendra (Indra), बाणवर्षेण with a shower of arrows, भूयः again, एव only, अभ्यवाकिरत् covered/showered
explanation: Having struck Matali, who was approaching, with excellent arrows, Indrajit then again showered Mahendra with a volley of arrows.

shloka_text: ततस्त्यक्त्वा रथं शक्रो विससर्ज च सारथिम् । ऐरावतं समारुह्य मृगयामास रावणिम् ।। 7.29.27 ।।
transliteration: tatastyaktvā rathaṃ śakro visasarja ca sārathim | airāvataṃ samāruhya mṛgayāmāsa rāvaṇim || 7.29.27 ||
translation: ततः then, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, रथं the chariot, शक्रः Indra, विससर्ज dismissed, च and, सारथिम् the charioteer, ऐरावतं Airavata, समारुह्य having mounted, मृगयामास searched for, रावणिम् Ravana's son.
explanation: Then, Indra abandoned his chariot and dismissed his charioteer, and having mounted Airavata, he searched for Ravana's son.

shloka_text: स तत्र मायाबलवानदृश्यो ऽथान्तरिक्षगः । इन्द्रं मायापरिक्षिप्तं कृत्वा स प्राद्रवच्छरैः ।। 7.29.28 ।।
transliteration: sa tatra māyābalavānadṛśyo 'thāntarikṣagaḥ | indraṃ māyāparikṣiptaṃ kṛtvā sa prādravaccharaiḥ || 7.29.28 ||
translation: सः he, तत्र there, मायाबलवान् powerful with illusion, अदृश्यः invisible, अथ then, अन्तरिक्षगः moving in the sky, इन्द्रं Indra, मायापरिक्षिप्तं enveloped in illusion, कृत्वा having made, सः he, प्राद्रवत् attacked, शरैः with arrows.
explanation: There, Indrajit, powerful with illusion and invisible, moving in the sky, enveloped Indra in illusion and then attacked him with arrows.

shloka_text: स तं यदा परिश्रान्तमिन्द्रं जज्ञे ऽथ रावणिः । तदैनं मायया बद्ध्वा स्वसैन्यमभितो ऽनयत् ।। 7.29.29 ।।
transliteration: sa taṃ yadā pariśrāntamindraṃ jajñe 'tha rāvaṇiḥ | tadainaṃ māyayā baddhvā svasainyamabhito 'nayat || 7.29.29 ||
translation: सः he, तं him, यदा when, परिश्रान्तं exhausted, इन्द्रं Indra, जज्ञे knew, अथ then, रावणिः Ravana's son, तदा then, एनं him, मायया with illusion, बद्ध्वा having bound, स्वसैन्यम् to his own army, अभितः around, अनयत् led.
explanation: When Ravana's son knew Indra to be exhausted, he then bound him with illusion and led him around his own army.

shloka_text: तं तु दृष्ट्वा बलात्तेन नीयमानं महारणात् । महेन्द्रममराः सर्वे किं नु स्यादित्यचिन्तयन् ।। 7.29.30 ।।
transliteration: taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā balāttena nīyamānaṃ mahāraṇāt | mahendramamarāḥ sarve kiṃ nu syādityacintayan || 7.29.30 ||
translation: तं him, तु indeed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, बलात् by force, तेन by him, नीयमानं being led, महारणात् from the great battle, महेन्द्रम् the great Indra, अमराः the gods, सर्वे all, किं what, नु indeed, स्यात् would happen, इति thus, अचिन्तयन् thought.
explanation: Having seen the great Indra being led away by force from the great battle by him, all the gods wondered what would happen next.

shloka_text: दृश्यते न स मायावी शक्रजित्समितिञ्जयः । विद्यावानपि येनेन्द्रो मायया नीयते बलात् ।। 7.29.31 ।।
transliteration: dṛśyate na sa māyāvī śakrajitsamitiñjayaḥ | vidyāvānapi yenendro māyayā nīyate balāt || 7.29.31 ||
translation: दृश्यते is seen, न not, सः he, मायावी the illusionist, शक्रजित् Indrajit, समितिञ्जयः conqueror in battle, विद्यावान् knowledgeable, अपि even, येन by whom, इन्द्रः Indra, मायया by illusion, नीयते is led, बलात् by force.
explanation: The illusionist Indrajit, the conqueror in battle, is not seen, by whom even the knowledgeable Indra is being led away by force through illusion.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धाः सर्वे सुरगणास्तदा । रावणं विमुखीकृत्य शरवर्षैरवाकिरन् ।। 7.29.32 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare kruddhāḥ sarve suragaṇāstadā | rāvaṇaṃ vimukhīkṛtya śaravarṣairavākiran || 7.29.32 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे meantime, क्रुद्धाः enraged, सर्वे all, सुरगणाः hosts of gods, तदा then, रावणं Ravana, विमुखीकृत्य having turned away (defeated), शरवर्षैः with showers of arrows, अवाकिरन् showered upon.
explanation: At that moment, all the enraged hosts of gods, having defeated Ravana, showered him with torrents of arrows.

shloka_text: रावणस्तु समासाद्य आदित्यांश्च वसूंस्तदा । न शशाक स सङ्ग्रामे योद्धुं शत्रुभिरर्दितः ।। 7.29.33 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇastu samāsādya ādityāṃśca vasūṃstadā | na śaśāka sa saṅgrāme yoddhuṃ śatrubhirarditaḥ || 7.29.33 ||
translation: रावणः Ravana, तु but, समासाद्य having encountered, आदित्यान् Adityas, च and, वसून् Vasus, तदा then, न not, शशाक was able, स he, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, योद्धुं to fight, शत्रुभिः by enemies, अर्दितः afflicted.
explanation: But Ravana, having encountered the Adityas and Vasus, was then unable to fight in battle, being tormented by his enemies.

shloka_text: स तं दृष्ट्वा परिम्लानं प्रहारैर्जर्जरीकृतम् । रावणिः पितरं युद्धे दर्शनस्थो ऽब्रवीदिदम् ।। 7.29.34 ।।
transliteration: sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā parimlānaṃ prahārairjarjarīkṛtam | rāvaṇiḥ pitaraṃ yuddhe darśanastho 'bravīdidam || 7.29.34 ||
translation: स he, तं him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, परिम्लानं greatly exhausted, प्रहारैः by blows, जर्जरीकृतम् shattered, रावणिः Ravani (Indrajit), पितरं father, युद्धे in battle, दर्शनस्थः standing in sight, अब्रवीत् spoke, इदम् this.
explanation: Seeing his father greatly exhausted and shattered by the blows in battle, Indrajit, standing visible, spoke these words to him.

shloka_text: आगच्छ तात गच्छामो रणकर्म निवर्तताम् । जितं नो विदितं ते ऽस्तु स्वस्थो भव गतज्वरः ।। 7.29.35 ।।
transliteration: āgaccha tāta gacchāmo raṇakarma nivartatām | jitaṃ no viditaṃ te 'stu svastho bhava gatajvaraḥ || 7.29.35 ||
translation: आगच्छ come, तात father, गच्छामः let us go, रणकर्म the act of war, निवर्तताम् let it cease. जितं victory, नः our, विदितं known, ते to you, अस्तु let it be. स्वस्थः well, भव be, गतज्वरः free from distress.
explanation: "Come, father, let us go; let this fighting cease, for our victory is known to you; be well and free from distress."

shloka_text: अयं हि सुरसैन्यस्य त्रैलोक्यस्य च यः प्रभुः । स गृहीतो दैवबलाद्भग्नदर्पाः सुराः कृताः ।। 7.29.36 ।।
transliteration: ayaṃ hi surasainyasya trailokyasya ca yaḥ prabhuḥ | sa gṛhīto daivabalādbhagnadarpāḥ surāḥ kṛtāḥ || 7.29.36 ||
translation: अयम् this one, हि indeed, सुरसैन्यस्य of the army of gods, त्रैलोक्यस्य of the three worlds, च and, यः who, प्रभुः lord, स he, गृहीतः captured, दैवबलात् by divine power. भग्नदर्पाः with broken pride, सुराः gods, कृताः made.
explanation: "Indeed, this one who is the lord of the army of gods and of the three worlds has been captured by divine power, and thus the gods have been rendered with broken pride."

shloka_text: यथेष्टं भुङ्क्ष्व लोकांस्त्रीन्निगृह्यारातिमोजसा । वृथा किं ते श्रमेणेह युद्धमद्य तु निष्फलम् ।। 7.29.37 ।।
transliteration: yatheṣṭaṃ bhuṅkṣva lokāṃstrīnnigṛhyārātimojasā | vṛthā kiṃ te śrameṇeha yuddhamadya tu niṣphalam || 7.29.37 ||
translation: यथेष्टम् as desired, भुङ्क्ष्व enjoy, लोकान्त्रीन् three worlds, निगृह्य having subdued, अरातिम् the enemy, ओजसा with might, वृथा in vain, किम् why, ते your, श्रमेण with effort, इह here, युद्धम् battle, अद्य today, तु indeed, निष्फलम् fruitless, ...
explanation: Enjoy the three worlds to your heart's content, having subdued the enemy with your might; why exert yourself in vain here, for today's battle is indeed fruitless.

shloka_text: ततस्ते दैवतगणा निवृत्ता रणकर्मणः । तच्छ्रुत्वा रावणेर्वाक्यं स्वस्थचेताः बभूव ह ।। 7.29.38 ।।
transliteration: tataste daivatagaṇā nivṛttā raṇakarmaṇaḥ | tacchrutvā rāvaṇervākyaṃ svasthacetāḥ babhūva ha || 7.29.38 ||
translation: ततः then, ते those, दैवतगणाः hosts of gods, निवृत्ताः ceased, रणकर्मणः from the act of battle, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, रावणेः of Ravani (Indrajit), वाक्यम् speech, स्वस्थचेताः with a calm mind, बभूव became, ह indeed, ...
explanation: Then, having heard that speech of Indrajit, those hosts of gods ceased from the act of battle and indeed became composed.

shloka_text: अथ स रणविगतज्वरः प्रभुर्विजयमवाप्य निशाचराधिपः । स्वभवनमभितो जगाम हृष्टः स्वसुतमवाप्य च वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। 7.29.39 ।।
transliteration: atha sa raṇavigatajvaraḥ prabhurvijayamavāpya niśācarādhipaḥ | svabhavanamabhito jagāma hṛṣṭaḥ svasutamavāpya ca vākyamabravīt || 7.29.39 ||
translation: अथ then, सः he, रणविगतज्वरः free from the fever of battle, प्रभुः lord, विजयम् victory, अवाप्य having obtained, निशाचराधिपः lord of night-wanderers (Ravana), स्वभवनम् to his own palace, अभितः towards, जगाम went, हृष्टः delighted, स्वसुतम् his own son, अवाप्य having met, च and, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, ...
explanation: Then, Ravana, the lord of night-wanderers, having obtained victory and being free from the fever of battle, went joyfully towards his own palace and, having met his son, spoke these words.

shloka_text: अतिबलसदृशैः पराक्रमैस्तैर्मम कुलमानविवर्धनं कृतम् । यदयमतुल्यबलस्त्वयाद्य वै त्रिदशपतिस्त्रिदशाश्च निर्जिताः ।। 7.29.40 ।।
transliteration: atibalasadṛśaiḥ parākramaistairmama kulamānavivardhanaṃ kṛtam | yadayamatulyabalastvayādya vai tridaśapatistridaśāśca nirjitāḥ || 7.29.40 ||
translation: अतिबलसदृशैः with exceedingly mighty, पराक्रमैः valorous deeds, तैः by those, मम my, कुलमान family's honor, विवर्धनम् enhancement, कृतम् has been done, यत् that, अयम् this, अतुल्यबलः of incomparable strength, त्वया by you, अद्य today, वै indeed, त्रिदशपतिः lord of the thirty (Indra), त्रिदशाः the thirty (gods), च and, निर्जिताः conquered, ...
explanation: By those exceedingly mighty valorous deeds, my family's honor has been greatly enhanced, for today, this Indra of incomparable strength and the other gods have indeed been conquered by you.

shloka_text: नय रथमधिरोप्य वासवं नगरमितो व्रज सेनया वृतस्त्वम् । अहमपि तव गच्छतो द्रुतं सह सचिवैरनुयामि पृष्ठतः ।। 7.29.41 ।।
transliteration: naya rathamadhiropya vāsavaṃ nagaramito vraja senayā vṛtastvam | ahamapi tava gacchato drutaṃ saha sacivairanuyāmi pṛṣṭhataḥ || 7.29.41 ||
translation: नय take, रथम् chariot, अधिरोप्य having placed upon, वासवम् Vasava (Indra), नगरम् to the city, इतः from here, व्रज go, सेनया by the army, वृतः surrounded, त्वम् you, अहम् I, अपि also, तव your, गच्छतः while going, द्रुतम् quickly, सह with, सचिवैः ministers, अनुयामि will follow, पृष्ठतः from behind, ...
explanation: Take Vasava (Indra), place him on the chariot, and you, surrounded by the army, go from here to the city; I also, with my ministers, will quickly follow behind you as you go.

shloka_text: अथ स बलवृतः सवाहनस्त्रिदशपतिं परिगृह्य रावणिः । स्वभवनमभिगम्य वीर्यवान्कृतसमरान्विससर्ज राक्षसान् ।। 7.29.42 ।।
transliteration: atha sa balavṛtaḥ savāhanastridaśapatiṃ parigṛhya rāvaṇiḥ | svabhavanamabhigamya vīryavānkṛtasamarānvisasarja rākṣasān || 7.29.42 ||
translation: अथ then, सः he, बलवृतः surrounded by his army, सवाहनः with his vehicles, त्रिदशपतिं the lord of the gods, परिगृह्य having seized, रावणिः Ravana's son, स्वभवनम् his own abode, अभिगम्य having reached, वीर्यवान् the valiant one, कृतसमरान् those who had fought the battle, विससर्ज dismissed, राक्षसान् the Rakshasas.
explanation: Then, the valiant son of Ravana, Indrajit, having captured the lord of the gods along with his vehicles and surrounded by his army, returned to his own abode and dismissed the Rakshasas who had fought the battle.

shloka_text: जिते महेन्द्रे ऽतिबले रावणस्य सुतेन वै । प्रजापतिं पुरस्कृत्य ययुर्लङ्कां सुरास्तदा ।। 7.30.1 ।।
transliteration: jite mahendre 'tibale rāvaṇasya sutena vai | prajāpatiṃ puraskṛtya yayurlaṅkāṃ surāstadā || 7.30.1 ||
translation: जिते when conquered, महेन्द्रे Mahendra, अतिबले exceedingly powerful, रावणस्य of Ravana, सुतेन by the son, वै indeed, प्रजापतिं Prajapati, पुरस्कृत्य having placed in front, ययुः went, लङ्कां to Lanka, सुराः the gods, तदा then.
explanation: When the exceedingly powerful Mahendra was indeed conquered by Ravana's son, the gods then went to Lanka, making Prajapati their leader.
comments: Brahma comes to Lanka to ransom Indra and names Ravana's son Indrajit, the conqueror of Indra -- denied outright immortality, Indrajit is granted that, whenever he first worships fire, a sun-chariot shall bear him invincible into battle -- Indra is freed, and Brahma reveals that his captivity was the fruit of his violation of Ahalya, bidding him regain heaven by a Vaishnava sacrifice -- thus, says Agastya, was even Indra conquered.

shloka_text: तत्र रावणमासाद्य पुत्रभ्रातृभिरावृतम् । अब्रवीद्गगने तिष्ठन्सामपूर्वं प्रजापतिः ।। 7.30.2 ।।
transliteration: tatra rāvaṇamāsādya putrabhrātṛbhirāvṛtam | abravīdgagane tiṣṭhansāmapūrvaṃ prajāpatiḥ || 7.30.2 ||
translation: तत्र there, रावणम् Ravana, आसाद्य having approached, पुत्रभ्रातृभिः by sons and brothers, आवृतम् surrounded, अब्रवीत् spoke, गगने in the sky, तिष्ठन् standing, सामपूर्वं with gentle words first, प्रजापतिः Prajapati.
explanation: There, Prajapati, standing in the sky, approached Ravana who was surrounded by his sons and brothers, and spoke to him first with gentle words.

shloka_text: वत्स रावण तुष्टो ऽस्मि पुत्रस्य तव संयुगे । अहो ऽस्य विक्रमौदार्यं तव तुल्यो ऽधिको ऽपि वा ।। 7.30.3 ।।
transliteration: vatsa rāvaṇa tuṣṭo 'smi putrasya tava saṃyuge | aho 'sya vikramaudāryaṃ tava tulyo 'dhiko 'pi vā || 7.30.3 ||
translation: वत्स dear son, रावण Ravana, तुष्टः अस्मि I am pleased, पुत्रस्य with the son, तव your, संयुगे in battle, अहो oh!, अस्य his, विक्रमौदार्यं valor and magnanimity, तव your, तुल्यः equal, अधिकः superior, अपि वा or even.
explanation: Prajapati said, "Dear son Ravana, I am pleased with your son's performance in battle; oh, his valor and magnanimity are equal to yours, or perhaps even superior!"

shloka_text: जितं हि भवता सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं स्वेन तेजसा । कृता प्रतिज्ञा सफला प्रीतो ऽस्मि स्वसुतेन वै ।। 7.30.4 ।।
transliteration: jitaṃ hi bhavatā sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ svena tejasā | kṛtā pratijñā saphalā prīto 'smi svasutena vai || 7.30.4 ||
translation: जितं conquered, हि indeed, भवता by you, सर्वं all, त्रैलोक्यं the three worlds, स्वेन by your own, तेजसा prowess, कृता made, प्रतिज्ञा vow, सफला fruitful, प्रीतः अस्मि I am pleased, स्वसुतेन by your own son, वै indeed.
explanation: Indeed, all three worlds have been conquered by your own prowess, and your vow has been made fruitful; I am truly pleased by your own son.

shloka_text: अयं च पुत्रो ऽतिबलस्तव रावण वीर्यवान् । जगतीन्द्रजिदित्येव परिख्यातो भविष्यति ।। 7.30.5 ।।
transliteration: ayaṃ ca putro 'tibalastava rāvaṇa vīryavān | jagatīndrajidityeva parikhyāto bhaviṣyati || 7.30.5 ||
translation: अयं this, च and, पुत्रो son, अतिबलः exceedingly strong, तव your, रावण O Ravana, वीर्यवान् valorous, जगतीन्द्रजित् Indrajit in the world, इति thus, एव indeed, परिख्यातः renowned, भविष्यति will be
explanation: This exceedingly strong and valorous son of yours, O Ravana, will indeed be renowned in the world as Indrajit.

shloka_text: बलवान्दुर्जयश्चैव भविष्यत्येव राक्षसः । यं समाश्रित्य ते राजन्स्थापितास्त्रिदशा वशे ।। 7.30.6 ।।
transliteration: balavāndurjayaścaiva bhaviṣyatyeva rākṣasaḥ | yaṃ samāśritya te rājansthāpitāstridaśā vaśe || 7.30.6 ||
translation: बलवान् powerful, दुर्जयः unconquerable, च and, एव indeed, भविष्यति will be, एव indeed, राक्षसः demon, यं whom, समाश्रित्य having relied upon, ते by you, राजन् O King, स्थापिताः placed, त्रिदशाः the gods, वशे under control
explanation: This demon will indeed be powerful and unconquerable, O King, and it is by relying on him that you have kept the gods under your control.

shloka_text: तन्मुच्यतां महाबाहो महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः । किञ्चास्य मोक्षणार्थाय प्रयच्छन्तु दिवौकसः ।। 7.30.7 ।।
transliteration: tanmucyatāṃ mahābāho mahendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ | kiñcāsya mokṣaṇārthāya prayacchantu divaukasaḥ || 7.30.7 ||
translation: तत् therefore, मुच्यतां let him be released, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, महेन्द्रः the great Indra, पाकशासनः the slayer of Paka, किञ्च and also, अस्य his, मोक्षणार्थाय for the sake of release, प्रयच्छन्तु let them give, दिवौकसः the dwellers of heaven
explanation: Therefore, O mighty-armed one, let the great Indra, the slayer of Paka, be released, and let the gods also offer something for his liberation.

shloka_text: अथाब्रवीन्महातेजा इन्द्रजित्समितिञ्जयः । अमरत्वमहं देव वृणे यद्येष मुच्यते ।। 7.30.8 ।।
transliteration: athābravīnmahātejā indrajitsamitiñjayaḥ | amaratvamahaṃ deva vṛṇe yadyeṣa mucyate || 7.30.8 ||
translation: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent, इन्द्रजित् Indrajit, समितिञ्जयः conqueror in battle, अमरत्वम् immortality, अहं I, देव O god, वृणे choose, यदि if, एषः this one, मुच्यते is released
explanation: Then, the greatly effulgent Indrajit, the conqueror in battle, spoke, saying, "O god, I choose immortality if this one (Indra) is released."

shloka_text: चतुष्पदां खेचराणामन्येषां वा महौजसाम् । वृक्षगुल्मक्षुपलतातृणोपलमहीभृताम् ।। 7.30.9 ।।
transliteration: catuṣpadāṃ khecarāṇāmanyeṣāṃ vā mahaujasām | vṛkṣagulmakṣupalatātṛṇopalamahībhṛtām || 7.30.9 ||
translation: चतुष्पदां of quadrupeds, खेचराणां of sky-dwellers, अन्येषां of others, वा or, महौजसां of greatly powerful ones, वृक्षगुल्मक्षुपलतातृणोपलमहीभृताम् of trees, bushes, shrubs, creepers, grasses, stones, and mountains
explanation: This refers to various categories of beings and objects, including quadrupeds, sky-dwellers, other greatly powerful entities, and also trees, bushes, shrubs, creepers, grasses, stones, and mountains.

shloka_text: सर्वे ऽपि जन्तवो ऽन्योन्यं भेतव्ये सति बिभ्यति । अतो ऽत्र लोके सर्वेषां सर्वस्माच्च भवेद्भयम् ।। 7.30.10 ।।
transliteration: sarve 'pi jantavo 'nyonyaṃ bhetavye sati bibhyati | ato 'tra loke sarveṣāṃ sarvasmācca bhavedbhayam || 7.30.10 ||
translation: सर्वे all, अपि even, जन्तवः living beings, अन्योन्यम् each other, भेतव्ये when there is fear, सति being, बिभ्यति fear, अतः therefore, अत्र here, लोके in the world, सर्वेषाम् for all, सर्वस्मात् from everything, च and, भवेत् may be, भयम् fear.
explanation: All living beings fear each other when there is cause for fear, and thus in this world, everyone may experience fear from everything.

shloka_text: ततो ऽब्रवीन्महातेजा मेघनादं प्रजापतिः । नास्ति सर्वामरत्वं हि कस्यचित्प्राणिनो भुवि । चतुष्पदः पक्षिणश्च भूतानां वा महौजसाम् ।। 7.30.11 ।।
transliteration: tato 'bravīnmahātejā meghanādaṃ prajāpatiḥ | nāsti sarvāmaratvaṃ hi kasyacitprāṇino bhuvi | catuṣpadaḥ pakṣiṇaśca bhūtānāṃ vā mahaujasām || 7.30.11 ||
translation: ततः then, अब्रवीत् spoke, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent, मेघनादम् to Meghanada, प्रजापतिः Prajapati (Brahma), न not, अस्ति is, सर्वामरत्वम् complete immortality, हि indeed, कस्यचित् for anyone, प्राणिनः living being, भुवि on earth, चतुष्पदः four-footed animals, पक्षिणः birds, च and, भूतानाम् of beings, वा or, महौजसाम् of great power.
explanation: Then the greatly effulgent Prajapati Brahma spoke to Meghanada, stating that complete immortality indeed does not exist for any living being on earth, be it four-footed animals, birds, or even beings of great power.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा पितामहेनोक्तमिन्द्रजित्प्रभुणाव्ययम् ।। 7.30.12 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā pitāmahenoktamindrajitprabhuṇāvyayam || 7.30.12 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, पितामहेन by the grandfather (Brahma), उक्तम् spoken, इन्द्रजित् Indrajit (Meghanada), प्रभुणा by the lord, अव्ययम् imperishable (words/truth).
explanation: Having heard the imperishable words spoken by his grandfather, Lord Brahma, Indrajit (Meghanada then responded).

shloka_text: ्वं हि कस्यचित्प्राणिनो भुवि । अथाब्रवीत्स तत्रस्थं मेघनादो महाबलः । श्रूयतां वा भवेत्सिद्धिः शतक्रतुविमोक्षणे ।। 7.30.13 ।।
transliteration: ्vaṃ hi kasyacitprāṇino bhuvi | athābravītsa tatrasthaṃ meghanādo mahābalaḥ | śrūyatāṃ vā bhavetsiddhiḥ śatakratuvimokṣaṇe || 7.30.13 ||
translation: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, सः he, तत्रस्थम् to him who was present there, मेघनादः Meghanada, महाबलः the mighty, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, वा or, भवेत् may there be, सिद्धिः success, शतक्रतुविमोक्षणे in releasing Shakra (Indra).
explanation: Then the mighty Meghanada spoke to Brahma, who was present there, saying, "Let it be heard, or may there be success in releasing Indra."

shloka_text: ममेष्टं नित्यशो हर्व्यैर्मन्त्रैः सम्पूज्य पावकम् । सङ्ग्राममवतर्त्तुं च शत्रुनिर्जयकाङ्क्षिणः ।। 7.30.14 ।।
transliteration: mameṣṭaṃ nityaśo harvyairmantraiḥ sampūjya pāvakam | saṅgrāmamavatarttuṃ ca śatrunirjayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 7.30.14 ||
translation: मम my, इष्टम् desire, नित्यशः always, हर्व्यैः with oblations, मन्त्रैः with mantras, सम्पूज्य having worshipped, पावकम् the fire, सङ्ग्रामम् battle, अवतर्त्तुम् to enter, च and, शत्रुनिर्जयकाङ्क्षिणः desiring victory over enemies.
explanation: My desire is to always worship the fire with oblations and mantras, and then to enter battle, desiring victory over my enemies.

shloka_text: अश्वयुक्तो रथो मह्यमुत्तिष्ठेत्तु विभावसोः । तत्स्थस्यामरता स्यान्मे एष मे निश्चयो वरः ।। 7.30.15 ।।
transliteration: aśvayukto ratho mahyamuttiṣṭhettu vibhāvasoḥ | tatsthasyāmaratā syānme eṣa me niścayo varaḥ || 7.30.15 ||
translation: अश्वयुक्तो horse-yoked, रथो chariot, मह्यम् for me, उत्तिष्ठेत् should rise, तु indeed, विभावसोः of the sun, तत्स्थस्य of one standing on it, अमरता immortality, स्यात् should be, मे for me, एष this, मे my, निश्चयो firm resolve, वरः best.
explanation: My best resolve is that a horse-yoked chariot of the sun should rise for me, and immortality should be granted to one standing on it.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्यद्यसमाप्ते च जप्यहोमे विभावसौ । युध्येयं देव सङ्ग्रामे तदा मे स्याद्विनाशनम् ।। 7.30.16 ।।
transliteration: tasminyadyasamāpte ca japyahome vibhāvasau | yudhyeyaṃ deva saṅgrāme tadā me syādvināśanam || 7.30.16 ||
translation: देव O god, तस्मिन् that, जप्यहोमे rite of muttered prayer and oblation, विभावसौ in the fire, अद्य now, असमाप्ते while unfinished, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, यदि युध्येयम् if I should fight, तदा then, मे my, विनाशनम् destruction, स्यात् would come to be.
explanation: O god, should I ever go to fight in battle while my fire-oblation rite remains unfinished, then in that case my destruction would surely follow.

shloka_text: सर्वो हि तपसा देव वृणोत्यमरतां पुमान् । विक्रमेण मया त्वेतदमरत्वं प्रवर्तितम् ।। 7.30.17 ।।
transliteration: sarvo hi tapasā deva vṛṇotyamaratāṃ pumān | vikrameṇa mayā tvetadamaratvaṃ pravartitam || 7.30.17 ||
translation: सर्वो everyone, हि indeed, तपसा by penance, देव O god, वृणोति obtains, अमरताम् immortality, पुमान् a man, विक्रमेण by valor, मया by me, तु but, एतत् this, अमरत्वम् immortality, प्रवर्तितम् established.
explanation: O god, while every man indeed obtains immortality through penance, I have established this immortality through my valor.

shloka_text: एवमस्त्विति तं चाह वाक्यं देवः पितामहः । मुक्तश्चेन्द्रजिता शक्रो गताश्च त्रिदिवं सुराः ।। 7.30.18 ।।
transliteration: evamastviti taṃ cāha vākyaṃ devaḥ pitāmahaḥ | muktaścendrajitā śakro gatāśca tridivaṃ surāḥ || 7.30.18 ||
translation: एवम् thus, अस्तु let it be, इति thus, तम् to him, च and, आह said, वाक्यम् word, देवः god, पितामहः Brahma, मुक्तः released, च and, इन्द्रजिता by Indrajit, शक्रो Indra, गताः went, च and, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, सुराः gods.
explanation: And thus, the god Brahma said to him, 'So be it,' whereupon Indra was released by Indrajit, and the gods returned to heaven.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम दीनो भ्रष्टाम्बरद्युतिः । इन्द्रश्चिन्तापरीतात्मा ध्यानतत्परतां गतः ।। 7.30.19 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare rāma dīno bhraṣṭāmbaradyutiḥ | indraścintāparītātmā dhyānatatparatāṃ gataḥ || 7.30.19 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, राम O Rama, दीनो distressed, भ्रष्टाम्बरद्युतिः one whose celestial radiance was lost, इन्द्रः Indra, चिन्तापरीतात्मा whose mind was overwhelmed by worry, ध्यानतत्परताम् to the state of being absorbed in thought, गतः attained.
explanation: O Rama, in the meantime, Indra, distressed and having lost his celestial radiance, became absorbed in thought, his mind overwhelmed by worry.

shloka_text: तं तु दृष्ट्वा तथाभूतं प्राह देवः प्रजापतिः । शतक्रतो किमु पुरा करोति स्म सुदुष्कृतम् ।। 7.30.20 ।।
transliteration: taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā tathābhūtaṃ prāha devaḥ prajāpatiḥ | śatakrato kimu purā karoti sma suduṣkṛtam || 7.30.20 ||
translation: तम् him, तु indeed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तथाभूतम् in such a state, प्राह said, देवः god, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, शतक्रतो O Shatakratu, किमु what indeed, पुरा formerly, करोति did, स्म (past tense marker), सुदुष्कृतम् a very evil deed.
explanation: Indeed, having seen him in such a state, the god Prajapati (Brahma) asked, 'O Shatakratu, what great evil deed did you commit formerly?'

shloka_text: अमरेन्द्र मया बह्व्यः प्रजाः सृष्टास्तथा प्रभो । एकवर्णाः समाभाषा एकरूपाश्च सर्वशः ।। 7.30.21 ।।
transliteration: amarendra mayā bahvyaḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭāstathā prabho | ekavarṇāḥ samābhāṣā ekarūpāśca sarvaśaḥ || 7.30.21 ||
translation: अमरेन्द्र O king of immortals, मया by me, बह्व्यः many, प्रजाः creatures, सृष्टाः were created, तथा thus, प्रभो O lord, एकवर्णाः of one color, समाभाषाः speaking the same language, एकरूपाः of one form, च and, सर्वशः in every respect.
explanation: O Lord Indra, I created many beings who were all of the same color, spoke the same language, and had the same form in every respect.

shloka_text: तासां नास्ति विशेषो हि दर्शने लक्षणे ऽपि वा । ततो ऽहमेकाग्रमनास्ताः प्रजाः परिचिन्तयम् ।। 7.30.22 ।।
transliteration: tāsāṃ nāsti viśeṣo hi darśane lakṣaṇe 'pi vā | tato 'hamekāgramanāstāḥ prajāḥ paricintayam || 7.30.22 ||
translation: तासां among them, न not, अस्ति there is, विशेषः distinction, हि indeed, दर्शने in appearance, लक्षणे in characteristics, अपि even, वा or, ततः then, अहम् I, एकाग्रमनाः with a concentrated mind, ताः those, प्रजाः creatures, परिचिन्तयम् pondered.
explanation: Indeed, there was no distinction among them in appearance or even in characteristics, so I pondered deeply about those creatures with a concentrated mind.

shloka_text: सो ऽहं तासां विशेषार्थं स्त्रियमेकां विनिर्ममे । यद्यत्प्रजानां प्रत्यङ्गं विशिष्टं तत्तदुद्धृतम् ।। 7.30.23 ।।
transliteration: so 'haṃ tāsāṃ viśeṣārthaṃ striyamekāṃ vinirmame | yadyatprajānāṃ pratyaṅgaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ tattaduddhṛtam || 7.30.23 ||
translation: सः that, अहम् I, तासां among them, विशेषार्थं for the sake of distinction, स्त्रियम् a woman, एकां one, विनिर्ममे created, यद्यत् whatever, प्रजानां of the creatures, प्रत्यङ्गं each limb, विशिष्टं excellent, तत् तत् that that, उद्धृतम् was taken out.
explanation: Therefore, I created one woman for the sake of distinction among them, extracting whatever was excellent from each limb of the creatures.

shloka_text: ततो मया रूपगुणैरहल्या स्त्री विनिर्मिता । हलं नामेह वैरूपं हल्यं तत्प्रभवं भवेत् ।। 7.30.24 ।।
transliteration: tato mayā rūpaguṇairahalyā strī vinirmitā | halaṃ nāmeha vairūpaṃ halyaṃ tatprabhavaṃ bhavet || 7.30.24 ||
translation: ततः then, मया by me, रूपगुणैः with qualities of beauty, अहल्या Ahalya, स्त्री a woman, विनिर्मिता was created, हलं Hala, नाम indeed, इह here, वैरूपं ugliness, हल्यं that which is born from Hala, तत्प्रभवं born from that, भवेत् is.
explanation: Then, I created a woman named Ahalya, endowed with qualities of beauty, for "Hala" here means ugliness or deformity, and "Halya" is that which arises from it.

shloka_text: यस्मान्न विद्यते हल्यं तेनाहल्येति विश्रुता । अहल्येति मया शक्र तस्या नाम प्रवर्तितम् ।। 7.30.25 ।।
transliteration: yasmānna vidyate halyaṃ tenāhalyeti viśrutā | ahalyeti mayā śakra tasyā nāma pravartitam || 7.30.25 ||
translation: यस्मात् because, न not, विद्यते exists, हल्यं ugliness, तेन therefore, अहल्येति as Ahalya, विश्रुता renowned, अहल्येति as Ahalya, मया by me, शक्र O Shakra, तस्याः her, नाम name, प्रवर्तितम् was given.
explanation: Because no ugliness exists in her, she is renowned as Ahalya, and O Shakra, I thus established her name as Ahalya.

shloka_text: निर्मितायां च देवेन्द्र तस्यां नार्यां सुरर्षभ । भविष्यतीति कस्यैषा मम चिन्ता ततो ऽभवत् ।। 7.30.26 ।।
transliteration: nirmitāyāṃ ca devendra tasyāṃ nāryāṃ surarṣabha | bhaviṣyatīti kasyaiṣā mama cintā tato 'bhavat || 7.30.26 ||
translation: निर्मितायां when created, च and, देवेन्द्र O king of gods, तस्यां in that, नार्यां woman, सुरर्षभ O best of gods, भविष्यतीति will be, कस्यैषा whose is this, मम my, चिन्ता worry, ततो then, अभवत् arose,
explanation: O Indra, O best of gods, when that woman was created, a worry arose in me, thinking, "Whose will she be?"

shloka_text: त्वं तु शक्र तदा नारीं जानीषे मनसा प्रभो । स्थानाधिकतया पत्नी ममैषेति पुरन्दर ।। 7.30.27 ।।
transliteration: tvaṃ tu śakra tadā nārīṃ jānīṣe manasā prabho | sthānādhikatayā patnī mamaiṣeti purandara || 7.30.27 ||
translation: त्वं you, तु indeed, शक्र O Shakra, तदा then, नारीं woman, जानीषे knew, मनसा mentally, प्रभो O lord, स्थानाधिकतया due to superiority of position, पत्नी wife, ममैषेति mine is this, पुरन्दर O Purandara,
explanation: O Shakra, O Lord, O Purandara, you then mentally considered that woman to be your wife due to your superior position.

shloka_text: सा मया न्यासभूता तु गौतमस्य महात्मनः । न्यस्ता बहूनि वर्षाणि तेन निर्यातिता च ह ।। 7.30.28 ।।
transliteration: sā mayā nyāsabhūtā tu gautamasya mahātmanaḥ | nyastā bahūni varṣāṇi tena niryātitā ca ha || 7.30.28 ||
translation: सा she, मया by me, न्यासभूता as a deposit, तु but, गौतमस्य of Gautama, महात्मनः the great-souled, न्यस्ता entrusted, बहूनि many, वर्षाणि years, तेन by him, निर्यातिता returned, च and, ह indeed,
explanation: But she was entrusted by me as a deposit to the great-souled Gautama for many years, and indeed, she was returned by him.

shloka_text: ततस्तस्य परिज्ञाय महास्थैर्यं महामुनेः । ज्ञात्वा तपसि सिद्धिं च पत्न्यर्थं स्पर्शिता तदा ।। 7.30.29 ।।
transliteration: tatastasya parijñāya mahāsthairyaṃ mahāmuneḥ | jñātvā tapasi siddhiṃ ca patnyarthaṃ sparśitā tadā || 7.30.29 ||
translation: ततस्तस्य then his, परिज्ञाय having known, महास्थैर्यं great steadfastness, महामुनेः of the great sage, ज्ञात्वा having known, तपसि in penance, सिद्धिं success, च and, पत्न्यर्थं for the purpose of a wife, स्पर्शिता offered, तदा then,
explanation: Then, having understood the great steadfastness of that great sage and his success in penance, she was offered to him as a wife.

shloka_text: सङ्क्रुद्धस्त्वं हि धर्मात्मन् गत्वा तस्याश्रमं मुनेः । दृष्टवांश्च तदा तां स्त्रीं दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव ।। 7.30.30 ।।
transliteration: saṅkruddhastvaṃ hi dharmātman gatvā tasyāśramaṃ muneḥ | dṛṣṭavāṃśca tadā tāṃ strīṃ dīptāmagniśikhāmiva || 7.30.30 ||
translation: सङ्क्रुद्धस्त्वं you, being very angry, हि indeed, धर्मात्मन् O righteous one, गत्वा having gone, तस्याश्रमं to his hermitage, मुनेः of the sage, दृष्टवांश्च and you saw, तदा then, तां that, स्त्रीं woman, दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव shining like a flame of fire,
explanation: Indeed, you, being very angry, O righteous one, went to that sage's hermitage and then saw that woman shining like a flame of fire.

shloka_text: सा त्वया धर्षिता शक्र कामार्तेन समन्युना । दृष्टस्त्वं च तदा तेन ह्याश्रमे परमर्षिणा ।। 7.30.31 ।।
transliteration: sā tvayā dharṣitā śakra kāmārtena samanyunā | dṛṣṭastvaṃ ca tadā tena hyāśrame paramarṣiṇā || 7.30.31 ||
translation: सा She, त्वया by you, धर्षिता was violated, शक्र O Shakra, कामार्तेन afflicted by lust, समन्युना with anger, दृष्टः seen, त्वं you, च and, तदा then, तेन by him, हि indeed, आश्रमे in the hermitage, परमर्षिणा by the great sage.
explanation: O Shakra, she was violated by you, who were afflicted by lust and anger, and you were then indeed seen in the hermitage by the great sage.

shloka_text: ततः क्रुद्धेन तेना ऽसि शप्तः परमतेजसा । गतो ऽसि येन देवेन्द्र दशाभागविपर्ययम् ।। 7.30.32 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kruddhena tenā 'si śaptaḥ paramatejasā | gato 'si yena devendra daśābhāgaviparyayam || 7.30.32 ||
translation: ततः Then, क्रुद्धेन by the enraged, तेन by him, असि you were, शप्तः cursed, परमतेजसा of great ascetic power, गतः gone, असि you are, येन by which, देवेन्द्र O king of gods, दशाभागविपर्ययम् a reversal of your state.
explanation: Then, by that enraged sage of great ascetic power, you were cursed, O king of gods, by which you have undergone a reversal of your state.

shloka_text: यस्मान्मे धर्षिता पत्नी त्वया वासव निर्भयम् । तस्मात्त्वं समरे राजञ्छत्रुहस्तं गमिष्यसि ।। 7.30.33 ।।
transliteration: yasmānme dharṣitā patnī tvayā vāsava nirbhayam | tasmāttvaṃ samare rājañchatruhastaṃ gamiṣyasi || 7.30.33 ||
translation: यस्मात् Because, मे my, धर्षिता was violated, पत्नी wife, त्वया by you, वासव O Vasava, निर्भयम् fearlessly, तस्मात् therefore, त्वं you, समरे in battle, राजन् O king, शत्रुहस्तं into the hands of enemies, गमिष्यसि will go.
explanation: Because my wife was fearlessly violated by you, O Vasava, therefore, O king, you will fall into the hands of your enemies in battle.

shloka_text: अयं तु भावो दुर्बुद्धे यस्त्वयेह प्रवर्तितः । मानुषेष्वपि लोकेषु भविष्यति न संशयः ।। 7.30.34 ।।
transliteration: ayaṃ tu bhāvo durbuddhe yastvayeha pravartitaḥ | mānuṣeṣvapi lokeṣu bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 7.30.34 ||
translation: अयं This, तु but, भावः state/consequence, दुर्बुद्धे O evil-minded one, यः which, त्वया by you, इह here, प्रवर्तितः initiated, मानुषेषु among humans, अपि even, लोकेषु in worlds, भविष्यति will be, न no, संशयः doubt.
explanation: But this consequence, O evil-minded one, which you have initiated here, will undoubtedly also manifest in the human worlds.

shloka_text: तत्रार्धं तस्य यः कर्ता त्वय्यर्धं निपतिष्यति । न च ते स्थावरं स्थानं भविष्यति न संशयः ।। 7.30.35 ।।
transliteration: tatrārdhaṃ tasya yaḥ kartā tvayyardhaṃ nipatiṣyati | na ca te sthāvaraṃ sthānaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 7.30.35 ||
translation: तत्र There, अर्धं half, तस्य of that, यः who, कर्ता doer, त्वयि on you, अर्धं half, निपतिष्यति will fall, न not, च and, ते for you, स्थावरं fixed, स्थानं place, भविष्यति will be, न no, संशयः doubt.
explanation: In that matter, half of the consequence will fall upon the doer, and half upon you, and undoubtedly, you will not have a fixed abode.

shloka_text: यश्च यश्च सुरेन्द्रः स्याद्ध्रुवः स न भविष्यति । एष शापो मया मुक्त इत्यसौ त्वां तदा ऽब्रवीत् ।। 7.30.36 ।।
transliteration: yaśca yaśca surendraḥ syāddhruvaḥ sa na bhaviṣyati | eṣa śāpo mayā mukta ityasau tvāṃ tadā 'bravīt || 7.30.36 ||
translation: यश्च यश्च whoever, whoever, सुरेन्द्रः king of gods, स्यात् may be, ध्रुवः permanent, स he, न not, भविष्यति will be, एषः this, शापः curse, मया by me, मुक्तः uttered, इति thus, असौ he, त्वाम् to you, तदा then, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: The sage then told you that whoever becomes the king of gods will not remain permanent, as this curse has been uttered by him.

shloka_text: तां तु भार्यां स निर्भर्त्स्य सो ऽब्रवीत्सुमहातपाः । दुर्विनीते विनिध्वंस ममाश्रमसमीपतः ।। 7.30.37 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ tu bhāryāṃ sa nirbhartsya so 'bravītsumahātapāḥ | durvinīte vinidhvaṃsa mamāśramasamīpataḥ || 7.30.37 ||
translation: ताम् her, तु indeed, भार्याम् wife, सः he, निर्भर्त्स्य having rebuked, सः he, अब्रवीत् said, सुमहातपाः the great ascetic, दुर्विनीते O ill-behaved one, विनिध्वंस perish, मम my, आश्रमसमीपतः from the vicinity of the hermitage.
explanation: Having rebuked his wife, the great ascetic then said, "O ill-behaved one, disappear from the vicinity of my hermitage!"

shloka_text: रूपयौवनसम्पन्ना यस्मात्त्वमनवस्थिता । तस्माद्रूपवती लोके न त्वमेका भविष्यति ।। 7.30.38 ।।
transliteration: rūpayauvanasampannā yasmāttvamanavasthitā | tasmādrūpavatī loke na tvamekā bhaviṣyati || 7.30.38 ||
translation: रूपयौवनसम्पन्ना endowed with beauty and youth, यस्मात् because, त्वम् you, अनवस्थिता are unstable, तस्मात् therefore, रूपवती beautiful woman, लोके in the world, न not, त्वम् you, एका alone, भविष्यति will be.
explanation: Because you, endowed with beauty and youth, are unstable, therefore you will not be the only beautiful woman in the world.

shloka_text: रूपं च ते प्रजाः सर्वा गमिष्यन्ति न संशयः । यत्तदेकं समाश्रित्य विभ्रमो ऽयमुपस्थितः ।। 7.30.39 ।।
transliteration: rūpaṃ ca te prajāḥ sarvā gamiṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ | yattadekaṃ samāśritya vibhramo 'yamupasthitaḥ || 7.30.39 ||
translation: रूपम् beauty, च and, ते your, प्रजाः creatures, सर्वाः all, गमिष्यन्ति will obtain, न not, संशयः doubt, यत् which, तत् that, एकम् unique, समाश्रित्य having relied upon, विभ्रमः delusion, अयम् this, उपस्थितः has arisen.
explanation: All creatures will undoubtedly obtain your beauty, having relied upon which unique beauty this delusion has arisen.

shloka_text: तदाप्रभृति भूयिष्ठं प्रजा रूपसमन्विताः । सा तं प्रसादयामास महर्षिं गौतमं तदा ।। 7.30.40 ।।
transliteration: tadāprabhṛti bhūyiṣṭhaṃ prajā rūpasamanvitāḥ | sā taṃ prasādayāmāsa maharṣiṃ gautamaṃ tadā || 7.30.40 ||
translation: तदाप्रभृति from that time onwards, भूयिष्ठम् mostly, प्रजाः creatures, रूपसमन्विताः endowed with beauty, सा she, तम् him, प्रसादयामास propitiated, महर्षिम् the great sage, गौतमम् Gautama, तदा then.
explanation: From that time onwards, most creatures became endowed with beauty, and then she (Ahalya) propitiated the great sage Gautama.

shloka_text: अज्ञानाद्धर्षिता विप्र त्वद्रूपेण दिवौकसा । न कामकाराद्विप्रर्षे प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ।। 7.30.41 ।।
transliteration: ajñānāddharṣitā vipra tvadrūpeṇa divaukasā | na kāmakārādviprarṣe prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 7.30.41 ||
translation: अज्ञानात् due to ignorance, हर्षिता deceived, विप्र O Brahmana, त्वद्रूपेण in your guise, दिवौकसा by the celestial being (Indra), न not, कामकारात् willingly, विप्रर्षे O Brahmana-sage, प्रसादम् grace, कर्तुम् to grant, अर्हसि you ought.
explanation: O Brahmana-sage, I was deceived by the celestial being in your guise due to ignorance, not willingly, so you ought to grant me your grace.

shloka_text: अहल्यया त्वेवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच स गौतमः । उत्पत्स्यति महातेजा इक्ष्वाकूणां महारथः ।। 7.30.42 ।।
transliteration: ahalyayā tvevamuktaḥ pratyuvāca sa gautamaḥ | utpatsyati mahātejā ikṣvākūṇāṃ mahārathaḥ || 7.30.42 ||
translation: अहल्यया by Ahalya, तु indeed, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, प्रत्युवाच replied, सः he, गौतमः Gautama, उत्पत्स्यति will be born, महातेजाः greatly effulgent, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of the Ikshvakus, महारथः a great warrior.
explanation: Thus addressed by Ahalya, Gautama replied that a greatly effulgent and great warrior of the Ikshvaku dynasty would be born.

shloka_text: रामो नाम श्रुतो लोके वनं चाप्युपयास्यति । ब्राह्मणार्थे महाबाहुर्विष्णुर्मानुषविग्रहः । तं द्रक्ष्यसि यदा भद्रे ततः पूता भविष्यसि ।। 7.30.43 ।।
transliteration: rāmo nāma śruto loke vanaṃ cāpyupayāsyati | brāhmaṇārthe mahābāhurviṣṇurmānuṣavigrahaḥ | taṃ drakṣyasi yadā bhadre tataḥ pūtā bhaviṣyasi || 7.30.43 ||
translation: रामः Rama, नाम by name, श्रुतः known, लोके in the world, वनम् forest, च and, अपि also, उपयास्यति will come, ब्राह्मणार्थे for the sake of Brahmanas, महाबाहुः mighty-armed, विष्णुः Vishnu, मानुषविग्रहः in human form, तम् him, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see, यदा when, भद्रे O auspicious one, ततः then, पूता purified, भविष्यसि you will become.
explanation: He will be known as Rama in the world, will come to the forest for the sake of Brahmanas, being the mighty-armed Vishnu in human form; when you see him, O auspicious one, you will then become purified.

shloka_text: स हि पावयितुं शक्तस्त्वया यद्दुष्कृतं कृतम् । तस्यातिथ्यं च कृत्वा वै मत्समीपं गमिष्यसि ।। 7.30.44 ।।
transliteration: sa hi pāvayituṃ śaktastvayā yadduṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam | tasyātithyaṃ ca kṛtvā vai matsamīpaṃ gamiṣyasi || 7.30.44 ||
translation: सः he, हि indeed, पावयितुम् to purify, शक्तः capable, त्वया by you, यत् whatever, दुष्कृतम् evil deed, कृतम् done, तस्य his, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, च and, कृत्वा having done, वै indeed, मत्समीपम् to my proximity, गमिष्यसि you will go.
explanation: He is indeed capable of purifying whatever evil deed you have committed, and after offering him hospitality, you will return to my side.

shloka_text: वत्स्यसि त्वं मया सार्धं तदा हि वरवर्णिनि । एवमुक्त्वा स विप्रर्षिराजगाम स्वमाश्रमम् ।। 7.30.45 ।।
transliteration: vatsyasi tvaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ tadā hi varavarṇini | evamuktvā sa viprarṣirājagāma svamāśramam || 7.30.45 ||
translation: वत्स्यसि you will dwell, त्वम् you, मया with me, सार्धम् together, तदा then, हि indeed, वरवर्णिनि O beautiful lady, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, सः he, विप्रर्षिः the Brahmana-sage, आजगाम went, स्वम् his own, आश्रमम् hermitage.
explanation: Then, O beautiful lady, you will indeed dwell with me; having spoken thus, the Brahmana-sage returned to his own hermitage.

shloka_text: तपश्चाचार सुमहत्सा पत्नी ब्रह्मवादिनः । शापोत्सर्गाद्धि तस्येदं मुनेः सर्वमुपस्थितम् ।। 7.30.46 ।।
transliteration: tapaścācāra sumahatsā patnī brahmavādinaḥ | śāpotsargāddhi tasyedaṃ muneḥ sarvamupasthitam || 7.30.46 ||
translation: तपः penance, च and, आचार performed, सुमहत् very great, सा she, पत्नी wife, ब्रह्मवादिनः of the knower of Brahman, शापोत्सर्गात् from the utterance of the curse, हि indeed, तस्य of that, इदम् this, मुनेः of the sage, सर्वम् all, उपस्थितम् has come to pass.
explanation: Indeed, that wife of the knower of Brahman performed very great penance, and all this has come to pass from the utterance of the sage's curse.

shloka_text: तत्स्मर त्वं महाबाहो दुष्कृतं यत्त्वया कृतम् । तेन त्वं ग्रहणं शत्रोर्यातो नान्येन वासव ।। 7.30.47 ।।
transliteration: tatsmara tvaṃ mahābāho duṣkṛtaṃ yattvayā kṛtam | tena tvaṃ grahaṇaṃ śatroryāto nānyena vāsava || 7.30.47 ||
translation: तत् that, स्मर remember, त्वम् you, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, दुष्कृतम् evil deed, यत् which, त्वया by you, कृतम् was done, तेन by that, त्वम् you, ग्रहणम् capture, शत्रोः by the enemy, यातः have obtained, न not, अन्येन by another, वासव O Vasava.
explanation: O mighty-armed Vasava, remember that evil deed which you committed; by that alone have you been captured by the enemy, and not by any other means.

shloka_text: शीघ्रं वै यज यज्ञं त्वं वैष्णवं सुसमाहितः । पावितस्तेन यज्ञेन यास्यसे त्रिदिवं ततः ।। 7.30.48 ।।
transliteration: śīghraṃ vai yaja yajñaṃ tvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ susamāhitaḥ | pāvitastena yajñena yāsyase tridivaṃ tataḥ || 7.30.48 ||
translation: शीघ्रम् quickly, वै indeed, यज perform, यज्ञम् sacrifice, त्वम् you, वैष्णवम् related to Vishnu, सुसमाहितः with great concentration, पावितः purified, तेन by that, यज्ञेन by the sacrifice, यास्यसे you will go, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, ततः thereafter.
explanation: You must quickly perform a Vaishnava sacrifice with great concentration, and purified by that sacrifice, you will then ascend to heaven.

shloka_text: पुत्रश्च तव देवेन्द्र न विनष्टो महारणे । नीतः सन्निहितश्चैव आर्यकेण महोदधौ ।। 7.30.49 ।।
transliteration: putraśca tava devendra na vinaṣṭo mahāraṇe | nītaḥ sannihitaścaiva āryakeṇa mahodadhau || 7.30.49 ||
translation: पुत्रः son, च and, तव your, देवेन्द्र O king of gods, न not, विनष्टः perished, महारणे in the great battle, नीतः taken, सन्निहितः kept, च and, एव indeed, आर्यकेण by Aryaka, महोदधौ in the great ocean.
explanation: O king of gods, your son did not perish in the great battle; he was taken and kept safe by Aryaka in the great ocean.

shloka_text: एतच्छ्रुत्वा महेन्द्रस्तु यज्ञमिष्ट्वा च वैष्णवम् । पुनस्त्रिदिवमाक्रामदन्वशासच्च देवराट् ।। 7.30.50 ।।
transliteration: etacchrutvā mahendrastu yajñamiṣṭvā ca vaiṣṇavam | punastridivamākrāmadanvaśāsacca devarāṭ || 7.30.50 ||
translation: एतत् this, श्रुत्वा having heard, महेन्द्रः Mahendra, तु and, यज्ञम् sacrifice, इष्ट्वा having performed, च and, वैष्णवम् related to Vishnu, पुनः again, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, आक्रामत् ascended, अन्वशासत् ruled, च and, देवराट् the king of gods.
explanation: Having heard this, Mahendra performed the Vaishnava sacrifice, and the king of gods then ascended to heaven again and ruled.

shloka_text: एतदिन्द्रजितो नाम बलं यत्कीर्तितं मया । निर्जितस्तेन देवेन्द्रः प्राणिनो ऽन्ये तु किं पुनः ।। 7.30.51 ।।
transliteration: etadindrajito nāma balaṃ yatkīrtitaṃ mayā | nirjitastena devendraḥ prāṇino 'nye tu kiṃ punaḥ || 7.30.51 ||
translation: एतत् this, इन्द्रजितः of Indrajit, नाम indeed, बलं strength, यत् which, कीर्तितम् has been recounted, मया by me, निर्जितः conquered, तेन by him, देवेन्द्रः the lord of gods, प्राणिनः living beings, अन्ये others, तु but, किं what, पुनः moreover.
explanation: This is the power of Indrajit that I have recounted, by which even the lord of gods, Indra, was conquered; what then to speak of other living beings?

shloka_text: आश्चर्यमिति रामश्च लक्ष्मणश्चाब्रवीत्तदा । अगस्त्यवचनं श्रुत्वा वानरा राक्षसास्तदा ।। 7.30.52 ।।
transliteration: āścaryamiti rāmaśca lakṣmaṇaścābravīttadā | agastyavacanaṃ śrutvā vānarā rākṣasāstadā || 7.30.52 ||
translation: आश्चर्यम् wonderful, इति thus, रामः Rama, च and, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, च and, अब्रवीत् said, तदा then, अगस्त्यवचनम् the words of Agastya, श्रुत्वा having heard, वानराः monkeys, राक्षसाः demons, तदा then.
explanation: Then, having heard the words of Agastya, Rama and Lakshmana, along with the monkeys and demons, exclaimed, "Wonderful!"

shloka_text: विभीषणस्तु रामस्य पार्श्वस्थो वाक्यमब्रवीत् । आश्चर्यं स्मारितो ऽस्म्यद्य यत्तद्दृष्टं पुरातनम् ।। 7.30.53 ।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇastu rāmasya pārśvastho vākyamabravīt | āścaryaṃ smārito 'smyadya yattaddṛṣṭaṃ purātanam || 7.30.53 ||
translation: विभीषणः Vibhishana, तु but, रामस्य of Rama, पार्श्वस्थः standing by the side, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said, आश्चर्यम् a wonder, स्मारितः reminded, अस्मि I am, अद्य today, यत् which, तत् that, दृष्टम् seen, पुरातनम् ancient.
explanation: But Vibhishana, standing by Rama's side, spoke, saying, "I am reminded today of that ancient wonder which I had seen."

shloka_text: अगस्त्यं त्वब्रवीद्रामः सत्यमेतच्छ्रुतं च मे ।। 7.30.54 ।।
transliteration: agastyaṃ tvabravīdrāmaḥ satyametacchrutaṃ ca me || 7.30.54 ||
translation: अगस्त्यम् to Agastya, तु but, अब्रवीत् said, रामः Rama, सत्यम् true, एतत् this, श्रुतम् heard, च and, मे by me.
explanation: But Rama said to Agastya, "This is true, and I have also heard it."

shloka_text: एवं राम समुद्भूतो रावणो लोककण्टकः । सपुत्रो येन सङ्ग्रामे जितः शक्रः सुरेश्वरः ।। 7.30.55 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ rāma samudbhūto rāvaṇo lokakaṇṭakaḥ | saputro yena saṅgrāme jitaḥ śakraḥ sureśvaraḥ || 7.30.55 ||
translation: एवम् thus, राम O Rama, समुद्भूतः originated, रावणः Ravana, लोककण्टकः a tormentor of the world, सपुत्रः with his son, येन by whom, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, जितः conquered, शक्रः Shakra, सुरेश्वरः the lord of gods.
explanation: O Rama, thus was born Ravana, a tormentor of the world, by whom, along with his son, Shakra, the lord of gods, was conquered in battle. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 30 ।। Thus ends the thirtieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततो रामो महातेजा विस्मयात्पुनरेव हि । उवाच प्रणतो वाक्यमगस्त्यमृषिसत्तमम् ।। 7.31.1 ।।
transliteration: tato rāmo mahātejā vismayātpunareva hi | uvāca praṇato vākyamagastyamṛṣisattamam || 7.31.1 ||
translation: ततो then, रामः Rama, महातेजा the greatly effulgent one, विस्मयात् out of wonder, पुनरेव again indeed, हि indeed, उवाच spoke, प्रणतः bowing down, वाक्यम् words, अगस्त्यम् to Agastya, ऋषिसत्तमम् the best among sages
explanation: Then, the greatly effulgent Rama, filled with wonder, again spoke words to Agastya, the best among sages, bowing down to him.
comments: Rama asks whether no king ever humbled Ravana, and Agastya begins the tale of Kartavirya Arjuna -- Ravana reaches Mahishmati to find its king Arjuna away sporting in the Narmada -- coming to the river himself, Ravana bathes and sets up a Shiva-linga on the sandbank, worshipping it with flowers, song and dance.

shloka_text: भगवन्राक्षसः क्रूरो यदाप्रभृति मेदिनीम् । पर्यटत्किं तदा लोकाः शून्या आसन्द्विजोत्तम ।। 7.31.2 ।।
transliteration: bhagavanrākṣasaḥ krūro yadāprabhṛti medinīm | paryaṭatkiṃ tadā lokāḥ śūnyā āsandvijottama || 7.31.2 ||
translation: भगवन् O revered one, राक्षसः the demon, क्रूरः cruel, यदाप्रभृति from when, मेदिनीम् the earth, पर्यटत् roamed, किम् whether, तदा then, लोकाः the worlds (people), शून्याः empty, आसन् were, द्विजोत्तम O best among twice-born (Brahmins)
explanation: O revered one, O best among Brahmins, when that cruel demon roamed the earth, were the worlds then empty of people?

shloka_text: राजा वा राजमात्रो वा किं तदा नात्र कश्चन । धर्षणं यत्र न प्राप्तो रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।। 7.31.3 ।।
transliteration: rājā vā rājamātro vā kiṃ tadā nātra kaścana | dharṣaṇaṃ yatra na prāpto rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ || 7.31.3 ||
translation: राजा a king, वा or, राजमात्रः a king's minister/equal to a king, वा or, किम् whether, तदा then, न not, अत्र here, कश्चन anyone, धर्षणम् humiliation/defeat, यत्र where, न not, प्राप्तः obtained/met, रावणः Ravana, राक्षसेश्वरः the lord of demons
explanation: Or was there no king or king's equal then, where Ravana, the lord of demons, did not meet with defeat or humiliation?

shloka_text: उताहो हतवीर्यास्ते बभूवुः पृथिवीक्षितः । बहिष्कृता वरास्त्रैश्च बहवो निर्जिता नृपाः ।। 7.31.4 ।।
transliteration: utāho hatavīryāste babhūvuḥ pṛthivīkṣitaḥ | bahiṣkṛtā varāstraiśca bahavo nirjitā nṛpāḥ || 7.31.4 ||
translation: उताहो or perhaps, हतवीर्याः whose valor was destroyed, ते those, बभूवुः became, पृथिवीक्षितः kings (earth-rulers), बहिष्कृताः expelled/deprived, वरास्त्रैः by excellent weapons, च and, बहवः many, निर्जिताः conquered, नृपाः kings
explanation: Or perhaps those kings became devoid of valor, and many rulers were conquered and deprived of their excellent weapons.

shloka_text: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा ह्यगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः । उवाच रामं प्रहसन्पितामह इवेश्वरम् ।। 7.31.5 ।।
transliteration: rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā hyagastyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ | uvāca rāmaṃ prahasanpitāmaha iveśvaram || 7.31.5 ||
translation: राघवस्य of Rama (descendant of Raghu), वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, हि indeed, अगस्त्यः Agastya, भगवान् the revered, ऋषिः sage, उवाच spoke, रामम् to Rama, प्रहसन् laughing, पितामहः grandfather (Brahma), इव like, ईश्वरम् to the lord (Shiva/Vishnu)
explanation: Having heard the words of Rama, the revered sage Agastya, laughing, spoke to Rama as Brahma would speak to the Lord.

shloka_text: इत्येवं बाधमानस्तु पार्थिवान्पार्थिवर्षभ । चचार रावणो राम पृथिवीं पृथिवीपते ।। 7.31.6 ।।
transliteration: ityevaṃ bādhamānastu pārthivānpārthivarṣabha | cacāra rāvaṇo rāma pṛthivīṃ pṛthivīpate || 7.31.6 ||
translation: इत्येवं thus, बाधमानस्तु indeed oppressing, पार्थिवान् kings, पार्थिवर्षभ O best of kings, चचार roamed, रावणो Ravana, राम O Rama, पृथिवीं the earth, पृथिवीपते O lord of the earth.
explanation: O Rama, O best of kings, O lord of the earth, Ravana thus indeed roamed the earth, oppressing kings.

shloka_text: ततो माहिष्मतीं नाम पुरीं स्वर्गपुरीप्रभाम् । सम्प्राप्तो यत्र सान्निध्यं सदासीद्वसुरेतसः ।। 7.31.7 ।।
transliteration: tato māhiṣmatīṃ nāma purīṃ svargapurīprabhām | samprāpto yatra sānnidhyaṃ sadāsīdvasuretasaḥ || 7.31.7 ||
translation: ततो then, माहिष्मतीं Mahishmati, नाम named, पुरीं city, स्वर्गपुरीप्रभाम् shining like a city of heaven, सम्प्राप्तो reached, यत्र where, सान्निध्यं presence, सदासीत् always was, वसुरेतसः of Vasuretasa.
explanation: Then he reached the city named Mahishmati, which shone like a celestial city, and where the presence of Vasuretasa (Agni) always resided.

shloka_text: तुल्य आसीन्नृपस्तस्य प्रभावाद्वसुरेतसः । अर्जुनो नाम यत्राग्निः शरकुण्डेशयः सदा ।। 7.31.8 ।।
transliteration: tulya āsīnnṛpastasya prabhāvādvasuretasaḥ | arjuno nāma yatrāgniḥ śarakuṇḍeśayaḥ sadā || 7.31.8 ||
translation: तुल्य equal, आसीत् was, नृपस्तस्य its king, प्रभावात् by the might, वसुरेतसः of Vasuretasa, अर्जुनो Arjuna, नाम named, यत्राग्निः where Agni, शरकुण्डेशयः residing in a pond of arrows, सदा always.
explanation: Its king, named Arjuna, was equal in might to Vasuretasa (Agni), where Agni always resided, known as Sharakuṇḍeśaya.

shloka_text: तमेव दिवसं सो ऽथ हैहयाधिपतिर्बली । अर्जुनो नर्मदां रन्तुं गतः स्त्रीभिः सहेश्वरः ।। 7.31.9 ।।
transliteration: tameva divasaṃ so 'tha haihayādhipatirbalī | arjuno narmadāṃ rantuṃ gataḥ strībhiḥ saheśvaraḥ || 7.31.9 ||
translation: तमेव that very, दिवसं day, सो ऽथ he then, हैहयाधिपतिर्बली the powerful lord of the Haihayas, अर्जुनो Arjuna, नर्मदां to the Narmada, रन्तुं to sport, गतः went, स्त्रीभिः with women, सहेश्वरः with his wives.
explanation: On that very day, the powerful lord of the Haihayas, Arjuna, had gone to the Narmada river with his wives to sport.

shloka_text: तमेव दिवसं सो ऽथ रावणस्तत्र आगतः । रावणो राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु तस्यामात्यानपृच्छत ।। 7.31.10 ।।
transliteration: tameva divasaṃ so 'tha rāvaṇastatra āgataḥ | rāvaṇo rākṣasendrastu tasyāmātyānapṛcchata || 7.31.10 ||
translation: तमेव that very, दिवसं day, सो ऽथ he then, रावणस्तत्र Ravana there, आगतः arrived, रावणो Ravana, राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु the lord of Rakshasas indeed, तस्यामात्यानपृच्छत asked his ministers.
explanation: On that very day, Ravana arrived there, and the lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, then inquired of his ministers.

shloka_text: क्वार्जुनो नृपतिः शीघ्रं सम्यगाख्यातुमर्हथ । रावणो ऽहमनुप्राप्तो युद्धेप्सुर्नृवरेण ह । ममागमनमप्यग्रे युष्माभिः सन्निवेद्यताम् ।। 7.31.11 ।।
transliteration: kvārjuno nṛpatiḥ śīghraṃ samyagākhyātumarhatha | rāvaṇo 'hamanuprāpto yuddhepsurnṛvareṇa ha | mamāgamanamapyagre yuṣmābhiḥ sannivedyatām || 7.31.11 ||
translation: क्व where, अर्जुनो Arjuna, नृपतिः the king, शीघ्रं quickly, सम्यक् properly, आख्यातुम् to tell, अर्हथ you ought; रावणो Ravana, अहम् I, अनुप्राप्तो have arrived, युद्धेप्सुः desirous of battle, नृवरेण with the best of men, ह indeed; मम my, आगमनम् arrival, अपि also, अग्रे before him, युष्माभिः by you all, सन्निवेद्यताम् let it be announced.
explanation: Ravana asks Arjuna's attendants to quickly and properly inform him of Arjuna's whereabouts, declaring his own arrival as Ravana, desirous of battle with the best of men, and instructing them to announce his presence to the king.

shloka_text: इत्येवं रावणेनोक्तास्ते ऽमात्याः सुविपश्चितः । अब्रुवन्राक्षसपतिमसान्निध्यं महीपतेः ।। 7.31.12 ।।
transliteration: ityevaṃ rāvaṇenoktāste 'mātyāḥ suvipaścitaḥ | abruvanrākṣasapatimasānnidhyaṃ mahīpateḥ || 7.31.12 ||
translation: इति thus, एवं in this manner, रावणेन by Ravana, उक्ताः spoken to, ते those, अमात्याः ministers, सुविपश्चितः very wise, अब्रुवन् they said, राक्षसपतिम् to the lord of Rakshasas, असान्निध्यम् the absence, महीपतेः of the king.
explanation: Thus addressed by Ravana, those very wise ministers informed the lord of Rakshasas about the king's absence.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा विश्रवसः पुत्रः पौराणामर्जुनं गतम् । अपसृत्यागतो विन्ध्यं हिमवत्सन्निभं गिरिम् ।। 7.31.13 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā viśravasaḥ putraḥ paurāṇāmarjunaṃ gatam | apasṛtyāgato vindhyaṃ himavatsannibhaṃ girim || 7.31.13 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, विश्रवसः of Vishravas, पुत्रः the son, पौराणाम् from the citizens, अर्जुनं Arjuna, गतम् had gone, अपसृत्य having departed, आगतो he came, विन्ध्यं to the Vindhya, हिमवत् like the Himalayas, सन्निभं resembling, गिरिम् mountain.
explanation: Having heard from the citizens that Arjuna had departed, Ravana, the son of Vishravas, also departed and came to the Vindhya mountain, which resembled the Himalayas.

shloka_text: स तमभ्रमिवाविष्टमुद्भ्रन्तमिव मेदिनीम् । अपश्यद्रावणो विन्ध्यमालिखन्तमिवाम्बरम् ।। 7.31.14 ।।
transliteration: sa tamabhramivāviṣṭamudbhrantamiva medinīm | apaśyadrāvaṇo vindhyamālikhantamivāmbaram || 7.31.14 ||
translation: सः he, तम् that, अभ्रम् a cloud, इव like, आविष्टम् pervaded, उद्भ्रान्तम् bewildered, इव like, मेदिनीम् the earth; अपश्यत् he saw, रावणो Ravana, विन्ध्यम् the Vindhya, आलिखन्तम् scratching, इव as if, अम्बरम् the sky.
explanation: Ravana saw that Vindhya mountain, which seemed to pervade the clouds and bewilder the earth, as if it were scratching the sky.

shloka_text: सहस्रशिखरोपेतं सिंहाध्युषितकन्दरम् । प्रपातपतितैस्तोयैः साट्टहासमिवाम्बुधिम् ।। 7.31.15 ।।
transliteration: sahasraśikharopetaṃ siṃhādhyuṣitakandaram | prapātapatitaistoyaiḥ sāṭṭahāsamivāmbudhim || 7.31.15 ||
translation: सहस्र a thousand, शिखर peaks, उपेतं endowed with, सिंह by lions, अध्युषित inhabited, कन्दरम् caves; प्रपात from waterfalls, पतितैः fallen, तोयैः by waters, स with, अट्टहासम् loud laughter, इव like, अम्बुधिम् the ocean.
explanation: He saw the mountain endowed with a thousand peaks, its caves inhabited by lions, and its waters falling from waterfalls, resembling the ocean with its loud laughter.

shloka_text: देवदानवगन्धर्वैः साप्सरोगणकिन्नरैः । स्वस्त्रीभिः क्रीडमानैश्च स्वर्गभूतं महोच्छ्रयम् ।। 7.31.16 ।।
transliteration: devadānavagandharvaiḥ sāpsarogaṇakinnaraiḥ | svastrībhiḥ krīḍamānaiśca svargabhūtaṃ mahocchrayam || 7.31.16 ||
translation: देवदानवगन्धर्वैः by gods, demons, and gandharvas, साप्सरोगणकिन्नरैः with groups of apsaras and kinnaras, स्वस्त्रीभिः with their own wives, क्रीडमानैः playing, च and, स्वर्गभूतम् appearing like heaven, महोच्छ्रयम् of great height.
explanation: The mountain, of immense height, appeared like heaven itself, with gods, demons, gandharvas, apsaras, and kinnaras playing there with their wives.

shloka_text: नदीभिः स्यन्दमानाभिः स्फटिकप्रतिमं जलम् । फणाभिश्चलजिह्वाभिरनन्तमिव विष्ठितम् ।। 7.31.17 ।।
transliteration: nadībhiḥ syandamānābhiḥ sphaṭikapratimaṃ jalam | phaṇābhiścalajihvābhiranantamiva viṣṭhitam || 7.31.17 ||
translation: नदीभिः by rivers, स्यन्दमानाभिः flowing, स्फटिकप्रतिमम् crystal-like, जलम् water, फणाभिः with hoods, चलजिह्वाभिः with flickering tongues, अनन्तम् Ananta, इव as if, विष्ठितम् pervaded.
explanation: The mountain was pervaded by crystal-clear water from flowing rivers, and appeared as if Ananta, the serpent god with his hoods and flickering tongues, had spread himself across it.

shloka_text: उत्क्रामन्तं दरीवन्तं हिमवत्सन्निभं गिरिम् । पश्यमानस्ततो विन्ध्यं रावणो नर्मदां ययौ ।। 7.31.18 ।।
transliteration: utkrāmantaṃ darīvantaṃ himavatsannibhaṃ girim | paśyamānastato vindhyaṃ rāvaṇo narmadāṃ yayau || 7.31.18 ||
translation: उत्क्रामन्तम् rising high, दरीवन्तम् having caves, हिमवत्सन्निभम् resembling the Himalayas, गिरिम् mountain, पश्यमानः seeing, ततः then, विन्ध्यम् the Vindhya, रावणः Ravana, नर्मदाम् to the Narmada, ययौ went.
explanation: Ravana, after observing the Vindhya mountain, which rose high, possessed many caves, and resembled the Himalayas, then proceeded to the Narmada river.

shloka_text: चलोपलजलां पुण्यां पश्चिमोदधिगामिनीम् ।। 7.31.19 ।।
transliteration: calopalajalāṃ puṇyāṃ paścimodadhigāminīm || 7.31.19 ||
translation: चलोपलजलाम् whose water moved over pebbles, पुण्याम् sacred, पश्चिमोदधिगामिनीम् flowing towards the western ocean.
explanation: Ravana went to the Narmada river, which was sacred, had water agitated by moving pebbles, and flowed towards the western ocean.

shloka_text: महिषैः सृमरैः सिंहैः शार्दूलर्क्षगजोत्तमैः । उष्णाभितप्तैस्तृषितैः सङ्क्षोभितजलाशयाम् ।। 7.31.20 ।।
transliteration: mahiṣaiḥ sṛmaraiḥ siṃhaiḥ śārdūlarkṣagajottamaiḥ | uṣṇābhitaptaistṛṣitaiḥ saṅkṣobhitajalāśayām || 7.31.20 ||
translation: महिषैः by buffaloes, सृमरैः by sṛmara deer, सिंहैः by lions, शार्दूलर्क्षगजोत्तमैः by tigers, bears, and excellent elephants, उष्णाभितप्तैः tormented by heat, तृषितैः thirsty, सङ्क्षोभितजलाशयाम् whose waters were agitated.
explanation: The Narmada's waters were agitated by buffaloes, sṛmara deer, lions, tigers, bears, and magnificent elephants, all of whom were tormented by the heat and seeking to quench their thirst.

shloka_text: चक्रवाकैः सकारण्डैः सहंसजलकुक्कुटैः । सारसैश्च सदा मत्तैः सुकूजद्भिः समावृताम् ।। 7.31.21 ।।
transliteration: cakravākaiḥ sakāraṇḍaiḥ sahaṃsajalakukkuṭaiḥ | sārasaiśca sadā mattaiḥ sukūjadbhiḥ samāvṛtām || 7.31.21 ||
translation: चक्रवाकैः by chakravaka birds, सकारण्डैः with karanda ducks, सहंसजलकुक्कुटैः with swans and water-hens, सारसैश्च and by sarasa cranes, सदा always, मत्तैः intoxicated (joyful), सुकूजद्भिः sweetly cooing, समावृताम् surrounded.
explanation: The river was surrounded by chakravaka birds, karanda ducks, swans, water-hens, and sarasa cranes, all always joyful and sweetly cooing.

shloka_text: फुल्लद्रुमकृतोत्तंसां चक्रवाकयुगस्तनीम् । विस्तीर्णपुलिनश्रोणीं हंसावलिसुमेखलाम् ।। 7.31.22 ।।
transliteration: phulladrumakṛtottaṃsāṃ cakravākayugastanīm | vistīrṇapulinaśroṇīṃ haṃsāvalisumekhalām || 7.31.22 ||
translation: फुल्लद्रुमकृतोत्तंसां having blooming trees as her head-ornaments, चक्रवाकयुगस्तनीम् having a pair of chakravaka birds as her breasts, विस्तीर्णपुलिनश्रोणीं having wide sandbanks as her hips, हंसावलिसुमेखलाम् having rows of swans as her beautiful girdle.
explanation: The river was adorned with blooming trees like head-ornaments, pairs of chakravaka birds like breasts, wide sandbanks like hips, and rows of swans like a beautiful girdle.

shloka_text: पुष्परेण्वनुलिप्ताङ्गीं जलफेनामलांशुकाम् । जलावगाहसंस्पर्शां फुल्लोत्पलशुभेक्षणाम् । पुष्पकादवरुह्याशु नर्मदां सरितां वराम् ।। 7.31.23 ।।
transliteration: puṣpareṇvanuliptāṅgīṃ jalaphenāmalāṃśukām | jalāvagāhasaṃsparśāṃ phullotpalaśubhekṣaṇām | puṣpakādavaruhyāśu narmadāṃ saritāṃ varām || 7.31.23 ||
translation: पुष्परेण्वनुलिप्ताङ्गीं having her body smeared with pollen, जलफेनामलांशुकाम् having pure foam of water as her garment, जलावगाहसंस्पर्शां whose touch was like bathing in water, फुल्लोत्पलशुभेक्षणाम् having blooming lotuses as her auspicious eyes, पुष्पकादवरुह्याशु quickly descending from the Pushpaka, नर्मदां to the Narmada, सरितां वराम् the best of rivers.
explanation: With her body smeared with pollen, pure water foam as her garment, a refreshing touch like a bath, and auspicious eyes like blooming lotuses, Ravana quickly descended from the Pushpaka to the Narmada, the best of rivers.

shloka_text: इष्टामिव वरां नारीमवगाह्य दशाननः । स तस्याः पुलिने रम्ये नानामुनिनिषेविते ।। 7.31.24 ।।
transliteration: iṣṭāmiva varāṃ nārīmavagāhya daśānanaḥ | sa tasyāḥ puline ramye nānāmuniniṣevite || 7.31.24 ||
translation: इष्टामिव like a desired, वरां excellent, नारीम् woman, अवगाह्य having entered, दशाननः Dashanana (Ravana), स he, तस्याः her, पुलिने on the sandbank, रम्ये beautiful, नानामुनिनिषेविते frequented by various sages.
explanation: Ravana, having entered the Narmada as if embracing a beloved woman, then sat on her beautiful sandbank, which was frequented by various sages.

shloka_text: उपोपविष्टैः सचिवैः सार्धं राक्षसपुङ्गवः । प्रख्याय नर्मदां सो ऽथ गङ्गेयमिति रावणः ।। 7.31.25 ।।
transliteration: upopaviṣṭaiḥ sacivaiḥ sārdhaṃ rākṣasapuṅgavaḥ | prakhyāya narmadāṃ so 'tha gaṅgeyamiti rāvaṇaḥ || 7.31.25 ||
translation: उपोपविष्टैः seated nearby, सचिवैः with his ministers, सार्धं together with, राक्षसपुङ्गवः the foremost of rakshasas (Ravana), प्रख्याय having declared, नर्मदां the Narmada, सः he, अथ then, गङ्गेयमिति "this is Ganga", रावणः Ravana.
explanation: The foremost of rakshasas, Ravana, then sat with his ministers who were seated nearby, mistakenly declaring the Narmada to be the Ganga.

shloka_text: नर्मदादर्शजं हर्षमाप्तवान् राक्षसाधिपः । उवाच सचिवांस्तत्र सलीलं शुकसारणौ ।। 7.31.26 ।।
transliteration: narmadādarśajaṃ harṣamāptavān rākṣasādhipaḥ | uvāca sacivāṃstatra salīlaṃ śukasāraṇau || 7.31.26 ||
translation: नर्मदादर्शजम् from seeing the Narmada, हर्षम् joy, आप्तवान् obtained, राक्षसाधिपः the lord of rakshasas, उवाच said, सचिवान् to his ministers, तत्र there, सलीलम् playfully, शुकसारणौ to Shuka and Sarana,
explanation: The lord of rakshasas, having experienced joy from seeing the Narmada, playfully spoke to his ministers Shuka and Sarana there.

shloka_text: एष रश्मिसहस्रेण जगत्कृत्वैव काञ्चनम् । तीक्ष्णतापकरः सूर्यो नभसो ऽर्धं समाश्रितः ।। 7.31.27 ।।
transliteration: eṣa raśmisahasreṇa jagatkṛtvaiva kāñcanam | tīkṣṇatāpakaraḥ sūryo nabhaso 'rdhaṃ samāśritaḥ || 7.31.27 ||
translation: एष this, रश्मिसहस्रेण with a thousand rays, जगत् the world, कृत्वैव having made indeed, काञ्चनम् golden, तीक्ष्णतापकरः causing intense heat, सूर्यः the sun, नभसः of the sky, अर्धम् half, समाश्रितः has occupied,
explanation: This sun, having made the world golden with its thousand rays and causing intense heat, has indeed reached the middle of the sky.

shloka_text: मामासीनं विदित्वैव चन्द्रायति दिवाकरः ।। 7.31.28 ।।
transliteration: māmāsīnaṃ viditvaiva candrāyati divākaraḥ || 7.31.28 ||
translation: माम् me, आसीनम् seated, विदित्वैव having known indeed, चन्द्रायति acts like the moon, दिवाकरः the sun,
explanation: The sun, knowing that I am seated here, indeed acts like the moon (becomes cool).

shloka_text: नर्मदाजलशीतश्च सुगन्धिः श्रमनाशनः । मद्भयादनिलो ऽप्यत्र वात्येष सुसमाहितः ।। 7.31.29 ।।
transliteration: narmadājalaśītaśca sugandhiḥ śramanāśanaḥ | madbhayādanilo 'pyatra vātyeṣa susamāhitaḥ || 7.31.29 ||
translation: नर्मदाजलशीतश्च and cool with Narmada's water, सुगन्धिः fragrant, श्रमनाशनः destroyer of fatigue, मद्भयात् from my fear, अनिलः the wind, अपि even, अत्र here, वाति blows, एष this, सुसमाहितः very carefully,
explanation: Even this wind, cool with the Narmada's water, fragrant, and a destroyer of fatigue, blows here very carefully out of fear of me.

shloka_text: इयं वापि सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा नर्मदा नर्मवर्धिनी । नक्रमीनविहङ्गोर्मिः सभयेवाङ्गना स्थिता ।। 7.31.30 ।।
transliteration: iyaṃ vāpi saricchreṣṭhā narmadā narmavardhinī | nakramīnavihaṅgormiḥ sabhayevāṅganā sthitā || 7.31.30 ||
translation: इयम् this, वा अपि or even, सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा best of rivers, नर्मदा Narmada, नर्मवर्धिनी increasing joy, नक्रमीनविहङ्गोर्मिः having crocodiles, fish, birds, and waves, सभयेव अङ्गना like a frightened woman, स्थिता stands,
explanation: This Narmada, the best of rivers and increaser of joy, with its crocodiles, fish, birds, and waves, stands as if a frightened woman.

shloka_text: तद्भवन्तः क्षताः शस्त्रैर्नृपैरिन्द्रसमैर्युधि । चन्दनस्य रसेनेव रुधिरेण समुक्षिताः ।। 7.31.31 ।।
transliteration: tadbhavantaḥ kṣatāḥ śastrairnṛpairindrasamairyudhi | candanasya raseneva rudhireṇa samukṣitāḥ || 7.31.31 ||
translation: तत् therefore, भवन्तः you, क्षताः wounded, शस्त्रैः by weapons, नृपैः by kings, इन्द्रसमैः equal to Indra, युधि in battle, चन्दनस्य of sandalwood, रसेन with the juice, इव as if, रुधिरेण with blood, समुक्षिताः drenched.
explanation: Therefore, you, who were wounded in battle by kings equal to Indra, are drenched in blood as if with sandalwood paste.

shloka_text: ते यूयमवगाहध्वं नर्मदां शर्मदां शुभाम् । महापद्ममुखा मत्ता गङ्गामिव गहागजाः । अस्यां स्नात्वा महानद्यां पाप्मानं विप्रमोक्ष्यथ ।। 7.31.32 ।।
transliteration: te yūyamavagāhadhvaṃ narmadāṃ śarmadāṃ śubhām | mahāpadmamukhā mattā gaṅgāmiva gahāgajāḥ | asyāṃ snātvā mahānadyāṃ pāpmānaṃ vipramokṣyatha || 7.31.32 ||
translation: ते those, यूयम् you, अवगाहध्वम् plunge into, नर्मदां the Narmada, शर्मदां bestowing happiness, शुभाम् auspicious, महापद्ममुखाः led by Mahapadma, मत्ताः intoxicated, गङ्गाम् into the Ganga, इव like, गहागजाः wild elephants; अस्याम् in this, स्नात्वा having bathed, महानद्याम् in the great river, पाप्मानम् sin, विप्रमोक्ष्यथ you will be freed from.
explanation: You should plunge into the auspicious and joy-giving Narmada river, just as rutting wild elephants led by Mahapadma plunge into the Ganga, and by bathing in this great river, you will be freed from sin.

shloka_text: अहमप्यद्य पुलिने शरदिन्दुसमप्रभे । पुष्पोपहारं शनकैः करिष्यामि कपर्दिनः ।। 7.31.33 ।।
transliteration: ahamapyadya puline śaradindusamaprabhe | puṣpopahāraṃ śanakaiḥ kariṣyāmi kapardinaḥ || 7.31.33 ||
translation: अहम् I, अपि also, अद्य today, पुलिने on the sandbank, शरदिन्दुसमप्रभे having the luster of the autumn moon, पुष्पोपहारम् a flower offering, शनकैः gently, करिष्यामि will make, कपर्दिनः to Kapardin (Shiva).
explanation: I also will gently make a flower offering to Kapardin (Shiva) today on the sandbank, which shines like the autumn moon.

shloka_text: रावणेनैवमुक्तास्तु प्रहस्तशुकसारणाः । समहोदरधूम्राक्षा नर्मदां विजगाहिरे ।। 7.31.34 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇenaivamuktāstu prahastaśukasāraṇāḥ | samahodaradhūmrākṣā narmadāṃ vijagāhire || 7.31.34 ||
translation: रावणेन by Ravana, एवम् thus, उक्ताः addressed, तु indeed, प्रहस्तशुकसारणाः Prahasta, Shuka, and Sarana, समहोदरधूम्राक्षाः along with Mahodara and Dhumraksha, नर्मदां into the Narmada, विजगाहिरे plunged.
explanation: Thus addressed by Ravana, Prahasta, Shuka, Sarana, along with Mahodara and Dhumraksha, plunged into the Narmada river.

shloka_text: राक्षसेन्द्रगजैस्तैस्तु क्षोभिता नर्मदा नदी । वामनाञ्जनपद्माद्यैर्गङ्गा इव महागजैः ।। 7.31.35 ।।
transliteration: rākṣasendragajaistaistu kṣobhitā narmadā nadī | vāmanāñjanapadmādyairgaṅgā iva mahāgajaiḥ || 7.31.35 ||
translation: राक्षसेन्द्रगजैः by those chief Rakshasas (who are like elephants), तैः by them, तु indeed, क्षोभिता agitated, नर्मदा the Narmada, नदी river, वामनाञ्जनपद्माद्यैः by Vamana, Anjana, Padma, and others, गङ्गा the Ganga, इव like, महागजैः by great elephants.
explanation: The Narmada river was agitated by those chief Rakshasas, who were like great elephants, just as the Ganga is disturbed by great elephants like Vamana, Anjana, and Padma.

shloka_text: ततस्ते राक्षसाः स्नात्वा नर्मदायां महाबलाः । उत्तीर्य पुष्पाण्याजह्रुर्बल्यर्थं रावणस्य तु ।। 7.31.36 ।।
transliteration: tataste rākṣasāḥ snātvā narmadāyāṃ mahābalāḥ | uttīrya puṣpāṇyājahrurbalyarthaṃ rāvaṇasya tu || 7.31.36 ||
translation: ततः then, ते those, राक्षसाः Rākṣasas, स्नात्वा having bathed, नर्मदायाम् in the Narmada, महाबलाः mighty, उत्तीर्य having come out, पुष्पाणि flowers, आजह्रुः brought, बल्यर्थम् for the offering, रावणस्य of Ravana, तु indeed.
explanation: Then, those mighty Rākṣasas, having bathed in the Narmada and emerged from the water, brought flowers for Ravana's offering.

shloka_text: नर्मदापुलिने हृद्ये शुभ्राभ्रसदृशप्रभे । राक्षसैस्तु मुहूर्तेन कृतः पुष्पमयो गिरिः ।। 7.31.37 ।।
transliteration: narmadāpuline hṛdye śubhrābhrasadṛśaprabhe | rākṣasaistu muhūrtena kṛtaḥ puṣpamayo giriḥ || 7.31.37 ||
translation: नर्मदापुलिने on the sandbank of the Narmada, हृद्ये charming, शुभ्राभ्रसदृशप्रभे having a luster like a white cloud, राक्षसैः by the Rākṣasas, तु indeed, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, कृतः was made, पुष्पमयः made of flowers, गिरिः a mountain.
explanation: On the charming sandbank of the Narmada, which shone like a white cloud, the Rākṣasas swiftly created a mountain of flowers in a moment.

shloka_text: पुष्पेषूपहृतेष्वेवं रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । अवतीर्णो नदीं स्नातुं गङ्गामिव महागजः ।। 7.31.38 ।।
transliteration: puṣpeṣūpahṛteṣvevaṃ rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ | avatīrṇo nadīṃ snātuṃ gaṅgāmiva mahāgajaḥ || 7.31.38 ||
translation: पुष्पेषु when the flowers, उपहृतेषु were brought, एवम् thus, रावणः Ravana, राक्षसेश्वरः the lord of Rākṣasas, अवतीर्णः descended, नदीम् into the river, स्नातुम् to bathe, गङ्गाम् into the Ganga, इव like, महागजः a great elephant.
explanation: When the flowers were thus brought, Ravana, the lord of Rākṣasas, descended into the river to bathe, just like a great elephant entering the Ganga.

shloka_text: तत्र स्नात्वा च विधिवज्जप्त्वा जप्यमनुत्तमम् । नर्मदासलिलात्तस्मादुत्ततार स रावणः ।। 7.31.39 ।।
transliteration: tatra snātvā ca vidhivajjaptvā japyamanuttamam | narmadāsalilāttasmāduttatāra sa rāvaṇaḥ || 7.31.39 ||
translation: तत्र there, स्नात्वा having bathed, च and, विधिवत् according to ritual, जप्त्वा having recited, जप्यम् the mantra, अनुत्तमम् excellent, नर्मदासलिलात् from the waters of the Narmada, तस्मात् from that, उत्ततार he emerged, सः that, रावणः Ravana.
explanation: Having bathed there according to ritual and recited the excellent mantra, that Ravana then emerged from the waters of the Narmada.

shloka_text: ततः क्लिन्नाम्बरं त्यक्त्वा शुक्लवस्त्रसमावृतम् । रावणं प्राञ्जलिं यान्तमन्वयुः सर्वराक्षसाः ।। 7.31.40 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ klinnāmbaraṃ tyaktvā śuklavastrasamāvṛtam | rāvaṇaṃ prāñjaliṃ yāntamanvayuḥ sarvarākṣasāḥ || 7.31.40 ||
translation: ततः then, क्लिन्नाम्बरम् wet garment, त्यक्त्वा having discarded, शुक्लवस्त्रसमावृतम् covered with white garments, रावणम् Ravana, प्राञ्जलिम् with folded hands, यान्तम् going, अन्वयुः followed, सर्वराक्षसाः all the Rākṣasas.
explanation: Then, having discarded his wet garment and now clad in white, Ravana proceeded with folded hands, followed by all the Rākṣasas.

shloka_text: तद्गतीवशमापन्ना मूर्तिमन्त इवाचलाः । यत्र यत्र च याति स्म रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । जाम्बूनदमयं लिङ्गं तत्र तत्र स्म नीयते ।। 7.31.41 ।।
transliteration: tadgatīvaśamāpannā mūrtimanta ivācalāḥ | yatra yatra ca yāti sma rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ | jāmbūnadamayaṃ liṅgaṃ tatra tatra sma nīyate || 7.31.41 ||
translation: तद्गतीवशमापन्ना having come under the sway of his movement, मूर्तिमन्तः embodied, इव as if, अचलाः mountains, यत्र यत्र wherever, च and, याति स्म went, रावणः Ravana, राक्षसेश्वरः the lord of Rakshasas, जाम्बूनदमयम् made of pure gold, लिङ्गम् the Lingam, तत्र तत्र there, स्म नीयते was carried.
explanation: Wherever Ravana, the lord of Rakshasas, went, the golden Shiva Lingam, as if an embodied mountain that had come under the sway of his movement, was carried along with him.

shloka_text: वालुकावेदिमध्ये तु तल्लिङ्गं स्थाप्य रावणः । अर्चयामास गन्धैश्च पुष्पैश्चामृतगन्धिभिः ।। 7.31.42 ।।
transliteration: vālukāvedimadhye tu talliṅgaṃ sthāpya rāvaṇaḥ | arcayāmāsa gandhaiśca puṣpaiścāmṛtagandhibhiḥ || 7.31.42 ||
translation: वालुकावेदिमध्ये in the middle of a sand altar, तु indeed, तल्लिङ्गम् that Lingam, स्थाप्य having placed, रावणः Ravana, अर्चयामास worshipped, गन्धैः with fragrances, च and, पुष्पैः with flowers, च and, अमृतगन्धिभिः having the fragrance of nectar.
explanation: Ravana placed that Lingam in the middle of a sand altar and worshipped it with fragrant substances and flowers that smelled like nectar.

shloka_text: ततः सतामार्तिहरं परं वरं वरप्रदं चन्द्रमयूखभूषणम् । समर्चयित्वा स निशाचरो जगौ प्रसार्य हस्तान्प्रणनर्त चाग्रतः ।। 7.31.43 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ satāmārtiharaṃ paraṃ varaṃ varapradaṃ candramayūkhabhūṣaṇam | samarcayitvā sa niśācaro jagau prasārya hastānpraṇanarta cāgrataḥ || 7.31.43 ||
translation: ततः then, सताम् of the good, आर्तिहरम् the remover of distress, परम् the supreme, वरम् boon (or best one), वरप्रदम् the giver of boons, चन्द्रमयूखभूषणम् adorned with moonbeams, समर्चयित्वा having worshipped well, सः he, निशाचरः the night-wanderer (Ravana), जगौ sang, प्रसार्य having stretched out, हस्तान् his hands, प्रणनर्त danced, च and, अग्रतः in front.
explanation: Then, having worshipped Shiva, who removes the distress of the virtuous, is the supreme boon, grants boons, and is adorned with the moon's rays, Ravana, the night-wanderer, sang and danced in front of the deity with outstretched hands. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकत्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 31 ।। Thus ends the thirty-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: नर्मदापुलिने यत्र राक्षसेन्द्रः सुदारुणः । पुष्पोपहारं कुरुते तस्माद्देशाददूरतः ।। 7.32.1 ।।
transliteration: narmadāpuline yatra rākṣasendraḥ sudāruṇaḥ | puṣpopahāraṃ kurute tasmāddeśādadūrataḥ || 7.32.1 ||
translation: नर्मदापुलिने on the sandbank of the Narmada, यत्र where, राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of Rakshasas, सुदारुणः very fierce, पुष्पोपहारम् an offering of flowers, कुरुते performs, तस्मात् from that, देशात् place, अदूरतः not far.
explanation: Not far from the place on the Narmada's sandbank where the very fierce lord of Rakshasas (Ravana) was performing his flower offering, another event was unfolding.
comments: Downstream, Kartavirya Arjuna dams the Narmada with his thousand arms, and the swollen flood sweeps away Ravana's offerings -- learning the cause, Ravana attacks; the armies clash, Prahasta is struck down, and Ravana and Arjuna duel with maces until Arjuna seizes the bewildered Ravana with his thousand arms and binds him as Vishnu bound Bali -- he bears Ravana captive into Mahishmati amid rejoicing.

shloka_text: अर्जुनो जयतां श्रेष्ठो माहिष्मत्याः पतिः प्रभुः । क्रीडते सह नारीभिर्नर्मदातोयमाश्रितः ।। 7.32.2 ।।
transliteration: arjuno jayatāṃ śreṣṭho māhiṣmatyāḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ | krīḍate saha nārībhirnarmadātoyamāśritaḥ || 7.32.2 ||
translation: अर्जुनः Arjuna, जयताम् among the victorious, श्रेष्ठः the best, माहिष्मत्याः of Mahishmati, पतिः the lord, प्रभुः the powerful, क्रीडते plays, सह with, नारीभिः women, नर्मदातोयम् the waters of the Narmada, आश्रितः having resorted to.
explanation: Kartavirya Arjuna, the best among the victorious, the powerful lord of Mahishmati, was sporting with women near the waters of the Narmada.

shloka_text: तासां मध्यगतो राजा रराज च तदार्जुनः । करेणूनां सहस्रस्य मध्यस्थ इव कुञ्जरः ।। 7.32.3 ।।
transliteration: tāsāṃ madhyagato rājā rarāja ca tadārjunaḥ | kareṇūnāṃ sahasrasya madhyastha iva kuñjaraḥ || 7.32.3 ||
translation: तासां of them, मध्यगतो situated in the middle, राजा the king, रराज shone, च and, तदार्जुनः that Arjuna, करेणूनां of female elephants, सहस्रस्य of a thousand, मध्यस्थ situated in the middle, इव like, कुञ्जरः an elephant,
explanation: King Kartavirya Arjuna, situated amidst those women, shone splendidly, just like a male elephant standing in the midst of a thousand female elephants.

shloka_text: जिज्ञासुः स तु बाहूनां सहस्रस्योत्तमं बलम् । रुरोध नर्मदावेगं बाहुभिर्बहुभिर्वृतः ।। 7.32.4 ।।
transliteration: jijñāsuḥ sa tu bāhūnāṃ sahasrasyottamaṃ balam | rurodha narmadāvegaṃ bāhubhirbahubhirvṛtaḥ || 7.32.4 ||
translation: जिज्ञासुः desirous of knowing, सः he, तु indeed, बाहूनां of arms, सहस्रस्य of a thousand, उत्तमं supreme, बलम् strength, रुरोध he obstructed, नर्मदावेगं the current of the Narmada, बाहुभिः with arms, बहुभिः many, वृतः using,
explanation: Desirous of testing the supreme strength of his thousand arms, he indeed obstructed the flow of the Narmada river with his many arms.

shloka_text: कार्तवीर्यभुजासक्तं तज्जलं प्राप्य निर्मलम् । कूलोपहारं कुर्वाणं प्रतिस्रोतः प्रधावति ।। 7.32.5 ।।
transliteration: kārtavīryabhujāsaktaṃ tajjalaṃ prāpya nirmalam | kūlopahāraṃ kurvāṇaṃ pratisrotaḥ pradhāvati || 7.32.5 ||
translation: कार्तवीर्यभुजासक्तं held by Kartavirya's arms, तज्जलं that water, प्राप्य having reached, निर्मलम् pure, कूलोपहारं making an offering to the banks (overflowing), कुर्वाणं doing, प्रतिस्रोतः against the current, प्रधावति it rushes,
explanation: That pure water, held back by Kartavirya's arms, then rushed upstream, overflowing and making an offering to the river banks.

shloka_text: समीननक्रमकरः सपुष्पकुशसंस्तरः । स नर्मदाम्भसो वेगः प्रावृट्काल इवाबभौ ।। 7.32.6 ।।
transliteration: samīnanakramakaraḥ sapuṣpakuśasaṃstaraḥ | sa narmadāmbhaso vegaḥ prāvṛṭkāla ivābabhau || 7.32.6 ||
translation: समीननक्रमकरः with fish, crocodiles, and alligators, सपुष्पकुशसंस्तरः with flowers and kusha grass spread out, सः that, नर्मदाम्भसो of the Narmada's water, वेगः current, प्रावृट्काल the rainy season, इव like, अबबभौ it appeared,
explanation: That current of the Narmada's water, filled with fish, crocodiles, and alligators, and strewn with flowers and kusha grass, appeared like the rainy season itself.

shloka_text: स वेगः कार्तवीर्येण सम्प्रेषित इवाम्भसः । पुष्पोपहारं सकलं रावणस्य जहार ह ।। 7.32.7 ।।
transliteration: sa vegaḥ kārtavīryeṇa sampreṣita ivāmbhasaḥ | puṣpopahāraṃ sakalaṃ rāvaṇasya jahāra ha || 7.32.7 ||
translation: सः that, वेगः current, कार्तवीर्येण by Kartavirya, सम्प्रेषित sent forth, इव as if, अम्भसः of the water, पुष्पोपहारं flower offering, सकलं all, रावणस्य of Ravana, जहार carried away, ह indeed,
explanation: That current, as if propelled by Kartavirya's water, indeed carried away all of Ravana's flower offerings.

shloka_text: रावणो ऽर्धसमाप्तं तमुत्सृज्य नियमं तदा । नर्मदां पश्यते कान्तां प्रतिकूलां यथा प्रियाम् ।। 7.32.8 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇo 'rdhasamāptaṃ tamutsṛjya niyamaṃ tadā | narmadāṃ paśyate kāntāṃ pratikūlāṃ yathā priyām || 7.32.8 ||
