shloka_text: सुमन्त्रस्तु तथेत्युक्त्वा युक्तं परमवाजिभिः । रथं सुरुचिरप्रख्यं स्वास्तीर्णं सुखशय्यया ।। 7.46.4 ।।
transliteration: sumantrastu tathetyuktvā yuktaṃ paramavājibhiḥ | rathaṃ suruciraprakhyaṃ svāstīrṇaṃ sukhaśayyayā || 7.46.4 ||
translation: सुमन्त्रस्तु but Sumantra, तथा so be it, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, युक्तं harnessed, परमवाजिभिः with excellent horses, रथं the chariot, सुरुचिरप्रख्यं appearing very beautiful, स्वास्तीर्णं well-cushioned, सुखशय्यया with a comfortable seat.
explanation: But Sumantra, having said "so be it," brought the chariot, harnessed with excellent horses, appearing very beautiful, and well-cushioned with a comfortable seat.

shloka_text: आनीयोवाच सौमित्रिं मित्राणां मानवर्धनम् । रथो ऽयं समनुप्राप्तो यत्कार्यं क्रियतां प्रभो ।। 7.46.5 ।।
transliteration: ānīyovāca saumitriṃ mitrāṇāṃ mānavardhanam | ratho 'yaṃ samanuprāpto yatkāryaṃ kriyatāṃ prabho || 7.46.5 ||
translation: आनीय having brought, उवाच said, सौमित्रिं to Lakshmana, मित्राणां of friends, मानवर्धनम् augmenter of honor, रथः chariot, अयं this, समनुप्राप्तो has arrived, यत् whatever, कार्यं task, क्रियतां let it be done, प्रभो O lord.
explanation: Having brought it, he said to Lakshmana, the augmenter of friends' honor, "O lord, this chariot has arrived; whatever task is to be done, let it be performed."

shloka_text: एवमुक्तः सुमन्त्रेण राजवेश्मनि लक्ष्मणः । प्रविश्य सीतामासाद्य व्याजहार नरर्षभः ।। 7.46.6 ।।
transliteration: evamuktaḥ sumantreṇa rājaveśmani lakṣmaṇaḥ | praviśya sītāmāsādya vyājahāra nararṣabhaḥ || 7.46.6 ||
translation: एवमुक्तः thus addressed, सुमन्त्रेण by Sumantra, राजवेश्मनि in the royal palace, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, प्रविश्य having entered, सीताम् Sita, आसाद्य having approached, व्याजहार spoke, नरर्षभः the best among men.
explanation: Lakshmana, the best among men, thus addressed by Sumantra, entered the royal palace, approached Sita, and spoke to her.

shloka_text: त्वया किलैष नृपतिर्वरं वै याचितः प्रभुः । नृपेण च प्रतिज्ञातमाज्ञप्तश्चाश्रमं प्रति ।। 7.46.7 ।।
transliteration: tvayā kilaiṣa nṛpatirvaraṃ vai yācitaḥ prabhuḥ | nṛpeṇa ca pratijñātamājñaptaścāśramaṃ prati || 7.46.7 ||
translation: त्वया by you, किल indeed, एषः this, नृपतिः king, वरम् a boon, वै indeed, याचितः was requested, प्रभुः the lord, नृपेण by the king, च and, प्रतिज्ञातम् promised, आज्ञप्तः I am commanded, च and, आश्रमम् to the hermitage, प्रति towards.
explanation: Lakshmana informed Sita that she had indeed requested a boon from the king, who in turn had promised it and now commanded Lakshmana to take her to a hermitage.

shloka_text: गङ्गीतीरे मया देवि ऋषीणामाश्रमाञ्छुभान् । शीघ्रं गत्वा तु वैदेहि शासनात्पार्थिवस्य नः । अरण्ये मुनिभिर्जुष्टे अपनेया भविष्यसि ।। 7.46.8 ।।
transliteration: gaṅgītīre mayā devi ṛṣīṇāmāśramāñchubhān | śīghraṃ gatvā tu vaidehi śāsanātpārthivasya naḥ | araṇye munibhirjuṣṭe apaneyā bhaviṣyasi || 7.46.8 ||
translation: गङ्गीतीरे on the bank of the Ganga, मया by me, देवि O Goddess, ऋषीणाम् of sages, आश्रमान् hermitages, शुभान् auspicious, शीघ्रम् quickly, गत्वा having gone, तु indeed, वैदेहि O Vaidehi, शासनात् by the command, पार्थिवस्य of the king, नः our, अरण्ये in the forest, मुनिभिः by sages, जुष्टे inhabited, अपनेया to be left, भविष्यसि you will be.
explanation: Lakshmana tells Sita that by the command of their king, he will quickly take her to the auspicious hermitages of sages on the bank of the Ganga, where she will be left in a forest frequented by ascetics.

shloka_text: एवमुक्ता तु वैदेही लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना । प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे गमनं चाप्यरोचयत् ।। 7.46.9 ।।
transliteration: evamuktā tu vaidehī lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā | praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe gamanaṃ cāpyarocayat || 7.46.9 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्ता addressed, तु indeed, वैदेही Vaidehi, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, महात्मना the great-souled, प्रहर्षम् great joy, अतुलम् incomparable, लेभे obtained, गमनम् the journey, च and, अपि also, अरोचयत् approved.
explanation: Thus addressed by the great-souled Lakshmana, Vaidehi felt incomparable joy and approved of the journey.

shloka_text: वासांसि च महार्हाणि रत्नानि विविधानि च । गृहीत्वा तानि वैदेही गमनायोपचक्रमे ।। 7.46.10 ।।
transliteration: vāsāṃsi ca mahārhāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca | gṛhītvā tāni vaidehī gamanāyopacakrame || 7.46.10 ||
translation: वासांसि garments, च and, महार्हाणि valuable, रत्नानि jewels, विविधानि various, च and, गृहीत्वा having taken, तानि them, वैदेही Vaidehi, गमनाय for the journey, उपचक्रमे prepared.
explanation: Vaidehi, having taken valuable garments and various jewels, prepared herself for the journey.

shloka_text: इमानि मुनिपत्नीनां दास्याम्याभरणान्हम् । वस्त्राणि च महार्हाणि धनानि विविधानि च ।। 7.46.11 ।।
transliteration: imāni munipatnīnāṃ dāsyāmyābharaṇānham | vastrāṇi ca mahārhāṇi dhanāni vividhāni ca || 7.46.11 ||
translation: इमानि these, मुनिपत्नीनाम् to the wives of the sages, दास्यामि I shall give, आभरणान् ornaments, अहम् I, वस्त्राणि clothes, च and, महार्हाणि very valuable, धनानि riches, विविधानि various, च and,
explanation: I shall give these ornaments, very valuable clothes, and various riches to the wives of the sages.

shloka_text: सौमित्रिस्तु तथेत्युक्त्वा रथमारोप्य मैथिलीम् । प्रययौ शीघ्रतुरगै रामस्याज्ञामनुस्मरन् ।। 7.46.12 ।।
transliteration: saumitristu tathetyuktvā rathamāropya maithilīm | prayayau śīghraturagai rāmasyājñāmanusmaran || 7.46.12 ||
translation: सौमित्रिस्तु But Lakshmana, तथा so be it, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, रथम् chariot, आरोप्य having made ascend, मैथिलीम् Maithili (Sita), प्रययौ proceeded, शीघ्रतुरगैः with swift horses, रामस्य of Rama, आज्ञाम् command, अनुस्मरन् remembering,
explanation: Lakshmana, having said "so be it," made Sita ascend the chariot and proceeded with swift horses, remembering Rama's command.

shloka_text: अब्रवीच्च तदा सीता लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मिवर्धनम् । अशुभानि बहून्येव पश्यामि रघुनन्दन ।। 7.46.13 ।।
transliteration: abravīcca tadā sītā lakṣmaṇaṃ lakṣmivardhanam | aśubhāni bahūnyeva paśyāmi raghunandana || 7.46.13 ||
translation: अब्रवीत् said, च and, तदा then, सीता Sita, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, लक्ष्मिवर्धनम् augmenter of prosperity, अशुभानि inauspicious signs, बहूनि many, एव indeed, पश्यामि I see, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus,
explanation: Then Sita said to Lakshmana, the augmenter of prosperity, "O delight of the Raghus, I indeed see many inauspicious signs."

shloka_text: नयनं मे स्फुरत्यद्य गात्रोत्कम्पश्च जायते । हृदयं चैव सौमित्रे अस्वस्थमिव लक्षये ।। 7.46.14 ।।
transliteration: nayanaṃ me sphuratyadya gātrotkampaśca jāyate | hṛdayaṃ caiva saumitre asvasthamiva lakṣaye || 7.46.14 ||
translation: नयनम् eye, मे my, स्फुरति throbs, अद्य today, गात्रोत्कम्पः trembling of the body, च and, जायते occurs, हृदयम् heart, च and, एव indeed, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, अस्वस्थम् uneasy, इव as if, लक्षये I perceive,
explanation: My eye throbs today, and a trembling of my body occurs; indeed, O son of Sumitra, I perceive my heart to be uneasy.

shloka_text: औत्सुक्यं परमं चापि अधृतिश्च परा मम । शून्यामेव च पश्यामि पृथिवीं पृथुलोचन ।। 7.46.15 ।।
transliteration: autsukyaṃ paramaṃ cāpi adhṛtiśca parā mama | śūnyāmeva ca paśyāmi pṛthivīṃ pṛthulocana || 7.46.15 ||
translation: औत्सुक्यम् anxiety, परमम् extreme, च and, अपि also, अधृतिः restlessness, च and, परा great, मम my, शून्याम् empty, एव indeed, च and, पश्यामि I see, पृथिवीम् the earth, पृथुलोचन O broad-eyed one,
explanation: I also have extreme anxiety and great restlessness, and indeed, O broad-eyed one, I see the earth as empty.

shloka_text: अपि स्वस्ति भवेत्तस्य भ्रातुस्ते भ्रातृवत्सल । श्वश्रूणां चैव मे वीर सर्वासामविशेषतः ।। 7.46.16 ।।
transliteration: api svasti bhavettasya bhrātuste bhrātṛvatsala | śvaśrūṇāṃ caiva me vīra sarvāsāmaviśeṣataḥ || 7.46.16 ||
translation: अपि also, स्वस्ति welfare, भवेत् may there be, तस्य of him, भ्रातुः of brother, ते your, भ्रातृवत्सल O lover of brothers, श्वश्रूणाम् of mothers-in-law, च and, एव indeed, मे my, वीर O hero, सर्वासाम् of all, अविशेषतः especially, without exception, ...
explanation: Sita, addressing Lakshmana as a lover of brothers and a hero, wishes for the well-being of his brother (Rama) and especially for all her mothers-in-law.

shloka_text: पुरे जनपदे चैव कुशलं प्राणिनामपि । इत्यञ्जलिकृता सीता देवता अभ्ययाचत ।। 7.46.17 ।।
transliteration: pure janapade caiva kuśalaṃ prāṇināmapi | ityañjalikṛtā sītā devatā abhyayācata || 7.46.17 ||
translation: पुरे in the city, जनपदे in the kingdom, च and, एव indeed, कुशलम् welfare, प्राणिनाम् of living beings, अपि also, इति thus, अञ्जलिकृता with folded hands, सीता Sita, देवताः to the deities, अभ्ययाचत prayed, ...
explanation: With folded hands, Sita thus prayed to the deities for the well-being of all living beings in the city and the kingdom.

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणो ऽर्थं ततः श्रुत्वा शिरसा वन्द्य मैथिलीम् । शिवमित्यब्रवीद्धृष्टो हृदयेन विशुष्यता ।। 7.46.18 ।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇo 'rthaṃ tataḥ śrutvā śirasā vandya maithilīm | śivamityabravīddhṛṣṭo hṛdayena viśuṣyatā || 7.46.18 ||
translation: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अर्थम् the request, ततः then, श्रुत्वा having heard, शिरसा with his head, वन्द्य having bowed to, मैथिलीम् Maithili, शिवम् auspicious, इति thus, अब्रवीत् said, धृष्टः outwardly pleased, हृदयेन with a heart, विशुष्यता drying up, ...
explanation: Lakshmana, having heard Sita's request, bowed his head to Maithili and, though outwardly appearing pleased, said "auspicious" with a heart that was inwardly grieving.

shloka_text: ततो वासमुपागम्य गोमतीतीर आश्रमे । प्रभाते पुनरुत्थाय सौमित्रिः सूतमब्रवीत् ।। 7.46.19 ।।
transliteration: tato vāsamupāgamya gomatītīra āśrame | prabhāte punarutthāya saumitriḥ sūtamabravīt || 7.46.19 ||
translation: ततः then, वासम् dwelling, उपागम्य having reached, गोमतीतीरे on the bank of Gomati, आश्रमे in the hermitage, प्रभाते in the morning, पुनरुत्थाय having risen again, सौमित्रिः Saumitri, सूतम् to the charioteer, अब्रवीत् said, ...
explanation: Then, having stayed in a hermitage on the bank of the Gomati, Lakshmana rose again in the morning and spoke to the charioteer.

shloka_text: योजयस्व रथं शीघ्रमद्य भागीरथीजलम् । शिरसा धारयिष्यामि त्र्यम्बकः पर्वते यथा ।। 7.46.20 ।।
transliteration: yojayasva rathaṃ śīghramadya bhāgīrathījalam | śirasā dhārayiṣyāmi tryambakaḥ parvate yathā || 7.46.20 ||
translation: योजयस्व harness, रथम् the chariot, शीघ्रम् quickly, अद्य today, भागीरथीजलम् the water of the Bhagirathi, शिरसा with my head, धारयिष्यामि I shall bear, त्र्यम्बकः Tryambaka, पर्वते on the mountain, यथा just as, ...
explanation: Lakshmana instructed the charioteer to quickly harness the chariot, stating that he would bear the waters of the Bhagirathi on his head today, just as Lord Shiva bears them on the mountain.

shloka_text: सो ऽश्वान् रज्वाथ चतुरो रथे युङ्क्त्वा मनोजवान् । आरोहस्वेति वैदेहीं सूतः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत् ।। 7.46.21 ।।
transliteration: so 'śvān rajvātha caturo rathe yuṅktvā manojavān | ārohasveti vaidehīṃ sūtaḥ prāñjalirabravīt || 7.46.21 ||
translation: सः he, अश्वान् horses, रज्वा with reins, अथ then, चतुरः four, रथे to the chariot, युङ्क्त्वा having yoked, मनोजवान् swift as mind, आरोहस्व please ascend, इति thus, वैदेहीं to Vaidehi, सूतः the charioteer, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: The charioteer Sumantra, having yoked four mind-swift horses to the chariot, then respectfully requested Vaidehi to ascend it.

shloka_text: सा तु सूतस्य वचनादारुरोह रथोत्तमम् । सीता सौमित्रिणा सार्धं सुमन्त्रेण च धीमता ।। 7.46.22 ।।
transliteration: sā tu sūtasya vacanādāruroha rathottamam | sītā saumitriṇā sārdhaṃ sumantreṇa ca dhīmatā || 7.46.22 ||
translation: सा she, तु indeed, सूतस्य of the charioteer, वचनात् from the words, आरुरोह ascended, रथोत्तमम् the excellent chariot, सीता Sita, सौमित्रिणा with Lakshmana, सार्धम् together with, सुमन्त्रेण with Sumantra, च and, धीमता intelligent.
explanation: Sita, in response to the charioteer's words, ascended the excellent chariot accompanied by Lakshmana and the intelligent Sumantra.

shloka_text: आससाद विशालाक्षी गङ्गां पापविनाशिनीम् । अथार्धदिवसं गत्वा भागीरथ्या जलाशयम् ।। 7.46.23 ।।
transliteration: āsasāda viśālākṣī gaṅgāṃ pāpavināśinīm | athārdhadivasaṃ gatvā bhāgīrathyā jalāśayam || 7.46.23 ||
translation: आससाद reached, विशालाक्षी the wide-eyed one, गङ्गां Ganga, पापविनाशिनीम् the destroyer of sins, अथ then, अर्धदिवसम् half a day, गत्वा having gone, भागीरथ्याः of Bhagirathi, जलाशयम् the body of water.
explanation: After traveling for half a day, the wide-eyed Sita reached the sacred waters of the Ganga, the destroyer of sins.

shloka_text: निरीक्ष्य लक्ष्मणो दीनः प्ररुरोद महास्वनः ।। 7.46.24 ।।
transliteration: nirīkṣya lakṣmaṇo dīnaḥ praruroda mahāsvanaḥ || 7.46.24 ||
translation: निरीक्ष्य having seen, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, दीनः distressed, प्ररुरोद wept loudly, महास्वनः with a great sound.
explanation: Observing the situation, the distressed Lakshmana wept loudly with a great sound.

shloka_text: सीता तु परमायत्ता दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणमातुरम् । उवाच वाक्यं धर्मज्ञा किमिदं रुद्यते त्वया ।। 7.46.25 ।।
transliteration: sītā tu paramāyattā dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇamāturam | uvāca vākyaṃ dharmajñā kimidaṃ rudyate tvayā || 7.46.25 ||
translation: सीता Sita, तु but, परमायत्ता greatly agitated, दृष्ट्वा having seen, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, आतुरम् distressed, उवाच said, वाक्यं words, धर्मज्ञा knower of dharma, किम् what, इदम् this, रुद्यते is being wept, त्वया by you.
explanation: But Sita, a knower of dharma and greatly agitated upon seeing Lakshmana distressed, asked him, "Why are you weeping like this?"

shloka_text: जाह्नवीतीरमासाद्य चिराभिलषितं मम । हर्षकाले किमर्थं मां विषादयसि लक्ष्मण ।। 7.46.26 ।।
transliteration: jāhnavītīramāsādya cirābhilaṣitaṃ mama | harṣakāle kimarthaṃ māṃ viṣādayasi lakṣmaṇa || 7.46.26 ||
translation: जाह्नवीतीरम् the bank of the Ganga, आसाद्य having reached, चिराभिलषितम् long-desired, मम my, हर्षकाले at the time of joy, किमर्थम् why, माम् me, विषादयसि you make sad, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana.
explanation: O Lakshmana, why do you make me sad at this joyful moment, when we have reached the bank of the Ganga, which I have desired for so long?

shloka_text: नित्यं त्वं रामपार्श्वेषु वर्तसे पुरुषर्षभ । कच्चिद्विनाकृतस्तेन द्विरात्रं शोकमागतः ।। 7.46.27 ।।
transliteration: nityaṃ tvaṃ rāmapārśveṣu vartase puruṣarṣabha | kaccidvinākṛtastena dvirātraṃ śokamāgataḥ || 7.46.27 ||
translation: नित्यम् always, त्वम् you, रामपार्श्वेषु by Rama's side, वर्तसे you remain, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men, कच्चित् I hope, विनाकृतः separated, तेन by him, द्विरात्रम् for two nights, शोकम् sorrow, आगतः you have come.
explanation: O best among men, you are always by Rama's side; I hope you have not become sorrowful because you have been separated from him for two nights.

shloka_text: ममापि दयितो रामो जीवितादपि लक्ष्मण । न चाहमेवं शोचामि मैवं त्वं बालिशो भव ।। 7.46.28 ।।
transliteration: mamāpi dayito rāmo jīvitādapi lakṣmaṇa | na cāhamevaṃ śocāmi maivaṃ tvaṃ bāliśo bhava || 7.46.28 ||
translation: ममापि even to me, दयितः dear, रामः Rama, जीवितादपि even more than life, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, न च and not, अहम् I, एवम् thus, शोचामि grieve, मा एवम् do not thus, त्वम् you, बालिशः childish, भव be.
explanation: O Lakshmana, Rama is dearer to me even than my own life, yet I do not grieve in this manner, so do not be childish.

shloka_text: तारयस्व च मां गङ्गां दर्शयस्व च तापसान् । ततो मुनिभ्यो दास्यामि वांसास्याभरणानि च ।। 7.46.29 ।।
transliteration: tārayasva ca māṃ gaṅgāṃ darśayasva ca tāpasān | tato munibhyo dāsyāmi vāṃsāsyābharaṇāni ca || 7.46.29 ||
translation: तारयस्व make me cross, च and, माम् me, गङ्गाम् the Ganga, दर्शयस्व show me, च and, तापसान् the ascetics, ततः then, मुनिभ्यः to the sages, दास्यामि I will give, वांसासि clothes, आभरणानि ornaments, च and.
explanation: Please ferry me across the Ganga and show me the ascetics, and then I will give clothes and ornaments to the sages.

shloka_text: ततः कृत्वा महर्षीणां यथार्हमभिवादनम् । तत्र चैकां निशामुष्य यास्यामस्तां पुरीं पुनः ।। 7.46.30 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kṛtvā maharṣīṇāṃ yathārhamabhivādanam | tatra caikāṃ niśāmuṣya yāsyāmastāṃ purīṃ punaḥ || 7.46.30 ||
translation: ततः then, कृत्वा having done, महर्षीणाम् of the great sages, यथार्हम् appropriately, अभिवादनम् salutation, तत्र there, च and, एकाम् one, निशाम् night, उष्य having stayed, यास्यामः we will go, ताम् that, पुरीम् city, पुनः again.
explanation: Then, after appropriately saluting the great sages and staying there for one night, we will return to that city (Ayodhya) again.

shloka_text: ममापि पद्मपत्राक्षं सिंहोरस्कं कृशोदरम् । त्वरते हि मनो द्रष्टुं रामं रमयतां वरम् ।। 7.46.31 ।।
transliteration: mamāpi padmapatrākṣaṃ siṃhoraskaṃ kṛśodaram | tvarate hi mano draṣṭuṃ rāmaṃ ramayatāṃ varam || 7.46.31 ||
translation: ममापि my also, पद्मपत्राक्षं one whose eyes are like lotus leaves, सिंहोरस्कं one whose chest is like a lion's, कृशोदरम् one with a slender belly, त्वरते hastens, हि indeed, मनो mind, द्रष्टुं to see, रामं Rama, रमयतां among those who delight, वरम् the best.
explanation: My mind also indeed yearns to see Rama, who has eyes like lotus leaves, a lion-like chest, a slender belly, and is the best among those who delight others.

shloka_text: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रमृज्य नयने शुभे । नाविकानाह्वयामास लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा ।। 7.46.32 ।।
transliteration: tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā pramṛjya nayane śubhe | nāvikānāhvayāmāsa lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā || 7.46.32 ||
translation: तस्याः her, तद्वचनं that word, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रमृज्य having wiped, नयने eyes, शुभे beautiful, नाविकानाह्वयामास called the boatmen, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, परवीरहा destroyer of enemy heroes.
explanation: Having heard her words and wiped his beautiful eyes, Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemy heroes, called the boatmen.

shloka_text: इयं च सज्जा नौश्चेति दाशाः प्राञ्जलयो ऽब्रुवन् ।। 7.46.33 ।।
transliteration: iyaṃ ca sajjā nauśceti dāśāḥ prāñjalayo 'bruvan || 7.46.33 ||
translation: इयं this, च and, सज्जा ready, नौः boat, च and, इति thus, दाशाः the boatmen, प्राञ्जलयो with folded hands, अब्रुवन् said.
explanation: The boatmen, with folded hands, said, "This boat is ready."

shloka_text: तितीर्षुर्लक्ष्मणो गङ्गां शुभां नावमुपारुहत् । गङ्गां सन्तारयामास लक्ष्मणस्तां समाहितः ।। 7.46.34 ।।
transliteration: titīrṣurlakṣmaṇo gaṅgāṃ śubhāṃ nāvamupāruhat | gaṅgāṃ santārayāmāsa lakṣmaṇastāṃ samāhitaḥ || 7.46.34 ||
translation: तितीर्षुः desiring to cross, लक्ष्मणो Lakshmana, गङ्गां the Ganga, शुभां auspicious, नावं boat, उपारुहत् boarded, गङ्गां the Ganga, सन्तारयामास caused to cross, लक्ष्मणस् Lakshmana, तां her (Sita), समाहितः attentively.
explanation: Desiring to cross the Ganga, Lakshmana boarded the auspicious boat and then attentively ferried Sita across the Ganga. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षट्चत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 46 ।। Thus ends the forty-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: अथ नावं सुविस्तीर्णां नैषादीं राघवानुजः । आरुरोह समायुक्तां पूर्वमारोप्य मैथिलीम् ।। 7.47.1 ।।
transliteration: atha nāvaṃ suvistīrṇāṃ naiṣādīṃ rāghavānujaḥ | āruroha samāyuktāṃ pūrvamāropya maithilīm || 7.47.1 ||
translation: अथ then, नावं boat, सुविस्तीर्णां very spacious, नैषादीं belonging to the Nishadas, राघवानुजः Rama's younger brother, आरुरोह boarded, समायुक्तां well-equipped, पूर्वं first, आरोप्य having placed, मैथिलीम् Maithili.
explanation: Then, Rama's younger brother, Lakshmana, first having placed Maithili (Sita) on the very spacious and well-equipped boat belonging to the Nishadas, himself boarded it.
comments: On the Ganga's far bank, bathed in tears, Lakshmana at last confesses that, on hearing the people's slander, the grief-stricken Rama has commanded her abandonment though she is faultless -- pointing out the holy hermitage of Valmiki, dear friend of Dasharatha, he bids her not despair but dwell there in devotion to Rama.

shloka_text: सुमन्त्रं चैव सरथं स्थीयतामिति लक्ष्मणः । उवाच शोकसन्तप्तः प्रयाहीति च नाविकम् ।। 7.47.2 ।।
transliteration: sumantraṃ caiva sarathaṃ sthīyatāmiti lakṣmaṇaḥ | uvāca śokasantaptaḥ prayāhīti ca nāvikam || 7.47.2 ||
translation: सुमन्त्रं Sumantra, चैव and, सरथं with the chariot, स्थीयतामिति "stay here" thus, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, उवाच said, शोकसन्तप्तः distressed by sorrow, प्रयाहीति "proceed" thus, च and, नाविकम् to the boatman.
explanation: Distressed by sorrow, Lakshmana told Sumantra to stay there with the chariot and instructed the boatman to proceed.

shloka_text: ततस्तीरमुपागम्य भागीरथ्याः स लक्ष्मणः । उवाच मैथिलीं वाक्यं प्राञ्जलिर्बाष्पसम्प्लुतः ।। 7.47.3 ।।
transliteration: tatastīramupāgamya bhāgīrathyāḥ sa lakṣmaṇaḥ | uvāca maithilīṃ vākyaṃ prāñjalirbāṣpasamplutaḥ || 7.47.3 ||
translation: ततः then, तीरम् the bank, उपागम्य having approached, भागीरथ्याः of the Bhagirathi (Ganga), सः that, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, उवाच spoke, मैथिलीं to Maithili (Sita), वाक्यं words, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, बाष्पसम्प्लुतः bathed in tears.
explanation: Then, having reached the bank of the Bhagirathi, Lakshmana, with folded hands and bathed in tears, spoke to Sita.

shloka_text: हृद्गतं मे महच्छल्यं यस्मादार्येण धीमता । अस्मिन्निमित्ते वैदेहि लोकस्य वचनीकृतः ।। 7.47.4 ।।
transliteration: hṛdgataṃ me mahacchalyaṃ yasmādāryeṇa dhīmatā | asminnimitte vaidehi lokasya vacanīkṛtaḥ || 7.47.4 ||
translation: हृद्गतं residing in the heart, मे my, महच्छल्यं great dart/thorn, यस्मात् because of which, आर्येण by the noble one (Rama), धीमता by the wise one, अस्मिन् in this, निमित्ते matter/cause, वैदेहि O Vaidehi (Sita), लोकस्य of the people, वचनीकृतः made an object of reproach.
explanation: O Vaidehi, a great thorn resides in my heart because of which the wise and noble Rama has been made an object of public reproach in this matter.

shloka_text: श्रेयो हि मरणं मे ऽद्य मृत्युर्वा यत्परं भवेत् । न चास्मिन्नीदृशे कार्ये नियोज्यो लोकनिन्दिते ।। 7.47.5 ।।
transliteration: śreyo hi maraṇaṃ me 'dya mṛtyurvā yatparaṃ bhavet | na cāsminnīdṛśe kārye niyojyo lokanindite || 7.47.5 ||
translation: श्रेयः better, हि indeed, मरणं death, मे for me, अद्य today, मृत्युर्वा or death, यत् which, परं ultimate, भवेत् may be, न not, च and, अस्मिन् in this, ईदृशे such, कार्ये task/deed, नियोज्यः to be employed, लोकनिन्दिते censured by people.
explanation: Indeed, death or whatever ultimate demise may befall me today would be better, for I should not be employed in such a task that is censured by the people.

shloka_text: प्रसीद च न मे पापं कर्तुमर्हसि शोभने । इत्यञ्जलिकृतो भूमौ निपपात स लक्ष्मणः ।। 7.47.6 ।।
transliteration: prasīda ca na me pāpaṃ kartumarhasi śobhane | ityañjalikṛto bhūmau nipapāta sa lakṣmaṇaḥ || 7.47.6 ||
translation: प्रसीद be gracious, च and, न not, मे to me, पापं sin, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि you ought, शोभने O beautiful one, इति thus, अञ्जलिकृतः having folded hands, भूमौ on the ground, निपपात fell down, सः that, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana.
explanation: "Be gracious, O beautiful one, and do not commit this sin against me," thus saying, Lakshmana, with folded hands, fell to the ground.

shloka_text: रुदन्तं प्राञ्जलिं दृष्ट्वा काङ्क्षन्तं मृत्युमात्मनः । मैथिली भृशसंविग्ना लक्ष्मणं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। 7.47.7 ।।
transliteration: rudantaṃ prāñjaliṃ dṛṣṭvā kāṅkṣantaṃ mṛtyumātmanaḥ | maithilī bhṛśasaṃvignā lakṣmaṇaṃ vākyamabravīt || 7.47.7 ||
translation: रुदन्तं crying, प्राञ्जलिं with folded hands, दृष्ट्वा having seen, काङ्क्षन्तं desiring, मृत्युम् death, आत्मनः for himself, मैथिली Maithili (Sita), भृशसंविग्ना greatly agitated, लक्ष्मणं to Lakshmana, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Seeing Lakshmana crying, with folded hands, and desiring his own death, Sita became greatly agitated and spoke to him.

shloka_text: किमिदं नावगच्छामि ब्रूहि तत्त्वेन लक्ष्मण । पश्यामि त्वां न च स्वस्थमपि क्षेमं महीपतेः ।। 7.47.8 ।।
transliteration: kimidaṃ nāvagacchāmi brūhi tattvena lakṣmaṇa | paśyāmi tvāṃ na ca svasthamapi kṣemaṃ mahīpateḥ || 7.47.8 ||
translation: किम् what, इदम् this, न not, अवगच्छामि I understand, ब्रूहि tell, तत्त्वेन truly, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, पश्यामि I see, त्वां you, न not, च and, स्वस्थम् well, अपि is it, क्षेमम् well-being, महीपतेः of the king.
explanation: O Lakshmana, I do not understand what this is; tell me the truth, for I see you are not well, and I wonder if the king is safe.

shloka_text: शापितो ऽसि नरेन्द्रेण यत्त्वं सन्तापमागतः । तद्ब्रूयाः सन्निधौ मह्यमहमाज्ञापयामि ते ।। 7.47.9 ।।
transliteration: śāpito 'si narendreṇa yattvaṃ santāpamāgataḥ | tadbrūyāḥ sannidhau mahyamahamājñāpayāmi te || 7.47.9 ||
translation: शापितः असि you have been cursed, नरेन्द्रेण by the king, यत् that, त्वम् you, सन्तापम् sorrow, आगतः have reached, तत् that, ब्रूयाः you should tell, सन्निधौ in the presence, मह्यम् to me, अहम् I, आज्ञापयामि command, ते you.
explanation: You must tell me in my presence if you have been cursed by the king, which has caused you such distress, for I command you to do so.

shloka_text: वैदेह्या चोद्यमानस्तु लक्ष्मणो दीनचेतनः । अवाङ्मुखो बाष्पकलं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.47.10 ।।
transliteration: vaidehyā codyamānastu lakṣmaṇo dīnacetanaḥ | avāṅmukho bāṣpakalaṃ vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.47.10 ||
translation: वैदेह्या by Vaidehi, चोद्यमानः being urged, तु but, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, दीनचेतनः with a sorrowful mind, अवाङ्मुखः with downcast face, बाष्पकलम् with choked voice, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच ह spoke.
explanation: Being urged by Sita, Lakshmana, with a sorrowful mind and downcast face, spoke these words in a voice choked with tears.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा परिषदो मध्ये ह्यपवादं सुदारुणम् । पुरे जनपदे चैव त्वत्कृते जनकात्मजे । रामः सन्तप्तहृदयो मा निवेद्य गृहं गतः ।। 7.47.11 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā pariṣado madhye hyapavādaṃ sudāruṇam | pure janapade caiva tvatkṛte janakātmaje | rāmaḥ santaptahṛdayo mā nivedya gṛhaṃ gataḥ || 7.47.11 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, परिषदः of the assembly, मध्ये in the midst, हि indeed, अपवादम् slander, सुदारुणम् very harsh, पुरे in the city, जनपदे in the countryside, च and, एव indeed, त्वत्कृते because of you, जनकात्मजे O daughter of Janaka, रामः Rama, सन्तप्तहृदयः with a tormented heart, मा me, निवेद्य having informed, गृहम् home, गतः went.
explanation: O daughter of Janaka, having heard a very harsh slander against you in the assembly, both in the city and the countryside, Rama, with a tormented heart, informed me and then went home.

shloka_text: न तानि वचनीयानि मया देवि तवाग्रतः । यानि राज्ञा हृदि न्यस्तान्यमर्षात्पृष्ठतः कृतः ।। 7.47.12 ।।
transliteration: na tāni vacanīyāni mayā devi tavāgrataḥ | yāni rājñā hṛdi nyastānyamarṣātpṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtaḥ || 7.47.12 ||
translation: न not, तानि those, वचनीयानि to be spoken, मया by me, देवि O Goddess, तवाग्रतः in front of you, यानि which, राज्ञा by the king, हृदि in the heart, न्यस्तानि placed, अमर्षात् due to public opinion, पृष्ठतः aside, कृतः made.
explanation: Lakshmana tells Sita that he cannot speak to her the words that King Rama has kept in his heart but has set aside due to public opinion.

shloka_text: सा त्वं त्यक्ता नृपतिना निर्दोषा मम सन्निधौ । पौरापवादभीतेन ग्राह्यं देवि न ते ऽन्यथा ।। 7.47.13 ।।
transliteration: sā tvaṃ tyaktā nṛpatinā nirdoṣā mama sannidhau | paurāpavādabhītena grāhyaṃ devi na te 'nyathā || 7.47.13 ||
translation: सा such, त्वं you, त्यक्ता abandoned, नृपतिना by the king, निर्दोषा faultless, मम my, सन्निधौ in the presence, पौरापवादभीतेन by one who fears the scandal of the citizens, ग्राह्यं to be accepted, देवि O Goddess, न not, ते by you, अन्यथा otherwise.
explanation: Lakshmana informs Sita that she, though faultless in his presence, has been abandoned by the king who fears public scandal, and this command must be accepted by her without question.

shloka_text: आश्रमान्तेषु च मया त्यक्तव्या त्वं भविष्यसि । राज्ञः शासनमाज्ञाय तवेदं किल दौर्हृदम् ।। 7.47.14 ।।
transliteration: āśramānteṣu ca mayā tyaktavyā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi | rājñaḥ śāsanamājñāya tavedaṃ kila daurhṛdam || 7.47.14 ||
translation: आश्रमान्तेषु at the borders of the hermitages, च and, मया by me, त्यक्तव्या to be abandoned, त्वं you, भविष्यसि will be, राज्ञः of the king, शासनम् command, आज्ञाय having known, तव your, इदं this, किल indeed, दौर्हृदम् longing.
explanation: Lakshmana further explains that he will abandon her at the borders of the hermitages, understanding that this is the king's command and also related to her longing for the forest.

shloka_text: तदेतज्जाह्नवीतीरे ब्रह्मर्षीणां तपोवनम् । पुण्यं च रमणीयं च मा विषादं कृथाः शुभे ।। 7.47.15 ।।
transliteration: tadetajjāhnavītīre brahmarṣīṇāṃ tapovanam | puṇyaṃ ca ramaṇīyaṃ ca mā viṣādaṃ kṛthāḥ śubhe || 7.47.15 ||
translation: तत् that, एतत् this, जाह्नवीतीरे on the bank of the Ganga, ब्रह्मर्षीणां of the Brahmarishis, तपोवनम् hermitage, पुण्यं sacred, च and, रमणीयं delightful, च and, मा do not, विषादं sorrow, कृथाः do, शुभे O auspicious one.
explanation: Lakshmana points out that this hermitage on the bank of the Ganga is sacred and delightful, belonging to Brahmarishis, and urges Sita, the auspicious one, not to despair.

shloka_text: राज्ञो दशरथस्येष्टः पितुर्मे मुनिपुङ्गवः । सखा परमको विप्रो वाल्मीकिः सुमहायशाः ।। 7.47.16 ।।
transliteration: rājño daśarathasyeṣṭaḥ piturme munipuṅgavaḥ | sakhā paramako vipro vālmīkiḥ sumahāyaśāḥ || 7.47.16 ||
translation: राज्ञः of the king, दशरथस्य Dasharatha, इष्टः dear, पितुः of the father, मे my, मुनिपुङ्गवः chief among sages, सखा friend, परमकः supreme, विप्रः Brahmin, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, सुमहायशाः very famous.
explanation: Lakshmana informs Sita that the highly renowned sage Valmiki, who is a dear and supreme friend to his father King Dasharatha, resides here.

shloka_text: पादच्छायामुपागम्य सुखमस्य महात्मनः । उपवासपरैकाग्रा वस त्वं जनकात्मजे ।। 7.47.17 ।।
transliteration: pādacchāyāmupāgamya sukhamasya mahātmanaḥ | upavāsaparaikāgrā vasa tvaṃ janakātmaje || 7.47.17 ||
translation: पादच्छायाम् in the shade of the feet, उपागम्य having approached, सुखम् happily, अस्य of this, महात्मनः great soul, उपवासपरैकाग्रा intent on fasting and concentrated, वस dwell, त्वम् you, जनकात्मजे O daughter of Janaka.
explanation: O daughter of Janaka, you should dwell happily and with focused devotion to fasting in the shade of this great soul (Valmiki).

shloka_text: पतिव्रतात्वमास्थाय रामं कृत्वा सदा हृदि । श्रेयस्ते परमं देवि तथा कृत्वा भविष्यति ।। 7.47.18 ।।
transliteration: pativratātvamāsthāya rāmaṃ kṛtvā sadā hṛdi | śreyaste paramaṃ devi tathā kṛtvā bhaviṣyati || 7.47.18 ||
translation: पतिव्रतात्वम् the state of being a devoted wife, आस्थाय having adopted, रामम् Rama, कृत्वा having placed, सदा always, हृदि in the heart, श्रेयः ultimate good, ते your, परमम् supreme, देवि O goddess, तथा thus, कृत्वा having done, भविष्यति will be.
explanation: O goddess, by adopting the state of a devoted wife and always keeping Rama in your heart, your supreme welfare will be achieved. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तचत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 47 ।। Thus ends the forty-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा दारुणं जनकात्मजा । परं विषादमागम्य वैदेही निपपात ह ।। 7.48.1 ।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā dāruṇaṃ janakātmajā | paraṃ viṣādamāgamya vaidehī nipapāta ha || 7.48.1 ||
translation: लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, दारुणम् harsh, जनकात्मजा the daughter of Janaka, परम् extreme, विषादम् sorrow, आगम्य having obtained, वैदेही Vaidehi, निपपात fell down, ह indeed.
explanation: Having heard Lakshmana's harsh words, Sita, the daughter of Janaka, was overcome with extreme sorrow and fell to the ground.
comments: Hearing this, Sita swoons and laments her cruel fate, yet resolves not to drown herself lest Rama's line be mocked -- through Lakshmana she sends her obeisance to her mothers-in-law and a message bidding Rama treat his subjects as he treats his brothers, for that is his supreme duty -- unable to speak, Lakshmana salutes her, recrosses the Ganga, and departs as Sita weeps alone in the forest.

shloka_text: सा मुहूर्तमिवासञ्ज्ञा बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा । लक्ष्मणं दीनया वाचा उवाच जनकात्मजा ।। 7.48.2 ।।
transliteration: sā muhūrtamivāsañjñā bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇā | lakṣmaṇaṃ dīnayā vācā uvāca janakātmajā || 7.48.2 ||
translation: सा she, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, इव as if, असञ्ज्ञा unconscious, बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा with eyes agitated by tears, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, दीनया with a piteous, वाचा voice, उवाच spoke, जनकात्मजा the daughter of Janaka.
explanation: For a moment, she lay as if unconscious, her eyes agitated with tears, and then the daughter of Janaka spoke to Lakshmana in a piteous voice.

shloka_text: मामिकेयं तनुर्नूनं सृष्टा दुःखाय लक्ष्मण । धात्रा यस्यास्तथा मे ऽद्य दुःखमूर्तिः प्रदृश्यते ।। 7.48.3 ।।
transliteration: māmikeyaṃ tanurnūnaṃ sṛṣṭā duḥkhāya lakṣmaṇa | dhātrā yasyāstathā me 'dya duḥkhamūrtiḥ pradṛśyate || 7.48.3 ||
translation: मामिकेयम् this my, तनुः body, नूनम् surely, सृष्टा created, दुःखाय for sorrow, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, धात्रा by the creator, यस्याः whose, तथा thus, मे my, अद्य today, दुःखमूर्तिः the very embodiment of sorrow, प्रदृश्यते is seen.
explanation: O Lakshmana, this body of mine was surely created by the creator for sorrow, as today it appears to me as the very embodiment of suffering.

shloka_text: किं नु पापं कृतं पूर्वं को वा दारैर्वियोजितः । या ऽहं शुद्धसमाचारा त्यक्ता नृपतिना सती ।। 7.48.4 ।।
transliteration: kiṃ nu pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ ko vā dārairviyojitaḥ | yā 'haṃ śuddhasamācārā tyaktā nṛpatinā satī || 7.48.4 ||
translation: किं what, नु indeed, पापं sin, कृतं done, पूर्वं previously, को who, वा or, दारैः from wives, वियोजितः separated, या who, अहं I, शुद्धसमाचारा of pure conduct, त्यक्ता abandoned, नृपतिना by the king, सती a chaste woman.
explanation: What sin did I commit previously, or whom did I separate from his wife, that I, a chaste woman of pure conduct, have been abandoned by the king?

shloka_text: पुरा ऽहमाश्रमे वासं रामपादानुवर्तिनी । अनुरुध्यापि सौमित्रे दुःखे च परिवर्तिनी ।। 7.48.5 ।।
transliteration: purā 'hamāśrame vāsaṃ rāmapādānuvartinī | anurudhyāpi saumitre duḥkhe ca parivartinī || 7.48.5 ||
translation: पुरा formerly, अहं I, आश्रमे in the hermitage, वासं dwelling, रामपादानुवर्तिनी following Rama's feet, अनुरुध्यापि even though I followed, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, दुःखे in sorrow, च and, परिवर्तिनी remaining.
explanation: O son of Sumitra, formerly I dwelt in the hermitage, devoted to Rama, and even though I followed him, I remained in sorrow.

shloka_text: सा कथं ह्याश्रमे सौम्य वत्स्यामि विजनीकृता । आख्यास्यामि च कस्याहं दुःखं दुःखपरायणा ।। 7.48.6 ।।
transliteration: sā kathaṃ hyāśrame saumya vatsyāmi vijanīkṛtā | ākhyāsyāmi ca kasyāhaṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhaparāyaṇā || 7.48.6 ||
translation: सा such a one, कथं how, हि indeed, आश्रमे in the hermitage, सौम्य O gentle one, वत्स्यामि shall I live, विजनीकृता made desolate, आख्यास्यामि shall I tell, च and, कस्य to whom, अहं I, दुःखं sorrow, दुःखपरायणा full of sorrow.
explanation: O gentle one, how shall I, made desolate, indeed live in the hermitage, and to whom shall I, full of sorrow, tell my grief?

shloka_text: किं नु वक्ष्यामि मुनिषु कर्म वा सत्कृतं च किम् । कस्मिंश्चित् कारणे त्यक्ता राघवेण महात्मना ।। 7.48.7 ।।
transliteration: kiṃ nu vakṣyāmi muniṣu karma vā satkṛtaṃ ca kim | kasmiṃścit kāraṇe tyaktā rāghaveṇa mahātmanā || 7.48.7 ||
translation: किं what, नु indeed, वक्ष्यामि shall I say, मुनिषु among the sages, कर्म deed, वा or, सत्कृतं good, च and, किम् what, कस्मिंश्चित् for some, कारणे reason, त्यक्ता abandoned, राघवेण by Raghava, महात्मना by the great-souled one.
explanation: What indeed shall I say among the sages, or what good deed have I done, that I have been abandoned by the great-souled Raghava for some reason?

shloka_text: न खल्वद्यैव सौमित्रे जीवितं जाह्नवीजले । त्यजेयं राजवंशस्तु भर्तुर्मे परिहास्यते ।। 7.48.8 ।।
transliteration: na khalvadyaiva saumitre jīvitaṃ jāhnavījale | tyajeyaṃ rājavaṃśastu bharturme parihāsyate || 7.48.8 ||
translation: न not, खलु indeed, अद्यैव just today, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, जीवितं life, जाह्नवीजले in the waters of the Ganga, त्यजेयं I would abandon, राजवंशः the royal lineage, तु but, भर्तुः of my husband, मे my, परिहास्यते will be ridiculed.
explanation: O son of Sumitra, I would indeed not abandon my life in the waters of the Ganga just today, but my husband's royal lineage would be ridiculed.

shloka_text: यथाज्ञं कुरु सोमित्रे त्यज मां दुःखभागिनीम् । निदेशे स्थीयतां राज्ञः शृणु चेदं वचो मम ।। 7.48.9 ।।
transliteration: yathājñaṃ kuru somitre tyaja māṃ duḥkhabhāginīm | nideśe sthīyatāṃ rājñaḥ śṛṇu cedaṃ vaco mama || 7.48.9 ||
translation: यथाज्ञं as commanded, कुरु do, सोमित्रे O son of Sumitra, त्यज abandon, मां me, दुःखभागिनीम् one destined for sorrow, निदेशे in the command, स्थीयतां remain, राज्ञः of the king, शृणु listen, च and, इदं this, वचो word, मम my.
explanation: O Lakshmana, do as commanded, abandon me, who is destined for sorrow, remain steadfast in the king's command, and listen to these words of mine.

shloka_text: श्वश्रूणामविशेषेण प्राञ्जलिप्रग्रहेण च । शिरसा ऽ ऽवन्द्य चरणौ कुशलं ब्रूहि पार्थिवम् ।। 7.48.10 ।।
transliteration: śvaśrūṇāmaviśeṣeṇa prāñjalipragraheṇa ca | śirasā ' 'vandya caraṇau kuśalaṃ brūhi pārthivam || 7.48.10 ||
translation: श्वश्रूणाम् of the mothers-in-law, अविशेषेण without distinction, प्राञ्जलिप्रग्रहेण with folded hands and reverence, च and, शिरसा with the head, आवन्द्य having bowed down, चरणौ the feet, कुशलं well-being, ब्रूहि tell, पार्थिवम् to the king.
explanation: Convey my respects to all mothers-in-law without distinction, and bowing down to the king's feet with folded hands and reverence, tell him of my well-being.

shloka_text: शिरसा ऽभिनतो ब्रूयाः सर्वासामेव लक्ष्मण । वक्तव्यश्चापि नृपतिर्धर्मेषु सुसमाहितः ।। 7.48.11 ।।
transliteration: śirasā 'bhinato brūyāḥ sarvāsāmeva lakṣmaṇa | vaktavyaścāpi nṛpatirdharmeṣu susamāhitaḥ || 7.48.11 ||
translation: शिरसा with the head, अभिनतो having bowed down, ब्रूयाः you should say, सर्वासाम् of all, एव indeed, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, वक्तव्यः should be told, च and, अपि also, नृपतिः the king, धर्मेषु in duties, सुसमाहितः well-focused.
explanation: O Lakshmana, you should convey my respects to all (mothers-in-law) by bowing your head, and also tell the king to remain steadfast in his duties of righteousness.

shloka_text: जानासि च यथा शुद्धा सीता तत्त्वेन राघव । भक्त्या च परया युक्ता हिता च तव नित्यशः ।। 7.48.12 ।।
transliteration: jānāsi ca yathā śuddhā sītā tattvena rāghava | bhaktyā ca parayā yuktā hitā ca tava nityaśaḥ || 7.48.12 ||
translation: जानासि you know, च and, यथा how, शुद्धा pure, सीता Sita, तत्त्वेन in reality, राघव O Rama, भक्त्या with devotion, च and, परया supreme, युक्ता endowed, हिता beneficial, च and, तव to you, नित्यशः always.
explanation: O Rama, you truly know how pure Sita is, and how she is always endowed with supreme devotion and is beneficial to you.

shloka_text: अहं त्यक्ता त्वया वीर अयशोभीरुणा जने । यच्च ते वचनीयं स्यादपवादसमुत्थितम् । मया च परिहर्तव्यं त्वं हि मे परमा गतिः ।। 7.48.13 ।।
transliteration: ahaṃ tyaktā tvayā vīra ayaśobhīruṇā jane | yacca te vacanīyaṃ syādapavādasamutthitam | mayā ca parihartavyaṃ tvaṃ hi me paramā gatiḥ || 7.48.13 ||
translation: अहं I, त्यक्ता abandoned, त्वया by you, वीर O hero, अयशोभीरुणा by one fearful of ill-repute, जने among people, यत् whatever, च and, ते to you, वचनीयं blame, स्यात् may be, अपवादसमुत्थितम् arising from slander, मया by me, च and, परिहर्तव्यं should be endured, त्वं you, हि indeed, मे my, परमा ultimate, गतिः refuge.
explanation: O hero, I have been abandoned by you, who fears ill-repute among people; whatever blame arises from public criticism, I shall endure it, for you are indeed my ultimate refuge.

shloka_text: वक्तव्यश्चेति नृपतिर्धमेण सुसमाहितः । यथा भ्रातृषु वर्तेथास्तथा पौरेषु नित्यदा ।। 7.48.14 ।।
transliteration: vaktavyaśceti nṛpatirdhameṇa susamāhitaḥ | yathā bhrātṛṣu vartethāstathā paureṣu nityadā || 7.48.14 ||
translation: वक्तव्यः should be told, च and, इति thus, नृपतिः the king, धर्मेण righteously, सुसमाहितः well-composed, यथा as, भ्रातृषु towards brothers, वर्तेथाः you should behave, तथा similarly, पौरेषु towards citizens, नित्यदा always.
explanation: The king should be told, with a composed mind and righteously, that he should always behave towards his citizens just as he behaves towards his brothers.

shloka_text: परमो ह्येष धर्मस्ते तस्मात्कीर्तिरनुत्तमा ।। 7.48.15 ।।
transliteration: paramo hyeṣa dharmaste tasmātkīrtiranuttamā || 7.48.15 ||
translation: परमः supreme, हि indeed, एषः this, धर्मः duty, ते your, तस्मात् therefore, कीर्तिः fame, अनुत्तमा unsurpassed.
explanation: Indeed, this is your supreme duty, and from it comes unsurpassed fame.

shloka_text: यत्तु पौरजनो राजन्धर्मेण समवाप्नुयात् । अहं तु नानुशोचामि स्वशरीरं नरर्षभ ।। 7.48.16 ।।
transliteration: yattu paurajano rājandharmeṇa samavāpnuyāt | ahaṃ tu nānuśocāmi svaśarīraṃ nararṣabha || 7.48.16 ||
translation: यत् what, तु but, पौरजनः the citizens, राजन् O King, धर्मेण righteously, समवाप्नुयात् may obtain, अहम् I, तु but, न not, अनुशोचामि grieve for, स्वशरीरम् my own body, नरर्षभ O best among men.
explanation: O King, whatever the citizens may righteously obtain, I, O best among men, do not grieve for my own body.

shloka_text: यथापवादं पौराणां तथैव रघुनन्दन । पतिर्हि देवता नार्याः पतिर्बन्धुः पतिर्गुरुः ।। 7.48.17 ।।
transliteration: yathāpavādaṃ paurāṇāṃ tathaiva raghunandana | patirhi devatā nāryāḥ patirbandhuḥ patirguruḥ || 7.48.17 ||
translation: यथापवादम् according to the slander, पौराणाम् of the citizens, तथैव similarly, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, पतिः husband, हि indeed, देवता deity, नार्याः of a woman, पतिः husband, बन्धुः relative, पतिः husband, गुरुः preceptor.
explanation: O delight of the Raghus, act according to the citizens' slander, for indeed, a husband is a woman's deity, her relative, and her preceptor.

shloka_text: प्राणैरपि प्रियं तस्माद्भर्तुः कार्यं विशेषतः । इति मद्वचनाद्रामो वक्तव्यो मम सङ्ग्रहः । निरीक्ष्य मा ऽद्य गच्छ त्वमृतुकालातिवर्तिनीम् ।। 7.48.18 ।।
transliteration: prāṇairapi priyaṃ tasmādbhartuḥ kāryaṃ viśeṣataḥ | iti madvacanādrāmo vaktavyo mama saṅgrahaḥ | nirīkṣya mā 'dya gaccha tvamṛtukālātivartinīm || 7.48.18 ||
translation: प्राणैः than life, अपि even, प्रियम् dear, तस्मात् therefore, भर्तुः of the husband, कार्यम् duty, विशेषतः especially, इति thus, मद्वचनात् from my words, रामः Rama, वक्तव्यः should be told, मम my, सङ्ग्रहः message, निरीक्ष्य having seen, मा me, अद्य today, गच्छ go, त्वम् you, ऋतुकलातिवर्तिनीम् one who has passed the time of menstruation.
explanation: Therefore, the husband's duty is dearer even than life, and thus, Rama should be told this message from me: "Having seen me today, who has passed the time of menstruation (i.e., pregnant), you may go."

shloka_text: एवं ब्रुवन्त्यां सीतायां लक्ष्मणो दीनचेतनः । शिरसा ऽ ऽवन्द्य धरणीं व्याहर्तुं न शशाक ह ।। 7.48.19 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ bruvantyāṃ sītāyāṃ lakṣmaṇo dīnacetanaḥ | śirasā ' 'vandya dharaṇīṃ vyāhartuṃ na śaśāka ha || 7.48.19 ||
translation: एवं thus, ब्रुवन्त्यां while speaking, सीतायां Sita, लक्ष्मणो Lakshmana, दीनचेतनः with a sorrowful mind, शिरसा with his head, आवन्द्य having bowed down, धरणीं to the earth, व्याहर्तुं to speak, न not, शशाक was able, ह indeed.
explanation: While Sita was speaking thus, Lakshmana, with a distressed mind, bowed his head to the earth and was unable to utter a word.

shloka_text: प्रदक्षिणं च तां कृत्वा रुदन्नेव महास्वनः । ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं तामाह किं मां वक्ष्यसि शोभने ।। 7.48.20 ।।
transliteration: pradakṣiṇaṃ ca tāṃ kṛtvā rudanneva mahāsvanaḥ | dhyātvā muhūrtaṃ tāmāha kiṃ māṃ vakṣyasi śobhane || 7.48.20 ||
translation: प्रदक्षिणं circumambulation, च and, तां her, कृत्वा having done, रुदन्नेव weeping indeed, महास्वनः with a loud sound, ध्यात्वा having thought, मुहूर्तं for a moment, तामाह to her he said, किं what, मां to me, वक्ष्यसि will you say, शोभने O beautiful one.
explanation: Having circumambulated her and weeping loudly, he pondered for a moment and then said to her, "O beautiful one, what will you say to me?"

shloka_text: दृष्टपूर्वं न ते रूपं पादौ दृष्टौ तवानघे । कथमत्र हि पश्यामि रामेण रहितां वने ।। 7.48.21 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ na te rūpaṃ pādau dṛṣṭau tavānaghe | kathamatra hi paśyāmi rāmeṇa rahitāṃ vane || 7.48.21 ||
translation: दृष्टपूर्वं seen before, न not, ते your, रूपं form, पादौ feet, दृष्टौ seen, तवानघे your, O sinless one, कथम् how, अत्र here, हि indeed, पश्यामि I see, रामेण by Rama, रहितां separated, वने in the forest.
explanation: "Your face has never been seen by me before, only your feet, O sinless one; how then can I look upon you here in the forest, separated from Rama?"

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा तां नमस्कृत्य पुनर्नावमुपारुहत् । आरुह्य च पुनर्नावं नाविकं चाभ्यचोदयत् ।। 7.48.22 ।।
transliteration: ityuktvā tāṃ namaskṛtya punarnāvamupāruhat | āruhya ca punarnāvaṃ nāvikaṃ cābhyacodayat || 7.48.22 ||
translation: इत्युक्त्वा having said thus, तां her, नमस्कृत्य having saluted, पुनर् again, नावम् boat, उपारुहत् he ascended, आरुह्य having boarded, च and, पुनर् again, नावम् boat, नाविकं boatman, च and, अभ्यचोदयत् he urged.
explanation: Having spoken thus and saluted her, he boarded the boat again, and having re-boarded the boat, he urged the boatman to proceed.

shloka_text: स गत्वा चोत्तरं तीरं शोकभारसमन्वितः । सम्मूढ इव दुःखेन रथमध्यारुहद्द्रुतम् ।। 7.48.23 ।।
transliteration: sa gatvā cottaraṃ tīraṃ śokabhārasamanvitaḥ | sammūḍha iva duḥkhena rathamadhyāruhaddrutam || 7.48.23 ||
translation: स he, गत्वा having gone, च and, उत्तरं northern, तीरं bank, शोकभारसमन्वितः overwhelmed by the burden of sorrow, सम्मूढ bewildered, इव as if, दुःखेन by sorrow, रथम् chariot, अध्यारुहत् he ascended, द्रुतम् quickly.
explanation: Having reached the northern bank, he, overwhelmed by the burden of sorrow and as if bewildered by distress, quickly mounted the chariot.

shloka_text: मुहुर्मुहुः परावृत्य दृष्ट्वा सीतामनाथवत् । चेष्टन्तीं परतीरस्थां लक्ष्मणः प्रययावथ ।। 7.48.24 ।।
transliteration: muhurmuhuḥ parāvṛtya dṛṣṭvā sītāmanāthavat | ceṣṭantīṃ paratīrasthāṃ lakṣmaṇaḥ prayayāvatha || 7.48.24 ||
translation: मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, परावृत्य having turned back, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सीताम् Sita, अनाथवत् like one without a protector, चेष्टन्तीम् struggling, परतीरस्थाम् standing on the other bank, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, प्रययाव departed, अथ then.
explanation: Lakshmana, having repeatedly turned back to see Sita struggling helplessly on the other bank, then departed.

shloka_text: दूरस्थं रथमालोक्य लक्ष्मणं च मुहूर्मुहुः । निरीक्षमाणां तूद्विग्नां सीतां शोकः समाविशत् ।। 7.48.25 ।।
transliteration: dūrasthaṃ rathamālokya lakṣmaṇaṃ ca muhūrmuhuḥ | nirīkṣamāṇāṃ tūdvignāṃ sītāṃ śokaḥ samāviśat || 7.48.25 ||
translation: दूरस्थम् far away, रथम् chariot, आलोक्य having seen, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, च and, मुहूर्मुहुः again and again, निरीक्षमाणाम् looking at, तु indeed, उद्विग्नाम् agitated, सीताम् Sita, शोकः sorrow, समाविशत् overwhelmed.
explanation: As Sita, agitated, repeatedly looked at the chariot and Lakshmana moving far away, sorrow overwhelmed her.

shloka_text: सा दुःखभारावनता यशस्विनी यशोधना नाथमपश्यती सती । रुरोद सा बर्हिणनादिते वने महास्वनं दुःखपरायणा सती ।। 7.48.26 ।।
transliteration: sā duḥkhabhārāvanatā yaśasvinī yaśodhanā nāthamapaśyatī satī | ruroda sā barhiṇanādite vane mahāsvanaṃ duḥkhaparāyaṇā satī || 7.48.26 ||
translation: सा she, दुःखभारावनता bowed down by the weight of sorrow, यशस्विनी glorious, यशोधना whose wealth is fame, नाथम् protector, अपश्यती not seeing, सती being, रुरोद cried, सा she, बर्हिणनादिते resounding with peacock cries, वने in the forest, महास्वनम् loudly, दुःखपरायणा immersed in sorrow, सती being.
explanation: She, glorious and renowned, bowed down by the immense sorrow and finding no protector, cried loudly in the forest filled with peacock calls, being utterly immersed in her grief. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टचत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 48 ।। Thus ends the forty-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: सीतां तु रुदतीं दृष्ट्वा ते तत्र मुनिदारकाः । प्राद्रवन्यत्र भगवानास्ते वाल्मीकिरुग्रधीः ।। 7.49.1 ।।
transliteration: sītāṃ tu rudatīṃ dṛṣṭvā te tatra munidārakāḥ | prādravanyatra bhagavānāste vālmīkirugradhīḥ || 7.49.1 ||
translation: सीताम् Sita, तु indeed, रुदतीम् crying, दृष्ट्वा having seen, ते those, तत्र there, मुनिदारकाः hermit boys, प्राद्रवन् ran, यत्र where, भगवान् revered, आस्ते resides, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, उग्रधीः of keen intellect.
explanation: Seeing Sita crying there, the hermit boys ran to where the revered Valmiki, of keen intellect, resided.
comments: The hermit-boys, finding the weeping Sita, run to tell Valmiki, who, knowing all by his ascetic vision, comes to her -- greeting her as Rama's pure and faultless queen and assuring her of her innocence, he takes her to his hermitage and entrusts her to the care of the female ascetics dwelling there.

shloka_text: अभिवाद्य मुनेः पादौ मुनिपुत्रा महर्षये । सर्वं निवेदयामासुस्तस्यास्तु रुदितस्वनम् ।। 7.49.2 ।।
transliteration: abhivādya muneḥ pādau muniputrā maharṣaye | sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsustasyāstu ruditasvanam || 7.49.2 ||
translation: अभिवाद्य having saluted, मुनेः of the sage, पादौ feet, मुनिपुत्राः hermit boys, महर्षये to the great sage, सर्वम् all, निवेदयामासुः reported, तस्याः her, तु indeed, रुदितस्वनम् sound of crying.
explanation: Having saluted the feet of the great sage, the hermit boys reported to him everything about her crying.

shloka_text: अदृष्टपूर्वा भगवन्कस्याप्येषा महात्मनः । पत्नी श्रीरिव सम्मोहाद्विरौति विकृतानना ।। 7.49.3 ।।
transliteration: adṛṣṭapūrvā bhagavankasyāpyeṣā mahātmanaḥ | patnī śrīriva sammohādvirauti vikṛtānanā || 7.49.3 ||
translation: अदृष्टपूर्वा never seen before, भगवन् O venerable one, कस्यापि of some, एषा this, महात्मनः great soul, पत्नी wife, श्रीरिव like Lakshmi, सम्मोहात् due to great distress, विरौति cries out, विकृतानना with a distorted face.
explanation: O venerable one, this woman, never seen before, the wife of some great soul, cries out with a distorted face as if Lakshmi herself were deluded and wailing.

shloka_text: भगवन्साधु पश्य त्वं देवतामिव खाच्च्युताम् । नद्यास्तु तीरे भगवन्वरस्त्री कापि दुःखिता ।। 7.49.4 ।।
transliteration: bhagavansādhu paśya tvaṃ devatāmiva khāccyutām | nadyāstu tīre bhagavanvarastrī kāpi duḥkhitā || 7.49.4 ||
translation: भगवन् O venerable one, साधु properly, पश्य behold, त्वं you, देवतामिव like a goddess, खात् from the sky, च्युताम् fallen, नद्यास्तु of the river, indeed, तीरे on the bank, भगवन् O venerable one, वरस्त्री an excellent woman, कापि some, दुःखिता distressed.
explanation: O venerable one, please observe carefully this excellent woman on the river bank, who appears distressed as if a goddess has fallen from the sky.

shloka_text: दृष्टास्माभिः प्ररुदिता दृढं शोकपरायणा । अनर्हा दुःखशोकाभ्यामेकां दीनां ह्यनाथवत् ।। 7.49.5 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭāsmābhiḥ praruditā dṛḍhaṃ śokaparāyaṇā | anarhā duḥkhaśokābhyāmekāṃ dīnāṃ hyanāthavat || 7.49.5 ||
translation: दृष्टा seen, अस्माभिः by us, प्ररुदिता weeping profusely, दृढं intensely, शोकपरायणा overcome by grief, अनर्हा undeserving, दुःखशोकाभ्याम् of sorrow and grief, एकां alone, दीनां miserable, हि indeed, अनाथवत् like an orphan.
explanation: We have seen her weeping profusely, intensely overcome by grief, alone and miserable like an orphan, though she is undeserving of such sorrow and grief.

shloka_text: न ह्येनां मानुषीं विद्मः सत्क्रिया ऽस्याः प्रयुज्यताम् । आश्रमस्याविदूरे च त्वामियं शरणं गता ।। 7.49.6 ।।
transliteration: na hyenāṃ mānuṣīṃ vidmaḥ satkriyā 'syāḥ prayujyatām | āśramasyāvidūre ca tvāmiyaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā || 7.49.6 ||
translation: न not, हि indeed, एनां her, मानुषीं a human woman, विद्मः we know, सत्क्रिया proper reception, अस्याः to her, प्रयुज्यताम् let it be offered, आश्रमस्य of the hermitage, अविदूरे near, च and, त्वाम् you, इयं this, शरणं refuge, गता has sought.
explanation: Indeed, we do not believe her to be a human woman, so let proper hospitality be offered to her, as she has come seeking refuge with you near the hermitage.

shloka_text: त्रातारमिच्छते साध्वी भगवंस्त्रातुमर्हसि । तेषां तु वचनं श्रुत्वा बुद्ध्या निश्चित्य धर्मवित् । तपसा लब्धचक्षुष्मान् प्राद्रवद्यत्र मैथिली ।। 7.49.7 ।।
transliteration: trātāramicchate sādhvī bhagavaṃstrātumarhasi | teṣāṃ tu vacanaṃ śrutvā buddhyā niścitya dharmavit | tapasā labdhacakṣuṣmān prādravadyatra maithilī || 7.49.7 ||
translation: त्रातारम् a protector, इच्छते desires, साध्वी the virtuous woman, भगवन् O venerable one, त्रातुम् to protect, अर्हसि you ought, तेषां their, तु indeed, वचनं words, श्रुत्वा having heard, बुद्ध्या with intellect, निश्चित्य having ascertained, धर्मवित् the knower of dharma, तपसा by asceticism, लब्धचक्षुष्मान् one who has gained spiritual sight, प्राद्रवत् rushed, यत्र where, मैथिली Maithili.
explanation: The virtuous woman desires a protector, O venerable one, and you ought to protect her; having heard their words, the knower of dharma, who had gained spiritual sight through asceticism, ascertained the situation with his intellect and rushed to where Maithili was.

shloka_text: तं प्रयान्तमभिप्रेत्य शिष्या ह्येनं महामतिम् । तं तु देशमभि प्रेत्य किञ्चित्पद्भ्यां महामतिः ।। 7.49.8 ।।
transliteration: taṃ prayāntamabhipretya śiṣyā hyenaṃ mahāmatim | taṃ tu deśamabhi pretya kiñcitpadbhyāṃ mahāmatiḥ || 7.49.8 ||
translation: तम् him, प्रयान्तम् going, अभिप्रेत्य having perceived, शिष्याः disciples, हि indeed, एनम् this, महामतिम् great-minded one (Valmiki); तम् that, तु but, देशम् place, अभि towards, प्रेत्य having gone, किञ्चित् a little, पद्भ्याम् by feet, महामतिः the great-minded one (Valmiki).
explanation: The great sage Valmiki, perceived by his disciples as he was departing, proceeded a short distance on foot towards a particular spot.

shloka_text: अर्घ्यमादाय रुचिरं जाह्नवीतीरमागमत् । ददर्श राघवस्येष्टां सीतां पत्नीमनाथवत् ।। 7.49.9 ।।
transliteration: arghyamādāya ruciraṃ jāhnavītīramāgamat | dadarśa rāghavasyeṣṭāṃ sītāṃ patnīmanāthavat || 7.49.9 ||
translation: अर्घ्यम् offering, आदाय having taken, रुचिरम् beautiful, जाह्नवीतीरम् the bank of the Ganga, आगमत् he came; ददर्श he saw, राघवस्य of Rama, इष्टाम् beloved, सीताम् Sita, पत्नीम् wife, अनाथवत् like one without a protector.
explanation: Having taken a beautiful offering, Valmiki arrived at the bank of the Ganga and there saw Sita, Rama's beloved wife, appearing helpless and unprotected.

shloka_text: तां सीतां शोकभारार्तां वाल्मीकिर्मुनिपुङ्गवः । उवाच मधुरां वाणीं ह्लादयन्निव तेजसा ।। 7.49.10 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ sītāṃ śokabhārārtāṃ vālmīkirmunipuṅgavaḥ | uvāca madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ hlādayanniva tejasā || 7.49.10 ||
translation: ताम् that, सीताम् Sita, शोकभारार्ताम् afflicted by the burden of sorrow, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages, उवाच he spoke, मधुराम् sweet, वाणीम् words, ह्लादयन् as if gladdening, इव as if, तेजसा with his spiritual radiance.
explanation: The foremost sage Valmiki spoke sweet words to that Sita, who was afflicted by the burden of sorrow, as if comforting her with his spiritual radiance.

shloka_text: स्नुषा दशरथस्य त्वं रामस्य महिषी प्रिया । जनकस्य सुता राज्ञः स्वागतं ते पतिव्रते ।। 7.49.11 ।।
transliteration: snuṣā daśarathasya tvaṃ rāmasya mahiṣī priyā | janakasya sutā rājñaḥ svāgataṃ te pativrate || 7.49.11 ||
translation: स्नुषा daughter-in-law, दशरथस्य of Dasharatha, त्वम् you, रामस्य of Rama, महिषी queen, प्रिया beloved, जनकस्य of Janaka, सुता daughter, राज्ञः of the king; स्वागतम् welcome, ते to you, पतिव्रते O chaste wife.
explanation: Valmiki addressed Sita, saying, "You are the daughter-in-law of Dasharatha, the beloved queen of Rama, and the daughter of King Janaka; welcome to you, O chaste wife."

shloka_text: आयान्ती चासि विज्ञाता मया धर्मसमाधिना । कारणं चैव सर्वं मे हृदयेनोपलक्षितम् ।। 7.49.12 ।।
transliteration: āyāntī cāsi vijñātā mayā dharmasamādhinā | kāraṇaṃ caiva sarvaṃ me hṛdayenopalakṣitam || 7.49.12 ||
translation: आयान्ती coming, च and, असि you are, विज्ञाता known, मया by me, धर्मसमाधिना through my meditation on dharma; कारणम् reason, च and, एव indeed, सर्वम् all, मे by me, हृदयेन by heart, उपलक्षितम् understood.
explanation: Valmiki further stated, "You, as you were coming, were known to me through my meditation on dharma, and indeed, all the reasons for your arrival have been discerned by my heart."

shloka_text: तव चैव महाभागे विदितं मम तत्त्वतः । सर्वं च विदितं मह्यं त्रैलोक्ये यद्धि वर्तते ।। 7.49.13 ।।
transliteration: tava caiva mahābhāge viditaṃ mama tattvataḥ | sarvaṃ ca viditaṃ mahyaṃ trailokye yaddhi vartate || 7.49.13 ||
translation: तव your, च and, एव indeed, महाभागे O highly fortunate one, विदितं known, मम to me, तत्त्वतः truly; सर्वं all, च and, विदितं known, मह्यं to me, त्रैलोक्ये in the three worlds, यत् whatever, हि indeed, वर्तते exists.
explanation: O highly fortunate one, your true nature is indeed known to me, and everything that exists in the three worlds is also known to me.

shloka_text: अपापां वेद्मि सीते त्वां तपोलब्धेन चक्षुषा । विस्रब्धा भव वैदेहि साम्प्रतं मयि वर्तसे ।। 7.49.14 ।।
transliteration: apāpāṃ vedmi sīte tvāṃ tapolabdhena cakṣuṣā | visrabdhā bhava vaidehi sāmprataṃ mayi vartase || 7.49.14 ||
translation: अपापां sinless, वेद्मि I know, सीते O Sita, त्वां you, तपोलब्धेन obtained through asceticism, चक्षुषा by the eye; विस्रब्धा confident, भव be, वैदेहि O Vaidehi, साम्प्रतं now, मयि in me, वर्तसे you reside.
explanation: O Sita, I know you to be sinless through the eye of wisdom gained by my penance; O Vaidehi, be confident, for you are now under my protection.

shloka_text: आश्रमस्याविदूरे मे तापस्यस्तपसि स्थिताः । तास्त्वां वत्से यथा वत्सं पालयिष्यन्ति नित्यशः ।। 7.49.15 ।।
transliteration: āśramasyāvidūre me tāpasyastapasi sthitāḥ | tāstvāṃ vatse yathā vatsaṃ pālayiṣyanti nityaśaḥ || 7.49.15 ||
translation: आश्रमस्य of the hermitage, अविदूरे not far, मे my, तापस्यः female ascetics, तपसि in penance, स्थिताः engaged; ताः they, त्वां you, वत्से O dear child, यथा as, वत्सं a calf, पालयिष्यन्ति will protect, नित्यशः always.
explanation: Not far from my hermitage, there are female ascetics engaged in penance, and they, O dear child, will always protect you as a mother protects her calf.

shloka_text: इदमर्ध्यं प्रतीच्छ त्वं विस्रब्धा विगतज्वरा । यथा स्वगृहमभ्येत्य विषादं चैव मा कृथाः ।। 7.49.16 ।।
transliteration: idamardhyaṃ pratīccha tvaṃ visrabdhā vigatajvarā | yathā svagṛhamabhyetya viṣādaṃ caiva mā kṛthāḥ || 7.49.16 ||
translation: इदं this, अर्ध्यं offering, प्रतीच्छ accept, त्वं you, विस्रब्धा confident, विगतज्वरा free from distress; यथा as if, स्वगृहं your own home, अभ्येत्य having reached, विषादं sorrow, च and, एव indeed, मा do not, कृथाः make.
explanation: Accept this offering, confident and free from distress, and do not feel any sorrow, as if you have come to your own home.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा तु भाषितं सीता मुनेः परममद्भुतम् । शिरसा ऽ ऽवन्द्य चरणौ तथेत्याह कृताञ्जलिः ।। 7.49.17 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu bhāṣitaṃ sītā muneḥ paramamadbhutam | śirasā ' 'vandya caraṇau tathetyāha kṛtāñjaliḥ || 7.49.17 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, भाषितं the words, सीता Sita, मुनेः of the sage, परमं supremely, अद्भुतम् wonderful; शिरसा with her head, आवन्द्य having bowed down to, चरणौ the two feet, तथा so be it, इति thus, आह said, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands.
explanation: Having heard the supremely wonderful words of the sage, Sita, with folded hands, bowed down to his feet with her head and said, "So be it."

shloka_text: तं प्रयान्तं मुनिं सीता प्राञ्जलिः पृष्ठतो ऽन्वगात् ।। 7.49.18 ।।
transliteration: taṃ prayāntaṃ muniṃ sītā prāñjaliḥ pṛṣṭhato 'nvagāt || 7.49.18 ||
translation: तम् him, प्रयान्तम् departing, मुनिम् sage, सीता Sita, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, पृष्ठतः from behind, अन्वगात् followed.
explanation: Sita, with folded hands, followed the departing sage from behind.

shloka_text: तं दृष्ट्वा मुनिमायान्तं वैदेह्या मुनिपत्नयः । उपाजग्मुर्मुदा युक्ता वचनं चेदमब्रुवन् ।। 7.49.19 ।।
transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā munimāyāntaṃ vaidehyā munipatnayaḥ | upājagmurmudā yuktā vacanaṃ cedamabruvan || 7.49.19 ||
translation: तम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, मुनिम् sage, आयान्तम् coming, वैदेह्या with Vaidehi, मुनिपत्नयः wives of sages, उपाजग्मुः approached, मुदा with joy, युक्ताः filled, वचनम् words, च and, इदम् these, अब्रुवन् spoke.
explanation: Seeing the sage approaching with Vaidehi, the wives of the sages, filled with joy, came forward and spoke these words.

shloka_text: स्वागतं ते मुनिश्रेष्ठ चिरस्यागमनं च ते । अभिवादयामस्त्वां सर्वा उच्यतां कि च कुर्महे ।। 7.49.20 ।।
transliteration: svāgataṃ te muniśreṣṭha cirasyāgamanaṃ ca te | abhivādayāmastvāṃ sarvā ucyatāṃ ki ca kurmahe || 7.49.20 ||
translation: स्वागतम् welcome, ते to you, मुनिश्रेष्ठ O best of sages, चिरस्य after a long time, आगमनम् arrival, च and, ते your, अभिवादयामः we salute, त्वाम् you, सर्वाः all, उच्यताम् tell us, किम् what, च and, कुर्महे we should do.
explanation: "Welcome to you, O best of sages; your arrival is after a long time; all of us salute you, please tell us what we should do."

shloka_text: तासां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वाल्मीकिरिदमब्रवीत् । सीतेयं समनुप्राप्ता पत्नी रामस्य धीमतः ।। 7.49.21 ।।
transliteration: tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vālmīkiridamabravīt | sīteyaṃ samanuprāptā patnī rāmasya dhīmataḥ || 7.49.21 ||
translation: तासाम् their, तत् that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke, सीता Sita, इयम् this, समनुप्राप्ता has arrived, पत्नी wife, रामस्य of Rama, धीमतः the wise.
explanation: Having heard their words, Valmiki spoke this: "This is Sita, the wife of the wise Rama, who has arrived."

shloka_text: स्नुषा दशरथस्यैषा जनकस्य सुता सती । अपापा पतिना त्यक्ता परिपाल्या मया सदा ।। 7.49.22 ।।
transliteration: snuṣā daśarathasyaiṣā janakasya sutā satī | apāpā patinā tyaktā paripālyā mayā sadā || 7.49.22 ||
translation: स्नुषा daughter-in-law, दशरथस्य of Dasharatha, एषा she, जनकस्य of Janaka, सुता daughter, सती chaste, अपापा sinless, पतिना by her husband, त्यक्ता abandoned, परिपाल्या to be protected, मया by me, सदा always.
explanation: "She is the daughter-in-law of Dasharatha and the chaste daughter of Janaka; though sinless, she has been abandoned by her husband and must always be protected by me."

shloka_text: इमां भवन्त्यः(?) पश्यन्तु स्नेहेन परमेण हि । गौरवान्मम वाक्याच्च पूज्या वो ऽस्तु विशेषतः ।। 7.49.23 ।।
transliteration: imāṃ bhavantyaḥ(?) paśyantu snehena parameṇa hi | gauravānmama vākyācca pūjyā vo 'stu viśeṣataḥ || 7.49.23 ||
translation: इमां her, भवन्त्यः you (feminine plural), पश्यन्तु may you regard, स्नेहेन with affection, परमेण supreme, हि indeed, गौरवात् out of respect, मम my, वाक्यात् from words, च and, पूज्या worthy of worship, वः for you, अस्तु let her be, विशेषतः especially.
explanation: Indeed, may you all regard her with supreme affection, and especially, let her be worthy of your reverence out of respect for my words.

shloka_text: मुहुर्मुहुश्च वैदेहीं प्रणिधाय महायशाः । स्वमाश्रमं शिष्यवृतः पुनरायान्महातपाः ।। 7.49.24 ।।
transliteration: muhurmuhuśca vaidehīṃ praṇidhāya mahāyaśāḥ | svamāśramaṃ śiṣyavṛtaḥ punarāyānmahātapāḥ || 7.49.24 ||
translation: मुहुर्मुहुः repeatedly, च and, वैदेहीं Vaidehi, प्रणिधाय having entrusted, महायशाः the greatly renowned, स्वम् his own, आश्रमं hermitage, शिष्यवृतः surrounded by disciples, पुनः again, आयात् returned, महातपाः the great ascetic.
explanation: And having repeatedly entrusted Vaidehi, the greatly renowned and great ascetic Valmiki, surrounded by his disciples, returned to his own hermitage. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोनपञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 49 ।। Thus ends the forty-ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा तु मैथिलीं सीतामाश्रमे सम्प्रवेशिताम् । सन्तापमगमद्घोरं लक्ष्मणो दीनचेतनः ।। 7.50.1 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tu maithilīṃ sītāmāśrame sampraveśitām | santāpamagamadghoraṃ lakṣmaṇo dīnacetanaḥ || 7.50.1 ||
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, तु indeed, मैथिलीं Maithili, सीताम् Sita, आश्रमे in the hermitage, सम्प्रवेशिताम् having been led in, सन्तापम् sorrow, अगमत् experienced, घोरम् terrible, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, दीनचेतनः with a distressed mind.
explanation: Indeed, having seen Maithili Sita led into the hermitage, Lakshmana, with a distressed mind, experienced terrible sorrow.
comments: Returning with Sumantra, Lakshmana laments Rama's sorrow and the cruelty of Sita's banishment over mere gossip -- Sumantra consoles him, revealing that this separation was long ago foretold to Dasharatha by sages as an inescapable destiny, and that Rama is fated even to part from his brothers in time -- Lakshmana asks to hear the whole prophecy.

shloka_text: अब्रवीच्च महातेजाः सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रसारथिम् । सीतासन्तापजं दुःखं पश्य रामस्य सारथे ।। 7.50.2 ।।
transliteration: abravīcca mahātejāḥ sumantraṃ mantrasārathim | sītāsantāpajaṃ duḥkhaṃ paśya rāmasya sārathe || 7.50.2 ||
translation: अब्रवीत् spoke, च and, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent, सुमन्त्रं to Sumantra, मन्त्रसारथिम् the wise charioteer, सीतासन्तापजं born of Sita's distress, दुःखं sorrow, पश्य behold, रामस्य of Rama, सारथे O charioteer.
explanation: And the greatly effulgent Lakshmana spoke to Sumantra, the wise charioteer, saying, 'O charioteer, behold Rama's sorrow born of Sita's distress!'

shloka_text: ततो दुःखतरं किं नु राघवस्य भविष्यति । पत्नीं शुद्धसमाचारां विसृज्य जनकात्मजाम् ।। 7.50.3 ।।
transliteration: tato duḥkhataraṃ kiṃ nu rāghavasya bhaviṣyati | patnīṃ śuddhasamācārāṃ visṛjya janakātmajām || 7.50.3 ||
translation: ततः than that, दुःखतरं more sorrowful, किं what, नु indeed, राघवस्य for Rama, भविष्यति will there be, पत्नीं wife, शुद्धसमाचारां of pure conduct, विसृज्य having abandoned, जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter.
explanation: Indeed, what could be more sorrowful for Rama than having abandoned his wife, Janaka's daughter, who is of pure conduct?

shloka_text: व्यक्तं दैवादहं मन्ये राघवस्य विना भवम् । वैदेह्या सारथे नित्यं दैवं हि दुरतिक्रमम् ।। 7.50.4 ।।
transliteration: vyaktaṃ daivādahaṃ manye rāghavasya vinā bhavam | vaidehyā sārathe nityaṃ daivaṃ hi duratikramam || 7.50.4 ||
translation: व्यक्तं clearly, दैवात् from destiny, अहं I, मन्ये believe, राघवस्य of Rama, विना without, भवम् being (separation), वैदेह्या from Vaidehi (Sita), सारथे O charioteer, नित्यं always, दैवं destiny, हि indeed, दुरतिक्रमम् insurmountable.
explanation: O charioteer, I clearly believe that Rama's separation from Sita is due to destiny, for destiny is always insurmountable.

shloka_text: यो हि देवान्सगन्धर्वानसुरान्सह राक्षसैः । निहन्याद्राघवः क्रुद्धः स दैवमनुवर्तते ।। 7.50.5 ।।
transliteration: yo hi devānsagandharvānasurānsaha rākṣasaiḥ | nihanyādrāghavaḥ kruddhaḥ sa daivamanuvartate || 7.50.5 ||
translation: यः who, हि indeed, देवान् gods, सगन्धर्वान् along with Gandharvas, असुरान् Asuras, सह with, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, निहन्यात् would kill, राघवः Rama, क्रुद्धः enraged, सः he, दैवम् destiny, अनुवर्तते follows.
explanation: Even Rama, who when enraged could indeed destroy gods, Gandharvas, Asuras, and Rakshasas, still follows destiny.

shloka_text: पुरा रामः पितुर्वाक्याद्दण्डके विजने वने । उषित्वा नव वर्षाणि पञ्च चैव महावने ।। 7.50.6 ।।
transliteration: purā rāmaḥ piturvākyāddaṇḍake vijane vane | uṣitvā nava varṣāṇi pañca caiva mahāvane || 7.50.6 ||
translation: पुरा formerly, रामः Rama, पितुः father's, वाक्यात् from command, दण्डके in Dandaka, विजने solitary, वने forest, उषित्वा having resided, नव nine, वर्षाणि years, पञ्च five, च and, एव indeed, महावने in the great forest.
explanation: Formerly, Rama, obeying his father's command, resided for fourteen years in the solitary Dandaka forest and other great forests.

shloka_text: ततो दुःखतरं भूयः सीताया विप्रवासनम् । पौराणां वचनं श्रुत्वा नृशंसं प्रतिभाति मे ।। 7.50.7 ।।
transliteration: tato duḥkhataraṃ bhūyaḥ sītāyā vipravāsanam | paurāṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā nṛśaṃsaṃ pratibhāti me || 7.50.7 ||
translation: ततः than that, दुःखतरं more sorrowful, भूयः again, सीतायाः of Sita, विप्रवासनम् banishment, पौराणां of the citizens, वचनं words, श्रुत्वा having heard, नृशंसं cruel, प्रतिभाति appears, मे to me.
explanation: Having heard the words of the citizens, Sita's banishment appears to me even more sorrowful than his previous sufferings, and indeed cruel.

shloka_text: को नु धर्माश्रयः सूत कर्मण्यस्मिन्यशोहरे । मैथिलीं प्रतिसम्प्राप्तः पौरैर्हीनार्थवादिभिः ।। 7.50.8 ।।
transliteration: ko nu dharmāśrayaḥ sūta karmaṇyasminyaśohare | maithilīṃ pratisamprāptaḥ paurairhīnārthavādibhiḥ || 7.50.8 ||
translation: कः what, नु indeed, धर्माश्रयः basis of righteousness, सूत O charioteer, कर्मणि in this act, अस्मिन् this, यशोहरे destroying fame, मैथिलीं regarding Maithili (Sita), प्रतिसम्प्राप्तः obtained (here, concerning), पौरैः by the citizens, हीनार्थवादिभिः speaking meaningless words.
explanation: O charioteer, what basis of righteousness is there in this act, which destroys fame, concerning Sita, especially when it is based on the meaningless words spoken by the citizens?

shloka_text: एता वाचो बहुविधाः श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणभाषिताः । सुमन्त्रः श्रद्धया प्राज्ञो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.50.9 ।।
transliteration: etā vāco bahuvidhāḥ śrutvā lakṣmaṇabhāṣitāḥ | sumantraḥ śraddhayā prājño vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.50.9 ||
translation: एताः these, वाचः words, बहुविधाः of many kinds, श्रुत्वा having heard, लक्ष्मणभाषिताः spoken by Lakshmana, सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, श्रद्धया with faith, प्राज्ञः wise, वाक्यम् statement, एतत् this, उवाच spoke, ह indeed
explanation: Having heard these various words spoken by Lakshmana, the wise Sumantra, with faith, indeed spoke this statement.

shloka_text: न सन्तापस्त्वया कार्यः सौमित्रे मैथिलीं प्रति । दृष्टमेतत्पुरा विप्रैः पितुस्ते लक्ष्मणाग्रतः ।। 7.50.10 ।।
transliteration: na santāpastvayā kāryaḥ saumitre maithilīṃ prati | dṛṣṭametatpurā vipraiḥ pituste lakṣmaṇāgrataḥ || 7.50.10 ||
translation: न not, सन्तापः sorrow, त्वया by you, कार्यः should be done, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra (Lakshmana), मैथिलीम् regarding Maithili (Sita), प्रति towards, दृष्टम् seen/foretold, एतत् this, पुरा formerly, विप्रैः by sages, पितुः of your father, ते your, लक्ष्मणाग्रतः in front of Lakshmana
explanation: O Lakshmana, you should not feel sorrow regarding Sita, for this very event was foretold long ago by sages in the presence of your father.

shloka_text: भविष्यति दृढं रामो दुःखप्रायो ऽपि सौख्यभाक् । प्राप्स्यते च महाबाहुर्विप्रयोगं प्रियैर्ध्रुवम् ।। 7.50.11 ।।
transliteration: bhaviṣyati dṛḍhaṃ rāmo duḥkhaprāyo 'pi saukhyabhāk | prāpsyate ca mahābāhurviprayogaṃ priyairdhruvam || 7.50.11 ||
translation: भविष्यति will be, दृढम् certainly, रामः Rama, दुःखप्रायः predominantly sorrowful, अपि even though, सौख्यभाक् partaker of happiness, प्राप्स्यते will obtain, च and, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, विप्रयोगम् separation, प्रियैः from dear ones, ध्रुवम् certainly
explanation: Rama, though predominantly sorrowful, will certainly experience happiness, and the mighty-armed one will undoubtedly face separation from his dear ones.

shloka_text: त्वां चैव मैथिलीं चैव शत्रुघ्नभरतावुभौ । सन्त्यजिष्यति धर्मात्मा कालेन महता महान् ।। 7.50.12 ।।
transliteration: tvāṃ caiva maithilīṃ caiva śatrughnabharatāvubhau | santyajiṣyati dharmātmā kālena mahatā mahān || 7.50.12 ||
translation: त्वाम् you, च and, एव indeed, मैथिलीम् Maithili (Sita), च and, एव indeed, शत्रुघ्नभरतौ Shatrughna and Bharata, उभौ both, सन्त्यजिष्यति will abandon, धर्मात्मा the righteous-souled one, कालेन by time, महता great/long, महान् the great one (Rama)
explanation: The great and righteous Rama will indeed abandon you, Maithili, and both Shatrughna and Bharata, after a long period of time.

shloka_text: इदं त्वयि न वक्तव्यं सौमित्रे भरते ऽपि वा । राज्ञा वो व्याहृतं वाक्यं दुर्वासा यदुवाच ह ।। 7.50.13 ।।
transliteration: idaṃ tvayi na vaktavyaṃ saumitre bharate 'pi vā | rājñā vo vyāhṛtaṃ vākyaṃ durvāsā yaduvāca ha || 7.50.13 ||
translation: इदम् this, त्वयि to you, न not, वक्तव्यम् to be spoken, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra (Lakshmana), भरते to Bharata, अपि even, वा or, राज्ञा by the king (Dasharatha), वः to you (plural), व्याहृतम् spoken, वाक्यम् words/statement, दुर्वासाः Durvasa (the sage), यत् which, उवाच spoke, ह indeed
explanation: O Lakshmana, this statement, which Durvasa indeed spoke to the king and which the king then spoke to you all, should not be revealed to you or even to Bharata.

shloka_text: महाजनसमीपे च मम चैव नरर्षभ । ऋषिणा व्याहृतं वाक्यं वसिष्ठस्य च सन्निधौ ।। 7.50.14 ।।
transliteration: mahājanasamīpe ca mama caiva nararṣabha | ṛṣiṇā vyāhṛtaṃ vākyaṃ vasiṣṭhasya ca sannidhau || 7.50.14 ||
translation: महाजनसमीपे in the presence of great people, च and, मम my, चैव and indeed, नरर्षभ O best among men, ऋषिणा by the sage, व्याहृतं spoken, वाक्यं statement, वसिष्ठस्य of Vasistha, च and, सन्निधौ in the presence.
explanation: O best among men, this statement was spoken by the sage (Valmiki) in a large gathering, in my presence, and also in the presence of Vasistha.

shloka_text: ऋषेस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा मामाह पुरुषर्षभः । सूत न क्वचिदेवं ते वक्तव्यं जनसन्निधौ ।। 7.50.15 ।।
transliteration: ṛṣestu vacanaṃ śrutvā māmāha puruṣarṣabhaḥ | sūta na kvacidevaṃ te vaktavyaṃ janasannidhau || 7.50.15 ||
translation: ऋषेस्तु but of the sage, वचनं statement, श्रुत्वा having heard, मामाह said to me, पुरुषर्षभः the best among men, सूत O charioteer, न not, क्वचिदेवं anywhere thus, ते by you, वक्तव्यं to be spoken, जनसन्निधौ in the presence of people.
explanation: Having heard the sage's words, the best among men (Rama) said to me, "O charioteer, you should never speak thus in the presence of people."

shloka_text: तस्याहं लोकपालस्य वाक्यं तत्सुसमाहितः । नैव जात्वनृतं कार्यमिति मे सौम्य दर्शनम् ।। 7.50.16 ।।
transliteration: tasyāhaṃ lokapālasya vākyaṃ tatsusamāhitaḥ | naiva jātvanṛtaṃ kāryamiti me saumya darśanam || 7.50.16 ||
translation: तस्याहं of him I, लोकपालस्य of the protector of the world, वाक्यं command, तत्सुसमाहितः that very carefully, नैव never indeed, जात्वनृतं ever untrue, कार्यमिति to be done thus, मे my, सौम्य O gentle one, दर्शनम् view.
explanation: O gentle one, I carefully consider that command of the protector of the world (Rama), for it is my view that one should never utter an untruth.

shloka_text: सर्वथैव न वक्तव्यं मया सौम्य तवाग्रतः । यदि ते श्रवणे श्रद्धा श्रूयतां रघुनन्दन ।। 7.50.17 ।।
transliteration: sarvathaiva na vaktavyaṃ mayā saumya tavāgrataḥ | yadi te śravaṇe śraddhā śrūyatāṃ raghunandana || 7.50.17 ||
translation: सर्वथैव in every way indeed, न not, वक्तव्यं to be spoken, मया by me, सौम्य O gentle one, तवाग्रतः in front of you, यदि if, ते your, श्रवणे in listening, श्रद्धा faith, श्रूयतां let it be heard, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: O gentle one, I should not speak of this in front of you at all; however, O delight of the Raghus, if you have faith in listening, then let it be heard.

shloka_text: यद्यप्यहं नरेन्द्रेण रहस्यं श्रावितः पुरा । तथाप्युदाहरिष्यामि दैवं हि दुरतिक्रमम् ।। 7.50.18 ।।
transliteration: yadyapyahaṃ narendreṇa rahasyaṃ śrāvitaḥ purā | tathāpyudāhariṣyāmi daivaṃ hi duratikramam || 7.50.18 ||
translation: यद्यप्यहं although I, नरेन्द्रेण by the king, रहस्यं secret, श्रावितः made to hear, पुरा formerly, तथाप्युदाहरिष्यामि nevertheless I will narrate, दैवं destiny, हि indeed, दुरतिक्रमम् difficult to overcome.
explanation: Although the king (Rama) previously told me this secret, I will nevertheless narrate it, for destiny is indeed difficult to overcome.

shloka_text: येनेदमीदृशं प्राप्तं दुःखं शोकसमन्वितम् । न त्वया भरते वाच्यं शत्रुघ्नस्यापि सन्निधौ ।। 7.50.19 ।।
transliteration: yenedamīdṛśaṃ prāptaṃ duḥkhaṃ śokasamanvitam | na tvayā bharate vācyaṃ śatrughnasyāpi sannidhau || 7.50.19 ||
translation: येन by whom, इदम् this, ईदृशम् such, प्राप्तम् obtained, दुःखम् sorrow, शोकसमन्वितम् accompanied by grief, न not, त्वया by you, भरते to Bharata, वाच्यम् to be spoken, शत्रुघ्नस्यापि even in Shatrughna's, सन्निधौ presence,
explanation: This sorrow, accompanied by grief, which has been experienced, should not be spoken of by you to Bharata, nor even in the presence of Shatrughna.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा भाषितं तस्य गम्भीरार्थपदं महत् । तथ्यं ब्रूहीति सौमित्रिः सूतं वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।। 7.50.20 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā bhāṣitaṃ tasya gambhīrārthapadaṃ mahat | tathyaṃ brūhīti saumitriḥ sūtaṃ vākyamathābravīt || 7.50.20 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, भाषितम् speech, तस्य his, गम्भीरार्थपदम् having profound meaning in words, महत् great, तथ्यम् the truth, ब्रूहि tell, इति thus, सौमित्रिः Saumitri, सूतम् to the charioteer, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke,
explanation: Having heard his profound and significant words, Lakshmana then spoke to the charioteer, saying, "Tell me the truth.". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 50 ।। Thus ends the fiftieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तथा सञ्चोदितः सूतो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना । तद्वाक्यमृषिणा प्रोक्तं व्याहर्तुमुपचक्रमे ।। 7.51.1 ।।
transliteration: tathā sañcoditaḥ sūto lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā | tadvākyamṛṣiṇā proktaṃ vyāhartumupacakrame || 7.51.1 ||
translation: तथा thus, सञ्चोदितः urged, सूतः the charioteer, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, महात्मना by the great-souled, तत् that, वाक्यम् words, ऋषिणा by the sage, प्रोक्तम् spoken, व्याहर्तुम् to narrate, उपचक्रमे began,
explanation: Thus urged by the great-souled Lakshmana, the charioteer began to narrate the words spoken by the sage.
comments: Sumantra recounts the prophecy of the sage Durvasa to Dasharatha: that Rama was Vishnu, fated through Bhrigu's ancient curse to suffer separation from his wife, to rule eleven thousand years and perform many sacrifices, to beget two sons by Sita born away from Ayodhya, and at last to return to Brahma's world -- consoled by this, Lakshmana halts for the night at Keshini.

shloka_text: पुरा नाम्ना हि दुर्वासा अत्रेः पुत्रो महामुनिः । वसिष्ठस्याश्रमे पुण्ये वार्षिक्यं समुवास ह ।। 7.51.2 ।।
transliteration: purā nāmnā hi durvāsā atreḥ putro mahāmuniḥ | vasiṣṭhasyāśrame puṇye vārṣikyaṃ samuvāsa ha || 7.51.2 ||
translation: पुरा formerly, नाम्ना by name, हि indeed, दुर्वासा Durvasa, अत्रेः of Atri, पुत्रः son, महामुनिः great sage, वसिष्ठस्य of Vasishtha, आश्रमे in the hermitage, पुण्ये sacred, वार्षिक्यम् the rainy season, समुवास resided, ह indeed,
explanation: Formerly, a great sage named Durvasa, the son of Atri, resided in the sacred hermitage of Vasishtha during the rainy season.

shloka_text: तमाश्रमं महातेजाः पिता ते सुमहायशाः । पुरोहितं महात्मानं दिदृक्षुरगमस्त्वयम् ।। 7.51.3 ।।
transliteration: tamāśramaṃ mahātejāḥ pitā te sumahāyaśāḥ | purohitaṃ mahātmānaṃ didṛkṣuragamastvayam || 7.51.3 ||
translation: तम् that, आश्रमम् hermitage, महातेजाः highly effulgent, पिता father, ते your, सुमहायशाः very famous, पुरोहितम् the priest, महात्मानम् the great-souled, दिदृक्षुः desirous of seeing, अगमत् went, अयम् this one,
explanation: Your highly effulgent and very famous father went to that hermitage, desirous of seeing the great-souled priest.

shloka_text: स दृष्ट्वा सूर्यसङ्काशं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा । उपविष्टं वसिष्ठस्य सव्यपार्श्वे महामुनिम् ।। 7.51.4 ।।
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā sūryasaṅkāśaṃ jvalantamiva tejasā | upaviṣṭaṃ vasiṣṭhasya savyapārśve mahāmunim || 7.51.4 ||
translation: सः He, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सूर्यसङ्काशं sun-like, ज्वलन्तम् blazing, इव as if, तेजसा with splendor, उपविष्टं seated, वसिष्ठस्य of Vasistha, सव्यपार्श्वे on the left side, महामुनिम् the great sage.
explanation: He (Rama) saw the great sage, who resembled the sun and blazed with splendor, seated on the left side of Vasistha.

shloka_text: तौ मुनी तापसश्रेष्ठौ विनीतो ह्यभिवादयत् । स ताभ्यां पूजितो राजा स्वागतेनासनेन च ।।
transliteration: tau munī tāpasaśreṣṭhau vinīto hyabhivādayat | sa tābhyāṃ pūjito rājā svāgatenāsanena ca ||
translation: तौ those two, मुनी sages, तापसश्रेष्ठौ best among ascetics, विनीतः humbly, हि indeed, अभिवादयत् greeted. सः He, ताभ्यां by those two, पूजितः honored, राजा the king, स्वागतेन with welcome, आसनेन with a seat, च and.
explanation: The king (Rama) humbly greeted those two sages, the best among ascetics, and was honored by them with a welcome and a seat.

shloka_text: पाद्येन फलमूलैश्च उवास मुनिभिः सह ।। 7.51.5 ।।
transliteration: pādyena phalamūlaiśca uvāsa munibhiḥ saha || 7.51.5 ||
