shloka_text: विस्मयं ते परं गत्वा शत्रुघ्नमिदमब्रुवन् । साधु पृच्छ नरश्रेष्ठ वाल्मीकिं मुनिपुङ्गवम् ।। 7.71.21 ।।
transliteration: vismayaṃ te paraṃ gatvā śatrughnamidamabruvan | sādhu pṛccha naraśreṣṭha vālmīkiṃ munipuṅgavam || 7.71.21 ||
translation: विस्मयं wonder, ते they, परं great, गत्वा having reached, शत्रुघ्नम् to Shatrughna, इदम् this, अब्रुवन् said, साधु properly, पृच्छ ask, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, वाल्मीकिं Valmiki, मुनिपुङ्गवम् the foremost among sages.
explanation: Filled with great astonishment, they said to Shatrughna, "O best among men, please properly ask Valmiki, the foremost among sages."

shloka_text: शत्रुघ्नस्त्वब्रवीत्सर्वान्कौतूहलसमन्वितान् । सैनिका न क्षमो ऽस्माकं परिप्रष्टुमिहेदृशः ।। 7.71.22 ।।
transliteration: śatrughnastvabravītsarvānkautūhalasamanvitān | sainikā na kṣamo 'smākaṃ paripraṣṭumihedṛśaḥ || 7.71.22 ||
translation: शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, तु but, अब्रवीत् said, सर्वान् to all, कौतूहलसमन्वितान् filled with curiosity, सैनिकाः O soldiers, न not, क्षमः capable, अस्माकं for us, परिप्रष्टुम् to inquire, इह here, ईदृशः such (a thing).
explanation: But Shatrughna said to all the curious soldiers, "O soldiers, it is not proper for us to make such inquiries here."

shloka_text: आश्चर्याणि बहूनीह भवन्त्यस्याश्रमे मुनेः । न तु कौतूहलाद्युक्तमन्वेष्टुं तं महामुनिम् ।। 7.71.23 ।।
transliteration: āścaryāṇi bahūnīha bhavantyasyāśrame muneḥ | na tu kautūhalādyuktamanveṣṭuṃ taṃ mahāmunim || 7.71.23 ||
translation: आश्चर्याणि wonders, बहूनि many, इह here, भवन्ति occur, अस्य of this, आश्रमे in the hermitage, मुनेः of the sage, न not, तु but, कौतूहलात् out of curiosity, युक्तम् proper, अन्वेष्टुं to inquire, तं that, महामुनिम् great sage.
explanation: Many wonders occur here in this sage's hermitage, but it is not proper to question that great sage out of mere curiosity.

shloka_text: एवं तद्वाक्यमुक्त्वा च सैनिकान्रघुनन्दनः । अभिवाद्य महर्षिं तं स्वं निवेशं ययौ तदा ।। 7.71.24 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ tadvākyamuktvā ca sainikānraghunandanaḥ | abhivādya maharṣiṃ taṃ svaṃ niveśaṃ yayau tadā || 7.71.24 ||
translation: एवं thus, तत् that, वाक्यम् statement, उक्त्वा having said, च and, सैनिकान् to the soldiers, रघुनन्दनः Shatrughna, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महर्षिं the great sage, तं that, स्वं his own, निवेशं camp, ययौ went, तदा then.
explanation: Having thus spoken that statement to the soldiers, Shatrughna then saluted the great sage and returned to his own camp. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकसप्ततिमः सर्गः ।। 71 ।। Thus ends the seventy-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तं शयानं नरव्याघ्रं निद्रा नाभ्यागमत्तदा । चिन्तयन्तमनेकार्थं रामगीतमनुत्तमम् ।। 7.72.1 ।।
transliteration: taṃ śayānaṃ naravyāghraṃ nidrā nābhyāgamattadā | cintayantamanekārthaṃ rāmagītamanuttamam || 7.72.1 ||
translation: तं him, शयानं lying down, नरव्याघ्रं tiger among men (best of men), निद्रा sleep, न not, अभ्यागमत् came, तदा then, चिन्तयन्तम् thinking, अनेकार्थं having many meanings, रामगीतम् song of Rama, अनुत्तमम् excellent.
explanation: At that time, sleep did not come to the best of men, Shatrughna, as he lay thinking about the excellent song of Rama, which had many meanings.
comments: Unable to sleep for the song, Shatrughna at dawn takes leave of Valmiki and reaches Ayodhya, where he reports that Lavana is slain and Mathura founded -- pining after twelve years apart, he begs to stay, but Rama, reminding him that a Kshatriya must guard his realm and not yield to grief, bids him remain seven nights and then return to Mathura, whither he departs escorted a while by his brothers.

shloka_text: तस्य शब्दं सुमधुरं तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम् । श्रुत्वा रात्रिर्जगामाशु शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः ।। 7.72.2 ।।
transliteration: tasya śabdaṃ sumadhuraṃ tantrīlayasamanvitam | śrutvā rātrirjagāmāśu śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ || 7.72.2 ||
translation: तस्य his, शब्दं sound (singing), सुमधुरं very sweet, तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम् accompanied by string instruments and rhythm, श्रुत्वा having heard, रात्रिः night, जगाम passed, आशु quickly, शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, महात्मनः of the great-souled.
explanation: Having heard his (Lava's and Kusha's) very sweet singing, accompanied by string instruments and rhythm, the night quickly passed for the great-souled Shatrughna.

shloka_text: तस्यां निशायां व्युष्टायां कृत्वा पौर्वाह्णिकं क्रमम् । उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं शत्रुघ्नो मुनिपुङ्गवम् ।। 7.72.3 ।।
transliteration: tasyāṃ niśāyāṃ vyuṣṭāyāṃ kṛtvā paurvāhṇikaṃ kramam | uvāca prāñjalirvākyaṃ śatrughno munipuṅgavam || 7.72.3 ||
translation: तस्यां in that, निशायां night, व्युष्टायां having dawned, कृत्वा having performed, पौर्वाह्णिकं morning, क्रमम् rituals, उवाच spoke, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, वाक्यं words, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, मुनिपुङ्गवम् to the chief of sages (Valmiki).
explanation: When that night had dawned, Shatrughna, having performed his morning rituals, spoke words with folded hands to the chief of sages, Valmiki.

shloka_text: भगवन्द्रष्टुमिच्छामि राघवं रघुनन्दनम् । त्वया ऽनुज्ञातुमिच्छामि सहैभिः संशितव्रतैः ।। 7.72.4 ।।
transliteration: bhagavandraṣṭumicchāmi rāghavaṃ raghunandanam | tvayā 'nujñātumicchāmi sahaibhiḥ saṃśitavrataiḥ || 7.72.4 ||
translation: भगवन् O venerable one, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि I wish, राघवं Rama, रघुनन्दनम् delight of the Raghus, त्वया by you, अनुज्ञातुम् to be permitted, इच्छामि I wish, सह with, एभिः these, संशितव्रतैः those of firm vows.
explanation: Shatrughna said, "O venerable one, I wish to see Rama, the delight of the Raghus, and I wish to be permitted by you to go with these ascetics of firm vows."

shloka_text: इत्येवंवादिनं तं तु शत्रुघ्नं शत्रुतापनम् । वाल्मीकिः सम्परिष्वज्य विससर्ज च राघवम् ।। 7.72.5 ।।
transliteration: ityevaṃvādinaṃ taṃ tu śatrughnaṃ śatrutāpanam | vālmīkiḥ sampariṣvajya visasarja ca rāghavam || 7.72.5 ||
translation: इति thus, एवंवादिनं speaking, तं him, तु indeed, शत्रुघ्नं Shatrughna, शत्रुतापनम् tormentor of foes, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, सम्परिष्वज्य having embraced, विससर्ज sent off, च and, राघवम् to Rama.
explanation: Having embraced Shatrughna, the tormentor of foes, who was speaking thus, Valmiki sent him off to Rama.

shloka_text: सो ऽभिवाद्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं रथमारुह्य सुप्रभम् । अयोध्यामगमत्तूर्णं राघवोत्सुकदर्शनः ।। 7.72.6 ।।
transliteration: so 'bhivādya muniśreṣṭhaṃ rathamāruhya suprabham | ayodhyāmagamattūrṇaṃ rāghavotsukadarśanaḥ || 7.72.6 ||
translation: सः He, अभिवाद्य having saluted, मुनिश्रेष्ठम् the best of sages, रथम् chariot, आरुह्य having ascended, सुप्रभम् resplendent, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, अगमत् went, तूर्णं quickly, राघवोत्सुकदर्शनः eager to see Rama
explanation: Having saluted the revered sage Valmiki and mounted his splendid chariot, he swiftly departed for Ayodhya, eager to behold Rama.

shloka_text: स प्रविष्टः पुरीं रम्यां श्रीमानिक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः । प्रविवेश महाबाहुर्यत्र रामो महाद्युतिः ।। 7.72.7 ।।
transliteration: sa praviṣṭaḥ purīṃ ramyāṃ śrīmānikṣvākunandanaḥ | praviveśa mahābāhuryatra rāmo mahādyutiḥ || 7.72.7 ||
translation: सः He, प्रविष्टः having entered, पुरीं city, रम्यां beautiful, श्रीमान् glorious, इक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः delight of the Ikshvakus, प्रविवेश entered, महाबाहुः mighty-armed, यत्र where, रामः Rama, महाद्युतिः highly effulgent
explanation: The glorious and mighty-armed Shatrughna, the delight of the Ikshvakus, entered the beautiful city and proceeded to where the highly effulgent Rama resided.

shloka_text: स रामं मन्त्रिमध्यस्थं पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननम् । पश्यन्नमरमध्यस्थं सहस्रनयनं यथा ।। 7.72.8 ।।
transliteration: sa rāmaṃ mantrimadhyasthaṃ pūrṇacandranibhānanam | paśyannamaramadhyasthaṃ sahasranayanaṃ yathā || 7.72.8 ||
translation: सः He, रामं Rama, मन्त्रिमध्यस्थं seated amidst ministers, पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननम् with a face like the full moon, पश्यन् seeing, अमरमध्यस्थं seated amidst gods, सहस्रनयनं thousand-eyed, यथा like
explanation: He saw Rama, whose face resembled the full moon, seated amidst his ministers, appearing like the thousand-eyed Indra surrounded by gods.

shloka_text: सो ऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा । उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम् ।। 7.72.9 ।।
transliteration: so 'bhivādya mahātmānaṃ jvalantamiva tejasā | uvāca prāñjalirvākyaṃ rāmaṃ satyaparākramam || 7.72.9 ||
translation: सः He, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महात्मानं the great-souled one, ज्वलन्तम् shining, इव as if, तेजसा with splendor, उवाच spoke, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, वाक्यं words, रामं to Rama, सत्यपराक्रमम् of true valor
explanation: Having saluted the great-souled Rama, who shone as if with his own splendor and possessed true valor, he spoke with folded hands.

shloka_text: यदाज्ञप्तं महाराज सर्वं तत्कृतवानहम् । हतः स लवणः पापः पुरी चास्य निवेशिता ।। 7.72.10 ।।
transliteration: yadājñaptaṃ mahārāja sarvaṃ tatkṛtavānaham | hataḥ sa lavaṇaḥ pāpaḥ purī cāsya niveśitā || 7.72.10 ||
translation: यत् whatever, आज्ञप्तं commanded, महाराज O great king, सर्वं all, तत् that, कृतवान् have done, अहम् I, हतः killed, सः that, लवणः Lavana, पापः wicked, पुरी city, च and, अस्य his, निवेशिता established
explanation: O great king, I have accomplished all that you commanded: the wicked Lavana has been slain, and his city has been established.

shloka_text: द्वादशैते गता वर्षास्त्वां विना रघुनन्दन । नोत्सहेयमहं वस्तुं त्वया विरहितो नृप ।। 7.72.11 ।।
transliteration: dvādaśaite gatā varṣāstvāṃ vinā raghunandana | notsaheyamahaṃ vastuṃ tvayā virahito nṛpa || 7.72.11 ||
translation: द्वादशैते these twelve, गता passed, वर्षास् years, त्वाम् you, विना without, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, न not, उत्सहेयम् I am able, अहम् I, वस्तुम् to live, त्वया by you, विरहितो separated, नृप O King
explanation: O Rama, twelve years have passed without you, and I, separated from you, O King, am no longer able to live here.

shloka_text: स मे प्रसादं काकुत्स्थ कुरुष्वामितविक्रम । मातृहीनो यथा वत्सो न चिरं प्रवसाम्यहम् ।। 7.72.12 ।।
transliteration: sa me prasādaṃ kākutstha kuruṣvāmitavikrama | mātṛhīno yathā vatso na ciraṃ pravasāmyaham || 7.72.12 ||
translation: स therefore, मे to me, प्रसादम् favor, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, कुरुष्व grant, अमितविक्रम O one of immeasurable valor, मातृहीनः motherless, यथा as, वत्सः a calf, न not, चिरम् long, प्रवसामि I can stay away, अहम् I
explanation: Therefore, O Rama of immeasurable valor, grant me this favor, for I cannot stay away much longer, just like a motherless calf.

shloka_text: एवं ब्रुवाणं शत्रुघ्नं परिष्वज्येदमब्रवीत् । मा विषादं कृथाः शूर नैतत्क्षत्रियचेष्टितम् ।। 7.72.13 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ śatrughnaṃ pariṣvajyedamabravīt | mā viṣādaṃ kṛthāḥ śūra naitatkṣatriyaceṣṭitam || 7.72.13 ||
translation: एवम् thus, ब्रुवाणम् speaking, शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, परिष्वज्य having embraced, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् he said, मा do not, विषादम् sorrow, कृथाः do, शूर O brave one, न not, एतत् this, क्षत्रियचेष्टितम् conduct of a Kshatriya
explanation: Having embraced Shatrughna who was speaking thus, Rama said, "O brave one, do not despair, for this is not the conduct befitting a Kshatriya."

shloka_text: नावसीदन्ति राजानो विप्रवासेषु राघव । प्रजा नः परिपाल्या हि क्षत्रधर्मेण राघव ।। 7.72.14 ।।
transliteration: nāvasīdanti rājāno vipravāseṣu rāghava | prajā naḥ paripālyā hi kṣatradharmeṇa rāghava || 7.72.14 ||
translation: न not, अवसीदन्ति become dejected, राजानो kings, विप्रवासेषु in separations, राघव O Raghava, प्रजा subjects, नः by us, परिपाल्या to be protected, हि indeed, क्षत्रधर्मेण by the duty of a Kshatriya, राघव O Raghava
explanation: O Raghava, kings do not become dejected during separations, for indeed, our subjects must be protected according to the duty of a Kshatriya.

shloka_text: काले काले तु मां वीर अयोध्यामवलोकितुम् । आगच्छ त्वं नरश्रेष्ठ गन्तासि च पुरं तव ।। 7.72.15 ।।
transliteration: kāle kāle tu māṃ vīra ayodhyāmavalokitum | āgaccha tvaṃ naraśreṣṭha gantāsi ca puraṃ tava || 7.72.15 ||
translation: काले काले from time to time, तु and, माम् me, वीर O brave one, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, अवलोकितुम् to see, आगच्छ come, त्वम् you, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, गन्तासि you will go, च and, पुरम् city, तव your
explanation: O brave one, O best among men, you should come to Ayodhya from time to time to see me, and you will also return to your own city.

shloka_text: ममापि त्वं सुदयितः प्राणैरपि न संशयः । अवश्यं करणीयं च राज्यस्य परिपालनम् ।। 7.72.16 ।।
transliteration: mamāpi tvaṃ sudayitaḥ prāṇairapi na saṃśayaḥ | avaśyaṃ karaṇīyaṃ ca rājyasya paripālanam || 7.72.16 ||
translation: ममापि my also, त्वं you, सुदयितः very dear, प्राणैरपि even than life, न no, संशयः doubt, अवश्यं certainly, करणीयं to be done, च and, राज्यस्य of the kingdom, परिपालनम् protection
explanation: Rama tells Shatrughna that he is dearer than life itself, but the protection of the kingdom is an essential duty.

shloka_text: तस्मात्त्वं वस काकुत्स्थ सप्तरात्रमिहावस । ऊर्ध्वं गन्तासि मधुरां सभृत्यबलवाहनः ।। 7.72.17 ।।
transliteration: tasmāttvaṃ vasa kākutstha saptarātramihāvasa | ūrdhvaṃ gantāsi madhurāṃ sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ || 7.72.17 ||
translation: तस्मात् therefore, त्वं you, वस stay, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, सप्तरात्रम् for seven nights, इह here, आवस stay, ऊर्ध्वं thereafter, गन्तासि you will go, मधुरां to Mathura, सभृत्यबलवाहनः with servants, army, and vehicles
explanation: Therefore, O Kakutstha, stay here for seven nights, and thereafter you shall proceed to Mathura with your servants, army, and vehicles.

shloka_text: रामस्यैतद्वचः श्रुत्वा धर्मयुक्तं मनोगतम् । शत्रुघ्नो दीनया वाचा बाढमित्येव चाब्रवीत् ।। 7.72.18 ।।
transliteration: rāmasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā dharmayuktaṃ manogatam | śatrughno dīnayā vācā bāḍhamityeva cābravīt || 7.72.18 ||
translation: रामस्य of Rama, एतत् this, वचः word, श्रुत्वा having heard, धर्मयुक्तं righteous, मनोगतम् heartfelt, शत्रुघ्नो Shatrughna, दीनया with a humble, वाचा voice, बाढम् indeed, इति thus, एव only, च and, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Having heard these righteous and heartfelt words of Rama, Shatrughna, with a humble voice, simply replied, "Indeed."

shloka_text: सप्तरात्रं च काकुत्स्थो राघवस्य यथाज्ञया । उष्य तत्र महेष्वासो गमनायोपचक्रमे ।। 7.72.19 ।।
transliteration: saptarātraṃ ca kākutstho rāghavasya yathājñayā | uṣya tatra maheṣvāso gamanāyopacakrame || 7.72.19 ||
translation: सप्तरात्रं for seven nights, च and, काकुत्स्थो Kakutstha, राघवस्य of Rama, यथाज्ञया as per the command, उष्य having stayed, तत्र there, महेष्वासो the great archer, गमनाय for departure, उपचक्रमे began
explanation: And the great archer Shatrughna, having stayed there for seven nights as per Rama's command, began preparations for his departure.

shloka_text: आमन्त्र्य तु महात्मानं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम् । भरतं लक्ष्मणं चैव महारथमुपारुहत् ।। 7.72.20 ।।
transliteration: āmantrya tu mahātmānaṃ rāmaṃ satyaparākramam | bharataṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ caiva mahārathamupāruhat || 7.72.20 ||
translation: आमन्त्र्य having bid farewell to, तु indeed, महात्मानं the great-souled, रामं Rama, सत्यपराक्रमम् of true valor, भरतं Bharata, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, च and, एव also, महारथम् a great chariot, उपारुहत् ascended
explanation: Having bid farewell to the great-souled Rama of true valor, and also to Bharata and Lakshmana, he then ascended a great chariot.

shloka_text: दूरमाभ्यामनुगतो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना । भरतेन च शत्रुघ्नो जगामाशु पुरं ततः ।। 7.72.21 ।।
transliteration: dūramābhyāmanugato lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā | bharatena ca śatrughno jagāmāśu puraṃ tataḥ || 7.72.21 ||
translation: दूरम् far, आभ्याम् by both, अनुगतः followed, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, महात्मना by the great-souled, भरतेन by Bharata, च and, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, जगाम went, आशु quickly, पुरम् to the city, ततः then.
explanation: After being accompanied for a long distance by the great-souled Lakshmana and Bharata, Shatrughna then quickly proceeded to the city of Ayodhya. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्विसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 72 ।। Thus ends the seventy-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: प्रस्थाप्य तु स शत्रुघ्नं भ्रातृभ्यां सह राघवः । प्रमुमोद सुखी राज्यं धर्मेण परिपालयन् ।। 7.73.1 ।।
transliteration: prasthāpya tu sa śatrughnaṃ bhrātṛbhyāṃ saha rāghavaḥ | pramumoda sukhī rājyaṃ dharmeṇa paripālayan || 7.73.1 ||
translation: प्रस्थाप्य having sent off, तु indeed, सः he, शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, भ्रातृभ्याम् with his two brothers, सह with, राघवः Rama, प्रमुमोद rejoiced, सुखी happy, राज्यम् the kingdom, धर्मेण righteously, परिपालयन् ruling.
explanation: Having sent off Shatrughna, Rama, accompanied by his two brothers, happily rejoiced while ruling the kingdom righteously.
comments: An old brahmin comes to the palace gate bearing his dead son, lamenting that in Rama's kingdom his only child has died untimely, a thing unheard of -- he charges that some fault of the king must have caused it and demands the boy be revived, vowing that he and his wife will die at the gate and leave Rama guilty of a brahmin's death.

shloka_text: ततः कतिपयाहःसु वृद्धो जानपदो द्विजः । मृतं बालमुपादाय राजद्वारमुपागमत् ।। 7.73.2 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ katipayāhaḥsu vṛddho jānapado dvijaḥ | mṛtaṃ bālamupādāya rājadvāramupāgamat || 7.73.2 ||
translation: ततः then, कतिपयाहःसु after a few days, वृद्धः an old man, जानपदः a citizen, द्विजः a Brahmin, मृतम् dead, बालम् child, उपादाय having taken, राजद्वारम् to the royal gate, उपागमत् approached.
explanation: Then, after a few days, an old Brahmin citizen, holding his dead child, approached the royal gate.

shloka_text: रुदन्बहुविधा वाचः स्नेहदुःखसमन्विताः । असकृत्पुत्र पुत्रेति वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.73.3 ।।
transliteration: rudanbahuvidhā vācaḥ snehaduḥkhasamanvitāḥ | asakṛtputra putreti vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.73.3 ||
translation: रुदन् weeping, बहुविधाः various kinds of, वाचः words, स्नेहदुःखसमन्विताः filled with affection and sorrow, असकृत् repeatedly, पुत्र O son!, पुत्र O son!, इति thus, वाक्यम् words, एतत् this, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.
explanation: Weeping, he uttered various words filled with affection and sorrow, repeatedly exclaiming, "O son, O son!"

shloka_text: किं नु मे दुष्कृतं कर्म पुरा देहान्तरे कृतम् । यदहं पुत्रमेकं त्वां पश्यामि निधनं गतम् ।। 7.73.4 ।।
transliteration: kiṃ nu me duṣkṛtaṃ karma purā dehāntare kṛtam | yadahaṃ putramekaṃ tvāṃ paśyāmi nidhanaṃ gatam || 7.73.4 ||
translation: किम् what, नु indeed, मे by me, दुष्कृतम् evil, कर्म deed, पुरा formerly, देहान्तरे in another body, कृतम् done, यत् that, अहम् I, पुत्रम् son, एकम् only one, त्वाम् you, पश्यामि I see, निधनम् death, गतम् gone to.
explanation: He lamented, "What evil deed did I commit in a previous birth that I now see you, my only son, having met your death?"

shloka_text: अप्राप्तयौवनं बालं पञ्चवर्षसहस्रकम् । अकाले कालमापन्नं मम दुःखाय पुत्रक ।। 7.73.5 ।।
transliteration: aprāptayauvanaṃ bālaṃ pañcavarṣasahasrakam | akāle kālamāpannaṃ mama duḥkhāya putraka || 7.73.5 ||
translation: अप्राप्तयौवनं one who has not attained youth, बालं child, पञ्चवर्षसहस्रकम् of five thousand years (age), अकाले untimely, कालम् death, आपन्नं attained, मम my, दुःखाय for sorrow, पुत्रक O son
explanation: The child, though five thousand years old, had not yet reached youth and met an untimely death, causing great sorrow to the speaker.

shloka_text: अल्पैरहोभिर्निधनं गमिष्यामि न संशयः । अहं च जननी चैव तव शोकेन पुत्रक ।। 7.73.6 ।।
transliteration: alpairahobhirnidhanaṃ gamiṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ | ahaṃ ca jananī caiva tava śokena putraka || 7.73.6 ||
translation: अल्पैः in a few, अहोभिः days, निधनं death, गमिष्यामि I shall attain, न no, संशयः doubt, अहं I, च and, जननी mother, च and, एव indeed, तव your, शोकेन by sorrow, पुत्रक O son
explanation: The speaker and the mother will undoubtedly die within a few days due to the grief over the son's death.

shloka_text: न स्मराम्यनृतं ह्युक्तं न च हिंसां स्मराम्यहम् । सर्वेषां प्राणिनां पापं कृतं नैव स्मराम्यहम् ।। 7.73.7 ।।
transliteration: na smarāmyanṛtaṃ hyuktaṃ na ca hiṃsāṃ smarāmyaham | sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ naiva smarāmyaham || 7.73.7 ||
translation: न not, स्मरामि I remember, अनृतं untruth, हि indeed, उक्तं spoken, न not, च and, हिंसां violence, स्मरामि I remember, अहम् I, सर्वेषां of all, प्राणिनां beings, पापं sin, कृतं done, न not, एव indeed, स्मरामि I remember, अहम् I
explanation: The speaker asserts that he does not recall ever speaking an untruth, committing violence, or performing any sin against any living being.

shloka_text: केनाद्य दुष्कृतेनायं बाल एव ममात्मजः । अकृत्वा पितृकार्याणि गतो वैवस्वतक्षयम् ।। 7.73.8 ।।
transliteration: kenādya duṣkṛtenāyaṃ bāla eva mamātmajaḥ | akṛtvā pitṛkāryāṇi gato vaivasvatakṣayam || 7.73.8 ||
translation: केन by what, अद्य today, दुष्कृतेन evil deed, अयं this, बालः child, एव indeed, मम my, आत्मजः son, अकृत्वा without performing, पितृकार्याणि filial duties, गतः gone, वैवस्वतक्षयम् to the abode of Yama
explanation: The speaker wonders what sin he committed that his son, still a child, has died without fulfilling his duties to his ancestors.

shloka_text: नेदृशं दृष्टपूर्वं मे श्रुतं वा घोरदर्शनम् । मृत्युरप्राप्तकालानां रामस्य विषये यथा ।। 7.73.9 ।।
transliteration: nedṛśaṃ dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ me śrutaṃ vā ghoradarśanam | mṛtyuraprāptakālānāṃ rāmasya viṣaye yathā || 7.73.9 ||
translation: न not, ईदृशं such, दृष्टपूर्वं seen before, मे by me, श्रुतं heard, वा or, घोरदर्शनम् terrible sight, मृत्युः death, अप्राप्तकालानां of those whose time has not come, रामस्य Rama's, विषये in the kingdom, यथा as
explanation: The speaker states that he has never before seen or heard of such a terrible sight as the untimely death of those in Rama's kingdom.

shloka_text: रामस्य दुष्कृतं किञ्चिन्महदस्ति न संशयः । यथा हि विषयस्थानां बालानां मृत्युरागतः ।। 7.73.10 ।।
transliteration: rāmasya duṣkṛtaṃ kiñcinmahadasti na saṃśayaḥ | yathā hi viṣayasthānāṃ bālānāṃ mṛtyurāgataḥ || 7.73.10 ||
translation: रामस्य Rama's, दुष्कृतं misdeed, किञ्चित् some, महत् great, अस्ति is, न no, संशयः doubt, यथा just as, हि indeed, विषयस्थानां of those living in the kingdom, बालानां of children, मृत्युः death, आगतः has come.
explanation: There is no doubt that Rama has committed some great sin, just as death has come upon the children living in his kingdom.

shloka_text: नह्यन्यविषयस्थानां बालानां मृत्युतो भयम् । त्वं राजञ्जीवयस्वैनं बालं मृत्युवशं गतम् ।। 7.73.11 ।।
transliteration: nahyanyaviṣayasthānāṃ bālānāṃ mṛtyuto bhayam | tvaṃ rājañjīvayasvainaṃ bālaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ gatam || 7.73.11 ||
translation: न not, हि indeed, अन्यविषयस्थानां of those living in other kingdoms, बालानां of children, मृत्युतः from death, भयम् fear, त्वं you, राजन् O King, जीवयस्व revive, एनं this, बालं child, मृत्युवशं under the sway of death, गतम् gone.
explanation: Indeed, children in other kingdoms do not fear death, so O King, you must revive this child who has fallen under the sway of death.

shloka_text: राजद्वारि मरिष्यामि पत्न्या सार्धमनाथवत् । ब्रह्महत्यां ततो राम समुपेत्य सुखी भव ।। 7.73.12 ।।
transliteration: rājadvāri mariṣyāmi patnyā sārdhamanāthavat | brahmahatyāṃ tato rāma samupetya sukhī bhava || 7.73.12 ||
translation: राजद्वारि at the king's gate, मरिष्यामि I will die, पत्न्या with my wife, सार्धम् together, अनाथवत् like an orphan, ब्रह्महत्यां the sin of killing a Brahmin, ततः then, राम O Rama, समुपेत्य having incurred, सुखी happy, भव be.
explanation: I will die at the king's gate with my wife, like a helpless person, and then, O Rama, having incurred the sin of killing a Brahmin, you may be happy.

shloka_text: भ्रातृभिः सहितो राजन्दीर्घमायुरवाप्स्यसि । उषिताः स्म सुखं राज्ये तवास्मिन्सुमहाबल ।। 7.73.13 ।।
transliteration: bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito rājandīrghamāyuravāpsyasi | uṣitāḥ sma sukhaṃ rājye tavāsminsumahābala || 7.73.13 ||
translation: भ्रातृभिः with brothers, सहितः accompanied, राजन् O King, दीर्घम् long, आयुः life, अवाप्स्यसि you will obtain, उषिताः we have lived, स्म (past tense indicator), सुखं happily, राज्ये in the kingdom, तव your, अस्मिन् in this, सुमहाबल O greatly powerful one.
explanation: O King, accompanied by your brothers, you will obtain a long life; O greatly powerful one, we have lived happily in your kingdom until now.

shloka_text: इदं तु पतितं तस्मात्तव राम वशे स्थिताः । कालस्य वशमापन्नाः स्वल्पं हि नहि नः सुखम् ।। 7.73.14 ।।
transliteration: idaṃ tu patitaṃ tasmāttava rāma vaśe sthitāḥ | kālasya vaśamāpannāḥ svalpaṃ hi nahi naḥ sukham || 7.73.14 ||
translation: इदं this, तु but, पतितं has fallen, तस्मात् therefore, तव your, राम O Rama, वशे under control, स्थिताः being, कालस्य of time, वशम् control, आपन्नाः having fallen into, स्वल्पं little, हि indeed, नहि not at all, नः our, सुखम् happiness.
explanation: But this misfortune has now befallen us, O Rama, who are under your control, as we have fallen under the sway of time, and indeed, our happiness is now very little.

shloka_text: सम्प्रत्यनाथो विषय इक्ष्वाकूणां महात्मनाम् । रामं नाथमिहासाद्य बालान्तकरणं ध्रुवम् ।। 7.73.15 ।।
transliteration: sampratyanātho viṣaya ikṣvākūṇāṃ mahātmanām | rāmaṃ nāthamihāsādya bālāntakaraṇaṃ dhruvam || 7.73.15 ||
translation: सम्प्रति now, अनाथः helpless, विषयः kingdom, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of the Ikshvakus, महात्मनाम् of the great-souled ones, रामम् Rama, नाथम् as protector, इह here, आसाद्य having obtained, बालान्तकरणम् causing the death of children, ध्रुवम् certainly.
explanation: Now, this kingdom of the great Ikshvakus, having obtained Rama as its protector, is certainly causing the death of children.

shloka_text: राजदोषैर्विपद्यन्ते प्रजा ह्यविधिपालिताः । असद्वृत्ते तु नृपतावकाले म्रियते जनः ।। 7.73.16 ।।
transliteration: rājadoṣairvipadyante prajā hyavidhipālitāḥ | asadvṛtte tu nṛpatāvakāle mriyate janaḥ || 7.73.16 ||
translation: राजदोषैः by the faults of the king, विपद्यन्ते perish, प्रजाः subjects, हि indeed, अविधिपालिताः not protected according to law, असद्वृत्ते when ill-behaved, तु but, नृपतौ when the king, अकाले untimely, म्रियते dies, जनः people.
explanation: Indeed, subjects not protected according to law perish due to the king's faults, and when the king is ill-behaved, people die untimely deaths.

shloka_text: यद्वा पुरेष्वयुक्तानि जना जनपदेषु च । कुर्वते न च रक्षा ऽस्ति तदा कालकृतं भयम् ।। 7.73.17 ।।
transliteration: yadvā pureṣvayuktāni janā janapadeṣu ca | kurvate na ca rakṣā 'sti tadā kālakṛtaṃ bhayam || 7.73.17 ||
translation: यद्वा or when, पुरेषु in cities, अयुक्तानि improper acts, जनाः people, जनपदेषु in districts, च and, कुर्वते do, न not, च and, रक्षा protection, अस्ति is, तदा then, कालकृतम् caused by time, भयम् fear.
explanation: Or when people commit improper acts in cities and districts, and there is no protection, then there is fear caused by the times.

shloka_text: सुव्यक्तं राजदोषो हि भविष्यति न संशयः । पुरे जनपदे चापि ततो बालवधो ह्ययम् ।। 7.73.18 ।।
transliteration: suvyaktaṃ rājadoṣo hi bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | pure janapade cāpi tato bālavadho hyayam || 7.73.18 ||
translation: सुव्यक्तम् very clearly, राजदोषः a king's fault, हि indeed, भविष्यति will be, न no, संशयः doubt, पुरे in the city, जनपदे in the district, च and, अपि also, ततः therefore, बालवधः child-killing, हि indeed, अयम् this.
explanation: It is very clear that there will be no doubt of a king's fault in the city and the district, and therefore, this child-killing is indeed due to that.

shloka_text: एवं बहुविधैर्वाक्यैरुपरुध्य मुहुर्मुहुः । राजानं दुःखसन्तप्तः सुतं तमुपगूहते ।। 7.73.19 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ bahuvidhairvākyairuparudhya muhurmuhuḥ | rājānaṃ duḥkhasantaptaḥ sutaṃ tamupagūhate || 7.73.19 ||
translation: एवम् thus, बहुविधैः of many kinds, वाक्यैः with words, उपरुध्य having importuned, मुहुर्मुहुः repeatedly, राजानम् the king, दुःखसन्तप्तः afflicted with sorrow, सुतम् son, तम् him, उपगूहते embraces.
explanation: Thus, repeatedly importuning the king with various kinds of words, the father, deeply distressed, clasps his son. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रिसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 73 ।। Thus ends the seventy-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तथा तु करुणं तस्य द्विजस्य परिदेवनम् । शुश्राव राघवः सर्वं दुःखशोकसमन्वितम् ।। 7.74.1 ।।
transliteration: tathā tu karuṇaṃ tasya dvijasya paridevanam | śuśrāva rāghavaḥ sarvaṃ duḥkhaśokasamanvitam || 7.74.1 ||
translation: तथा thus, तु indeed, करुणं piteous, तस्य his, द्विजस्य of the brahmin, परिदेवनम् lamentation, शुश्राव heard, राघवः Rama, सर्वं all, दुःखशोकसमन्वितम् filled with sorrow and grief.
explanation: Rama heard the entire piteous lamentation of that brahmin, which was filled with sorrow and grief.
comments: Rama summons his ministers and the sages, and Narada explains the cause: that in each age penance is lawful only to the higher orders in turn, and a Shudra now performing forbidden austerities has brought about the child's untimely death -- to restore dharma and the boy's life, Rama must seek out and punish the transgressor.

shloka_text: स दुःखेन च सन्तप्तो मन्त्रिणस्तानुपाह्वयत् । वसिष्ठं वामदेवं च भ्रातरौ सह नैगमान् ।। 7.74.2 ।।
transliteration: sa duḥkhena ca santapto mantriṇastānupāhvayat | vasiṣṭhaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca bhrātarau saha naigamān || 7.74.2 ||
translation: सः He, दुःखेन by sorrow, च and, सन्तप्तो distressed, मन्त्रिणः ministers, तान् those, उपाह्वयत् summoned, वसिष्ठं Vasistha, वामदेवं Vamadeva, च and, भ्रातरौ his two brothers, सह along with, नैगमान् the citizens/merchants.
explanation: Distressed by sorrow, Rama summoned his ministers, along with Vasistha, Vamadeva, his two brothers, and the representatives of the city.

shloka_text: ततो द्विजा वसिष्ठेन सार्धमष्टौ प्रवेशिताः । राजानं देवसङ्काशं वर्धस्वेति ततो ऽब्रुवन् ।। 7.74.3 ।।
transliteration: tato dvijā vasiṣṭhena sārdhamaṣṭau praveśitāḥ | rājānaṃ devasaṅkāśaṃ vardhasveti tato 'bruvan || 7.74.3 ||
translation: ततः then, द्विजाः brahmins, वसिष्ठेन by Vasistha, सार्धम् together with, अष्टौ eight, प्रवेशिताः were ushered in, राजानं the king, देवसङ्काशं god-like, वर्धस्व may you prosper, इति thus, ततः then, अब्रुवन् they said.
explanation: Then, eight brahmins, accompanied by Vasistha, were ushered in and, seeing the god-like king, they blessed him saying, "May you prosper!"

shloka_text: मार्कण्डेयो ऽथ मौद्गल्यो वामदेवश्च काश्यपः । कात्यायनो ऽथ जाबालिर्गौतमो नारदस्तथा । एते द्विजर्षभाः सर्वे आसनेषूपवेशिताः ।। 7.74.4 ।।
transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyo 'tha maudgalyo vāmadevaśca kāśyapaḥ | kātyāyano 'tha jābālirgautamo nāradastathā | ete dvijarṣabhāḥ sarve āsaneṣūpaveśitāḥ || 7.74.4 ||
translation: मार्कण्डेयः Markandeya, अथ and, मौद्गल्यः Maudgalya, वामदेवः Vamadeva, च and, काश्यपः Kashyapa, कात्यायनः Katyayana, अथ and, जाबालिः Jabali, गौतमः Gautama, नारदः Narada, तथा and also, एते these, द्विजर्षभाः best of brahmins, सर्वे all, आसनेषु on seats, उपवेशिताः were seated.
explanation: Markandeya, Maudgalya, Vamadeva, Kashyapa, Katyayana, Jabali, Gautama, and Narada—all these eminent brahmins were seated on their respective seats.

shloka_text: महर्षीन्समनुप्राप्तानभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः । मन्त्रिणो नैगमांश्चैव यथार्हमनुकूलतः ।। 7.74.5 ।।
transliteration: maharṣīnsamanuprāptānabhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ | mantriṇo naigamāṃścaiva yathārhamanukūlataḥ || 7.74.5 ||
translation: महर्षीन् the great sages, समनुप्राप्तान् who had arrived, अभिवाद्य having saluted, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, मन्त्रिणः the ministers, नैगमान् the citizens/merchants, च and, एव also, यथार्हम् appropriately, अनुकूलतः respectfully.
explanation: With folded hands, Rama respectfully saluted the arrived great sages, as well as the ministers and citizens, each according to their due.

shloka_text: तेषां समुपविष्टानां सर्वेषां दीप्ततेजसाम् । राघवः सर्वमाचष्टे द्विजो ऽयमुपरोधते ।। 7.74.6 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ samupaviṣṭānāṃ sarveṣāṃ dīptatejasām | rāghavaḥ sarvamācaṣṭe dvijo 'yamuparodhate || 7.74.6 ||
translation: तेषां of them, समुपविष्टानां who were seated, सर्वेषां of all, दीप्ततेजसाम् of shining splendor, राघवः Rama, सर्वम् everything, आचष्टे narrated, अयम् this, द्विजः brahmin, उपरोधते obstructs.
explanation: Rama narrated everything to all those seated sages of shining splendor, explaining that this brahmin's situation was causing a hindrance.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राज्ञो दीनस्य नारदः । प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यमृषीणां सन्निधौ नृपम् ।। 7.74.7 ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rājño dīnasya nāradaḥ | pratyuvāca śubhaṃ vākyamṛṣīṇāṃ sannidhau nṛpam || 7.74.7 ||
translation: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, राज्ञः of the king, दीनस्य distressed, नारदः Narada, प्रत्युवाच replied, शुभं auspicious, वाक्यम् words, ऋषीणां of the sages, सन्निधौ in the presence, नृपम् to the king.
explanation: Having heard the distressed king's words, Narada replied with auspicious words to the king in the presence of the sages.

shloka_text: शृणु राजन्यथाकाले प्राप्तो बालस्य सङ्क्षयः । श्रुत्वा कर्तव्यतां राजन्कुरुष्वरघुनन्दन ।। 7.74.8 ।।
transliteration: śṛṇu rājanyathākāle prāpto bālasya saṅkṣayaḥ | śrutvā kartavyatāṃ rājankuruṣvaraghunandana || 7.74.8 ||
translation: शृणु listen, राजन् O King, यथाकाले in due course, प्राप्तः occurred, बालस्य of the child, सङ्क्षयः the death, श्रुत्वा having heard, कर्तव्यतां what is to be done, राजन् O King, कुरुष्व perform, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: O King, O Rama, listen to how the child's death occurred in due course, and having heard what is to be done, perform your duty.

shloka_text: पुरा कृतयुगे राजन्ब्राह्मणा वै तपस्विनः । अब्राह्मणस्तदा राजन्न तपस्वी कथञ्चन ।। 7.74.9 ।।
transliteration: purā kṛtayuge rājanbrāhmaṇā vai tapasvinaḥ | abrāhmaṇastadā rājanna tapasvī kathañcana || 7.74.9 ||
translation: पुरा formerly, कृतयुगे in the Krita Yuga, राजन् O King, ब्राह्मणाः brahmins, वै indeed, तपस्विनः were ascetics, अब्राह्मणः a non-brahmin, तदा then, राजन् O King, न not, तपस्वी an ascetic, कथञ्चन by any means.
explanation: O King, in the ancient Krita Yuga, only brahmins were ascetics, and no non-brahmin was an ascetic by any means.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्युगे प्रज्वलिते ब्रह्मभूते त्वनावृते । अमृत्यवस्तदा सर्वे जज्ञिरे दीर्घदर्शिनः ।। 7.74.10 ।।
transliteration: tasminyuge prajvalite brahmabhūte tvanāvṛte | amṛtyavastadā sarve jajñire dīrghadarśinaḥ || 7.74.10 ||
translation: तस्मिन् in that, युगे age, प्रज्वलिते shining brightly, ब्रह्मभूते divine, तु and, अनावृते unobstructed, अमृत्युवः immortal, तदा then, सर्वे all, जज्ञिरे were born, दीर्घदर्शिनः far-seeing.
explanation: In that resplendent, divine, and unobstructed age, all beings were born immortal and far-seeing.

shloka_text: ततस्त्रेतायुगं नाम मानवानां वपुष्मताम् । क्षत्रियास्तत्र जायन्ते पूर्णेन तपसा ऽन्विताः ।। 7.74.11 ।।
transliteration: tatastretāyugaṃ nāma mānavānāṃ vapuṣmatām | kṣatriyāstatra jāyante pūrṇena tapasā 'nvitāḥ || 7.74.11 ||
translation: ततः thereafter, त्रेतायुगं Treta Yuga, नाम named, मानवानां of humans, वपुष्मताम् embodied, क्षत्रियाः Kshatriyas, तत्र there, जायन्ते are born, पूर्णेन with complete, तपसा penance, अन्विताः endowed with,
explanation: Thereafter, in the age named Treta Yuga, embodied humans, specifically Kshatriyas, were born endowed with complete penance.

shloka_text: वीर्येण तपसा चैव ते ऽधिकाः पूर्वजन्मनि । मानवा ये महात्मानस्त्वत्र त्रेतायुगे युगे ।। 7.74.12 ।।
transliteration: vīryeṇa tapasā caiva te 'dhikāḥ pūrvajanmani | mānavā ye mahātmānastvatra tretāyuge yuge || 7.74.12 ||
translation: वीर्येण by valor, तपसा by penance, च and, एव indeed, ते they, अधिकाः superior, पूर्वजन्मनि in previous birth, मानवाः humans, ये who, महात्मानः great-souled ones, तु indeed, अत्र here, त्रेतायुगे in Treta Yuga, युगे in the age,
explanation: Those great-souled humans who were superior in valor and penance in their previous birth were indeed born in this Treta Yuga.

shloka_text: ब्रह्मक्षत्रं च तत्सर्वं यत्पूर्वमपरं च यत् । युगयोरुभयोरासीत्समवीर्यसमन्वितम् ।। 7.74.13 ।।
transliteration: brahmakṣatraṃ ca tatsarvaṃ yatpūrvamaparaṃ ca yat | yugayorubhayorāsītsamavīryasamanvitam || 7.74.13 ||
translation: ब्रह्मक्षत्रं Brahmanas and Kshatriyas, च and, तत् that, सर्वं all, यत् which, पूर्वं earlier, अपरं later, च and, यत् which, युगयोः of the two ages, उभयोः of both, आसीत् was, समवीर्यसमन्वितम् endowed with equal valor,
explanation: All those Brahmanas and Kshatriyas, both the former and the latter, were endowed with equal valor in both ages.

shloka_text: अपश्यंस्तु न ते सर्वे विशेषमधिकं ततः । स्थापनं चक्रिरे तत्र चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य सम्मतम् ।। 7.74.14 ।।
transliteration: apaśyaṃstu na te sarve viśeṣamadhikaṃ tataḥ | sthāpanaṃ cakrire tatra cāturvarṇyasya sammatam || 7.74.14 ||
translation: अपश्यन्तः not seeing, तु but, न not, ते they, सर्वे all, विशेषं distinction, अधिकं greater, ततः from that, स्थापनं establishment, चक्रिरे they made, तत्र there, चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य of the four varnas, सम्मतम् approved,
explanation: Not seeing any greater distinction among them, all of them then established the approved system of four varnas.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्युगे प्रज्वलिते धर्मभूते ह्यनावृते । अधर्मः पादमेकं तु पातयत्पृथिवीतले ।। 7.74.15 ।।
transliteration: tasminyuge prajvalite dharmabhūte hyanāvṛte | adharmaḥ pādamekaṃ tu pātayatpṛthivītale || 7.74.15 ||
translation: तस्मिन् in that, युगे age, प्रज्वलिते shining brightly, धर्मभूते full of dharma, हि indeed, अनावृते unobstructed, अधर्मः unrighteousness, पादं foot, एकं one, तु indeed, पातयत् cast down, पृथिवीतले on the surface of the earth,
explanation: In that brightly shining age, which was indeed full of unobstructed dharma, unrighteousness nevertheless placed one foot upon the surface of the earth.

shloka_text: अधर्मेण हि संयुक्तस्तेजो मन्दं भविष्यति ।। 7.74.16 ।।
transliteration: adharmeṇa hi saṃyuktastejo mandaṃ bhaviṣyati || 7.74.16 ||
translation: अधर्मेण by unrighteousness, हि indeed, संयुक्तः joined, तेजः splendor, मन्दम् diminished, भविष्यति will become.
explanation: Indeed, one who is associated with unrighteousness will find their splendor diminished.

shloka_text: आमिषं यच्च पूर्वेषां राजसं च मलं भृशम् । अनृतं नाम तद्भूतं पादेन पृथिवीतले ।। 7.74.17 ।।
transliteration: āmiṣaṃ yacca pūrveṣāṃ rājasaṃ ca malaṃ bhṛśam | anṛtaṃ nāma tadbhūtaṃ pādena pṛthivītale || 7.74.17 ||
translation: आमिषम् desire, यत् which, च and, पूर्वेषाम् of the ancients, राजसम् passionate, च and, मलम् impurity, भृशम् exceedingly, अनृतम् untruth, नाम named, तत् that, भूतम् being, पादेन by a foot, पृथिवीतले on the surface of the earth.
explanation: That which was the object of desire for the ancients and a great passionate impurity, that very being named Untruth, manifested on the earth with one foot.

shloka_text: अनृतं पातयित्वा तु पादमेकमधर्मतः । ततः प्रादुष्कृतं पूर्वमायुषः परिनिष्ठितम् ।। 7.74.18 ।।
transliteration: anṛtaṃ pātayitvā tu pādamekamadharmataḥ | tataḥ prāduṣkṛtaṃ pūrvamāyuṣaḥ pariniṣṭhitam || 7.74.18 ||
translation: अनृतम् untruth, पातयित्वा having caused to fall, तु indeed, पादम् foot, एकम् one, अधर्मतः from unrighteousness, ततः then, प्रादुष्कृतम् manifested, पूर्वम् formerly, आयुषः of life, परिनिष्ठितम् determined.
explanation: Indeed, when untruth caused one foot of Dharma to fall due to unrighteousness, then the duration of life was previously determined and established.

shloka_text: पतिते त्वनृते तस्मिन्नधर्मे च महीतले । शुभान्येवाचरँल्लोकः सत्यधर्मपरायणः ।। 7.74.19 ।।
transliteration: patite tvanṛte tasminnadharme ca mahītale | śubhānyevācaraँllokaḥ satyadharmaparāyaṇaḥ || 7.74.19 ||
translation: पतिते having descended, तु indeed, अनृते untruth, तस्मिन् that, अधर्मे unrighteousness, च and, महीतले on the surface of the earth, शुभानि auspicious things, एव only, आचरन् performing, लोकः people, सत्यधर्मपरायणः devoted to truth and righteousness.
explanation: Indeed, even when that untruth and unrighteousness had descended upon the earth, people devoted to truth and righteousness still performed only auspicious deeds.

shloka_text: त्रेतायुगे च वर्तन्ते ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रियाश्च ये । तपो ऽतप्यन्त ते सर्वे शुश्रूषामपरे जनाः ।। 7.74.20 ।।
transliteration: tretāyuge ca vartante brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāśca ye | tapo 'tapyanta te sarve śuśrūṣāmapare janāḥ || 7.74.20 ||
translation: त्रेतायुगे in the Treta Yuga, च and, वर्तन्ते existed, ब्राह्मणाः Brahmins, क्षत्रियाः Kshatriyas, च and, ये who, तपः penance, अतप्यन्त performed, ते they, सर्वे all, शुश्रूषाम् service, अपरे others, जनाः people.
explanation: In the Treta Yuga, all those Brahmins and Kshatriyas who existed performed penance, while other people performed service.

shloka_text: स धर्मः परमस्तेषां वैश्यशूद्रं समागमत् । पूजां च सर्ववर्णानां शूद्राश्चक्रुर्विशेषतः ।। 7.74.21 ।।
transliteration: sa dharmaḥ paramasteṣāṃ vaiśyaśūdraṃ samāgamat | pūjāṃ ca sarvavarṇānāṃ śūdrāścakrurviśeṣataḥ || 7.74.21 ||
translation: स that, धर्मः righteousness, परमः supreme, तेषाम् of them, वैश्यशूद्रम् to the Vaiśyas and Śūdras, समागमत् reached, पूजां worship, च and, सर्ववर्णानाम् of all castes, शूद्राः Śūdras, चक्रुः performed, विशेषतः especially.
explanation: That supreme righteousness, which was previously universal, now reached the Vaiśyas and Śūdras, and the Śūdras, in particular, began to perform worship for all castes.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तेषामधर्मे चानृते च ह । ततः पूर्वे भृशं ह्रासमगमन्नृपसत्तम ।। 7.74.22 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare teṣāmadharme cānṛte ca ha | tataḥ pūrve bhṛśaṃ hrāsamagamannṛpasattama || 7.74.22 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, तेषाम् of them, अधर्मे in unrighteousness, च and, अनृते in falsehood, च and, ह indeed, ततः then, पूर्वे the former (righteousness), भृशम् greatly, ह्रासम् diminution, अगमन् underwent, नृपसत्तम O best of kings.
explanation: O best of kings, in this interval, as unrighteousness and falsehood increased among the people, the former state of righteousness greatly diminished.

shloka_text: ततः पादमधर्मस्स द्वितीयमवतारयत् । ततो द्वापरसञ्ज्ञा ऽस्य युगस्य समजायत ।। 7.74.23 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pādamadharmassa dvitīyamavatārayat | tato dvāparasañjñā 'sya yugasya samajāyata || 7.74.23 ||
translation: ततः then, पादम् a quarter, अधर्मः unrighteousness, सः that, द्वितीयम् second, अवतारयत् manifested, ततः then, द्वापरसञ्ज्ञा the name Dvāpara, अस्य of this, युगस्य of the age, समजायत arose.
explanation: Then, unrighteousness manifested its second quarter, and consequently, this age came to be known as Dvāpara.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्द्वापरसञ्ज्ञे तु वर्तमाने युगक्षये । अधर्मश्चानृतं चैव ववृधे पुरुषर्षभ ।। 7.74.24 ।।
transliteration: tasmindvāparasañjñe tu vartamāne yugakṣaye | adharmaścānṛtaṃ caiva vavṛdhe puruṣarṣabha || 7.74.24 ||
translation: तस्मिन् in that, द्वापरसञ्ज्ञे named Dvāpara, तु indeed, वर्तमाने prevailing, युगक्षये in the decline of the age, अधर्मः unrighteousness, च and, अनृतम् falsehood, च and, एव indeed, ववृधे increased, पुरुषर्षभ O best of men.
explanation: O best of men, during the prevailing Dvāpara age, which marked a decline, both unrighteousness and falsehood greatly increased.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्द्वापरसङ्ख्याते तपो वैश्यान्समाविशत् । त्रिभ्यो युगेभ्यस्त्रीन्वर्णान्क्रमाद्वै तप आविशत् ।। 7.74.25 ।।
transliteration: tasmindvāparasaṅkhyāte tapo vaiśyānsamāviśat | tribhyo yugebhyastrīnvarṇānkramādvai tapa āviśat || 7.74.25 ||
translation: तस्मिन् in that, द्वापरसङ्ख्याते designated as Dvāpara, तपः austerity, वैश्यान् the Vaiśyas, समाविशत् entered, त्रिभ्यः from three, युगेभ्यः ages, त्रीन् three, वर्णान् castes, क्रमात् successively, वै indeed, तपः austerity, आविशत् entered.
explanation: In that age designated as Dvāpara, austerity entered the Vaiśyas, as indeed, austerity successively entered the three castes over the course of the three ages (Kṛta, Tretā, Dvāpara).

shloka_text: त्रिभ्यो युगेभ्यस्त्रीन्वर्णान्धर्मश्च परिनिष्ठितः । न शुद्धो लभते धर्मं युगतस्तु नरर्षभ । हीनवर्णो नृपश्रेष्ठ तप्यते सुमहत्तपः ।। 7.74.26 ।।
transliteration: tribhyo yugebhyastrīnvarṇāndharmaśca pariniṣṭhitaḥ | na śuddho labhate dharmaṃ yugatastu nararṣabha | hīnavarṇo nṛpaśreṣṭha tapyate sumahattapaḥ || 7.74.26 ||
translation: त्रिभ्यो from three, युगेभ्यः ages (Yugas), त्रीन् three, वर्णान् castes/classes, धर्मः righteousness/duty, च and, परिनिष्ठितः established/fixed. न not, शुद्धः a Shudra, लभते obtains/gets, धर्मम् religious merit/duty, युगतः according to the age, तु but, नरर्षभ O best among men (Rama). हीनवर्णः a person of lower caste, नृपश्रेष्ठ O best of kings (Rama), तप्यते performs penance, सुमहत् very great, तपः penance.
explanation: For the three ages (Krita, Treta, Dvapara), dharma is established for the three higher varnas, and a Shudra does not obtain religious merit by performing penance in these ages; yet, O best of kings, a person of lower caste is performing very great penance.

shloka_text: भविष्यच्छूद्रयोन्यां वै तपश्चर्या कलौ युगे । अधर्मः परमो राजन्द्वापरे शूद्रजन्मनः ।। 7.74.27 ।।
transliteration: bhaviṣyacchūdrayonyāṃ vai tapaścaryā kalau yuge | adharmaḥ paramo rājandvāpare śūdrajanmanaḥ || 7.74.27 ||
translation: भविष्यत् will be, शूद्रयोन्याम् in the Shudra caste, वै indeed, तपश्चर्या performance of penance, कलौ in the Kali, युगे age. अधर्मः unrighteousness, परमः supreme/greatest, राजन् O King, द्वापरे in the Dvapara, शूद्रजन्मनः for one born as a Shudra.
explanation: Indeed, the performance of penance by a Shudra will be permissible in the Kali Yuga, but in the Dvapara Yuga, O King, it is the greatest unrighteousness for one born as a Shudra.

shloka_text: स वै विषयपर्यन्ते तव राजन्महातपाः । अद्य तप्यति दुर्बुद्धिस्तेन बालवधो ह्ययम् ।। 7.74.28 ।।
transliteration: sa vai viṣayaparyante tava rājanmahātapāḥ | adya tapyati durbuddhistena bālavadho hyayam || 7.74.28 ||
translation: सः that (person), वै indeed, विषयपर्यन्ते at the border of your kingdom, तव your, राजन् O King, महातपाः great ascetic. अद्य today, तप्यति performs penance, दुर्बुद्धिः evil-minded/foolish, तेन by that, बालवधः child's death, हि indeed, अयम् this.
explanation: That very great ascetic, O King, is indeed performing penance today at the border of your kingdom, and it is by this foolish act that this child's death has occurred.

shloka_text: यो ह्यधर्ममकार्यं वा विषये पार्थिवस्य तु । करोति चाश्रीमूलं तत्पुरे वा दुर्मतिर्नरः । क्षिप्रं च नरकं याति स च राजा न संशयः ।। 7.74.29 ।।
transliteration: yo hyadharmamakāryaṃ vā viṣaye pārthivasya tu | karoti cāśrīmūlaṃ tatpure vā durmatirnaraḥ | kṣipraṃ ca narakaṃ yāti sa ca rājā na saṃśayaḥ || 7.74.29 ||
translation: यः who, हि indeed, अधर्मम् unrighteousness, अकार्यम् improper act, वा or, विषये in the kingdom, पार्थिवस्य of the king, तु but. करोति does, च and, अश्रीमूलम् root of misfortune, तत्पुरे in his city, वा or, दुर्मतिः evil-minded, नरः man. क्षिप्रम् quickly, च and, नरकम् to hell, याति goes, सः he, च and, राजा the king, न no, संशयः doubt.
explanation: Indeed, any evil-minded person who commits unrighteousness or an improper act, which is the root of misfortune, in the king's kingdom or city, quickly goes to hell, and so does the king, without a doubt.

shloka_text: अधीतस्य च तप्तस्य कर्मणः सुकृतस्य च । षष्ठं भजति भागं तु प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन् ।। 7.74.30 ।।
transliteration: adhītasya ca taptasya karmaṇaḥ sukṛtasya ca | ṣaṣṭhaṃ bhajati bhāgaṃ tu prajā dharmeṇa pālayan || 7.74.30 ||
translation: अधीतस्य of what is studied (Vedas), च and, तप्तस्य of what is performed (penance), कर्मणः of action, सुकृतस्य of good deeds, च and. षष्ठम् sixth, भजति obtains/enjoys, भागम् share, तु but, प्रजाः subjects, धर्मेण righteously, पालयन् protecting/governing.
explanation: A king who protects his subjects righteously obtains a sixth share of the merit from their Vedic studies, penance, and good deeds.

shloka_text: षङ्भागस्य न भोक्ता ऽसौ रक्षते न प्रजाः कथम् ।। 7.74.31 ।।
transliteration: ṣaṅbhāgasya na bhoktā 'sau rakṣate na prajāḥ katham || 7.74.31 ||
translation: षङ्भागस्य of the sixth part, न not, भोक्ता enjoyer, असौ he, रक्षते protects, न not, प्रजाः subjects, कथम् how
explanation: How can a king who does not protect his subjects be entitled to receive the sixth part of their produce as tax?

shloka_text: स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल मार्गस्व विषयं स्वकम् । दुष्कृतं यत्र पश्येथास्तत्र यत्नं समाचर ।। 7.74.32 ।।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ puruṣaśārdūla mārgasva viṣayaṃ svakam | duṣkṛtaṃ yatra paśyethāstatra yatnaṃ samācara || 7.74.32 ||
translation: स that, त्वं you, पुरुषशार्दूल O tiger among men, मार्गस्व search, विषयं realm, स्वकम् your own, दुष्कृतं evil deed, यत्र where, पश्येथाः you might see, तत्र there, यत्नं effort, समाचर undertake
explanation: O tiger among men, you should search your own kingdom, and wherever you find an evil deed, there you must make an effort to rectify it.

shloka_text: एवं चेद्धर्मवृद्धिश्च नृणां चायुर्विवर्धनम् । भविष्यति नरश्रेष्ठ बालस्यास्य च जीवितम् ।। 7.74.33 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ ceddharmavṛddhiśca nṛṇāṃ cāyurvivardhanam | bhaviṣyati naraśreṣṭha bālasyāsya ca jīvitam || 7.74.33 ||
translation: एवं thus, चेत् if, धर्मवृद्धिश्च and increase of righteousness, नृणां of men, च and, आयुर्विवर्धनम् increase of life span, भविष्यति will be, नरश्रेष्ठ O best of men, बालस्य of the child, अस्य this, च and, जीवितम् life
explanation: O best of men, if this is done, there will be an increase in righteousness and the lifespan of men, and this child's life will also be restored. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुःसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 74 ।। Thus ends the seventy-fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: नारदस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा ऽमृतमयं तदा । प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे लक्ष्मणं चेदमब्रवीत् ।। 7.75.1 ।।
transliteration: nāradasya tu tadvākyaṃ śrutvā 'mṛtamayaṃ tadā | praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe lakṣmaṇaṃ cedamabravīt || 7.75.1 ||
translation: नारदस्य of Narada, तु indeed, तद्वाक्यं that speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, अमृतमयं nectar-like, तदा then, प्रहर्षमतुलं immeasurable joy, लेभे obtained, लक्ष्मणं to Lakshmana, च and, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Then, having heard those nectar-like words of Narada, Rama obtained immeasurable joy and spoke this to Lakshmana.
comments: Rama has the child's body preserved in oil and, summoning the Pushpaka, sets out armed to search his realm -- finding no fault in the west, north or east, he comes south and beside a lake on Mount Shaivala sees an ascetic hanging head-down in fierce penance, and asks him who he is and of what caste.

shloka_text: गच्छ सौम्य द्विजश्रेष्ठं समाश्वासय सुव्रतम् । बालस्य तु शरीरं तत्तैलद्रोण्यां निधापय ।। 7.75.2 ।।
transliteration: gaccha saumya dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ samāśvāsaya suvratam | bālasya tu śarīraṃ tattailadroṇyāṃ nidhāpaya || 7.75.2 ||
translation: गच्छ go, सौम्य O gentle one, द्विजश्रेष्ठं the best of Brahmins, समाश्वासय console, सुव्रतम् the one of good vows, बालस्य of the child, तु indeed, शरीरं body, तत् that, तैलद्रोण्यां in a trough of oil, निधापय cause to be placed
explanation: O gentle one, go and console that best of Brahmins, the one of good vows, and have the child's body preserved in a trough of oil.

shloka_text: गन्धैश्च परमोदारैस्तैलैश्चापि सुगन्धिभिः । यथा न क्षीयते बालस्तथा सौम्य विधीयताम् ।। 7.75.3 ।।
transliteration: gandhaiśca paramodāraistailaiścāpi sugandhibhiḥ | yathā na kṣīyate bālastathā saumya vidhīyatām || 7.75.3 ||
translation: गन्धैः with fragrances, च and, परमोदारैः very excellent, तैलैः with oils, च and, अपि also, सुगन्धिभिः fragrant, यथा so that, न not, क्षीयते wastes away, बालः the child, तथा so, सौम्य O gentle one, विधीयताम् let it be done
explanation: O gentle one, let it be done with very excellent fragrances and fragrant oils so that the child does not waste away.

shloka_text: यथा शरीरो बालस्य गुप्तः सन् शिष्टकर्मणः । विपत्तिः परिभेदो वा न भवेच्च तथा कुरु ।। 7.75.4 ।।
transliteration: yathā śarīro bālasya guptaḥ san śiṣṭakarmaṇaḥ | vipattiḥ paribhedo vā na bhavecca tathā kuru || 7.75.4 ||
translation: यथा so that, शरीरः the body, बालस्य of the child, गुप्तः protected, सन् being, शिष्टकर्मणः of the well-behaved one, विपत्तिः misfortune, परिभेदः injury, वा or, न not, भवेत् may occur, च and, तथा so, कुरु do
explanation: Ensure that the body of the well-behaved child is protected so that no misfortune or injury may occur.

shloka_text: एवमादिश्य काकुत्स्थो लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम् । मनसा पुष्पकं दध्यावागच्छेति महायशाः ।। 7.75.5 ।।
transliteration: evamādiśya kākutstho lakṣmaṇaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam | manasā puṣpakaṃ dadhyāvāgaccheti mahāyaśāḥ || 7.75.5 ||
translation: एवम् thus, आदिश्य having instructed, काकुत्स्थः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, शुभलक्षणम् auspicious-featured, मनसा with his mind, पुष्पकम् the Pushpaka, दध्यौ meditated upon, आगच्छ come, इति thus, महायशाः the highly renowned one
explanation: Having thus instructed the auspicious-featured Lakshmana, the highly renowned Rama thought of the Pushpaka chariot in his mind, commanding it to come.

shloka_text: इङ्गितं स तु विज्ञाय पुष्पको हेमभूषितः । आजगाम मुहूर्तेन समीपे राघवस्य वै ।। 7.75.6 ।।
transliteration: iṅgitaṃ sa tu vijñāya puṣpako hemabhūṣitaḥ | ājagāma muhūrtena samīpe rāghavasya vai || 7.75.6 ||
translation: इङ्गितम् the hint, सः it, तु indeed, विज्ञाय having understood, पुष्पकः the Pushpaka, हेमभूषितः adorned with gold, आजगाम came, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, समीपे near, राघवस्य of Rama, वै indeed
explanation: Indeed, having understood Rama's mental signal, the gold-adorned Pushpaka chariot arrived near Rama in a moment.

shloka_text: सो ऽब्रवीत्प्रणतो भूत्वा अयमस्मि नराधिप । वश्यस्तव महाबाहो किङ्करः समुपस्थितः ।। 7.75.7 ।।
transliteration: so 'bravītpraṇato bhūtvā ayamasmi narādhipa | vaśyastava mahābāho kiṅkaraḥ samupasthitaḥ || 7.75.7 ||
translation: सः it, अब्रवीत् spoke, प्रणतः bowed, भूत्वा having become, अयम् this, अस्मि I am, नराधिप O king of men, वश्यः obedient, तव your, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, किङ्करः servant, समुपस्थितः present
explanation: Having bowed, the Pushpaka spoke, "O king of men, O mighty-armed one, I am your obedient servant, present here."

shloka_text: भाषितं रुचिरं श्रुत्वा पुष्पकस्य नराधिपः । अभिवाद्य महर्षींस्तान् विमानं सो ऽध्यरोहत ।। 7.75.8 ।।
transliteration: bhāṣitaṃ ruciraṃ śrutvā puṣpakasya narādhipaḥ | abhivādya maharṣīṃstān vimānaṃ so 'dhyarohata || 7.75.8 ||
translation: भाषितं spoken words, रुचिरं pleasing, श्रुत्वा having heard, पुष्पकस्य of Pushpaka, नराधिपः the king, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महर्षींस्तान् those great sages, विमानं the aerial chariot, सः he, अध्यरोहत ascended.
explanation: Having heard the pleasing words of Pushpaka, the king (Rama) saluted those great sages and then ascended the aerial chariot.

shloka_text: धनुर्गृहीत्वा तूणी च खड्गं च रुचिरप्रभम् । निक्षिप्य नगरे वीरौ सौमित्रिभरतावुभौ ।। 7.75.9 ।।
transliteration: dhanurgṛhītvā tūṇī ca khaḍgaṃ ca ruciraprabham | nikṣipya nagare vīrau saumitribharatāvubhau || 7.75.9 ||
translation: धनुः bow, गृहीत्वा having taken, तूणी quiver, च and, खड्गं sword, च and, रुचिरप्रभम् of beautiful luster, निक्षिप्य having left, नगरे in the city, वीरौ the two heroes, सौमित्रिभरतौ Lakshmana and Bharata, उभौ both.
explanation: Having taken his bow, quiver, and a beautifully shining sword, and having left both heroes Lakshmana and Bharata in the city, (Rama proceeded).

shloka_text: प्रायात्प्रतीचीं हरितं विचिन्वंश्च ततस्ततः । उत्तरामगमच्छ्रीमान्दिशं हिमवता वृताम् ।। 7.75.10 ।।
transliteration: prāyātpratīcīṃ haritaṃ vicinvaṃśca tatastataḥ | uttarāmagamacchrīmāndiśaṃ himavatā vṛtām || 7.75.10 ||
translation: प्रायात् he went, प्रतीचीं western, हरितं direction, विचिन्वंश्च and searching, ततस्ततः here and there, उत्तराम northern, अगमत् he went, श्रीमान् the glorious one, दिशं direction, हिमवता by the Himalayas, वृताम् covered.
explanation: The glorious Rama proceeded to the western direction, searching everywhere, and then went to the northern direction, which is covered by the Himalayas.

shloka_text: अपश्यमानस्तत्रापि स्वल्पमप्यथ दुष्कृतम् । पूर्वामपि दिशं सर्वामथो ऽपश्यन्नराधिपः ।। 7.75.11 ।।
transliteration: apaśyamānastatrāpi svalpamapyatha duṣkṛtam | pūrvāmapi diśaṃ sarvāmatho 'paśyannarādhipaḥ || 7.75.11 ||
translation: अपश्यमानः not seeing, तत्रापि even there, स्वल्पमपि even a little, अथ then, दुष्कृतम् evil deed, पूर्वामपि even the eastern, दिशं direction, सर्वाम् entire, अथो then, अपश्यत् he saw, नराधिपः the king.
explanation: Not finding even a slight evil deed there (in the north), the king then surveyed the entire eastern direction as well.

shloka_text: प्रविशुद्धसमाचारामादर्शतलनिर्मलाम् । पुष्पकस्थो महाबाहुस्तदापश्यन्नराधिपः ।। 7.75.12 ।।
transliteration: praviśuddhasamācārāmādarśatalanirmalām | puṣpakastho mahābāhustadāpaśyannarādhipaḥ || 7.75.12 ||
translation: प्रविशुद्धसमाचाराम् whose conduct was perfectly pure, आदर्शतलनिर्मलाम् as clear as the surface of a mirror, पुष्पकस्थः seated in Pushpaka, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, तदा then, अपश्यत् he saw, नराधिपः the king.
explanation: Seated in Pushpaka, the mighty-armed king then saw (the entire land) whose conduct was perfectly pure and as clear as the surface of a mirror.

shloka_text: दक्षिणां दिशमाक्रामत्ततो राजर्षिनन्दनः । शैवलस्योत्तरे पार्श्वे ददर्श सुमहत्सरः ।। 7.75.13 ।।
transliteration: dakṣiṇāṃ diśamākrāmattato rājarṣinandanaḥ | śaivalasyottare pārśve dadarśa sumahatsaraḥ || 7.75.13 ||
translation: दक्षिणां southern, दिशम् direction, आक्रामत् proceeded, ततः then, राजर्षिनन्दनः the son of the royal sage (Rama), शैवलस्य of Shaivala, उत्तरे northern, पार्श्वे side, ददर्श saw, सुमहत् very large, सरः lake.
explanation: Then, Rama, the son of the royal sage, proceeded towards the southern direction and on the northern side of Shaivala, he saw a very large lake.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्सरसि तप्यन्तं तापसं सुमहत्तपः । ददर्श राघवः श्रीमाँल्लम्बमानमधोमुखम् ।। 7.75.14 ।।
transliteration: tasminsarasi tapyantaṃ tāpasaṃ sumahattapaḥ | dadarśa rāghavaḥ śrīmāँllambamānamadhomukham || 7.75.14 ||
translation: तस्मिन् in that, सरसि lake, तप्यन्तं performing penance, तापसं an ascetic, सुमहत् very great, तपः penance, ददर्श saw, राघवः Rama, श्रीमान् glorious, लम्बमानम् hanging, अधोमुखम् head downwards.
explanation: In that lake, the glorious Rama saw an ascetic performing very great penance, hanging head downwards.

shloka_text: राघवस्तमुपागम्य तप्यन्तं तप उत्तमम् । उवाच स तदा वाक्यं धन्यस्त्वमसि सुव्रत ।। 7.75.15 ।।
transliteration: rāghavastamupāgamya tapyantaṃ tapa uttamam | uvāca sa tadā vākyaṃ dhanyastvamasi suvrata || 7.75.15 ||
translation: राघवः Rama, तम् him, उपागम्य having approached, तप्यन्तं performing, तपः penance, उत्तमम् excellent, उवाच said, सः he, तदा then, वाक्यं words, धन्यः blessed, त्वम् you, असि are, सुव्रत O ascetic of good vows.
explanation: Rama, having approached him who was performing excellent penance, then spoke these words: "O ascetic of good vows, you are blessed."

shloka_text: कस्यां योन्यां तपोवृद्ध वर्तसे दृढविक्रम । कौतूहलात्त्वां पृच्छामि रामो दाशरथिर्ह्यहम् ।। 7.75.16 ।।
transliteration: kasyāṃ yonyāṃ tapovṛddha vartase dṛḍhavikrama | kautūhalāttvāṃ pṛcchāmi rāmo dāśarathirhyaham || 7.75.16 ||
translation: कस्यां in which, योन्यां birth/species, तपोवृद्ध O venerable ascetic, वर्तसे you are, दृढविक्रम O one of firm resolve, कौतूहलात् out of curiosity, त्वां you, पृच्छामि I ask, रामः Rama, दाशरथिः son of Dasharatha, हि indeed, अहम् I.
explanation: "O venerable ascetic, in which birth or species do you exist, O one of firm resolve? I ask you out of curiosity, for I am Rama, the son of Dasharatha."

shloka_text: को ऽर्थो मनीषितस्तुभ्यं स्वर्गलाभः परो ऽथवा । वराश्रयो यदर्थं त्वं तपस्यसि सुदुष्करम् । यमाश्रित्य तपस्तप्तं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तापस ।। 7.75.17 ।।
transliteration: ko 'rtho manīṣitastubhyaṃ svargalābhaḥ paro 'thavā | varāśrayo yadarthaṃ tvaṃ tapasyasi suduṣkaram | yamāśritya tapastaptaṃ śrotumicchāmi tāpasa || 7.75.17 ||
translation: कः what, अर्थः purpose, मनीषितः desired, तुभ्यं by you, स्वर्गलाभः attainment of heaven, परः supreme/other, अथवा or, वर boon, आश्रयः object/support, यदर्थं for which purpose, त्वं you, तपस्यसि perform penance, सुदुष्करम् very difficult, यम् whom/which, आश्रित्य having resorted to, तपः penance, तप्तं performed, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छामि I wish, तापस O ascetic.
explanation: "What is the purpose desired by you, is it the attainment of heaven or some other supreme boon, for which you are performing this very difficult penance, O ascetic? I wish to hear what you have resorted to for performing this penance."

shloka_text: ब्राह्मणो वा ऽसि भद्रं ते क्षत्रियो वा ऽसि दुर्जयः । वैश्यस्तृतीयवर्णो वा शूद्रो वा सत्यवाग्भव ।। 7.75.18 ।।
transliteration: brāhmaṇo vā 'si bhadraṃ te kṣatriyo vā 'si durjayaḥ | vaiśyastṛtīyavarṇo vā śūdro vā satyavāgbhava || 7.75.18 ||
translation: ब्राह्मणो A Brahmana, वा or, ऽसि you are, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, क्षत्रियो A Kshatriya, वा or, ऽसि you are, दुर्जयः unconquerable, वैश्यस्तृतीयवर्णो A Vaishya, the third varna, वा or, शूद्रो A Shudra, वा or, सत्यवाग्भव be truthful.
explanation: Rama asks the ascetic to truthfully state his varna, whether he is a Brahmana, a Kshatriya, a Vaishya, or a Shudra, wishing him well regardless.

shloka_text: इत्येवमुक्तः स नराधिपेन ह्यवाक्छिरा दाशरथाय तस्मै । उवाच जातिं नृपपुङ्गवाय यत्कारणे चैव तपःप्रयत्नः ।। 7.75.19 ।।
transliteration: ityevamuktaḥ sa narādhipena hyavākchirā dāśarathāya tasmai | uvāca jātiṃ nṛpapuṅgavāya yatkāraṇe caiva tapaḥprayatnaḥ || 7.75.19 ||
translation: इत्येवमुक्तः thus spoken to, स he, नराधिपेन by the king, ह्यवाक्छिरा with head bowed down, दाशरथाय to Dasharatha's son (Rama), तस्मै to him, उवाच spoke, जातिं his caste, नृपपुङ्गवाय to the best of kings, यत्कारणे for what reason, च and, एव indeed, तपःप्रयत्नः the effort of penance.
explanation: Thus addressed by the king, the ascetic, with his head bowed, revealed his caste and the reason for his severe penance to Rama, the best of kings. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 75 ।। Thus ends the seventy-fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः । अवाक्छिरास्तथाभूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.76.1 ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ | avākchirāstathābhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.76.1 ||
translation: तस्य his, तद्वचनं that speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः of Rama, whose deeds are unblemished, अवाक्छिरास्तथाभूत्वा having become thus with head bowed down, वाक्यमेतदुवाच spoke this statement, ह indeed.
explanation: Having heard those words of Rama, whose deeds are unblemished, the ascetic, with his head still bowed, then spoke the following words.
comments: The ascetic declares himself Shambuka, a Shudra seeking heaven in his own body by penance, and Rama draws his sword and beheads him, the gods raining flowers -- offered a boon, Rama asks that the brahmin's son be revived, and learns the boy lived again the moment Shambuka fell -- Rama then visits Agastya, who gives him a divine ornament and, when Rama hesitates to accept a brahmin's gift, explains its lawfulness and begins its tale.

shloka_text: शूद्रयोन्यां प्रसूतो ऽस्मि शम्बूको नाम नामतः । देवत्वं पार्थये राम सशरीरो महायशः ।। 7.76.2 ।।
transliteration: śūdrayonyāṃ prasūto 'smi śambūko nāma nāmataḥ | devatvaṃ pārthaye rāma saśarīro mahāyaśaḥ || 7.76.2 ||
translation: शूद्रयोन्यां in a Shudra womb, प्रसूतो born, ऽस्मि I am, शम्बूको Shambuka, नाम named, नामतः by name, देवत्वं divinity, पार्थये I seek, राम O Rama, सशरीरो with my body, महायशः O greatly renowned one.
explanation: The ascetic declared that he was born in a Shudra family, named Shambuka, and that he sought to attain divinity with his physical body, O greatly renowned Rama.

shloka_text: न मिथ्या ऽहं वदे राम देवलोकजिगीषया । शूद्रं मां विद्धि काकुत्स्थ तप उग्रं समास्थितम् ।। 7.76.3 ।।
transliteration: na mithyā 'haṃ vade rāma devalokajigīṣayā | śūdraṃ māṃ viddhi kākutstha tapa ugraṃ samāsthitam || 7.76.3 ||
translation: न not, मिथ्या falsely, ऽहं I, वदे speak, राम O Rama, देवलोकजिगीषया with the desire to conquer the world of gods, शूद्रं a Shudra, मां me, विद्धि know, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, तप penance, उग्रं severe, समास्थितम् engaged in.
explanation: Shambuka affirmed to Rama that he was not speaking falsely out of a desire to conquer the world of gods, and asked Rama to know him as a Shudra engaged in severe penance.

shloka_text: भाषतस्तस्य शूद्रस्य खड्गं सुरुचिरप्रभम् । निष्कृष्य कोशाद्विमलं शिरश्चिच्छेद राघवः ।। 7.76.4 ।।
transliteration: bhāṣatastasya śūdrasya khaḍgaṃ suruciraprabham | niṣkṛṣya kośādvimalaṃ śiraściccheda rāghavaḥ || 7.76.4 ||
translation: भाषतः while speaking, तस्य of that, शूद्रस्य of the Shudra, खड्गं sword, सुरुचिरप्रभम् of very beautiful luster, निष्कृष्य having drawn out, कोशात् from the sheath, विमलम् spotless, शिरः head, चिच्छेद cut off, राघवः Rama.
explanation: Rama, having drawn his spotless sword of very beautiful luster from its sheath, cut off the head of that Shudra while he was speaking.

shloka_text: तस्मिञ्छूद्रे हते देवाः सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः । साधु साध्विति काकुत्स्थं प्रशशंसुर्मुहुर्मुहुः ।। 7.76.5 ।।
transliteration: tasmiñchūdre hate devāḥ sendrāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ | sādhu sādhviti kākutsthaṃ praśaśaṃsurmuhurmuhuḥ || 7.76.5 ||
translation: तस्मिन् that, शूद्रे Shudra, हते having been killed, देवाः gods, सेन्द्राः with Indra, साग्निपुरोगमाः with Agni as their leader, साधु साधु इति "Excellent! Excellent!" thus, काकुत्स्थं Rama, प्रशशंसुः praised, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again.
explanation: When that Shudra was killed, the gods, led by Indra and Agni, repeatedly praised Rama, exclaiming "Excellent! Excellent!"

shloka_text: पुष्पवृष्टिर्महत्यासीद्दिव्यानां सुसुगन्धिनाम् । पुष्पाणां वायुमुक्तानां सर्वतः प्रपपात ह ।। 7.76.6 ।।
transliteration: puṣpavṛṣṭirmahatyāsīddivyānāṃ susugandhinām | puṣpāṇāṃ vāyumuktānāṃ sarvataḥ prapapāta ha || 7.76.6 ||
translation: पुष्पवृष्टिः shower of flowers, महती great, आसीत् was, दिव्यानाम् divine, सुसुगन्धिनाम् very fragrant, पुष्पाणाम् of flowers, वायुमुक्तानाम् released by the wind, सर्वतः from all sides, प्रपपात ह fell down indeed.
explanation: A great shower of divine, very fragrant flowers, released by the wind, fell down from all sides.

shloka_text: सुप्रीताश्चाब्रुवन्रामं देवाः सत्यपराक्रमम् । सुरकार्यमिदं सौम्य सुकृतं ते महामते ।। 7.76.7 ।।
transliteration: suprītāścābruvanrāmaṃ devāḥ satyaparākramam | surakāryamidaṃ saumya sukṛtaṃ te mahāmate || 7.76.7 ||
translation: सुप्रीताः very pleased, च and, अब्रुवन् said, रामं to Rama, देवाः gods, सत्यपराक्रमम् of true valor, सुरकार्यम् work of the gods, इदम् this, सौम्य O gentle one, सुकृतम् well done, ते by you, महामते O great-minded one.
explanation: The very pleased gods then said to Rama, the one of true valor, "O gentle and great-minded one, this task for the gods has been well accomplished by you."

shloka_text: गृहाण च वरं सौम्य यत्त्वमिच्छस्यरिन्दम । स्वर्गभाङ्नहि शूद्रो ऽयं त्वत्कृते रघुनन्दन ।। 7.76.8 ।।
transliteration: gṛhāṇa ca varaṃ saumya yattvamicchasyarindama | svargabhāṅnahi śūdro 'yaṃ tvatkṛte raghunandana || 7.76.8 ||
translation: गृहाण accept, च and, वरम् boon, सौम्य O gentle one, यत् which, त्वम् you, इच्छसि desire, अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies, स्वर्गभाक् partaker of heaven, न not, हि indeed, शूद्रः Shudra, अयम् this, त्वत्कृते because of you, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: "O gentle one, subduer of enemies, and delight of the Raghus, accept any boon you desire, for this Shudra will certainly not attain heaven because of your action."

shloka_text: देवानां भाषितं श्रुत्वा राघवः सुसमाहितः । उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं सहस्राक्षं पुरन्दरम् ।। 7.76.9 ।।
transliteration: devānāṃ bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā rāghavaḥ susamāhitaḥ | uvāca prāñjalirvākyaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ purandaram || 7.76.9 ||
translation: देवानां of the gods, भाषितं speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, राघवः Rama, सुसमाहितः very attentive, उवाच spoke, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, वाक्यं words, सहस्राक्षं to the thousand-eyed one, पुरन्दरम् to the destroyer of cities.
explanation: Having heard the words of the gods, Rama, composed and with folded hands, spoke to Indra, the thousand-eyed destroyer of cities.

shloka_text: यदि देवाः प्रसन्ना मे द्विजपुत्रः स जीवतु । दिशन्तु वरमेतं मे इप्सितं परमं मम ।। 7.76.10 ।।
transliteration: yadi devāḥ prasannā me dvijaputraḥ sa jīvatu | diśantu varametaṃ me ipsitaṃ paramaṃ mama || 7.76.10 ||
translation: यदि if, देवाः gods, प्रसन्नाः pleased, मे with me, द्विजपुत्रः the son of the brahmin, सः he, जीवतु may live, दिशन्तु may they grant, वरम् boon, एतम् this, मे to me, इप्सितं desired, परमं supreme, मम my.
explanation: Rama requested that if the gods were pleased with him, they should grant his greatest desire: that the brahmin's son be brought back to life.

shloka_text: ममापचाराद्यातो ऽसौ ब्राह्मणस्यैकपुत्रकः । अप्राप्तकालः कालेन नीतो वैवस्वतक्षयम् ।। 7.76.11 ।।
transliteration: mamāpacārādyāto 'sau brāhmaṇasyaikaputrakaḥ | aprāptakālaḥ kālena nīto vaivasvatakṣayam || 7.76.11 ||
translation: मम my, अपचारात् due to fault, यातः gone, असौ that, ब्राह्मणस्य of the brahmin, एकपुत्रकः only son, अप्राप्तकालः whose time had not come, कालेन by time, नीतः taken, वैवस्वतक्षयम् to the abode of Yama.
explanation: Rama declared that the brahmin's only son, whose time had not yet come, was taken to Yama's abode due to Rama's own transgression.

shloka_text: तं जीवयथ भद्रं वो नानृतं कर्तुमर्हथ । द्विजस्य संश्रुतो ऽर्थो मे जीवयिष्यामि ते सुतम् ।। 7.76.12 ।।
transliteration: taṃ jīvayatha bhadraṃ vo nānṛtaṃ kartumarhatha | dvijasya saṃśruto 'rtho me jīvayiṣyāmi te sutam || 7.76.12 ||
translation: तं him, जीवयथ you revive, भद्रं welfare, वः to you, न not, अनृतं untruth, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हथ you ought, द्विजस्य to the brahmin, संश्रुतः promised, अर्थः word, मे by me, जीवयिष्यामि I shall revive, ते your, सुतम् son.
explanation: Rama urged the gods to revive the child, wishing them well, and reminded them that he had promised the brahmin to bring his son back to life, thus he could not allow his word to be false.

shloka_text: राघवस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा विबुधसत्तमाः । प्रत्युचू राघवं प्रीता देवाः प्रीतिसमन्वितम् ।। 7.76.13 ।।
transliteration: rāghavasya tu tadvākyaṃ śrutvā vibudhasattamāḥ | pratyucū rāghavaṃ prītā devāḥ prītisamanvitam || 7.76.13 ||
translation: राघवस्य of Rama, तु indeed, तत् that, वाक्यं speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, विबुधसत्तमाः the best among the gods, प्रत्युचू replied, राघवम् to Rama, प्रीताः pleased, देवाः gods, प्रीतिसमन्वितम् filled with affection.
explanation: Having heard Rama's words, the best among the gods, pleased and filled with affection, replied to Rama.

shloka_text: निर्वृतो भव काकुत्स्थ सो ऽस्मिन्नहनि बालकः । जीवितं प्राप्तवान्भूयः समेतश्चापि बन्धुभिः ।। 7.76.14 ।।
transliteration: nirvṛto bhava kākutstha so 'sminnahani bālakaḥ | jīvitaṃ prāptavānbhūyaḥ sametaścāpi bandhubhiḥ || 7.76.14 ||
translation: निर्वृतो be relieved, भव be, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, सः that, अस्मिन् in this, अहनि day, बालकः boy, जीवितं life, प्राप्तवान् obtained, भूयः again, समेतः united, च and, अपि also, बन्धुभिः with relatives
explanation: O Kakutstha, be relieved, for that boy has regained his life and is reunited with his relatives this very day.

shloka_text: यस्मिन्मुहूर्ते काकुत्स्थ शूद्रो ऽयं विनिपातितः । तस्मिन्मुहूर्ते बालो ऽसौ जीवेन समयुज्यत ।। 7.76.15 ।।
transliteration: yasminmuhūrte kākutstha śūdro 'yaṃ vinipātitaḥ | tasminmuhūrte bālo 'sau jīvena samayujyata || 7.76.15 ||
translation: यस्मिन् in which, मुहूर्ते moment, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, शूद्रः Shudra, अयं this, विनिपातितः was killed, तस्मिन् in that, मुहूर्ते moment, बालः boy, असौ that, जीवेन with life, समयुज्यत was united
explanation: O Kakutstha, the very moment this Shudra was struck down, that boy was reunited with his life.

shloka_text: स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि भद्रं ते साधु याम नरर्षभ । अगस्त्यस्याश्रमपदं द्रष्टुमिच्छाम राघव ।। 7.76.16 ।।
transliteration: svasti prāpnuhi bhadraṃ te sādhu yāma nararṣabha | agastyasyāśramapadaṃ draṣṭumicchāma rāghava || 7.76.16 ||
translation: स्वस्ति well-being, प्राप्नुहि obtain, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, साधु well, याम let us go, नरर्षभ O best among men, अगस्त्यस्य of Agastya, आश्रमपदं hermitage, द्रष्टुं to see, इच्छाम we wish, राघव O Raghava
explanation: May you obtain well-being, O best among men, and may good fortune be yours; we wish to go and see the hermitage of Agastya, O Raghava.

shloka_text: तस्य दीक्षा समाप्ता हि ब्रह्मर्षेः सुमहाद्युतेः । द्वादशं हि गतं वर्षं जलशय्यां समासतः ।। 7.76.17 ।।
transliteration: tasya dīkṣā samāptā hi brahmarṣeḥ sumahādyuteḥ | dvādaśaṃ hi gataṃ varṣaṃ jalaśayyāṃ samāsataḥ || 7.76.17 ||
translation: तस्य his, सुमहाद्युतेः of great splendour, ब्रह्मर्षेः of the brahmin-sage, दीक्षा the consecratory vow, समाप्ता हि is indeed completed, जलशय्यां on a bed of water, समासतः as he abode, द्वादशं वर्षम् the twelfth year, गतं हि has now passed.
explanation: The consecratory vow of that brahmin-sage of great splendour is now completed, for the twelfth year has passed as he lay abiding upon a bed of water.

shloka_text: काकुत्स्थ तद्गमिष्यामो मुनिं समभिनन्दितुम् । त्वं चाप्यागच्छ भद्रं ते द्रष्टुं तमृषिसत्तमम् ।। 7.76.18 ।।
transliteration: kākutstha tadgamiṣyāmo muniṃ samabhinanditum | tvaṃ cāpyāgaccha bhadraṃ te draṣṭuṃ tamṛṣisattamam || 7.76.18 ||
translation: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, तत् therefore, गमिष्यामः we shall go, मुनिं the sage, समभिनन्दितुम् to greet, त्वं you, च and, अपि also, आगच्छ come, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, द्रष्टुं to see, तं that, ऋषिसत्तमम् best of sages
explanation: O Kakutstha, we shall therefore go to greet that sage, and you too should come, for your welfare, to see that best of sages.

shloka_text: स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय देवानां रघुनन्दनः । आरुरोह विमानं तं पुष्पकं हेमभूषितम् ।। 7.76.19 ।।
transliteration: sa tatheti pratijñāya devānāṃ raghunandanaḥ | āruroha vimānaṃ taṃ puṣpakaṃ hemabhūṣitam || 7.76.19 ||
translation: सः he, तथा so, इति thus, प्रतिज्ञाय having promised, देवानां of the gods, रघुनन्दनः Rama, आरुरोह ascended, विमानं aerial chariot, तं that, पुष्पकं Pushpaka, हेमभूषितम् adorned with gold
explanation: Having thus agreed to the words of the gods, Rama, the delight of the Raghus, ascended that Pushpaka aerial chariot, which was adorned with gold.

shloka_text: ततो देवाः प्रयातास्ते विमानैर्बहुविस्तरैः । रामो ऽप्यनुजगामाशु कुम्भयोनेस्तपोवनम् ।। 7.76.20 ।।
transliteration: tato devāḥ prayātāste vimānairbahuvistaraiḥ | rāmo 'pyanujagāmāśu kumbhayonestapovanam || 7.76.20 ||
translation: ततः then, देवाः the gods, प्रयाताः departed, ते they, विमानैः by aerial chariots, बहुविस्तरैः very extensive, रामः Rama, अपि also, अनुजगाम followed, आशु quickly, कुम्भयोनेः of Agastya, तपोवनम् to the hermitage.
explanation: Then, the gods departed in their vast aerial chariots, and Rama also quickly followed them to the hermitage of Agastya.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा तु देवान्सम्प्राप्तानगस्त्यस्तपसां निधिः । अर्चयामास धर्मात्मा सर्वांस्तानविशेषतः ।। 7.76.21 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tu devānsamprāptānagastyastapasāṃ nidhiḥ | arcayāmāsa dharmātmā sarvāṃstānaviśeṣataḥ || 7.76.21 ||
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, तु indeed, देवान् the gods, सम्प्राप्तान् who had arrived, अगस्त्यः Agastya, तपसाम् of austerities, निधिः a treasure, अर्चयामास worshipped, धर्मात्मा the righteous-souled one, सर्वान् all, तान् them, अविशेषतः without distinction.
explanation: Upon seeing the arrived gods, the righteous Agastya, a treasure-house of austerities, worshipped all of them equally without distinction.

shloka_text: प्रतिगृह्य ततः पूजां सम्पूज्य च महामुनिम् । जग्मुस्ते त्रिदशा हृष्टा नाकपृष्ठं सहानुगैः ।। 7.76.22 ।।
transliteration: pratigṛhya tataḥ pūjāṃ sampūjya ca mahāmunim | jagmuste tridaśā hṛṣṭā nākapṛṣṭhaṃ sahānugaiḥ || 7.76.22 ||
translation: प्रतिगृह्य having accepted, ततः then, पूजां the worship, सम्पूज्य and having honored, च and, महामुनिम् the great sage, जग्मुः went, ते they, त्रिदशाः the gods, हृष्टाः delighted, नाकपृष्ठम् to heaven, सहानुगैः with their followers.
explanation: Having accepted the worship and honored the great sage, the delighted gods then departed to heaven with their followers.

shloka_text: गतेषु तेषु काकुत्स्थः पुष्पकादवरुह्य च । ततो ऽभिवादयामास ह्यगस्त्यमृषिसत्तमम् ।। 7.76.23 ।।
transliteration: gateṣu teṣu kākutsthaḥ puṣpakādavaruhya ca | tato 'bhivādayāmāsa hyagastyamṛṣisattamam || 7.76.23 ||
translation: गतेषु when they had gone, तेषु those (gods), काकुत्स्थः Rama, पुष्पकात् from the Pushpaka (chariot), अवरुह्य having descended, च and, ततः then, अभिवादयामास bowed down to, हि indeed, अगस्त्यम् Agastya, ऋषिसत्तमम् the best of sages.
explanation: After the gods had departed, Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, descended from the Pushpaka chariot and then saluted Agastya, the foremost of sages.

shloka_text: सो ऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा । आतिथ्यं परमं प्राप्य निषसाद नराधिपः ।। 7.76.24 ।।
transliteration: so 'bhivādya mahātmānaṃ jvalantamiva tejasā | ātithyaṃ paramaṃ prāpya niṣasāda narādhipaḥ || 7.76.24 ||
translation: सः he (Rama), अभिवाद्य having saluted, महात्मानम् the great-souled one (Agastya), ज्वलन्तम् shining, इव as if, तेजसा with brilliance, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, परमम् excellent, प्राप्य having received, निषसाद sat down, नराधिपः the king of men (Rama).
explanation: Having saluted the great-souled Agastya, who shone as if with brilliance, and having received excellent hospitality, the king of men, Rama, then sat down.

shloka_text: तमुवाच महातेजाः कुम्भयोनिर्महातपाः । स्वागतं ते नरश्रेष्ठ दिष्ट्या प्राप्तो ऽसि राघव ।। 7.76.25 ।।
transliteration: tamuvāca mahātejāḥ kumbhayonirmahātapāḥ | svāgataṃ te naraśreṣṭha diṣṭyā prāpto 'si rāghava || 7.76.25 ||
translation: तम् him, उवाच said, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent one, कुम्भयोनिः Agastya, महातपाः the great ascetic, स्वागतम् welcome, ते to you, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, दिष्ट्या fortunately, प्राप्तो ऽसि you have arrived, राघव O scion of Raghu
explanation: The greatly effulgent and great ascetic Agastya said to him, "Welcome to you, O best among men, O scion of Raghu, fortunately you have arrived."

shloka_text: त्वं मे बहुमतो राम गुणैर्बहुभिरुत्तमैः । अतिथिः पूजनीयश्च मम नित्यं हृदि स्थितः ।। 7.76.26 ।।
transliteration: tvaṃ me bahumato rāma guṇairbahubhiruttamaiḥ | atithiḥ pūjanīyaśca mama nityaṃ hṛdi sthitaḥ || 7.76.26 ||
translation: त्वम् you, मे by me, बहुमतः highly esteemed, राम O Rama, गुणैः by qualities, बहुभिः many, उत्तमैः excellent, अतिथिः a guest, पूजनीयश्च and worthy of worship, मम my, नित्यम् always, हृदि in the heart, स्थितः residing
explanation: O Rama, you are highly esteemed by me for your many excellent qualities, and you are a guest worthy of worship, always residing in my heart.

shloka_text: सुरा हि कथयन्ति त्वामागतं शूद्रघातिनम् । ब्राह्मणस्य तु धर्मेण त्वया जीवापितः सुतः ।। 7.76.27 ।।
transliteration: surā hi kathayanti tvāmāgataṃ śūdraghātinam | brāhmaṇasya tu dharmeṇa tvayā jīvāpitaḥ sutaḥ || 7.76.27 ||
translation: सुराः the gods, हि indeed, कथयन्ति speak, त्वाम् of you, आगतम् having come, शूद्रघातिनम् as the slayer of a Shudra, ब्राह्मणस्य of a Brahmin, तु but, धर्मेण by righteousness, त्वया by you, जीवापितः made alive, सुतः the son
explanation: Indeed, the gods speak of you as having come after slaying the Shudra (Shambuka), and by your righteous action, the Brahmin's son was brought back to life.

shloka_text: उष्यतां चेह रजनी सकाशे मम राघव । प्रभाते पुष्पकेण त्वं गन्ता ऽसि पुरमेव हि ।। 7.76.28 ।।
transliteration: uṣyatāṃ ceha rajanī sakāśe mama rāghava | prabhāte puṣpakeṇa tvaṃ gantā 'si purameva hi || 7.76.28 ||
translation: उष्यताम् let it be stayed, च and, इह here, रजनी the night, सकाशे near, मम my, राघव O scion of Raghu, प्रभाते in the morning, पुष्पकेण by the Pushpaka, त्वम् you, गन्ता ऽसि will go, पुरम् to the city, एव indeed, हि certainly
explanation: O scion of Raghu, please stay here for the night near me, and in the morning, you will certainly go to your city by the Pushpaka chariot.

shloka_text: त्वं हि नारायणः श्रीमांस्त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् । त्वं प्रभुः सर्वदेवानां पुरुषस्त्वं सनातनः ।। 7.76.29 ।।
transliteration: tvaṃ hi nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmāṃstvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | tvaṃ prabhuḥ sarvadevānāṃ puruṣastvaṃ sanātanaḥ || 7.76.29 ||
translation: त्वम् you, हि indeed, नारायणः Narayana, श्रीमान् the glorious one, त्वयि in you, सर्वम् everything, प्रतिष्ठितम् is established, त्वम् you, प्रभुः the lord, सर्वदेवानाम् of all gods, पुरुषः the being, त्वम् you, सनातनः the eternal
explanation: Indeed, you are the glorious Narayana, in whom everything is established; you are the lord of all gods, and you are the eternal being.

shloka_text: इदं चाभरणं सौम्य निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा । दिव्यं दिव्येन वपुषा दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा । प्रतिगृह्णीष्व काकुत्स्थ मत्प्रियं कुरु राघव ।। 7.76.30 ।।
