transliteration: idaṃ cābharaṇaṃ saumya nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā | divyaṃ divyena vapuṣā dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā | pratigṛhṇīṣva kākutstha matpriyaṃ kuru rāghava || 7.76.30 ||
translation: इदं this, च and, आभरणं ornament, सौम्य O gentle one, निर्मितं created, विश्वकर्मणा by Vishwakarma, दिव्यं divine, दिव्येन with divine, वपुषा form/body, दीप्यमानं shining, स्वतेजसा with its own splendor, प्रतिगृह्णीष्व accept, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, मत्प्रियं my pleasure, कुरु do, राघव O Raghava.
explanation: O gentle Raghava, please accept this divine ornament, created by Vishwakarma, which shines with its own splendor and divine form, and by doing so, fulfill my wish.

shloka_text: दत्तस्य हि पुनर्दाने सुमहत्फलमुच्यते । भरणे हि भवान् शक्तः सेन्द्राणां मरुतामपि ।। 7.76.31 ।।
transliteration: dattasya hi punardāne sumahatphalamucyate | bharaṇe hi bhavān śaktaḥ sendrāṇāṃ marutāmapi || 7.76.31 ||
translation: दत्तस्य of what is given, हि indeed, पुनर्दाने in giving again, सुमहत्फलम् a very great reward, उच्यते is said, भरणे in supporting, हि indeed, भवान् you, शक्तः are capable, सेन्द्राणां along with Indra, मरुतामपि even of the Maruts.
explanation: It is said that giving something again, once it has been given, yields a very great reward, and indeed, you are capable of sustaining even Indra and the Maruts.

shloka_text: त्वं हि शक्तस्तारयितुं सेन्द्रानपि दिवौकसः । तस्मात्प्रदास्ये विधिवत्तत्प्रतीच्छ नराधिप ।। 7.76.32 ।।
transliteration: tvaṃ hi śaktastārayituṃ sendrānapi divaukasaḥ | tasmātpradāsye vidhivattatpratīccha narādhipa || 7.76.32 ||
translation: त्वं you, हि indeed, शक्तः are capable, तारयितुं to save/protect, सेन्द्रानपि even Indra and others, दिवौकसः the dwellers of heaven, तस्मात् therefore, प्रदास्ये I will give, विधिवत् properly, तत् that, प्रतीच्छ accept, नराधिप O king of men.
explanation: Indeed, you are capable of protecting even the gods, including Indra, therefore I will properly give this to you; O king of men, please accept it.

shloka_text: दिव्यमाभरणं चित्रं प्रदीप्तमिव भास्करम् ।। 7.76.33 ।।
transliteration: divyamābharaṇaṃ citraṃ pradīptamiva bhāskaram || 7.76.33 ||
translation: दिव्यम् divine, आभरणं ornament, चित्रं wonderful, प्रदीप्तमिव shining like, भास्करम् the sun.
explanation: This divine and wonderful ornament shines brilliantly like the sun.

shloka_text: अथोवाच महात्मानमिक्ष्वाकूणां महारथः । रामो मतिमतां श्रेष्ठः क्षत्रधर्ममनुस्मरन् ।। 7.76.34 ।।
transliteration: athovāca mahātmānamikṣvākūṇāṃ mahārathaḥ | rāmo matimatāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ kṣatradharmamanusmaran || 7.76.34 ||
translation: अथ then, उवाच spoke, महात्मानम् to the great-souled one, इक्ष्वाकूणां of the Ikshvakus, महारथः the great warrior, रामो Rama, मतिमतां of the intelligent ones, श्रेष्ठः the best, क्षत्रधर्ममनुस्मरन् remembering the duty of a Kshatriya.
explanation: Then, Rama, the great warrior of the Ikshvakus and the best among the intelligent, spoke to the great-souled one, remembering the duties of a Kshatriya.

shloka_text: प्रतिग्रहो ऽयं भगवन्ब्राह्मणस्याविगर्हितः । गृह्णीयां क्षत्रियो ऽहं वै कथं ब्राह्मणपुङ्गव ।। 7.76.35 ।।
transliteration: pratigraho 'yaṃ bhagavanbrāhmaṇasyāvigarhitaḥ | gṛhṇīyāṃ kṣatriyo 'haṃ vai kathaṃ brāhmaṇapuṅgava || 7.76.35 ||
translation: प्रतिग्रहः acceptance of gifts, अयम् this, भगवन् O revered one, ब्राह्मणस्य for a Brahmana, अविगर्हितः blameless, गृह्णीयाम् should I accept, क्षत्रियः a Kshatriya, अहम् I, वै indeed, कथम् how, ब्राह्मणपुङ्गव O best among Brahmanas.
explanation: Rama questions the sage, asking how he, a Kshatriya, can accept a gift that is considered blameless only for a Brahmana.

shloka_text: ब्राह्मणेन विशेषेण दत्तं तद्वक्तुमर्हसि । एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण प्रत्युवाच महानृषिः ।। 7.76.36 ।।
transliteration: brāhmaṇena viśeṣeṇa dattaṃ tadvaktumarhasi | evamuktastu rāmeṇa pratyuvāca mahānṛṣiḥ || 7.76.36 ||
translation: ब्राह्मणेन by a Brahmana, विशेषेण especially, दत्तम् given, तत् that, वक्तुम् to tell, अर्हसि you ought, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु but, रामेण by Rama, प्रत्युवाच replied, महानृषिः the great sage.
explanation: Rama further requested the sage to explain the reason for accepting such a gift, especially when given by a Brahmana, to which the great sage then replied.

shloka_text: आसन्कृतयुगे राम ब्रह्मभूते पुरायुगे । अपार्थिवाः प्रजाः सर्वाः सुराणां तु शतक्रतुः ।। 7.76.37 ।।
transliteration: āsankṛtayuge rāma brahmabhūte purāyuge | apārthivāḥ prajāḥ sarvāḥ surāṇāṃ tu śatakratuḥ || 7.76.37 ||
translation: आसन् were, कृतयुगे in the Krita Yuga, राम O Rama, ब्रह्मभूते when Brahma was present, पुरायुगे in the ancient age, अपार्थिवाः without a king, प्रजाः the people, सर्वाः all, सुराणाम् of the gods, तु but, शतक्रतुः Indra.
explanation: The great sage began by telling Rama that in the ancient Krita Yuga, when the world was pure, all people were without an earthly king, though Indra was the ruler of the gods.

shloka_text: ताः प्रजा देवदेवेशं राजार्थं समुपाद्रवन् । सुराणां स्थापितो राजा त्वया देव शतक्रतुः ।। 7.76.38 ।।
transliteration: tāḥ prajā devadeveśaṃ rājārthaṃ samupādravan | surāṇāṃ sthāpito rājā tvayā deva śatakratuḥ || 7.76.38 ||
translation: ताः those, प्रजाः people, देवदेवेशम् to the Lord of gods, राजार्थम् for the sake of a king, समुपाद्रवन् approached, सुराणाम् of the gods, स्थापितः established, राजा king, त्वया by you, देव O god, शतक्रतुः Indra.
explanation: Those people approached the Lord of gods (Brahma) requesting a king, reminding him that he had already established Indra as the king of the gods.

shloka_text: प्रयच्छ नो हि लोकेश पार्थिवं नरपुङ्गवम् । यस्मै पूजां प्रयुञ्जाना धूतपापाश्चरेमहि । न वसामो विना राज्ञा एष नो निश्चयः परः ।। 7.76.39 ।।
transliteration: prayaccha no hi lokeśa pārthivaṃ narapuṅgavam | yasmai pūjāṃ prayuñjānā dhūtapāpāścaremahi | na vasāmo vinā rājñā eṣa no niścayaḥ paraḥ || 7.76.39 ||
translation: प्रयच्छ give, नः to us, हि indeed, लोकेश O Lord of the worlds, पार्थिवम् an earthly ruler, नरपुङ्गवम् a best among men, यस्मै to whom, पूजां worship, प्रयुञ्जानाः offering, धूतपापाः having cleansed sins, चरेमहि we may live, न not, वसामः we live, विना without, राज्ञा a king, एषः this, नः our, निश्चयः firm resolve, परः supreme.
explanation: The people implored Brahma, the Lord of the worlds, to grant them an earthly king, a best among men, whom they could worship to cleanse their sins and under whose rule they could live, as they declared their supreme resolve not to live without a king.

shloka_text: प्रजानां वचनं श्रुत्वा निश्चयित्वा ऽर्थमुत्तमम् ।। 7.76.40 ।।
transliteration: prajānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā niścayitvā 'rthamuttamam || 7.76.40 ||
translation: प्रजानाम् of the subjects, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, निश्चयित्वा having ascertained, अर्थम् the purpose, उत्तमम् excellent.
explanation: Having heard the words of the subjects, and having ascertained their excellent purpose.

shloka_text: ततो ब्रह्मा सुरश्रेष्ठो लोकपालान्सवासवान् । समाहूयाब्रवीत्सर्वांस्तेजोभागान्प्रयच्छत ।। 7.76.41 ।।
transliteration: tato brahmā suraśreṣṭho lokapālānsavāsavān | samāhūyābravītsarvāṃstejobhāgānprayacchata || 7.76.41 ||
translation: ततः then, ब्रह्मा Brahma, सुरश्रेष्ठः best among gods, लोकपालान् the protectors of the worlds, सवासवान् along with Vasava (Indra), समाहूय having summoned, अब्रवीत् said, सर्वान् to all, तेजोभागान् shares of your splendor, प्रयच्छत give.
explanation: Then, Brahma, the best among gods, summoned all the protectors of the worlds, including Indra, and told them to bestow shares of their splendor.

shloka_text: ततो ददुर्लोकपालाः सर्वे भागान्स्वतेजसः । अक्षुपच्च ततो ब्रह्मा यतो जातः क्षुपो नृपः ।। 7.76.42 ।।
transliteration: tato dadurlokapālāḥ sarve bhāgānsvatejasaḥ | akṣupacca tato brahmā yato jātaḥ kṣupo nṛpaḥ || 7.76.42 ||
translation: ततः then, ददुः gave, लोकपालाः the protectors of the worlds, सर्वे all, भागान् shares, स्वतेजसः of their own splendor, अक्षुपत् च and sneezed, ततः then, ब्रह्मा Brahma, यतः from which, जातः was born, क्षुपः Kṣupa, नृपः the king.
explanation: Then all the protectors of the worlds gave shares of their own splendor, and then Brahma sneezed, from which King Kṣupa was born.

shloka_text: तं ब्रह्मा लोकपालानां सहांशैः समयोजयत् । ततो ददौ नृपं तासां प्रजानामीश्वरं क्षुपम् ।। 7.76.43 ।।
transliteration: taṃ brahmā lokapālānāṃ sahāṃśaiḥ samayojayat | tato dadau nṛpaṃ tāsāṃ prajānāmīśvaraṃ kṣupam || 7.76.43 ||
translation: तम् him, ब्रह्मा Brahma, लोकपालानाम् of the protectors of the worlds, सहांशैः with their shares (of splendor), समयोजयत् endowed, ततः then, ददौ gave, नृपम् the king, तासाम् of those, प्रजानाम् subjects, ईश्वरम् the ruler, क्षुपम् Kṣupa.
explanation: Brahma then endowed him (Kṣupa) with the shares of splendor from the protectors of the worlds, and then gave King Kṣupa as the ruler of those subjects.

shloka_text: तत्रैन्द्रेण च भागेन महीमाज्ञापयन्नृपः । वारुणेन तु भागेन वपुः पुष्यति पार्थिवः ।। 7.76.44 ।।
transliteration: tatraindreṇa ca bhāgena mahīmājñāpayannṛpaḥ | vāruṇena tu bhāgena vapuḥ puṣyati pārthivaḥ || 7.76.44 ||
translation: तत्र there, ऐन्द्रेण with the share of Indra, च and, भागेन with the share, महीम् the earth, आज्ञापयन् rules, नृपः the king, वारुणेन with the share of Varuna, तु but, भागेन with the share, वपुः the body, पुष्यति nourishes, पार्थिवः the king.
explanation: There, the king rules the earth with the share of Indra, and with the share of Varuna, the king nourishes his body.

shloka_text: कौबेरेण तु भागेन वित्तमासां ददौ तदा । यस्तु याम्यो ऽभवद्भागस्तेन शास्ति स्म स प्रजाः ।। 7.76.45 ।।
transliteration: kaubereṇa tu bhāgena vittamāsāṃ dadau tadā | yastu yāmyo 'bhavadbhāgastena śāsti sma sa prajāḥ || 7.76.45 ||
translation: कौबेरेण by the northern (Kubera's), तु indeed, भागेन part, वित्तम् wealth, आसाम् to them, ददौ he gave, तदा then, यः which, तु but, याम्यः southern (Yama's), अभवत् was, भागः part, तेन by that, शास्ति स्म he ruled, सः he, प्रजाः the subjects.
explanation: Then, he gave wealth to the people from the northern part (Kubera's domain), and with the southern part (Yama's domain), he ruled his subjects.

shloka_text: तत्रैन्द्रेण नरश्रेष्ठ भागेन रघुनन्दन । प्रतिगृह्णीष्व भद्रं ते तारणार्थं मम प्रभो ।। 7.76.46 ।।
transliteration: tatraindreṇa naraśreṣṭha bhāgena raghunandana | pratigṛhṇīṣva bhadraṃ te tāraṇārthaṃ mama prabho || 7.76.46 ||
translation: तत्र there, ऐन्द्रेण by the eastern (Indra's), नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, भागेन part, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, प्रतिगृह्णीष्व please accept, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, तारणार्थं for the purpose of saving, मम me, प्रभो O lord.
explanation: O best among men, O delight of the Raghus, O lord, please accept this eastern part (Indra's domain) for my salvation; may good fortune be yours.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ऋषेः परमधार्मिकम् । तद्रामः प्रतिजग्राह मुनेराभरणं वरम् ।। 7.76.47 ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ṛṣeḥ paramadhārmikam | tadrāmaḥ pratijagrāha munerābharaṇaṃ varam || 7.76.47 ||
translation: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, ऋषेः of the sage, परमधार्मिकम् most righteous, तत् that, रामः Rama, प्रतिजग्राह accepted, मुनेः of the sage, आभरणं ornament, वरम् excellent.
explanation: Having heard that most righteous speech of the sage, Rama accepted that excellent ornament from the sage.

shloka_text: प्रतिगृह्य ततो रामस्तदाभरणमुत्तमम् । आगमं तस्य दीप्तस्य प्रष्टुमेवोपचक्रमे ।। 7.76.48 ।।
transliteration: pratigṛhya tato rāmastadābharaṇamuttamam | āgamaṃ tasya dīptasya praṣṭumevopacakrame || 7.76.48 ||
translation: प्रतिगृह्य having accepted, ततः then, रामः Rama, तत् that, आभरणम् ornament, उत्तमम् excellent, आगमं origin, तस्य of that, दीप्तस्य shining, प्रष्टुम् to ask, एव indeed, उपचक्रमे began.
explanation: Having accepted that excellent ornament, Rama then began to inquire about the origin of that radiant object.

shloka_text: अत्यद्भुतमिदं दिव्यं वपुषा युक्तमुत्तमम् । कथं वा भगवता प्राप्तं कुतो वा केन वा हृतम् ।। 7.76.49 ।।
transliteration: atyadbhutamidaṃ divyaṃ vapuṣā yuktamuttamam | kathaṃ vā bhagavatā prāptaṃ kuto vā kena vā hṛtam || 7.76.49 ||
translation: अति extremely, अद्भुतम् wonderful, इदं this, दिव्यं divine, वपुषा with a form, युक्तम् endowed, उत्तमम् excellent, कथं how, वा or, भगवता by your revered self, प्राप्तं obtained, कुतः from where, वा or, केन by whom, वा or, हृतम् taken away.
explanation: Rama asked, "How was this extremely wonderful, divine, and excellent form obtained by your revered self, or from where, or by whom was it taken away?"

shloka_text: कुतूहलितया ब्रह्मन्पृच्छामि त्वां महायशः । आश्चर्याणां बहूनां हि निधिः परमको भवान् ।। 7.76.50 ।।
transliteration: kutūhalitayā brahmanpṛcchāmi tvāṃ mahāyaśaḥ | āścaryāṇāṃ bahūnāṃ hi nidhiḥ paramako bhavān || 7.76.50 ||
translation: कुतूहलितया out of curiosity, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, पृच्छामि I ask, त्वां you, महायशः O greatly renowned one, आश्चर्याणां of wonders, बहूनां many, हि indeed, निधिः a treasure, परमको supreme, भवान् you are
explanation: O greatly renowned Brahmana, I ask you out of curiosity, for you are indeed a supreme treasure of many wonders.

shloka_text: एवं ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे मुनिर्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् । शृणु राम यथावृत्तं पुरा त्रेतायुगे युगे ।। 7.76.51 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ bruvati kākutsthe munirvākyamathābravīt | śṛṇu rāma yathāvṛttaṃ purā tretāyuge yuge || 7.76.51 ||
translation: एवं thus, ब्रुवति when speaking, काकुत्स्थे Kakutstha (Rama), मुनिः the sage, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, शृणु listen, राम O Rama, यथावृत्तं as it happened, पुरा formerly, त्रेतायुगे in the Treta Yuga, युगे in the age
explanation: When Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, spoke thus, the sage then replied, "Listen, O Rama, to what happened formerly in the Treta Yuga."

shloka_text: रमणीयप्रदेशे ऽस्मिन् वने यद्दृष्टवानहम् । आश्चर्यं मे महाबाहो दानमाश्रित्य केवलम् ।। 7.76.52 ।।
transliteration: ramaṇīyapradeśe 'smin vane yaddṛṣṭavānaham | āścaryaṃ me mahābāho dānamāśritya kevalam || 7.76.52 ||
translation: रमणीयप्रदेशे in this beautiful region, अस्मिन् in this, वने forest, यत् which, दृष्टवान् saw, अहम् I, आश्चर्यं a wonder, मे to me, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, दानम् charity, आश्रित्य concerning, केवलम् merely
explanation: O mighty-armed one, I saw a wonder in this beautiful forest region, which was solely concerning the power of charity. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षट्सप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 76 ।। Thus ends the seventy-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: पुरा त्रेतायुगे राम बभूव बहुविस्तरम् । समन्ताद्योजनशतं विमृगं पक्षिवर्जितम् ।। 7.77.1 ।।
transliteration: purā tretāyuge rāma babhūva bahuvistaram | samantādyojanaśataṃ vimṛgaṃ pakṣivarjitam || 7.77.1 ||
translation: पुरा formerly, त्रेतायुगे in the Treta Yuga, राम O Rama, बभूव there was, बहुविस्तरम् very extensive, समन्तात् all around, योजनशतं a hundred yojanas, विमृगं without deer, पक्षिवर्जितम् devoid of birds
explanation: O Rama, formerly in the Treta Yuga, there was a very extensive area, a hundred yojanas all around, that was devoid of both animals and birds.
comments: Agastya tells how once, in a desolate forest by a lovely lake, he found a corpse that would not decay -- a celestial being descended from a swan-drawn chariot, attended by apsaras, devoured the corpse, bathed, and made to depart -- and Agastya asked him who he was and why he ate such loathsome food.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्निर्मानुषे ऽरण्ये कुर्वाणस्तप उत्तमम् । अहमाक्रमितुं सौम्य तदरण्यमुपागमम् ।। 7.77.2 ।।
transliteration: tasminnirmānuṣe 'raṇye kurvāṇastapa uttamam | ahamākramituṃ saumya tadaraṇyamupāgamam || 7.77.2 ||
translation: तस्मिन् in that, निर्मानुषे uninhabited by humans, अरण्ये forest, कुर्वाणः performing, तपः penance, उत्तमम् excellent, अहम् I, आक्रमितुं to enter, सौम्य O gentle one, तत् that, अरण्यम् forest, उपागमम् approached
explanation: O gentle one, I approached that uninhabited forest to perform excellent penance and to traverse it.

shloka_text: तस्य रूपमरण्यस्य निर्देष्टुं न शशाक ह । फलमूलैः सुखास्वादैर्बहुरूपैश्च पादपैः ।। 7.77.3 ।।
transliteration: tasya rūpamaraṇyasya nirdeṣṭuṃ na śaśāka ha | phalamūlaiḥ sukhāsvādairbahurūpaiśca pādapaiḥ || 7.77.3 ||
translation: तस्य of that, रूपम् beauty, अरण्यस्य of the forest, निर्देष्टुम् to describe, न not, शशाक was able, ह indeed, फलमूलैः with fruits and roots, सुखास्वादैः of pleasant taste, बहुरूपैः of various forms, च and, पादपैः with trees.
explanation: The beauty of that forest, with its various kinds of trees bearing fruits and roots of pleasant taste, was indeed indescribable.

shloka_text: तस्यारण्यस्य मध्ये तु सरो योजनमायतम् । हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णं चक्रवाकोपशोभितम् ।। 7.77.4 ।।
transliteration: tasyāraṇyasya madhye tu saro yojanamāyatam | haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ cakravākopaśobhitam || 7.77.4 ||
translation: तस्य of that, अरण्यस्य forest, मध्ये in the middle, तु indeed, सरः a lake, योजनम् a yojana, आयतम् long, हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णम् filled with swans and karandava ducks, चक्रवाकोपशोभितम् adorned with chakravaka birds.
explanation: In the middle of that forest was a lake, a yojana in length, teeming with swans and karandava ducks, and graced by chakravaka birds.

shloka_text: पद्मोत्पलसमाकीर्णं समतिक्रान्तशैवलम् । तदाश्चर्यमिवात्यर्थं सुखास्वादमनुत्तमम् ।। 7.77.5 ।।
transliteration: padmotpalasamākīrṇaṃ samatikrāntaśaivalam | tadāścaryamivātyarthaṃ sukhāsvādamanuttamam || 7.77.5 ||
translation: पद्मोत्पलसमाकीर्णम् filled with lotuses and water lilies, समतिक्रान्तशैवलम् free from moss, तत् that, आश्चर्यम् wonder, इव as if, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, सुखास्वादम् of pleasant taste, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.
explanation: That lake was filled with lotuses and water lilies, free from moss, exceedingly wonderful, and its water was of unsurpassed pleasant taste.

shloka_text: अरजस्कं तथा ऽक्षोभ्यं श्रीमत्पक्षिगणायुतम् । समीपे तस्य सरसो महदद्भुतमाश्रमम् ।। 7.77.6 ।।
transliteration: arajaskaṃ tathā 'kṣobhyaṃ śrīmatpakṣigaṇāyutam | samīpe tasya saraso mahadadbhutamāśramam || 7.77.6 ||
translation: अरजस्कम् dustless, तथा and, अक्षोभ्यम् undisturbed, श्रीमत् glorious, पक्षिगणायुतम् endowed with flocks of birds, समीपे near, तस्य of that, सरसः lake, महत् great, अद्भुतम् wonderful, आश्रमम् hermitage.
explanation: The lake was pure, undisturbed, glorious, and filled with flocks of birds; and near it was a great and wonderful hermitage.

shloka_text: पुराणं पुण्यमत्यर्थं तपस्विजनवर्जितम् । तत्राहमवसं रात्रिं नैदाघीं पुरुषर्षभ ।। 7.77.7 ।।
transliteration: purāṇaṃ puṇyamatyarthaṃ tapasvijanavarjitam | tatrāhamavasaṃ rātriṃ naidāghīṃ puruṣarṣabha || 7.77.7 ||
translation: पुराणम् ancient, पुण्यम् sacred, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, तपस्विजनवर्जितम् devoid of ascetics, तत्र there, अहम् I, अवसम् resided, रात्रिम् night, नैदाघीम् a summer, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men.
explanation: O best among men, that hermitage was ancient, exceedingly sacred, yet devoid of ascetics, and there I spent a summer night.

shloka_text: प्रभाते काल्यमुत्थाय सरस्तदुपचक्रमे । अथापश्यं शवं तत्र सुपुष्टमजरं क्वचित् ।। 7.77.8 ।।
transliteration: prabhāte kālyamutthāya sarastadupacakrame | athāpaśyaṃ śavaṃ tatra supuṣṭamajaraṃ kvacit || 7.77.8 ||
translation: प्रभाते in the morning, काल्यम् early, उत्थाय having risen, सरः the lake, तत् that, उपचक्रमे approached, अथ then, अपश्यम् I saw, शवम् a corpse, तत्र there, सुपुष्टम् very well-nourished, अजरम् ageless, क्वचित् somewhere,
explanation: Early in the morning, having risen, I approached that lake, and there I saw a very well-nourished, undecaying corpse somewhere.

shloka_text: पङ्किभेदेन पुष्टाङ्गं समाश्रितसरोवरम् । तिष्ठन्तं परया लक्ष्म्या तस्मिंस्तोयाशये नृप ।। 7.77.9 ।।
transliteration: paṅkibhedena puṣṭāṅgaṃ samāśritasarovaram | tiṣṭhantaṃ parayā lakṣmyā tasmiṃstoyāśaye nṛpa || 7.77.9 ||
translation: पङ्किभेदेन by the rich mud/algae, पुष्टाङ्गम् having well-nourished limbs, समाश्रितसरोवरम् resting in the lake, तिष्ठन्तम् remaining, परया with supreme, लक्ष्म्या splendor, तस्मिन् in that, तोयाशये body of water, नृप O King,
explanation: O King, it was resting in that body of water, its limbs nourished by the rich environment, remaining there with supreme splendor.

shloka_text: तमर्थं चिन्तयानो ऽहं मुहूर्तं तत्र राघव । उषितो ऽस्मि सरस्तीरे किन्न्विदं स्यादिति प्रभो ।। 7.77.10 ।।
transliteration: tamarthaṃ cintayāno 'haṃ muhūrtaṃ tatra rāghava | uṣito 'smi sarastīre kinnvidaṃ syāditi prabho || 7.77.10 ||
translation: तम् that, अर्थम् matter, चिन्तयानः pondering, अहम् I, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, तत्र there, राघव O Raghava, उषितः remained, अस्मि I am, सरस्तीरे on the lake shore, किम् what, नु indeed, इदम् this, स्यात् might be, इति thus, प्रभो O Lord,
explanation: O Raghava, O Lord, pondering that matter, I remained on the lake shore for a moment, wondering what this might be.

shloka_text: अथापश्यं मुहूर्तेन दिव्यमद्भुतदर्शनम् । विमानं परमोदारं हंसयुक्तं मनोजवम् ।। 7.77.11 ।।
transliteration: athāpaśyaṃ muhūrtena divyamadbhutadarśanam | vimānaṃ paramodāraṃ haṃsayuktaṃ manojavam || 7.77.11 ||
translation: अथ then, अपश्यम् I saw, मुहूर्तेन after a moment, दिव्यम् divine, अद्भुतदर्शनम् of wondrous sight, विमानम् an aerial chariot, परमोदारम् exceedingly grand, हंसयुक्तम् yoked with swans, मनोजवम् swift as thought,
explanation: Then, after a moment, I saw a divine aerial chariot of wondrous sight, exceedingly grand, yoked with swans, and swift as thought.

shloka_text: अत्यर्थं स्वर्गिणं त विमाने रघुनन्दन । उपास्ते ऽप्सरसां वीर सहस्रं दिव्यभूषणम् ।। 7.77.12 ।।
transliteration: atyarthaṃ svargiṇaṃ ta vimāne raghunandana | upāste 'psarasāṃ vīra sahasraṃ divyabhūṣaṇam || 7.77.12 ||
translation: अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, स्वर्गिणम् the celestial being, तम् him, विमाने in the aerial chariot, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, उपास्ते serves, अप्सरसाम् of Apsaras, वीर O hero, सहस्रम् a thousand, दिव्यभूषणम् adorned with divine ornaments,
explanation: O Raghunandana, O hero, a thousand Apsaras adorned with divine ornaments served that exceedingly celestial being in the aerial chariot.

shloka_text: गायन्ति दिव्यगेयानि वादयन्ति तथा ऽपराः । क्ष्वेलयन्ति तथा चान्या नृत्यन्ति च तथा ऽपराः ।। 7.77.13 ।।
transliteration: gāyanti divyageyāni vādayanti tathā 'parāḥ | kṣvelayanti tathā cānyā nṛtyanti ca tathā 'parāḥ || 7.77.13 ||
translation: गायन्ति they sing, दिव्यगेयानि divine songs, वादयन्ति they play (instruments), तथा similarly, अपराः others, क्ष्वेलयन्ति they sport, तथा च and similarly, अन्याः others, नृत्यन्ति they dance, च and, तथा similarly, अपराः others.
explanation: Some (celestial women) sing divine songs, others play musical instruments, some engage in playful sports, and still others dance.

shloka_text: अपराश्चन्द्ररश्म्याभैर्हेमदण्डैश्च चामरैः । दोधूयुर्वदनं तस्य पुण्डरीकनिभेक्षणम् ।। 7.77.14 ।।
transliteration: aparāścandraraśmyābhairhemadaṇḍaiśca cāmaraiḥ | dodhūyurvadanaṃ tasya puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇam || 7.77.14 ||
translation: अपराः others, चन्द्ररश्म्याभैः with moonbeam-like (lustre), हेमदण्डैश्च and with golden handles, चामरैः with whisks, दोधूयुः they fanned, वदनं the face, तस्य his, पुण्डरीकनिभेक्षणम् whose eyes resemble lotus flowers.
explanation: Other celestial women fanned his lotus-eyed face with whisks that had golden handles and shone like moonbeams.

shloka_text: ततः सिंहासनं त्यक्त्वा मेरुकूटमिवांशुमान् । पश्यतो मे तदा राम विमानादवरुह्य च । तं शवं भक्षयामास स स्वर्गी रघुनन्दन ।। 7.77.15 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ siṃhāsanaṃ tyaktvā merukūṭamivāṃśumān | paśyato me tadā rāma vimānādavaruhya ca | taṃ śavaṃ bhakṣayāmāsa sa svargī raghunandana || 7.77.15 ||
translation: ततः then, सिंहासनं the throne, त्यक्त्वा having left, मेरुकूटमिव like the peak of Meru, अंशुमान् the sun, पश्यतो मे while I was watching, तदा then, राम O Rama, विमानात् from the celestial chariot, अवरुह्य having descended, च and, तं that, शवं corpse, भक्षयामास he ate, सः he, स्वर्गी the celestial being, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: Then, O Rama, O delight of the Raghus, while I watched, that celestial being, like the sun leaving the peak of Meru, descended from his celestial chariot, abandoned his throne, and proceeded to eat that corpse.

shloka_text: तथा भुक्त्वा यथाकामं मांसं बहु सुपीवरम् । अवतीर्य सरः स्वर्गी संस्प्रष्टुमुपचक्रमे ।। 7.77.16 ।।
transliteration: tathā bhuktvā yathākāmaṃ māṃsaṃ bahu supīvaram | avatīrya saraḥ svargī saṃspraṣṭumupacakrame || 7.77.16 ||
translation: तथा thus, भुक्त्वा having eaten, यथाकामं to his heart's content, मांसं meat, बहु much, सुपीवरम् very fat, अवतीर्य having descended, सरः into the lake, स्वर्गी the celestial being, संस्प्रष्टुम् to touch (water), उपचक्रमे he began.
explanation: After thus eating a large quantity of very plump meat to his heart's content, the celestial being descended into a lake and began to perform ablutions.

shloka_text: उपस्पृश्य यथान्यायं स स्वर्गी रघुपुङ्गव । आरोढुमुपचक्राम विमानवरमुत्तमम् ।। 7.77.17 ।।
transliteration: upaspṛśya yathānyāyaṃ sa svargī raghupuṅgava | āroḍhumupacakrāma vimānavaramuttamam || 7.77.17 ||
translation: उपस्पृश्य having performed ablutions, यथान्यायं properly, सः he, स्वर्गी the celestial being, रघुपुङ्गव O foremost of the Raghus, आरोढुम् to ascend, उपचक्राम he began, विमानवरम् the best celestial chariot, उत्तमम् excellent.
explanation: Having performed ablutions properly, O foremost of the Raghus, that celestial being then began to ascend his excellent and best celestial chariot.

shloka_text: तमहं देवसङ्काशमारोहन्तमुदीक्ष्य वै । अथाहमब्रुवं वाक्यं स्वर्गिणं पुरुषर्षभ ।। 7.77.18 ।।
transliteration: tamahaṃ devasaṅkāśamārohantamudīkṣya vai | athāhamabruvaṃ vākyaṃ svargiṇaṃ puruṣarṣabha || 7.77.18 ||
translation: तम् him, अहम् I, देवसङ्काशम् god-like, आरोहन्तम् ascending, उदीक्ष्य having seen, वै indeed, अथ then, अहम् I, अब्रुवम् spoke, वाक्यम् words, स्वर्गिणम् to the celestial being, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men.
explanation: Having seen that god-like being ascending, I then spoke these words to the celestial being, O best among men.

shloka_text: को भवान्देवसङ्काश आहारश्च विगर्हितः । त्वयेदं भुज्यते सौम्य किमर्थं वक्तुमर्हसि ।। 7.77.19 ।।
transliteration: ko bhavāndevasaṅkāśa āhāraśca vigarhitaḥ | tvayedaṃ bhujyate saumya kimarthaṃ vaktumarhasi || 7.77.19 ||
translation: कः who, भवान् are you, देवसङ्काश god-like, आहारः food, च and, विगर्हितः reprehensible, त्वया by you, इदम् this, भुज्यते is eaten, सौम्य O gentle one, किमर्थम् for what purpose, वक्तुम् to speak, अर्हसि you ought.
explanation: O god-like one, who are you, and why do you consume this reprehensible food, O gentle one, please tell me the reason.

shloka_text: कस्य स्यादीदृशो भाव आहारो देवसम्मतः । आश्चर्यं वर्तते सौम्य श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः ।। 7.77.20 ।।
transliteration: kasya syādīdṛśo bhāva āhāro devasammataḥ | āścaryaṃ vartate saumya śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 7.77.20 ||
translation: कस्य whose, स्यात् would be, ईदृशः such, भावः nature, आहारः food, देवसम्मतः approved by gods, आश्चर्यम् wonder, वर्तते exists, सौम्य O gentle one, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छामि I wish, तत्त्वतः truly.
explanation: Whose nature would be such, and what kind of food is this that is approved by gods; O gentle one, this is a wonder, and I truly wish to hear about it.

shloka_text: नाहमौपयिकं मन्ये तव भक्ष्यमिदं शवम् ।। 7.77.21 ।।
transliteration: nāhamaupayikaṃ manye tava bhakṣyamidaṃ śavam || 7.77.21 ||
translation: न not, अहम् I, औपयिकम् suitable, मन्ये consider, तव your, भक्ष्यम् food, इदम् this, शवम् corpse.
explanation: I do not consider this corpse to be suitable food for you.

shloka_text: इत्येवमुक्तः स नरेन्द्र नाकी कौतूहलात्सूनृतया गिरा च । श्रुत्वा च वाक्यं मम सर्वमेतत्सर्वं तथा चाकथयन्ममेति ।। 7.77.22 ।।
transliteration: ityevamuktaḥ sa narendra nākī kautūhalātsūnṛtayā girā ca | śrutvā ca vākyaṃ mama sarvametatsarvaṃ tathā cākathayanmameti || 7.77.22 ||
translation: इति thus, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, सः he, नरेन्द्र O king, नाकी the celestial being, कौतूहलात् out of curiosity, सूनृतया with pleasant and truthful, गिरा words, च and, श्रुत्वा having heard, च and, वाक्यम् words, मम my, सर्वम् all, एतत् this, सर्वम् all, तथा thus, च and, अकथयत् narrated, मम to me, इति thus.
explanation: O king, thus addressed, that celestial being, out of curiosity and with pleasant and truthful words, having heard all my words, then narrated everything to me. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 77 ।। Thus ends the seventy-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा तु भाषितं वाक्यं मम राम शुभाक्षरम् । प्राञ्जलिः प्रत्युवाचेदं स स्वर्गी रघुनन्दन ।। 7.78.1 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu bhāṣitaṃ vākyaṃ mama rāma śubhākṣaram | prāñjaliḥ pratyuvācedaṃ sa svargī raghunandana || 7.78.1 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, भाषितं spoken, वाक्यं words, मम my, राम O Rama, शुभाक्षरम् auspicious-worded, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रत्युवाच replied, इदं this, सः he, स्वर्गी the celestial being, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: O Rama, O delight of the Raghus, having heard my auspicious words, that celestial being replied with folded hands.
comments: The being tells that he was Shveta, king of Vidarbha, who won Brahma's world by penance but, having given no charity in life, was doomed there to eat his own ever-renewing flesh until Agastya should free him -- begging the sage to accept his ornament and release him, Shveta is freed, his body perishes, and he ascends to heaven -- and this is the ornament Agastya now bestows on Rama.

shloka_text: शृणु ब्रह्मन्पुरा वृत्तं ममैतत्सुखदुःखयोः । अनतिक्रमणीयं हि यथा पृच्छसि मां द्विज ।। 7.78.2 ।।
transliteration: śṛṇu brahmanpurā vṛttaṃ mamaitatsukhaduḥkhayoḥ | anatikramaṇīyaṃ hi yathā pṛcchasi māṃ dvija || 7.78.2 ||
translation: शृणु listen, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, पुरा formerly, वृत्तं the story, मम my, एतत् this, सुखदुःखयोः of joys and sorrows, अनतिक्रमणीयं unavoidable, हि indeed, यथा as, पृच्छसि you ask, मां me, द्विज O twice-born.
explanation: O Brahmana, O twice-born, listen to this unavoidable story of my past joys and sorrows, as you have asked me.

shloka_text: पुरा वैदर्भको राजा पिता मम महायशाः । सुदेव इति विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु वीर्यवान् ।। 7.78.3 ।।
transliteration: purā vaidarbhako rājā pitā mama mahāyaśāḥ | sudeva iti vikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu vīryavān || 7.78.3 ||
translation: पुरा formerly, वैदर्भकः of Vidarbha, राजा king, पिता father, मम my, महायशाः greatly renowned, सुदेवः Sudeva, इति thus, विख्यातः famous, त्रिषु in three, लोकेषु worlds, वीर्यवान् valorous.
explanation: Formerly, my father was a greatly renowned and valorous king of Vidarbha, famous in all three worlds by the name Sudeva.

shloka_text: तस्य पुत्रद्वयं ब्रह्मन्द्वाभ्यां स्त्रीभ्यामजायत । अहं श्वेत इति ख्यातो यवीयान्सुरथो ऽभवत् ।। 7.78.4 ।।
transliteration: tasya putradvayaṃ brahmandvābhyāṃ strībhyāmajāyata | ahaṃ śveta iti khyāto yavīyānsuratho 'bhavat || 7.78.4 ||
translation: तस्य his, पुत्रद्वयं two sons, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, द्वाभ्यां from two, स्त्रीभ्याम् wives, अजायत were born, अहं I, श्वेतः Shveta, इति thus, ख्यातः known, यवीयान् the younger, सुरथः Suratha, अभवत् was.
explanation: O Brahmana, he had two sons born from two wives; I was known as Shveta, and the younger one was Suratha.

shloka_text: ततः पितरि स्वर्याते पौरा मामभ्यषेचयन् । तत्राहं कृतवान्राज्यं धर्म्यं च सुसमाहितः ।। 7.78.5 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pitari svaryāte paurā māmabhyaṣecayan | tatrāhaṃ kṛtavānrājyaṃ dharmyaṃ ca susamāhitaḥ || 7.78.5 ||
translation: ततः then, पितरि when the father, स्वर्याते had gone to heaven, पौराः the citizens, माम् me, अभ्यषेचयन् consecrated, तत्र there, अहं I, कृतवान् did, राज्यं kingship, धर्म्यं righteous, च and, सुसमाहितः very attentively.
explanation: Then, when my father had passed away to heaven, the citizens consecrated me, and I diligently performed righteous kingship there.

shloka_text: एवं वर्षसहस्राणि समतीतानि सुव्रत । राज्यं कारयतो ब्रह्मन्प्रजा धर्मेण रक्षतः ।। 7.78.6 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi samatītāni suvrata | rājyaṃ kārayato brahmanprajā dharmeṇa rakṣataḥ || 7.78.6 ||
translation: एवं thus, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, समतीतानि passed, सुव्रत O virtuous one, राज्यं kingdom, कारयतः while ruling, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, प्रजा subjects, धर्मेण righteously, रक्षतः while protecting.
explanation: O virtuous one, O Brahmana, thus thousands of years passed while I ruled the kingdom and protected the subjects righteously.

shloka_text: सो ऽहं निमित्ते कस्मिंश्चिद्विज्ञातायुर्द्विजोत्तम । कालधर्मं हृदि न्यस्य ततो वनमुपागमम् ।। 7.78.7 ।।
transliteration: so 'haṃ nimitte kasmiṃścidvijñātāyurdvijottama | kāladharmaṃ hṛdi nyasya tato vanamupāgamam || 7.78.7 ||
translation: सः that, अहं I, निमित्ते on an occasion, कस्मिंश्चित् some, विज्ञातायुः having known my lifespan, द्विजोत्तम O best of Brahmanas, कालधर्मं the law of time (death), हृदि in my heart, न्यस्य having placed, ततः then, वनं to the forest, उपागमम् I went.
explanation: O best of Brahmanas, having known my lifespan due to some cause, I then accepted the law of time in my heart and went to the forest.

shloka_text: सो ऽहं वनमिदं दुर्गं मृगपक्षिविवर्जितम् । तपश्चर्तुं प्रविष्टो ऽस्मि समीपे सरसः शुभे ।। 7.78.8 ।।
transliteration: so 'haṃ vanamidaṃ durgaṃ mṛgapakṣivivarjitam | tapaścartuṃ praviṣṭo 'smi samīpe sarasaḥ śubhe || 7.78.8 ||
translation: सः that, अहं I, वनं forest, इदं this, दुर्गं inaccessible, मृगपक्षिविवर्जितम् devoid of deer and birds, तपः penance, चर्तुं to perform, प्रविष्टः entered, अस्मि I am, समीपे near, सरसः of the lake, शुभे auspicious.
explanation: I entered this inaccessible forest, devoid of deer and birds, to perform penance near an auspicious lake.

shloka_text: भ्रातरं सुरथं राज्ये ह्यभिषिच्य महीपतिम् । इदं सरः समासाद्य तपस्तप्तं मया चिरम् ।। 7.78.9 ।।
transliteration: bhrātaraṃ surathaṃ rājye hyabhiṣicya mahīpatim | idaṃ saraḥ samāsādya tapastaptaṃ mayā ciram || 7.78.9 ||
translation: भ्रातरं brother, सुरथं Suratha, राज्ये in the kingdom, हि indeed, अभिषिच्य having consecrated, महीपतिम् as king, इदं this, सरः lake, समासाद्य having reached, तपः penance, तप्तं performed, मया by me, चिरम् for a long time.
explanation: Indeed, having consecrated my brother Suratha as king in the kingdom, I reached this lake and performed penance for a long time.

shloka_text: सो ऽहं वर्षसहस्राणि तपस्त्रीणि महावने । तप्त्वा सुदुष्करं प्राप्तो ब्रह्मलोकमनुत्तमम् ।। 7.78.10 ।।
transliteration: so 'haṃ varṣasahasrāṇi tapastrīṇi mahāvane | taptvā suduṣkaraṃ prāpto brahmalokamanuttamam || 7.78.10 ||
translation: सः that, अहं I, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, तपः penance, त्रीणि three, महावने in the great forest, तप्त्वा having performed, सुदुष्करं very difficult, प्राप्तः attained, ब्रह्मलोकं the world of Brahma, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.
explanation: Having performed very difficult penance for three thousand years in the great forest, I attained the unsurpassed world of Brahma.

shloka_text: तस्य मे स्वर्गभूतस्य क्षुत्पिपासे द्विजोत्तम । बाधेते परमोदार ततो ऽहं व्यथितेन्द्रियः । गत्वा त्रिभुवनश्रेष्ठं पितामहमुवाच ह ।। 7.78.11 ।।
transliteration: tasya me svargabhūtasya kṣutpipāse dvijottama | bādhete paramodāra tato 'haṃ vyathitendriyaḥ | gatvā tribhuvanaśreṣṭhaṃ pitāmahamuvāca ha || 7.78.11 ||
translation: तस्य of that, मे to me, स्वर्गभूतस्य having become heavenly, क्षुत्पिपासे hunger and thirst, द्विजोत्तम O best of Brahmins, बाधेते afflict, परमोदार O most generous one, ततः then, अहम् I, व्यथितेन्द्रियः with distressed senses, गत्वा having gone, त्रिभुवनश्रेष्ठम् to the best of the three worlds, पितामहम् to the grandfather, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.
explanation: O best of Brahmins and most generous one, even after attaining heaven, hunger and thirst afflicted me, causing my senses distress, so I went and spoke to the grandfather, Brahma, the best of the three worlds.

shloka_text: भगवन्ब्रह्मलोको ऽयं क्षुत्पिपासाविवर्जितः । कस्यायं कर्मणः पाकः क्षुत्पिपासानुगो ह्यहम् ।। 7.78.12 ।।
transliteration: bhagavanbrahmaloko 'yaṃ kṣutpipāsāvivarjitaḥ | kasyāyaṃ karmaṇaḥ pākaḥ kṣutpipāsānugo hyaham || 7.78.12 ||
translation: भगवन् O venerable one, ब्रह्मलोकः Brahma's world, अयम् this, क्षुत्पिपासाविवर्जितः devoid of hunger and thirst, कस्य of what, अयम् this, कर्मणः of action, पाकः fruit, क्षुत्पिपासानुगः followed by hunger and thirst, हि indeed, अहम् I.
explanation: O venerable one, this Brahma-loka is free from hunger and thirst, so what deed's consequence is it that I am indeed still afflicted by hunger and thirst?

shloka_text: आहारः कश्च मे देव तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ।। 7.78.13 ।।
transliteration: āhāraḥ kaśca me deva tanme brūhi pitāmaha || 7.78.13 ||
translation: आहारः food, कः what, च and, मे for me, देव O god, तत् that, मे to me, ब्रूहि tell, पितामह O grandfather.
explanation: O divine grandfather, please tell me what my food should be.

shloka_text: पितामहस्तु मामाह तवाहारः सुदेवज । स्वादूनि स्वानि मांसानि तानि भक्षय नित्यशः ।। 7.78.14 ।।
transliteration: pitāmahastu māmāha tavāhāraḥ sudevaja | svādūni svāni māṃsāni tāni bhakṣaya nityaśaḥ || 7.78.14 ||
translation: पितामहः the grandfather, तु indeed, माम् to me, आह said, तव your, आहारः food, सुदेवज O son of a good god, स्वादूनि delicious, स्वानि your own, मांसानि flesh, तानि those, भक्षय eat, नित्यशः always.
explanation: The grandfather, Brahma, then told me, "O son of a good god, your food shall be your own delicious flesh, which you must eat constantly."

shloka_text: स्वशरीरं त्वया पुष्टं कुर्वता तप उत्तमम् । अनुप्तं रोहते श्वेत न कदाचिन्महामते ।। 7.78.15 ।।
transliteration: svaśarīraṃ tvayā puṣṭaṃ kurvatā tapa uttamam | anuptaṃ rohate śveta na kadācinmahāmate || 7.78.15 ||
translation: स्वशरीरम् one's own body, त्वया by you, पुष्टम् nourished, कुर्वता while performing, तपः penance, उत्तमम् excellent, अनुप्तम् unsown, रोहते grows, श्वेत O white one, न not, कदाचित् ever, महामते O great-minded one.
explanation: O great-minded and white one, your body, which you nourished through excellent penance, will not grow back once consumed, just as something unsown never sprouts.

shloka_text: तृप्तिर्न ते ऽस्ति सूक्ष्मा ऽपि वने सत्वनिषेविते । पुरा तु भिक्षमाणाय भिक्षा वै यतये नृप । न हि दत्ता त्वयेन्द्राभ यस्मादतिथये ऽपि वै ।। 7.78.16 ।।
transliteration: tṛptirna te 'sti sūkṣmā 'pi vane satvaniṣevite | purā tu bhikṣamāṇāya bhikṣā vai yataye nṛpa | na hi dattā tvayendrābha yasmādatithaye 'pi vai || 7.78.16 ||
translation: तृप्तिः satisfaction, न not, ते to you, अस्ति is, सूक्ष्मा even a little, अपि even, वने in the forest, सत्वनिषेविते inhabited by creatures, पुरा formerly, तु but, भिक्षमाणाय to one begging, भिक्षा alms, वै indeed, यतये to an ascetic, नृप O king, न not, हि indeed, दत्ता given, त्वया by you, इन्द्राभ O Indra-like one, यस्मात् because, अतिथये to a guest, अपि even, वै indeed.
explanation: O King, even a little satisfaction is not yours in this forest inhabited by creatures, because formerly, O Indra-like one, you did not give alms to a begging ascetic, nor indeed to any guest.

shloka_text: दत्तं न ते ऽस्ति सूक्ष्मो ऽपि तप एव निषेवसे । तेन स्वर्गगतो वत्स बाध्यसे क्षुत्पिपासया ।। 7.78.17 ।।
transliteration: dattaṃ na te 'sti sūkṣmo 'pi tapa eva niṣevase | tena svargagato vatsa bādhyase kṣutpipāsayā || 7.78.17 ||
translation: दत्तम् charity, न not, ते to you, अस्ति is, सूक्ष्मः even a little, अपि even, तपः penance, एव only, निषेवसे you practiced, तेन therefore, स्वर्गगतः having gone to heaven, वत्स O child, बाध्यसे you are tormented, क्षुत्पिपासया by hunger and thirst.
explanation: You have not given even a little charity, having only practiced penance; therefore, O child, even after reaching heaven, you are tormented by hunger and thirst.

shloka_text: स त्वं सुपुष्टमाहारैः स्वशरीरमनुत्तमम् । भक्षयित्वामृतरसं तेन तृप्तिर्भविष्यति ।। 7.78.18 ।।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ supuṣṭamāhāraiḥ svaśarīramanuttamam | bhakṣayitvāmṛtarasaṃ tena tṛptirbhaviṣyati || 7.78.18 ||
translation: सः that, त्वम् you, सुपुष्टम् well-nourished, आहारैः with food, स्वशरीरम् your own body, अनुत्तमम् excellent, भक्षयित्वा having eaten, अमृतरसम् the nectar-like essence, तेन by that, तृप्तिः satisfaction, भविष्यति will be.
explanation: You, having eaten the nectar-like essence of your own excellent body, which was well-nourished with food, will then find satisfaction.

shloka_text: यदा तु तद्वनं श्वेत अगस्त्यः सुमहानृषिः । आगमिष्यति दुर्धर्षस्तदा कृच्छ्राद्विमोक्ष्यते ।। 7.78.19 ।।
transliteration: yadā tu tadvanaṃ śveta agastyaḥ sumahānṛṣiḥ | āgamiṣyati durdharṣastadā kṛcchrādvimokṣyate || 7.78.19 ||
translation: यदा when, तु but, तत् that, वनम् forest, श्वेत O Śveta, अगस्त्यः Agastya, सुमहानृषिः the great sage, आगमिष्यति will come, दुर्धर्षः unconquerable, तदा then, कृच्छ्रात् from distress, विमोक्ष्यते he will be liberated.
explanation: But, O Śveta, when the great and unconquerable sage Agastya comes to that forest, then you will be liberated from your distress.

shloka_text: स हि तारयितुं सौम्य शक्तः सुरगणानपि । किं पुनस्त्वां महाबाहो क्षुत्पिपासावशं गतम् ।। 7.78.20 ।।
transliteration: sa hi tārayituṃ saumya śaktaḥ suragaṇānapi | kiṃ punastvāṃ mahābāho kṣutpipāsāvaśaṃ gatam || 7.78.20 ||
translation: सः he, हि indeed, तारयितुम् to save, सौम्य O gentle one, शक्तः capable, सुरगणान् the hosts of gods, अपि even, किम् what, पुनः then, त्वाम् you, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, क्षुत्पिपासावशम् under the sway of hunger and thirst, गतम् fallen.
explanation: Indeed, O gentle one, he is capable of saving even the hosts of gods; how much more so can he save you, O mighty-armed one, who have fallen under the sway of hunger and thirst?

shloka_text: सो ऽहं भगवतः श्रुत्वा देवदेवस्य निश्चयम् । आहारं गर्हितं स्वशरीरं द्विजोत्तम ।। 7.78.21 ।।
transliteration: so 'haṃ bhagavataḥ śrutvā devadevasya niścayam | āhāraṃ garhitaṃ svaśarīraṃ dvijottama || 7.78.21 ||
translation: सः that, अहम् I, भगवतः of the venerable one, श्रुत्वा having heard, देवदेवस्य of the god of gods, निश्चयम् the resolve, आहारम् food, गर्हितम् condemned, स्वशरीरम् my own body, द्विजोत्तम O best of brahmins.
explanation: O best of brahmins, having heard the resolve of the venerable god of gods (Shiva), I consider my own body as condemned food.

shloka_text: बहून्वर्षगणान्ब्रह्मन्भुज्यमानमिदं मया । क्षयं नाभ्येति ब्रह्मर्षे तृप्तिश्चापि ममोत्तमा ।। 7.78.22 ।।
transliteration: bahūnvarṣagaṇānbrahmanbhujyamānamidaṃ mayā | kṣayaṃ nābhyeti brahmarṣe tṛptiścāpi mamottamā || 7.78.22 ||
translation: बहून् many, वर्षगणान् years, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmin, भुज्यमानम् being consumed, इदम् this, मया by me, क्षयम् destruction, न not, अभ्येति reaches, ब्रह्मर्षे O Brahmarshi, तृप्तिः satisfaction, च and, अपि also, मम my, उत्तमा supreme.
explanation: O Brahmin, O Brahmarshi, though this body has been consumed by me for many years, it does not undergo destruction, and my satisfaction is also supreme.

shloka_text: तस्य मे कृच्छ्रभूतस्य कृच्छ्रादस्माद्विमोचय । अन्येषां न गतिर्ह्यत्र कुम्भयोनिमृते द्विजम् ।। 7.78.23 ।।
transliteration: tasya me kṛcchrabhūtasya kṛcchrādasmādvimocaya | anyeṣāṃ na gatirhyatra kumbhayonimṛte dvijam || 7.78.23 ||
translation: तस्य of that, मे me, कृच्छ्रभूतस्य who has fallen into distress, कृच्छ्रात् from distress, अस्मात् from this, विमोचय release, अन्येषां for others, न not, गतिः a way, हि indeed, अत्र here, कुम्भयोनिम् the pot-born, ऋते without, द्विजम् the brahmin.
explanation: Therefore, release me, who am in this great distress, from this predicament, for indeed, there is no other way or refuge here for anyone except the pot-born brahmin (Agastya).

shloka_text: इदमाभरणं सौम्य तारणार्थं द्विजोत्तम । प्रतिगृह्णीष्व भद्रं ते प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ।। 7.78.24 ।।
transliteration: idamābharaṇaṃ saumya tāraṇārthaṃ dvijottama | pratigṛhṇīṣva bhadraṃ te prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 7.78.24 ||
translation: इदम् this, आभरणम् ornament, सौम्य O gentle one, तारणार्थम् for deliverance, द्विजोत्तम O best of brahmins, प्रतिगृह्णीष्व please accept, भद्रम् good fortune, ते to you, प्रसादम् favor, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि you ought.
explanation: O gentle one, O best of brahmins, please accept this ornament for my deliverance; may good fortune be yours, and you ought to grant this favor.

shloka_text: इदं तावत्सुवर्णं च धनं वस्त्राणि च द्विज । भक्ष्यं भोज्यं च ब्रह्मर्षे ददात्याभरणानि च ।। 7.78.25 ।।
transliteration: idaṃ tāvatsuvarṇaṃ ca dhanaṃ vastrāṇi ca dvija | bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca brahmarṣe dadātyābharaṇāni ca || 7.78.25 ||
translation: इदम् this, तावत् indeed, सुवर्णम् gold, च and, धनम् wealth, वस्त्राणि clothes, च and, द्विज O brahmin, भक्ष्यम् food to be chewed, भोज्यम् food to be eaten, च and, ब्रह्मर्षे O Brahmarshi, ददाति gives, आभरणानि ornaments, च and.
explanation: O brahmin, O Brahmarshi, this indeed gives gold, wealth, clothes, food to be chewed, food to be eaten, and ornaments.

shloka_text: सर्वान्कामान्प्रयच्छामि भोगांश्च मुनिपुङ्गव । तारणे भगवन्मह्यं प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ।। 7.78.26 ।।
transliteration: sarvānkāmānprayacchāmi bhogāṃśca munipuṅgava | tāraṇe bhagavanmahyaṃ prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 7.78.26 ||
translation: सर्वान् all, कामान् desires, प्रयच्छामि I grant, भोगांश्च and enjoyments, मुनिपुङ्गव O best among sages, तारणे for crossing over, भगवन् O venerable one, मह्यं to me, प्रसादं grace, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि you ought.
explanation: The king pleaded with Agastya, "O best among sages, O venerable one, I grant all desires and enjoyments; please grant me the favor of liberation."

shloka_text: तस्याहं स्वर्गिणो वाक्यं श्रुत्वा दुःखसमन्वितम् । तारणायोपजग्राह तदाभरणमुत्तमम् ।। 7.78.27 ।।
transliteration: tasyāhaṃ svargiṇo vākyaṃ śrutvā duḥkhasamanvitam | tāraṇāyopajagrāha tadābharaṇamuttamam || 7.78.27 ||
translation: तस्य his, अहं I, स्वर्गिणो of the one desiring heaven, वाक्यं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, दुःखसमन्वितम् filled with sorrow, तारणाय for liberation, उपजग्राह I accepted, तदाभरणम् that ornament, उत्तमम् excellent.
explanation: Having heard the sorrowful plea of that king who desired heaven, I accepted his excellent ornament for the purpose of his liberation.

shloka_text: मया प्रतिगृहीते तु तस्मिन्नाभरणे शुभे । मानुषः पूर्वको देहो राजर्षेर्विननाश ह ।। 7.78.28 ।।
transliteration: mayā pratigṛhīte tu tasminnābharaṇe śubhe | mānuṣaḥ pūrvako deho rājarṣervinanāśa ha || 7.78.28 ||
translation: मया by me, प्रतिगृहीते having been accepted, तु indeed, तस्मिन् in that, आभरणे ornament, शुभे auspicious, मानुषः human, पूर्वको former, देहः body, राजर्षेः of the royal sage, विननाश perished, ह indeed.
explanation: Indeed, as soon as that auspicious ornament was accepted by me, the former human body of that royal sage perished.

shloka_text: प्रनष्टे तु शरीरे ऽसौ राजर्षिः परया मुदा । तृप्तः प्रमुदितो राजा जगाम त्रिदिवं सुखम् ।। 7.78.29 ।।
transliteration: pranaṣṭe tu śarīre 'sau rājarṣiḥ parayā mudā | tṛptaḥ pramudito rājā jagāma tridivaṃ sukham || 7.78.29 ||
translation: प्रनष्टे having perished, तु indeed, शरीरे body, असौ that, राजर्षिः royal sage, परया with supreme, मुदा joy, तृप्तः satisfied, प्रमुदितो greatly delighted, राजा king, जगाम went, त्रिदिवं to heaven, सुखम् happily.
explanation: Indeed, when his body perished, that royal sage, the king, filled with supreme joy, satisfied and greatly delighted, happily ascended to heaven.

shloka_text: तेनेदं शक्रतुल्येन दिव्यमाभरणं मम । तस्मिन्निमित्ते काकुत्स्थ दत्तमद्भुतदर्शनम् ।। 7.78.30 ।।
transliteration: tenedaṃ śakratulyena divyamābharaṇaṃ mama | tasminnimitte kākutstha dattamadbhutadarśanam || 7.78.30 ||
translation: तेन by him, इदं this, शक्रतुल्येन by one equal to Indra, दिव्यम् divine, आभरणं ornament, मम to me, तस्मिन् on that, निमित्ते occasion, काकुत्स्थ O descendant of Kakutstha, दत्तम् given, अद्भुतदर्शनम् of wondrous appearance.
explanation: O Kakutstha, this divine ornament of wondrous appearance was given to me by that king, who was equal to Indra, on that very occasion. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 78 ।। Thus ends the seventy-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तदद्भुततमं वाक्यं श्रुत्वागस्त्यस्य राघवः । गौरवाद्विस्मयाच्चैव पुनः प्रष्टुं प्रचक्रमे ।। 7.79.1 ।।
transliteration: tadadbhutatamaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvāgastyasya rāghavaḥ | gauravādvismayāccaiva punaḥ praṣṭuṃ pracakrame || 7.79.1 ||
translation: तत् that, अद्भुततमम् most wonderful, वाक्यम् statement, श्रुत्वा having heard, अगस्त्यस्य of Agastya, राघवः Rama, गौरवात् out of respect, विस्मयात् out of wonder, च and, एव indeed, पुनः again, प्रष्टुम् to ask, प्रचक्रमे began.
explanation: Having heard that most wonderful statement from Agastya, Rama, out of both respect and wonder, began to ask again.
comments: Rama asks why that forest was desolate, and Agastya tells how Manu set his son Ikshvaku to found royal lines -- Ikshvaku's hundred sons included a dull and unruly youngest named Danda, who founded a city called Madhumanta between the Vindhya and Shaivala mountains, with Shukra as his priest, and ruled there.

shloka_text: भगवंस्तद्वनं घोरं तपस्तप्यति यत्र सः । श्वेतो वैदर्भको राजा कथं स्यादमृगद्विजम् ।। 7.79.2 ।।
transliteration: bhagavaṃstadvanaṃ ghoraṃ tapastapyati yatra saḥ | śveto vaidarbhako rājā kathaṃ syādamṛgadvijam || 7.79.2 ||
translation: भगवन् O venerable one, तत् that, वनम् forest, घोरम् dreadful, तपः penance, तप्यति performs, यत्र where, सः he, श्वेतः Shveta, वैदर्भकः of Vidarbha, राजा king, कथम् how, स्यात् could it be, अमृगद्विजम् without deer and birds.
explanation: O venerable one, how could that dreadful forest, where King Shveta of Vidarbha performed penance, be devoid of deer and birds?

shloka_text: तद्वनं स कथ राजा शून्यं मनुजवर्जितम् । तपश्चर्तुं प्रविष्टः स श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः ।। 7.79.3 ।।
transliteration: tadvanaṃ sa katha rājā śūnyaṃ manujavarjitam | tapaścartuṃ praviṣṭaḥ sa śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 7.79.3 ||
translation: तत् that, वनम् forest, सः he, कथम् how, राजा king, शून्यम् empty, मनुजवर्जितम् devoid of humans, तपः penance, चर्तुम् to perform, प्रविष्टः entered, सः he, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छामि I wish, तत्त्वतः truly.
explanation: I truly wish to hear how that king entered such a desolate forest, devoid of humans, to perform penance.

shloka_text: रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा कौतूहलसमन्वितम् । वाक्यं परमतेजस्वी वक्तुमेवोपचक्रमे ।। 7.79.4 ।।
transliteration: rāmasya vacanaṃ śrutvā kautūhalasamanvitam | vākyaṃ paramatejasvī vaktumevopacakrame || 7.79.4 ||
translation: रामस्य of Rama, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, कौतूहलसमन्वितम् filled with curiosity, वाक्यम् words, परमतेजस्वी the highly effulgent one, वक्तुम् to speak, एव indeed, उपचक्रमे began.
explanation: Having heard Rama's words, which were filled with curiosity, the highly effulgent Agastya indeed began to speak.

shloka_text: पुरा कृतयुगे राम मनुर्दण्डधरः प्रभुः । तस्य पुत्रो महानासीदिक्ष्वाकुः कुलनन्दनः ।। 7.79.5 ।।
transliteration: purā kṛtayuge rāma manurdaṇḍadharaḥ prabhuḥ | tasya putro mahānāsīdikṣvākuḥ kulanandanaḥ || 7.79.5 ||
translation: पुरा formerly, कृतयुगे in the Krita Yuga, राम O Rama, मनुः Manu, दण्डधरः wielder of the scepter, प्रभुः lord, तस्य his, पुत्रः son, महान् great, आसीत् was, इक्ष्वाकुः Ikshvaku, कुलनन्दनः delight of the family.
explanation: O Rama, formerly in the Krita Yuga, there was a powerful lord named Manu, the wielder of the scepter, and his great son, Ikshvaku, was the delight of his family.

shloka_text: तं पुत्रं पूर्वंकं राज्ये निक्षिप्य भुवि दुर्जयम् । पृथिव्यां राजवंशानां भव कर्तेत्युवाच ह ।। 7.79.6 ।।
transliteration: taṃ putraṃ pūrvaṃkaṃ rājye nikṣipya bhuvi durjayam | pṛthivyāṃ rājavaṃśānāṃ bhava kartetyuvāca ha || 7.79.6 ||
translation: तम् that, पुत्रम् son, पूर्वंकम् the first-born, राज्ये in the kingdom, निक्षिप्य having placed, भुवि on the earth, दुर्जयम् unconquerable, पृथिव्याम् on the earth, राजवंशानाम् of royal dynasties, भव become, कर्ता the creator, इति thus, उवाच said, ह indeed,
explanation: Having placed that unconquerable first-born son in the kingdom on earth, Manu said to him, "Become the founder of royal dynasties on this earth."

shloka_text: तथैवेति प्रतिज्ञातं पितुः पुत्रेण राघव । ततः परमसन्तुष्टो मनुः पुत्रमुवाच ह ।। 7.79.7 ।।
transliteration: tathaiveti pratijñātaṃ pituḥ putreṇa rāghava | tataḥ paramasantuṣṭo manuḥ putramuvāca ha || 7.79.7 ||
translation: तथा so, एव indeed, इति thus, प्रतिज्ञातम् was promised, पितुः by the father, पुत्रेण by the son, राघव O Rama, ततः then, परमसन्तुष्टः extremely pleased, मनुः Manu, पुत्रम् to the son, उवाच said, ह indeed,
explanation: O Rama, the son assented to his father's command, and then Manu, extremely pleased, spoke to his son.

shloka_text: प्रीतो ऽस्मि परमोदार त्वं कर्ता ऽसि न संशयः । दण्डेन च प्रजा रक्ष मा च दण्डमकारणे ।। 7.79.8 ।।
transliteration: prīto 'smi paramodāra tvaṃ kartā 'si na saṃśayaḥ | daṇḍena ca prajā rakṣa mā ca daṇḍamakāraṇe || 7.79.8 ||
translation: प्रीतः pleased, अस्मि I am, परमोदार O most generous one, त्वम् you, कर्ता the creator, असि are, न no, संशयः doubt, दण्डेन by punishment, च and, प्रजाः the subjects, रक्ष protect, मा do not, च and, दण्डम् punishment, अकारणे without cause,
explanation: Manu said, "O most generous one, I am pleased; you are indeed the creator, of this there is no doubt; protect the subjects with justice, but do not inflict punishment without cause."

shloka_text: अपराधिषु यो दण्डः पात्यते मानवेषु वै । स दण्डो विधिवन्मुक्तः स्वर्गं नयति पार्थिवम् ।। 7.79.9 ।।
transliteration: aparādhiṣu yo daṇḍaḥ pātyate mānaveṣu vai | sa daṇḍo vidhivanmuktaḥ svargaṃ nayati pārthivam || 7.79.9 ||
translation: अपराधिषु on offenders, यः which, दण्डः punishment, पात्यते is inflicted, मानवेषु among men, वै indeed, सः that, दण्डः punishment, विधिवत् according to law, मुक्तः administered, स्वर्गम् to heaven, नयति leads, पार्थिवम् the king,
explanation: The punishment that is properly inflicted upon offenders among men, when administered according to law, leads the king to heaven.

shloka_text: तस्माद्दण्डे महाबाहो यत्नवान्भव पुत्रक । धर्मो हि परमो लोके कुर्वतस्ते भविष्यति ।। 7.79.10 ।।
transliteration: tasmāddaṇḍe mahābāho yatnavānbhava putraka | dharmo hi paramo loke kurvataste bhaviṣyati || 7.79.10 ||
translation: तस्मात् therefore, दण्डे in punishment, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, यत्नवान् diligent, भव be, पुत्रक O son, धर्मः righteousness, हि indeed, परमः supreme, लोके in the world, कुर्वतः while performing, ते for you, भविष्यति will be,
explanation: Therefore, O mighty-armed son, be diligent in administering justice, for by doing so, supreme righteousness will be yours in this world.

shloka_text: इति तं बहु सन्दिश्य मनुः पुत्रं समाधिना । जगाम त्रिदिवं हृष्टो ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम् ।। 7.79.11 ।।
transliteration: iti taṃ bahu sandiśya manuḥ putraṃ samādhinā | jagāma tridivaṃ hṛṣṭo brahmalokaṃ sanātanam || 7.79.11 ||
translation: इति thus, तं to him, बहु much, सन्दिश्य having instructed, मनुः Manu, पुत्रं his son, समाधिना with a composed mind, जगाम went, त्रिदिवं to heaven, हृष्टो delighted, ब्रह्मलोकं to the world of Brahma, सनातनम् eternal,
explanation: Having thus given many instructions to his son with a composed mind, Manu, delighted, went to the eternal world of Brahma, which is heaven.

shloka_text: प्रयाते त्रिदिवं तस्मिन्निक्ष्वाकुरमितप्रभः । जनयिष्ये कथं पुत्रानिति चिन्तापरो ऽभवत् ।। 7.79.12 ।।
transliteration: prayāte tridivaṃ tasminnikṣvākuramitaprabhaḥ | janayiṣye kathaṃ putrāniti cintāparo 'bhavat || 7.79.12 ||
translation: प्रयाते having departed, त्रिदिवं to heaven, तस्मिन् when he (Manu), इक्श्वाकुः Ikshvaku, अमितप्रभः of immeasurable splendor, जनयिष्ये shall I beget, कथं how, पुत्रान् sons, इति thus, चिन्तापरो absorbed in thought, अभवत् became,
explanation: When Manu had departed to heaven, Ikshvaku, who was of immeasurable splendor, became absorbed in the thought, "How shall I beget sons?"

shloka_text: कर्मभिर्बहुरूपैश्च तैस्तैर्मनुसुतस्सुतान् । जनयामास धर्मात्मा शतं देवसुतोपमान् ।। 7.79.13 ।।
transliteration: karmabhirbahurūpaiśca taistairmanusutassutān | janayāmāsa dharmātmā śataṃ devasutopamān || 7.79.13 ||
translation: कर्मभिः by deeds, बहुरूपैः of many kinds, च and, तैस्तैः by those various, मनुसुतः Manu's son, सुतान् sons, जनयामास begot, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, शतं a hundred, देवसुतोपमान् resembling sons of gods,
explanation: The righteous son of Manu, Ikshvaku, then begot a hundred sons, resembling the sons of gods, through various kinds of rituals and deeds.

shloka_text: तेषामवरजस्तात सर्वेषां रघुनन्दन । मूढश्चाकृतविद्यश्च न शुश्रूषति पूर्वजान् ।। 7.79.14 ।।
transliteration: teṣāmavarajastāta sarveṣāṃ raghunandana | mūḍhaścākṛtavidyaśca na śuśrūṣati pūrvajān || 7.79.14 ||
translation: तेषां among them, अवरजः the youngest, तात O dear one, सर्वेषां of all, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghu dynasty, मूढः foolish, च and, अकृतविद्यः uneducated, च and, न not, शुश्रूषति serves, पूर्वजान् his elders,
explanation: O dear Rama, the delight of the Raghu dynasty, the youngest among all those sons was foolish and uneducated, and he did not serve his elders.

shloka_text: नाम तस्य च दण्डेति पिता चक्रे ऽल्पमेधसः । अवश्यं दण्डपतनं शरीरे ऽस्य भविष्यति ।। 7.79.15 ।।
transliteration: nāma tasya ca daṇḍeti pitā cakre 'lpamedhasaḥ | avaśyaṃ daṇḍapatanaṃ śarīre 'sya bhaviṣyati || 7.79.15 ||
translation: नाम name, तस्य his, च and, दण्डः Danda, इति thus, पिता father, चक्रे gave, अल्पमेधसः to the dull-witted one, अवश्यं certainly, दण्डपतनं the falling of punishment, शरीरे on the body, अस्य his, भविष्यति will be,
explanation: His father named that dull-witted son Danda, thinking that punishment would certainly befall his body.

shloka_text: अपश्यमानस्तं देशं घोरं पुत्रस्य राघव । विन्ध्यशैवलयोर्मध्ये राज्यं प्रादादरिन्दम ।। 7.79.16 ।।
transliteration: apaśyamānastaṃ deśaṃ ghoraṃ putrasya rāghava | vindhyaśaivalayormadhye rājyaṃ prādādarindama || 7.79.16 ||
translation: अपश्यमानः not finding, तम् that, देशम् region, घोरम् dreadful, पुत्रस्य of the son (Lavana), राघव O Raghava, विन्ध्यशैवलयोः of Vindhya and Shaivala, मध्ये in the middle, राज्यम् kingdom, प्रादात् established, अरिन्दम O destroyer of enemies.
explanation: O Raghava, O destroyer of enemies, not finding that dreadful region of Lavana suitable, he (Shatrughna) established a kingdom in the middle of the Vindhya and Shaivala mountains.

shloka_text: स दण्डस्तत्र राजाभूद्रम्ये पर्वतरोधसि । पुरं चाप्रतिमं राम न्यवेशयदनुत्तमम् ।। 7.79.17 ।।
transliteration: sa daṇḍastatra rājābhūdramye parvatarodhasi | puraṃ cāpratimaṃ rāma nyaveśayadanuttamam || 7.79.17 ||
translation: सः he, दण्डः the wielder of justice, तत्र there, राजा king, अभूत् became, रम्ये beautiful, पर्वतरोधसि on the mountain slope, पुरम् city, च and, अप्रतिमम् unequalled, राम O Rama, न्यवेशयत् established, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.
explanation: O Rama, he (Shatrughna), the wielder of justice, became king there on the beautiful mountain slope and established an unequalled, unsurpassed city.

shloka_text: पुरस्य चाकरोन्नाम मधुमन्तमिति प्रभो । पुरोहितं तूशनसं वरयामास सुव्रतम् ।। 7.79.18 ।।
transliteration: purasya cākaronnāma madhumantamiti prabho | purohitaṃ tūśanasaṃ varayāmāsa suvratam || 7.79.18 ||
translation: पुरस्य of the city, च and, अकरोत् made, नाम name, मधुमन्तम् Madhumanta, इति thus, प्रभो O Lord, पुरोहितम् priest, तु indeed, उशनसम् Ushanas, वरयामास chose, सुव्रतम् righteous.
explanation: And, O Lord, he named the city Madhumanta and indeed chose the righteous Ushanas as his priest.

shloka_text: एवं स राजा तद्राज्यमकरोत्सपुरोहितः । प्रहृष्टमनुजाकीर्णं देवराजं यथा वृषा ।। 7.79.19 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ sa rājā tadrājyamakarotsapurohitaḥ | prahṛṣṭamanujākīrṇaṃ devarājaṃ yathā vṛṣā || 7.79.19 ||
translation: एवम् thus, सः he, राजा king, तत् that, राज्यम् kingdom, अकरोत् ruled, सपुरोहितः with his priest, प्रहृष्टमनुजाकीर्णम् filled with joyful people, देवराजम् the king of gods, यथा as, वृषा Indra.
explanation: Thus, that king (Shatrughna), with his priest, ruled that kingdom, which was filled with joyful people, just as Indra rules the kingdom of the gods.

shloka_text: ततः स राजा मनुजेन्द्रपुत्रः सार्धं च तेनोशनसा तदानीम् । चकार राज्यं सुमहान्महात्मा शक्रो दिवीवोशनसा समेतः ।। 7.79.20 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa rājā manujendraputraḥ sārdhaṃ ca tenośanasā tadānīm | cakāra rājyaṃ sumahānmahātmā śakro divīvośanasā sametaḥ || 7.79.20 ||
translation: ततः then, सः he, राजा king, मनुजेन्द्रपुत्रः son of the lord of men, सार्धम् together, च and, तेन with him, उशनसा Ushanas, तदानीम् at that time, चकार ruled, राज्यम् kingdom, सुमहान् very great, महात्मा great-souled, शक्रः Indra, दिवि in heaven, इव like, उशनसा with Ushanas, समेतः accompanied by.
explanation: Then, that great-souled king, the son of the lord of men (Shatrughna), together with Ushanas at that time, ruled the very great kingdom, just as Indra, accompanied by Ushanas, rules in heaven. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोनशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 79 ।। Thus ends the seventy-ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एतदाख्याय रामाय महर्षिः कुम्भसम्भवः । अस्यामेवापरं वाक्यं कथायामुपचक्रमे ।। 7.80.1 ।।
transliteration: etadākhyāya rāmāya maharṣiḥ kumbhasambhavaḥ | asyāmevāparaṃ vākyaṃ kathāyāmupacakrame || 7.80.1 ||
translation: एतत् this, आख्याय having narrated, रामाय to Rama, महर्षिः the great sage, कुम्भसम्भवः Agastya, अस्याम् in this, एव indeed, अपरम् another, वाक्यम् statement, कथायाम् in the story, उपचक्रमे began.
explanation: Having narrated this to Rama, the great sage Agastya then began another part of the same story.
comments: At Bhrigu's hermitage King Danda lusts for the sage's daughter Araja -- though she bids him seek her lawfully from her father, his own preceptor, the maddened king forces her and flees to his city -- and the terrified Araja waits weeping for her father's return.

shloka_text: ततः स दण्डः काकुत्स्थ बहुवर्षगणायुतम् । अकरोत्तत्र दान्तात्मा राज्यं निहतकण्टकम् ।। 7.80.2 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa daṇḍaḥ kākutstha bahuvarṣagaṇāyutam | akarottatra dāntātmā rājyaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam || 7.80.2 ||
translation: ततः then, सः he, दण्डः Danda, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, बहुवर्षगणायुतम् for many thousands of years, अकरोत् ruled, तत्र there, दान्तात्मा with a controlled self, राज्यम् the kingdom, निहतकण्टकम् free from enemies.
explanation: O Kakutstha, then King Danda, with a controlled mind, ruled his kingdom there, free from enemies, for many thousands of years.

shloka_text: अथ काले तु कस्मिंश्चिद्राजा भार्गवमाश्रमम् । रमणीयमुपाक्रामच्चैत्रे मासि मनोरमे ।। 7.80.3 ।।
transliteration: atha kāle tu kasmiṃścidrājā bhārgavamāśramam | ramaṇīyamupākrāmaccaitre māsi manorame || 7.80.3 ||
translation: अथ then, काले at a time, तु indeed, कस्मिंश्चित् some, राजा the king, भार्गवम् of Bhrigu, आश्रमम् the hermitage, रमणीयम् delightful, उपाक्रामत् approached, चैत्रे in Chaitra, मासि in the month, मनोरमे charming.
explanation: Then, at some point, the king approached the delightful hermitage of Bhrigu in the charming month of Chaitra.

shloka_text: तत्र भार्गवकन्यां स रूपेणाप्रतिमां भुवि । विचरन्तीं वनोद्देशे दण्डो ऽपश्यदनुत्तमाम् ।। 7.80.4 ।।
transliteration: tatra bhārgavakanyāṃ sa rūpeṇāpratimāṃ bhuvi | vicarantīṃ vanoddeśe daṇḍo 'paśyadanuttamām || 7.80.4 ||
translation: तत्र there, भार्गवकन्याम् the daughter of Bhrigu, सः he, रूपेण in beauty, अप्रतिमाम् unequalled, भुवि on earth, विचरन्तीम् wandering, वनोद्देशे in the forest region, दण्डः Danda, अपश्यत् saw, अनुत्तमाम् unsurpassed.
explanation: There, King Danda saw the unsurpassed daughter of Bhrigu, unequalled in beauty on earth, wandering in the forest region.

shloka_text: स दृष्ट्वा तां सुदुर्मेधा अनङ्गशरपीडितः । अभिगम्य सुसंविग्नां कन्यां वचनमब्रवीत् ।। 7.80.5 ।।
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā tāṃ sudurmedhā anaṅgaśarapīḍitaḥ | abhigamya susaṃvignāṃ kanyāṃ vacanamabravīt || 7.80.5 ||
translation: सः he, दृष्ट्वा having seen, ताम् her, सुदुर्मेधाः very foolish, अनङ्गशरपीडितः afflicted by the arrows of Kama, अभिगम्य having approached, सुसंविग्नाम् very agitated, कन्याम् the maiden, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having seen her, the very foolish king, afflicted by the arrows of Kama, approached the very agitated maiden and spoke words to her.

shloka_text: कुतस्त्वमसि सुश्रोणि कस्य वा ऽसि सुता शुभे । पीडितो ऽहमनङ्गेन गच्छामि त्वां शुभानने ।। 7.80.6 ।।
transliteration: kutastvamasi suśroṇi kasya vā 'si sutā śubhe | pīḍito 'hamanaṅgena gacchāmi tvāṃ śubhānane || 7.80.6 ||
translation: कुतः whence, त्वम् you, असि are, सुश्रोणि O beautiful-hipped one, कस्य whose, वा or, असि are, सुता daughter, शुभे O auspicious one, पीडितः afflicted, अहम् I, अनङ्गेन by Ananga, गच्छामि I approach, त्वाम् you, शुभानने O beautiful-faced one.
explanation: O beautiful-hipped one, from where are you, or whose daughter are you, O auspicious one; I am tormented by Cupid, and so I approach you, O beautiful-faced one.

shloka_text: तस्य त्वेवं ब्रुवाणस्य मोहोन्मत्तस्य कामिनः । भार्गवी प्रत्युवाचेदं वचः सानुनयं नृपम् ।। 7.80.7 ।।
transliteration: tasya tvevaṃ bruvāṇasya mohonmattasya kāminaḥ | bhārgavī pratyuvācedaṃ vacaḥ sānunayaṃ nṛpam || 7.80.7 ||
translation: तस्य to him, तु indeed, एवम् thus, ब्रुवाणस्य speaking, मोहोन्मत्तस्य maddened by delusion, कामिनः lustful, भार्गवी the daughter of Bhrigu, प्रत्युवाच replied, इदम् this, वचः word, सानुनयम् with humility, नृपम् to the king.
explanation: To that lustful king, who was speaking thus, maddened by infatuation, the daughter of Bhrigu replied with these humble words.

shloka_text: भार्गवस्य सुतां विद्धि देवस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः । अरजां नाम राजेन्द्र ज्येष्ठामाश्रमवासिनीम् ।। 7.80.8 ।।
transliteration: bhārgavasya sutāṃ viddhi devasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ | arajāṃ nāma rājendra jyeṣṭhāmāśramavāsinīm || 7.80.8 ||
translation: भार्गवस्य of Bhrigu, सुताम् daughter, विद्धि know, देवस्य of the divine one, अक्लिष्टकर्मणः of unwearied deeds, अरजाम् Araja, नाम named, राजेन्द्र O king of kings, ज्येष्ठाम् the eldest, आश्रमवासिनीम् dwelling in the hermitage.
explanation: O king of kings, know me to be Araja by name, the eldest daughter of the divine sage Bhrigu, whose deeds are pure, and who dwells in the hermitage.

shloka_text: मा मां स्पृश बलाद्राजन्कन्या पितृवशा ह्यहम् । गुरुः पिता मे राजेन्द्र त्वं च शिष्यो महात्मनः । व्यसनं सुमहत्क्रुद्धः स ते दद्यान्महातपाः ।। 7.80.9 ।।
transliteration: mā māṃ spṛśa balādrājankanyā pitṛvaśā hyaham | guruḥ pitā me rājendra tvaṃ ca śiṣyo mahātmanaḥ | vyasanaṃ sumahatkruddhaḥ sa te dadyānmahātapāḥ || 7.80.9 ||
translation: मा do not, माम् me, स्पृश touch, बलात् by force, राजन् O king, कन्या a maiden, पितृवशा dependent on her father, हि indeed, अहम् I, गुरुः teacher, पिता father, मे my, राजेन्द्र O king of kings, त्वम् you, च and, शिष्यः disciple, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, व्यसनम् calamity, सुमहत् very great, क्रुद्धः enraged, सः he, ते to you, दद्यात् would give, महातपाः of great penance.
explanation: O king, do not touch me by force, for I am a maiden dependent on my father; O king of kings, my father is your preceptor, and you are the disciple of that great-souled one, and if enraged, that sage of great penance would inflict a very great calamity upon you.

shloka_text: यदि वान्यन्मया कार्यं धर्मदृष्टेन सत्पथा । वरयस्व नरश्रेष्ठ पितरं मे महाद्युतिम् ।। 7.80.10 ।।
transliteration: yadi vānyanmayā kāryaṃ dharmadṛṣṭena satpathā | varayasva naraśreṣṭha pitaraṃ me mahādyutim || 7.80.10 ||
translation: यदि if, वा or, अन्यत् anything else, मया by me, कार्यम् to be done, धर्मदृष्टेन according to dharma, सत्पथा by the righteous path, वरयस्व ask for, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, पितरम् father, मे my, महाद्युतिम् highly effulgent.
explanation: O best among men, if anything else is to be done by me according to the righteous path of dharma, then ask for me from my glorious father.

shloka_text: अन्यथा तु फलं तुभ्यं भवेद्घोराभिसंहितम् । क्रोधेन हि पिता मे ऽसौ त्रैलोक्यमपि निर्दहेत् ।। 7.80.11 ।।
transliteration: anyathā tu phalaṃ tubhyaṃ bhavedghorābhisaṃhitam | krodhena hi pitā me 'sau trailokyamapi nirdahet || 7.80.11 ||
translation: अन्यथा otherwise, तु indeed, फलम् consequence, तुभ्यम् for you, भवेत् would be, घोराभिसंहितम् terrible, क्रोधेन by anger, हि indeed, पिता father, मे my, असौ he, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, अपि even, निर्दहेत् would burn completely.
explanation: Otherwise, the consequence for you would be terrible, for my father, in his anger, could indeed burn down even the three worlds.

shloka_text: दास्यते चानवद्याङ्ग तव मा याचितः पिता ।। 7.80.12 ।।
transliteration: dāsyate cānavadyāṅga tava mā yācitaḥ pitā || 7.80.12 ||
translation: दास्यते will give, च and, अनवद्याङ्ग O one with faultless limbs, तव to you, मा me, याचितः when requested, पिता father.
explanation: And O one with faultless limbs, my father will give me to you when he is requested.

shloka_text: एवं ब्रुवाणामरजां दण्डः कामवशं गतः । प्रत्युवाच मदोन्मत्तः शिरस्याधाय चाञ्जलिम् ।। 7.80.13 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ bruvāṇāmarajāṃ daṇḍaḥ kāmavaśaṃ gataḥ | pratyuvāca madonmattaḥ śirasyādhāya cāñjalim || 7.80.13 ||
translation: एवम् thus, ब्रुवाणाम् to the speaking, अरजाम् to Araja, दण्डः Danda, कामवशम् under the sway of desire, गतः having gone, प्रत्युवाच replied, मदोन्मत्तः intoxicated with passion, शिरसि on the head, आधाय having placed, च and, अञ्जलिम् folded hands.
explanation: Having thus gone under the sway of desire, Danda, intoxicated with passion, replied to Araja, placing his folded hands on his head.

shloka_text: प्रसादं कुरु सुश्रोणि न कालं क्षेप्तुमर्हसि । त्वत्कृते हि मम प्राणा विदीर्यन्ते वरानने ।। 7.80.14 ।।
transliteration: prasādaṃ kuru suśroṇi na kālaṃ kṣeptumarhasi | tvatkṛte hi mama prāṇā vidīryante varānane || 7.80.14 ||
translation: प्रसादम् favor, कुरु do, सुश्रोणि O one with beautiful hips, न not, कालम् time, क्षेप्तुम् to waste, अर्हसि you ought, त्वत्कृते for your sake, हि indeed, मम my, प्राणाः life breaths, विदीर्यन्ते are being torn apart, वरानने O one with a beautiful face.
explanation: O one with beautiful hips and a beautiful face, please grant me your favor; you should not waste time, for indeed, my life breaths are being torn apart for your sake.

shloka_text: त्वां प्राप्य मे वधो वा स्याच्छापो वा यदि दारुणः । भक्तं भजस्व मां भीरु भजमानं सुविह्वलम् ।। 7.80.15 ।।
transliteration: tvāṃ prāpya me vadho vā syācchāpo vā yadi dāruṇaḥ | bhaktaṃ bhajasva māṃ bhīru bhajamānaṃ suvihvalam || 7.80.15 ||
translation: त्वाम् you, प्राप्य having obtained, मे my, वधः death, वा or, स्यात् may be, शापः curse, वा or, यदि if, दारुणः terrible, भक्तम् devoted, भजस्व accept, माम् me, भीरु O timid one, भजमानम् serving, सुविह्वलम् greatly agitated.
explanation: O timid one, even if I obtain you and face death or a terrible curse, please accept me, your devoted servant who is greatly agitated.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा तु तां कन्यां दोर्भ्यां गृह्य बलाद्बली । विस्फुरन्तीं यथाकामं मैथुनायोपचक्रमे ।। 7.80.16 ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu tāṃ kanyāṃ dorbhyāṃ gṛhya balādbalī | visphurantīṃ yathākāmaṃ maithunāyopacakrame || 7.80.16 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, तु indeed, ताम् her, कन्याम् maiden, दोर्भ्याम् with two arms, गृह्य having seized, बलात् by force, बली the strong one, विस्फुरन्तीम् struggling, यथाकामम् as he desired, मैथुनाय for sexual intercourse, उपचक्रमे he began.
explanation: Having spoken thus, the powerful Daṇḍa seized the struggling maiden with his arms by force and proceeded to have sexual intercourse with her as he desired.

shloka_text: एतमर्थं महाघोरं दण्डः कृत्वा सुदारुणम् । नगरं प्रययावाशु मधुमन्तमनुत्तमम् ।। 7.80.17 ।।
transliteration: etamarthaṃ mahāghoraṃ daṇḍaḥ kṛtvā sudāruṇam | nagaraṃ prayayāvāśu madhumantamanuttamam || 7.80.17 ||
translation: एतम् this, अर्थम् deed, महाघोरम् very terrible, दण्डः Daṇḍa, कृत्वा having committed, सुदारुणम् very cruel, नगरम् to the city, प्रययाव he went, आशु quickly, मधुमन्तम् Madhumanta, अनुत्तमम् unequalled.
explanation: Having committed this extremely dreadful and very cruel act, Daṇḍa quickly departed to his unequalled city of Madhumanta.

shloka_text: अरजा ऽपि रुदन्ती सा आश्रमस्याविदूरतः । प्रतीक्षन्ति सुसंत्रस्ता पितरं देवसन्निभम् ।। 7.80.18 ।।
transliteration: arajā 'pi rudantī sā āśramasyāvidūrataḥ | pratīkṣanti susaṃtrastā pitaraṃ devasannibham || 7.80.18 ||
translation: अरजा Arajā, अपि also, रुदन्ती weeping, सा she, आश्रमस्य of the hermitage, अविदूरतः not far from, प्रतीक्षन्ति she waited for, सुसंत्रस्ता greatly terrified, पितरम् father, देवसन्निभम् god-like.
explanation: Arajā, greatly terrified and weeping, waited for her god-like father not far from the hermitage. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 80 ।। Thus ends the eightieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: स मुहूर्तादुपश्रुत्य देवर्षिरमितप्रभः । स्वमाश्रमं शिष्यवृतः क्षुधार्तः सन्न्यवर्तत ।। 7.81.1 ।।
transliteration: sa muhūrtādupaśrutya devarṣiramitaprabhaḥ | svamāśramaṃ śiṣyavṛtaḥ kṣudhārtaḥ sannyavartata || 7.81.1 ||
translation: सः he, मुहूर्तात् after a short while, उपश्रुत्य having heard, देवर्षिः the divine sage, अमितप्रभः of immeasurable splendor, स्वम् his own, आश्रमम् hermitage, शिष्यवृतः surrounded by disciples, क्षुधार्तः afflicted by hunger, सन्न्यवर्तत he returned.
explanation: After a short while, the divine sage of immeasurable splendor, surrounded by his disciples and afflicted by hunger, returned to his hermitage, having heard (something amiss).
comments: The returning Bhrigu, learning of the outrage, curses Danda to perish within seven nights with all his realm under a rain of dust -- having removed the hermits to safety and bidden Araja dwell unharmed by the lake, the curse falls and the whole kingdom is reduced to ashes, thereafter called Dandakaranya, or Janasthana -- and Agastya sends Rama to his evening prayers as the sun sets.

shloka_text: सो ऽपश्यदरजां दीनां रजसा समभिप्लुताम् । ज्योत्स्नामिव ग्रहग्रस्तां प्रत्यूषे न विराजतीम् ।। 7.81.2 ।।
transliteration: so 'paśyadarajāṃ dīnāṃ rajasā samabhiplutām | jyotsnāmiva grahagrastāṃ pratyūṣe na virājatīm || 7.81.2 ||
translation: सः he, अपश्यत् he saw, अरजाम् Arajā, दीनाम् distressed, रजसा with impurity, समभिप्लुताम् covered, ज्योत्स्नाम् moonlight, इव like, ग्रहग्रस्ताम् eclipsed, प्रत्यूषे at dawn, न not, विराजतीम् shining.
explanation: He saw Arajā, distressed and covered with impurity, like moonlight eclipsed by a planet and not shining brightly at dawn.

shloka_text: तस्य रोषः समभवत्क्षुधार्तस्य विशेषतः । निर्दहन्निव लोकांस्त्रीञ्छिष्यांश्चैतदुवाच ह ।। 7.81.3 ।।
transliteration: tasya roṣaḥ samabhavatkṣudhārtasya viśeṣataḥ | nirdahanniva lokāṃstrīñchiṣyāṃścaitaduvāca ha || 7.81.3 ||
translation: तस्य his, रोषः anger, समभवत् arose, क्षुधार्तस्य of the hungry one, विशेषतः especially, निर्दहन्निव as if burning, लोकान् worlds, त्रीन् three, शिष्यान् to the disciples, च and, एतत् this, उवाच said, ह indeed.
explanation: His anger, especially due to hunger, arose as if burning the three worlds, and he spoke this to his disciples.

shloka_text: पश्यध्वं विपरीतस्य दण्डस्याविजितात्मनः । विपत्तिं घोरसङ्काशां क्रुद्धामग्निशिखामिव ।। 7.81.4 ।।
transliteration: paśyadhvaṃ viparītasya daṇḍasyāvijitātmanaḥ | vipattiṃ ghorasaṅkāśāṃ kruddhāmagniśikhāmiva || 7.81.4 ||
translation: पश्यध्वं behold, विपरीतस्य of the perverse, दण्डस्य of Daṇḍa, अविजितात्मनः of the uncontrolled one, विपत्तिं the calamity, घोरसङ्काशां terrible-looking, क्रुद्धां enraged, अग्निशिखाम् a flame of fire, इव like.
explanation: Behold the terrible calamity, like an enraged flame of fire, that will befall the perverse and uncontrolled King Daṇḍa.

shloka_text: क्षयो ऽस्य दुर्मतेः प्राप्तः सानुगस्य दुरात्मनः । यः प्रदीप्तां हुताशस्य शिखां वै स्प्रष्टुमिच्छति ।। 7.81.5 ।।
transliteration: kṣayo 'sya durmateḥ prāptaḥ sānugasya durātmanaḥ | yaḥ pradīptāṃ hutāśasya śikhāṃ vai spraṣṭumicchati || 7.81.5 ||
translation: क्षयः destruction, अस्य of this, दुर्मतेः evil-minded one, प्राप्तः is imminent, सानुगस्य with his followers, दुरात्मनः of the wicked one, यः who, प्रदीप्तां blazing, हुताशस्य of fire, शिखां a flame, वै indeed, स्प्रष्टुम् to touch, इच्छति desires.
explanation: The destruction of this evil-minded and wicked one, along with his followers, is imminent, for he desires to touch a blazing flame of fire.

shloka_text: यस्मात्स कृतवान्पापमीदृशं घोरसंहितम् । तस्मात्प्राप्स्यति दुर्मेधाः फलं पापस्य कर्मणः ।। 7.81.6 ।।
transliteration: yasmātsa kṛtavānpāpamīdṛśaṃ ghorasaṃhitam | tasmātprāpsyati durmedhāḥ phalaṃ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ || 7.81.6 ||
translation: यस्मात् because, सः he, कृतवान् has committed, पापम् a sin, ईदृशं such, घोरसंहितम् a terrible one, तस्मात् therefore, प्राप्स्यति will obtain, दुर्मेधाः the foolish one, फलं the fruit, पापस्य of the evil, कर्मणः deed.
explanation: Because he has committed such a terrible sin, that foolish one will therefore receive the consequence of his evil deed.

shloka_text: सप्तरात्रेण राजासौ सभृत्यबलवाहनः । पापकर्मसमाचारो वधं प्राप्स्यति दुर्मतिः ।। 7.81.7 ।।
transliteration: saptarātreṇa rājāsau sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ | pāpakarmasamācāro vadhaṃ prāpsyati durmatiḥ || 7.81.7 ||
translation: सप्तरात्रेण within seven nights, राजा king, असौ that, सभृत्यबलवाहनः with his servants, army, and vehicles, पापकर्मसमाचारः whose conduct is sinful, वधं death, प्राप्स्यति will meet, दुर्मतिः the evil-minded one.
explanation: Within seven nights, that evil-minded king, whose conduct is sinful, will meet his death along with his servants, army, and vehicles.

shloka_text: समन्ताद्योजनशतं विषयं चास्य दुर्मतेः । धक्ष्यते पांसुवर्षेण महता पाकशासनः ।। 7.81.8 ।।
transliteration: samantādyojanaśataṃ viṣayaṃ cāsya durmateḥ | dhakṣyate pāṃsuvarṣeṇa mahatā pākaśāsanaḥ || 7.81.8 ||
translation: समन्तात् all around, योजनशतम् a hundred yojanas, विषयम् the region, च and, अस्य of this, दुर्मतेः evil-minded one, धक्ष्यते will burn, पांसुवर्षेण by a dust shower, महता great, पाकशासनः Paka-shasana (Indra).
explanation: Shukra declares that Indra will destroy the evil-minded Daṇḍa's region, extending a hundred yojanas in all directions, with a mighty shower of dust.

shloka_text: सर्वसत्वानि यानीह स्थावराणि चराणि च । महता पांसुवर्षेण विलयं सर्वतो ऽगमन् ।। 7.81.9 ।।
transliteration: sarvasatvāni yānīha sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca | mahatā pāṃsuvarṣeṇa vilayaṃ sarvato 'gaman || 7.81.9 ||
translation: सर्वसत्वानि all beings, यानि which, इह here, स्थावराणि immobile, चराणि mobile, च and, महता by a great, पांसुवर्षेण dust shower, विलयम् destruction, सर्वतः completely, अगमन् reached.
explanation: All beings, both mobile and immobile, present in that region, completely met their destruction due to the great shower of dust.

shloka_text: दण्डस्य विषयो यावत्तावत्सर्वसमुच्छ्रयम् । पांसुवर्षमिवालक्ष्यं सप्तरात्रं भविष्यति ।। 7.81.10 ।।
transliteration: daṇḍasya viṣayo yāvattāvatsarvasamucchrayam | pāṃsuvarṣamivālakṣyaṃ saptarātraṃ bhaviṣyati || 7.81.10 ||
translation: दण्डस्य of Daṇḍa, विषयः the region, यावत् as far as, तावत् so far, सर्वसमुच्छ्रयम् all elevated things, पांसुवर्षम् a dust shower, इव like, अलक्ष्यम् imperceptible, सप्तरात्रम् for seven nights, भविष्यति will be.
explanation: For seven nights, the entire region of Daṇḍa, including all elevated structures, will become imperceptible, as if covered by a continuous shower of dust.

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा क्रोधताम्राक्षस्तदाश्रमनिवासिनम् । जनं जनपदान्तेषु स्थीयतामिति चाब्रवीत् ।। 7.81.11 ।।
transliteration: ityuktvā krodhatāmrākṣastadāśramanivāsinam | janaṃ janapadānteṣu sthīyatāmiti cābravīt || 7.81.11 ||
translation: इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, क्रोधताम्राक्षः with eyes red with anger, तदाश्रमनिवासिनम् to the residents of that hermitage, जनम् the people, जनपदान्तेषु at the borders of the country, स्थीयताम् let it be stayed, इति thus, च and, अब्रवीत् he said.
explanation: Having spoken thus, Shukra, whose eyes were red with anger, instructed the people residing in that hermitage to stay at the borders of the country.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा तूशनसो वाक्यं सो ऽ ऽश्रमावसथो जनः । निष्क्रान्तो विषयात्तस्मात्स्थानं चक्रे ऽथ बाह्यतः ।। 7.81.12 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā tūśanaso vākyaṃ so ' 'śramāvasatho janaḥ | niṣkrānto viṣayāttasmātsthānaṃ cakre 'tha bāhyataḥ || 7.81.12 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, उशनसः of Ushanas, वाक्यम् the word, सः that, आश्रमावसथः hermitage-dwelling, जनः people, निष्क्रान्तः departed, विषयात् from the region, तस्मात् from that, स्थानम् place, चक्रे made, अथ then, बाह्यतः outside.
explanation: Having heard the words of Ushanas (Shukra), the people dwelling in that hermitage then departed from that region and established their abode outside.

shloka_text: स तथोक्त्वा मुनिजनमरजामिदमब्रवीत् । इहैव वस दुर्मेधे आश्रमे सुसमाहिता ।। 7.81.13 ।।
