transliteration: sa tathoktvā munijanamarajāmidamabravīt | ihaiva vasa durmedhe āśrame susamāhitā || 7.81.13 ||
translation: सः He, तथा thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, मुनिजनम् to the sages, अरजाम् to Araja, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said, इह एव here itself, वस dwell, दुर्मेधे O foolish one, आश्रमे in the hermitage, सुसमाहिता well-composed.
explanation: Having thus spoken to the sages, he then said to Araja, "O foolish one, dwell here in this hermitage, well-composed."

shloka_text: इदं योजनपर्यन्तं सरः सुरुचिरप्रभम् । अरजे विज्वरा भुङ्क्ष्व कालश्चात्र प्रतीक्ष्यताम् ।। 7.81.14 ।।
transliteration: idaṃ yojanaparyantaṃ saraḥ suruciraprabham | araje vijvarā bhuṅkṣva kālaścātra pratīkṣyatām || 7.81.14 ||
translation: इदम् This, योजनपर्यन्तम् extending for a yojana, सरः lake, सुरुचिरप्रभम् of very beautiful splendor, अरजे O Araja, विज्वरा free from distress, भुङ्क्ष्व enjoy, कालः च and time, अत्र here, प्रतीक्ष्यताम् let it be awaited.
explanation: O Araja, enjoy this lake, which extends for a yojana and possesses a very beautiful splendor, free from distress, and let time pass here.

shloka_text: त्वत्समीपे च ये सत्त्वा वासमेष्यन्ति तां निशाम् । अवध्याः पांसुवर्षेण ते भविष्यन्ति नित्यदा ।। 7.81.15 ।।
transliteration: tvatsamīpe ca ye sattvā vāsameṣyanti tāṃ niśām | avadhyāḥ pāṃsuvarṣeṇa te bhaviṣyanti nityadā || 7.81.15 ||
translation: त्वत्समीपे near you, च and, ये those, सत्त्वाः beings, वासम् dwelling, एष्यन्ति will come, ताम् that, निशाम् night, अवध्याः invulnerable, पांसुवर्षेण by the shower of dust, ते they, भविष्यन्ति will be, नित्यदा always.
explanation: And those beings who come to dwell near you for that night will always be invulnerable to the shower of dust.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा नियोगं ब्रह्मर्षेः सा ऽरजा भार्गवी तदा । तथेति पितरं प्राह भार्गवं भृशदुःखिता । इत्युक्त्वा भार्गवो वासमन्यत्र समकारयत् ।। 7.81.16 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā niyogaṃ brahmarṣeḥ sā 'rajā bhārgavī tadā | tatheti pitaraṃ prāha bhārgavaṃ bhṛśaduḥkhitā | ityuktvā bhārgavo vāsamanyatra samakārayat || 7.81.16 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा Having heard, नियोगम् the command, ब्रह्मर्षेः of the Brahmarshi, सा she, अरजा Araja, भार्गवी the daughter of Bhargava, तदा then, तथा इति "So be it", पितरम् to her father, प्राह said, भार्गवम् to Bhargava, भृशदुःखिता greatly distressed; इति उक्त्वा having said this, भार्गवः Bhargava, वासम् dwelling, अन्यत्र elsewhere, समकारयत् caused to be made.
explanation: Greatly distressed, Araja, the daughter of Bhargava, then said "So be it" to her father, the Brahmarshi, after hearing his command; having said this, Bhargava then arranged for his dwelling elsewhere.

shloka_text: तच्च राज्यं नरेन्द्रस्य सभृत्यबलवाहनम् । सप्ताहाद्भस्मसाद्भूतं यथोक्तं ब्रह्मवादिना ।। 7.81.17 ।।
transliteration: tacca rājyaṃ narendrasya sabhṛtyabalavāhanam | saptāhādbhasmasādbhūtaṃ yathoktaṃ brahmavādinā || 7.81.17 ||
translation: तत् च And that, राज्यम् kingdom, नरेन्द्रस्य of the king, सभृत्यबलवाहनम् with servants, army, and vehicles, सप्ताहात् within seven days, भस्मसाद्भूतम् turned into ashes, यथा उक्तम् as spoken, ब्रह्मवादिना by the speaker of Brahman.
explanation: And that kingdom of the king, along with its servants, army, and vehicles, was reduced to ashes within seven days, just as the sage had foretold.

shloka_text: तस्यासौ दण्डविषयो विन्ध्यशैवलयोर्नृप । शप्तो ब्रह्मर्षिणा तेन वैधर्म्ये सहिते कृते ।। 7.81.18 ।।
transliteration: tasyāsau daṇḍaviṣayo vindhyaśaivalayornṛpa | śapto brahmarṣiṇā tena vaidharmye sahite kṛte || 7.81.18 ||
translation: तस्य his, असौ this, दण्डविषयः region of Daṇḍa, विन्ध्यशैवलयोः of Vindhya and Śaivala, नृप O king, शप्तः cursed, ब्रह्मर्षिणा by the Brahmarṣi, तेन by him, वैधर्म्ये unrighteousness, सहिते accompanied, कृते having been done.
explanation: O king, this region of Daṇḍa, situated between the Vindhya and Śaivala mountains, was cursed by that Brahmarṣi when unrighteousness was committed there.

shloka_text: ततः प्रभृति काकुत्स्थ दण्डकारण्यमुच्यते । तपस्विनः स्थिता ह्यत्र जनस्थानमतो ऽभवत् ।। 7.81.19 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti kākutstha daṇḍakāraṇyamucyate | tapasvinaḥ sthitā hyatra janasthānamato 'bhavat || 7.81.19 ||
translation: ततः from then, प्रभृति onwards, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, दण्डकारण्यम् Daṇḍaka forest, उच्यते is called, तपस्विनः ascetics, स्थिताः resided, हि indeed, अत्र here, जनस्थानम् Janasthāna, अतः therefore, अभवत् became.
explanation: O Kakutstha, from that time onwards, this region is called Daṇḍakāraṇya, and because ascetics resided here, it also became known as Janasthāna.

shloka_text: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां पृच्छसि राघव । सन्ध्यामुपासितुं वीर समयो ह्यतिवर्तते ।। 7.81.20 ।।
transliteration: etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ pṛcchasi rāghava | sandhyāmupāsituṃ vīra samayo hyativartate || 7.81.20 ||
translation: एतत् this, ते to you, सर्वम् all, आख्यातम् has been told, यत् which, माम् me, पृच्छसि you ask, राघव O Raghava, सन्ध्याम् twilight prayer, उपासितुम् to perform, वीर O hero, समयः time, हि indeed, अतिवर्तते is passing.
explanation: O Raghava, I have told you all that you asked me, but O hero, the time for performing the twilight prayer is indeed passing.

shloka_text: एते महर्षयः सर्वे पूर्णकुम्भाः समन्ततः । कृतोदका नरव्याघ्र आदित्यं पर्युपासते ।। 7.81.21 ।।
transliteration: ete maharṣayaḥ sarve pūrṇakumbhāḥ samantataḥ | kṛtodakā naravyāghra ādityaṃ paryupāsate || 7.81.21 ||
translation: एते these, महर्षयः great sages, सर्वे all, पूर्णकुम्भाः with full water pots, समन्ततः all around, कृतोदकाः having performed water rituals, नरव्याघ्र O tiger among men, आदित्यम् the sun god, पर्युपासते are worshipping.
explanation: O tiger among men, all these great sages, with their water pots full and having performed their water rituals, are worshipping the sun god all around.

shloka_text: स तैर्ब्राह्मणमभ्यस्तं सहितैर्ब्रह्मवित्तमैः । रविरस्तं गतो राम गच्छोदकमुपस्पृश ।। 7.81.22 ।।
transliteration: sa tairbrāhmaṇamabhyastaṃ sahitairbrahmavittamaiḥ | ravirastaṃ gato rāma gacchodakamupaspṛśa || 7.81.22 ||
translation: सः he, तैः by them, ब्राह्मणम् the Brahman, अभ्यस्तम् practiced, सहितैः together with, ब्रह्मवित्तमैः by the best knowers of Brahman, रविः the sun, अस्तम् setting, गतः has gone, राम O Rama, गच्छ go, उदकम् water, उपस्पृश touch.
explanation: O Rama, the sun has set, having been worshipped by those best knowers of Brahman who recite the Vedas; therefore, go and perform your ablutions. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकाशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 81 ।। Thus ends the eighty-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ऋषेर्वचनमाज्ञाय रामः सन्ध्यामुपासितुम् । उपाक्रमत्सरः पुण्यमप्सरोगणसेवितम् ।। 7.82.1 ।।
transliteration: ṛṣervacanamājñāya rāmaḥ sandhyāmupāsitum | upākramatsaraḥ puṇyamapsarogaṇasevitam || 7.82.1 ||
translation: ऋषेः of the sage, वचनम् word, आज्ञाय having understood, रामः Rama, सन्ध्याम् twilight prayer, उपासितुम् to perform, उपाक्रमत् approached, सरः lake, पुण्यम् sacred, अप्सरोगणसेवितम् frequented by groups of Apsaras
explanation: Having understood the sage's words, Rama approached a sacred lake, frequented by groups of Apsaras, to perform his twilight prayers.
comments: After evening prayers and a night at the hermitage, Rama takes leave; Agastya extols him as the purifier of all beings and the support of the world and bids him rule righteously -- mounting the Pushpaka, Rama reaches Ayodhya by midday, dismisses the chariot, and bids the doorkeeper summon Lakshmana and Bharata.

shloka_text: तत्रोदकमुपस्पृश्य सन्ध्यामन्वास्य पश्चिमाम् । आश्रमं प्राविशद्रामः कुम्भयोनेर्महात्मनः ।। 7.82.2 ।।
transliteration: tatrodakamupaspṛśya sandhyāmanvāsya paścimām | āśramaṃ prāviśadrāmaḥ kumbhayonermahātmanaḥ || 7.82.2 ||
translation: तत्र there, उदकम् water, उपस्पृश्य having performed ablutions, सन्ध्याम् twilight prayer, अन्वास्य having performed, पश्चिमाम् western (evening), आश्रमम् hermitage, प्राविशत् entered, रामः Rama, कुम्भयोनेः of Agastya, महात्मनः of the great-souled one
explanation: There, having performed ablutions and completed the evening twilight prayers, Rama entered the hermitage of the great-souled Agastya.

shloka_text: तस्यागस्त्यो बहुगुणं कन्दमूलं तथौषधिम् । शाल्यादीनि पवित्राणि भोजनार्थमकल्पयत् ।। 7.82.3 ।।
transliteration: tasyāgastyo bahuguṇaṃ kandamūlaṃ tathauṣadhim | śālyādīni pavitrāṇi bhojanārthamakalpayat || 7.82.3 ||
translation: तस्य for him, अगस्त्यः Agastya, बहुगुणम् of many qualities, कन्दमूलम् roots and fruits, तथा and, औषधिम् herbs, शाल्यादीनि rice and other grains, पवित्राणि pure, भोजनार्थम् for a meal, अकल्पयत् arranged
explanation: For Rama, Agastya arranged a meal consisting of excellent roots, fruits, herbs, and pure rice and other grains.

shloka_text: स भुक्तवान्नरश्रेष्ठस्तदन्नममृतोपमम् । प्रीतश्च परितुष्टश्च तां रात्रिं समुपाविशत् ।। 7.82.4 ।।
transliteration: sa bhuktavānnaraśreṣṭhastadannamamṛtopamam | prītaśca parituṣṭaśca tāṃ rātriṃ samupāviśat || 7.82.4 ||
translation: सः he, भुक्तवान् ate, नरश्रेष्ठः best among men, तत् that, अन्नम् food, अमृतोपमम् like nectar, प्रीतः pleased, च and, परितुष्टः fully satisfied, च and, ताम् that, रात्रिम् night, समुपाविशत् rested
explanation: The best among men, Rama, ate that nectar-like food, and being pleased and fully satisfied, he rested for that night.

shloka_text: प्रभाते काल्यमुत्थाय कृत्वा ऽ ऽह्निकमरिन्दमः । ऋषिं समुपचक्राम गमनाय रघूत्तमः ।। 7.82.5 ।।
transliteration: prabhāte kālyamutthāya kṛtvā ' 'hnikamarindamaḥ | ṛṣiṃ samupacakrāma gamanāya raghūttamaḥ || 7.82.5 ||
translation: प्रभाते in the morning, काल्यम् early morning duties, उत्थाय having risen, कृत्वा having performed, आह्निकम् daily rituals, अरिन्दमः subduer of enemies, ऋषिम् to the sage, समुपचक्राम approached, गमनाय for departure, रघूत्तमः best of the Raghu dynasty
explanation: In the morning, having risen and performed his daily rituals, Rama, the subduer of enemies and best of the Raghu dynasty, approached the sage for his departure.

shloka_text: अभिवाद्याब्रवीद्रामो महर्षिं कुम्भसम्भवम् । आपृच्छे स्वां पुरीं गन्तुं मामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ।। 7.82.6 ।।
transliteration: abhivādyābravīdrāmo maharṣiṃ kumbhasambhavam | āpṛcche svāṃ purīṃ gantuṃ māmanujñātumarhasi || 7.82.6 ||
translation: अभिवाद्य having saluted, अब्रवीत् spoke, रामः Rama, महर्षिम् to the great sage, कुम्भसम्भवम् Agastya (born from a pot), आपृच्छे I ask leave, स्वां my own, पुरीं city, गन्तुम् to go, माम् me, अनुज्ञातुम् to permit, अर्हसि you ought.
explanation: Having saluted the great sage Agastya, Rama spoke, saying, "I ask your leave to go to my own city, and you ought to permit me."

shloka_text: धन्यो ऽस्म्यनुगृहीतो ऽस्मि दर्शनेन महात्मनः । द्रष्टुं चैवागमिष्यामि पावनार्थमिहात्मनः ।। 7.82.7 ।।
transliteration: dhanyo 'smyanugṛhīto 'smi darśanena mahātmanaḥ | draṣṭuṃ caivāgamiṣyāmi pāvanārthamihātmanaḥ || 7.82.7 ||
translation: धन्यः blessed, अस्मि I am, अनुगृहीतः favored, अस्मि I am, दर्शनेन by the sight, महात्मनः of the great soul, द्रष्टुं to see, च and, एव indeed, आगमिष्यामि I shall come, पावनार्थम् for the purification, इह here, आत्मनः of my self.
explanation: I am blessed and favored by the sight of your great self, and I shall indeed come here again to see you for the purification of my own soul.

shloka_text: तथा वदति काकुत्स्थे वाक्यमद्भुतदर्शनम् । उवाच परमप्रीतो धर्मनेत्रस्तपोधनः ।। 7.82.8 ।।
transliteration: tathā vadati kākutsthe vākyamadbhutadarśanam | uvāca paramaprīto dharmanetrastapodhanaḥ || 7.82.8 ||
translation: तथा thus, वदति when speaking, काकुत्स्थे by Rama, वाक्यम् words, अद्भुतदर्शनम् of wonderful meaning, उवाच spoke, परमप्रीतः extremely pleased, धर्मनेत्रः whose eye is dharma, तपोधनः whose wealth is austerity.
explanation: As Rama, whose words were of wonderful meaning, spoke thus, the sage Agastya, whose vision was righteousness and whose wealth was austerity, spoke, being extremely pleased.

shloka_text: अत्यद्भुतमिदं वाक्यं तव राम शुभाक्षरम् । पावनः सर्वभूतानां त्वमेव रघुनन्दन ।। 7.82.9 ।।
transliteration: atyadbhutamidaṃ vākyaṃ tava rāma śubhākṣaram | pāvanaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvameva raghunandana || 7.82.9 ||
translation: अत्यद्भुतम् very wonderful, इदं this, वाक्यं speech, तव your, राम O Rama, शुभाक्षरम् of auspicious words, पावनः purifier, सर्वभूतानां of all beings, त्वम् you, एव indeed, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: O Rama, your words are indeed very wonderful and auspicious, for you alone, O delight of the Raghus, are the purifier of all beings.

shloka_text: मुहूर्तमपि राम त्वां ये च पश्यन्ति केचन । पाविताः स्वर्गभूताश्च पूज्यास्ते सर्वदैवतैः ।। 7.82.10 ।।
transliteration: muhūrtamapi rāma tvāṃ ye ca paśyanti kecana | pāvitāḥ svargabhūtāśca pūjyāste sarvadaivataiḥ || 7.82.10 ||
translation: मुहूर्तम् for a moment, अपि even, राम O Rama, त्वाम् you, ये those who, च and, पश्यन्ति see, केचन some, पाविताः purified, स्वर्गभूताः become heavenly, च and, पूज्याः worshipable, ते they, सर्वदैवतैः by all deities.
explanation: O Rama, even those who merely see you for a moment become purified and attain heaven, and they are then worshipable by all deities.

shloka_text: ये च त्वां घोरचक्षुर्भिः पश्यन्ति प्राणिनो भुवि । हतास्ते यमदण्डेन सद्यो निरयगामिनः ।। 7.82.11 ।।
transliteration: ye ca tvāṃ ghoracakṣurbhiḥ paśyanti prāṇino bhuvi | hatāste yamadaṇḍena sadyo nirayagāminaḥ || 7.82.11 ||
translation: ये those who, च and, त्वां you, घोरचक्षुर्भिः with terrible eyes, पश्यन्ति see, प्राणिनो living beings, भुवि on earth, हतास्ते they are struck down, यमदण्डेन by Yama's rod, सद्यो immediately, निरयगामिनः going to hell
explanation: Those living beings on earth who look at you with hostile eyes are immediately struck down by the rod of Yama and go to hell.

shloka_text: ईदृशस्त्वं रघुश्रेष्ठ पावनः सर्वदेहिनाम् । भुवि त्वां कथयन्तो ऽपि सिद्धिमेष्यन्ति राघव ।। 7.82.12 ।।
transliteration: īdṛśastvaṃ raghuśreṣṭha pāvanaḥ sarvadehinām | bhuvi tvāṃ kathayanto 'pi siddhimeṣyanti rāghava || 7.82.12 ||
translation: ईदृशस्त्वं such are you, रघुश्रेष्ठ O best of Raghus, पावनः purifier, सर्वदेहिनाम् of all embodied beings, भुवि on earth, त्वां you, कथयन्तो speaking about, अपि even, सिद्धिमेष्यन्ति will attain perfection, राघव O scion of Raghu
explanation: O best of Raghus, you are such a purifier of all embodied beings, and even those on earth who merely speak of you, O scion of Raghu, will attain perfection.

shloka_text: गच्छ चारिष्टमव्याग्रः पन्थानमकुतोभयम् । प्रशाधि राज्यं धर्मेण गतिर्हि जगतो भवान् ।। 7.82.13 ।।
transliteration: gaccha cāriṣṭamavyāgraḥ panthānamakutobhayam | praśādhi rājyaṃ dharmeṇa gatirhi jagato bhavān || 7.82.13 ||
translation: गच्छ go, च and, अरिष्टम् auspicious, अव्याग्रः undisturbed, पन्थानम् path, अकुतोभयम् fearless, प्रशाधि rule, राज्यं kingdom, धर्मेण with righteousness, गतिर्हि indeed the support, जगतो of the world, भवान् you
explanation: Go forth calmly on an auspicious and fearless path, and rule your kingdom with righteousness, for you are indeed the support of the world.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु मुनिना प्राञ्जलिः प्रग्रहो नृपः । अभ्यवादयत प्राज्ञस्तमृषिं पुण्यशालिनम् ।। 7.82.14 ।।
transliteration: evamuktastu muninā prāñjaliḥ pragraho nṛpaḥ | abhyavādayata prājñastamṛṣiṃ puṇyaśālinam || 7.82.14 ||
translation: एवमुक्तस्तु thus spoken, मुनिना by the sage, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रग्रहो humble, नृपः the king, अभ्यवादयत saluted, प्राज्ञः the wise (king), तम् that, ऋषिं sage, पुण्यशालिनम् endowed with merit
explanation: Thus addressed by the sage, the wise and humble king, with folded hands, saluted that virtuous sage.

shloka_text: अभिवाद्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं तांश्च सर्वांस्तपोधनान् । अध्यारोहत्तदव्यग्रः पुष्पकं हेमभूषितम् ।। 7.82.15 ।।
transliteration: abhivādya muniśreṣṭhaṃ tāṃśca sarvāṃstapodhanān | adhyārohattadavyagraḥ puṣpakaṃ hemabhūṣitam || 7.82.15 ||
translation: अभिवाद्य having saluted, मुनिश्रेष्ठं the best of sages, तांश्च and them, सर्वान् all, तपोधनान् ascetics, अध्यारोहत् ascended, तदव्यग्रः then undisturbed, पुष्पकं the Pushpaka (aerial chariot), हेमभूषितम् adorned with gold
explanation: Having saluted the best of sages and all those ascetics, he then calmly ascended the Pushpaka chariot, which was adorned with gold.

shloka_text: तं प्रयान्तं मुनिगणा ह्याशीर्वादैः समन्ततः । अपूजयन्महेन्द्राभं सहस्राक्षमिवामराः ।। 7.82.16 ।।
transliteration: taṃ prayāntaṃ munigaṇā hyāśīrvādaiḥ samantataḥ | apūjayanmahendrābhaṃ sahasrākṣamivāmarāḥ || 7.82.16 ||
translation: तं him, प्रयान्तं departing, मुनिगणाः groups of sages, हि indeed, आशीर्वादैः with blessings, समन्ततः from all sides, अपूजयन् worshipped, महेन्द्राभं resembling Mahendra, सहस्राक्षम् one with a thousand eyes, इव like, अमराः gods.
explanation: As Rama departed, groups of sages honored him from all sides with blessings, just as the gods worship Indra, who resembles Mahendra and has a thousand eyes.

shloka_text: स्वस्थः स ददृशे रामः पुष्पके हेमभूषिते । शशी मेघसमीपस्थो यथा जलधरागमे ।। 7.82.17 ।।
transliteration: svasthaḥ sa dadṛśe rāmaḥ puṣpake hemabhūṣite | śaśī meghasamīpastho yathā jaladharāgame || 7.82.17 ||
translation: स्वस्थः at ease, सः he, ददृशे was seen, रामः Rama, पुष्पके in the Pushpaka, हेमभूषिते adorned with gold, शशी the moon, मेघसमीपस्थो situated near a cloud, यथा just as, जलधरागमे at the arrival of rain clouds.
explanation: Rama, at ease in the gold-adorned Pushpaka, appeared like the moon near a cloud at the onset of the monsoon season.

shloka_text: ततो ऽर्धदिवसे प्राप्ते पूज्यमानस्ततस्ततः । अयोध्यां प्राप्य काकुत्स्थो मध्यकक्ष्यामवारुहत् ।। 7.82.18 ।।
transliteration: tato 'rdhadivase prāpte pūjyamānastatastataḥ | ayodhyāṃ prāpya kākutstho madhyakakṣyāmavāruhat || 7.82.18 ||
translation: ततः then, अर्धदिवसे midday, प्राप्ते having arrived, पूज्यमानः being honored, ततस्ततः from all sides, अयोध्यां to Ayodhya, प्राप्य having reached, काकुत्स्थो Rama, मध्यकक्ष्याम् the middle chamber, अवारुहत् descended.
explanation: Then, by midday, Rama, being honored from all sides, reached Ayodhya and descended into the middle chamber of his palace.

shloka_text: ततो विसृज्य रुचिरं पुष्पकं कामगामि तत् । विसर्जयित्वा गच्छेति स्वस्ति ते ऽस्त्विति च प्रभुः ।। 7.82.19 ।।
transliteration: tato visṛjya ruciraṃ puṣpakaṃ kāmagāmi tat | visarjayitvā gaccheti svasti te 'stviti ca prabhuḥ || 7.82.19 ||
translation: ततः then, विसृज्य having dismissed, रुचिरं beautiful, पुष्पकं Pushpaka, कामगामि moving at will, तत् that, विसर्जयित्वा having dismissed, गच्छ go, इति thus, स्वस्ति welfare, ते to you, अस्तु let it be, इति thus, च and, प्रभुः the lord.
explanation: Then, the lord Rama dismissed that beautiful Pushpaka, which moved at will, saying "Go, and let there be welfare for you."

shloka_text: कक्षान्तरविनिक्षिप्तं द्वास्स्थं रामो ऽब्रवीद्वचः । लक्ष्मणं भरतं चैव गत्वा तौ लघुविक्रमौ ।। ममागमनमाख्याय शब्दापयत मा चिरम् ।। 7.82.20 ।।
transliteration: kakṣāntaravinikṣiptaṃ dvāssthaṃ rāmo 'bravīdvacaḥ | lakṣmaṇaṃ bharataṃ caiva gatvā tau laghuvikramau || mamāgamanamākhyāya śabdāpayata mā ciram || 7.82.20 ||
translation: कक्षान्तरविनिक्षिप्तं placed in an inner chamber, द्वास्स्थं to the doorkeeper, रामो Rama, अब्रवीत् spoke, वचः words, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, भरतं Bharata, च and, एव indeed, गत्वा having gone, तौ those two, लघुविक्रमौ swift-footed, मम my, आगमनम् arrival, आख्याय having announced, शब्दापयत summon, मा not, चिरम् long.
explanation: Rama then spoke to the doorkeeper, who was stationed in an inner chamber, instructing him to swiftly go and inform Lakshmana and Bharata of his arrival, and to summon them without delay. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे व्द्यशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 82 ।। Thus ends the eighty-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा भाषितं तस्य रामस्याक्लिष्ट कर्मणः । द्वास्स्थः कुमारावाहूय राघवाय न्यवेदयत् ।। 7.83.1 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā bhāṣitaṃ tasya rāmasyākliṣṭa karmaṇaḥ | dvāssthaḥ kumārāvāhūya rāghavāya nyavedayat || 7.83.1 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, भाषितं the words spoken, तस्य of him, रामस्य of Rama, अक्लिष्टकर्मणः of the one whose deeds are unwearied, द्वास्स्थः the doorkeeper, कुमारौ the two princes, आहूय having called, राघवाय to Raghava, न्यवेदयत् announced.
explanation: Having heard the words of Rama, whose deeds were effortless, the doorkeeper called the two princes and announced their arrival to Raghava.
comments: Rama tells his brothers that, his duty to the brahmins done, he wishes to perform the Rajasuya sacrifice to raise a lasting bridge of dharma -- but Bharata objects that the rite entails the ruin of royal lines across the earth, which the refuge of all should not cause -- and, pleased with the wise counsel, Rama desists.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा तु राघवः प्राप्तौ प्रियौ भरतलक्ष्मणौ । परिष्वज्य तदा रामो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.83.2 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tu rāghavaḥ prāptau priyau bharatalakṣmaṇau | pariṣvajya tadā rāmo vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.83.2 ||
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, तु and, राघवः Raghava, प्राप्तौ arrived, प्रियौ dear, भरतलक्ष्मणौ Bharata and Lakshmana, परिष्वज्य having embraced, तदा then, रामः Rama, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.
explanation: And when Raghava saw his dear Bharata and Lakshmana arrive, Rama embraced them and then spoke these words.

shloka_text: कृतं मया यथा तथ्यं द्विजकार्यमनुत्तमम् । धर्मसेतुमथो भूयः कर्तुमिच्छामि राघवौ ।। 7.83.3 ।।
transliteration: kṛtaṃ mayā yathā tathyaṃ dvijakāryamanuttamam | dharmasetumatho bhūyaḥ kartumicchāmi rāghavau || 7.83.3 ||
translation: कृतं done, मया by me, यथातथ्यं truly, द्विजकार्यम् the duty of a Brahmin, अनुत्तमम् excellent, धर्मसेतुम् a bridge of righteousness, अथ now, उ and, भूयः again, कर्तुम् to make, इच्छामि I wish, राघवौ O Raghavas.
explanation: O Raghavas, I have truly and excellently performed the duty of a Brahmin, and now I wish to further establish a bridge of righteousness.

shloka_text: अक्षय्यश्चाव्ययश्चैव धर्मसेतुर्मतो मम । धर्मप्रसाधकं ह्येतत् सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ।। 7.83.4 ।।
transliteration: akṣayyaścāvyayaścaiva dharmaseturmato mama | dharmaprasādhakaṃ hyetat sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 7.83.4 ||
translation: अक्षय्यः imperishable, च and, अव्ययः immutable, च and, एव indeed, धर्मसेतुः the bridge of righteousness, मतः considered, मम by me, धर्मप्रसाधकं that which accomplishes dharma, हि indeed, एतत् this, सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् the destroyer of all sins.
explanation: This bridge of righteousness is considered by me to be imperishable and immutable, for it indeed accomplishes dharma and destroys all sins.

shloka_text: युवाभ्यामात्मभूताभ्यां राजसूयमनुत्तमम् । सहितो यष्टुमिच्छामि तत्र धर्मो हि शाश्वतः ।। 7.83.5 ।।
transliteration: yuvābhyāmātmabhūtābhyāṃ rājasūyamanuttamam | sahito yaṣṭumicchāmi tatra dharmo hi śāśvataḥ || 7.83.5 ||
translation: युवाभ्याम् with both of you, आत्मभूताभ्याम् who are like my own self, राजसूयम् the Rajasuya sacrifice, अनुत्तमम् excellent, सहितः together, यष्टुम् to perform, इच्छामि I wish, तत्र there, धर्मः dharma, हि indeed, शाश्वतः eternal.
explanation: I wish to perform the excellent Rajasuya sacrifice together with both of you, who are like my own self, for indeed, the dharma achieved through it is eternal.

shloka_text: इष्ट्वा तु राजसूयेन मित्रः शत्रुनिबर्हणः । सुहुतेन सुयज्ञेन वरुणत्वमुपागमत् ।। 7.83.6 ।।
transliteration: iṣṭvā tu rājasūyena mitraḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ | suhutena suyajñena varuṇatvamupāgamat || 7.83.6 ||
translation: इष्ट्वा having performed a sacrifice, तु indeed, राजसूयेन by the Rajasuya sacrifice, मित्रः Mitra, शत्रुनिबर्हणः destroyer of enemies, सुहुतेन with well-offered oblations, सुयज्ञेन by a good sacrifice, वरुणत्वम् the state of being Varuna, उपागमत् attained.
explanation: Indeed, Mitra, the destroyer of enemies, attained the state of Varuna by performing the well-offered and good Rajasuya sacrifice.

shloka_text: सोमश्च राजसूयेन इष्ट्वा धर्मेण धर्मवित् । प्राप्तश्च सर्वलोकेषु कीर्तिस्थानं च शाश्वतम् ।। 7.83.7 ।।
transliteration: somaśca rājasūyena iṣṭvā dharmeṇa dharmavit | prāptaśca sarvalokeṣu kīrtisthānaṃ ca śāśvatam || 7.83.7 ||
translation: सोमश्च and Soma, राजसूयेन by the Rajasuya sacrifice, इष्ट्वा having performed a sacrifice, धर्मेण righteously, धर्मवित् the knower of dharma, प्राप्तश्च and attained, सर्वलोकेषु in all worlds, कीर्तिस्थानम् a place of fame, च and, शाश्वतम् eternal.
explanation: And Soma, the knower of dharma, having righteously performed the Rajasuya sacrifice, attained an eternal place of fame in all worlds.

shloka_text: अस्मिन्नहनि यच्छ्रेयश्चिन्त्यतां तन्मया सह । हितं चायतियुक्तं च प्रयतौ कर्तुमर्हथः ।। 7.83.8 ।।
transliteration: asminnahani yacchreyaścintyatāṃ tanmayā saha | hitaṃ cāyatiyuktaṃ ca prayatau kartumarhathaḥ || 7.83.8 ||
translation: अस्मिन्नहनि on this day, यत् whatever, श्रेयः good, चिन्त्यताम् let it be thought about, तत् that, मया by me, सह with, हितम् beneficial, च and, आयतियुक्तम् leading to future good, च and, प्रयतौ both of you, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हथः ought.
explanation: Let whatever is good and beneficial, leading to future prosperity, be thought about by me together with you on this day, and both of you ought to strive to accomplish it.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा तु राघवस्यैतद्वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः । भरतः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.83.9 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu rāghavasyaitadvākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ | bharataḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.83.9 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, राघवस्यैतत् this of Rama, वाक्यम् speech, वाक्यविशारदः skilled in speech, भरतः Bharata, प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा having become with folded hands, वाक्यम् speech, एतत् this, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.
explanation: Indeed, having heard this speech of Rama, Bharata, who was skilled in speech, spoke these words with folded hands.

shloka_text: त्वयि धर्मः परः साधो त्वयि सर्वा वसुन्धरा । प्रतिष्ठिता महाबाहो यशश्चामितविक्रम ।। 7.83.10 ।।
transliteration: tvayi dharmaḥ paraḥ sādho tvayi sarvā vasundharā | pratiṣṭhitā mahābāho yaśaścāmitavikrama || 7.83.10 ||
translation: त्वयि in you, धर्मः dharma, परः supreme, साधो O righteous one, त्वयि in you, सर्वा all, वसुन्धरा the earth, प्रतिष्ठिता established, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, यशश्च and fame, अमितविक्रम O one of immeasurable valor.
explanation: O righteous one, supreme dharma resides in you; O mighty-armed one, the entire earth is established in you; and O one of immeasurable valor, fame also rests in you.

shloka_text: महीपालाश्च सर्वे त्वां प्रजापतिमिवामराः । निरीक्षन्ते महात्मानं लोकानाथं यथा वयम् ।। 7.83.11 ।।
transliteration: mahīpālāśca sarve tvāṃ prajāpatimivāmarāḥ | nirīkṣante mahātmānaṃ lokānāthaṃ yathā vayam || 7.83.11 ||
translation: महीपालाश्च kings and, सर्वे all, त्वां you, प्रजापतिम् Prajapati, इव like, अमराः gods, निरीक्षन्ते look upon, महात्मानं the great-souled one, लोकानाथं lord of the worlds, यथा as, वयम् we,
explanation: All kings, like gods regarding Prajapati, look upon you, the great-souled one and lord of the worlds, just as we do.

shloka_text: पुत्राश्च पितृवद्राजन्पश्यन्ति त्वां महाबल । पृथिव्या गतिभूतो ऽसि प्राणिनामपि राघव ।। 7.83.12 ।।
transliteration: putrāśca pitṛvadrājanpaśyanti tvāṃ mahābala | pṛthivyā gatibhūto 'si prāṇināmapi rāghava || 7.83.12 ||
translation: पुत्राश्च sons and, पितृवत् like a father, राजन् O King, पश्यन्ति they see, त्वां you, महाबल O mighty-armed one, पृथिव्या of the earth, गतिभूतः the refuge, असि you are, प्राणिनाम् of living beings, अपि even, राघव O Raghava,
explanation: O King, O mighty-armed one, your sons regard you as a father, and you are indeed the refuge for all living beings on earth, O Raghava.

shloka_text: स त्वमेवंविधं यज्ञमाहर्तासि कथं नृप । पृथिव्यां राजवंशानां विनाशो यत्र दृश्यते ।। 7.83.13 ।।
transliteration: sa tvamevaṃvidhaṃ yajñamāhartāsi kathaṃ nṛpa | pṛthivyāṃ rājavaṃśānāṃ vināśo yatra dṛśyate || 7.83.13 ||
translation: सः such, त्वं you, एवंविधं such a kind of, यज्ञम् sacrifice, आहर्ता performer, असि you are, कथं how, नृप O King, पृथिव्यां on earth, राजवंशानां of royal lineages, विनाशः destruction, यत्र where, दृश्यते is seen,
explanation: O King, how can you perform such a sacrifice where the destruction of royal lineages on earth is foreseen?

shloka_text: पृथिव्यां ये च पुरुषा राजन्पौरुषमागताः । सर्वेषां भविता तत्र सङ्क्षयः सर्वकोपजः ।। 7.83.14 ।।
transliteration: pṛthivyāṃ ye ca puruṣā rājanpauruṣamāgatāḥ | sarveṣāṃ bhavitā tatra saṅkṣayaḥ sarvakopajaḥ || 7.83.14 ||
translation: पृथिव्यां on earth, ये who, च and, पुरुषाः men, राजन् O King, पौरुषम् valor, आगताः attained, सर्वेषां of all, भविता will be, तत्र there, सङ्क्षयः destruction, सर्वकोपजः born of universal wrath,
explanation: O King, all men on earth who have attained valor will face destruction there, born of universal wrath.

shloka_text: स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल गुणैरतुलविक्रम । पृथिवीं नार्हसे हन्तुं वशे हि तव वर्तते ।। 7.83.15 ।।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ puruṣaśārdūla guṇairatulavikrama | pṛthivīṃ nārhase hantuṃ vaśe hi tava vartate || 7.83.15 ||
translation: सः such, त्वं you, पुरुषशार्दूल O tiger among men, गुणैः by virtues, अतुलविक्रम O one of unequalled valor, पृथिवीं the earth, न not, अर्हसे you ought, हन्तुं to destroy, वशे under control, हि indeed, तव your, वर्तते it is,
explanation: O tiger among men, O one of unequalled valor by your virtues, you ought not to destroy the earth, for it is indeed under your control.

shloka_text: भरतस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा ऽमृतमयं तदा । प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे रामः सत्यपराक्रमः ।। 7.83.16 ।।
transliteration: bharatasya tu tadvākyaṃ śrutvā 'mṛtamayaṃ tadā | praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ || 7.83.16 ||
translation: भरतस्य Bharata's, तु indeed, तत् that, वाक्यम् speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, अमृतमयम् nectar-like, तदा then, प्रहर्षम् great joy, अतुलम् incomparable, लेभे obtained, रामः Rama, सत्यपराक्रमः whose valor is true
explanation: Then, Rama, whose valor was true, having heard that nectar-like speech of Bharata, obtained incomparable great joy.

shloka_text: उवाच च शुभं वाक्यं कैकेय्यानन्दवर्धनम् । प्रीतो ऽस्मि परितुष्टो ऽस्मि तवाद्य वचने ऽनघ ।। 7.83.17 ।।
transliteration: uvāca ca śubhaṃ vākyaṃ kaikeyyānandavardhanam | prīto 'smi parituṣṭo 'smi tavādya vacane 'nagha || 7.83.17 ||
translation: उवाच spoke, च and, शुभम् auspicious, वाक्यम् speech, कैकेय्यानन्दवर्धनम् increasing Kaikeyi's joy, प्रीतः अस्मि pleased am I, परितुष्टः अस्मि completely satisfied am I, तव your, अद्य today, वचने in speech, अनघ O sinless one
explanation: And he spoke auspicious words that increased Kaikeyi's joy, saying, "O sinless one, I am pleased and completely satisfied with your words today."

shloka_text: इदं वचनमक्लीबं त्वया धर्मसमाहितम् । व्याहृतं पुरुषव्याघ्र पृथिव्याः परिपालनम् ।। 7.83.18 ।।
transliteration: idaṃ vacanamaklībaṃ tvayā dharmasamāhitam | vyāhṛtaṃ puruṣavyāghra pṛthivyāḥ paripālanam || 7.83.18 ||
translation: इदम् this, वचनम् speech, अक्लीबम् firm, त्वया by you, धर्मसमाहितम् imbued with righteousness, व्याहृतम् spoken, पुरुषव्याघ्र O tiger among men, पृथिव्याः of the earth, परिपालनम् protection
explanation: O tiger among men, this firm speech, imbued with righteousness and concerning the protection of the earth, has been spoken by you.

shloka_text: एष्यदस्मदभिप्रायाद्राजसूयात्क्रतूत्तमात् । निवर्तयामि धर्मज्ञ तव सुव्याहृतेन च ।। 7.83.19 ।।
transliteration: eṣyadasmadabhiprāyādrājasūyātkratūttamāt | nivartayāmi dharmajña tava suvyāhṛtena ca || 7.83.19 ||
translation: एष्यत् impending, अस्मदभिप्रायात् from our intention, राजसूयात् from the Rajasuya sacrifice, क्रतूत्तमात् from the best of sacrifices, निवर्तयामि I desist, धर्मज्ञ O knower of dharma, तव your, सुव्याहृतेन by well-spoken words, च and
explanation: O knower of dharma, I desist from the impending Rajasuya, the best of sacrifices, which was our intention, because of your well-spoken words.

shloka_text: लोकपीडाकरं कर्म न कर्तव्यं विचक्षणैः । बालानां तु शुभं वाक्यं ग्राह्य लक्ष्मणपूर्वज । तस्माच्छृणोमि ते वाक्यं साधु युक्तं महामते ।। 7.83.20 ।।
transliteration: lokapīḍākaraṃ karma na kartavyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ | bālānāṃ tu śubhaṃ vākyaṃ grāhya lakṣmaṇapūrvaja | tasmācchṛṇomi te vākyaṃ sādhu yuktaṃ mahāmate || 7.83.20 ||
translation: लोकपीडाकरम् causing distress to people, कर्म action, न not, कर्तव्यम् should be done, विचक्षणैः by the wise, बालानाम् of children, तु indeed, शुभम् auspicious, वाक्यम् speech, ग्राह्यम् should be accepted, लक्ष्मणपूर्वज O elder brother of Lakshmana, तस्मात् therefore, शृणोमि I listen, ते your, वाक्यम् speech, साधु good, युक्तम् appropriate, महामते O great-minded one
explanation: Wise people should not perform actions that cause distress to others, and indeed, O elder brother of Lakshmana, even the auspicious words of younger ones should be accepted; therefore, O great-minded one, I listen to your good and appropriate speech. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्र्यशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 83 ।। Thus ends the eighty-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तथोक्तवति रामे तु भरते च महात्मनि । लक्ष्मणो ऽथ शुभं वाक्यमुवाच रघुनन्दनम् ।। 7.84.1 ।।
transliteration: tathoktavati rāme tu bharate ca mahātmani | lakṣmaṇo 'tha śubhaṃ vākyamuvāca raghunandanam || 7.84.1 ||
translation: तथोक्तवति when thus spoken, रामे by Rama, तु indeed, भरते by Bharata, च and, महात्मनि the great-souled, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अथ then, शुभम् auspicious, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke, रघुनन्दनम् to Rama, the delight of the Raghus.
explanation: After Rama and the great-souled Bharata had spoken, Lakshmana then addressed Rama, the delight of the Raghus, with auspicious words.
comments: Lakshmana proposes instead the Ashvamedha, the all-purifying sacrifice by which Indra was once cleansed of brahmin-slaughter -- and he begins the tale of the mighty, righteous Daitya Vritra, who, ruling the earth in prosperity, took to severe penance, so alarming the gods that Indra appealed to Vishnu to slay him.

shloka_text: अश्वमेधो महायज्ञः पावनः सर्वपाप्मनाम् । पावनस्तव दुर्धर्षो रोचतां रघुनन्दन ।। 7.84.2 ।।
transliteration: aśvamedho mahāyajñaḥ pāvanaḥ sarvapāpmanām | pāvanastava durdharṣo rocatāṃ raghunandana || 7.84.2 ||
translation: अश्वमेधः The Ashwamedha, महायज्ञः a great sacrifice, पावनः purifier, सर्वपाप्मनाम् of all sins, पावनः a purifier, तव for you, दुर्धर्षः unconquerable, रोचताम् may it be pleasing, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: O delight of the Raghus, may the Ashwamedha, a great sacrifice and purifier of all sins, which is a purifier for you, the unconquerable one, be pleasing to you.

shloka_text: श्रूयते हि पुरावृत्तं वासवे सुमहात्मनि । ब्रह्महत्यावृतः शक्रो हयमेधेन पावितः ।। 7.84.3 ।।
transliteration: śrūyate hi purāvṛttaṃ vāsave sumahātmani | brahmahatyāvṛtaḥ śakro hayamedhena pāvitaḥ || 7.84.3 ||
translation: श्रूयते it is heard, हि indeed, पुरावृत्तम् an ancient event, वासवे regarding Indra, सुमहात्मनि the very great-souled, ब्रह्महत्यावृतः afflicted by the sin of Brahman-slaughter, शक्रः Indra, हयमेधेन by the Ashwamedha, पावितः was purified.
explanation: Indeed, it is heard that in an ancient event, the very great-souled Indra, afflicted by the sin of Brahman-slaughter, was purified by the Ashwamedha sacrifice.

shloka_text: पुरा किल महाबाहो देवासुरसमागमे । वृत्रो नाम महानासीद्दैतेयो लोकसम्मतः ।। 7.84.4 ।।
transliteration: purā kila mahābāho devāsurasamāgame | vṛtro nāma mahānāsīddaiteyo lokasammataḥ || 7.84.4 ||
translation: पुरा formerly, किल indeed, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, देवासुरसमागमे in the encounter between gods and asuras, वृत्रः Vritra, नाम named, महान् a great one, आसीत् was, दैतेयः a Daitya, लोकसम्मतः renowned in the world.
explanation: O mighty-armed one, it is said that formerly, during the conflict between gods and asuras, there was a great Daitya named Vritra, renowned throughout the world.

shloka_text: विस्तीर्णो योजनशतमुच्छ्रितस्त्रिगुणं ततः । अनुरागेण लोकांस्त्रीन्स्नेहात्पश्यति सर्वतः ।। 7.84.5 ।।
transliteration: vistīrṇo yojanaśatamucchritastriguṇaṃ tataḥ | anurāgeṇa lokāṃstrīnsnehātpaśyati sarvataḥ || 7.84.5 ||
translation: विस्तीर्णः extended, योजनशतम् a hundred yojanas, उच्छ्रितः tall, त्रिगुणम् three times, ततः than that, अनुरागेण with affection, लोकान् worlds, त्रीन् three, स्नेहात् out of love, पश्यति he saw, सर्वतः everywhere.
explanation: He was a hundred yojanas wide and three times that in height, and he regarded all three worlds everywhere with affection and love.

shloka_text: धर्मज्ञश्च कृतज्ञश्च बुद्ध्या च परिनिष्ठितः । शशास पृथिवीं स्फीतां धर्मेण सुसमाहितः ।। 7.84.6 ।।
transliteration: dharmajñaśca kṛtajñaśca buddhyā ca pariniṣṭhitaḥ | śaśāsa pṛthivīṃ sphītāṃ dharmeṇa susamāhitaḥ || 7.84.6 ||
translation: धर्मज्ञः righteous, च and, कृतज्ञः grateful, च and, बुद्ध्या with intellect, च and, परिनिष्ठितः perfected, शशास ruled, पृथिवीम् the earth, स्फीताम् prosperous, धर्मेण with righteousness, सुसमाहितः perfectly attentive.
explanation: He, being righteous, grateful, and perfected in intellect, ruled the vast and prosperous earth with perfect attention to dharma.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्प्रशासति तदा सर्वकामदुघा मही । रसवन्ति प्रभूनानि मूलानि च फलानि च ।। 7.84.7 ।।
transliteration: tasminpraśāsati tadā sarvakāmadughā mahī | rasavanti prabhūnāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca || 7.84.7 ||
translation: तस्मिन् when he, प्रशासति was ruling, तदा then, सर्वकामदुघा wish-fulfilling, मही the earth, रसवन्ति juicy, प्रभूनानि abundant, मूलानि roots, च and, फलानि fruits, च and.
explanation: While he was ruling, the earth became a wish-fulfilling cow, providing abundant and juicy roots and fruits.

shloka_text: अकृष्टपच्या पृथिवी सुसम्पन्ना महात्मनः । स राज्यं तादृशं भुङ्क्ते स्फीतमद्भुतदर्शनम् ।। 7.84.8 ।।
transliteration: akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī susampannā mahātmanaḥ | sa rājyaṃ tādṛśaṃ bhuṅkte sphītamadbhutadarśanam || 7.84.8 ||
translation: अकृष्टपच्या yielding crops without cultivation, पृथिवी the earth, सुसम्पन्ना well-endowed, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, सः he, राज्यम् kingdom, तादृशम् such, भुङ्क्ते enjoyed, स्फीतम् prosperous, अद्भुतदर्शनम् of wonderful appearance.
explanation: The earth, without cultivation, yielded abundant crops for that great-souled king, and he enjoyed such a prosperous and marvelous kingdom.

shloka_text: तस्य बुद्धिः समुप्तन्ना तपः कुर्यामनुत्तमम् । तपो हि परमं श्रेयः सम्मोहमितरत्सुखम् ।। 7.84.9 ।।
transliteration: tasya buddhiḥ samuptannā tapaḥ kuryāmanuttamam | tapo hi paramaṃ śreyaḥ sammohamitaratsukham || 7.84.9 ||
translation: तस्य his, बुद्धिः thought, समुप्तन्ना arose, तपः penance, कुर्याम् I should perform, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, तपः penance, हि indeed, परमम् supreme, श्रेयः good, सम्मोहम् delusion, इतरत् other, सुखम् happiness.
explanation: A thought arose in his mind that he should perform unsurpassed penance, for indeed, penance is the supreme good, while other forms of happiness lead to delusion.

shloka_text: स निक्षिप्य सुतं ज्येष्ठं पौरेषु मधुरेश्वरम् । तप उग्रं समातिष्ठत्तापयन्सर्वदेवताः ।। 7.84.10 ।।
transliteration: sa nikṣipya sutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ paureṣu madhureśvaram | tapa ugraṃ samātiṣṭhattāpayansarvadevatāḥ || 7.84.10 ||
translation: सः he, निक्षिप्य entrusting, सुतम् son, ज्येष्ठम् eldest, पौरेषु among the citizens, मधुरेश्वरम् Madhureśvara, तपः penance, उग्रम् severe, समातिष्ठत् undertook, तापयन् causing to suffer, सर्वदेवताः all deities.
explanation: He entrusted his eldest son, Madhureśvara, to the citizens and undertook severe penance, thereby causing all the deities to suffer.

shloka_text: तपस्तप्यति वृत्रे तु वासवः परमार्तवत् । विष्णुं समुपसङ्क्रम्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.84.11 ।।
transliteration: tapastapyati vṛtre tu vāsavaḥ paramārtavat | viṣṇuṃ samupasaṅkramya vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.84.11 ||
translation: तपः penance, तप्यति performs, वृत्रे when Vritra, तु indeed, वासवः Indra, परमार्तवत् like one greatly distressed, विष्णुं to Vishnu, समुपसङ्क्रम्य having approached, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.
explanation: When Vritra was performing penance, Indra, greatly distressed, approached Vishnu and spoke these words.

shloka_text: तपस्यता महाबाहो लोकाः वृत्रेण निर्जिताः । बलवान्स हि धर्मात्मा नैनं शक्ष्यामि शासितुम् ।। 7.84.12 ।।
transliteration: tapasyatā mahābāho lokāḥ vṛtreṇa nirjitāḥ | balavānsa hi dharmātmā nainaṃ śakṣyāmi śāsitum || 7.84.12 ||
translation: तपस्यता by the one performing penance, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, लोकाः the worlds, वृत्रेण by Vritra, निर्जिताः have been conquered, बलवान् powerful, सः he, हि indeed, धर्मात्मा righteous-souled, न not, एनं him, शक्ष्यामि I am able, शासितुम् to control.
explanation: O mighty-armed one, Vritra, who is performing penance, has conquered the worlds; he is indeed powerful and righteous, and I am unable to control him.

shloka_text: यद्यसौ तप आतिष्ठेद्भूय एवासुरेश्वर । यावल्लोका धरिष्यन्ति तावदस्य वशानुगाः ।। 7.84.13 ।।
transliteration: yadyasau tapa ātiṣṭhedbhūya evāsureśvara | yāvallokā dhariṣyanti tāvadasya vaśānugāḥ || 7.84.13 ||
translation: यदि if, असौ he, तपः penance, आतिष्ठेत् should perform, भूयः again, एव indeed, असुरेश्वर O lord of Asuras, यावत् as long as, लोकाः the worlds, धरिष्यन्ति will endure, तावत् so long, अस्य his, वशानुगाः subservient.
explanation: O Lord of Asuras, if he performs penance again, the worlds will remain subservient to him as long as they endure.

shloka_text: तं चैनं परमोदारमुपेक्षसि महाबलम् । क्षणं हि न भवेद्वृत्रः क्रुद्धे त्वयि सुरेश्वर ।। 7.84.14 ।।
transliteration: taṃ cainaṃ paramodāramupekṣasi mahābalam | kṣaṇaṃ hi na bhavedvṛtraḥ kruddhe tvayi sureśvara || 7.84.14 ||
translation: तं him, च and, एनं this one, परमोदारम् extremely powerful, उपेक्षसि you disregard, महाबलम् very powerful, क्षणं for a moment, हि indeed, न not, भवेत् would exist, वृत्रः Vritra, क्रुद्धे when angry, त्वयि you, सुरेश्वर O lord of gods.
explanation: And yet you disregard this extremely powerful Vritra; for indeed, Vritra would not exist even for a moment if you, O Lord of gods, were to become angry.

shloka_text: यदा हि प्रीतिसंयोगं त्वया विष्णो समागतः । तदाप्रभृति लोकानां नाथत्वमुपलब्धवान् ।। 7.84.15 ।।
transliteration: yadā hi prītisaṃyogaṃ tvayā viṣṇo samāgataḥ | tadāprabhṛti lokānāṃ nāthatvamupalabdhavān || 7.84.15 ||
translation: यदा when, हि indeed, प्रीतिसंयोगं union of affection, त्वया by you, विष्णो O Vishnu, समागतः he obtained, तदाप्रभृति from that time onwards, लोकानां of the worlds, नाथत्वम् lordship, उपलब्धवान् he obtained.
explanation: Indeed, it was when he obtained your favor, O Vishnu, that he achieved lordship over the worlds from that time onwards.

shloka_text: स त्वं प्रसादं लोकानां कुरुष्व सुसमाहितः । त्वत्कृतेन हि सर्वं स्याप्रशान्तमरुजं जगत् ।। 7.84.16 ।।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ prasādaṃ lokānāṃ kuruṣva susamāhitaḥ | tvatkṛtena hi sarvaṃ syāpraśāntamarujaṃ jagat || 7.84.16 ||
translation: स that, त्वं you, प्रसादं favor, लोकानां of the worlds, कुरुष्व do, सुसमाहितः well-composed, त्वत्कृतेन by your doing, हि indeed, सर्वं all, स्यात् would be, प्रशान्तम् peaceful, अरुजं free from suffering, जगत् world.
explanation: You, being well-composed, should bestow your favor upon the worlds, for by your action alone, the entire world would become peaceful and free from suffering.

shloka_text: इमे हि सर्वे विष्णो त्वां निरीक्षन्ते दिवौकसः । वृत्रघातेन महता तेषां साह्यं कुरुष्व ह ।। 7.84.17 ।।
transliteration: ime hi sarve viṣṇo tvāṃ nirīkṣante divaukasaḥ | vṛtraghātena mahatā teṣāṃ sāhyaṃ kuruṣva ha || 7.84.17 ||
translation: इमे these, हि indeed, सर्वे all, विष्णो O Vishnu, त्वां you, निरीक्षन्ते await, दिवौकसः gods, वृत्रघातेन by the slaying of Vritra, महता great, तेषां their, साह्यं help, कुरुष्व render, ह indeed.
explanation: O Vishnu, all these gods indeed await you; therefore, render them great help by slaying Vritra.

shloka_text: त्वया हि नित्यशः साह्यं कृतमेषां महात्मनाम् । असह्यमिदमन्येषामगतीनां गतिर्भवान् ।। 7.84.18 ।।
transliteration: tvayā hi nityaśaḥ sāhyaṃ kṛtameṣāṃ mahātmanām | asahyamidamanyeṣāmagatīnāṃ gatirbhavān || 7.84.18 ||
translation: त्वया by you, हि indeed, नित्यशः always, साह्यं help, कृतम् rendered, एषां of these, महात्मनाम् great-souled ones, असह्यम् unbearable, इदम् this, अन्येषाम् for others, अगतीनां of those without refuge, गतिः refuge, भवान् you.
explanation: Indeed, you have always rendered help to these great-souled ones, for this task is unbearable for others, and you are the sole refuge for the helpless. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुरशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 84 ।। Thus ends the eighty-fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा शत्रुनिबर्हणः । वृत्रघातमशेषेण कथयेत्याह सुव्रत ।। 7.85.1 ।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya tu tadvākyaṃ śrutvā śatrunibarhaṇaḥ | vṛtraghātamaśeṣeṇa kathayetyāha suvrata || 7.85.1 ||
translation: लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, तु indeed, तत् that, वाक्यं speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, शत्रुनिबर्हणः the destroyer of enemies, वृत्रघातम् the slaying of Vritra, अशेषेण completely, कथय narrate, इति thus, आह said, सुव्रत O one of good vows.
explanation: Having heard that speech of Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemies (Rama) said, "O one of good vows, narrate the slaying of Vritra completely."
comments: At Rama's bidding Lakshmana finishes the tale of Vritra -- Vishnu, bound by friendship with the demon, divides himself into three parts, entering Indra, his thunderbolt and the earth, so that Indra may slay him -- the gods march out, Indra beheads Vritra with the thunderbolt, but the sin of brahmin-slaughter pursues and clings to him.

shloka_text: राघवेणैवमुक्तस्तु सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः । भूय एव कथां दिव्यां कथयामास सुव्रतः ।। 7.85.2 ।।
transliteration: rāghaveṇaivamuktastu sumitrānandavardhanaḥ | bhūya eva kathāṃ divyāṃ kathayāmāsa suvrataḥ || 7.85.2 ||
translation: राघवेण by Rama, एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, तु indeed, सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः the enhancer of Sumitra's joy, भूयः again, एव indeed, कथां story, दिव्यां divine, कथयामास narrated, सुव्रतः the one of good vows.
explanation: Thus addressed by Rama, the enhancer of Sumitra's joy, who was of good vows, again narrated the divine story.

shloka_text: सहस्राक्षवचः श्रुत्वा सर्वेषां च दिवौकसाम् । विष्णुर्देवानुवाचेदं सर्वानिन्द्रपुरोगमान् ।। 7.85.3 ।।
transliteration: sahasrākṣavacaḥ śrutvā sarveṣāṃ ca divaukasām | viṣṇurdevānuvācedaṃ sarvānindrapurogamān || 7.85.3 ||
translation: सहस्राक्षवचः Indra's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, सर्वेषां of all, च and, दिवौकसाम् of the gods, विष्णुः Vishnu, देवान् to the gods, उवाच said, इदं this, सर्वान् all, इन्द्रपुरोगमान् with Indra as their leader.
explanation: Having heard the words of Indra and all the gods, Vishnu spoke these words to all the gods, with Indra at their forefront.

shloka_text: पूर्वं सौहृदबद्धो ऽस्मि वृत्रस्य ह महात्मनः । तेन युष्मत्प्रियार्थं हि नाहं हन्मि महासुरम् ।। 7.85.4 ।।
transliteration: pūrvaṃ sauhṛdabaddho 'smi vṛtrasya ha mahātmanaḥ | tena yuṣmatpriyārthaṃ hi nāhaṃ hanmi mahāsuram || 7.85.4 ||
translation: पूर्वं previously, सौहृदबद्धः bound by friendship, अस्मि I am, वृत्रस्य of Vritra, ह indeed, महात्मनः the great-souled one, तेन therefore, युष्मत्प्रियार्थं for your benefit, हि indeed, न not, अहं I, हन्मि kill, महासुरम् the great demon.
explanation: I am indeed bound by a prior friendship with the great Vritra, and therefore I cannot kill this great demon for your benefit.

shloka_text: अवश्यं करणीयं च भवतां सुखमुत्तमम् । तस्मादुपायमाख्यास्ये येन वृत्रो निहन्यते ।। 7.85.5 ।।
transliteration: avaśyaṃ karaṇīyaṃ ca bhavatāṃ sukhamuttamam | tasmādupāyamākhyāsye yena vṛtro nihanyate || 7.85.5 ||
translation: अवश्यं certainly, करणीयम् to be done, च and, भवतां your, सुखम् happiness, उत्तमम् supreme, तस्मात् therefore, उपायम् a means, आख्यास्ये I shall explain, येन by which, वृत्रः Vritra, निहन्यते is killed.
explanation: Your supreme happiness must certainly be achieved, therefore I shall explain a method by which Vritra can be killed.

shloka_text: त्रिधाभूतं करिष्यामि ह्यात्मानं सुरसत्तमाः । तेन वृत्रं सहस्राक्षो वधिष्यति न संशयः ।। 7.85.6 ।।
transliteration: tridhābhūtaṃ kariṣyāmi hyātmānaṃ surasattamāḥ | tena vṛtraṃ sahasrākṣo vadhiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 7.85.6 ||
translation: त्रिधाभूतं made into three parts, करिष्यामि I shall make, हि indeed, आत्मानं myself, सुरसत्तमाः O best of gods, तेन thereby, वृत्रं Vritra, सहस्राक्षः Indra, वधिष्यति will kill, न no, संशयः doubt.
explanation: O best of gods, I shall indeed divide myself into three parts, and thereby Indra will kill Vritra without a doubt.

shloka_text: एकांशो वासवं यातु द्वितीयो वज्रमेव तु । तृतीयो भूतलं शक्रस्तदा वृत्रं वधिष्यति ।। 7.85.7 ।।
transliteration: ekāṃśo vāsavaṃ yātu dvitīyo vajrameva tu | tṛtīyo bhūtalaṃ śakrastadā vṛtraṃ vadhiṣyati || 7.85.7 ||
translation: एकांशः one part, वासवं to Indra, यातु let it go, द्वितीयः the second, वज्रम् to the thunderbolt, एव indeed, तु and, तृतीयः the third, भूतलम् to the earth, शक्रः Indra, तदा then, वृत्रं Vritra, वधिष्यति will kill.
explanation: Let one part of me go into Indra, the second into his thunderbolt, and the third into the earth; then Indra will be able to kill Vritra.

shloka_text: तथा ब्रुवति देवेशे देवा वाक्यमथाब्रुवन् । एवमेतन्न सन्देहो यथा वदसि दैत्यहन् ।। 7.85.8 ।।
transliteration: tathā bruvati deveśe devā vākyamathābruvan | evametanna sandeho yathā vadasi daityahan || 7.85.8 ||
translation: तथा thus, ब्रुवति while speaking, देवेशे to the lord of gods (Vishnu), देवाः the gods, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रुवन् spoke, एवम् thus, एतत् this, न not, सन्देहः doubt, यथा as, वदसि you speak, दैत्यहन् O slayer of demons.
explanation: When the Lord of Gods (Vishnu) spoke thus, the gods then replied, "O slayer of demons, what you say is indeed true, there is no doubt about it."

shloka_text: भद्रं ते ऽस्तु गमिष्यामो वृत्रासुरवधैषिणः । भजस्व परमोदार वासवं स्वेन तेजसा ।। 7.85.9 ।।
transliteration: bhadraṃ te 'stu gamiṣyāmo vṛtrāsuravadhaiṣiṇaḥ | bhajasva paramodāra vāsavaṃ svena tejasā || 7.85.9 ||
translation: भद्रम् welfare, ते to you, अस्तु let it be, गमिष्यामः we shall go, वृत्रासुरवधैषिणः desirous of killing Vritrasura, भजस्व resort to, परमोदार O most generous one, वासवम् Indra, स्वेन with your own, तेजसा might.
explanation: "May good fortune be with you; we shall now go, eager to slay Vritrasura, and O most generous one, you should empower Indra with your own might."

shloka_text: ततः सर्वे महात्मानः सहस्राक्षपुरोगमाः । तदारण्यमुपाक्रामन्यत्र वृत्रो महासुरः ।। 7.85.10 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sarve mahātmānaḥ sahasrākṣapurogamāḥ | tadāraṇyamupākrāmanyatra vṛtro mahāsuraḥ || 7.85.10 ||
translation: ततः then, सर्वे all, महात्मानः the great-souled ones, सहस्राक्षपुरोगमाः with Indra at the forefront, तत् that, अरण्यम् forest, उपाक्रामन् approached, यत्र where, वृत्रः Vritra, महासुरः the great demon.
explanation: Then all the great-souled gods, led by Indra, proceeded towards that forest where the mighty demon Vritra resided.

shloka_text: ते पश्यंस्तेजसा भूतं तप्यन्तमसुरोत्तमम् । पिबन्तमिव लोकांस्त्रीन्निर्दहन्तमिवाम्बरम् ।। 7.85.11 ।।
transliteration: te paśyaṃstejasā bhūtaṃ tapyantamasurottamam | pibantamiva lokāṃstrīnnirdahantamivāmbaram || 7.85.11 ||
translation: ते they, पश्यन् saw, तेजसा with splendor, भूतं endowed, तप्यन्तम् radiating heat, असुरोत्तमम् the best of demons, पिबन्तम् drinking, इव as if, लोकान् worlds, त्रीन् three, निर्दहन्तम् burning completely, इव as if, अम्बरम् the sky.
explanation: They saw the foremost of demons, Vritra, endowed with immense splendor and radiating heat, as if he were drinking up the three worlds and burning the very sky.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वैव चासुरश्रेष्ठं देवास्त्रासमुपागमन् । कथमेनं वधिष्यामः कथं न स्यात्पराजयः ।। 7.85.12 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvaiva cāsuraśreṣṭhaṃ devāstrāsamupāgaman | kathamenaṃ vadhiṣyāmaḥ kathaṃ na syātparājayaḥ || 7.85.12 ||
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, एव indeed, च and, असुरश्रेष्ठम् the best of demons, देवाः the gods, त्रासम् fear, उपागमन् felt, कथम् how, एनम् him, वधिष्यामः shall we kill, कथम् how, न not, स्यात् may it be, पराजयः defeat.
explanation: And having seen that foremost of demons, the gods were struck with fear, wondering, "How shall we kill him? How can we avoid defeat?"

shloka_text: तेषां चिन्तयतां तत्र सहस्राक्षः पुरन्दरः । वज्रं प्रगृह्य पाणिभ्यां प्राहिणोद्वृत्रमूर्धनि ।। 7.85.13 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ cintayatāṃ tatra sahasrākṣaḥ purandaraḥ | vajraṃ pragṛhya pāṇibhyāṃ prāhiṇodvṛtramūrdhani || 7.85.13 ||
translation: तेषां of them, चिन्तयतां while thinking, तत्र there, सहस्राक्षः the thousand-eyed (Indra), पुरन्दरः the destroyer of cities (Indra), वज्रं the thunderbolt, प्रगृह्य having grasped, पाणिभ्यां with both hands, प्राहिणोत् he hurled, वृत्रमूर्धनि on Vritra's head.
explanation: While the gods were contemplating there, the thousand-eyed Indra, the destroyer of cities, grasped the thunderbolt with both hands and hurled it onto Vritra's head.

shloka_text: कालाग्निनेव घोरेण तप्तेनैव महार्चिषा । पतता वृत्रशिरसा जगत्ऺत्रासमुपागमत् ।। 7.85.14 ।।
transliteration: kālāgnineva ghoreṇa taptenaiva mahārciṣā | patatā vṛtraśirasā jagatऺtrāsamupāgamat || 7.85.14 ||
translation: कालाग्निना by the fire of time, इव as if, घोरेण terrible, तप्तेन burning, एव indeed, महार्चिषा with a great flame, पतता falling, वृत्रशिरसा by Vritra's head, जगत् the world, त्रासं terror, उपागमत् experienced.
explanation: As Vritra's head fell, burning like the terrible, great-flamed fire of universal destruction, the world experienced immense terror.

shloka_text: असम्भाव्यं वधं तस्य वृत्रस्य विबुधाधिपः । चिन्तयानो जगामाशु लोकस्यान्तं महायशाः ।। 7.85.15 ।।
transliteration: asambhāvyaṃ vadhaṃ tasya vṛtrasya vibudhādhipaḥ | cintayāno jagāmāśu lokasyāntaṃ mahāyaśāḥ || 7.85.15 ||
translation: असम्भाव्यं the inconceivable, वधं killing, तस्य of him, वृत्रस्य of Vritra, विबुधाधिपः the lord of gods, चिन्तयानः contemplating, जगाम he went, आशु quickly, लोकस्य of the world, अन्तं to the end, महायशाः the greatly renowned.
explanation: The greatly renowned lord of gods, contemplating the inconceivable slaying of Vritra, quickly went to a secluded corner of the world.

shloka_text: तमिन्द्रं ब्रह्महत्या ऽ ऽशु गच्छन्तमनुगच्छति । अपतच्चास्य गात्रेषु तमिन्द्रं दुःखमाविशत् ।। 7.85.16 ।।
transliteration: tamindraṃ brahmahatyā ' 'śu gacchantamanugacchati | apataccāsya gātreṣu tamindraṃ duḥkhamāviśat || 7.85.16 ||
translation: तं that, इन्द्रं Indra, ब्रह्महत्या the sin of Brahmanicide, आशु quickly, गच्छन्तं going, अनुगच्छति followed, अपतत् it fell, च and, अस्य his, गात्रेषु on limbs, तं that, इन्द्रं Indra, दुःखं sorrow, आविशत् enveloped.
explanation: As that Indra was going, the sin of Brahmanicide quickly followed him and fell upon his limbs, enveloping him in sorrow.

shloka_text: हतारयः प्रनष्टेन्द्रा देवाः साग्निपुरोगमाः । विष्णुं त्रिभुवनेशानं मुहुर्मुहुरपूजयन् ।। 7.85.17 ।।
transliteration: hatārayaḥ pranaṣṭendrā devāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ | viṣṇuṃ tribhuvaneśānaṃ muhurmuhurapūjayan || 7.85.17 ||
translation: हतारयः whose enemies were slain, प्रनष्टेन्द्राः whose Indra was lost, देवाः the gods, साग्निपुरोगमाः with Agni as their leader, विष्णुं Vishnu, त्रिभुवनेशानं the lord of the three worlds, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, अपूजयन् they worshipped.
explanation: The gods, whose enemies were slain but whose Indra had disappeared, with Agni as their leader, repeatedly worshipped Vishnu, the lord of the three worlds.

shloka_text: त्वं गतिः परमेशान पूर्वजो जगतः पिता । रक्षार्थं सर्वभूतानां विष्णुत्वमुपजग्मिवान् ।। 7.85.18 ।।
transliteration: tvaṃ gatiḥ parameśāna pūrvajo jagataḥ pitā | rakṣārthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viṣṇutvamupajagmivān || 7.85.18 ||
translation: त्वं You, गतिः the refuge, परमेशान O Supreme Lord, पूर्वजः the primeval one, जगतः of the world, पिता the father, रक्षार्थं for the protection, सर्वभूतानां of all beings, विष्णुत्वम् the state of Vishnu, उपजग्मिवान् you have attained.
explanation: O Supreme Lord, you are the ultimate refuge, the primeval father of the world, who has assumed the form of Vishnu for the protection of all beings.

shloka_text: हतश्चायं त्वया वृत्रो ब्रह्महत्या च वासवम् । बाधते सुरशार्दूल मोक्षं तस्या विनिर्दिश ।। 7.85.19 ।।
transliteration: hataścāyaṃ tvayā vṛtro brahmahatyā ca vāsavam | bādhate suraśārdūla mokṣaṃ tasyā vinirdiśa || 7.85.19 ||
translation: हतः killed, च and, अयं this, त्वया by you, वृत्रः Vritra, ब्रह्महत्या the sin of Brahmanicide, च and, वासवम् Indra, बाधते afflicts, सुरशार्दूल O best among gods, मोक्षं liberation, तस्या from that, विनिर्दिश please prescribe.
explanation: O best among gods, Vritra has been killed by you, and now the sin of Brahmanicide afflicts Indra; please prescribe a means of liberation for him from this sin.

shloka_text: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवानां विष्णुरब्रवीत् । मामेव यजतां शक्रः पावयिष्यामि वज्रिणम् ।। 7.85.20 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devānāṃ viṣṇurabravīt | māmeva yajatāṃ śakraḥ pāvayiṣyāmi vajriṇam || 7.85.20 ||
translation: तेषां their, तत् that, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, देवानां of the gods, विष्णुः Vishnu, अब्रवीत् said, माम् me, एव only, यजतां let him worship, शक्रः Indra, पावयिष्यामि I shall purify, वज्रिणम् the wielder of the thunderbolt.
explanation: Having heard the words of the gods, Vishnu said, "Let Indra worship me alone, and I shall purify the wielder of the thunderbolt."

shloka_text: पुण्येन हयमेधेन मामिष्ट्वा पाकशासनः । पुनरेष्यति देवानामिन्द्रत्वमकुतोभयम् ।। 7.85.21 ।।
transliteration: puṇyena hayamedhena māmiṣṭvā pākaśāsanaḥ | punareṣyati devānāmindratvamakutobhayam || 7.85.21 ||
translation: पुण्येन by the sacred, हयमेधेन Ashvamedha sacrifice, माम् me, इष्ट्वा having worshipped, पाकशासनः Indra, पुनः again, एष्यति he will attain, देवानाम् of the gods, इन्द्रत्वम् the sovereignty of Indra, अकुतोभयम् fearless.
explanation: Having worshipped me with a meritorious Ashvamedha sacrifice, Indra will again attain his fearless sovereignty over the gods.

shloka_text: एवं सन्दिश्य तां वाणीं देवानाममृतोपमाम् । जगाम विष्णुर्देवेशः स्तूयमानस्त्रिविष्टपम् ।। 7.85.22 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ sandiśya tāṃ vāṇīṃ devānāmamṛtopamām | jagāma viṣṇurdeveśaḥ stūyamānastriviṣṭapam || 7.85.22 ||
translation: एवं thus, सन्दिश्य having instructed, तां that, वाणीं speech, देवानाम् of the gods, अमृतोपमाम् nectar-like, जगाम went, विष्णुः Vishnu, देवेशः the lord of gods, स्तूयमानः being praised, त्रिविष्टपम् to heaven.
explanation: Having thus delivered that nectar-like message to the gods, Vishnu, the lord of gods, returned to heaven, being praised by them. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चाशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 85 ।। Thus ends the eighty-fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तदा वृत्रवधं सर्वमखिलेन स लक्ष्मणः । कथयित्वा नरश्रेष्ठः कथाशेषं प्रचक्रमे ।। 7.86.1 ।।
transliteration: tadā vṛtravadhaṃ sarvamakhilena sa lakṣmaṇaḥ | kathayitvā naraśreṣṭhaḥ kathāśeṣaṃ pracakrame || 7.86.1 ||
translation: तदा then, वृत्रवधं the slaying of Vritra, सर्वम् all, अखिलेन completely, स he, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, कथयित्वा having narrated, नरश्रेष्ठः best among men, कथाशेषं the rest of the story, प्रचक्रमे began.
explanation: Then, Lakshmana, the best among men, having completely narrated the entire story of Vritra's slaying, proceeded to tell the rest of the tale.
comments: With Indra fled and the world withered by drought, the gods perform the Ashvamedha Vishnu had prescribed and cleanse Indra of brahmin-slaughter, dividing the sin into four portions to dwell in rivers, in the earth, in women's pride and in false accusers -- restored, Indra revives the world, and Lakshmana again urges Rama to perform the horse-sacrifice.

shloka_text: ततो हते महावीर्ये वृत्रे देवभयङ्करे । ब्रह्महत्यावृतः शक्रः सञ्ज्ञां लेभे न वृत्रहा ।। 7.86.2 ।।
transliteration: tato hate mahāvīrye vṛtre devabhayaṅkare | brahmahatyāvṛtaḥ śakraḥ sañjñāṃ lebhe na vṛtrahā || 7.86.2 ||
translation: ततः thereafter, हते having been killed, महावीर्ये mighty, वृत्रे Vritra, देवभयङ्करे terrifying to the gods, ब्रह्महत्यावृतः enveloped by the sin of Brahmanicide, शक्रः Indra, सञ्ज्ञां consciousness, लेभे attained, न not, वृत्रहा the slayer of Vritra.
explanation: After the mighty Vritra, who was a terror to the gods, was slain, Indra, the slayer of Vritra, became enveloped by the sin of Brahmanicide and did not regain his consciousness.

shloka_text: सो ऽन्तमाश्रित्य लोकानां नष्टसञ्ज्ञो विचेतनः । कालं तत्रावसत्कञ्चिद्वेष्टमान इवोरगः ।। 7.86.3 ।।
transliteration: so 'ntamāśritya lokānāṃ naṣṭasañjño vicetanaḥ | kālaṃ tatrāvasatkañcidveṣṭamāna ivoragaḥ || 7.86.3 ||
translation: सः he, अन्तम् the end, आश्रित्य having resorted to, लोकानां of the worlds, नष्टसञ्ज्ञः having lost consciousness, विचेतनः senseless, कालम् time, तत्र there, अवसत् resided, कञ्चित् for some, वेष्टमानः writhing, इव like, उरगः a serpent.
explanation: Having lost his senses and consciousness, he (Indra) took refuge at the ends of the worlds and remained there for some time, writhing like a serpent.

shloka_text: अथ नष्टे सहस्राक्षे उद्विग्नमभवज्जगत् । भूमिश्च ध्वस्तसङ्काशा निःस्नेहा शुष्ककानना ।। 7.86.4 ।।
transliteration: atha naṣṭe sahasrākṣe udvignamabhavajjagat | bhūmiśca dhvastasaṅkāśā niḥsnehā śuṣkakānanā || 7.86.4 ||
translation: अथ then, नष्टे having disappeared, सहस्राक्षे the thousand-eyed one, उद्विग्नम् agitated, अभवत् became, जगत् the world, भूमिः the earth, च and, ध्वस्तसङ्काशा appearing ruined, निःस्नेहा devoid of moisture, शुष्ककानना with dry forests.
explanation: Then, with the disappearance of the thousand-eyed Indra, the world became distressed, and the earth appeared devastated, devoid of moisture, and with dry forests.

shloka_text: निःस्रोतसश्च ते सर्वे तु ह्रदाश्च सरितस्तथा । सङ्क्षोभश्चैव सत्त्वानामनावृष्टिकृतो ऽभवत् ।। 7.86.5 ।।
transliteration: niḥsrotasaśca te sarve tu hradāśca saritastathā | saṅkṣobhaścaiva sattvānāmanāvṛṣṭikṛto 'bhavat || 7.86.5 ||
translation: निःस्रोतसः without streams, च and, ते those, सर्वे all, तु indeed, ह्रदाः lakes, च and, सरितः rivers, तथा similarly, सङ्क्षोभः agitation, च and, एव indeed, सत्त्वानाम् of living beings, अनावृष्टिकृतः caused by drought, अभवत् occurred.
explanation: All those lakes and rivers became dried up without streams, and a great agitation among living beings occurred, caused by the drought.

shloka_text: क्षीयमाणे तु लोके ऽस्मिन्सम्भ्रान्तमनसः सुराः । यदुक्तं विष्णुना पूर्वं तं यज्ञं समुपानयन् ।। 7.86.6 ।।
transliteration: kṣīyamāṇe tu loke 'sminsambhrāntamanasaḥ surāḥ | yaduktaṃ viṣṇunā pūrvaṃ taṃ yajñaṃ samupānayan || 7.86.6 ||
translation: क्षीयमाणे while decaying, तु indeed, लोके in the world, अस्मिन् in this, सम्भ्रान्तमनसः with bewildered minds, सुराः the gods, यत् which, उक्तं was said, विष्णुना by Vishnu, पूर्वं previously, तं that, यज्ञं sacrifice, समुपानयन् they performed.
explanation: With bewildered minds, the gods performed that sacrifice which Vishnu had previously instructed, as this world was diminishing.

shloka_text: ततः सर्वे सुरगणाः सोपाध्यायाः सहर्षिभिः । तं देशं समुपाजग्मुर्यत्रेन्द्रो भयमोहितः ।। 7.86.7 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sarve suragaṇāḥ sopādhyāyāḥ saharṣibhiḥ | taṃ deśaṃ samupājagmuryatrendro bhayamohitaḥ || 7.86.7 ||
translation: ततः then, सर्वे all, सुरगणाः hosts of gods, सोपाध्यायाः with their preceptors, सहर्षिभिः with the sages, तं that, देशं place, समुपाजग्मुः they approached, यत्र where, इन्द्रः Indra, भयमोहितः was deluded by fear.
explanation: Then, all the hosts of gods, accompanied by their preceptors and sages, approached that place where Indra was deluded by fear.

shloka_text: ते तु दृष्ट्वा सहस्राक्षमावृतं ब्रह्महत्यया । तं पुरस्कृत्य देवेशमश्वमेधमुपाक्रमन् ।। 7.86.8 ।।
transliteration: te tu dṛṣṭvā sahasrākṣamāvṛtaṃ brahmahatyayā | taṃ puraskṛtya deveśamaśvamedhamupākraman || 7.86.8 ||
translation: ते they, तु indeed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सहस्राक्षम् the thousand-eyed one, आवृतं covered, ब्रह्महत्यया by the sin of Brahmanicide, तं him, पुरस्कृत्य having placed in front, देवेशम् the lord of gods, अश्वमेधम् the Ashwamedha sacrifice, उपाक्रमन् they commenced.
explanation: Having seen the thousand-eyed Indra enveloped by the sin of Brahmanicide, they honored him and commenced the Ashwamedha sacrifice.

shloka_text: ततो ऽश्वमेधः सुमहान्महेन्द्रस्य महात्मनः । ववृधे ब्रह्महत्ययाः पावनार्थं नरेश्वर ।। 7.86.9 ।।
transliteration: tato 'śvamedhaḥ sumahānmahendrasya mahātmanaḥ | vavṛdhe brahmahatyayāḥ pāvanārthaṃ nareśvara || 7.86.9 ||
translation: ततः then, अश्वमेधः the Ashwamedha sacrifice, सुमहान् very great, महेन्द्रस्य of Mahendra, महात्मनः the great-souled one, ववृधे grew, ब्रह्महत्ययाः of the sin of Brahmanicide, पावनार्थं for the purification, नरेश्वर O king of men.
explanation: O king of men, then the very great Ashwamedha sacrifice of the great-souled Mahendra prospered for the purification from the sin of Brahmanicide.

shloka_text: ततो यज्ञे समाप्ते तु ब्रह्महत्या महात्मनः । अभिगम्याब्रवीद्वाक्यं क्व मे स्थानं विधास्यथ ।। 7.86.10 ।।
transliteration: tato yajñe samāpte tu brahmahatyā mahātmanaḥ | abhigamyābravīdvākyaṃ kva me sthānaṃ vidhāsyatha || 7.86.10 ||
translation: ततः then, यज्ञे समाप्ते when the sacrifice was completed, महात्मनः of the great-souled Indra, ब्रह्महत्या the sin of brahmin-slaughter, अभिगम्य approaching, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, मे for me, स्थानं a place, क्व where, विधास्यथ will you appoint.
explanation: When the sacrifice was completed, the personified sin of brahmin-slaughter that clung to the great-souled Indra approached and asked, 'Where will you appoint a dwelling place for me?'

shloka_text: ते तामूचुस्तदा देवास्तुष्टाः प्रीतिसमन्विताः । चतुर्धा विभजात्मानमात्मनैव दुरासदे ।। 7.86.11 ।।
transliteration: te tāmūcustadā devāstuṣṭāḥ prītisamanvitāḥ | caturdhā vibhajātmānamātmanaiva durāsade || 7.86.11 ||
translation: ते they, ताम् to her, ऊचुः said, तदा then, देवाः the gods, तुष्टाः pleased, प्रीतिसमन्विताः filled with affection, चतुर्धा into four parts, विभज divide, आत्मानम् yourself, आत्मना by yourself, एव indeed, दुरासदे O difficult to approach one.
explanation: Then, the gods, pleased and filled with affection, said to her (Brahmahatya), "O difficult to approach one, divide yourself into four parts by yourself."

shloka_text: देवानां भाषितं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्महत्या महात्मनाम् । सन्निधौ स्थानमन्यत्र वरयामास दुर्वसा ।। 7.86.12 ।।
transliteration: devānāṃ bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā brahmahatyā mahātmanām | sannidhau sthānamanyatra varayāmāsa durvasā || 7.86.12 ||
translation: देवानां of the gods, भाषितं the words, श्रुत्वा having heard, ब्रह्महत्या the sin of Brahman-killing, महात्मनाम् of the great souls, सन्निधौ in the presence, स्थानम् a place, अन्यत्र elsewhere, वरयामास chose, दुर्वसा Durvasa (the personified sin).
explanation: Having heard the words of the great gods, the personified sin of Brahman-killing, named Durvasa, chose a different dwelling place in their presence.

shloka_text: एकेनांशेन वत्स्यामि पूर्णोदासु नदीषु वै । चतुरो वार्षिकान्मासान्दर्पघ्नी कामवारिणी ।। 7.86.13 ।।
transliteration: ekenāṃśena vatsyāmi pūrṇodāsu nadīṣu vai | caturo vārṣikānmāsāndarpaghnī kāmavāriṇī || 7.86.13 ||
translation: एकेनांशेन with one part, वत्स्यामि I shall dwell, पूर्णोदासु in full-watered, नदीषु rivers, वै indeed, चतुरो four, वार्षिकान् of the rainy season, मासान् months, दर्पघ्नी destroying pride, कामवारिणी obstructing desires.
explanation: She declared that with one part of herself, she would dwell for four months of the rainy season in full-watered rivers, causing pride to be destroyed and desires to be obstructed.

shloka_text: भूम्यामहं सर्वकालमेकेनांशेन सर्वदा । वसिष्यामि न सन्देहः सत्येनैतद्ब्रवीमि वः ।। 7.86.14 ।।
transliteration: bhūmyāmahaṃ sarvakālamekenāṃśena sarvadā | vasiṣyāmi na sandehaḥ satyenaitadbravīmi vaḥ || 7.86.14 ||
translation: भूम्याम् on the earth, अहं I, सर्वकालम् at all times, एकेनांशेन with one part, सर्वदा always, वसिष्यामि I shall dwell, न no, सन्देहः doubt, सत्येन by truth, एतद् this, ब्रवीमि I speak, वः to you.
explanation: She further stated that with another part, she would always dwell on the earth at all times, declaring this truth to them without a doubt.

shloka_text: यो ऽयमंशस्तृतीयो मे स्त्रीषु यौवनशालिषु । त्रिरात्रं दर्पपूर्णासु वशिष्ये दर्पघातिनी ।। 7.86.15 ।।
transliteration: yo 'yamaṃśastṛtīyo me strīṣu yauvanaśāliṣu | trirātraṃ darpapūrṇāsu vaśiṣye darpaghātinī || 7.86.15 ||
translation: यः which, अयम् this, अंशः part, तृतीयो third, मे my, स्त्रीषु in women, यौवनशालिषु endowed with youth, त्रिरात्रं for three nights, दर्पपूर्णासु full of pride, वशिष्ये I shall dwell, दर्पघातिनी destroying pride.
explanation: She announced that her third part would dwell for three nights in young women full of pride, acting as a destroyer of their arrogance.

shloka_text: हन्तारो ब्राह्मणान्ये तु मृषापूर्वमदूषकान् । तांश्चतुर्थेन भागेन संश्रयिष्ये सुरर्षभाः ।। 7.86.16 ।।
transliteration: hantāro brāhmaṇānye tu mṛṣāpūrvamadūṣakān | tāṃścaturthena bhāgena saṃśrayiṣye surarṣabhāḥ || 7.86.16 ||
translation: हन्तारो killers, ब्राह्मणान् Brahmins, ये who, तु indeed, मृषापूर्वम् falsely, अदूषकान् innocent, तान् them, च and, चतुर्थेन with the fourth, भागेन part, संश्रयिष्ये I shall resort to, सुरर्षभाः O best of gods.
explanation: She concluded by stating, "O best of gods, I shall resort with my fourth part to those who kill innocent Brahmins after falsely accusing them."

shloka_text: प्रत्यूचुस्तां ततो देवा यथा वदसि दुर्वसे । तथा भवतु तत्सर्वं साधयस्व यदीप्सितम् ।। 7.86.17 ।।
transliteration: pratyūcustāṃ tato devā yathā vadasi durvase | tathā bhavatu tatsarvaṃ sādhayasva yadīpsitam || 7.86.17 ||
translation: प्रत्यूचुः replied, ताम् to her/him, ततः then, देवाः the gods, यथा as, वदसि you speak, दुर्वसे O sage, तथा so, भवतु let it be, तत् that, सर्वम् all, साधयस्व accomplish, यत् what, ईप्सितम् is desired.
explanation: Then the gods replied to him, "O sage, as you say, so let it be; accomplish all that is desired."

shloka_text: ततः प्रीत्या ऽन्विता देवाः सहस्राक्षं ववन्दिरे । विज्वरः स च पूतात्मा वासवः समपद्यत ।। 7.86.18 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ prītyā 'nvitā devāḥ sahasrākṣaṃ vavandire | vijvaraḥ sa ca pūtātmā vāsavaḥ samapadyata || 7.86.18 ||
translation: ततः then, प्रीत्या with joy, अन्विताः filled, देवाः the gods, सहस्राक्षम् to the thousand-eyed one (Indra), ववन्दिरे bowed down, विज्वरः free from distress, सः he, च and, पूतात्मा purified soul, वासवः Indra, समपद्यत became.
explanation: Then the gods, filled with joy, saluted the thousand-eyed Indra, and Indra himself became free from distress and purified in soul.

shloka_text: प्रशान्तं च जगत्सर्वं सहस्राक्षे प्रतिष्ठिते । यज्ञं चाद्भुतसङ्काशं तदा शक्रो ऽभ्यपूजयत् ।। 7.86.19 ।।
transliteration: praśāntaṃ ca jagatsarvaṃ sahasrākṣe pratiṣṭhite | yajñaṃ cādbhutasaṅkāśaṃ tadā śakro 'bhyapūjayat || 7.86.19 ||
translation: प्रशान्तम् peaceful, च and, जगत् the world, सर्वम् all, सहस्राक्षे when the thousand-eyed one (Indra), प्रतिष्ठिते was established, यज्ञम् the sacrifice, च and, अद्भुतसङ्काशम् wondrous-looking, तदा then, शक्रः Indra, अभ्यपूजयत् worshipped.
explanation: And when the thousand-eyed Indra was re-established, the entire world became peaceful, and then Indra worshipped the wondrous sacrifice.

shloka_text: ईदृशो ह्यश्वमेधस्य प्रसादो रघुनन्दन । यजस्व सुमहाभाग हयमेधेन पार्थिव ।। 7.86.20 ।।
transliteration: īdṛśo hyaśvamedhasya prasādo raghunandana | yajasva sumahābhāga hayamedhena pārthiva || 7.86.20 ||
translation: ईदृशः such, हि indeed, अश्वमेधस्य of the Ashwamedha, प्रसादः is the efficacy, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus (Rama), यजस्व perform sacrifice, सुमहाभाग O greatly fortunate one, हयमेधेन with the horse sacrifice, पार्थिव O king.
explanation: O Rama, such indeed is the efficacy of the Ashwamedha sacrifice; therefore, O greatly fortunate king, perform the horse sacrifice.

shloka_text: इति लक्ष्मणवाक्यमुत्तमं नृपतिरतीव मनोहरं महात्मा । परितोषमवाप हृष्टचेता निशमय्येन्द्रसमानविक्रमौजाः ।। 7.86.21 ।।
transliteration: iti lakṣmaṇavākyamuttamaṃ nṛpatiratīva manoharaṃ mahātmā | paritoṣamavāpa hṛṣṭacetā niśamayyendrasamānavikramaujāḥ || 7.86.21 ||
translation: इति thus, लक्ष्मणवाक्यम् Lakshmana's words, उत्तमम् excellent, नृपतिः the king (Rama), अतीव exceedingly, मनोहरम् charming, महात्मा the great-souled one, परितोषम् great satisfaction, अवाप obtained, हृष्टचेताः with a joyful mind, निशमय्य having heard, इन्द्रसमानविक्रमौजाः whose valor and energy are equal to Indra's.
explanation: Having heard these excellent and exceedingly charming words of Lakshmana, the great-souled king, whose valor and energy were equal to Indra's, felt great satisfaction with a joyful mind. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षडशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 86 ।। Thus ends the eighty-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणेनोक्तं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः । प्रत्युवाच महातेजाः प्रहसन्राघवो वचः ।। 7.87.1 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā lakṣmaṇenoktaṃ vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ | pratyuvāca mahātejāḥ prahasanrāghavo vacaḥ || 7.87.1 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, उक्तं spoken, वाक्यं word, वाक्यविशारदः expert in speech, प्रत्युवाच replied, महातेजाः greatly effulgent, प्रहसन् smiling, राघवः Rama, वचः words.
explanation: Having heard the words spoken by Lakshmana, Rama, who was greatly effulgent and an expert in speech, replied with a smile.
comments: Rama agrees but first tells of King Ila, lord of Bahlika, who while hunting enters a region where Shiva, to please Parvati, has turned himself and all beings female, so that Ila and his men become women -- denied restoration of his manhood, Ila wins from Uma a compromise: to be a man one month and the woman Ila the next, with no memory of either state.

shloka_text: एवमेव नरश्रेष्ठ यथा वदसि लक्ष्मण । वृत्रघातमशेषेण वाजिमेधफलं च यत् ।। 7.87.2 ।।
transliteration: evameva naraśreṣṭha yathā vadasi lakṣmaṇa | vṛtraghātamaśeṣeṇa vājimedhaphalaṃ ca yat || 7.87.2 ||
translation: एवमेव exactly so, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, यथा as, वदसि you say, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, वृत्रघातम् the slaying of Vritra, अशेषेण completely, वाजिमेधफलम् the fruit of Ashwamedha sacrifice, च and, यत् which.
explanation: Rama affirmed to Lakshmana, "O best among men, what you say is exactly true, regarding the complete slaying of Vritra and the fruit of the Ashwamedha sacrifice."

shloka_text: श्रूयते हि पुरा सौम्य कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः । पुत्रो बाह्लीश्वरः श्रीमानिलो नाम महाशयाः ।। 7.87.3 ।।
transliteration: śrūyate hi purā saumya kardamasya prajāpateḥ | putro bāhlīśvaraḥ śrīmānilo nāma mahāśayāḥ || 7.87.3 ||
translation: श्रूयते it is heard, हि indeed, पुरा formerly, सौम्य O gentle one, कर्दमस्य of Kardama, प्रजापतेः the Prajapati, पुत्रः son, बाह्लीश्वरः lord of Bahlika, श्रीमान् glorious, इलः Ila, नाम named, महाशयाः of great mind.
explanation: O gentle one, it is indeed heard that formerly, there was a glorious son of Prajapati Kardama, named Ila, who was the lord of Bahlika and of great mind.

shloka_text: स राजा पृथिवीं सर्वां वशे कृत्वा सुधार्मिकः । राज्यं चैव नरव्याघ्र पुत्रवत्पर्यपालयत् ।। 7.87.4 ।।
transliteration: sa rājā pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ vaśe kṛtvā sudhārmikaḥ | rājyaṃ caiva naravyāghra putravatparyapālayat || 7.87.4 ||
translation: सः that, राजा king, पृथिवीं earth, सर्वां entire, वशे under control, कृत्वा having made, सुधार्मिकः very righteous, राज्यं kingdom, च and, एव indeed, नरव्याघ्र O tiger among men, पुत्रवत् like a son, पर्यपालयत् protected.
explanation: That very righteous king, having brought the entire earth under his control, protected his kingdom as if it were his own son, O tiger among men.

shloka_text: सुरैश्च परमोदारैर्दैतेयैश्च महाधनैः । नागराक्षसगन्धर्वैर्यक्षैश्च सुमहात्मभिः ।। 7.87.5 ।।
transliteration: suraiśca paramodārairdaiteyaiśca mahādhanaiḥ | nāgarākṣasagandharvairyakṣaiśca sumahātmabhiḥ || 7.87.5 ||
translation: सुरैः by gods, च and, परमोदारैः extremely generous, दैतेयैः by Daityas, च and, महाधनैः very wealthy, नागराक्षसगन्धर्वैः by Nagas, Rakshasas, and Gandharvas, यक्षैः by Yakshas, च and, सुमहात्मभिः very noble-minded.
explanation: He was revered by extremely generous gods, very wealthy Daityas, Nagas, Rakshasas, Gandharvas, and very noble-minded Yakshas.

shloka_text: पूज्यते नित्यशः सौम्य भयार्तै रघुनन्दन । अबिभ्यंश्च त्रयो लोकाः सरोषस्य महात्मनः ।। 7.87.6 ।।
transliteration: pūjyate nityaśaḥ saumya bhayārtai raghunandana | abibhyaṃśca trayo lokāḥ saroṣasya mahātmanaḥ || 7.87.6 ||
translation: पूज्यते is worshipped, नित्यशः constantly, सौम्य O gentle one, भयार्तैः by the fearful, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, अबिभ्यंश्च and fearless, त्रयो लोकाः the three worlds, सरोषस्य of the wrathful, महात्मनः great soul.
explanation: O gentle Rama, O delight of the Raghus, this great and wrathful king is constantly worshipped by those afflicted with fear, and due to his power, the three worlds are fearless.

shloka_text: स राजा तादृशो ह्यासीद्धर्मे वीर्ये च निष्ठितः । बुद्ध्या च परमोदारो बाह्लीकेशो महायशाः ।। 7.87.7 ।।
transliteration: sa rājā tādṛśo hyāsīddharme vīrye ca niṣṭhitaḥ | buddhyā ca paramodāro bāhlīkeśo mahāyaśāḥ || 7.87.7 ||
translation: सः that, राजा king, तादृशः such, हि indeed, आसीत् was, धर्मे in righteousness, वीर्ये in valor, च and, निष्ठितः established, बुद्ध्या in intellect, च and, परमोदारः supremely noble, बाह्लीकेशः the lord of Bahlika, महायशाः greatly renowned.
explanation: That king, the lord of Bahlika, was indeed such a one, firmly established in righteousness and valor, supremely noble in intellect, and greatly renowned.

shloka_text: स प्रचक्रे महाबाहुर्मृगयां रुचिरे वने । चैत्रे मनोरमे मासि सभृत्यबलवाहनः ।। 7.87.8 ।।
transliteration: sa pracakre mahābāhurmṛgayāṃ rucire vane | caitre manorame māsi sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ || 7.87.8 ||
translation: सः he, प्रचक्रे undertook, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, मृगयाम् hunting, रुचिरे in a beautiful, वने forest, चैत्रे in Chaitra, मनोरमे delightful, मासि month, सभृत्यबलवाहनः with servants, army, and conveyances.
explanation: The mighty-armed king undertook a hunt in a beautiful forest during the delightful month of Chaitra, accompanied by his servants, army, and conveyances.

shloka_text: प्रजघ्ने च नृपो ऽरण्ये मृगाञ्छतसहस्रशः । हत्वैव तृप्तिर्नाभूच्च राज्ञस्तस्य महात्मनः ।। 7.87.9 ।।
transliteration: prajaghne ca nṛpo 'raṇye mṛgāñchatasahasraśaḥ | hatvaiva tṛptirnābhūcca rājñastasya mahātmanaḥ || 7.87.9 ||
translation: प्रजघ्ने killed, च and, नृपः the king, अरण्ये in the forest, मृगान् animals, शतसहस्रशः by hundreds of thousands, हत्वा having killed, एव even, तृप्तिः satisfaction, न not, अभूत् was, च and, राज्ञः of the king, तस्य that, महात्मनः great soul.
explanation: And the king killed hundreds of thousands of animals in the forest, yet even after killing so many, that great-souled king was not satisfied.

shloka_text: नानामृगाणामयुतं वध्यमानं महात्मना । यत्र जातो माहासेनस्तं देशमुपचक्रमे ।। 7.87.10 ।।
transliteration: nānāmṛgāṇāmayutaṃ vadhyamānaṃ mahātmanā | yatra jāto māhāsenastaṃ deśamupacakrame || 7.87.10 ||
translation: नानामृगाणाम् of various animals, अयुतम् ten thousand, वध्यमानम् being killed, महात्मना by the great soul, यत्र where, जातः was born, माहासेनः Mahasena, तम् that, देशम् region, उपचक्रमे approached.
explanation: While ten thousand animals of various kinds were being killed by the great-souled king, he approached that region where Mahasena (Kartikeya) was born.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्प्रदेशे देवेश शैलराजसुतां हरः । रमयामास दुर्धर्षः सर्वैरनुचरैः सह ।। 7.87.11 ।।
transliteration: tasminpradeśe deveśa śailarājasutāṃ haraḥ | ramayāmāsa durdharṣaḥ sarvairanucaraiḥ saha || 7.87.11 ||
translation: तस्मिन्प्रदेशे in that region, देवेश the lord of gods, शैलराजसुतां the daughter of the king of mountains, हरः Hara, रमयामास made to sport, दुर्धर्षः the unassailable one, सर्वैः with all, अनुचरैः attendants, सह together.
explanation: In that region, the unassailable Hara, the lord of gods, sported with Parvati, the daughter of the king of mountains, accompanied by all his attendants.

shloka_text: कृत्वा स्त्रीरूपमात्मानमुमेशो गोपतिध्वजः । देव्याः प्रियचिकीर्षुः संस्तस्मिन्पर्वतनिर्झरे ।। 7.87.12 ।।
transliteration: kṛtvā strīrūpamātmānamumeśo gopatidhvajaḥ | devyāḥ priyacikīrṣuḥ saṃstasminparvatanirjhare || 7.87.12 ||
translation: कृत्वा having made, स्त्रीरूपम् a female form, आत्मानम् himself, उमेशः the lord of Uma, गोपतिध्वजः one whose banner has a bull, देव्याः of the goddess, प्रियचिकीर्षुः desirous of doing what is pleasing, सन् being, तस्मिन् in that, पर्वतनिर्झरे mountain stream.
