explanation: Desirous of pleasing the goddess, Shiva, the lord of Uma whose banner bears a bull, transformed himself into a female form in that mountain stream.

shloka_text: ये तु तत्र वनोद्देशे सत्त्वाः पुरुषवादिनः । वृक्षाः पुरुषनामानस्ते ऽभवन् स्त्रीजनास्तदा ।। 7.87.13 ।।
transliteration: ye tu tatra vanoddeśe sattvāḥ puruṣavādinaḥ | vṛkṣāḥ puruṣanāmānaste 'bhavan strījanāstadā || 7.87.13 ||
translation: ये those who, तु indeed, तत्र there, वनोद्देशे in the forest region, सत्त्वाः beings, पुरुषवादिनः called males, वृक्षाः trees, पुरुषनामानः named as males, ते they, अभवन् became, स्त्रीजनाः women, तदा then.
explanation: Then, all the male beings and trees with male names in that forest region transformed into women.

shloka_text: यच्च किञ्चन तत्सर्वं नारीसञ्ज्ञं बभूव ह । एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजा स इलः कर्दमात्मजः । निघ्नन्मृगसहस्राणि तं देशमुपचक्रमे ।। 7.87.14 ।।
transliteration: yacca kiñcana tatsarvaṃ nārīsañjñaṃ babhūva ha | etasminnantare rājā sa ilaḥ kardamātmajaḥ | nighnanmṛgasahasrāṇi taṃ deśamupacakrame || 7.87.14 ||
translation: यत् whatever, च and, किञ्चन anything, तत् that, सर्वम् all, नारीसञ्ज्ञं having a female form, बभूव became, ह indeed. एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, राजा king, सः that, इलः Ila, कर्दमात्मजः son of Kardama, निघ्नन् killing, मृगसहस्राणि thousands of deer, तम् that, देशम् region, उपचक्रमे approached.
explanation: Indeed, everything there became female, and in the meantime, King Ila, the son of Kardama, entered that region while hunting thousands of deer.

shloka_text: स दृष्ट्वा स्त्रीकृतं सर्वं सव्यालमृगपक्षकम् । आत्मनं स्त्रीकृतं चैव सानुगं रघुनन्दन ।। 7.87.15 ।।
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā strīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ savyālamṛgapakṣakam | ātmanaṃ strīkṛtaṃ caiva sānugaṃ raghunandana || 7.87.15 ||
translation: सः he, दृष्ट्वा having seen, स्त्रीकृतं made into a female, सर्वम् everything, सव्यालमृगपक्षकम् with wild animals, deer, and birds, आत्मानं himself, स्त्रीकृतं made into a female, च and, एव indeed, सानुगं with his followers, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: O delight of the Raghus, upon seeing everything—including wild animals, deer, and birds—transformed into females, and himself along with his followers also turned into women, he was astonished.

shloka_text: तस्य दुःखं महच्चासीद्दृष्ट्वा ऽ ऽत्मानं तथागतम् । उमापतेश्च तत्कर्म ज्ञात्वा त्रासमुपागमत् ।। 7.87.16 ।।
transliteration: tasya duḥkhaṃ mahaccāsīddṛṣṭvā ' 'tmānaṃ tathāgatam | umāpateśca tatkarma jñātvā trāsamupāgamat || 7.87.16 ||
translation: तस्य tasya, his, दुःखं duḥkhaṃ, sorrow, महत् mahat, great, च ca, and, आसीत् āsīt, was, दृष्ट्वा dṛṣṭvā, having seen, आत्मानं ātmānaṃ, himself, तथागतम् tathāgatam, in that state, उमापतेः umāpateḥ, of the lord of Uma (Shiva), च ca, and, तत् tat, that, कर्म karma, deed, ज्ञात्वा jñātvā, having known, त्रासम् trāsam, fear, उपागमत् upāgamat, he attained.
explanation: Seeing himself transformed and realizing that this was the deed of Lord Shiva, he was overcome with great sorrow and fear.

shloka_text: ततो देवं महात्मानं शितिकण्ठं कपर्दिनम् । जगाम शरणं राजा सभृत्यबलवाहनः ।। 7.87.17 ।।
transliteration: tato devaṃ mahātmānaṃ śitikaṇṭhaṃ kapardinam | jagāma śaraṇaṃ rājā sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ || 7.87.17 ||
translation: ततः tataḥ, then, देवं devaṃ, to the god, महात्मानं mahātmānaṃ, the great-souled, शितिकण्ठं śitikaṇṭhaṃ, blue-necked, कपर्दिनम् kapardinam, one with matted hair, जगाम jagāma, went, शरणं śaraṇaṃ, for refuge, राजा rājā, the king, सभृत्यबलवाहनः sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ, with his servants, army, and vehicles.
explanation: Then, the king, along with his servants, army, and vehicles, went to seek refuge with the great-souled, blue-necked, matted-haired god (Shiva).

shloka_text: ततः प्रहस्य वरदः सह देव्या महेश्वरः । प्रजापतिसुतं वाक्यमुवाच वरदः स्वयम् ।। 7.87.18 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ prahasya varadaḥ saha devyā maheśvaraḥ | prajāpatisutaṃ vākyamuvāca varadaḥ svayam || 7.87.18 ||
translation: ततः tataḥ, then, प्रहस्य prahasya, having laughed, वरदः varadaḥ, the bestower of boons, सह saha, with, देव्या devyā, the goddess, महेश्वरः maheśvaraḥ, the great lord (Shiva), प्रजापतिसुतं prajāpatisutaṃ, to the son of Prajapati, वाक्यम् vākyam, words, उवाच uvāca, spoke, वरदः varadaḥ, the bestower of boons, स्वयम् svayam, himself.
explanation: Then, the great lord Maheśvara, the bestower of boons, laughed with the goddess and himself spoke these words to the son of Prajapati.

shloka_text: उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ राजर्षे कार्दमेय महाबल । पुरुषत्वमृते सौम्य वरं वरय सुव्रत ।। 7.87.19 ।।
transliteration: uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha rājarṣe kārdameya mahābala | puruṣatvamṛte saumya varaṃ varaya suvrata || 7.87.19 ||
translation: उत्तिष्ठ uttiṣṭha, arise, उत्तिष्ठ uttiṣṭha, arise, राजर्षे rājarṣe, O royal sage, कार्दमेय kārdameya, O son of Kardama, महाबल mahābala, O mighty one, पुरुषत्वम् puruṣatvam, manhood, ऋते ṛte, except for, सौम्य saumya, O gentle one, वरम् varam, a boon, वरय varaya, choose, सुव्रत suvrata, O one of good vows.
explanation: Lord Shiva commanded, "Arise, arise, O royal sage, O son of Kardama, O mighty one; O gentle one, O one of good vows, choose any boon except for manhood."

shloka_text: ततः स राजा दुःखार्तः प्रत्याख्यातो महात्मना । न च जग्राह स्त्रीभूतो वरमन्यं सुरोत्तमात् ।। 7.87.20 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa rājā duḥkhārtaḥ pratyākhyāto mahātmanā | na ca jagrāha strībhūto varamanyaṃ surottamāt || 7.87.20 ||
translation: ततः tataḥ, then, सः saḥ, that, राजा rājā, king, दुःखार्तः duḥkhārtaḥ, afflicted by sorrow, प्रत्याख्यातः pratyākhyātaḥ, rejected, महात्मना mahātmanā, by the great-souled one, न na, not, च ca, and, जग्राह jagrāha, accepted, स्त्रीभूतो strībhūto, having become a woman, वरम् varam, a boon, अन्यम् anyam, other, सुरोत्तमात् surottamāt, from the best of gods.
explanation: Then, that king, afflicted by sorrow and rejected by the great-souled one, did not accept any other boon from the best of gods, having become a woman.

shloka_text: ततः शोकेन महता शैलराजसुतां नृपः । प्रणिपत्य ह्युमां देवीं सर्वेणैवान्तरात्मना ।। 7.87.21 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ śokena mahatā śailarājasutāṃ nṛpaḥ | praṇipatya hyumāṃ devīṃ sarveṇaivāntarātmanā || 7.87.21 ||
translation: ततः then, शोकेन with sorrow, महता great, शैलराजसुतां to the daughter of the king of mountains, नृपः the king, प्रणिपत्य having bowed down, हि indeed, उमां Uma, देवीं to the goddess, सर्वेण with all, एव indeed, अन्तरात्मना with his inner self.
explanation: Then, overwhelmed by great sorrow, the king bowed down to the goddess Uma, the daughter of the king of mountains, with his entire heart and soul.

shloka_text: ईशे वराणां वरदे लोकानामसि भामिनी । अमोघदर्शने देवी भज सौम्येन चक्षुषा ।। 7.87.22 ।।
transliteration: īśe varāṇāṃ varade lokānāmasi bhāminī | amoghadarśane devī bhaja saumyena cakṣuṣā || 7.87.22 ||
translation: ईशे You are the mistress, वराणां of boons, वरदे O giver of boons, लोकानाम् of the worlds, असि you are, भामिनी O radiant one, अमोघदर्शने O one whose sight is unfailing, देवी O goddess, भज look upon, सौम्येन with a gentle, चक्षुषा eye.
explanation: O radiant goddess, giver of boons, you are the mistress of boons and the worlds, and your sight is unfailing; please look upon me with a gentle eye.

shloka_text: हृद्गतं तस्य राजर्षेर्विज्ञाय हरसन्निधौ । प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यं देवी रुद्रस्य संमता ।। 7.87.23 ।।
transliteration: hṛdgataṃ tasya rājarṣervijñāya harasannidhau | pratyuvāca śubhaṃ vākyaṃ devī rudrasya saṃmatā || 7.87.23 ||
translation: हृद्गतं that which is in the heart, तस्य his, राजर्षेः of the royal sage, विज्ञाय having known, हरसन्निधौ in the presence of Hara, प्रत्युवाच replied, शुभं auspicious, वाक्यं words, देवी the goddess, रुद्रस्य of Rudra, संमता approved by.
explanation: Having understood the desire in the heart of that royal sage, the goddess, who was dear to Rudra, replied with auspicious words in the presence of Hara.

shloka_text: अर्धस्य देवो वरदो वरार्धस्य तव ह्यहम् । तस्मादर्धं गृहाण त्वं स्त्रीपुंसोर्यावदिच्छसि ।। 7.87.24 ।।
transliteration: ardhasya devo varado varārdhasya tava hyaham | tasmādardhaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ strīpuṃsoryāvadicchasi || 7.87.24 ||
translation: अर्धस्य of half, देवो the god, वरदो is the giver of boons, वरार्धस्य of the other half of the boon, तव to you, हि indeed, अहम् I, तस्मात् therefore, अर्धं half, गृहाण take, त्वं you, स्त्रीपुंसोः of male and female, यावत् as much as, इच्छसि you desire.
explanation: The goddess declared that Shiva grants half of the boons, and she grants the other half, therefore the king should take as much of the male and female aspect as he desires.

shloka_text: तदद्भुततरं श्रुत्वा देव्या वरमनुत्तमम् । सम्प्रहृष्टमना भूत्वा राजा वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।। 7.87.25 ।।
transliteration: tadadbhutataraṃ śrutvā devyā varamanuttamam | samprahṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā rājā vākyamathābravīt || 7.87.25 ||
translation: तत् that, अद्भुततरं most wonderful, श्रुत्वा having heard, देव्या from the goddess, वरम् boon, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, सम्प्रहृष्टमना with a greatly delighted mind, भूत्वा having become, राजा the king, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having heard that most wonderful and unsurpassed boon from the goddess, the king became greatly delighted and then spoke.

shloka_text: यदि देवि प्रसन्ना मे रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि । मासं स्त्रीत्वमुपासित्वा मासं स्यां पुरुषः पुनः ।। 7.87.26 ।।
transliteration: yadi devi prasannā me rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi | māsaṃ strītvamupāsitvā māsaṃ syāṃ puruṣaḥ punaḥ || 7.87.26 ||
translation: यदि if, देवि O Goddess, प्रसन्ना pleased, मे with me, रूपेण in form/beauty, अप्रतिमा unequalled, भुवि on earth, मासम् for a month, स्त्रीत्वम् womanhood, उपासित्वा having experienced, मासम् for a month, स्याम् may I be, पुरुषः a man, पुनः again.
explanation: O Goddess, if you are pleased with me, who is unequalled in beauty on earth, then may I experience womanhood for one month and then become a man again for another month.

shloka_text: ईप्सितं तस्य विज्ञाय देवी सुरुचिरानना । प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यमेवमेव भविष्यति ।। 7.87.27 ।।
transliteration: īpsitaṃ tasya vijñāya devī surucirānanā | pratyuvāca śubhaṃ vākyamevameva bhaviṣyati || 7.87.27 ||
translation: ईप्सितम् the desired wish, तस्य his, विज्ञाय having understood, देवी the Goddess, सुरुचिरानना with a very beautiful face, प्रत्युवाच replied, शुभम् auspicious, वाक्यम् words, एवमेव exactly so, भविष्यति it shall be.
explanation: Understanding his wish, the Goddess with a very beautiful face replied with auspicious words, saying, 'It shall be exactly so.'

shloka_text: राजन्पुरुषभूतस्त्वं स्त्रीभावं न स्मरिष्यसि । स्त्रीभूतश्च परं मासं न स्मरिष्यसि पौरुषम् ।। 7.87.28 ।।
transliteration: rājanpuruṣabhūtastvaṃ strībhāvaṃ na smariṣyasi | strībhūtaśca paraṃ māsaṃ na smariṣyasi pauruṣam || 7.87.28 ||
translation: राजन् O King, पुरुषभूतः having become a man, त्वम् you, स्त्रीभावम् the state of being a woman, न not, स्मरिष्यसि will remember, स्त्रीभूतः having become a woman, च and, परम् next, मासम् month, न not, स्मरिष्यसि will remember, पौरुषम् manhood.
explanation: O King, when you become a man, you will not remember your state as a woman, and when you become a woman for the next month, you will not remember your manhood.

shloka_text: एवं स राजा पुरुषो मासं भूत्वाथ कार्दमिः । त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी नारी मासमेकमिला ऽभवत् ।। 7.87.29 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ sa rājā puruṣo māsaṃ bhūtvātha kārdamiḥ | trailokyasundarī nārī māsamekamilā 'bhavat || 7.87.29 ||
translation: एवम् thus, सः that, राजा king, पुरुषः a man, मासम् for a month, भूत्वा having been, अथ then, कार्दमिः the son of Kardama, त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी beautiful in the three worlds, नारी a woman, मासम् for a month, एकम् one, इला Ila, अभवत् became.
explanation: Thus, that King Ila, the son of Kardama, having been a man for one month, then became Ila, a woman beautiful in the three worlds, for another month. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्ताशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 87 ।। Thus ends the eighty-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तां कथामिलसम्बद्धां रामेण समुदीरिताम् । लक्ष्मणो भरतश्चैव श्रुत्वा परमविस्मितौ ।। 7.88.1 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ kathāmilasambaddhāṃ rāmeṇa samudīritām | lakṣmaṇo bharataścaiva śrutvā paramavismitau || 7.88.1 ||
translation: ताम् that, कथाम् story, इलसम्बद्धाम् related to Ila, रामेण by Rama, समुदीरिताम् narrated, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, भरतः Bharata, च and, एव indeed, श्रुत्वा having heard, परमविस्मितौ greatly astonished.
explanation: Having heard that story related to Ila, narrated by Rama, Lakshmana and Bharata were greatly astonished.
comments: Asked how Ila fared, Rama continues: as a woman she wanders the forest and comes upon Budha, son of Soma, at his penance -- smitten, Budha learns by his spell who she is, and turns her companions, the former men, into Kimpurushis to dwell on the mountain with Kimpurusha husbands.

shloka_text: तौ रामं प्राञ्जली भूत्वा तस्य राज्ञो महात्मनः । विस्तरं तस्य भावस्य तदा पप्रच्छतुः पुनः ।। 7.88.2 ।।
transliteration: tau rāmaṃ prāñjalī bhūtvā tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ | vistaraṃ tasya bhāvasya tadā papracchatuḥ punaḥ || 7.88.2 ||
translation: तौ they (the two), रामं to Rama, प्राञ्जली with folded hands, भूत्वा having become, तस्य of that, राज्ञो king, महात्मनः great-souled, विस्तरं the details, तस्य of that, भावस्य state/condition, तदा then, पप्रच्छतुः asked, पुनः again.
explanation: The two, with folded hands, then again asked Rama for the detailed account of the great-souled king's condition.

shloka_text: कथं स राजा स्त्रीभूतो वर्तयामास दुर्गतिः । पुरुषः स यदा भूतः कां वृत्तिं वर्तयत्यसौ ।। 7.88.3 ।।
transliteration: kathaṃ sa rājā strībhūto vartayāmāsa durgatiḥ | puruṣaḥ sa yadā bhūtaḥ kāṃ vṛttiṃ vartayatyasau || 7.88.3 ||
translation: कथं how, स that, राजा king, स्त्रीभूतो having become a woman, वर्तयामास lived, दुर्गतिः in misfortune, पुरुषः a man, स he, यदा when, भूतः became, कां what, वृत्तिं way of life, वर्तयत्यसौ did he lead.
explanation: They inquired how that king lived in misfortune after becoming a woman, and what kind of life he led when he became a man again.

shloka_text: तयोस्तद्भाषितं श्रुत्वा कौतूहलसमन्वितम् । कथयामास काकुत्स्थस्तस्य राज्ञो यथागतम् ।। 7.88.4 ।।
transliteration: tayostadbhāṣitaṃ śrutvā kautūhalasamanvitam | kathayāmāsa kākutsthastasya rājño yathāgatam || 7.88.4 ||
translation: तयोः of those two, तद्भाषितं their speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, कौतूहलसमन्वितम् filled with curiosity, कथयामास narrated, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), तस्य of that, राज्ञो king, यथागतम् as it happened.
explanation: Hearing their speech, which was full of curiosity, Rama (Kakutstha) narrated the king's story exactly as it had happened.

shloka_text: तमेव प्रथमं मासं स्त्रीभूता लोकसुन्दरी । ताभिः परिवृता स्त्रीभिर्ये च पूर्वपदानुगाः ।। 7.88.5 ।।
transliteration: tameva prathamaṃ māsaṃ strībhūtā lokasundarī | tābhiḥ parivṛtā strībhirye ca pūrvapadānugāḥ || 7.88.5 ||
translation: तं that, एव very, प्रथमं first, मासं month, स्त्रीभूता having become a woman, लोकसुन्दरी beautiful in the world, ताभिः by those, परिवृता surrounded, स्त्रीभिः by women, ये who, च and, पूर्वपदानुगाः followed his former position.
explanation: For that very first month, having become a woman of unparalleled beauty, she was surrounded by the women who had previously been part of his retinue.

shloka_text: तत्काननं विगाह्वाशु विजह्रे लोकसुन्दरी । द्रुमगुल्मलताकीर्णं पद्भ्यां पद्मदलेक्षणा ।। 7.88.6 ।।
transliteration: tatkānanaṃ vigāhvāśu vijahre lokasundarī | drumagulmalatākīrṇaṃ padbhyāṃ padmadalekṣaṇā || 7.88.6 ||
translation: तत्काननं that forest, विगाह्वा having entered, आशु quickly, विजह्रे roamed, लोकसुन्दरी the beautiful woman, द्रुमगुल्मलताकीर्णं filled with trees, bushes, and creepers, पद्भ्यां with her feet, पद्मदलेक्षणा lotus-petal-eyed.
explanation: The lotus-petal-eyed woman, beautiful in the world, quickly entered that forest, which was filled with trees, bushes, and creepers, and roamed through it on foot.

shloka_text: वाहनानि च सर्वाणि सा त्यक्त्वा वै समन्ततः । पर्वताभोगविवरे तस्मिन्रेमे इला तदा ।। 7.88.7 ।।
transliteration: vāhanāni ca sarvāṇi sā tyaktvā vai samantataḥ | parvatābhogavivare tasminreme ilā tadā || 7.88.7 ||
translation: वाहनानि conveyances, च and, सर्वाणि all, सा she, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, वै indeed, समन्ततः all around, पर्वताभोगविवरे in the wide expanse of the mountain, तस्मिन् in that, रेमे she delighted, इला Ilā, तदा then.
explanation: Then, Ilā, having completely abandoned all her conveyances, delighted in that wide mountain cavity.

shloka_text: अथ तस्मिन्वनोद्देशे पर्वतस्याविदूरतः । सरः सुरुचिरप्रख्यं नानापक्षिगणैर्युतम् ।। 7.88.8 ।।
transliteration: atha tasminvanoddeśe parvatasyāvidūrataḥ | saraḥ suruciraprakhyaṃ nānāpakṣigaṇairyutam || 7.88.8 ||
translation: अथ then, तस्मिन् in that, वनोद्देशे forest region, पर्वतस्य of the mountain, अविदूरतः not far from, सरः a lake, सुरुचिरप्रख्यं very beautiful in appearance, नानापक्षिगणैर्युतम् endowed with various flocks of birds.
explanation: Then, in that forest region not far from the mountain, there was a lake, very beautiful in appearance and filled with various flocks of birds.

shloka_text: ददर्श सा त्विला तस्मिन्बुधं सोमसुतं तदा । ज्वलन्तं स्वेन वपुषा पूर्णसोममिवोदितम् ।। 7.88.9 ।।
transliteration: dadarśa sā tvilā tasminbudhaṃ somasutaṃ tadā | jvalantaṃ svena vapuṣā pūrṇasomamivoditam || 7.88.9 ||
translation: ददर्श she saw, सा she, तु indeed, इला Ilā, तस्मिन् in that, बुधं Budha, सोमसुतं son of Soma, तदा then, ज्वलन्तं shining, स्वेन with his own, वपुषा body, पूर्णसोममिवोदितम् like the full moon risen.
explanation: Then, Ilā saw Budha, the son of Soma, in that place, shining with his own body like the risen full moon.

shloka_text: तपन्तं च तपस्तीव्रमम्भोमध्ये दुरासदम् । यशस्करं कामकरं कारुण्ये पर्यवस्थितम् ।। 7.88.10 ।।
transliteration: tapantaṃ ca tapastīvramambhomadhye durāsadam | yaśaskaraṃ kāmakaraṃ kāruṇye paryavasthitam || 7.88.10 ||
translation: तपन्तं performing penance, च and, तपः penance, तीव्रम् intense, अम्भोमध्ये in the midst of water, दुरासदम् difficult to approach, यशस्करं bestowing fame, कामकरं fulfilling desires, कारुण्ये in compassion, पर्यवस्थितम् established.
explanation: He was performing intense and formidable penance in the midst of water, established in compassion, bestowing fame and fulfilling desires.

shloka_text: सा तं जलाशयं सर्वं क्षोभयामास विस्मिता । सहगैः पूर्वपुरुषैः स्त्रीभूतै रघुनन्दन ।। 7.88.11 ।।
transliteration: sā taṃ jalāśayaṃ sarvaṃ kṣobhayāmāsa vismitā | sahagaiḥ pūrvapuruṣaiḥ strībhūtai raghunandana || 7.88.11 ||
translation: सा she, तं that, जलाशयं body of water, सर्वं entire, क्षोभयामास she agitated, विस्मिता astonished, सहगैः with her companions, पूर्वपुरुषैः former men, स्त्रीभूतैः having become women, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: O delight of the Raghus, astonished, she agitated that entire body of water along with her companions, who were formerly men but had also become women.

shloka_text: बुधस्तु तां समीक्ष्यैव कामबाणवशं गतः । नोपलेभे तदा ऽ ऽत्मानं सञ्चचाल तदा ऽ ऽम्भसि ।। 7.88.12 ।।
transliteration: budhastu tāṃ samīkṣyaiva kāmabāṇavaśaṃ gataḥ | nopalebhe tadā ' 'tmānaṃ sañcacāla tadā ' 'mbhasi || 7.88.12 ||
translation: बुधः Budha, तु but, तां her, समीक्ष्यैव having just seen, कामबाणवशं the sway of Cupid's arrows, गतः fallen into, न not, उपलेभे perceived, तदा then, आत्मानं himself, सञ्चचाल moved, तदा then, अम्भसि in the water.
explanation: But Budha, having just seen her, fell under the sway of Cupid's arrows, lost control of himself, and then stirred in the water.

shloka_text: इलां निरीक्षमाणस्तु त्रैलोक्याभ्यधिकां शुभाम् । चिन्तां समभ्यतिक्रामत् का न्वियं देवताधिका ।। 7.88.13 ।।
transliteration: ilāṃ nirīkṣamāṇastu trailokyābhyadhikāṃ śubhām | cintāṃ samabhyatikrāmat kā nviyaṃ devatādhikā || 7.88.13 ||
translation: इलां Ila, निरीक्षमाणस्तु looking at, त्रैलोक्याभ्यधिकां superior to the three worlds, शुभाम् beautiful, चिन्तां a thought, समभ्यतिक्रामत् came to him, का who, नु indeed, इयं this, देवताधिका superior goddess.
explanation: As he gazed at Ila, who was more beautiful than anything in the three worlds, a thought came to him: "Who indeed is this superior goddess?"

shloka_text: न देवीषु न नागीषु नासुरीष्वप्सरःसु च । दृष्टपूर्वा मया काचिद्रूपेणानेन शोभिता ।। 7.88.14 ।।
transliteration: na devīṣu na nāgīṣu nāsurīṣvapsaraḥsu ca | dṛṣṭapūrvā mayā kācidrūpeṇānena śobhitā || 7.88.14 ||
translation: न not, देवीषु among goddesses, न not, नागीषु among Nāga women, न not, आसुरीषु among Asura women, अप्सरःसु among Apsaras, च and, दृष्टपूर्वा seen before, मया by me, काचित् any, रूपेण by form, अनेन by this, शोभिता adorned.
explanation: Never before have I seen anyone adorned with such beauty, neither among goddesses, Nāga women, Asura women, nor Apsaras.

shloka_text: सदृशीयं मम भवेद्यदि नान्यपरिग्रहः । इति बुद्धिं समास्थाय जलात्कूलमुपागमत् ।। 7.88.15 ।।
transliteration: sadṛśīyaṃ mama bhavedyadi nānyaparigrahaḥ | iti buddhiṃ samāsthāya jalātkūlamupāgamat || 7.88.15 ||
translation: सदृशी suitable, इयं this (woman), मम for me, भवेत् would be, यदि if, न not, अन्यपरिग्रहः taken by another, इति thus, बुद्धिं a thought, समास्थाय having firmly resolved, जलात् from the water, कूलं to the bank, उपागमत् he went.
explanation: Having firmly resolved that she would be suitable for him if she were not already taken by another, he then went from the water to the bank.

shloka_text: आश्रमं समुपागम्य ततस्ताः प्रमदोत्तमाः । शब्दापयत धर्मात्मा ताश्चैनं च ववन्दिरे ।। 7.88.16 ।।
transliteration: āśramaṃ samupāgamya tatastāḥ pramadottamāḥ | śabdāpayata dharmātmā tāścainaṃ ca vavandire || 7.88.16 ||
translation: आश्रमं to the hermitage, समुपागम्य having approached, ततः then, ताः those, प्रमदोत्तमाः excellent women, शब्दापयत called out to, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, ताः they, च and, एनं him, च and, ववन्दिरे bowed down.
explanation: Having approached the hermitage, the righteous Budha then called out to those excellent women, and they, in turn, bowed down to him.

shloka_text: स ताः पप्रच्छ धर्मात्मा कस्यैषा लोकसुन्दरी । किमर्थमागता चैव सर्वमाख्यात मा चिरम् ।। 7.88.17 ।।
transliteration: sa tāḥ papraccha dharmātmā kasyaiṣā lokasundarī | kimarthamāgatā caiva sarvamākhyāta mā ciram || 7.88.17 ||
translation: सः He, ताः them, पप्रच्छ asked, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, कस्य whose, एषा is this, लोकसुन्दरी world-beautiful woman, किमर्थम् for what purpose, आगता has come, च and, एव indeed, सर्वम् everything, आख्यात tell, मा not, चिरम् delay
explanation: The righteous king asked them, "Whose is this most beautiful woman, and for what purpose has she come? Tell me everything without delay."

shloka_text: शुभं तु तस्य तद्वाक्यं मधुरं मधुराक्षरम् । श्रुत्वा स्त्रियश्च ताः सर्वा ऊचुर्मधुरया गिरा ।। 7.88.18 ।।
transliteration: śubhaṃ tu tasya tadvākyaṃ madhuraṃ madhurākṣaram | śrutvā striyaśca tāḥ sarvā ūcurmadhurayā girā || 7.88.18 ||
translation: शुभम् auspicious, तु indeed, तस्य his, तत् that, वाक्यम् speech, मधुरम् sweet, मधुराक्षरम् with sweet words, श्रुत्वा having heard, स्त्रियः women, च and, ताः those, सर्वाः all, ऊचुः spoke, मधुरया with sweet, गिरा voice
explanation: Having heard his auspicious, sweet, and melodious words, all those women replied with a sweet voice.

shloka_text: अस्माकमेषा सुश्रोणी प्रभुत्वे वर्तते सदा । अपतिः काननान्तेषु सहास्माभिश्चरत्यसौ ।। 7.88.19 ।।
transliteration: asmākameṣā suśroṇī prabhutve vartate sadā | apatiḥ kānanānteṣu sahāsmābhiścaratyasau || 7.88.19 ||
translation: अस्माकम् our, एषा this, सुश्रोणी beautiful-hipped woman, प्रभुत्वे in authority, वर्तते is, सदा always, अपतिः without a husband, काननान्तेषु in the forest regions, सह with, अस्माभिः us, चरति wanders, असौ she
explanation: This beautiful-hipped woman is always in authority over us; she wanders in the forest regions without a husband, accompanied by us.

shloka_text: तद्वाक्यमव्यक्तपदं तासां स्त्रीणां निशम्य च । विद्यामावर्तनीं पुण्यामावर्तयत स द्विजः ।। 7.88.20 ।।
transliteration: tadvākyamavyaktapadaṃ tāsāṃ strīṇāṃ niśamya ca | vidyāmāvartanīṃ puṇyāmāvartayata sa dvijaḥ || 7.88.20 ||
translation: तत् that, वाक्यम् speech, अव्यक्तपदम् with unclear words, तासाम् of those, स्त्रीणाम् women, निशम्य having heard, च and, विद्याम् knowledge/spell, आवर्तनीम् that which causes return, पुण्याम् sacred, आवर्तयत recited, सः that, द्विजः brahmin
explanation: Having heard that speech with indistinct words from those women, that brahmin recited the sacred spell that causes return.

shloka_text: सो ऽर्थं विदित्वा सकलं तस्य राज्ञो यथागतम् । सर्वा एव स्त्रियस्ताश्च बभाषे मुनिपुङ्गवः ।। 7.88.21 ।।
transliteration: so 'rthaṃ viditvā sakalaṃ tasya rājño yathāgatam | sarvā eva striyastāśca babhāṣe munipuṅgavaḥ || 7.88.21 ||
translation: सः He, अर्थम् the meaning, विदित्वा having known, सकलम् the entire, तस्य of that, राज्ञः king, यथागतम् as it happened, सर्वाः all, एव indeed, स्त्रियः women, ताः those, च and, बभाषे spoke, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages
explanation: Having understood the entire situation of that king as it had occurred, the foremost among sages then spoke to all those women.

shloka_text: अत्र किम्पुरुषीर्भूत्वा शैलरोधसि वत्स्यथ । आवासस्तु गिरावस्मिञ्छीघ्रमेव विधीयताम् ।। 7.88.22 ।।
transliteration: atra kimpuruṣīrbhūtvā śailarodhasi vatsyatha | āvāsastu girāvasmiñchīghrameva vidhīyatām || 7.88.22 ||
translation: अत्र here, किम्पुरुषीर्भूत्वा becoming Kimpurushis, शैलरोधसि on the mountain slope, वत्स्यथ you shall dwell, आवासस्तु but a dwelling place, गिरावस्मिन् on this mountain, शीघ्रमेव quickly indeed, विधीयताम् let it be arranged.
explanation: You shall dwell here on the mountain slope, becoming Kimpurushis, and a dwelling place on this mountain should be arranged quickly.

shloka_text: मूलपत्रफलैः सर्वा वर्तयिष्यथ नित्यदा । स्त्रियः किम्पुरुषान्नाम भर्तऽन्समुपलप्स्यथ ।। 7.88.23 ।।
transliteration: mūlapatraphalaiḥ sarvā vartayiṣyatha nityadā | striyaḥ kimpuruṣānnāma bharta'nsamupalapsyatha || 7.88.23 ||
translation: मूलपत्रफलैः with roots, leaves, and fruits, सर्वा all (of you), वर्तयिष्यथ you shall sustain yourselves, नित्यदा always, स्त्रियः women, किम्पुरुषान्नाम named Kimpurushas, भर्तऽन् husbands, समुपलप्स्यथ you shall obtain.
explanation: All of you shall always sustain yourselves with roots, leaves, and fruits, and as women, you shall obtain husbands named Kimpurushas.

shloka_text: ताः श्रुत्वा सोमपुत्रस्य वाचं किम्पुरुषीकृताः । उपासाञ्चक्रिरे शैलं वध्वस्ता बहुलास्तदा ।। 7.88.24 ।।
transliteration: tāḥ śrutvā somaputrasya vācaṃ kimpuruṣīkṛtāḥ | upāsāñcakrire śailaṃ vadhvastā bahulāstadā || 7.88.24 ||
translation: ताः those, श्रुत्वा having heard, सोमपुत्रस्य of the son of Soma, वाचं the word, किम्पुरुषीकृताः having been made Kimpurushis, उपासाञ्चक्रिरे they resided near, शैलं the mountain, वध्वस्ता those women, बहुलाः many, तदा then.
explanation: Then, those many women, having been transformed into Kimpurushis upon hearing the words of Budha, the son of Soma, resided near that mountain. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टाशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 88 ।। Thus ends the eighty-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा किम्पुरुषोत्पत्तिं लक्ष्मणो भरतस्तदा । आश्चर्यमिति चाब्रूतामुभौ रामं जनेश्वरम् ।। 7.89.1 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā kimpuruṣotpattiṃ lakṣmaṇo bharatastadā | āścaryamiti cābrūtāmubhau rāmaṃ janeśvaram || 7.89.1 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, किम्पुरुषोत्पत्तिं the origin of the Kimpurushas, लक्ष्मणो Lakshmana, भरतस्तदा and Bharata then, आश्चर्यमिति "this is wonderful" thus, च and, अब्रूताम् they both said, उभौ both, रामं to Rama, जनेश्वरम् the lord of people.
explanation: Having heard the origin of the Kimpurushas, Lakshmana and Bharata then both exclaimed "This is wonderful!" to Rama, the lord of people.
comments: Budha woos the woman Ila, who yields, and they pass the month happily; when Ila turns man again, Budha consoles him that his army perished in a storm and bids him stay a year -- in the ninth month the woman Ila bears Budha a son, Pururavas, while the man Ila lives on under Budha's care, woman one month and man the next.

shloka_text: अथ रामः कथामेतां भूय एव महायशाः । कथयामास धर्मात्मा प्रजापतिसुतस्य वै ।। 7.89.2 ।।
transliteration: atha rāmaḥ kathāmetāṃ bhūya eva mahāyaśāḥ | kathayāmāsa dharmātmā prajāpatisutasya vai || 7.89.2 ||
translation: अथ then, रामः Rama, कथामेतां this story, भूय again, एव indeed, महायशाः the greatly renowned, कथयामास narrated, धर्मात्मा the righteous-souled, प्रजापतिसुतस्य of the son of Prajapati, वै indeed.
explanation: Then, the greatly renowned and righteous-souled Rama indeed narrated this story again, concerning the son of Prajapati.

shloka_text: सर्वास्ता विद्रुता दृष्ट्वा किन्नरीर्ऋषिसत्तमः । उवाच रूपसम्पन्नां तां स्त्रियं प्रहसन्निव ।। 7.89.3 ।।
transliteration: sarvāstā vidrutā dṛṣṭvā kinnarīrṛṣisattamaḥ | uvāca rūpasampannāṃ tāṃ striyaṃ prahasanniva || 7.89.3 ||
translation: सर्वास्ताः all of them, विद्रुताः having fled, दृष्ट्वा having seen, किन्नरीः the Kinnaris, ऋषिसत्तमः the best among sages (Budha), उवाच spoke, रूपसम्पन्नाम् endowed with beauty, ताम् that, स्त्रियम् woman, प्रहसन् इव as if laughing.
explanation: Seeing all the Kinnaris flee, the best among sages, Budha, spoke to that beautiful woman as if laughing.

shloka_text: सोमस्याहं सुदयितः सुतः सुरुचिरानने । भजस्व मां वरारोहे भक्त्या स्निग्धेन चक्षुषा ।। 7.89.4 ।।
transliteration: somasyāhaṃ sudayitaḥ sutaḥ surucirānane | bhajasva māṃ varārohe bhaktyā snigdhena cakṣuṣā || 7.89.4 ||
translation: सोमस्य of Soma, अहम् I, सुदयितः very beloved, सुतः son, सुरुचिरानने O one with a very beautiful face, भजस्व love, माम् me, वरारोहे O beautiful woman, भक्त्या with devotion, स्निग्धेन with loving, चक्षुषा eyes.
explanation: Budha declared himself to be the beloved son of Soma and urged the beautiful woman to love him with devoted and tender eyes.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शून्ये स्वजनवर्जिते । इला सुरुचिरप्रख्यं प्रत्युवाच महाग्रहम् ।। 7.89.5 ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śūnye svajanavarjite | ilā suruciraprakhyaṃ pratyuvāca mahāgraham || 7.89.5 ||
translation: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, शून्ये in the desolate place, स्वजनवर्जिते devoid of her own people, इला Ila, सुरुचिरप्रख्यम् to the very radiant one, प्रत्युवाच replied, महाग्रहम् to the great planet (Budha).
explanation: Hearing his words in that desolate place, devoid of her own people, Ila replied to the radiant Budha, the great planet.

shloka_text: अहं कामचरी सौम्य तवास्मि वशवर्तिनी । प्रशाधि मां सोमसुत यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु ।। 7.89.6 ।।
transliteration: ahaṃ kāmacarī saumya tavāsmi vaśavartinī | praśādhi māṃ somasuta yathecchasi tathā kuru || 7.89.6 ||
translation: अहम् I, कामचरी moving at will, सौम्य O gentle one, तव your, अस्मि am, वशवर्तिनी obedient, प्रशाधि command, माम् me, सोमसुत O son of Soma, यथा as, इच्छसि you wish, तथा so, कुरु do.
explanation: Ila declared herself to be free-willed but now submissive to him, asking the gentle son of Soma to command her and do as he pleased.

shloka_text: तस्यास्तदद्भुतप्रख्यं श्रुत्वा हर्षमुपागतः । स वै कामी सह तया रेमे चन्द्रमसः सुतः ।। 7.89.7 ।।
transliteration: tasyāstadadbhutaprakhyaṃ śrutvā harṣamupāgataḥ | sa vai kāmī saha tayā reme candramasaḥ sutaḥ || 7.89.7 ||
translation: तस्याः her, तत् that, अद्भुतप्रख्यम् wonderful (speech), श्रुत्वा having heard, हर्षम् joy, उपागतः attained, सः he, वै indeed, कामी desirous, सह with, तया her, रेमे enjoyed, चन्द्रमसः of the Moon, सुतः son.
explanation: Hearing her wonderful words, the son of the Moon, filled with desire, indeed rejoiced and enjoyed himself with her.

shloka_text: बुधस्य माधवो मासस्तामिलां रुचिराननाम् । गतो रमयतो ऽत्यर्थं क्षणवत्तस्य कामिनः ।। 7.89.8 ।।
transliteration: budhasya mādhavo māsastāmilāṃ rucirānanām | gato ramayato 'tyarthaṃ kṣaṇavattasya kāminaḥ || 7.89.8 ||
translation: बुधस्य of Budha, माधवः Madhava, मासः month, तामिलाम् Tamila, रुचिराननाम् with a beautiful face, गतः passed, रमयतः while enjoying, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, क्षणवत् like a moment, तस्य for him, कामिनः the lustful one.
explanation: For Budha, the lustful one, the month of Madhava passed like a moment while he was exceedingly enjoying with Tamila of the beautiful face.

shloka_text: अथ मासे तु सम्पूर्णे पूर्णेन्दुसदृशाननः । प्रजापतिसुतः श्रीमाञ्छयने प्रत्यबुध्यत ।। 7.89.9 ।।
transliteration: atha māse tu sampūrṇe pūrṇendusadṛśānanaḥ | prajāpatisutaḥ śrīmāñchayane pratyabudhyata || 7.89.9 ||
translation: अथ Then, मासे when the month, तु indeed, सम्पूर्णे was complete, पूर्णेन्दुसदृशाननः whose face was like the full moon, प्रजापतिसुतः the son of Prajapati, श्रीमान् the glorious one, शयने on his bed, प्रत्यबुध्यत awoke.
explanation: Then, when the month was complete, the glorious son of Prajapati, whose face was like the full moon, awoke on his bed.

shloka_text: सो ऽपश्यत्सोमजं तत्र तपन्तं सलिलाशये । ऊर्ध्वबाहुं निरालम्बं तं राजा प्रत्यभाषत ।। 7.89.10 ।।
transliteration: so 'paśyatsomajaṃ tatra tapantaṃ salilāśaye | ūrdhvabāhuṃ nirālambaṃ taṃ rājā pratyabhāṣata || 7.89.10 ||
translation: सः He, अपश्यत् saw, सोमजम् the son of Soma, तत्र there, तपन्तम् performing penance, सलिलाशये in the water reservoir, ऊर्ध्वबाहुम् with raised arms, निरालम्बम् without support, तम् to him, राजा the king, प्रत्यभाषत spoke in return.
explanation: The king (Pururavas) saw Budha, the son of Soma, performing severe penance there in the water, with his arms raised and without support, and then the king spoke to him.

shloka_text: भगवन्पर्वतं दुर्गं प्रविष्टो ऽस्मि सहानुगः । न च पश्यामि तत्सैन्यं क्व नु ते मामका गताः ।। 7.89.11 ।।
transliteration: bhagavanparvataṃ durgaṃ praviṣṭo 'smi sahānugaḥ | na ca paśyāmi tatsainyaṃ kva nu te māmakā gatāḥ || 7.89.11 ||
translation: भगवन् O venerable one!, पर्वतम् mountain, दुर्गम् difficult to access, प्रविष्टः entered, अस्मि I am, सहानुगः with my followers, न not, च and, पश्यामि I see, तत् that, सैन्यम् army, क्व where, नु indeed, ते those, मामकाः my people, गताः gone.
explanation: The king addressed Budha, saying, "O venerable one, I entered this difficult mountain with my followers, but I do not see my army; where have my people gone?"

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा तस्य राजर्षेर्नष्टसञ्ज्ञस्य भाषितम् । प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यं सान्त्वयन्परया गिरा ।। 7.89.12 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā tasya rājarṣernaṣṭasañjñasya bhāṣitam | pratyuvāca śubhaṃ vākyaṃ sāntvayanparayā girā || 7.89.12 ||
translation: तत् That, श्रुत्वा having heard, तस्य his, राजर्षेः of the royal sage, नष्टसञ्ज्ञस्य whose consciousness was lost, भाषितम् speech, प्रत्युवाच replied, शुभम् auspicious, वाक्यम् words, सान्त्वयन् consoling, परया with supreme, गिरा voice.
explanation: Having heard the bewildered words of that royal sage, Budha replied with auspicious words, consoling him with a supreme voice.

shloka_text: अश्मवर्षेण महता भृत्यास्ते विनिपातिताः । त्वं चाश्रमपदे सुप्तो वातवर्षभयार्दितः ।। 7.89.13 ।।
transliteration: aśmavarṣeṇa mahatā bhṛtyāste vinipātitāḥ | tvaṃ cāśramapade supto vātavarṣabhayārditaḥ || 7.89.13 ||
translation: अश्मवर्षेण by a shower of stones, महता great, भृत्याः servants, ते your, विनिपातिताः were killed, त्वं you, च and, आश्रमपदे in the hermitage, सुप्तः sleeping, वातवर्षभयार्दितः afflicted by the fear of wind and rain.
explanation: Your servants were killed by a great shower of stones, and you were sleeping in the hermitage, afflicted by the fear of wind and rain.

shloka_text: समाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते निर्भयो विगतज्वरः । फलमूलाशनो वीर निवसेह यथासुखम् ।। 7.89.14 ।।
transliteration: samāśvasihi bhadraṃ te nirbhayo vigatajvaraḥ | phalamūlāśano vīra nivaseha yathāsukham || 7.89.14 ||
translation: समाश्वसिहि be comforted, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, निर्भयः fearless, विगतज्वरः free from anxiety, फलमूलाशनः one who eats fruits and roots, वीर O hero, निवस reside, इह here, यथासुखम् as comfortably as possible.
explanation: Be comforted, may good fortune be with you; O hero, reside here fearlessly and free from anxiety, subsisting on fruits and roots as comfortably as you wish.

shloka_text: स राजा तेन वाक्येन प्रत्याश्वस्तो महामतिः । प्रत्युवाच ततो वाक्यं दीनो भृत्यक्षयाद् भृशम् ।। 7.89.15 ।।
transliteration: sa rājā tena vākyena pratyāśvasto mahāmatiḥ | pratyuvāca tato vākyaṃ dīno bhṛtyakṣayād bhṛśam || 7.89.15 ||
translation: सः that, राजा king, तेन by that, वाक्येन word, प्रत्याश्वस्तः reassured, महामतिः great-minded, प्रत्युवाच replied, ततः then, वाक्यं words, दीनः distressed, भृत्यक्षयात् due to the destruction of servants, भृशम् greatly.
explanation: That great-minded king, though reassured by those words, then replied with great distress due to the loss of his servants.

shloka_text: त्यक्ष्याम्यहं स्वकं राज्यं नाहं भृत्यैर्विनाकृतः । वर्तयेयं क्षणं ब्रह्मन्समनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ।। 7.89.16 ।।
transliteration: tyakṣyāmyahaṃ svakaṃ rājyaṃ nāhaṃ bhṛtyairvinākṛtaḥ | vartayeyaṃ kṣaṇaṃ brahmansamanujñātumarhasi || 7.89.16 ||
translation: त्यक्ष्यामि I will abandon, अहं I, स्वकं my own, राज्यं kingdom, न not, अहं I, भृत्यैः by servants, विनाकृतः deprived of, वर्तयेयं I can live, क्षणं for a moment, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, समनुज्ञातुम् to permit, अर्हसि you ought.
explanation: O Brahmana, I will abandon my own kingdom, for I cannot live even for a moment without my servants; you ought to permit me to do so.

shloka_text: सुतो धर्मपरो ब्रह्मञ्ज्येष्ठो मम महायशाः । शशबिन्दुरिति ख्यातः स मे राज्यं प्रपत्स्यते ।। 7.89.17 ।।
transliteration: suto dharmaparo brahmañjyeṣṭho mama mahāyaśāḥ | śaśabinduriti khyātaḥ sa me rājyaṃ prapatsyate || 7.89.17 ||
translation: सुतः son, धर्मपरः devoted to dharma, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, ज्येष्ठः eldest, मम my, महायशाः very famous, शशबिन्दुः Shashabindu, इति thus, ख्यातः known, सः he, मे my, राज्यं kingdom, प्रपत्स्यते will obtain.
explanation: O Brahmana, my eldest son, who is devoted to righteousness and very famous by the name Shashabindu, will succeed to my kingdom.

shloka_text: न हि शक्ष्याम्यहं हित्वा भृत्यदारान्सुखान्वितान् । प्रतिवक्तुं महातेजः किञ्चिदप्यशुभं वचः ।। 7.89.18 ।।
transliteration: na hi śakṣyāmyahaṃ hitvā bhṛtyadārānsukhānvitān | prativaktuṃ mahātejaḥ kiñcidapyaśubhaṃ vacaḥ || 7.89.18 ||
translation: न not, हि indeed, शक्ष्यामि I am able, अहं I, हित्वा having abandoned, भृत्यदारान् servants and wives, सुखान्वितान् comfortable, प्रतिवक्तुं to reply, महातेजः O greatly effulgent one, किञ्चिदपि even a little, अशुभं inauspicious, वचः word.
explanation: O greatly effulgent one, I am indeed unable to utter even a single inauspicious word in reply, having abandoned my comfortable servants and wives.

shloka_text: तथा ब्रुवति राजेन्द्रे बुधः परममद्भुतम् । सान्त्वपूर्वमथोवाच वासस्त इह रोचताम् ।। 7.89.19 ।।
transliteration: tathā bruvati rājendre budhaḥ paramamadbhutam | sāntvapūrvamathovāca vāsasta iha rocatām || 7.89.19 ||
translation: तथा thus, ब्रुवति while speaking, राजेन्द्रे by the king of kings, बुधः Budha, परमम् exceedingly, अद्भुतम् wonderful, सान्त्वपूर्वम् consolingly, अथ then, उवाच spoke, वासः dwelling, त to you, इह here, रोचताम् may it be pleasing.
explanation: As the king of kings spoke thus, Budha, in an exceedingly wonderful and consoling manner, then said, "May your dwelling here be pleasing to you."

shloka_text: न सन्तापस्त्वया कार्यः कार्दमेय महाबल । संवत्सरोषितस्येह कारयिष्यामि ते हितम् ।। 7.89.20 ।।
transliteration: na santāpastvayā kāryaḥ kārdameya mahābala | saṃvatsaroṣitasyeha kārayiṣyāmi te hitam || 7.89.20 ||
translation: न not, सन्तापः sorrow, त्वया by you, कार्यः to be caused, कार्दमेय O son of Kardama, महाबल O mighty one, संवत्सरोषितस्य of one who has resided for a year, इह here, कारयिष्यामि I shall cause to be done, ते for you, हितम् welfare.
explanation: O mighty son of Kardama, you should not feel any sorrow, for I shall ensure your well-being here after you have resided for a year.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा बुधस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः । वासाय विदधे बुद्धिं यदुक्तं ब्रह्मवादिना ।। 7.89.21 ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā budhasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ | vāsāya vidadhe buddhiṃ yaduktaṃ brahmavādinā || 7.89.21 ||
translation: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, बुधस्य of Budha, अक्लिष्टकर्मणः of untiring action, वासाय for dwelling, विदधे he resolved, बुद्धिं mind, यत् which, उक्तं was spoken, ब्रह्मवादिना by the speaker of Brahman.
explanation: Having heard that word from Budha, whose deeds were untiring and who spoke of Brahman, Ila resolved in his mind to dwell there as instructed.

shloka_text: मासं स स्त्री तदा भूत्वा रमयत्यनिशं शुदा । मासं पुरुषभावेन धर्मबुद्धिं चकार सः ।। 7.89.22 ।।
transliteration: māsaṃ sa strī tadā bhūtvā ramayatyaniśaṃ śudā | māsaṃ puruṣabhāvena dharmabuddhiṃ cakāra saḥ || 7.89.22 ||
translation: मासं for a month, स he, स्त्री a woman, तदा then, भूत्वा having become, रमयत्य he delighted, अनिशं constantly, शुदा happily, मासं for a month, पुरुषभावेन in the state of a man, धर्मबुद्धिं righteous intention, चकार he made, सः he.
explanation: For one month, he became a woman and constantly delighted happily, and for the next month, he assumed the state of a man and focused his mind on righteousness.

shloka_text: ततः सा नवमे मासि इला सोमसुतात्सुतम् । जनयामास सुश्रोणी पुरूरवसमूर्जितम् ।। 7.89.23 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sā navame māsi ilā somasutātsutam | janayāmāsa suśroṇī purūravasamūrjitam || 7.89.23 ||
translation: ततः then, सा she, नवमे in the ninth, मासि month, इला Ila, सोमसुतात् from the son of Soma (Budha), सुतम् a son, जनयामास gave birth, सुश्रोणी (she) of beautiful hips, पुरूरवसम् Pururavas, ऊर्जितम् mighty.
explanation: Then, in the ninth month, Ila, who had beautiful hips, gave birth to a mighty son named Pururavas from Budha, the son of Soma.

shloka_text: जातमात्रं तु सुश्रोणी पितुर्हस्ते न्यवेशयत् । बुधस्य समवर्णभमिला पुत्रं महाबलम् ।। 7.89.24 ।।
transliteration: jātamātraṃ tu suśroṇī piturhaste nyaveśayat | budhasya samavarṇabhamilā putraṃ mahābalam || 7.89.24 ||
translation: जातमात्रं as soon as born, तु indeed, सुश्रोणी (she) of beautiful hips (Ila), पितुः of the father, हस्ते in the hand, न्यवेशयत् placed, बुधस्य of Budha, समवर्णभम् having a similar complexion, इला Ila, पुत्रं the son, महाबलम् very powerful.
explanation: As soon as the very powerful son, who resembled Budha in complexion, was born, Ila of beautiful hips placed him in his father Budha's hand.

shloka_text: बुधस्तु पुरुषीभूतं स वै संवत्सरान्तरम् । कथाभी रमयामास धर्मयुक्ताभिरात्मवान् ।। 7.89.25 ।।
transliteration: budhastu puruṣībhūtaṃ sa vai saṃvatsarāntaram | kathābhī ramayāmāsa dharmayuktābhirātmavān || 7.89.25 ||
translation: बुधः Budha, तु but, पुरुषीभूतं having become a man (Ila), सः he, वै indeed, संवत्सरान्तरम् after a year, कथाभी with stories, रमयामास entertained, धर्मयुक्ताभिः righteous, आत्मवान् the wise one.
explanation: But the wise Budha, after a year, entertained Ila, who had become a man again, with righteous stories. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोननवतितमः सर्गः ।। 89 ।। Thus ends the eighty-ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तथोक्तवति रामे तु तस्य जन्म तदद्भुतम् । उवाच लक्ष्मणो भूयो भरतश्च महायशाः ।। 7.90.1 ।।
transliteration: tathoktavati rāme tu tasya janma tadadbhutam | uvāca lakṣmaṇo bhūyo bharataśca mahāyaśāḥ || 7.90.1 ||
translation: तथा thus, उक्तवति having spoken, रामे Rama, तु but, तस्य his (Pururavas's), जन्म birth, तत् that, अद्भुतम् wonderful, उवाच spoke, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, भूयः again, भरतः Bharata, च and, महायशाः highly renowned.
explanation: When Rama had thus spoken about that wonderful birth of Pururavas, Lakshmana and the highly renowned Bharata spoke again.
comments: Asked what became of Ila, Rama tells how Budha gathered the sages, Kardama among them, who for Ila's sake perform an Ashvamedha to Rudra -- pleased, Shiva restores Ila to permanent manhood; Ila founds Pratishthana and rules, Shashabindu takes Bahli, and Pururavas succeeds him -- such, says Rama, is the power of the horse-sacrifice.

shloka_text: इला सा सोमपुत्रस्य संवत्सरमथोषिता । अकरोत्किं नरश्रेष्ठ तत्त्वं शंसितुमर्हसि ।। 7.90.2 ।।
transliteration: ilā sā somaputrasya saṃvatsaramathoṣitā | akarotkiṃ naraśreṣṭha tattvaṃ śaṃsitumarhasi || 7.90.2 ||
translation: इला Ila, सा she, सोमपुत्रस्य of the son of Soma (Budha), संवत्सरम् for a year, अथ then, उषिता having resided, अकरोत् did, किं what, नरश्रेष्ठ O best of men, तत्त्वं the truth, शंसितुम् to tell, अर्हसि you ought.
explanation: O best of men, you ought to tell us the truth about what Ila did after she resided with Budha, the son of Soma, for a year.

shloka_text: तयोस्तद्वाक्यमाधुर्यं निशम्य परिपृच्छतोः । रामः पुनरुवाचेमां प्रजापतिसुते कथाम् ।। 7.90.3 ।।
transliteration: tayostadvākyamādhuryaṃ niśamya paripṛcchatoḥ | rāmaḥ punaruvācemāṃ prajāpatisute kathām || 7.90.3 ||
translation: tayoḥ of those two, tat that, vākyamādhuryam sweetness of speech, niśamya having heard, paripṛcchatoḥ who were asking, rāmaḥ Rama, punar again, uvāca said, imām this, prajāpatisute O daughter of Prajapati, kathām story.
explanation: Having heard the sweet words of those two who were questioning, Rama again told this story, O daughter of Prajapati.

shloka_text: पुरुषत्वं गते शूरे बुधः परमबुद्धिमान् । संवर्तं परमोदारमाजुहाव महायशाः ।। 7.90.4 ।।
transliteration: puruṣatvaṃ gate śūre budhaḥ paramabuddhimān | saṃvartaṃ paramodāramājuhāva mahāyaśāḥ || 7.90.4 ||
translation: puruṣatvam manhood, gate having attained, śūre the brave one, budhaḥ Budha, paramabuddhimān extremely intelligent, saṃvartam Samvarta, paramodāram extremely generous, ājuhāva invited, mahāyaśāḥ highly renowned.
explanation: When the brave one (Ila/Sudyumna) attained manhood, the highly renowned and extremely intelligent Budha invited the exceedingly generous sage Samvarta.

shloka_text: च्यवनं भृगुपुत्रं च मुनिं चारिष्टनेमिनम् । प्रमोदनं मोदकरं ततो दुर्वाससं मुनिम् ।। 7.90.5 ।।
transliteration: cyavanaṃ bhṛguputraṃ ca muniṃ cāriṣṭaneminam | pramodanaṃ modakaraṃ tato durvāsasaṃ munim || 7.90.5 ||
translation: cyavanam Chyavana, bhṛguputram son of Bhrigu, ca and, munim sage, ca and, ariṣṭaneminam Arishtanemi, pramodanam Pramodana, modakaram who causes joy, tataḥ then, durvāsasam Durvasas, munim sage.
explanation: He also invited Chyavana, the son of Bhrigu, the sage Arishtanemi, Pramodana who brings joy, and then the sage Durvasas.

shloka_text: एतान्सर्वान्समानीय वाक्यज्ञस्तत्त्वदर्शनः । उवाच सर्वान्सुहृदो धैर्येण सुसमाहितान् ।। 7.90.6 ।।
transliteration: etānsarvānsamānīya vākyajñastattvadarśanaḥ | uvāca sarvānsuhṛdo dhairyeṇa susamāhitān || 7.90.6 ||
translation: etān these, sarvān all, samānīya having gathered, vākyajñaḥ one who knows speech, tattvadarśanaḥ one who sees the truth, uvāca said, sarvān to all, suhṛdaḥ friends, dhairyeṇa with patience, susamāhitān well-composed.
explanation: Having gathered all these, the eloquent and perceptive Budha spoke to all his well-composed friends with patience.

shloka_text: अयं राजा महाबाहुः कर्दमस्य इलः सुतः । जानीतैनं यथाभूतं श्रेयो ह्यत्र विधीयताम् ।। 7.90.7 ।।
transliteration: ayaṃ rājā mahābāhuḥ kardamasya ilaḥ sutaḥ | jānītainaṃ yathābhūtaṃ śreyo hyatra vidhīyatām || 7.90.7 ||
translation: ayam this, rājā king, mahābāhuḥ mighty-armed, kardamasya of Kardama, ilaḥ Ila, sutaḥ son, jānīta know, enam him, yathābhūtam as he truly is, śreyaḥ welfare, hi indeed, atra in this matter, vidhīyatām let it be done.
explanation: He said, "This mighty-armed king, Ila, is the son of Kardama; know him as he truly is, and indeed, let his welfare be ensured in this matter."

shloka_text: तेषां संवदतामेव तमाश्रममुपागमत् । कर्दमस्तु महातेजा द्विजैः सह महात्मभिः ।। 7.90.8 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ saṃvadatāmeva tamāśramamupāgamat | kardamastu mahātejā dvijaiḥ saha mahātmabhiḥ || 7.90.8 ||
translation: तेषां of them, संवदताम् conversing, एव just, तम् that, आश्रमम् hermitage, उपागमत् approached, कर्दमः Kardama, तु and, महातेजाः highly effulgent, द्विजैः with brahmins, सह together with, महात्मभिः great-souled ones
explanation: Just as they were conversing, the greatly refulgent Kardama approached that hermitage along with other great-souled brahmins.

shloka_text: पुलस्त्यश्च क्रतुश्चैव वषट्कारस्तथैव च । ओङ्कारश्च महातेजास्तमाश्रममुपागमत् ।। 7.90.9 ।।
transliteration: pulastyaśca kratuścaiva vaṣaṭkārastathaiva ca | oṅkāraśca mahātejāstamāśramamupāgamat || 7.90.9 ||
translation: पुलस्त्यः Pulastya, च and, क्रतुः Kratu, च and, एव indeed, वषट्कारः Vaṣaṭkāra, तथा similarly, एव indeed, च and, ओङ्कारः Oṅkāra, च and, महातेजाः highly effulgent, तम् that, आश्रमम् hermitage, उपागमत् approached
explanation: Pulastya, Kratu, Vaṣaṭkāra, and the greatly effulgent Oṅkāra also similarly approached that hermitage.

shloka_text: ते सर्वे हृष्टमनसः परस्परसमागमे । हितैषिणो बाल्हिपतेः पृथग्वाक्यान्यथाब्रुवन् ।। 7.90.10 ।।
transliteration: te sarve hṛṣṭamanasaḥ parasparasamāgame | hitaiṣiṇo bālhipateḥ pṛthagvākyānyathābruvan || 7.90.10 ||
translation: ते they, सर्वे all, हृष्टमनसः with joyful minds, परस्परसमागमे at their mutual meeting, हितैषिणः well-wishers, बाल्हिपतेः of the king of Bālhika, पृथक् separately, वाक्यानि words, अथ then, अब्रुवन् spoke
explanation: All of them, delighted at their mutual meeting and being well-wishers of the king of Bālhika, then spoke different words.

shloka_text: कर्दमस्त्वब्रवीद्वाक्यं सुतार्थं परमं हितम् । द्विजाः शृणुत मद्वाक्यं यच्छ्रेयः पार्थिवस्य हि ।। 7.90.11 ।।
transliteration: kardamastvabravīdvākyaṃ sutārthaṃ paramaṃ hitam | dvijāḥ śṛṇuta madvākyaṃ yacchreyaḥ pārthivasya hi || 7.90.11 ||
translation: कर्दमः Kardama, तु and, अब्रवीत् spoke, वाक्यम् words, सुतार्थम् for the sake of a son, परमम् supreme, हितम् beneficial, द्विजाः O brahmins, शृणुत listen, मद्वाक्यम् my words, यत् which, श्रेयः welfare, पार्थिवस्य of the king, हि indeed
explanation: Kardama then spoke words that were supremely beneficial for the sake of a son, saying, "O brahmins, listen to my words which are indeed for the welfare of the king."

shloka_text: नान्यं पश्यामि भैषज्यमन्तरा वृषभध्वजम् । नाश्वमेधात्परो यज्ञः प्रियश्चैव महात्मनः । तस्माद्यजामहे सर्वे पार्थिवार्थे दुरासदम् ।। 7.90.12 ।।
transliteration: nānyaṃ paśyāmi bhaiṣajyamantarā vṛṣabhadhvajam | nāśvamedhātparo yajñaḥ priyaścaiva mahātmanaḥ | tasmādyajāmahe sarve pārthivārthe durāsadam || 7.90.12 ||
translation: न not, अन्यम् other, पश्यामि I see, भैषज्यम् remedy, अन्तरा without, वृषभध्वजम् Lord Shiva, न not, अश्वमेधात् than the Ashvamedha sacrifice, परः superior, यज्ञः sacrifice, प्रियः dear, च and, एव indeed, महात्मनः to the great-souled one, तस्मात् therefore, यजामहे let us sacrifice, सर्वे all, पार्थिवार्थे for the sake of the king, दुरासदम् formidable
explanation: I see no other remedy except Lord Shiva, and there is no sacrifice superior to the Ashvamedha, which is indeed dear to the great-souled one; therefore, let us all perform the formidable Ashvamedha sacrifice for the sake of the king.

shloka_text: कर्दमेनैवमुक्तास्तु सर्व एव द्विजर्षभाः । रोचयन्ति स्म तं यज्ञं रुद्रस्याराधनं प्रति ।। 7.90.13 ।।
transliteration: kardamenaivamuktāstu sarva eva dvijarṣabhāḥ | rocayanti sma taṃ yajñaṃ rudrasyārādhanaṃ prati || 7.90.13 ||
translation: कर्दमेनैव by Kardama thus, उक्ताः spoken, तु indeed, सर्वे all, एव indeed, द्विजर्षभाः best among Brahmins, रोचयन्ति स्म approved, तम् that, यज्ञम् sacrifice, रुद्रस्य of Rudra, आराधनम् worship, प्रति for.
explanation: All the eminent Brahmins, thus addressed by Kardama, approved of that sacrifice intended for the worship of Rudra.

shloka_text: संवर्तस्य तु राजर्षेः शिष्यः पुरपुरञ्जयः । मरुत्त इति विख्यातस्तं यज्ञं समुपाहरत् ।। 7.90.14 ।।
transliteration: saṃvartasya tu rājarṣeḥ śiṣyaḥ purapurañjayaḥ | marutta iti vikhyātastaṃ yajñaṃ samupāharat || 7.90.14 ||
translation: संवर्तस्य of Samvarta, तु indeed, राजर्षेः of the royal sage, शिष्यः disciple, पुरपुरञ्जयः conqueror of cities, मरुत्तः Marutta, इति thus, विख्यातः renowned, तम् that, यज्ञम् sacrifice, समुपाहरत् performed.
explanation: The renowned Marutta, a disciple of the royal sage Samvarta and a conqueror of cities, then performed that sacrifice.

shloka_text: ततो यज्ञो महानासीद्बुधाश्रमसमीपतः । रुद्रश्च परमं तोषमाजगाम महायशाः ।। 7.90.15 ।।
transliteration: tato yajño mahānāsīdbudhāśramasamīpataḥ | rudraśca paramaṃ toṣamājagāma mahāyaśāḥ || 7.90.15 ||
translation: ततः then, यज्ञः sacrifice, महान् great, आसीत् was, बुधाश्रमसमीपतः near Budha's hermitage, रुद्रः Rudra, च and, परमम् supreme, तोषम् satisfaction, आजगाम attained, महायशाः highly renowned.
explanation: A great sacrifice then took place near Budha's hermitage, and the highly renowned Rudra attained supreme satisfaction.

shloka_text: अथ यज्ञे समाप्ते तु प्रीतः परमया मुदा । उमापतिर्द्विजान्सर्वानुवाच इलसन्निधौ ।। 7.90.16 ।।
transliteration: atha yajñe samāpte tu prītaḥ paramayā mudā | umāpatirdvijānsarvānuvāca ilasannidhau || 7.90.16 ||
translation: अथ then, यज्ञे समाप्ते when the sacrifice was concluded, उमापतिः the lord of Uma, प्रीतः pleased, परमया मुदा with supreme joy, इलसन्निधौ in Ila's presence, सर्वान् द्विजान् all the brahmins, उवाच addressed.
explanation: Then, when the sacrifice was concluded, the lord of Uma, pleased and filled with supreme joy, addressed all the brahmins there in Ila's presence.

shloka_text: प्रीतो ऽस्मि हयमेधेन भक्त्या च द्विजसत्तमाः । अस्य बाह्लिपतेश्चैव किं करोमि प्रियं शुभम् ।। 7.90.17 ।।
transliteration: prīto 'smi hayamedhena bhaktyā ca dvijasattamāḥ | asya bāhlipateścaiva kiṃ karomi priyaṃ śubham || 7.90.17 ||
translation: प्रीतः pleased, अस्मि I am, हयमेधेन by the horse sacrifice, भक्त्या by devotion, च and, द्विजसत्तमाः O best among Brahmins, अस्य of this, बाह्लिपतेः of the lord of Bahlika, च and, एव indeed, किम् what, करोमि shall I do, प्रियम् pleasing, शुभम् auspicious.
explanation: Rudra declared, "O best among Brahmins, I am pleased by this horse sacrifice and by your devotion; what pleasing and auspicious thing shall I do for this lord of Bahlika?"

shloka_text: तथा वदति देवेशे द्विजास्ते सुसमाहिताः । प्रसादयन्ति देवेशं यथा स्यात्पुरुषस्त्विला ।। 7.90.18 ।।
transliteration: tathā vadati deveśe dvijāste susamāhitāḥ | prasādayanti deveśaṃ yathā syātpuruṣastvilā || 7.90.18 ||
translation: तथा thus, वदति speaking, देवेशे when the lord of gods, द्विजाः Brahmins, ते those, सुसमाहिताः well-composed, प्रसादयन्ति propitiated, देवेशम् the lord of gods, यथा so that, स्यात् may become, पुरुषः a man, तु indeed, इला Ila.
explanation: When the lord of gods spoke thus, those attentive Brahmins propitiated him so that Ila might indeed become a man again.

shloka_text: ततः प्रीतो महादेवः पुरुषत्वं ददौ पुनः । इलायै सुमहातेजा दत्त्वा चान्तरधीयत ।। 7.90.19 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ prīto mahādevaḥ puruṣatvaṃ dadau punaḥ | ilāyai sumahātejā dattvā cāntaradhīyata || 7.90.19 ||
translation: ततः then, प्रीतो pleased, महादेवः Mahadeva, पुरुषत्वं manhood, ददौ gave, पुनः again, इलायै to Ila, सुमहातेजा of great splendor, दत्त्वा having given, च and, अन्तरधीयत disappeared.
explanation: Then, the greatly effulgent Mahadeva, being pleased, restored Ila to manhood, and having done so, he disappeared.

shloka_text: निवृत्ते हयमेधे च गतश्चादर्शनं हरः । यथागतं द्विजाः सर्वे ह्यगच्छन्दीर्घदर्शिनः ।। 7.90.20 ।।
transliteration: nivṛtte hayamedhe ca gataścādarśanaṃ haraḥ | yathāgataṃ dvijāḥ sarve hyagacchandīrghadarśinaḥ || 7.90.20 ||
translation: निवृत्ते having concluded, हयमेधे the horse sacrifice, च and, गतश्च went and, अदर्शनं out of sight, हरः Hara, यथागतं as they had come, द्विजाः Brahmins, सर्वे all, हि indeed, अगच्छन् went, दीर्घदर्शिनः far-sighted ones.
explanation: After the horse sacrifice was concluded, Hara disappeared, and all the wise Brahmins returned to their respective places as they had come.

shloka_text: राजा तु बाह्लिमुत्सृज्य मध्यदेशे ह्यनुत्तमम् । निवेशयामास पुरं प्रतिष्ठानं यशस्करम् ।। 7.90.21 ।।
transliteration: rājā tu bāhlimutsṛjya madhyadeśe hyanuttamam | niveśayāmāsa puraṃ pratiṣṭhānaṃ yaśaskaram || 7.90.21 ||
translation: राजा the king, तु but, बाह्लिम् Bahli, उत्सृज्य having abandoned, मध्यदेशे in the central region, हि indeed, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, निवेशयामास established, पुरं a city, प्रतिष्ठानं Pratishthana, यशस्करम् glorious.
explanation: But the king, having left Bahli, established the glorious and unsurpassed city of Pratishthana in the central region.

shloka_text: शशबिन्दुश्च राजर्षिर्बाह्लिं पुरपुरञ्जयः । प्रतिष्ठाने इलो राजा प्रजापतिसुतो बली ।। 7.90.22 ।।
transliteration: śaśabinduśca rājarṣirbāhliṃ purapurañjayaḥ | pratiṣṭhāne ilo rājā prajāpatisuto balī || 7.90.22 ||
translation: शशबिन्दुः Shashabindu, च and, राजर्षिः royal sage, बाह्लिम् Bahli, पुरपुरञ्जयः conqueror of cities, प्रतिष्ठाने in Pratishthana, इलः Ila, राजा king, प्रजापतिसुतः son of Prajapati, बली powerful.
explanation: The royal sage Shashabindu, a conqueror of cities, ruled Bahli, while the powerful King Ila, son of Prajapati, ruled in Pratishthana.

shloka_text: स काले प्राप्तवाँल्लोकमिलो ब्राह्ममनुत्तमम् । ऐलः पुरूरवा राजा प्रतिष्ठानमवाप्तवान् ।। 7.90.23 ।।
transliteration: sa kāle prāptavāँllokamilo brāhmamanuttamam | ailaḥ purūravā rājā pratiṣṭhānamavāptavān || 7.90.23 ||
translation: सः he, काले in time, प्राप्तवान् attained, लोकम् world, इलः Ila, ब्राह्मम् of Brahma, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, ऐलः Aila, पुरूरवा Pururava, राजा king, प्रतिष्ठानम् Pratishthana, अवाप्तवान् obtained.
explanation: In due course, King Ila attained the unsurpassed divine realm of Brahma, and his son, King Pururava Aila, then obtained Pratishthana.

shloka_text: ईदृशो ह्यश्वमेधस्य प्रभावः पुरुषर्षभौ । स्त्रीभूतः पौरुषं लेभे यच्चान्यदपि दुर्लभम् ।। 7.90.24 ।।
transliteration: īdṛśo hyaśvamedhasya prabhāvaḥ puruṣarṣabhau | strībhūtaḥ pauruṣaṃ lebhe yaccānyadapi durlabham || 7.90.24 ||
translation: ईदृशः such, हि indeed, अश्वमेधस्य of the Ashwamedha sacrifice, प्रभावः power, पुरुषर्षभौ O best among men, स्त्रीभूतः having become a woman, पौरुषं manhood, लेभे obtained, यत् च and what, अन्यत् अपि other also, दुर्लभम् difficult to obtain.
explanation: Indeed, such is the power of the Ashwamedha sacrifice, O best among men, that one who had become a woman regained manhood and obtained other things that are difficult to achieve. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे नवतितमः सर्गः ।। 90 ।। Thus ends the ninetieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एतदाख्याय काकुत्स्थो भ्रातृभ्याममितप्रभः । लक्ष्मणं पुनरेवाह धर्मयुक्तमिदं वचः ।। 7.91.1 ।।
transliteration: etadākhyāya kākutstho bhrātṛbhyāmamitaprabhaḥ | lakṣmaṇaṃ punarevāha dharmayuktamidaṃ vacaḥ || 7.91.1 ||
translation: एतत् आख्याय having narrated this, काकुत्स्थः Rama, भ्रातृभ्याम् to his two brothers, अमितप्रभः of immeasurable splendor, लक्ष्मणं to Lakshmana, पुनः एव आह again indeed said, धर्मयुक्तम् इदं righteous this, वचः word.
explanation: Having narrated this, Rama of immeasurable splendor then again spoke these righteous words to Lakshmana in the presence of his brothers.
comments: Resolved on the Ashvamedha, Rama has the brahmins ordain it and a horse of auspicious marks released, and bids Lakshmana invite Sugriva and the monkeys, Vibhishana and the rakshasas, the allied kings, sages and entertainers -- a vast sacrificial ground is prepared in the Naimisha forest by the Gomati, with Bharata leading ahead the supplies, treasure, retinue and the queen-mothers.

shloka_text: वसिष्ठं वामदेवं च जाबालिमथ कश्यपम् । द्विजांश्च सर्वप्रवरानश्वमेधपुरस्कृतान् ।। 7.91.2 ।।
transliteration: vasiṣṭhaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca jābālimatha kaśyapam | dvijāṃśca sarvapravarānaśvamedhapuraskṛtān || 7.91.2 ||
translation: वसिष्ठं Vasistha, वामदेवं Vamadeva, च and, जाबालिम् अथ Jabali and then, कश्यपम् Kashyapa, द्विजान् च Brahmins and, सर्वप्रवरान् all the chief, अश्वमेधपुरस्कृतान् those appointed for the Ashwamedha sacrifice.
explanation: He spoke about inviting Vasistha, Vamadeva, Jabali, Kashyapa, and all other chief Brahmins who are appointed for the Ashwamedha sacrifice.

shloka_text: एतान्सर्वान्समानीय मन्त्रयित्वा च लक्ष्मण । हयं लक्षणसम्पन्नं विमोक्ष्यामि समाधिना ।। 7.91.3 ।।
transliteration: etānsarvānsamānīya mantrayitvā ca lakṣmaṇa | hayaṃ lakṣaṇasampannaṃ vimokṣyāmi samādhinā || 7.91.3 ||
translation: एतान् सर्वान् all these, समानीय having assembled, मन्त्रयित्वा having consulted, च and, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, हयं horse, लक्षणसम्पन्नं endowed with auspicious marks, विमोक्ष्यामि I shall release, समाधिना with proper ritual observance.
explanation: O Lakshmana, having assembled all these and consulted with them, I shall release a horse endowed with auspicious marks, with proper ritual observance.

shloka_text: तद्वाक्यं राघवेणोक्तं श्रुत्वा त्वरितविक्रमः । द्विजान्सर्वान्समाहूय दर्शयामास राघवम् ।। 7.91.4 ।।
transliteration: tadvākyaṃ rāghaveṇoktaṃ śrutvā tvaritavikramaḥ | dvijānsarvānsamāhūya darśayāmāsa rāghavam || 7.91.4 ||
translation: तत् वाक्यं that statement, राघवेण उक्तं spoken by Rama, श्रुत्वा having heard, त्वरितविक्रमः of swift valor (Lakshmana), द्विजान् सर्वान् all the Brahmins, समाहूय having summoned, दर्शयामास showed, राघवम् to Rama.
explanation: Having heard that statement spoken by Rama, Lakshmana, of swift valor, summoned all the Brahmins and presented them to Rama.

shloka_text: ते दृष्ट्वा देवसङ्काशं कृतपादाभिवन्दनम् । राघवं सुदुराधर्षमाशीर्भिः समपूजयन् ।। 7.91.5 ।।
transliteration: te dṛṣṭvā devasaṅkāśaṃ kṛtapādābhivandanam | rāghavaṃ sudurādharṣamāśīrbhiḥ samapūjayan || 7.91.5 ||
translation: ते they, दृष्ट्वा having seen, देवसङ्काशं god-like, कृतपादाभिवन्दनम् one who had performed obeisance at their feet, राघवं Rama, सुदुराधर्षम् very difficult to overcome, आशीर्भिः with blessings, समपूजयन् they honored.
explanation: Having seen Rama, who was god-like, very difficult to overcome, and had just bowed at their feet, they honored him with their blessings.

shloka_text: प्राञ्जलिः स तदा भूत्वा राघवो द्विजसत्तमान् । आचचक्षे ऽश्वमेधस्य ह्यभिप्रायं महायशाः ।। 7.91.6 ।।
transliteration: prāñjaliḥ sa tadā bhūtvā rāghavo dvijasattamān | ācacakṣe 'śvamedhasya hyabhiprāyaṃ mahāyaśāḥ || 7.91.6 ||
translation: प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, स he, तदा then, भूत्वा having become, राघवः Rama, द्विजसत्तमान् to the best of the Brahmins, आचचक्षे he explained, अश्वमेधस्य of the Ashwamedha sacrifice, हि indeed, अभिप्रायं the intention, महायशाः the highly renowned one.
explanation: Then, the highly renowned Rama, with folded hands, explained his intention regarding the Ashwamedha sacrifice to the foremost Brahmins.

shloka_text: ते तु रामस्य तच्छ्रुत्वा नमस्कृत्वा वृषध्वजम् । अश्वमेधं द्विजाः सर्वे पूजयन्ति स्म सर्वशः ।। 7.91.7 ।।
transliteration: te tu rāmasya tacchrutvā namaskṛtvā vṛṣadhvajam | aśvamedhaṃ dvijāḥ sarve pūjayanti sma sarvaśaḥ || 7.91.7 ||
translation: ते they, तु indeed, रामस्य of Rama, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, नमस्कृत्वा having bowed down, वृषध्वजम् to Shiva, अश्वमेधं the Ashwamedha sacrifice, द्विजाः the Brahmins, सर्वे all, पूजयन्ति स्म they honored, सर्वशः in every way.
explanation: Having heard Rama's intention, all the Brahmins bowed down to Shiva and then honored the Ashwamedha sacrifice in every way.

shloka_text: स तेषां द्विजमुख्यानां वाक्यमद्भुतदर्शनम् । अश्वमेधाश्रितं श्रुत्वा भृशं प्रीतो ऽभवत्तदा ।। 7.91.8 ।।
transliteration: sa teṣāṃ dvijamukhyānāṃ vākyamadbhutadarśanam | aśvamedhāśritaṃ śrutvā bhṛśaṃ prīto 'bhavattadā || 7.91.8 ||
translation: स he, तेषां of them, द्विजमुख्यानां of the chief Brahmins, वाक्यम् the words, अद्भुतदर्शनम् of wonderful insight, अश्वमेधाश्रितं related to the Ashwamedha, श्रुत्वा having heard, भृशं greatly, प्रीतः pleased, अभवत् became, तदा then.
explanation: Then, having heard the words of wonderful insight from those chief Brahmins regarding the Ashwamedha, he (Rama) became greatly pleased.

shloka_text: विज्ञाय कर्म तत्तेषां रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत् । प्रेषयस्व द्रुतं दूतान् सुग्रीवाय महात्मने ।। 7.91.9 ।।
transliteration: vijñāya karma tatteṣāṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt | preṣayasva drutaṃ dūtān sugrīvāya mahātmane || 7.91.9 ||
translation: विज्ञाय having understood, कर्म the decision, तत् that, तेषां of them, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् he said, प्रेषयस्व send, द्रुतं quickly, दूतान् messengers, सुग्रीवाय to Sugriva, महात्मने to the great-souled one.
explanation: Having understood their decision, Rama then said to Lakshmana, "Send messengers quickly to the great-souled Sugriva."

shloka_text: यथा महद्भिर्हरिभिर्बहुभिश्च वनौकसाम् । सार्धमागच्छ भद्रं ते ह्यनुभोक्तुं महोत्सवम् ।। 7.91.10 ।।
transliteration: yathā mahadbhirharibhirbahubhiśca vanaukasām | sārdhamāgaccha bhadraṃ te hyanubhoktuṃ mahotsavam || 7.91.10 ||
translation: यथा as, महद्भिः with great, हरिभिः monkeys, बहुभिः many, च and, वनौकसाम् of forest dwellers, सार्धम् together with, आगच्छ come, भद्रं ते may you be well, हि indeed, अनुभोक्तुम् to enjoy, महोत्सवम् the great festival.
explanation: Come with many great forest-dwelling monkeys to indeed enjoy this great festival, and may you be well.

shloka_text: बिभीषणश्च रक्षोभिः कामगैर्बहुभिर्वृतः । अश्वमेधं महायज्ञमायात्वतुलविक्रमः ।। 7.91.11 ।।
transliteration: bibhīṣaṇaśca rakṣobhiḥ kāmagairbahubhirvṛtaḥ | aśvamedhaṃ mahāyajñamāyātvatulavikramaḥ || 7.91.11 ||
translation: बिभीषणः Vibhishana, च and, रक्षोभिः with Rakshasas, कामगैः who can go anywhere at will, बहुभिः many, वृतः surrounded, अश्वमेधम् the Ashwamedha, महायज्ञम् great sacrifice, आयातु let him come, अतुलविक्रमः of unequalled valor.
explanation: Let Vibhishana, of unequalled valor, come to the great Ashwamedha sacrifice, surrounded by many Rakshasas who can travel at will.

shloka_text: राजानश्च महाभागा ये मे प्रियचिकीर्षवः । सानुगाः क्षिप्रमायान्तु यज्ञं द्रष्टुमनुत्तमम् ।। 7.91.12 ।।
transliteration: rājānaśca mahābhāgā ye me priyacikīrṣavaḥ | sānugāḥ kṣipramāyāntu yajñaṃ draṣṭumanuttamam || 7.91.12 ||
translation: राजानः kings, च and, महाभागाः highly fortunate ones, ये who, मे my, प्रियचिकीर्षवः desirous of doing good, सानुगाः with their followers, क्षिप्रम् quickly, आयान्तु let them come, यज्ञम् the sacrifice, द्रष्टुम् to see, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.
explanation: Let all the highly fortunate kings who wish me well come quickly with their followers to witness this unsurpassed sacrifice.

shloka_text: देशान्तरगता ये च द्विजा धर्मसमाहिताः । आमन्त्रयस्व तान्सर्वानश्वमेधाय लक्ष्मण ।। 7.91.13 ।।
transliteration: deśāntaragatā ye ca dvijā dharmasamāhitāḥ | āmantrayasva tānsarvānaśvamedhāya lakṣmaṇa || 7.91.13 ||
translation: देशान्तरगताः gone to other countries, ये who, च and, द्विजाः Brahmins, धर्मसमाहिताः devoted to dharma, आमन्त्रयस्व invite, तान्सर्वान् all of them, अश्वमेधाय for the Ashwamedha, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana.
explanation: Lakshmana, invite all those Brahmins who are devoted to dharma and have gone to other countries for the Ashwamedha sacrifice.

shloka_text: ऋषयश्च महाबाहो आहूयन्तां तपोधनाः । देशान्तरगताः सर्वे सदाराश्च द्विजातयः । तथैव तालावचरास्तथैव नटनर्तकाः ।। 7.91.14 ।।
transliteration: ṛṣayaśca mahābāho āhūyantāṃ tapodhanāḥ | deśāntaragatāḥ sarve sadārāśca dvijātayaḥ | tathaiva tālāvacarāstathaiva naṭanartakāḥ || 7.91.14 ||
translation: ऋषयः sages, च and, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, आहूयन्ताम् let them be invited, तपोधनाः whose wealth is penance, देशान्तरगताः gone to other countries, सर्वे all, सदाराः with their wives, च and, द्विजातयः Brahmins, तथैव similarly, तालावचराः musicians, तथैव similarly, नटनर्तकाः actors and dancers.
explanation: O mighty-armed one, let all sages whose wealth is penance, all Brahmins who have gone to other countries along with their wives, and similarly musicians, actors, and dancers be invited.

shloka_text: यज्ञवाटश्च सुमहान्गोमत्या नैमिशे वने । आज्ञाप्यतां महाबाहो तद्धि पुण्यमनुत्तमम् ।। 7.91.15 ।।
transliteration: yajñavāṭaśca sumahāngomatyā naimiśe vane | ājñāpyatāṃ mahābāho taddhi puṇyamanuttamam || 7.91.15 ||
translation: yajñavāṭaḥ sacrificial enclosure, ca and, sumahān very large, gomatyā near Gomati, naimiśe vane in Naimisha forest, ājñāpyatāṃ let it be arranged, mahābāho O mighty-armed one, tat that, hi indeed, puṇyam meritorious, anuttamam unsurpassed.
explanation: O mighty-armed one, let a very large sacrificial enclosure be arranged in the Naimisha forest near the Gomati river, for that indeed is an unsurpassed meritorious act.

shloka_text: शान्तयश्च महाबाहो प्रवर्त्यन्तां समन्ततः ।। 7.91.16 ।।
transliteration: śāntayaśca mahābāho pravartyantāṃ samantataḥ || 7.91.16 ||
translation: śāntayaḥ peace rites, ca and, mahābāho O mighty-armed one, pravartyantāṃ let them be performed, samantataḥ all around.
explanation: And O mighty-armed one, let peace rites be performed everywhere.

shloka_text: शतशश्चापि धर्मज्ञाः क्रतुमुख्यमनुत्तमम् । अनुभूय महायज्ञं नैमिशे रघुनन्दन ।। 7.91.17 ।।
transliteration: śataśaścāpi dharmajñāḥ kratumukhyamanuttamam | anubhūya mahāyajñaṃ naimiśe raghunandana || 7.91.17 ||
translation: śataśaḥ by hundreds, ca and, api also, dharmajñāḥ knowers of dharma, kratumukhyam chief of sacrifices, anuttamam unsurpassed, anubhūya having experienced, mahāyajñaṃ the great sacrifice, naimiśe in Naimisha, raghunandana O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: O delight of the Raghus, let hundreds of knowers of dharma, having experienced this great and unsurpassed chief of sacrifices in Naimisha...

shloka_text: तुष्टः पुष्टश्च सर्वो ऽसौ मानितश्च यथाविधि । प्रीतिं यास्यति धर्मज्ञ शीघ्रमामन्त्र्यतां जनः ।। 7.91.18 ।।
transliteration: tuṣṭaḥ puṣṭaśca sarvo 'sau mānitaśca yathāvidhi | prītiṃ yāsyati dharmajña śīghramāmantryatāṃ janaḥ || 7.91.18 ||
translation: tuṣṭaḥ satisfied, puṣṭaḥ nourished, ca and, sarvaḥ all, asau that (people), mānitaḥ honored, ca and, yathāvidhi according to custom, prītiṃ joy, yāsyati will attain, dharmajña O knower of dharma, śīghram quickly, āmantryatāṃ let them be invited, janaḥ people.
explanation: O knower of dharma, let all those people be quickly invited, so that they will be satisfied, nourished, and properly honored, thereby attaining great joy.

shloka_text: शतं वाहसहस्राणां तण्डुलानां वपुष्मताम् । अयुतं तिलमुद्गानां प्रयात्वग्रे महाबल ।। 7.91.19 ।।
transliteration: śataṃ vāhasahasrāṇāṃ taṇḍulānāṃ vapuṣmatām | ayutaṃ tilamudgānāṃ prayātvagre mahābala || 7.91.19 ||
translation: śatam a hundred, vāhasahasrāṇām of thousands of cartloads, taṇḍulānām of rice grains, vapuṣmatām excellent, ayutam ten thousand, tilamudgānām of sesame and mung beans, prayātu let it go, agre in front, mahābala O mighty one.
explanation: O mighty one, let a hundred thousand cartloads of excellent rice grains and ten thousand cartloads of sesame and mung beans be sent ahead.

shloka_text: चणकानां कुलित्थानां माषाणां लवणस्य च । अतो ऽनुरूपं स्नेहं च गन्धं सङ्क्षिप्तमेव च ।। 7.91.20 ।।
transliteration: caṇakānāṃ kulitthānāṃ māṣāṇāṃ lavaṇasya ca | ato 'nurūpaṃ snehaṃ ca gandhaṃ saṅkṣiptameva ca || 7.91.20 ||
translation: चणकानां of chickpeas, कुलित्थानां of horse gram, माषाणां of black gram, लवणस्य of salt, च and, अतः therefore, अनुरूपं suitable, स्नेहं oil, च and, गन्धं spices, सङ्क्षिप्तम् collected, एव indeed, च and.
explanation: Therefore, suitable oil and collected spices, along with chickpeas, horse gram, black gram, and salt, should also be taken.

shloka_text: सुवर्णकोट्यो बहुला हिरण्यस्य शतोत्तराः । अग्रतो भरतः कृत्वा गच्छत्वग्रे समाधिना ।। 7.91.21 ।।
transliteration: suvarṇakoṭyo bahulā hiraṇyasya śatottarāḥ | agrato bharataḥ kṛtvā gacchatvagre samādhinā || 7.91.21 ||
translation: सुवर्णकोट्यः crores of gold, बहुलाः many, हिरण्यस्य of gold, शतोत्तराः hundreds more, अग्रतः in front, भरतः Bharata, कृत्वा having placed, गच्छतु let him go, अग्रे forward, समाधिना with careful arrangement.
explanation: Bharata should go forth at the head, having placed many crores of gold and hundreds more of other gold wealth, with careful arrangement.

shloka_text: अन्तरा पण्यवीथ्यश्च सर्वे च नटनर्तकाः । सूदा नार्यश्च बहवो नित्यं यौवनशालिनः ।। 7.91.22 ।।
transliteration: antarā paṇyavīthyaśca sarve ca naṭanartakāḥ | sūdā nāryaśca bahavo nityaṃ yauvanaśālinaḥ || 7.91.22 ||
translation: अन्तरा along the way, पण्यवीथ्यः market streets, च and, सर्वे all, च and, नटनर्तकाः actors and dancers, सूदाः cooks, नार्यः women, च and, बहवः many, नित्यं always, यौवनशालिनः youthful.
explanation: Along the way, there should be market streets, and all actors and dancers, as well as many cooks and perpetually youthful women.

shloka_text: भरतेन तु सार्धं ते यान्तु सैन्यानि चाग्रतः । नैगमा बलवृद्धाश्च द्विजाश्च सुसमाहिताः ।। 7.91.23 ।।
transliteration: bharatena tu sārdhaṃ te yāntu sainyāni cāgrataḥ | naigamā balavṛddhāśca dvijāśca susamāhitāḥ || 7.91.23 ||
translation: भरतेन with Bharata, तु indeed, सार्धं together, ते they, यान्तु let them go, सैन्यानि armies, च and, अग्रतः in front, नैगमाः merchants, बलवृद्धाः strong and old, च and, द्विजाः Brahmins, च and, सुसमाहिताः well-prepared.
explanation: Indeed, let the armies go forth with Bharata, and also the merchants, the strong and old, and the well-prepared Brahmins.

shloka_text: कर्मान्तिकान्वर्धकिनः कोशाध्यक्षांश्च नैगमान् । मम मातऽस्तथा सर्वाः कुमारान्तःपुराणि च ।। 7.91.24 ।।
transliteration: karmāntikānvardhakinaḥ kośādhyakṣāṃśca naigamān | mama māta'stathā sarvāḥ kumārāntaḥpurāṇi ca || 7.91.24 ||
translation: कर्मान्तिकान् workers, वर्धकिनः carpenters, कोशाध्यक्षांश्च and treasurers, नैगमान् merchants, मम my, मातः mothers, तथा similarly, सर्वाः all, कुमारान्तःपुराणि inner chambers of princes, च and.
explanation: Also, workers, carpenters, treasurers, merchants, all my mothers, and the inner chambers of the princes should similarly accompany them.

shloka_text: काञ्चनीं मम पत्नीं च दीक्षायां ज्ञांश्च कर्मणि । अग्रतो भरतः कृत्वा गच्छत्वग्रे महायशाः ।। 7.91.25 ।।
transliteration: kāñcanīṃ mama patnīṃ ca dīkṣāyāṃ jñāṃśca karmaṇi | agrato bharataḥ kṛtvā gacchatvagre mahāyaśāḥ || 7.91.25 ||
translation: काञ्चनीं golden, मम my, पत्नीं wife, च and, दीक्षायां in the initiation, ज्ञांश्च and those who know, कर्मणि in the ritual, अग्रतः in front, भरतः Bharata, कृत्वा having placed, गच्छतु let him go, अग्रे in front, महायशाः the greatly renowned one.
explanation: Rama commanded that the greatly renowned Bharata should proceed first, carrying his golden idol of Sita, who represented his wife for the initiation, and also leading those who were knowledgeable in the rituals.

shloka_text: उपकार्या महार्हाश्च पार्थिवानां महौजसाम् । सानुगानां नरश्रेष्ठो व्यादिदेश महाबलः ।। 7.91.26 ।।
transliteration: upakāryā mahārhāśca pārthivānāṃ mahaujasām | sānugānāṃ naraśreṣṭho vyādideśa mahābalaḥ || 7.91.26 ||
translation: उपकार्याः temporary dwellings, महार्हाः very valuable, च and, पार्थिवानां for the kings, महौजसाम् of great might, सानुगानां along with their followers, नरश्रेष्ठः the best among men, व्यादिदेश commanded, महाबलः the mighty one.
explanation: The mighty Rama, the best among men, commanded that splendid temporary dwellings be arranged for the powerful kings and their retinues. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकनवतितमः सर्गः ।। 91 ।। Thus ends the ninety-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तत्सर्वमखिलेनाशु प्रस्थाप्य भरताग्रजः । हयं लक्षणसम्पन्नं कृष्णसारं मुमोच ह ।। 7.92.1 ।।
transliteration: tatsarvamakhilenāśu prasthāpya bharatāgrajaḥ | hayaṃ lakṣaṇasampannaṃ kṛṣṇasāraṃ mumoca ha || 7.92.1 ||
translation: तत् that, सर्वम् all, अखिलेन completely, आशु quickly, प्रस्थाप्य having sent forth, भरताग्रजः Bharata's elder brother, हयं horse, लक्षणसम्पन्नं endowed with auspicious marks, कृष्णसारं black-spotted, मुमोच released, ह indeed.
explanation: Having quickly sent forth all those arrangements completely, Rama, Bharata's elder brother, then released the black-spotted horse, which was endowed with auspicious marks, for the sacrifice.
comments: Rama releases the sacrificial horse under Lakshmana's charge and proceeds to Naimisha -- the kings bring gifts, Bharata and Shatrughna provide for all, and the monkeys and rakshasas give so lavishly that none is poor or unsatisfied -- the matchless sacrifice, of boundless giving such as none had seen, continues more than a year.

shloka_text: ऋत्विग्भिर्लक्ष्मणं सार्धमश्वतन्त्रे नियोज्य च । ततो ऽभ्यगच्छत्काकुत्स्थः सह सैन्येन नैमिशम् ।। 7.92.2 ।।
transliteration: ṛtvigbhirlakṣmaṇaṃ sārdhamaśvatantre niyojya ca | tato 'bhyagacchatkākutsthaḥ saha sainyena naimiśam || 7.92.2 ||
translation: ऋत्विग्भिः with the priests, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, सार्धम् together with, अश्वतन्त्रे in the protection of the horse, नियोज्य having appointed, च and, ततः then, अभ्यगच्छत् proceeded towards, काकुत्स्थः Rama, सह with, सैन्येन the army, नैमिशम् Naimisha.
explanation: After appointing Lakshmana along with the priests to supervise the sacrificial horse, Rama then proceeded towards Naimisha with his army.

shloka_text: यज्ञवाटं महाबाहुर्दृष्ट्वा परममद्भुतम् । प्रबर्षमतुलं लेभे श्रीमानिति वचो ऽब्रवीत् ।। 7.92.3 ।।
transliteration: yajñavāṭaṃ mahābāhurdṛṣṭvā paramamadbhutam | prabarṣamatulaṃ lebhe śrīmāniti vaco 'bravīt || 7.92.3 ||
translation: यज्ञवाटं the sacrificial enclosure, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, दृष्ट्वा having seen, परमम् extremely, अद्भुतम् wonderful, प्रबर्षम् great joy, अतुलं incomparable, लेभे obtained, श्रीमान् the glorious one, इति thus, वचः words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having seen the extremely wonderful sacrificial enclosure, the glorious and mighty-armed Rama felt incomparable joy and spoke these words.

shloka_text: नैमिषे वसतस्तस्य सर्व एव नराधिपाः । आनिन्युरुपहारांश्च तान्रामः प्रत्यपूजयत् ।। 7.92.4 ।।
transliteration: naimiṣe vasatastasya sarva eva narādhipāḥ | āninyurupahārāṃśca tānrāmaḥ pratyapūjayat || 7.92.4 ||
translation: नैमिषे in Naimisha, वसतस्तस्य while he (Rama) was residing, सर्व एव all indeed, नराधिपाः kings, आनिन्युरुपहारांश्च brought gifts and, तान् them, रामः Rama, प्रत्यपूजयत् honored in return.
explanation: While Rama was residing in Naimisha, all the kings brought him gifts, and Rama, in turn, honored them.

shloka_text: उपकार्या महार्हाश्च पार्थिवानां महात्मनाम् । सानुगानां नरश्रेष्ठो व्यादिदेश महामतिः ।। 7.92.5 ।।
transliteration: upakāryā mahārhāśca pārthivānāṃ mahātmanām | sānugānāṃ naraśreṣṭho vyādideśa mahāmatiḥ || 7.92.5 ||
translation: उपकार्या suitable dwellings, महार्हाश्च and very valuable, पार्थिवानां for the kings, महात्मनाम् great-souled, सानुगानां along with their followers, नरश्रेष्ठो the best among men (Rama), व्यादिदेश assigned, महामतिः the great-minded one.
explanation: The great-minded Rama, the best among men, arranged for valuable and suitable lodgings for the great kings and their retinues.

shloka_text: अन्नपानानि वस्त्राणि सानुगानां महात्मनाम् । भरतः सन्ददावाशु शत्रुघ्नसहितस्तदा ।। 7.92.6 ।।
transliteration: annapānāni vastrāṇi sānugānāṃ mahātmanām | bharataḥ sandadāvāśu śatrughnasahitastadā || 7.92.6 ||
translation: अन्नपानानि food and drinks, वस्त्राणि clothes, सानुगानां for those with their followers, महात्मनाम् great-souled, भरतः Bharata, सन्ददावाशु quickly distributed, शत्रुघ्नसहितस्तदा then along with Shatrughna.
explanation: Bharata, accompanied by Shatrughna, then swiftly provided food, drinks, and clothes for the great-souled kings and their followers.

shloka_text: वानराश्च महात्मानः सुग्रीवसहितास्तदा । विप्राणां प्रणताः सर्वे चक्रिरे परिवेषणम् ।। 7.92.7 ।।
transliteration: vānarāśca mahātmānaḥ sugrīvasahitāstadā | viprāṇāṃ praṇatāḥ sarve cakrire pariveṣaṇam || 7.92.7 ||
translation: वानराश्च and the Vanaras, महात्मानः great-souled, सुग्रीवसहितास्तदा then along with Sugriva, विप्राणां for the Brahmins, प्रणताः bowing down, सर्वे all, चक्रिरे performed, परिवेषणम् serving (food).
explanation: Then, all the great-souled Vanaras, led by Sugriva, humbly served food to the Brahmins.

shloka_text: बिभीषणश्च रक्षोभिर्बहुभिः स्रग्विभिर्वृतः । ऋषीणामुग्रतपसां पूजां चक्रे महात्मनाम् ।। 7.92.8 ।।
transliteration: bibhīṣaṇaśca rakṣobhirbahubhiḥ sragvibhirvṛtaḥ | ṛṣīṇāmugratapasāṃ pūjāṃ cakre mahātmanām || 7.92.8 ||
translation: बिभीषणश्च and Vibhishana, रक्षोभिर्बहुभिः by many Rakshasas, स्रग्विभिर्वृतः surrounded by garland-wearing ones, ऋषीणामुग्रतपसां of the sages of severe penance, पूजां worship, चक्रे performed, महात्मनाम् great-souled.
explanation: Vibhishana, accompanied by many garland-wearing Rakshasas, performed worship for the great-souled sages of severe penance.

shloka_text: एवं सुविहितो यज्ञो हयमेधो ऽभ्यवर्तत । लक्ष्मणेनागुप्ता च हयचर्या प्रवर्तत । ईदृशं राजसिंहस्य यज्ञप्रवरमुत्तमम् ।। 7.92.9 ।।
