transliteration: evaṃ suvihito yajño hayamedho 'bhyavartata | lakṣmaṇenāguptā ca hayacaryā pravartata | īdṛśaṃ rājasiṃhasya yajñapravaramuttamam || 7.92.9 ||
translation: एवं thus, सुविहितो well-arranged, यज्ञो sacrifice, हयमेधो Ashvamedha, अभ्यवर्तत proceeded, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, अगुप्ता unguarded, च and, हयचर्या the horse's wandering, प्रवर्तत proceeded, ईदृशं such, राजसिंहस्य of the lion among kings, यज्ञप्रवरम् the best of sacrifices, उत्तमम् excellent.
explanation: Thus, the well-arranged Ashvamedha sacrifice proceeded, and the horse's journey, unguarded by Lakshmana, also took place, such was this excellent and supreme sacrifice of the lion among kings.

shloka_text: नान्यः शब्दो ऽभवत्तत्र हयमेधे महात्मनः । छन्दतो देहि विस्रब्धो यावत्तुष्यन्ति याचकाः ।। 7.92.10 ।।
transliteration: nānyaḥ śabdo 'bhavattatra hayamedhe mahātmanaḥ | chandato dehi visrabdho yāvattuṣyanti yācakāḥ || 7.92.10 ||
translation: न not, अन्यः other, शब्दो sound, अभवत् was, तत्र there, हयमेधे in the Ashvamedha, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, छन्दतो according to desire, देहि give, विस्रब्धो confidently, यावत् until, तुष्यन्ति are satisfied, याचकाः supplicants.
explanation: In the great-souled Rama's Ashvamedha, no other sound was heard except "Give freely and confidently until the supplicants are satisfied."

shloka_text: तावत्सर्वाणि दत्तानि क्रतुमध्ये महात्मनः । विविधानि च गौडानि खाण्डवानि तथैव च ।। 7.92.11 ।।
transliteration: tāvatsarvāṇi dattāni kratumadhye mahātmanaḥ | vividhāni ca gauḍāni khāṇḍavāni tathaiva ca || 7.92.11 ||
translation: तावत् then, सर्वाणि all, दत्तानि were given, क्रतुमध्ये in the midst of the sacrifice, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, विविधानि various, च and, गौडानि jaggery sweets, खाण्डवानि sugar sweets, तथैव similarly, च and.
explanation: In the midst of the great-souled one's sacrifice, all sorts of things were given, including various jaggery sweets and sugar sweets.

shloka_text: न निस्सृतं भतत्योष्ठाद्वचनं यावदर्थिनाम् । तावद्वानररक्षोभिर्दत्तमेवाभ्यदृश्यत ।। 7.92.12 ।।
transliteration: na nissṛtaṃ bhatatyoṣṭhādvacanaṃ yāvadarthinām | tāvadvānararakṣobhirdattamevābhyadṛśyata || 7.92.12 ||
translation: न not, निस्सृतं emerged, ओष्ठात् from the lips, वचनं word, यावत् until, अर्थिनाम् of the supplicants, तावत् then, वानररक्षोभिर् by monkeys and rakshasas, दत्तमेव indeed given, अभ्यदृश्यत was seen.
explanation: Before a word could even emerge from the lips of the supplicants, it was already seen to be given by the monkeys and rakshasas.

shloka_text: न कश्चिन्मलिनस्तत्र दीनो वा ऽप्यथ कृर्शतः । तस्मिन्यज्ञवरे राज्ञो हृष्टपुष्टजनावृते ।। 7.92.13 ।।
transliteration: na kaścinmalinastatra dīno vā 'pyatha kṛrśataḥ | tasminyajñavare rājño hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛte || 7.92.13 ||
translation: न not, कश्चित् anyone, मलिनस् dirty, तत्र there, दीनो poor, वा or, अपि even, अथ moreover, कृशः emaciated, तस्मिन् in that, यज्ञवरे excellent sacrifice, राज्ञो of the king, हृष्टपुष्टजनावृते filled with happy and well-nourished people.
explanation: In that excellent sacrifice of the king, which was filled with happy and well-nourished people, there was no one who was dirty, poor, or emaciated.

shloka_text: ये च तत्र महात्मानो मुनयश्चिरजीविनः । नास्मरंस्तादृशं यज्ञं नाप्यासीत् स कदाचन ।। 7.92.14 ।।
transliteration: ye ca tatra mahātmāno munayaścirajīvinaḥ | nāsmaraṃstādṛśaṃ yajñaṃ nāpyāsīt sa kadācana || 7.92.14 ||
translation: ये those who, च and, तत्र there, महात्मानो great-souled ones, मुनयः sages, चिरजीविनः long-lived, न not, अस्मरन् remembered, तादृशं such, यज्ञं a sacrifice, न not, अपि even, आसीत् was, सः that, कदाचन ever.
explanation: Even the great-souled, long-lived sages present there had never remembered or witnessed such a sacrifice before.

shloka_text: यः कृत्यवान्सुवर्णेन सुवर्णं लभते स्म सः । वित्तार्थी लभते वित्तं रत्नार्थी रत्नमेव च ।। 7.92.15 ।।
transliteration: yaḥ kṛtyavānsuvarṇena suvarṇaṃ labhate sma saḥ | vittārthī labhate vittaṃ ratnārthī ratnameva ca || 7.92.15 ||
translation: यः whoever, कृत्यवान् had a need, सुवर्णेन for gold, सुवर्णं gold, लभते obtained, स्म indeed, सः he, वित्तार्थी one desiring wealth, लभते obtained, वित्तं wealth, रत्नार्थी one desiring jewels, रत्नम् jewels, एव indeed, च and.
explanation: Whoever had a need for gold obtained gold, those desiring wealth obtained wealth, and those desiring jewels indeed obtained jewels.

shloka_text: रजतानां सुवर्णानामश्मनामथ वाससाम् । अनिशं दीयमानानां राशिः समुपदृश्यते ।। 7.92.16 ।।
transliteration: rajatānāṃ suvarṇānāmaśmanāmatha vāsasām | aniśaṃ dīyamānānāṃ rāśiḥ samupadṛśyate || 7.92.16 ||
translation: रजतानां of silver, सुवर्णानाम् of gold, अश्मनाम् of jewels, अथ and, वाससाम् of clothes, अनिशं constantly, दीयमानानां being given, राशिः a heap, समुपदृश्यते was seen.
explanation: Heaps of silver, gold, jewels, and clothes, constantly being distributed, were visible everywhere.

shloka_text: न शक्रस्य धनेशस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य वा । ईदृशो दृष्टपूर्वो न एवमूचुस्तपोधनाः ।। 7.92.17 ।।
transliteration: na śakrasya dhaneśasya yamasya varuṇasya vā | īdṛśo dṛṣṭapūrvo na evamūcustapodhanāḥ || 7.92.17 ||
translation: न not, शक्रस्य of Indra, धनेशस्य of Kubera, यमस्य of Yama, वरुणस्य of Varuna, वा or, ईदृशः such, दृष्टपूर्वः seen before, न not, एवम् thus, ऊचुः said, तपोधनाः the ascetics.
explanation: The ascetics declared that such a spectacle had never been seen before, not even in the realms of Indra, Kubera, Yama, or Varuna.

shloka_text: सर्वत्र वानरास्तस्थुः सर्वत्रैव च राक्षसाः । वासोधनान्नमर्थिभ्यः पूर्णहस्ता ददुर्भृशम् ।। 7.92.18 ।।
transliteration: sarvatra vānarāstasthuḥ sarvatraiva ca rākṣasāḥ | vāsodhanānnamarthibhyaḥ pūrṇahastā dadurbhṛśam || 7.92.18 ||
translation: सर्वत्र everywhere, वानराः monkeys, तस्थुः stood, सर्वत्र everywhere, एव indeed, च and, राक्षसाः rakshasas, वासः clothes, धन wealth, अन्नम् food, अर्थिभ्यः to the supplicants, पूर्णहस्ताः with full hands, ददुः gave, भृशम् abundantly.
explanation: Monkeys and rakshasas were present everywhere, giving clothes, wealth, and food abundantly with full hands to all who sought them.

shloka_text: ईदृशो राजसिंहस्य यज्ञः सर्वगुणान्वितः । संवत्सरमथो साग्रं वर्तते न च हीयते ।। 7.92.19 ।।
transliteration: īdṛśo rājasiṃhasya yajñaḥ sarvaguṇānvitaḥ | saṃvatsaramatho sāgraṃ vartate na ca hīyate || 7.92.19 ||
translation: ईदृशः such, राजसिंहस्य of the lion among kings, यज्ञः sacrifice, सर्वगुणान्वितः endowed with all good qualities, संवत्सरम् a year, अथो and, साग्रम् more than, वर्तते continues, न not, च and, हीयते diminishes.
explanation: Such a sacrifice of the lion among kings, endowed with all good qualities, continued for more than a year without diminishing. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्विनवतितमः सर्गः ।। 92 ।। Thus ends the ninety-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: वर्तमाने तथाभूते यज्ञे च परमाद्भुते । सशिष्य आजगामाशु वाल्मीकिर्मुनिपुङ्गवः ।। 7.93.1 ।।
transliteration: vartamāne tathābhūte yajñe ca paramādbhute | saśiṣya ājagāmāśu vālmīkirmunipuṅgavaḥ || 7.93.1 ||
translation: वर्तमाने while going on, तथाभूते being such, यज्ञे in the sacrifice, च and, परमाद्भुते supremely wonderful, सशिष्यः with disciples, आजगाम came, आशु quickly, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages.
explanation: While that supremely wonderful sacrifice was thus going on, Valmiki, the foremost among sages, quickly arrived with his disciples.
comments: Valmiki arrives at the sacrifice with his disciples Kusha and Lava and instructs them to sing the whole Ramayana he has composed, twenty cantos a day and sweetly, taking no payment, naming him as their teacher if Rama asks, and singing above all at Rama's gate -- the boys take the charge to heart and pass the night in eager anticipation.

shloka_text: स दृष्ट्वा दिव्यसङ्काशं यज्ञमद्भुतदर्शनम् । एकान्ते ऋषिवाटानां चकार उटजाञ्छुभान् ।। 7.93.2 ।।
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā divyasaṅkāśaṃ yajñamadbhutadarśanam | ekānte ṛṣivāṭānāṃ cakāra uṭajāñchubhān || 7.93.2 ||
translation: सः he, दृष्ट्वा having seen, दिव्यसङ्काशम् divine-like, यज्ञम् the sacrifice, अद्भुतदर्शनम् wondrous to behold, एकान्ते in a secluded place, ऋषिवाटानाम् of the hermitages of sages, चकार made, उटजान् huts, शुभान् auspicious.
explanation: Having seen the divine-like and wondrous sacrifice, he (Valmiki) constructed auspicious huts in a secluded spot among the hermitages of other sages.

shloka_text: शकटांश्च बहून्पूर्णान्फलमूलैश्च शोभनान् । वाल्मीकिवाटे रुचिरे स्थापयन्नविदूरतः ।। 7.93.3 ।।
transliteration: śakaṭāṃśca bahūnpūrṇānphalamūlaiśca śobhanān | vālmīkivāṭe rucire sthāpayannavidūrataḥ || 7.93.3 ||
translation: शकटान् carts, च and, बहून् many, पूर्णान् full, फलमूलैः with fruits and roots, च and, शोभनान् excellent, वाल्मीकिवाटे in Valmiki's hermitage, रुचिरे charming, स्थापयन् placing, अविदूरतः not far off.
explanation: He also had many carts, full of excellent fruits and roots, placed not far off in his charming hermitage.

shloka_text: आसीत्सुपूजितो राज्ञा मुनिभिश्च महात्मभिः । वाल्मीकिः सुमहातेजा न्यवसत्परमात्मवान् ।। 7.93.4 ।।
transliteration: āsītsupūjito rājñā munibhiśca mahātmabhiḥ | vālmīkiḥ sumahātejā nyavasatparamātmavān || 7.93.4 ||
translation: आसीत् was, सुपूजितः well-honored, राज्ञा by the king, मुनिभिः by sages, च and, महात्मभिः by great-souled ones, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, सुमहातेजा of great splendor, न्यवसत् resided, परमात्मवान् self-controlled.
explanation: Valmiki, of great splendor and self-controlled, was greatly honored by the king and the great-souled sages, and thus he resided there.

shloka_text: स शिष्यावब्रवीद्धृष्टौ युवां गत्वा समाहितौ । कृत्स्नं रामायणं काव्यं गायेथां परया मुदा ।। 7.93.5 ।।
transliteration: sa śiṣyāvabravīddhṛṣṭau yuvāṃ gatvā samāhitau | kṛtsnaṃ rāmāyaṇaṃ kāvyaṃ gāyethāṃ parayā mudā || 7.93.5 ||
translation: सः He, शिष्यौ to his two disciples, अब्रवीत् said, हृष्टौ delighted, युवाम् you two, गत्वा having gone, समाहितौ concentrated, कृत्स्नम् entire, रामायणम् Ramayana, काव्यम् epic poem, गायेथाम् you two should sing, परया with supreme, मुदा joy.
explanation: Valmiki, delighted, instructed his two disciples to go and sing the entire epic poem of Ramayana with utmost concentration and joy.

shloka_text: ऋषिवाटेषु पुण्येषु ब्राह्मणावसथेषु च । रथ्यासु राजमार्गेषु पार्थिवानां गृहेषु च ।। 7.93.6 ।।
transliteration: ṛṣivāṭeṣu puṇyeṣu brāhmaṇāvasatheṣu ca | rathyāsu rājamārgeṣu pārthivānāṃ gṛheṣu ca || 7.93.6 ||
translation: ऋषिवाटेषु in hermitages of sages, पुण्येषु sacred, ब्राह्मणावसथेषु in abodes of Brahmins, च and, रथ्यासु in streets, राजमार्गेषु in royal highways, पार्थिवानाम् of kings, गृहेषु in houses, च and.
explanation: They were to sing in sacred hermitages of sages, in the homes of Brahmins, in streets, on royal highways, and in the palaces of kings.

shloka_text: रामस्य भवनद्वारि यत्र कर्म च कुर्वते । ऋत्विजामग्रतश्चैव तत्र गेयं विशेषतः ।। 7.93.7 ।।
transliteration: rāmasya bhavanadvāri yatra karma ca kurvate | ṛtvijāmagrataścaiva tatra geyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 7.93.7 ||
translation: रामस्य of Rama, भवनद्वारि at the palace gate, यत्र where, कर्म rituals, च and, कुर्वते they perform, ऋत्विजाम् of priests, अग्रतः in front, च and, एव indeed, तत्र there, गेयम् it should be sung, विशेषतः especially.
explanation: They should sing especially at Rama's palace gate, where rituals are performed, and in front of the priests.

shloka_text: इमानि च फलान्यत्र स्वादूनि विविधानि च । जातानि पर्वताग्रेषु चास्वाद्यास्वाद्य गायताम् ।। 7.93.8 ।।
transliteration: imāni ca phalānyatra svādūni vividhāni ca | jātāni parvatāgreṣu cāsvādyāsvādya gāyatām || 7.93.8 ||
translation: इमानि these, च and, फलानि fruits, अत्र here, स्वादूनि delicious, विविधानि various, च and, जातानि grown, पर्वताग्रेषु on mountain peaks, च and, आस्वाद्य having tasted, आस्वाद्य repeatedly tasted, गायताम् let them sing.
explanation: While singing, they should repeatedly taste these various delicious fruits that grow on the mountain peaks.

shloka_text: न यास्यथः श्रमं वत्सौ भक्षयित्वा फलानि वै । मूलानि च सुमृष्टानि नगराद्बहिरास्यथः ।। 7.93.9 ।।
transliteration: na yāsyathaḥ śramaṃ vatsau bhakṣayitvā phalāni vai | mūlāni ca sumṛṣṭāni nagarādbahirāsyathaḥ || 7.93.9 ||
translation: न not, यास्यथः you two will experience, श्रमम् fatigue, वत्सौ O dear children, भक्षयित्वा having eaten, फलानि fruits, वै indeed, मूलानि roots, च and, सुमृष्टानि very clean/delicious, नगरात् from the city, बहिः outside, आस्यथः you two will stay/be.
explanation: O dear children, you two will not experience fatigue by eating fruits and pure roots, and you will stay outside the city.

shloka_text: यदि शब्दापयेद्रामः श्रवणाय महीपतिः । ऋषीणामुपविष्टानां ततो गेयं प्रवर्तताम् ।। 7.93.10 ।।
transliteration: yadi śabdāpayedrāmaḥ śravaṇāya mahīpatiḥ | ṛṣīṇāmupaviṣṭānāṃ tato geyaṃ pravartatām || 7.93.10 ||
translation: यदि if, शब्दापयेत् calls, रामः Rama, श्रवणाय for listening, महीपतिः the king, ऋषीणाम् of the sages, उपविष्टानाम् who are seated, ततः then, गेयम् the song, प्रवर्तताम् let it proceed.
explanation: If King Rama calls for the sages to listen, then the singing should begin.

shloka_text: दिवसे विंशतिः सर्गा गेया मधुरया गिरा । प्रमाणैर्बहुभिस्तत्र यथोद्दिष्टा मया पुरा ।। 7.93.11 ।।
transliteration: divase viṃśatiḥ sargā geyā madhurayā girā | pramāṇairbahubhistatra yathoddiṣṭā mayā purā || 7.93.11 ||
translation: दिवसे in a day, विंशतिः twenty, सर्गाः cantos, गेयाः should be sung, मधुरया with sweet, गिरा voice, प्रमाणैः with measures, बहुभिः many, तत्र there, यथोद्दिष्टाः as instructed, मया by me, पुरा previously.
explanation: Twenty cantos should be sung daily with a sweet voice, using the many meters and measures as I have previously instructed.

shloka_text: लोभश्चापि न कर्तव्यः स्वल्पो ऽपि धनकाङ्क्षया । किं धनेनाश्रमस्थानां फलमूलोपजीविना ।। 7.93.12 ।।
transliteration: lobhaścāpi na kartavyaḥ svalpo 'pi dhanakāṅkṣayā | kiṃ dhanenāśramasthānāṃ phalamūlopajīvinā || 7.93.12 ||
translation: लोभः greed, च and, अपि also, न not, कर्तव्यः should be done, स्वल्पः even a little, अपि even, धनकाङ्क्षया with desire for wealth, किम् what use, धनेन with wealth, आश्रमस्थानाम् for those living in hermitages, फलमूलोपजीविनाम् who subsist on fruits and roots.
explanation: Do not show even a little greed for wealth, for what use is wealth to those who live in hermitages and subsist on fruits and roots?

shloka_text: यदि पृच्छेत्स काकुत्स्थो युवां कस्येति दारकौ । आवां वाल्मीकिशिष्यौ स्वो ब्रूतमेवं नराधिपम् ।। 7.93.13 ।।
transliteration: yadi pṛcchetsa kākutstho yuvāṃ kasyeti dārakau | āvāṃ vālmīkiśiṣyau svo brūtamevaṃ narādhipam || 7.93.13 ||
translation: यदि if, पृच्छेत् asks, सः he, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), युवाम् you two, कस्य whose, इति thus, दारकौ boys, आवाम् we two, वाल्मीकिशिष्यौ disciples of Valmiki, स्वः are, ब्रूतम् say, एवम् thus, नराधिपम् to the king.
explanation: If Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, asks, "Whose boys are you two?", then tell the king, "We are the disciples of Valmiki."

shloka_text: इमास्तन्त्रीः सुमधुराः स्थानं वा ऽपूर्वदर्शनम् । मूर्च्छयित्वा सुमधुरं गायतां विगतज्वरौ ।। 7.93.14 ।।
transliteration: imāstantrīḥ sumadhurāḥ sthānaṃ vā 'pūrvadarśanam | mūrcchayitvā sumadhuraṃ gāyatāṃ vigatajvarau || 7.93.14 ||
translation: इमाः these, तन्त्रीः strings, सुमधुराः very sweet, स्थानम् notes/pitch, वा or, अपूर्वदर्शनम् unprecedented to see/hear, मूर्च्छयित्वा having tuned/harmonized, सुमधुरम् very sweetly, गायतम् sing, विगतज्वरौ free from anxiety.
explanation: Harmonize these very sweet strings or notes in an unprecedented manner, and sing very sweetly, free from any anxiety.

shloka_text: आदिप्रभृति गेयं स्यान्न चावज्ञाय पार्थिवम् । पिता हि सर्वभूतानां राजा भविति धर्मतः ।। 7.93.15 ।।
transliteration: ādiprabhṛti geyaṃ syānna cāvajñāya pārthivam | pitā hi sarvabhūtānāṃ rājā bhaviti dharmataḥ || 7.93.15 ||
translation: आदिप्रभृति from the beginning, गेयं to be sung, स्यात् should be, न not, च and, अवज्ञाय disrespecting, पार्थिवम् the king, पिता father, हि indeed, सर्वभूतानां of all beings, राजा the king, भविति is, धर्मतः by dharma.
explanation: The Ramayana should be sung from the beginning, and the king should not be disrespected, for a king is indeed the father of all beings by virtue of dharma.

shloka_text: तद्युवां हृष्टमनसौ श्वः प्रभाते समास्थितौ । गायेथां मधुरं गेयं तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम् ।। 7.93.16 ।।
transliteration: tadyuvāṃ hṛṣṭamanasau śvaḥ prabhāte samāsthitau | gāyethāṃ madhuraṃ geyaṃ tantrīlayasamanvitam || 7.93.16 ||
translation: तत् therefore, युवां you two, हृष्टमनसौ with joyful minds, श्वः tomorrow, प्रभाते in the morning, समास्थितौ having taken your seats, गायेथां you two should sing, मधुरं sweet, गेयं song, तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम् accompanied by string instruments and rhythm.
explanation: Therefore, you two, with joyful minds, should take your seats tomorrow morning and sing the sweet song, accompanied by string instruments and rhythm.

shloka_text: इति सन्दिश्य बहुशो मुनिः प्राचेतसस्तदा । वाल्मीकिः परमोदारस्तूष्णीमासीन्महायशाः ।। 7.93.17 ।।
transliteration: iti sandiśya bahuśo muniḥ prācetasastadā | vālmīkiḥ paramodārastūṣṇīmāsīnmahāyaśāḥ || 7.93.17 ||
translation: इति thus, सन्दिश्य having instructed, बहुशः repeatedly, मुनिः the sage, प्राचेतसः son of Prachetas, तदा then, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, परमोदारः most noble, तूष्णीम् silently, आसीत् remained, महायशाः highly renowned.
explanation: Thus, having repeatedly instructed them, the highly renowned and most noble sage Valmiki, son of Prachetas, then remained silent.

shloka_text: सन्दिष्टौ मुनिना तेन तावुभौ मैथिलीसुतौ । तथैव करवावेति निर्जग्मतुररिन्दमौ ।। 7.93.18 ।।
transliteration: sandiṣṭau muninā tena tāvubhau maithilīsutau | tathaiva karavāveti nirjagmaturarindamau || 7.93.18 ||
translation: सन्दिष्टौ having been instructed, मुनिना by the sage, तेन by him, तौ those two, उभौ both, मैथिलीसुतौ sons of Maithili, तथैव just so, करवाव we shall do, इति thus, निर्जग्मतुः they departed, अरिन्दमौ subduers of enemies.
explanation: Having been instructed by that sage, both sons of Maithili, those subduers of enemies, departed, saying, "We shall do just so."

shloka_text: तामद्भुतां तौ हृदये कुमारौ निवेश्य वाणीमृषिभाषितां तदा । समुत्सुकौ तौ सममूषतुर्निशां यथा ऽश्विनौ भार्गवनीतिसंहिताम् ।। 7.93.19 ।।
transliteration: tāmadbhutāṃ tau hṛdaye kumārau niveśya vāṇīmṛṣibhāṣitāṃ tadā | samutsukau tau samamūṣaturniśāṃ yathā 'śvinau bhārgavanītisaṃhitām || 7.93.19 ||
translation: ताम् that, अद्भुतां wonderful, तौ those two, हृदये in their hearts, कुमारौ the princes, निवेश्य having placed, वाणीम् words, ऋषिभाषितां spoken by the sage, तदा then, समुत्सुकौ very eager, तौ those two, सममूषतुः they passed, निशां the night, यथा just as, अश्विनौ the Ashvins, भार्गवनीतिसंहिताम् (the night) associated with the wisdom of Bhargava.
explanation: Then, those two princes, having fixed those wonderful words spoken by the sage in their hearts, passed the night with great eagerness, just as the Ashvins awaited the wisdom of Bhargava. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रिनवतितमः सर्गः ।। 93 ।। Thus ends the ninety-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तौ रजन्यां प्रभातायां स्नातौ हुतहुताशनौ । यथोक्तमृषिणा पूर्वं सर्वं तत्रोपगायताम् ।। 7.94.1 ।।
transliteration: tau rajanyāṃ prabhātāyāṃ snātau hutahutāśanau | yathoktamṛṣiṇā pūrvaṃ sarvaṃ tatropagāyatām || 7.94.1 ||
translation: तौ they both, रजन्यां in the night, प्रभातायां when it dawned, स्नातौ having bathed, हुतहुताशनौ having offered oblations to the fire, यथोक्तम् as narrated, ऋषिणा by the sage, पूर्वं previously, सर्वं all, तत्र there, उपगायताम् they sang.
explanation: When the night dawned, after bathing and performing their fire oblations, the two boys sang the entire Ramayana as previously narrated by the sage Valmiki in that assembly.
comments: At dawn Kusha and Lava sing the Ramayana before the assembly; captivated, Rama gathers the learned and seats the boys among them, all marvelling how like Rama they are -- after twenty cantos he offers them gold, which they refuse as forest-dwellers, and learns the poem is Valmiki's, of twenty-four thousand verses and six books recounting Rama's own deeds, and that the sage is present.

shloka_text: तां स शुश्राव काकुत्स्थः पूर्वाचार्यविजिर्मिताम् । अपूर्वां पाठ्यजातिं च गेयेन समलङ्कृताम् ।। 7.94.2 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ sa śuśrāva kākutsthaḥ pūrvācāryavijirmitām | apūrvāṃ pāṭhyajātiṃ ca geyena samalaṅkṛtām || 7.94.2 ||
translation: ताम् that, सः he, शुश्राव heard, काकुत्स्थः Rama, पूर्वाचार्यविजिर्मिताम् composed by the ancient preceptor, अपूर्वाम् unprecedented, पाठ्यजातिं type of recitation, च and, गेयेन with melody, समलङ्कृताम् adorned.
explanation: Rama heard that unique form of recitation, composed by the ancient preceptor Valmiki, which was embellished with melody.

shloka_text: प्रमाणैर्बहुभिर्बद्धां तन्त्रीलयसमन्विताम् । बालाभ्यां राघवः श्रुत्वा कौतूहलपरो ऽभवत् ।। 7.94.3 ।।
transliteration: pramāṇairbahubhirbaddhāṃ tantrīlayasamanvitām | bālābhyāṃ rāghavaḥ śrutvā kautūhalaparo 'bhavat || 7.94.3 ||
translation: प्रमाणैः with many measures, बहुभिः many, बद्धां structured, तन्त्रीलयसमन्विताम् accompanied by string instruments and rhythm, बालाभ्यां from the two boys, राघवः Rama, श्रुत्वा having heard, कौतूहलपरः filled with curiosity, अभवत् became.
explanation: Having heard the recitation, which was structured with many meters and accompanied by string instruments and rhythm, from the two boys, Rama became extremely curious.

shloka_text: अथ कर्मान्तरे राजा समाहूय महामुनीन् । पार्थिवांश्च नरव्याघ्रः पण्डितान्नैगमांस्तथा ।। 7.94.4 ।।
transliteration: atha karmāntare rājā samāhūya mahāmunīn | pārthivāṃśca naravyāghraḥ paṇḍitānnaigamāṃstathā || 7.94.4 ||
translation: अथ then, कर्मान्तरे at the end of the ritual, राजा the king, समाहूय having summoned, महामुनीन् great sages, पार्थिवाम् kings, च and, नरव्याघ्रः the tiger among men, पण्डितान् scholars, नैगमान् citizens, तथा also.
explanation: Then, during a break in the ceremony, King Rama, the tiger among men, summoned great sages, other kings, scholars, and citizens.

shloka_text: पौराणिकाञ्छब्दविदो ये च वृद्धा द्विजातयः । स्वराणां लक्षणज्ञांश्च उत्सुकान्द्विजसत्तमान् ।। 7.94.5 ।।
transliteration: paurāṇikāñchabdavido ye ca vṛddhā dvijātayaḥ | svarāṇāṃ lakṣaṇajñāṃśca utsukāndvijasattamān || 7.94.5 ||
translation: पौराणिकाञ् those learned in Puranas, शब्दविदः grammarians, ये who, च and, वृद्धाः elderly, द्विजातयः Brahmins, स्वराणां of musical notes, लक्षणज्ञान् experts, च and, उत्सुकान् eager, द्विजसत्तमान् excellent Brahmins.
explanation: He also summoned those learned in Puranas, grammarians, elderly Brahmins, experts in musical notes, and other eager, excellent Brahmins.

shloka_text: लक्षणज्ञांश्च गान्धर्वान्नैगमांश्च विशेषतः । पादाक्षरसमासज्ञांश्छन्दःसु परिनिष्ठितान् ।। 7.94.6 ।।
transliteration: lakṣaṇajñāṃśca gāndharvānnaigamāṃśca viśeṣataḥ | pādākṣarasamāsajñāṃśchandaḥsu pariniṣṭhitān || 7.94.6 ||
translation: लक्षणज्ञान् those who know characteristics, च and, गान्धर्वान् those skilled in music, नैगमान् those skilled in Vedas, च and, विशेषतः especially, पादाक्षरसमासज्ञान् those who know feet, syllables, and compounds, छन्दःसु in prosody, परिनिष्ठितान् well-versed.
explanation: He gathered those who were knowledgeable in characteristics, skilled in music, especially proficient in the Vedas, and well-versed in the intricacies of prosody, including feet, syllables, and compounds.

shloka_text: कलामात्राविशेषज्ञाञ्ज्योतिषे च परं गतान् । क्रियाकल्पविदश्चैव तथा कार्यविदो जनान् ।। 7.94.7 ।।
transliteration: kalāmātrāviśeṣajñāñjyotiṣe ca paraṃ gatān | kriyākalpavidaścaiva tathā kāryavido janān || 7.94.7 ||
translation: कलामात्राविशेषज्ञान् those who know the distinctions of arts and measures, ज्योतिषे in astronomy, च and, परं highest, गतान attained, क्रियाकल्पविदः those who know rituals and procedures, च and, एव indeed, तथा similarly, कार्यविदः those who know actions, जनान् people.
explanation: He also gathered people who were experts in the nuances of arts and measures, highly proficient in astronomy, knowledgeable in rituals and procedures, and skilled in practical affairs.

shloka_text: भाषाज्ञानिङ्गितज्ञांश्च नैगमांश्चाप्यशेषतः । हेतूपचारकुशलान् वचने चापि हैतुकान् ।। 7.94.8 ।।
transliteration: bhāṣājñāniṅgitajñāṃśca naigamāṃścāpyaśeṣataḥ | hetūpacārakuśalān vacane cāpi haitukān || 7.94.8 ||
translation: भाषाज्ञान् those who know languages, इङ्गितज्ञान् those who know gestures, च and, नैगमान् those skilled in Vedas, च and, अपि also, अशेषतः completely, हेतूपचारकुशलान् those skilled in reasoning and application, वचने in speech, च and, अपि also, हैतुकान् logicians.
explanation: He assembled those who were proficient in languages, understood gestures, were completely knowledgeable in the Vedas, skilled in reasoning and its application, and adept logicians in speech.

shloka_text: छन्दोविदः पुराणज्ञान्वैदिकान्द्विजसत्तमान् । चित्रज्ञान्वृत्तसूत्रज्ञान्गीतनृत्यविशारदान् ।। 7.94.9 ।।
transliteration: chandovidaḥ purāṇajñānvaidikāndvijasattamān | citrajñānvṛttasūtrajñāngītanṛtyaviśāradān || 7.94.9 ||
translation: छन्दोविदः those who know prosody, पुराणज्ञान् those who know Puranas, वैदिकान् those who know Vedas, द्विजसत्तमान् best among Brahmins, चित्रज्ञान् those who know painting, वृत्तसूत्रज्ञान् those who know conduct and aphorisms, गीतनृत्यविशारदान् those skilled in singing and dancing.
explanation: He gathered the best among Brahmins who were experts in prosody, Puranas, and Vedas, along with those skilled in painting, conduct, aphorisms, singing, and dancing.

shloka_text: शास्त्रज्ञान्नीतिनिपुणान्वेदान्तार्थप्रबोधकान् । एतान्सर्वान्समानीय गातारौ समवेशयत् ।। 7.94.10 ।।
transliteration: śāstrajñānnītinipuṇānvedāntārthaprabodhakān | etānsarvānsamānīya gātārau samaveśayat || 7.94.10 ||
translation: शास्त्रज्ञान् those who know scriptures, नीतिनिपुणान् those skilled in ethics, वेदान्तार्थप्रबोधकान् those who enlighten on the meaning of Vedanta, एतान् these, सर्वान् all, समानीय having assembled, गातारौ the two singers, समवेशयत् he seated.
explanation: Having assembled all these individuals who were knowledgeable in scriptures, skilled in ethics, and capable of explaining the meaning of Vedanta, he then seated the two singers (Lava and Kusha) among them.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा मुनिगणाः सर्वे पार्थिवाश्च महौजसः । पिबन्त इव चक्षुर्भ्यां राजानं गायकौ च तौ ।। 7.94.11 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā munigaṇāḥ sarve pārthivāśca mahaujasaḥ | pibanta iva cakṣurbhyāṃ rājānaṃ gāyakau ca tau || 7.94.11 ||
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, मुनिगणाः groups of sages, सर्वे all, पार्थिवाश्च and kings, महौजसः of great might, पिबन्त इव as if drinking, चक्षुर्भ्यां with their eyes, राजानं the king (Rama), गायकौ the two singers, च and, तौ those two
explanation: All the sages and mighty kings, having seen the king and those two singers, were as if drinking them in with their eyes.

shloka_text: ऊचुः परस्परं चेदं सर्व एव समन्ततः । उभौ रामस्य सदृशौ बिम्बाद्बिम्बमिवोत्थितौ ।। 7.94.12 ।।
transliteration: ūcuḥ parasparaṃ cedaṃ sarva eva samantataḥ | ubhau rāmasya sadṛśau bimbādbimbamivotthitau || 7.94.12 ||
translation: ऊचुः they said, परस्परं to each other, च and, इदं this, सर्वे all, एव indeed, समन्ततः from all sides, उभौ both, रामस्य of Rama, सदृशौ similar, बिम्बात् from an image, बिम्बमिव like an image, उत्थितौ arisen
explanation: All of them, from all sides, said this to each other: "Both are similar to Rama, as if one image has arisen from another."

shloka_text: जटिलौ यदि न स्यातां न वल्कलधरौ यदि । विशेषं नाधिगच्छामो गायतो राघवस्य च ।। 7.94.13 ।।
transliteration: jaṭilau yadi na syātāṃ na valkaladharau yadi | viśeṣaṃ nādhigacchāmo gāyato rāghavasya ca || 7.94.13 ||
translation: जटिलौ having matted hair, यदि if, न स्यातां they were not, न not, वल्कलधरौ wearing bark garments, यदि if, विशेषं difference, न not, अधिगच्छामः we would perceive, गायतोः between the two singers, राघवस्य of Rama, च and
explanation: If they did not have matted hair and were not wearing bark garments, we would not perceive any difference between the two singers and Rama.

shloka_text: तेषां संवदतामेवं श्रोतऽणां हर्षवर्धनम् । गेयं प्रचक्रतुस्तत्र तावुभौ मुनिदारकौ ।। 7.94.14 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ saṃvadatāmevaṃ śrota'ṇāṃ harṣavardhanam | geyaṃ pracakratustatra tāvubhau munidārakau || 7.94.14 ||
translation: तेषां of them, संवदतां conversing, एवं thus, श्रोतऽणां of the listeners, हर्षवर्धनम् increasing joy, गेयं the song, प्रचक्रतुः they performed, तत्र there, तौ those, उभौ two, मुनिदारकौ sons of the sage
explanation: While they were conversing thus, those two sons of the sage performed the song there, which increased the joy of the listeners.

shloka_text: ततः प्रवृत्तं मधुरं गान्धर्वमतिमानुषम् । न च तृप्तिं ययुः सर्वे श्रोतारो गानसम्पदा ।। 7.94.15 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pravṛttaṃ madhuraṃ gāndharvamatimānuṣam | na ca tṛptiṃ yayuḥ sarve śrotāro gānasampadā || 7.94.15 ||
translation: ततः then, प्रवृत्तं commenced, मधुरं sweet, गान्धर्वं music (Gandharva style), अतिमानुषम् superhuman, न not, च and, तृप्तिं satisfaction, ययुः they attained, सर्वे all, श्रोतारः listeners, गानसम्पदा from the richness of the song
explanation: Then commenced the sweet, superhuman Gandharva music, and all the listeners could not get enough of the richness of the song.

shloka_text: प्रवृत्तमादितः पूर्वसर्गं नारददर्शितम् । ततः प्रभृति सर्गांश्च यावद्विंशत्यगायताम् ।। 7.94.16 ।।
transliteration: pravṛttamāditaḥ pūrvasargaṃ nāradadarśitam | tataḥ prabhṛti sargāṃśca yāvadviṃśatyagāyatām || 7.94.16 ||
translation: प्रवृत्तम् begun, आदितः from the beginning, पूर्वसर्गम् the first canto, नारददर्शितम् revealed by Narada, ततः then, प्रभृति onwards, सर्गांश्च and the cantos, यावत् up to, विंशति twenty, अगायताम् they sang.
explanation: They sang the Ramayana, starting from the first canto revealed by Narada, and continued singing up to the twentieth canto.

shloka_text: ततो ऽपराह्णसमये राघवः समभाषत । श्रुत्वा विंशतिसर्गांस्तान्भ्रातरं भ्रातृवत्सलः ।। 7.94.17 ।।
transliteration: tato 'parāhṇasamaye rāghavaḥ samabhāṣata | śrutvā viṃśatisargāṃstānbhrātaraṃ bhrātṛvatsalaḥ || 7.94.17 ||
translation: ततः then, अपराह्णसमये in the afternoon time, राघवः Rama, समभाषत spoke, श्रुत्वा having heard, विंशतिसर्गांस्तान् those twenty cantos, भ्रातरं to his brother, भ्रातृवत्सलः affectionate towards his brothers.
explanation: After hearing those twenty cantos, Rama, who was affectionate towards his brothers, spoke to his brother in the afternoon.

shloka_text: अष्टादशसहस्राणि सुवर्णस्य महात्मनोः । प्रयच्छ शीघ्रं काकुत्स्थ यदन्यदभिकाङ्क्षितम् । ददौ शीघ्रं स काकुत्स्थो बालयोर्वै पृथक्पृथक् ।। 7.94.18 ।।
transliteration: aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi suvarṇasya mahātmanoḥ | prayaccha śīghraṃ kākutstha yadanyadabhikāṅkṣitam | dadau śīghraṃ sa kākutstho bālayorvai pṛthakpṛthak || 7.94.18 ||
translation: अष्टादशसहस्राणि eighteen thousand, सुवर्णस्य of gold, महात्मनोः to the great-souled ones, प्रयच्छ give, शीघ्रं quickly, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, यत् whatever, अन्यत् other, अभिकाङ्क्षितम् is desired; ददौ he gave, शीघ्रं quickly, स he, काकुत्स्थो Kakutstha, बालयोर्वै to the two boys indeed, पृथक्पृथक् separately.
explanation: Rama instructed his brother, "O Kakutstha, quickly give eighteen thousand gold coins to these great-souled ones, and whatever else they desire," and his brother promptly gave the two boys their shares separately.

shloka_text: दीयमानं सुवर्णं तु नागृह्णीतां कुशीलवौ । ऊचतुश्च महात्मानौ किमनेनेति विस्मितौ ।। 7.94.19 ।।
transliteration: dīyamānaṃ suvarṇaṃ tu nāgṛhṇītāṃ kuśīlavau | ūcatuśca mahātmānau kimaneneti vismitau || 7.94.19 ||
translation: दीयमानं being given, सुवर्णं gold, तु but, नागृह्णीतां did not accept, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava, ऊचतुश्च and they said, महात्मानौ the two great-souled ones, किम् what, अनेन with this, इति thus, विस्मितौ astonished.
explanation: But Kusha and Lava, the two great-souled boys, did not accept the gold being offered, and astonished, they asked, "What shall we do with this?"

shloka_text: वन्येन फलमूलेन निरतौ वनवासिनौ । सुवर्णेन हिरण्येन किं करिष्यावहे वने ।। 7.94.20 ।।
transliteration: vanyena phalamūlena niratau vanavāsinau | suvarṇena hiraṇyena kiṃ kariṣyāvahe vane || 7.94.20 ||
translation: वन्येन with forest produce, फलमूलेन with fruits and roots, निरतौ content, वनवासिनौ we two forest dwellers, सुवर्णेन with gold, हिरण्येन with gold, किं what, करिष्यावहे shall we do, वने in the forest.
explanation: As forest dwellers content with forest produce, fruits, and roots, they questioned what they would do with gold in the forest.

shloka_text: तथा तयोः प्रब्रुवतोः कौतूहलसमन्विताः । श्रोतारश्चैव रामश्च सर्व एव सुविस्मिताः ।। 7.94.21 ।।
transliteration: tathā tayoḥ prabruvatoḥ kautūhalasamanvitāḥ | śrotāraścaiva rāmaśca sarva eva suvismitāḥ || 7.94.21 ||
translation: तथा thus, तयोः of those two, प्रब्रुवतोः while speaking, कौतूहलसमन्विताः filled with curiosity, श्रोतारः the listeners, च and, एव indeed, रामः Rama, च and, सर्व all, एव indeed, सुविस्मिताः greatly astonished.
explanation: As those two (Lava and Kusha) recited, all the listeners, including Rama, were filled with curiosity and greatly astonished.

shloka_text: तस्य चैवागमं रामः काव्यस्य श्रोतुमुत्सुकः । पप्रच्छ तौ महातेजास्तावुभौ मुनिदारकौ ।। 7.94.22 ।।
transliteration: tasya caivāgamaṃ rāmaḥ kāvyasya śrotumutsukaḥ | papraccha tau mahātejāstāvubhau munidārakau || 7.94.22 ||
translation: तस्य of that, च and, एव indeed, आगमम् origin, रामः Rama, काव्यस्य of the poem, श्रोतुम् to hear, उत्सुकः eager, पप्रच्छ asked, तौ those two, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent one, तौ those, उभौ both, मुनिदारकौ sons of the sage.
explanation: The greatly effulgent Rama, eager to hear about the origin of that poem, questioned both those young ascetics.

shloka_text: किम्प्रमाणमिदं काव्यं का प्रतिष्ठा महात्मनः । कर्ता काव्यस्य महतः क्व चासौ मुनिपुङ्गवः ।। 7.94.23 ।।
transliteration: kimpramāṇamidaṃ kāvyaṃ kā pratiṣṭhā mahātmanaḥ | kartā kāvyasya mahataḥ kva cāsau munipuṅgavaḥ || 7.94.23 ||
translation: किम्प्रमाणम् of what measure, इदम् this, काव्यम् poem, का what, प्रतिष्ठा fame, महात्मनः of the great soul, कर्ता the author, काव्यस्य of the poem, महतः great, क्व where, च and, असौ that, मुनिपुङ्गवः foremost among sages.
explanation: Rama inquired about the length of this poem, the fame of its great author, and the whereabouts of that foremost sage who composed this great work.

shloka_text: पृच्छन्तं राघवं वाक्यमूचतुर्मुनिदारकौ ।। 7.94.24 ।।
transliteration: pṛcchantaṃ rāghavaṃ vākyamūcaturmunidārakau || 7.94.24 ||
translation: पृच्छन्तम् to the questioning one, राघवम् to Rama, वाक्यम् words, ऊचतुः spoke, मुनिदारकौ the sons of the sage.
explanation: The sons of the sage then spoke words to Rama, who was questioning them.

shloka_text: वाल्मीकिर्भगवान्कर्ता सम्प्राप्तो यज्ञसंविधम् । येनेदं चरितं तुभ्यमशेषं सम्प्रदर्शितम् ।। 7.94.25 ।।
transliteration: vālmīkirbhagavānkartā samprāpto yajñasaṃvidham | yenedaṃ caritaṃ tubhyamaśeṣaṃ sampradarśitam || 7.94.25 ||
translation: वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, भगवान् the revered, कर्ता the author, सम्प्राप्तः has arrived, यज्ञसंविधम् to the sacrificial assembly, येन by whom, इदम् this, चरितम् story, तुभ्यम् to you, अशेषम् completely, सम्प्रदर्शितम् has been shown.
explanation: The revered Valmiki, the author, has arrived at this sacrificial assembly, and it is by him that this entire story has been revealed to you.

shloka_text: सन्निबद्धं हि श्लोकानां चतुर्विशत्सहस्रकम् । उपाख्यानशतं चैव भार्गवेण तपस्विना ।। 7.94.26 ।।
transliteration: sannibaddhaṃ hi ślokānāṃ caturviśatsahasrakam | upākhyānaśataṃ caiva bhārgaveṇa tapasvinā || 7.94.26 ||
translation: सन्निबद्धं composed, हि indeed, श्लोकानां of verses, चतुर्विशत्सहस्रकम् twenty-four thousand, उपाख्यानशतं a hundred episodes, च and, एव indeed, भार्गवेण by Bhrigu's descendant (Valmiki), तपस्विना by the ascetic.
explanation: This epic, consisting of twenty-four thousand verses and a hundred sub-stories, was indeed composed by the ascetic Valmiki.

shloka_text: आदिप्रभृति वै राजन्पञ्चसर्गशतानि च । काण्डानि षट् कृतानीह सोत्तराणि महात्मना । कृतानि गुरुणास्माकमृषिणा चरितं तव ।। 7.94.27 ।।
transliteration: ādiprabhṛti vai rājanpañcasargaśatāni ca | kāṇḍāni ṣaṭ kṛtānīha sottarāṇi mahātmanā | kṛtāni guruṇāsmākamṛṣiṇā caritaṃ tava || 7.94.27 ||
translation: आदिप्रभृति from the beginning, वै indeed, राजन् O King, पञ्चसर्गशतानि five hundred sargas, च and, काण्डानि sections, षट् six, कृतानीह have been made here, सोत्तराणि with the Uttara Kanda, महात्मना by the great soul, कृतानि composed, गुरुणा by the preceptor, अस्माकम् our, ऋषिणा by the sage, चरितं the deeds, तव your.
explanation: O King, from the very beginning, this work, comprising five hundred sargas and six sections including the Uttara Kanda, has been composed here by our great sage and preceptor, detailing your deeds.

shloka_text: प्रतिष्ठा ऽ ऽजीवितं यावत्तावत्सर्वस्य वर्तते ।। 7.94.28 ।।
transliteration: pratiṣṭhā ' 'jīvitaṃ yāvattāvatsarvasya vartate || 7.94.28 ||
translation: प्रतिष्ठा fame, आजीवितं as long as life, यावत् as long as, तावत् so long, सर्वस्य of everyone, वर्तते exists.
explanation: As long as life exists, so long will the fame of this work endure for everyone.

shloka_text: सोत्तराणि महात्मना । यदि बुद्धिः कृता राजञ्छ्रवणाय महारथ । कर्मान्तरे क्षणीभूतस्तच्छृणुष्व सहानुजः ।। 7.94.29 ।।
transliteration: sottarāṇi mahātmanā | yadi buddhiḥ kṛtā rājañchravaṇāya mahāratha | karmāntare kṣaṇībhūtastacchṛṇuṣva sahānujaḥ || 7.94.29 ||
translation: सोत्तराणि with the Uttara Kanda, महात्मना by the great soul, यदि if, बुद्धिः intention, कृता made, राजन् O King, श्रवणाय for listening, महारथ O great warrior, कर्मान्तरे in the interval of work, क्षणीभूतः having found a moment, तत् that, शृणुष्व listen, सहानुजः with your younger brothers.
explanation: O King, O great warrior, if you have formed the intention to listen to this work, including the Uttara Kanda, composed by the great soul, then find a moment during your work interval and listen to it with your younger brothers.

shloka_text: बाढमित्यब्रवीद्रामस्तौ चानुज्ञाप्य राघवम् । प्रहृष्टौ जग्मतुः स्थानं यत्रास्ते मुनिपुङ्गवः ।। 7.94.30 ।।
transliteration: bāḍhamityabravīdrāmastau cānujñāpya rāghavam | prahṛṣṭau jagmatuḥ sthānaṃ yatrāste munipuṅgavaḥ || 7.94.30 ||
translation: बाढम् certainly, इति thus, अब्रवीत् said, रामः Rama, तौ those two, च and, अनुज्ञाप्य having taken leave, राघवम् from Rama, प्रहृष्टौ delighted, जग्मतुः went, स्थानं to the place, यत्र where, आस्ते resides, मुनिपुङ्गवः the best of sages.
explanation: Rama said, "Certainly," and those two (Kusha and Lava), having taken leave from Rama, went delighted to the place where the best of sages (Valmiki) resided.

shloka_text: रामो ऽपि मुनिभिः सार्धं पार्थिवैश्च महात्मभिः । श्रुत्वा तद्गीतिमाधुर्यं कर्मशालामुपागमत् ।। 7.94.31 ।।
transliteration: rāmo 'pi munibhiḥ sārdhaṃ pārthivaiśca mahātmabhiḥ | śrutvā tadgītimādhuryaṃ karmaśālāmupāgamat || 7.94.31 ||
translation: रामो Rama, अपि also, मुनिभिः with sages, सार्धम् together, पार्थिवैः with kings, च and, महात्मभिः great-souled, श्रुत्वा having heard, तत् their, गीतिमाधुर्यम् sweetness of song, कर्मशालाम् to the sacrificial hall, उपागमत् approached.
explanation: Rama, accompanied by great-souled sages and kings, approached the sacrificial hall after hearing the sweetness of their song.

shloka_text: शुश्राव तत्ताललयोपपन्नं सर्गान्वितं स स्वरशब्दयुक्तम् । तन्त्रीलयव्यञ्जनयोगयुक्तं कुशीलवाभ्यां परिगीयमानम् ।। 7.94.32 ।।
transliteration: śuśrāva tattālalayopapannaṃ sargānvitaṃ sa svaraśabdayuktam | tantrīlayavyañjanayogayuktaṃ kuśīlavābhyāṃ parigīyamānam || 7.94.32 ||
translation: शुश्राव he heard, तत् that, ताललयोपपन्नम् endowed with rhythm and tempo, सर्गान्वितम् containing cantos, स with, स्वरशब्दयुक्तम् endowed with notes and words, तन्त्रीलयव्यञ्जनयोगयुक्तम् endowed with the harmony of string instruments and clear articulation, कुशीलवाभ्याम् by Kusha and Lava, परिगीयमानम् being sung.
explanation: He heard that song, which was endowed with rhythm and tempo, contained cantos, was rich in notes and words, and harmonized with string instruments and clear articulation, being sung by Kusha and Lava. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुर्नवतितमः सर्गः ।। 94 ।। Thus ends the ninety-fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: रामो बहून्यहान्येवं तद्गीतं परमं शुभम् । शुश्राव मुनिभिः सार्धं पार्थिवैः सह वानरैः ।। 7.95.1 ।।
transliteration: rāmo bahūnyahānyevaṃ tadgītaṃ paramaṃ śubham | śuśrāva munibhiḥ sārdhaṃ pārthivaiḥ saha vānaraiḥ || 7.95.1 ||
translation: रामो Rama, बहूनि many, अहानि days, एवम् thus, तत् that, गीतम् song, परमम् supreme, शुभम् auspicious, शुश्राव heard, मुनिभिः with sages, सार्धम् together, पार्थिवैः with kings, सह along with, वानरैः monkeys.
explanation: Rama thus heard that supremely auspicious song for many days, accompanied by sages, kings, and monkeys.
comments: Hearing the song day by day and recognizing Kusha and Lava as Sita's sons, Rama sends to Valmiki to ask that Sita, if pure, take an oath of purification before the assembly on the morrow -- Valmiki assents, and Rama announces it to the sages and kings, who applaud, before the gathering disperses for the morrow.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्गीते तु विज्ञाय सीतापुत्रौ कुशीलवौ । तस्याः परिषदो मध्ये रामो वचनमब्रवीत् । दूताञ्छुद्धसमाचारानाहूयात्ममनीषया ।। 7.95.2 ।।
transliteration: tasmingīte tu vijñāya sītāputrau kuśīlavau | tasyāḥ pariṣado madhye rāmo vacanamabravīt | dūtāñchuddhasamācārānāhūyātmamanīṣayā || 7.95.2 ||
translation: तस्मिन् in that, गीते song, तु indeed, विज्ञाय having recognized, सीतापुत्रौ the sons of Sita, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava, तस्याः of that, परिषदः assembly, मध्ये in the midst, रामो Rama, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, दूतान् messengers, शुद्धसमाचारान् of pure conduct, आहूय having called, आत्ममनीषया by his own intention.
explanation: Having recognized Kusha and Lava as Sita's sons through that song, Rama, by his own intention, called messengers of pure conduct and spoke words in the midst of that assembly.

shloka_text: मद्वचो ब्रूत गच्छध्वमितो भगवतो ऽन्तिकम् ।। 7.95.3 ।।
transliteration: madvaco brūta gacchadhvamito bhagavato 'ntikam || 7.95.3 ||
translation: मद्वचो my words, ब्रूत speak, गच्छध्वम् go, इतः from here, भगवतः of the revered one, अन्तिकम् to the presence.
explanation: He instructed them, "Go from here to the presence of the revered one (Valmiki) and speak my words."

shloka_text: परिषदो मध्ये रामो वचनमब्रवीत् । यदि शुद्धसमाचारा यदि वा वीतकल्मषा । करोत्विहात्मनः शुद्धिमनुमान्य महामुनिम् ।। 7.95.4 ।।
transliteration: pariṣado madhye rāmo vacanamabravīt | yadi śuddhasamācārā yadi vā vītakalmaṣā | karotvihātmanaḥ śuddhimanumānya mahāmunim || 7.95.4 ||
translation: परिषदो of the assembly, मध्ये in the midst, रामः Rama, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, यदि if, शुद्धसमाचारा of pure conduct, यदि if, वा or, वीतकल्मषा free from sin, करोतु let her perform, इह here, आत्मनः of herself, शुद्धिम् purification, अनुमान्य having obtained permission from, महामुनिम् the great sage.
explanation: In the midst of the assembly, Rama spoke, saying that if Sita is of pure conduct or free from sin, she should perform her purification here, having obtained the great sage's permission.

shloka_text: छन्दं मुनेश्च विज्ञाय सीतायाश्च मनोगतम् । प्रत्ययं दातुकामायास्ततः शंसत मे लघु ।। 7.95.5 ।।
transliteration: chandaṃ muneśca vijñāya sītāyāśca manogatam | pratyayaṃ dātukāmāyāstataḥ śaṃsata me laghu || 7.95.5 ||
translation: छन्दम् the wish, मुनेः of the sage, च and, विज्ञाय having known, सीतायाः of Sita, च and, मनोगतम् the thought in her mind, प्रत्ययम् proof, दातुकामायाः who wishes to give, ततः then, शंसत tell, मे to me, लघु quickly.
explanation: Having understood the wish of the sage and the thought in Sita's mind, who desires to give proof, then quickly report it to me.

shloka_text: श्वः प्रभाते तु शपथं मैथिली जनकात्मजा । करोतु परिषन्मध्ये शोधनार्थं ममैव च ।। 7.95.6 ।।
transliteration: śvaḥ prabhāte tu śapathaṃ maithilī janakātmajā | karotu pariṣanmadhye śodhanārthaṃ mamaiva ca || 7.95.6 ||
translation: श्वः tomorrow, प्रभाते in the morning, तु indeed, शपथम् an oath, मैथिली Maithili, जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, करोतु let her perform, परिषन्मध्ये in the midst of the assembly, शोधनार्थम् for the sake of purification, मम my, एव indeed, च and.
explanation: Let Maithili, Janaka's daughter, perform an oath tomorrow morning in the midst of the assembly for her own purification and indeed for mine.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा तु ऱागवस्यैतद्वचः परममद्भुतम् । दूताः सम्प्रययुर्बाटं यत्रास्ते मुनिपुङ्गवः ।। 7.95.7 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu ऱ्āgavasyaitadvacaḥ paramamadbhutam | dūtāḥ samprayayurbāṭaṃ yatrāste munipuṅgavaḥ || 7.95.7 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, राघवस्य of Rama, एतत् this, वचः word, परमम् most, अद्भुतम् wonderful, दूताः messengers, सम्प्रययुः went forth, बाटम् to the hermitage, यत्र where, आस्ते resides, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages.
explanation: Having heard this most wonderful speech of Rama, the messengers went forth to the hermitage where the foremost among sages, Valmiki, resided.

shloka_text: ते प्रणम्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तममितप्रभम् । ऊचुस्ते रामवाक्यानि मृदूनि मधुराणि च ।। 7.95.8 ।।
transliteration: te praṇamya mahātmānaṃ jvalantamamitaprabham | ūcuste rāmavākyāni mṛdūni madhurāṇi ca || 7.95.8 ||
translation: ते they, प्रणम्य having bowed down to, महात्मानम् the great soul, ज्वलन्तम् shining, अमितप्रभम् of immeasurable splendor, ऊचुः they spoke, ते those, रामवाक्यानि Rama's words, मृदूनि soft, मधुराणि sweet, च and.
explanation: Having bowed down to the great soul, who was shining with immeasurable splendor, they spoke Rama's words, which were both soft and sweet.

shloka_text: तेषां तद्व्याहृतं श्रुत्वा रामस्य च मनोगतम् । विज्ञाय सुमहातेजा मुनिर्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।। 7.95.9 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ tadvyāhṛtaṃ śrutvā rāmasya ca manogatam | vijñāya sumahātejā munirvākyamathābravīt || 7.95.9 ||
translation: तेषां their, तद्व्याहृतं their words, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामस्य of Rama, च and, मनोगतम् his intention, विज्ञाय having understood, सुमहातेजा the greatly effulgent, मुनिः sage, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having heard their words and understood Rama's intention, the greatly effulgent sage Valmiki then spoke.

shloka_text: एवं भवतु भद्रं वो यथा वदति राघवः । तथा करिष्यते सीता दैवतं हि पतिः स्त्रियाः ।। 7.95.10 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ bhavatu bhadraṃ vo yathā vadati rāghavaḥ | tathā kariṣyate sītā daivataṃ hi patiḥ striyāḥ || 7.95.10 ||
translation: एवं thus, भवतु let it be, भद्रं good fortune, वः to you, यथा as, वदति speaks, राघवः Rama, तथा so, करिष्यते will do, सीता Sita, दैवतं deity, हि indeed, पतिः husband, स्त्रियाः of a woman.
explanation: Let it be so, good fortune to you, as Rama speaks, so will Sita do, for indeed, a husband is the deity of a woman.

shloka_text: तथोक्ता मुनिना सर्वे राजदूता महौजसम् । प्रत्येत्य राघवं क्षिप्रं मुनिवाक्यं बभाषिरे ।। 7.95.11 ।।
transliteration: tathoktā muninā sarve rājadūtā mahaujasam | pratyetya rāghavaṃ kṣipraṃ munivākyaṃ babhāṣire || 7.95.11 ||
translation: तथा thus, उक्ताः spoken to, मुनिना by the sage, सर्वे all, राजदूताः royal messengers, प्रत्येत्य having returned, राघवं to Rama, क्षिप्रं quickly, मुनिवाक्यं the sage's words, बभाषिरे spoke, महौजसम् to the greatly powerful one.
explanation: All the royal messengers, thus addressed by the sage, quickly returned to the greatly powerful Rama and conveyed the sage's words.

shloka_text: ततः प्रहृष्टः काकुत्स्थः श्रुत्वा वाक्यं महात्मनः । ऋषींस्तत्र समेतांश्च राज्ञश्चैवाभ्यभाषत ।। 7.95.12 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ kākutsthaḥ śrutvā vākyaṃ mahātmanaḥ | ṛṣīṃstatra sametāṃśca rājñaścaivābhyabhāṣata || 7.95.12 ||
translation: ततः then, प्रहृष्टः delighted, काकुत्स्थः Rama, श्रुत्वा having heard, वाक्यं the words, महात्मनः of the great soul, ऋषीन् to the sages, तत्र there, समेतान् assembled, च and, राज्ञः to the kings, च and, एव indeed, अभ्यभाषत addressed.
explanation: Then, greatly delighted after hearing the words of the great soul Valmiki, Rama addressed the sages and kings assembled there.

shloka_text: भगवन्तः सशिष्या वै सानुगाश्च नराधिपाः । पश्यन्तु सीताशपथं यश्चैवान्यो ऽपि काङ्क्षते ।। 7.95.13 ।।
transliteration: bhagavantaḥ saśiṣyā vai sānugāśca narādhipāḥ | paśyantu sītāśapathaṃ yaścaivānyo 'pi kāṅkṣate || 7.95.13 ||
translation: भगवन्तः O revered ones, सशिष्याः with disciples, वै indeed, सानुगाः with followers, च and, नराधिपाः O kings, पश्यन्तु let them see, सीताशपथं Sita's oath, यः who, च and, एव indeed, अन्यः other, अपि also, काङ्क्षते desires.
explanation: O revered sages with your disciples, and O kings with your followers, let all who desire witness Sita's oath.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राघवस्य महात्मनः । सर्वेषामृषिमुख्यानां साधुवादो महानभूत् ।। 7.95.14 ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ | sarveṣāmṛṣimukhyānāṃ sādhuvādo mahānabhūt || 7.95.14 ||
translation: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनं speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, राघवस्य of Rama, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, सर्वेषाम् of all, ऋषिमुख्यानां of the chief sages, साधुवादो applause, महान् great, अभूत् was.
explanation: Having heard the words of the great-souled Rama, a great acclamation arose from all the chief sages.

shloka_text: राजानश्च महात्मानः प्रशंसन्ति स्म राघवम् । उपपन्नं नरश्रेष्ठ त्वय्येव भुवि नान्यतः ।। 7.95.15 ।।
transliteration: rājānaśca mahātmānaḥ praśaṃsanti sma rāghavam | upapannaṃ naraśreṣṭha tvayyeva bhuvi nānyataḥ || 7.95.15 ||
translation: राजानश्च and kings, महात्मानः great-souled ones, प्रशंसन्ति स्म praised, राघवम् Rama, उपपन्नं fitting, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, त्वय्येव in you alone, भुवि on earth, नान्यतः not elsewhere.
explanation: The great-souled kings also praised Rama, saying, "O best among men, this is fitting only in you on earth, and not in anyone else."

shloka_text: एवं विनिश्चयं कृत्वा श्वोभूत इति राघवः । विसर्जयामास तदा सर्वांस्ताञ्छत्रुसूदनः ।। 7.95.16 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ viniścayaṃ kṛtvā śvobhūta iti rāghavaḥ | visarjayāmāsa tadā sarvāṃstāñchatrusūdanaḥ || 7.95.16 ||
translation: एवं thus, विनिश्चयं decision, कृत्वा having made, श्वोभूत tomorrow, इति thus, राघवः Rama, विसर्जयामास dismissed, तदा then, सर्वान् all, तान् them, शत्रुसूदनः the destroyer of enemies.
explanation: Having thus made the decision for "tomorrow," Rama, the destroyer of enemies, then dismissed all of them.

shloka_text: इति सम्प्रविचार्य राजसिंहः श्वोभूते शपथस्य निश्चयं वै । विससर्ज मुनीन्नृपांश्च सर्वान्स महात्मा महतो महानुभावः ।। 7.95.17 ।।
transliteration: iti sampravicārya rājasiṃhaḥ śvobhūte śapathasya niścayaṃ vai | visasarja munīnnṛpāṃśca sarvānsa mahātmā mahato mahānubhāvaḥ || 7.95.17 ||
translation: इति thus, सम्प्रविचार्य having deliberated well, राजसिंहः the lion among kings, श्वोभूते on the morrow, शपथस्य of the oath, निश्चयं decision, वै indeed, विससर्ज dismissed, मुनीन् the sages, नृपांश्च and the kings, सर्वान् all, स he, महात्मा the great-souled one, महतो great, महानुभावः of great power.
explanation: Having thus deliberated well and made the decision for the oath on the morrow, that great-souled king, the lion among kings and one of great power, dismissed all the sages and kings. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चनवतितमः सर्ग ।। 95 ।। Thus ends the ninety-fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तस्यां रजन्यां व्युष्टायां यज्ञवाटगतो नृपः । ऋषीन्सर्वान्महातेजाः शब्दापयति राघवः ।। 7.96.1 ।।
transliteration: tasyāṃ rajanyāṃ vyuṣṭāyāṃ yajñavāṭagato nṛpaḥ | ṛṣīnsarvānmahātejāḥ śabdāpayati rāghavaḥ || 7.96.1 ||
translation: तस्यां in that, रजन्यां night, व्युष्टायां having dawned, यज्ञवाटगतो having gone to the sacrificial enclosure, नृपः the king, ऋषीन् the sages, सर्वान् all, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent one, शब्दापयति summons, राघवः Rama.
explanation: When that night had dawned, King Rama, the greatly effulgent one, having gone to the sacrificial enclosure, summoned all the sages.
comments: Next day the sages and a vast throng assemble to witness Sita's oath -- Valmiki leads in Sita, who follows with downcast face amid the crowd's acclaim, and declares that, though faultless, she was abandoned for fear of scandal, that her twin sons are Rama's, and swears by all his accumulated penance and his own sinlessness that she is pure.

shloka_text: वसिष्ठो वामदेवश्च जाबालिरथ काश्यपः । विश्वामित्रो दीर्घतपा दुर्वासाश्च महातपाः ।। 7.96.2 ।।
transliteration: vasiṣṭho vāmadevaśca jābāliratha kāśyapaḥ | viśvāmitro dīrghatapā durvāsāśca mahātapāḥ || 7.96.2 ||
translation: वसिष्ठो Vasistha, वामदेवश्च Vamadeva and, जाबालिरथ Jabali then, काश्यपः Kashyapa, विश्वामित्रो Vishwamitra, दीर्घतपा one of long penance, दुर्वासाश्च Durvasa and, महातपाः one of great penance
explanation: Vasistha, Vamadeva, Jabali, Kashyapa, Vishwamitra of great austerity, and Durvasa of great penance were present.

shloka_text: पुलस्त्यो ऽपि तथा शक्तिर्भार्गवश्चैव वामनः । मार्कण्डेयश्च दीर्घायुर्मौद्गल्यश्च महायशाः ।। 7.96.3 ।।
transliteration: pulastyo 'pi tathā śaktirbhārgavaścaiva vāmanaḥ | mārkaṇḍeyaśca dīrghāyurmaudgalyaśca mahāyaśāḥ || 7.96.3 ||
translation: पुलस्त्यो Pulastya, अपि also, तथा similarly, शक्तिः Shakti, भार्गवश्चैव Bhargava and indeed, वामनः Vamana, मार्कण्डेयश्च Markandeya and, दीर्घायुः long-lived, मौद्गल्यश्च Maudgalya and, महायशाः highly renowned
explanation: Pulastya, Shakti, Bhargava, Vamana, the long-lived Markandeya, and the highly renowned Maudgalya were also present.

shloka_text: गर्गश्च च्यवनश्चैव शतानन्दश्च धर्मवित् । भरद्वाजश्च तेजस्वी ह्यग्निपुत्रश्च सुप्रभः ।। 7.96.4 ।।
transliteration: gargaśca cyavanaścaiva śatānandaśca dharmavit | bharadvājaśca tejasvī hyagniputraśca suprabhaḥ || 7.96.4 ||
translation: गर्गश्च Garga and, च्यवनश्चैव Chyavana and indeed, शतानन्दश्च Shatananda and, धर्मवित् knower of dharma, भरद्वाजश्च Bharadvaja and, तेजस्वी radiant, ह्यग्निपुत्रश्च and Agniputra and, सुप्रभः very luminous
explanation: Garga, Chyavana, Shatananda the knower of dharma, the radiant Bharadvaja, and the brilliant Agniputra were also among them.

shloka_text: नारदः पर्वतश्चैव गौतमश्च महायशाः । कात्यायनः सुयज्ञश्च ह्यगस्त्यस्तपसां निधिः ।। 7.96.5 ।।
transliteration: nāradaḥ parvataścaiva gautamaśca mahāyaśāḥ | kātyāyanaḥ suyajñaśca hyagastyastapasāṃ nidhiḥ || 7.96.5 ||
translation: नारदः Narada, पर्वतश्चैव Parvata and indeed, गौतमश्च Gautama and, महायशाः highly renowned, कात्यायनः Katyayana, सुयज्ञश्च Suyajna and, ह्यगस्त्यः and Agastya, तपसां of austerities, निधिः a treasure
explanation: Narada, Parvata, the highly renowned Gautama, Katyayana, Suyajna, and Agastya, a treasure-house of austerities, were also present.

shloka_text: एते चान्ये च बहवो मुनयः संशितव्रताः । कौतूहलसमाविष्टाः सर्व एव समागताः ।। 7.96.6 ।।
transliteration: ete cānye ca bahavo munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ | kautūhalasamāviṣṭāḥ sarva eva samāgatāḥ || 7.96.6 ||
translation: एते these, च and, अन्ये others, च and, बहवो many, मुनयः sages, संशितव्रताः of firm vows, कौतूहलसमाविष्टाः filled with curiosity, सर्व all, एव indeed, समागताः assembled
explanation: These and many other sages of firm vows, all filled with curiosity, had assembled.

shloka_text: राक्षसाश्च महावीर्या वानराश्च महाबलाः । सर्व एव समाजग्मुर्महात्मानः कुतूहलात् ।। 7.96.7 ।।
transliteration: rākṣasāśca mahāvīryā vānarāśca mahābalāḥ | sarva eva samājagmurmahātmānaḥ kutūhalāt || 7.96.7 ||
translation: राक्षसाः demons, च and, महावीर्या exceedingly valorous, वानराः monkeys, च and, महाबलाः exceedingly strong, सर्वे all, एव indeed, समाजग्मुः assembled, महात्मानः great-souled ones, कुतूहलात् out of curiosity.
explanation: All the great-souled demons of immense valor and monkeys of great strength assembled there out of curiosity.

shloka_text: क्षत्रिया ये च शूद्राश्च वैश्याश्चैव सहस्रशः । नानादेशगताश्चैव ब्राह्मणाः संशितव्रताः ।। 7.96.8 ।।
transliteration: kṣatriyā ye ca śūdrāśca vaiśyāścaiva sahasraśaḥ | nānādeśagatāścaiva brāhmaṇāḥ saṃśitavratāḥ || 7.96.8 ||
translation: क्षत्रियाः Kshatriyas, ये who, च and, शूद्राः Shudras, च and, वैश्याः Vaishyas, च and, एव indeed, सहस्रशः by thousands, नानादेशगताः from various countries, च and, एव indeed, ब्राह्मणाः Brahmins, संशितव्रताः of firm vows.
explanation: Thousands of Kshatriyas, Shudras, and Vaishyas, along with Brahmins of firm vows from various countries, also gathered.

shloka_text: ज्ञाननिष्ठाः कर्मनिष्ठाः योगनिष्ठास्तथापरे । सीताशपथवीक्षार्थं सर्व एव समागताः ।। 7.96.9 ।।
transliteration: jñānaniṣṭhāḥ karmaniṣṭhāḥ yoganiṣṭhāstathāpare | sītāśapathavīkṣārthaṃ sarva eva samāgatāḥ || 7.96.9 ||
translation: ज्ञाननिष्ठाः devoted to knowledge, कर्मनिष्ठाः devoted to action, योगनिष्ठाः devoted to yoga, तथा and, अपरे others, सीताशपथवीक्षार्थम् for the purpose of witnessing Sita's oath, सर्वे all, एव indeed, समागताः assembled.
explanation: All these, including those devoted to knowledge, action, and yoga, had assembled there to witness Sita's oath.

shloka_text: तदा समागतं सर्वमश्मभूतमिवाचलम् । श्रुत्वा मुनिवरस्तूर्णं ससीतः समुपागमत् ।। 7.96.10 ।।
transliteration: tadā samāgataṃ sarvamaśmabhūtamivācalam | śrutvā munivarastūrṇaṃ sasītaḥ samupāgamat || 7.96.10 ||
translation: तदा then, समागतम् assembled, सर्वम् all, अश्मभूतम् like a stone, इव as if, अचलम् unmoving, श्रुत्वा having heard, मुनिवरः the best of sages, तूर्णं quickly, ससीतः with Sita, समुपागमत् approached.
explanation: Then, hearing that everyone had assembled and stood unmoving like a stone, the best of sages, Valmiki, quickly approached with Sita.

shloka_text: तमृषिं पृष्ठतः सीता त्वन्वगच्छदवाङ्मुखी । कृताञ्जलिर्बाष्पगला कृत्वा रामं मनोगतम् ।। 7.96.11 ।।
transliteration: tamṛṣiṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ sītā tvanvagacchadavāṅmukhī | kṛtāñjalirbāṣpagalā kṛtvā rāmaṃ manogatam || 7.96.11 ||
translation: तम् that, ऋषिम् sage, पृष्ठतः behind, सीता Sita, तु indeed, अन्वगच्छत् followed, अवाङ्मुखी with downcast face, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, बाष्पगला with a choked voice due to tears, कृत्वा having made, रामम् Rama, मनोगतम् present in her mind.
explanation: Sita, with a downcast face, folded hands, and a voice choked with tears, followed that sage from behind, having fixed Rama in her mind.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा श्रुतिमिवायान्तीं ब्रह्माणमनुगामिनीम् । वाल्मीकेः पृष्ठतः सीतां साधुवादो महानभूत् ।। 7.96.12 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā śrutimivāyāntīṃ brahmāṇamanugāminīm | vālmīkeḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ sītāṃ sādhuvādo mahānabhūt || 7.96.12 ||
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, श्रुतिम् इव like a Veda, आयान्तीम् coming, ब्रह्माणम् Brahma (Valmiki), अनुगामिनीम् following, वाल्मीकेः Valmiki's, पृष्ठतः behind, सीताम् Sita, साधुवादः applause, महान् great, अभूत् arose.
explanation: Upon seeing Sita following Valmiki, appearing like a Veda following Brahma, a great acclamation of "excellent" arose from the crowd.

shloka_text: ततो हलहलाशब्दः सर्वेषामेवमाबभौ । दुःखजन्मविशालेन शोकेनाकुलितात्मनाम् ।। 7.96.13 ।।
transliteration: tato halahalāśabdaḥ sarveṣāmevamābabhau | duḥkhajanmaviśālena śokenākulitātmanām || 7.96.13 ||
translation: ततः then, हलहलाशब्दः a tumultuous sound, सर्वेषाम् of all, एवम् thus, आबभौ appeared, दुःखजन्मविशालेन by the vast sorrow born of distress, शोकेन by sorrow, आकुलित agitated, आत्मनाम् whose minds were.
explanation: Then, a tumultuous clamor arose from all those whose minds were agitated by the vast sorrow born of their distress.

shloka_text: साधु रामेति केचित्तु साधु सीतेति चापरे । उभावेव च तत्रान्ये प्रेक्षकाः सम्प्रचुक्रुशुः ।। 7.96.14 ।।
transliteration: sādhu rāmeti kecittu sādhu sīteti cāpare | ubhāveva ca tatrānye prekṣakāḥ sampracukruśuḥ || 7.96.14 ||
translation: साधु राम इति "Excellent, Rama!" thus, केचित् तु some indeed, साधु सीता इति च "Excellent, Sita!" thus and, अपरे others, उभौ एव च both indeed and, तत्र there, अन्ये others, प्रेक्षकाः spectators, सम्प्रचुक्रुशुः loudly acclaimed.
explanation: Some spectators acclaimed, "Excellent, Rama!", others cried, "Excellent, Sita!", and still others there loudly praised both of them.

shloka_text: ततो मध्ये जनौघस्य प्रविश्य मुनिपुङ्गवः । सीतासहायो वाल्मीकिरिति होवाच राघवम् ।। 7.96.15 ।।
transliteration: tato madhye janaughasya praviśya munipuṅgavaḥ | sītāsahāyo vālmīkiriti hovāca rāghavam || 7.96.15 ||
translation: ततः then, मध्ये in the midst, जनौघस्य of the multitude of people, प्रविश्य having entered, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost of sages, सीतासहायः accompanied by Sita, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, इति thus, ह indeed, उवाच spoke, राघवम् to Rama.
explanation: Then, having entered the midst of the multitude of people, Valmiki, the foremost of sages, accompanied by Sita, spoke thus to Rama.

shloka_text: इयं दाशरथे सीता सुव्रता धर्मचारिणी । अपवादैः परित्यक्ता ममाश्रमसमीपतः ।। 7.96.16 ।।
transliteration: iyaṃ dāśarathe sītā suvratā dharmacāriṇī | apavādaiḥ parityaktā mamāśramasamīpataḥ || 7.96.16 ||
translation: इयम् this, दाशरथे O son of Dasharatha, सीता Sita, सुव्रता of excellent vows, धर्मचारिणी practicing righteousness, अपवादैः by slanders, परित्यक्ता abandoned, मम my, आश्रम hermitage, समीपतः near.
explanation: O son of Dasharatha, this is Sita, virtuous and righteous, who was abandoned near my hermitage due to public slanders.

shloka_text: लोकापवादभीतस्य तव राम महाव्रत । प्रत्ययं दास्यते सीता तदनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ।। 7.96.17 ।।
transliteration: lokāpavādabhītasya tava rāma mahāvrata | pratyayaṃ dāsyate sītā tadanujñātumarhasi || 7.96.17 ||
translation: लोकापवादभीतस्य of one fearful of public scandal, तव your, राम O Rama, महाव्रत O great vow-keeper, प्रत्ययम् proof, दास्यते will give, सीता Sita, तत् that, अनुज्ञातुम् to permit, अर्हसि you ought.
explanation: O Rama, keeper of great vows, you who are fearful of public scandal, Sita will provide proof, and you ought to permit her to do so.

shloka_text: इमौ तु जानकीपुत्रावुभौ च यमजातकौ । सुतौ तवैव दुर्धर्षौ सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते ।। 7.96.18 ।।
transliteration: imau tu jānakīputrāvubhau ca yamajātakau | sutau tavaiva durdharṣau satyametadbravīmi te || 7.96.18 ||
translation: इमौ these two, तु indeed, जानकीपुत्रावुभौ both sons of Janaki, च and, यमजातकौ born as twins, सुतौ sons, तव your, एव indeed, दुर्धर्षौ formidable, सत्यम् truth, एतत् this, ब्रवीमि I speak, ते to you.
explanation: These two formidable sons, born as twins to Janaki, are indeed your own sons, and I speak this truth to you.

shloka_text: प्रचेतसो ऽहं दशमः पुत्रो राघवनन्दन । न स्मराम्यनृतं वाक्यमिमौ तु तव पुत्रकौ ।। 7.96.19 ।।
transliteration: pracetaso 'haṃ daśamaḥ putro rāghavanandana | na smarāmyanṛtaṃ vākyamimau tu tava putrakau || 7.96.19 ||
translation: प्रचेतसः of Prachetas, अहम् I, दशमः tenth, पुत्रः son, राघवनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, न not, स्मरामि I remember, अनृतम् untruth, वाक्यम् a word, इमौ these two, तु indeed, तव your, पुत्रकौ sons.
explanation: O delight of the Raghus, I am the tenth son of Prachetas, and I have never uttered a lie; these two are indeed your sons.

shloka_text: बहुवर्षसहस्राणि तपश्चर्या मया कृता । नोपाश्नीयां फलं तस्या दुष्टेयं यदि मैथिली ।। 7.96.20 ।।
transliteration: bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi tapaścaryā mayā kṛtā | nopāśnīyāṃ phalaṃ tasyā duṣṭeyaṃ yadi maithilī || 7.96.20 ||
translation: बहुवर्षसहस्राणि many thousands of years, तपश्चर्या penance, मया by me, कृता performed, न not, उपाश्नीयाम् I would enjoy, फलम् the fruit, तस्याः of that, दुष्टा impure, इयम् this, यदि if, मैथिली Maithili.
explanation: If this Maithili were impure, I would not partake of the fruit of the penance that I have performed for many thousands of years.

shloka_text: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा भूतपूर्वं न किल्बिषम् । तस्याः फलमुपाश्नीयामपापा मैथिली यदि ।। 7.96.21 ।।
transliteration: manasā karmaṇā vācā bhūtapūrvaṃ na kilbiṣam | tasyāḥ phalamupāśnīyāmapāpā maithilī yadi || 7.96.21 ||
translation: मनसा by mind, कर्मणा by action, वाचा by speech, भूतपूर्वम् ever before, न not, किल्बिषम् sin, तस्याः of that (sinlessness), फलम् the fruit, उपाश्नीयाम् I would enjoy, अपापा sinless, मैथिली Maithili, यदि if.
explanation: If Maithili is sinless, then may I enjoy the fruit of never having committed any sin by thought, word, or deed.

shloka_text: अहं पञ्चसु भूतेषु मनष्षष्ठेषु राघव । विचिन्त्य सीतां शुद्धेति जग्राह वननिर्झरे ।। 7.96.22 ।।
transliteration: ahaṃ pañcasu bhūteṣu manaṣṣaṣṭheṣu rāghava | vicintya sītāṃ śuddheti jagrāha vananirjhare || 7.96.22 ||
translation: अहं I, पञ्चसु among the five, भूतेषु elements, मनष्षष्ठेषु with mind as the sixth, राघव O Raghava, विचिन्त्य having considered, सीतां Sita, शुद्धेति as pure, जग्राह I accepted, वननिर्झरे in the forest stream.
explanation: O Raghava, I, who am present in the five elements and the mind as the sixth, accepted Sita as pure, having considered her in the forest stream.

shloka_text: इयं शुद्धसमाचारा अपापा पतिदेवता । लोकापवादभीतस्य प्रत्ययं तव दास्यति ।। 7.96.23 ।।
transliteration: iyaṃ śuddhasamācārā apāpā patidevatā | lokāpavādabhītasya pratyayaṃ tava dāsyati || 7.96.23 ||
translation: इयं This, शुद्धसमाचारा of pure conduct, अपापा sinless, पतिदेवता devoted to her husband as a deity, लोकापवादभीतस्य of one who fears public scandal, प्रत्ययं conviction, तव to you, दास्यति will give.
explanation: This Sita, who is of pure conduct, sinless, and devoted to her husband as a deity, will provide conviction to you, who feared public scandal.

shloka_text: तस्मादियं नरवरात्मज शुद्धभावा दिव्येन दृष्टिविषयेण तदा प्रविष्टा । लोकापवादकलुषीकृतचेतसा या त्यक्ता त्वया प्रियतमा विदिता ऽपि शुद्धा ।। 7.96.24 ।।
transliteration: tasmādiyaṃ naravarātmaja śuddhabhāvā divyena dṛṣṭiviṣayeṇa tadā praviṣṭā | lokāpavādakaluṣīkṛtacetasā yā tyaktā tvayā priyatamā viditā 'pi śuddhā || 7.96.24 ||
translation: तस्मात् Therefore, इयं this, नरवरात्मज O son of the best among men, शुद्धभावा of pure nature, दिव्येन by divine, दृष्टिविषयेण by the range of sight, तदा then, प्रविष्टा entered, लोकापवादकलुषीकृतचेतसा by one whose mind was defiled by public scandal, या who, त्यक्ता was abandoned, त्वया by you, प्रियतमा the dearest, विदिता known, अपि even, शुद्धा pure.
explanation: Therefore, O son of the best among men, this Sita of pure nature, whom you, whose mind was defiled by public scandal, abandoned even though she was known to be pure and dearest to you, then entered the divine realm. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षण्णवतितमः सर्गः ।। 96 ।। Thus ends the ninety-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: वाल्मीकिनैवमुक्तस्तु राघवः प्रत्यभाषत । प्राञ्जलिर्जगतो मध्ये दृष्ट्वा तां वरवर्णिनीम् ।। 7.97.1 ।।
transliteration: vālmīkinaivamuktastu rāghavaḥ pratyabhāṣata | prāñjalirjagato madhye dṛṣṭvā tāṃ varavarṇinīm || 7.97.1 ||
translation: वाल्मीकिना by Valmiki, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, राघवः Rama, प्रत्यभाषत replied, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, जगतः of the world, मध्ये in the midst, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तां her, वरवर्णिनीम् of excellent complexion.
explanation: Indeed, when spoken to thus by Valmiki, Rama, having seen Sita of excellent complexion in the midst of the people, replied with folded hands.
comments: Rama accepts Valmiki's word, owning that he abandoned the pure Sita only for fear of scandal, and acknowledges Kusha and Lava as his sons -- as the gods assemble, Sita swears that, having never thought of any man but Rama, may the Earth receive her, whereupon a naga-borne throne rises and Mother Earth takes her upon it and bears her down into the netherworld amid a rain of flowers, all beings standing astonished.

shloka_text: एवमेतन्महाभाग यथा वदसि धर्मवित् । प्रत्ययस्तु मम ब्रह्मंस्तव वाक्यैरकल्मषैः ।। 7.97.2 ।।
transliteration: evametanmahābhāga yathā vadasi dharmavit | pratyayastu mama brahmaṃstava vākyairakalmaṣaiḥ || 7.97.2 ||
translation: एवम् thus, एतत् this, महाभाग O great fortunate one, यथा as, वदसि you say, धर्मवित् O knower of dharma, प्रत्ययः conviction, तु indeed, मम my, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, तव your, वाक्यैः by words, अकल्मषैः sinless.
explanation: O great fortunate one, O knower of dharma, this is indeed as you say, and my conviction is established by your pure words, O Brahmana.

shloka_text: प्रत्ययस्तु पुरा वृत्तो वैदेह्याः सुरसन्निधौ । शपथस्तु कृतस्तत्र तेन वेश्म प्रवेशिता । लोकापवादो बलवान्येन त्यक्ता हि मैथिली ।। 7.97.3 ।।
transliteration: pratyayastu purā vṛtto vaidehyāḥ surasannidhau | śapathastu kṛtastatra tena veśma praveśitā | lokāpavādo balavānyena tyaktā hi maithilī || 7.97.3 ||
translation: प्रत्ययस्तु assurance but, पुरा formerly, वृत्तो occurred, वैदेह्याः of Vaidehi, सुरसन्निधौ in the presence of gods, शपथस्तु oath but, कृतस्तत्र made there, तेन by that, वेश्म home, प्रवेशिता was made to enter, लोकापवादो public scandal, बलवान् powerful, येन by which, त्यक्ता abandoned, हि indeed, मैथिली Maithili.
explanation: Although Vaidehi's purity was previously proven by an oath taken in the presence of the gods, and she was admitted back into the home, the powerful public scandal compelled me to abandon Maithili.

shloka_text: सेयं लोकभयाद्ब्रह्मन्नपापेत्यभिजानता । परित्यक्ता मया सीता तद्भावन्क्षन्तुमर्हति ।। 7.97.4 ।।
transliteration: seyaṃ lokabhayādbrahmannapāpetyabhijānatā | parityaktā mayā sītā tadbhāvankṣantumarhati || 7.97.4 ||
translation: सेयं she this, लोकभयाद् from fear of public opinion, ब्रह्मन् O Brahman, अपापेत्यभिजानता knowing her to be sinless, परित्यक्ता abandoned, मया by me, सीता Sita, तद्भावन् that you, क्षन्तुमर्हति should forgive.
explanation: O Brahman, knowing her to be sinless, I abandoned Sita out of fear of public opinion, and for this, you should forgive me.

shloka_text: जानामि चेमौ पुत्रौ मे यमजातौ कुशीलवौ । शुद्धायां जगतो मध्ये मैथिल्यां प्रीतिरस्तु मे ।। 7.97.5 ।।
transliteration: jānāmi cemau putrau me yamajātau kuśīlavau | śuddhāyāṃ jagato madhye maithilyāṃ prītirastu me || 7.97.5 ||
translation: जानामि I know, चेमौ and these two, पुत्रौ sons, मे my, यमजातौ twins, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava, शुद्धायां pure, जगतो of the world, मध्ये in the midst, मैथिल्यां in Maithili, प्रीतिरस्तु let there be affection, मे my.
explanation: I know that these two, Kusha and Lava, are my twin sons, and I desire that my affection for Maithili, who is pure in the eyes of the world, be restored.

shloka_text: अभिप्रायं तु विज्ञाय रामस्य सुरसत्तमाः । सीतायाः शपथे तस्मिन् महेन्द्राद्या महौजसः ।। 7.97.6 ।।
transliteration: abhiprāyaṃ tu vijñāya rāmasya surasattamāḥ | sītāyāḥ śapathe tasmin mahendrādyā mahaujasaḥ || 7.97.6 ||
translation: अभिप्रायं intention, तु indeed, विज्ञाय having understood, रामस्य of Rama, सुरसत्तमाः best among gods, सीतायाः of Sita, शपथे in the oath, तस्मिन् in that, महेन्द्राद्या Mahendra and others, महौजसः greatly powerful.
explanation: Having understood Rama's intention regarding Sita's oath, the greatly powerful best among gods, led by Mahendra (Indra), prepared to act.

shloka_text: पितामहं पुरस्कृत्य सर्व एव समागताः ।। 7.97.7 ।।
transliteration: pitāmahaṃ puraskṛtya sarva eva samāgatāḥ || 7.97.7 ||
translation: पितामहं Grandfather (Brahma), पुरस्कृत्य having made the leader, सर्व all, एव indeed, समागताः assembled.
explanation: All of them, indeed, assembled, making Grandfather Brahma their leader.

shloka_text: आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा ह्यश्विनौ समरुद्गणाः । गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव सर्व एव समागताः ।। 7.97.8 ।।
transliteration: ādityā vasavo rudrā hyaśvinau samarudgaṇāḥ | gandharvāpsarasaścaiva sarva eva samāgatāḥ || 7.97.8 ||
translation: आदित्याः Adityas, वसवः Vasus, रुद्राः Rudras, हि indeed, अश्विनौ the two Ashvins, समरुद्गणाः along with the groups of Maruts, गन्धर्वाप्सरसः Gandharvas and Apsaras, च and, एव indeed, सर्वे all, एव indeed, समागताः had assembled.
explanation: The Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, the two Ashvins along with the Maruts, Gandharvas, and Apsaras, all indeed had assembled there.

shloka_text: साध्याश्च विश्वेदेवाश्च सर्वे च परमर्षयः । नागाः सुपर्णाः सिद्धाश्च ते सर्वे हृष्टमानसाः । सीताशपथसम्भ्रान्ताः सर्व एव समागताः ।। 7.97.9 ।।
transliteration: sādhyāśca viśvedevāśca sarve ca paramarṣayaḥ | nāgāḥ suparṇāḥ siddhāśca te sarve hṛṣṭamānasāḥ | sītāśapathasambhrāntāḥ sarva eva samāgatāḥ || 7.97.9 ||
translation: साध्याः Sadhyas, च and, विश्वेदेवाः Vishvedevas, च and, सर्वे all, च and, परमर्षयः great sages, नागाः Nagas, सुपर्णाः Suparnas, सिद्धाः Siddhas, च and, ते they, सर्वे all, हृष्टमानसाः with joyful minds, सीताशपथसम्भ्रान्ताः agitated by Sita's oath, सर्वे all, एव indeed, समागताः had assembled.
explanation: The Sadhyas, Vishvedevas, all great sages, Nagas, Suparnas, and Siddhas, all of them with joyful minds, agitated by Sita's oath, had indeed assembled there.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा देवानृषींश्चैव राघवः पुनरब्रवीत् । प्रत्ययो मे नरश्रेष्ठा ऋषिवाक्यैरकल्मषैः ।। 7.97.10 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā devānṛṣīṃścaiva rāghavaḥ punarabravīt | pratyayo me naraśreṣṭhā ṛṣivākyairakalmaṣaiḥ || 7.97.10 ||
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, देवान् the gods, ऋषीन् and the sages, च and, एव indeed, राघवः Rama, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् spoke, प्रत्ययः faith/conviction, मे is for me, नरश्रेष्ठाः O best among men, ऋषिवाक्यैः by the words of the sages, अकल्मषैः which are faultless.
explanation: Having seen the gods and sages, Rama spoke again, saying, "O best among men, I have conviction in the faultless words of the sages."

shloka_text: शुद्धायां जगतो मध्ये वैदेह्यां प्रीतिरस्तु मे ।। 7.97.11 ।।
transliteration: śuddhāyāṃ jagato madhye vaidehyāṃ prītirastu me || 7.97.11 ||
translation: शुद्धायाम् in the pure one, जगतः of the world, मध्ये in the midst, वैदेह्याम् in Vaidehi (Sita), प्रीतिः affection/love, अस्तु let there be, मे for me.
explanation: Let my affection for Vaidehi, who is pure in the midst of the world, be firm.

shloka_text: ततो वायुः शुभः पुण्यो दिव्यगन्धो मनोरमः । तज्जनौघं सुरश्रेष्ठो ह्लादयामास सर्वतः ।। 7.97.12 ।।
transliteration: tato vāyuḥ śubhaḥ puṇyo divyagandho manoramaḥ | tajjanaughaṃ suraśreṣṭho hlādayāmāsa sarvataḥ || 7.97.12 ||
translation: ततः then, वायुः the wind, शुभः auspicious, पुण्यः sacred, दिव्यगन्धः with divine fragrance, मनोरमः delightful, तत् that, जनौघम् multitude of people, सुरश्रेष्ठः best among gods (referring to Vayu, the god of wind), ह्लादयामास delighted, सर्वतः from all sides.
explanation: Then, the auspicious, sacred, divinely fragrant, and delightful wind, the best among gods (Vayu), delighted that multitude of people from all sides.

shloka_text: तदद्भुतमिवाचिन्त्यं निरैक्षन्त समागताः । मानवाः सर्वराष्ट्रेभ्यः पूर्वं कृतयुगे यथा ।। 7.97.13 ।।
transliteration: tadadbhutamivācintyaṃ niraikṣanta samāgatāḥ | mānavāḥ sarvarāṣṭrebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ kṛtayuge yathā || 7.97.13 ||
translation: तत् that, अद्भुतम् wonderful, इव as if, अचिन्त्यम् inconceivable, निरैक्षन्त they beheld, समागताः assembled, मानवाः humans, सर्वराष्ट्रेभ्यः from all kingdoms, पूर्वम् formerly, कृतयुगे in the Krita Yuga, यथा as.
explanation: People gathered from all kingdoms beheld that wonderful and inconceivable sight, just as they would have in the Krita Yuga.

shloka_text: सर्वान्समागतान्दृष्ट्वा सीता काषायवासिनी । अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमधोदृष्टिरवाङ्मुखी ।। 7.97.14 ।।
transliteration: sarvānsamāgatāndṛṣṭvā sītā kāṣāyavāsinī | abravītprāñjalirvākyamadhodṛṣṭiravāṅmukhī || 7.97.14 ||
translation: सर्वान् all, समागतान् assembled ones, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सीता Sita, काषायवासिनी clad in ochre robes, अब्रवीत् she spoke, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, वाक्यम् words, अधोदृष्टिः with downcast eyes, अवाङ्मुखी with face turned downwards.
explanation: Having seen all the assembled people, Sita, clad in ochre robes, spoke with folded hands, her eyes and face cast downwards.

shloka_text: यथा ऽहं राघवादन्यं मनसापि न चिन्तये । तथा मे माधवी देवी विवरं दातुमर्हति ।। 7.97.15 ।।
transliteration: yathā 'haṃ rāghavādanyaṃ manasāpi na cintaye | tathā me mādhavī devī vivaraṃ dātumarhati || 7.97.15 ||
translation: यथा just as, अहम् I, राघवात् from Rama, अन्यम् another, मनसा by mind, अपि even, न not, चिन्तये I think, तथा so, मे to me, माधवी daughter of Madhu (Earth), देवी goddess, विवरम् an opening, दातुम् to give, अर्हति she ought.
explanation: Sita prayed, "Just as I do not think of any other man than Rama even in my mind, so may Goddess Earth grant me an opening."

shloka_text: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा यथा रामं समर्चये । तथा मे माधवी देवी विवरं दातुमर्हति ।। 7.97.16 ।।
transliteration: manasā karmaṇā vācā yathā rāmaṃ samarcaye | tathā me mādhavī devī vivaraṃ dātumarhati || 7.97.16 ||
translation: मनसा by mind, कर्मणा by action, वाचा by speech, यथा just as, रामम् Rama, समर्चये I worship, तथा so, मे to me, माधवी daughter of Madhu (Earth), देवी goddess, विवरम् an opening, दातुम् to give, अर्हति she ought.
explanation: Sita prayed, "Just as I worship Rama with my mind, actions, and speech, so may Goddess Earth grant me an opening."

shloka_text: यथैतत्सत्यमुक्तं मे वेद्मि रामात्परं न च । तथा मे माधवी देवी विवरं दातुमर्हति ।। 7.97.17 ।।
transliteration: yathaitatsatyamuktaṃ me vedmi rāmātparaṃ na ca | tathā me mādhavī devī vivaraṃ dātumarhati || 7.97.17 ||
translation: यथा just as, एतत् this, सत्यम् truth, उक्तम् spoken, मे by me, वेद्मि I know, रामात् than Rama, परम् superior, न not, च and, तथा so, मे to me, माधवी daughter of Madhu (Earth), देवी goddess, विवरम् an opening, दातुम् to give, अर्हति she ought.
explanation: Sita prayed, "Just as this truth has been spoken by me and I know no one superior to Rama, so may Goddess Earth grant me an opening."

shloka_text: तथा शपन्त्यां वैदेह्यां प्रादुरासीत्तदद्भुतम् । भूतलादुत्थितं दिव्यं सिंहासनमनुत्तमम् ।। 7.97.18 ।।
transliteration: tathā śapantyāṃ vaidehyāṃ prādurāsīttadadbhutam | bhūtalādutthitaṃ divyaṃ siṃhāsanamanuttamam || 7.97.18 ||
translation: तथा thus, शपन्त्यां while swearing, वैदेह्यां by Vaidehi, प्रादुरासीत् appeared, तत् that, अद्भुतम् wonderful, भूतलात् from the surface of the earth, उत्थितं risen, दिव्यं divine, सिंहासनम् throne, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.
explanation: As Vaidehi was thus swearing, a wonderful, divine, and unsurpassed throne emerged from the surface of the earth.

shloka_text: ध्रियमाणं शिरोभिस्तु नागैरमितविक्रमैः । दिव्यं दिव्येन वपुषा दिव्यरत्नविभूषितैः ।। 7.97.19 ।।
transliteration: dhriyamāṇaṃ śirobhistu nāgairamitavikramaiḥ | divyaṃ divyena vapuṣā divyaratnavibhūṣitaiḥ || 7.97.19 ||
translation: ध्रियमाणं being held, शिरोभिः by heads, तु and, नागैः by Nagas, अमितविक्रमैः of immeasurable valor, दिव्यं divine, दिव्येन with divine, वपुषा bodies, दिव्यरत्नविभूषितैः adorned with divine jewels.
explanation: This divine throne was being held by the heads of Nagas of immeasurable valor, who themselves possessed divine bodies adorned with divine jewels.

shloka_text: तस्मिंस्तु धरणी देवी बाहुभ्यां गृह्य मैथिलीम् । स्वागतेनाभिनन्द्यैनामासने चोपवेशयत् ।। 7.97.20 ।।
transliteration: tasmiṃstu dharaṇī devī bāhubhyāṃ gṛhya maithilīm | svāgatenābhinandyaināmāsane copaveśayat || 7.97.20 ||
translation: तस्मिन् on that, तु and, धरणी the Earth, देवी goddess, बाहुभ्यां with two arms, गृह्य taking, मैथिलीम् Maithili, स्वागतेन with a welcome, अभिनन्द्य having greeted, एनाम् her, आसने on the seat, च and, उपवेशयत् made her sit.
explanation: Then, Goddess Earth, taking Maithili with her two arms, greeted her with a welcome and made her sit upon that throne.

shloka_text: तामासनगतां दृष्ट्वा प्रविशन्तीं रसातलम् । पुष्पवृष्टिरविच्छिन्ना दिव्या सीतामवाकिरत् ।। 7.97.21 ।।
transliteration: tāmāsanagatāṃ dṛṣṭvā praviśantīṃ rasātalam | puṣpavṛṣṭiravicchinnā divyā sītāmavākirat || 7.97.21 ||
translation: ताम् her, आसनगतां seated on the throne, दृष्ट्वा having seen, प्रविशन्तीं entering, रसातलम् the netherworld, पुष्पवृष्टिः a shower of flowers, अविच्छिन्ना uninterrupted, दिव्या divine, सीताम् upon Sita, अवाकिरत् showered.
explanation: As Sita, seated on the throne, was seen entering the netherworld, an uninterrupted divine shower of flowers fell upon her.

shloka_text: साधुकारश्च सुमहान्देवानां सहसोत्थितः । साधु साध्विति वै सीते यस्यास्ते शीलमीदृशम् ।। 7.97.22 ।।
transliteration: sādhukāraśca sumahāndevānāṃ sahasotthitaḥ | sādhu sādhviti vai sīte yasyāste śīlamīdṛśam || 7.97.22 ||
translation: साधुकारः an acclamation of well done, च and, सुमहान् very great, देवानां of the gods, सहसा suddenly, उत्थितः arose, साधु well done, साधु well done, इति thus, वै indeed, सीते O Sita, यस्याः whose, ते your, शीलम् character, ईदृशम् such.
explanation: A very great acclamation of "well done" suddenly arose from the gods, praising, "Well done, well done, O Sita, whose character is indeed of such purity!"

shloka_text: एवं बहुविधा वाचो ह्यन्तरिक्षगताः सुराः । व्याजह्रुर्हृष्टमनसो दृष्ट्वा सीताप्रवेशनम् ।। 7.97.23 ।।
