transliteration: yaḥ śṛṇoti nirīkṣedvā sa vadhyo bhavitā tava | bhavedvai munimukhyasya vacanaṃ yadyapekṣase || 7.103.13 ||
translation: यः whoever, शृणोति listens, निरीक्षेत् looks, वा or, सः he, वध्यः punishable by death, भविता will be, तव your, भवेत् it should be, वै indeed, मुनिमुख्यस्य of the chief of sages, वचनम् the word, यदि if, अपेक्षसे you desire.
explanation: Whoever listens or looks will be punishable by death by you, if you truly desire to heed the words of the chief of sages.

shloka_text: स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत् । द्वारि तिष्ठ महाबाहो प्रतिहारं विसर्जय ।। 7.103.14 ।।
transliteration: sa tatheti pratijñāya rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt | dvāri tiṣṭha mahābāho pratihāraṃ visarjaya || 7.103.14 ||
translation: सः He, तथा so, इति thus, प्रतिज्ञाय having promised, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् spoke, द्वारि at the door, तिष्ठ stand, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, प्रतिहारम् the doorkeeper, विसर्जय dismiss.
explanation: Having agreed to the condition, Rama spoke to Lakshmana, instructing him to stand at the door and dismiss the doorkeeper.

shloka_text: स मे वध्यः खलु भवेत् कथाद्वन्द्वं समीरितम् । ऋषेर्मम च सौमित्रे पश्येद्वा शृणुयाच्च यः ।। 7.103.15 ।।
transliteration: sa me vadhyaḥ khalu bhavet kathādvandvaṃ samīritam | ṛṣermama ca saumitre paśyedvā śṛṇuyācca yaḥ || 7.103.15 ||
translation: सः He, मे my, वध्यः one to be killed, खलु indeed, भवेत् would be, कथाद्वन्द्वम् the conversation of two, समीरितम् spoken, ऋषेः of the sage, मम and my, च and, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, पश्येत् sees, वा or, शृणुयात् hears, च and, यः who.
explanation: Rama declared that anyone who sees or hears the private conversation between him and the sage would indeed be worthy of death.

shloka_text: ततो निक्षिप्य काकुत्स्थो लक्ष्मणं द्वारि सङ्ग्रहम् । तमुवाच मुने वाक्यं कथयस्वेति राघवः ।। 7.103.16 ।।
transliteration: tato nikṣipya kākutstho lakṣmaṇaṃ dvāri saṅgraham | tamuvāca mune vākyaṃ kathayasveti rāghavaḥ || 7.103.16 ||
translation: ततः Then, निक्षिप्य having stationed, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, द्वारि at the door, सङ्ग्रहम् as a guard, तम् to him (the sage), उवाच spoke, मुने O sage, वाक्यम् the matter, कथयस्व tell, इति thus, राघवः Raghava (Rama).
explanation: Then, having stationed Lakshmana as a guard at the door, Rama (Kakutstha) spoke to the sage, saying, "O sage, please tell me the matter."

shloka_text: यत्ते मनीषितं वाक्यं येन वा ऽसि समाहितः । कथयस्वाविशङ्कस्त्वं ममापि हृदि वर्तते ।। 7.103.17 ।।
transliteration: yatte manīṣitaṃ vākyaṃ yena vā 'si samāhitaḥ | kathayasvāviśaṅkastvaṃ mamāpi hṛdi vartate || 7.103.17 ||
translation: यत् whatever, ते your, मनीषितम् desired, वाक्यम् message, येन by which, वा or, असि you are, समाहितः intent, कथयस्व tell, अविशङ्कः without hesitation, त्वम् you, मम my, अपि also, हृदि in heart, वर्तते it exists.
explanation: Rama urged the sage to speak without hesitation whatever message he desired or was intent upon, for a similar thought was also present in Rama's heart. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्र्युत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 103 ।। Thus ends the hundred and third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: शृणु राजन्महासत्व यदर्थमहमागतः । पितामहेन देवेन प्रेषितो ऽस्मि महाबल ।। 7.104.1 ।।
transliteration: śṛṇu rājanmahāsatva yadarthamahamāgataḥ | pitāmahena devena preṣito 'smi mahābala || 7.104.1 ||
translation: शृणु Listen, राजन् O King, महासत्व O greatly courageous one, यदर्थम् for what purpose, अहम् I, आगतः have come, पितामहेन by the grandfather, देवेन the god, प्रेषितः sent, अस्मि I am, महाबल O mighty-armed one.
explanation: The sage then began, asking Rama to listen, and revealed that he had been sent by the divine grandfather Brahma for a specific purpose.
comments: The messenger reveals himself as Time, sent by Brahma to tell Rama that his ordained span as Vishnu among men is fulfilled and that the grandfather summons him to return, whether to rule on or come back to the gods -- and Rama, smiling, accepts that his time has come and resolves to depart.

shloka_text: तवाहं पूर्वसद्भावे पुत्रः परपुरञ्जय । मायासम्भावितो वीर कालः सर्वसमाहरः ।। 7.104.2 ।।
transliteration: tavāhaṃ pūrvasadbhāve putraḥ parapurañjaya | māyāsambhāvito vīra kālaḥ sarvasamāharaḥ || 7.104.2 ||
translation: तव your, अहम् I, पूर्वसद्भावे in a previous existence, पुत्रः son, परपुरञ्जय O conqueror of enemy cities, मायासम्भावितः created by Maya, वीर O hero, कालः Time, सर्वसमाहरः the destroyer of all.
explanation: O conqueror of enemy cities, O hero, I am your son from a previous existence, created by your divine power as Time, the destroyer of all.

shloka_text: पितामहश्च भगवानाह लोकपतिः प्रभुः । समयस्ते कृतः सौम्य लोकान्सम्परिरक्षितुम् ।। 7.104.3 ।।
transliteration: pitāmahaśca bhagavānāha lokapatiḥ prabhuḥ | samayaste kṛtaḥ saumya lokānsamparirakṣitum || 7.104.3 ||
translation: पितामहः Grandfather Brahma, च and, भगवान् the revered one, आह said, लोकपतिः lord of the worlds, प्रभुः the mighty one, समयः an agreement, ते by you, कृतः made, सौम्य O gentle one, लोकान् the worlds, सम्परिरक्षितुम् to protect well.
explanation: And the revered Grandfather Brahma, the mighty lord of the worlds, said, "O gentle one, an agreement has been made by you to protect the worlds well."

shloka_text: सङ्क्षिप्य हि पुरा लोकान्मायया स्वयमेव हि । महार्णवे शयानो ऽप्सु मां त्वं पूर्वमजीजनः ।। 7.104.4 ।।
transliteration: saṅkṣipya hi purā lokānmāyayā svayameva hi | mahārṇave śayāno 'psu māṃ tvaṃ pūrvamajījanaḥ || 7.104.4 ||
translation: सङ्क्षिप्य having dissolved, हि indeed, पुरा formerly, लोकान् the worlds, मायया by Maya, स्वयमेव by yourself alone, हि indeed, महार्णवे in the great ocean, शयानः lying, अप्सु in the waters, माम् me, त्वम् you, पूर्वम् formerly, अजीजनः begot.
explanation: Indeed, formerly, having dissolved the worlds by your own divine power, you lay in the great ocean and begot me in the waters.

shloka_text: भोगवन्तं ततो नागमनन्तमुदकेशयम् । मायया जनयित्वा त्वं द्वौ च सत्त्वौ महाबलौ ।। 7.104.5 ।।
transliteration: bhogavantaṃ tato nāgamanantamudakeśayam | māyayā janayitvā tvaṃ dvau ca sattvau mahābalau || 7.104.5 ||
translation: भोगवन्तम् having hoods, ततः then, नागम् the serpent, अनन्तम् Ananta, उदकेशयम् lying in the water, मायया by Maya, जनयित्वा having created, त्वम् you, द्वौ two, च and, सत्त्वौ beings, महाबलौ very powerful.
explanation: Then, having created by your divine power the hooded serpent Ananta, who lies in the water, you also created two very powerful beings.

shloka_text: मधुं च कैटभं चैव ययोरस्थिचयैर्वृता । इयं पर्वतसम्बाधा मेदिनी चाभवन्मही ।। 7.104.6 ।।
transliteration: madhuṃ ca kaiṭabhaṃ caiva yayorasthicayairvṛtā | iyaṃ parvatasambādhā medinī cābhavanmahī || 7.104.6 ||
translation: मधुम् Madhu, च and, कैटभम् Kaitabha, च and, एव indeed, ययोः whose, अस्थिचयैः by heaps of bones, वृता covered, इयम् this, पर्वतसम्बाधा crowded with mountains, मेदिनी the earth, च and, अभवत् became, मही the great earth.
explanation: These two were Madhu and Kaitabha, whose heaps of bones covered this earth, which then became the great earth crowded with mountains.

shloka_text: पद्मे दिव्ये ऽर्कसङ्काशे नाभ्यामुत्पाद्य मामपि । प्राजापत्यं त्वया कर्म मयि सर्वं निवेशितम् ।। 7.104.7 ।।
transliteration: padme divye 'rkasaṅkāśe nābhyāmutpādya māmapi | prājāpatyaṃ tvayā karma mayi sarvaṃ niveśitam || 7.104.7 ||
translation: पद्मे on the lotus, दिव्ये divine, अर्कसङ्काशे sun-like, नाभ्याम् from the navel, उत्पाद्य having created, माम् me, अपि also, प्राजापत्यम् of creation, त्वया by you, कर्म work, मयि in me, सर्वम् all, निवेशितम् entrusted.
explanation: Having created me from your divine, sun-like lotus navel, you entrusted all the work of creation to me.

shloka_text: सो ऽहं सन्न्यस्तभारो हि त्वामुपासे जगत्पतिम् । रक्षां विधत्स्व भूतेषु मम तेजस्करो भवान् ।। 7.104.8 ।।
transliteration: so 'haṃ sannyastabhāro hi tvāmupāse jagatpatim | rakṣāṃ vidhatsva bhūteṣu mama tejaskaro bhavān || 7.104.8 ||
translation: सः that, अहम् I, सन्न्यस्तभारः having relinquished the burden, हि indeed, त्वाम् you, उपासे I worship, जगत्पतिम् the lord of the world, रक्षाम् protection, विधत्स्व bestow, भूतेषु for beings, मम my, तेजस्करः increasing the splendor, भवान् you.
explanation: Having indeed relinquished that burden, I now worship you, the Lord of the world; please bestow protection upon all beings and increase my splendor.

shloka_text: ततस्त्वमपि दुर्धर्षात्तस्माद्भावात्सनातनात् । रक्षार्थं सर्वभूतानां विष्णुत्वमुपजग्मिवान् ।। 7.104.9 ।।
transliteration: tatastvamapi durdharṣāttasmādbhāvātsanātanāt | rakṣārthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viṣṇutvamupajagmivān || 7.104.9 ||
translation: ततः then, त्वम् you, अपि also, दुर्धर्षात् from the unassailable, तस्मात् from that, भावात् state, सनातनात् eternal, रक्षार्थम् for the protection, सर्वभूतानाम् of all beings, विष्णुत्वम् the state of Vishnu, उपजग्मिवान् attained.
explanation: Therefore, you also, from that unassailable and eternal state, assumed the form of Vishnu for the protection of all beings.

shloka_text: अदित्यां वीर्यवान्पुत्रो भ्रातऽणां वीर्यवर्धनः । समुत्पन्नेषु कृत्येषु तेषां साह्याय कल्पसे ।। 7.104.10 ।।
transliteration: adityāṃ vīryavānputro bhrāta'ṇāṃ vīryavardhanaḥ | samutpanneṣu kṛtyeṣu teṣāṃ sāhyāya kalpase || 7.104.10 ||
translation: अदित्याम् in Aditi, वीर्यवान् powerful, पुत्रः son, भ्रातॄणाम् of brothers, वीर्यवर्धनः increasing the valor, समुत्पन्नेषु when arisen, कृत्येषु in difficulties, तेषाम् their, साह्याय for help, कल्पसे you become capable.
explanation: As a powerful son born to Aditi, increasing the valor of your brothers, you become capable of assisting them when difficulties arise.

shloka_text: स त्वं वित्रास्यमानासु प्रजासु जगतां वर । रावणस्य वधाकाङ्क्षी मानुषेषु मनो ऽदधाः ।। 7.104.11 ।।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ vitrāsyamānāsu prajāsu jagatāṃ vara | rāvaṇasya vadhākāṅkṣī mānuṣeṣu mano 'dadhāḥ || 7.104.11 ||
translation: सः that, त्वम् you, वित्रास्यमानासु when being terrified, प्रजासु the creatures, जगताम् of the worlds, वर O best one, रावणस्य of Ravana, वधाकाङ्क्षी desiring the slaying, मानुषेषु among humans, मनः mind, अदधाः you set.
explanation: O best of the worlds, when the creatures were being terrified, you, desiring the slaying of Ravana, set your mind on being born among humans.

shloka_text: दश वर्षसहस्राणि दश वर्षशतानि च । कृत्वा वासस्य नियतिं स्वयमेवात्मना पुरा ।। 7.104.12 ।।
transliteration: daśa varṣasahasrāṇi daśa varṣaśatāni ca | kṛtvā vāsasya niyatiṃ svayamevātmanā purā || 7.104.12 ||
translation: दश ten, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, दश ten, वर्षशतानि hundreds of years, च and, कृत्वा having fixed, वासस्य of dwelling, नियतिं the duration, स्वयमेव by yourself, आत्मना by yourself, पुरा formerly
explanation: Formerly, you yourself fixed the duration of your dwelling (on earth) for ten thousand and ten hundred years.

shloka_text: स त्वं मनोमयः पुत्रः पूर्णायुर्मानुषेष्विह । कालो ऽयं ते नरश्रेष्ठ समीपमुपवर्तितुम् ।। 7.104.13 ।।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ manomayaḥ putraḥ pūrṇāyurmānuṣeṣviha | kālo 'yaṃ te naraśreṣṭha samīpamupavartitum || 7.104.13 ||
translation: स that, त्वं you, मनोमयः born of mind, पुत्रः son, पूर्णायुः having completed your lifespan, मानुषेषु among humans, इह here, कालः time, अयम् this, ते for you, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, समीपम् proximity, उपवर्तितुम् to return
explanation: O best among men, you, the mind-born son, have completed your lifespan among humans here, and now it is time for you to return to my proximity.

shloka_text: यदि भूयो महाराज प्रजा इच्छस्युपासितुम् । वस वा वीर भद्रं त एवमाह पितामहः ।। 7.104.14 ।।
transliteration: yadi bhūyo mahārāja prajā icchasyupāsitum | vasa vā vīra bhadraṃ ta evamāha pitāmahaḥ || 7.104.14 ||
translation: यदि if, भूयः again, महाराज O great king, प्रजाः subjects, इच्छसि you desire, उपासितुम् to rule, वस dwell, वा or, वीर O hero, भद्रं welfare, ते for you, एवम् thus, आह said, पितामहः the grandfather
explanation: The grandfather (Brahma) said, "O great king, if you desire to rule your subjects again, or if you wish to stay, O hero, may good fortune be upon you."

shloka_text: अथ वा विजिगीषा ते सुरलोकाय राघव । सनाथा विष्णुना देवा भवन्तु विगतज्वराः ।। 7.104.15 ।।
transliteration: atha vā vijigīṣā te suralokāya rāghava | sanāthā viṣṇunā devā bhavantu vigatajvarāḥ || 7.104.15 ||
translation: अथ now, वा or, विजिगीषा desire to go, ते your, सुरलोकाय to the world of gods, राघव O Raghava, सनाथाः protected, विष्णुना by Vishnu, देवाः the gods, भवन्तु may they be, विगतज्वराः free from anxiety
explanation: Or, O Raghava, if you desire to return to the world of the gods, then may the gods be protected by Vishnu and be free from all distress.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा पितामहेनोक्तं वाक्यं कालसमीरितम् । राघवः प्रहसन्वाक्यं सर्वसंहारमब्रवीत् ।। 7.104.16 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā pitāmahenoktaṃ vākyaṃ kālasamīritam | rāghavaḥ prahasanvākyaṃ sarvasaṃhāramabravīt || 7.104.16 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, पितामहेन by the grandfather, उक्तं spoken, वाक्यं words, कालसमीरितम् prompted by time, राघवः Rama, प्रहसन् smiling, वाक्यं words, सर्वसंहारम् indicating the dissolution of everything, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Having heard the words spoken by the grandfather, which indicated the end of his time, Rama smiled and spoke words signifying the dissolution of everything.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा मे देवदेवस्य वाक्यं परममद्भुतम् । प्रीतिर्हि महती जाता तवागमनसम्भवा ।। 7.104.17 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā me devadevasya vākyaṃ paramamadbhutam | prītirhi mahatī jātā tavāgamanasambhavā || 7.104.17 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, मे my, देवदेवस्य of the god of gods, वाक्यं word, परमम् supreme, अद्भुतम् wonderful, प्रीतिः joy, हि indeed, महती great, जाता arisen, तव your, आगमन coming, सम्भवा caused by.
explanation: Having heard the supreme and wonderful words of the god of gods, a great joy has indeed arisen in me, caused by your arrival.

shloka_text: त्रयाणामपि लोकानां कार्यार्थं मम सम्भवः । भद्रं ते ऽस्तु गमिष्यामि यत एवाहमागतः ।। 7.104.18 ।।
transliteration: trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ kāryārthaṃ mama sambhavaḥ | bhadraṃ te 'stu gamiṣyāmi yata evāhamāgataḥ || 7.104.18 ||
translation: त्रयाणाम् of the three, अपि even, लोकानाम् of worlds, कार्यार्थम् for the purpose, मम my, सम्भवः existence, भद्रम् welfare, ते to you, अस्तु let it be, गमिष्यामि I shall go, यतः from where, एव indeed, अहम् I, आगतः came.
explanation: My existence is for the purpose of the three worlds; may good fortune be to you, I shall now depart to the place from where I came.

shloka_text: हद्गतो ह्यसि सम्प्राप्तो न मे तत्र विचारणा । मया हि सर्वकृत्येषु देवानां वशवर्तिनाम् । स्थातव्यं सर्वसंहार यथा ह्याह पितामहः ।। 7.104.19 ।।
transliteration: hadgato hyasi samprāpto na me tatra vicāraṇā | mayā hi sarvakṛtyeṣu devānāṃ vaśavartinām | sthātavyaṃ sarvasaṃhāra yathā hyāha pitāmahaḥ || 7.104.19 ||
translation: हद्गतः understood, हि indeed, असि you are, सम्प्राप्तः reached, न not, मे my, तत्र there, विचारणा deliberation, मया by me, हि indeed, सर्वकृत्येषु in all duties, देवानाम् of the gods, वशवर्तिनाम् obedient, स्थातव्यम् must be acted, सर्वसंहार the destruction of all, यथा as, हि indeed, आह said, पितामहः the grandfather.
explanation: You are indeed understood and your time has arrived, there is no doubt in my mind about that; for I must indeed act in all duties, obedient to the gods, for the destruction of all, just as the grandfather Brahma has indeed commanded. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुरधिकशततमः सर्गः ।। 104 ।। Thus ends the hundred and fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तथा तयोः संवदतोर्दुर्वासा भगवानृषिः । रामस्य दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी राजद्वारमुपागमत् ।। 7.105.1 ।।
transliteration: tathā tayoḥ saṃvadatordurvāsā bhagavānṛṣiḥ | rāmasya darśanākāṅkṣī rājadvāramupāgamat || 7.105.1 ||
translation: तथा thus, तयोः of those two, संवदतोः while conversing, दुर्वासा Durvasa, भगवान् revered, ऋषिः sage, रामस्य of Rama, दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी desiring the sight, राजद्वारम् royal gate, उपागमत् approached.
explanation: While those two were thus conversing, the revered sage Durvasa, desiring an audience with Rama, approached the royal gate.
comments: As they confer, the sage Durvasa arrives demanding instant audience and threatening to curse Rama's line if denied -- Lakshmana, choosing one life over all, breaks in to announce him, and Rama receives Durvasa, who asks only for food, eats and departs -- but, recalling Time's death-condition, Rama is overcome with grief for Lakshmana.

shloka_text: सो ऽभिगम्य तु सौमित्रिमुवाच ऋषिसत्तमः । रामं दर्शय मे शीघ्रं पुरा मे ऽर्थो ऽतिवर्तते ।। 7.105.2 ।।
transliteration: so 'bhigamya tu saumitrimuvāca ṛṣisattamaḥ | rāmaṃ darśaya me śīghraṃ purā me 'rtho 'tivartate || 7.105.2 ||
translation: सः he, अभिगम्य having approached, तु indeed, सौमित्रिम् to Saumitri, उवाच said, ऋषिसत्तमः the best of sages, रामम् Rama, दर्शय show, मे to me, शीघ्रम् quickly, पुरा before, मे my, अर्थः purpose, अतिवर्तते passes away.
explanation: Having approached Saumitri, the best of sages indeed said, "Show Rama to me quickly, before my purpose passes away."

shloka_text: मुनेस्तु भाषितं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा । अभिवाद्य महात्मानं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.105.3 ।।
transliteration: munestu bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā | abhivādya mahātmānaṃ vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.105.3 ||
translation: मुनेः of the sage, तु indeed, भाषितम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, परवीरहा destroyer of enemy heroes, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महात्मानम् the great-souled one, वाक्यम् words, एतत् this, उवाच said, ह indeed,
explanation: Having heard the words of the sage, Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemy heroes, saluted the great-souled one and then spoke these words.

shloka_text: किं कार्यं ब्रूहि भगवन्को वा ऽर्थः किं करोम्यहम् । व्यग्रो हि राघवो ब्रह्मन्मुहूर्तं प्रतिपाल्यताम् ।। 7.105.4 ।।
transliteration: kiṃ kāryaṃ brūhi bhagavanko vā 'rthaḥ kiṃ karomyaham | vyagro hi rāghavo brahmanmuhūrtaṃ pratipālyatām || 7.105.4 ||
translation: किम् what, कार्यम् task, ब्रूहि tell, भगवन् O revered one, कः what, वा or, अर्थः purpose, किम् what, करोमि shall I do, अहम् I, व्यग्रः busy, हि indeed, राघवः Rama, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, प्रतिपाल्यताम् let him be waited for,
explanation: Lakshmana asked, "O revered one, what is the task or purpose, and what shall I do, for Rama is indeed busy, O Brahmana, please wait for a moment."

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा ऋषिशार्दूलः क्रोधेन कलुषीकृतः । उवाच लक्ष्मणं वाक्यं निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा ।। 7.105.5 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā ṛṣiśārdūlaḥ krodhena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ | uvāca lakṣmaṇaṃ vākyaṃ nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā || 7.105.5 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, ऋषिशार्दूलः the tiger among sages, क्रोधेन by anger, कलुषीकृतः agitated, उवाच said, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, वाक्यम् words, निर्दहन् burning, इव as if, चक्षुषा with his eyes,
explanation: Having heard that, the tiger among sages, agitated by anger, spoke words to Lakshmana as if burning him with his eyes.

shloka_text: अस्मिन्क्षणे मां सौमित्रे रामाय प्रतिवेदय । अस्मिन्क्षणे मां सौमित्रे न निवेदयसे यदि ।। 7.105.6 ।।
transliteration: asminkṣaṇe māṃ saumitre rāmāya prativedaya | asminkṣaṇe māṃ saumitre na nivedayase yadi || 7.105.6 ||
translation: अस्मिन् in this, क्षणे moment, माम् me, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, रामाय to Rama, प्रतिवेदय announce, अस्मिन् in this, क्षणे moment, माम् me, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, न not, निवेदयसे you announce, यदि if,
explanation: The sage commanded, "O son of Sumitra, announce me to Rama this very moment; if you do not announce me to Rama this very moment, O son of Sumitra..."

shloka_text: विषयं त्वां पुरं चैव शपिष्ये राघवं तथा । भरतं चैव सौमित्रे युष्माकं या च सन्ततिः ।। 7.105.7 ।।
transliteration: viṣayaṃ tvāṃ puraṃ caiva śapiṣye rāghavaṃ tathā | bharataṃ caiva saumitre yuṣmākaṃ yā ca santatiḥ || 7.105.7 ||
translation: विषयम् the kingdom, त्वाम् you, पुरम् the city, च and, एव indeed, शपिष्ये I shall curse, राघवम् Rama, तथा and, भरतम् Bharata, च and, एव indeed, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, युष्माकम् your, या which, च and, सन्ततिः progeny,
explanation: ...then I shall curse your kingdom, you, the city, Rama, and also Bharata, O son of Sumitra, and all your progeny.

shloka_text: न हि शक्ष्याम्यहं भूयो मन्युं धारयितुं हृदि । तच्छ्रुत्वा घोरसङ्काशं वाक्यं तस्य महात्मनः । चिन्तयामास मनसा तस्य वाक्यस्य निश्चयम् ।। 7.105.8 ।।
transliteration: na hi śakṣyāmyahaṃ bhūyo manyuṃ dhārayituṃ hṛdi | tacchrutvā ghorasaṅkāśaṃ vākyaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ | cintayāmāsa manasā tasya vākyasya niścayam || 7.105.8 ||
translation: न not, हि indeed, शक्ष्यामि I shall be able, अहं I, भूयो again, मन्युं anger, धारयितुं to hold, हृदि in the heart, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, घोरसङ्काशं terrible-looking, वाक्यं word, तस्य of him, महात्मनः of the great soul, चिन्तयामास he thought, मनसा with the mind, तस्य of that, वाक्यस्य of the speech, निश्चयम् the certainty.
explanation: Having heard the terrible words of that great soul, he pondered in his mind the definite meaning of that statement, realizing he could no longer contain his anger.

shloka_text: एकस्य मरणं मे ऽस्तु मा भूत्सर्वविनाशनम् । इति बुद्ध्या विनिश्चित्य राघवाय न्यवेदयत् ।। 7.105.9 ।।
transliteration: ekasya maraṇaṃ me 'stu mā bhūtsarvavināśanam | iti buddhyā viniścitya rāghavāya nyavedayat || 7.105.9 ||
translation: एकस्य of one, मरणं death, मे for me, अस्तु let it be, मा not, भूत् let it be, सर्वविनाशनम् destruction of all, इति thus, बुद्ध्या with intellect, विनिश्चित्य having decided, राघवाय to Rama, न्यवेदयत् he reported.
explanation: Deciding with his intellect that it was better for one person to die than for everyone to be destroyed, he reported this to Rama.

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रामः कालं विसृज्य च । निस्सृत्य त्वरितं राजा अत्रेः पुत्रं ददर्श ह ।। 7.105.10 ।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā rāmaḥ kālaṃ visṛjya ca | nissṛtya tvaritaṃ rājā atreḥ putraṃ dadarśa ha || 7.105.10 ||
translation: लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, कालं Kala, विसृज्य having dismissed, च and, निस्सृत्य having come out, त्वरितं quickly, राजा the king, अत्रेः of Atri, पुत्रं the son, ददर्श saw, ह indeed.
explanation: Having heard Lakshmana's words, King Rama dismissed Kala and quickly came out to see the son of Atri.

shloka_text: सो ऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा । किं कार्यमिति काकुत्स्थः कृताञ्जलिरभाषत ।। 7.105.11 ।।
transliteration: so 'bhivādya mahātmānaṃ jvalantamiva tejasā | kiṃ kāryamiti kākutsthaḥ kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata || 7.105.11 ||
translation: सः he, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महात्मानं the great soul, ज्वलन्तम् blazing, इव as if, तेजसा with splendor, किं what, कार्यम् work, इति thus, काकुत्स्थः Rama, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, अभाषत spoke.
explanation: Having saluted the great soul who was blazing with splendor, Rama, with folded hands, asked what his purpose was.

shloka_text: तद्वाक्यं राघवेणोक्तं श्रुत्वा मुनिवरः प्रभुम् । प्रत्याह रामं दुर्वासाः श्रूयतां धर्मवत्सल ।। 7.105.12 ।।
transliteration: tadvākyaṃ rāghaveṇoktaṃ śrutvā munivaraḥ prabhum | pratyāha rāmaṃ durvāsāḥ śrūyatāṃ dharmavatsala || 7.105.12 ||
translation: तत् that, वाक्यं word, राघवेण by Rama, उक्तं spoken, श्रुत्वा having heard, मुनिवरः the best of sages, प्रभुम् to the lord, प्रत्याह replied, रामं to Rama, दुर्वासाः Durvasa, श्रूयतां let it be heard, धर्मवत्सल O lover of righteousness.
explanation: Having heard those words spoken by Rama, the best of sages, Durvasa, replied to the lord, saying, "O lover of righteousness, listen."

shloka_text: अद्य वर्षसहस्रस्य समाप्तिस्तपसो मम । सो ऽहं भोजनमिच्छामि यथासिद्धं तवानघ ।। 7.105.13 ।।
transliteration: adya varṣasahasrasya samāptistapaso mama | so 'haṃ bhojanamicchāmi yathāsiddhaṃ tavānagha || 7.105.13 ||
translation: अनघ O sinless one, अद्य today, मम my, वर्षसहस्रस्य of a thousand years, तपसः of penance, समाप्तिः is the completion, सः अहम् I therefore, यथासिद्धं whatever is ready, भोजनम् food, इच्छामि desire.
explanation: O sinless one, today marks the completion of my thousand-year penance, and so I desire whatever food is ready to break my fast.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं राजा राघवः प्रीतमानसः । भोजनं मुनिमुख्याय यथासिद्धमुपाहरत् ।। 7.105.14 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rājā rāghavaḥ prītamānasaḥ | bhojanaṃ munimukhyāya yathāsiddhamupāharat || 7.105.14 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, वचनं word, राजा king, राघवः Rama, प्रीतमानसः with a pleased mind, भोजनं food, मुनिमुख्याय to the chief of sages, यथासिद्धम् as prepared, उपाहरत् offered.
explanation: Having heard that word, King Rama, with a pleased mind, offered food to the chief of sages as it was prepared.

shloka_text: स तु भुक्त्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठस्तदन्नममृतोपमम् । साधु रामेति सम्भाष्य स्वमाश्रममुपागमत् ।। 7.105.15 ।।
transliteration: sa tu bhuktvā muniśreṣṭhastadannamamṛtopamam | sādhu rāmeti sambhāṣya svamāśramamupāgamat || 7.105.15 ||
translation: सः he, तु indeed, भुक्त्वा having eaten, मुनिश्रेष्ठः the best of sages, तत् that, अन्नम् food, अमृतोपमम् like nectar, साधु excellent, राम Rama, इति thus, सम्भाष्य having spoken, स्वम् his own, आश्रमम् hermitage, उपागमत् returned.
explanation: Having eaten that nectar-like food, the best of sages praised Rama saying "Excellent, Rama!" and then returned to his own hermitage.

shloka_text: तस्मिन् गते मुनिवरे स्वाश्रमं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः । संस्मृत्य कालवाक्यानि ततो दुःखमुपागमत् ।। 7.105.16 ।।
transliteration: tasmin gate munivare svāśramaṃ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ | saṃsmṛtya kālavākyāni tato duḥkhamupāgamat || 7.105.16 ||
translation: तस्मिन् when he, गते had gone, मुनिवरे the excellent sage, स्वम् his own, आश्रमम् hermitage, लक्ष्मणाग्रजः the elder brother of Lakshmana, संस्मृत्य having remembered, कालवाक्यानि the words of Kala, ततः then, दुःखम् sorrow, उपागमत् felt.
explanation: After that excellent sage had returned to his hermitage, Rama, the elder brother of Lakshmana, remembered the words of Kala and was then overcome with sorrow.

shloka_text: दुःखेन च सुसन्तप्तः स्मृत्वा तद्घोरदर्शनम् । अवाङ्मुखो दीनमना व्याहर्तुं न शशाक ह ।। 7.105.17 ।।
transliteration: duḥkhena ca susantaptaḥ smṛtvā tadghoradarśanam | avāṅmukho dīnamanā vyāhartuṃ na śaśāka ha || 7.105.17 ||
translation: दुःखेन by sorrow, च and, सुसन्तप्तः greatly afflicted, स्मृत्वा having remembered, तत् that, घोरदर्शनम् terrible sight, अवाङ्मुखः with downcast face, दीनमनाः with a dejected mind, व्याहर्तुं to speak, न not, शशाक was able, ह indeed.
explanation: Deeply distressed by sorrow and remembering that terrible sight, he became downcast and dejected, unable to utter a word.

shloka_text: ततो बुद्ध्या विनिश्चित्य कालवाक्यानि राघवः । नैतदस्तीति निश्चित्य तूष्णीमासीन्महायशाः ।। 7.105.18 ।।
transliteration: tato buddhyā viniścitya kālavākyāni rāghavaḥ | naitadastīti niścitya tūṣṇīmāsīnmahāyaśāḥ || 7.105.18 ||
translation: ततः then, बुद्ध्या by intellect, विनिश्चित्य having ascertained, कालवाक्यानि the words of Kala, राघवः Rama, न not, एतत् this, अस्ति is, इति thus, निश्चित्य having decided, तूष्णीम् silently, आसीत् remained, महायशाः the greatly renowned one.
explanation: Then, the greatly renowned Rama, having intellectually ascertained the words of Kala and deciding that "this is not (to be avoided)", remained silent. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 105 ।। Thus ends the hundred and fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: अवाङ्मुखमथो दीनं दृष्ट्वा सोममिवाप्लुतम् । राघवं लक्ष्मणो वाक्यं हृष्टो मधुरमब्रवीत् ।। 7.106.1 ।।
transliteration: avāṅmukhamatho dīnaṃ dṛṣṭvā somamivāplutam | rāghavaṃ lakṣmaṇo vākyaṃ hṛṣṭo madhuramabravīt || 7.106.1 ||
translation: अवाङ्मुखम् with face downwards, अथो then, दीनम् distressed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सोमम् the moon, इव like, आप्लुतम् submerged (in sorrow), राघवम् Rama, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, वाक्यम् words, हृष्टः with resolve, मधुरम् gentle, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Seeing Rama with his face downcast and distressed, like the moon submerged in sorrow, Lakshmana, with a firm resolve, spoke gentle words to him.
comments: Lakshmana, understanding, bids Rama abandon him to keep his vow lest dharma itself perish, and the council and Vasishtha confirm that the parting was foreseen and must be borne for the worlds' sake -- Rama gives him up, and Lakshmana goes to the Sarayu, stills his breath, and is taken bodily to heaven by Indra as the fourth part of Vishnu, honoured by the gods.

shloka_text: न संतापं महाबाहो मदर्थं कर्तुमर्हसि । पूर्वनिर्माणबद्धा हि कालस्य गतिरीदृशी ।। 7.106.2 ।।
transliteration: na saṃtāpaṃ mahābāho madarthaṃ kartumarhasi | pūrvanirmāṇabaddhā hi kālasya gatirīdṛśī || 7.106.2 ||
translation: न not, संतापम् sorrow, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, मदर्थम् for my sake, कर्तुम् to make, अर्हसि you ought, पूर्वनिर्माणबद्धा bound by previous destiny, हि indeed, कालस्य of time, गतिः the course, ईदृशी such.
explanation: O mighty-armed one, you should not grieve for my sake, for such is indeed the course of time, bound by preordained destiny.

shloka_text: जहि मां सौम्य विस्रब्धं प्रतिज्ञां परिपालय । हीनप्रतिज्ञाः काकुत्स्थ प्रयान्ति नरकं नराः ।। 7.106.3 ।।
transliteration: jahi māṃ saumya visrabdhaṃ pratijñāṃ paripālaya | hīnapratijñāḥ kākutstha prayānti narakaṃ narāḥ || 7.106.3 ||
translation: जहि kill/abandon, माम् me, सौम्य O gentle one, विस्रब्धम् confidently, प्रतिज्ञाम् the vow, परिपालय fulfill, हीनप्रतिज्ञाः those who fail in their vows, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, प्रयान्ति go, नरकम् to hell, नराः men.
explanation: O gentle one, confidently abandon me and fulfill your vow, for men who fail in their promises, O Kakutstha, go to hell.

shloka_text: यदि प्रीतिर्महाराज यद्यनुग्राह्यता मयि । जहि मां निर्विशङ्कस्त्वं धर्मं वर्धय राघव ।। 7.106.4 ।।
transliteration: yadi prītirmahārāja yadyanugrāhyatā mayi | jahi māṃ nirviśaṅkastvaṃ dharmaṃ vardhaya rāghava || 7.106.4 ||
translation: यदि if, प्रीतिः affection, महाराज O great king, यदि if, अनुग्राह्यता favor, मयि in me, जहि kill/abandon, माम् me, निर्विशङ्कः without doubt, त्वम् you, धर्मम् righteousness, वर्धय uphold, राघव O Raghava.
explanation: O great king, if there is affection and favor towards me, then abandon me without hesitation, O Raghava, and uphold your dharma.

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणेन तथोक्तस्तु रामः प्रचलितेन्द्रियः । मन्त्रिणः समुपानीय तथैव च पुरोधसम् ।। 7.106.5 ।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇena tathoktastu rāmaḥ pracalitendriyaḥ | mantriṇaḥ samupānīya tathaiva ca purodhasam || 7.106.5 ||
translation: लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, तथा thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, रामः Rama, प्रचलितेन्द्रियः with agitated senses, मन्त्रिणः the ministers, समुपानीय having summoned, तथैव and similarly, च and, पुरोधसम् the chief priest.
explanation: Thus spoken to by Lakshmana, Rama, with his senses greatly disturbed, summoned his ministers and similarly his chief priest.

shloka_text: अब्रवीच्च तदा वृत्तं तेषां मध्ये स राघवः । दुर्वासोभिगमं चैव प्रतिज्ञां तापसस्य च ।। 7.106.6 ।।
transliteration: abravīcca tadā vṛttaṃ teṣāṃ madhye sa rāghavaḥ | durvāsobhigamaṃ caiva pratijñāṃ tāpasasya ca || 7.106.6 ||
translation: अब्रवीत् spoke, च and, तदा then, वृत्तम् the incident, तेषाम् among them, मध्ये in the midst, सः he, राघवः Rama, दुर्वासोभिगमम् the arrival of Durvasa, च and, एव also, प्रतिज्ञाम् the vow, तापसस्य of the ascetic, च and.
explanation: Then, in their midst, Rama recounted the incident, including the arrival of Durvasa and the ascetic's vow.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा मन्त्रिणः सर्वे सोपाध्यायाः समासत । वसिष्ठस्तु महातेजा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.106.7 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā mantriṇaḥ sarve sopādhyāyāḥ samāsata | vasiṣṭhastu mahātejā vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.106.7 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, मन्त्रिणः the ministers, सर्वे all, सोपाध्यायाः with their preceptors, समासत assembled, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, तु indeed, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.
explanation: Having heard that, all the ministers, along with their preceptors, assembled, and then the greatly effulgent Vasishtha spoke these words.

shloka_text: दृष्टमेतन्महाबाहो क्षयं ते रोमहर्षणम् । लक्ष्मणेन वियोगश्च तव राम महायशः ।। 7.106.8 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭametanmahābāho kṣayaṃ te romaharṣaṇam | lakṣmaṇena viyogaśca tava rāma mahāyaśaḥ || 7.106.8 ||
translation: दृष्टम् foreseen, एतत् this, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, क्षयम् destruction, ते your, रोमहर्षणम् terrifying, लक्ष्मणेन with Lakshmana, वियोगः separation, च and, तव your, राम O Rama, महायशः O greatly renowned one.
explanation: O mighty-armed and greatly renowned Rama, this terrifying destruction and your separation from Lakshmana have been foreseen.

shloka_text: त्यजैनं बलवान्कालो मा प्रतिज्ञां वृथा कृताः । विनष्टायां प्रतिज्ञायां धर्मो ऽपि च लयं व्रजेत् ।। 7.106.9 ।।
transliteration: tyajainaṃ balavānkālo mā pratijñāṃ vṛthā kṛtāḥ | vinaṣṭāyāṃ pratijñāyāṃ dharmo 'pi ca layaṃ vrajet || 7.106.9 ||
translation: त्यज abandon, एनम् him, बलवान् powerful, कालः time/fate, मा do not, प्रतिज्ञाम् the vow, वृथा in vain, कृताः made; विनष्टायाम् if violated, प्रतिज्ञायाम् the vow, धर्मः righteousness, अपि even, च and, लयम् dissolution, व्रजेत् would attain.
explanation: Abandon him, for time is powerful; do not let your vow be made in vain, because if the vow is violated, even righteousness will meet its dissolution.

shloka_text: ततो धर्मे विनष्टे तु त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । सदेवर्षिगणं सर्वं विनश्येत्तु न संशयः ।। 7.106.10 ।।
transliteration: tato dharme vinaṣṭe tu trailokyaṃ sacarācaram | sadevarṣigaṇaṃ sarvaṃ vinaśyettu na saṃśayaḥ || 7.106.10 ||
translation: ततः then, धर्मे righteousness, विनष्टे having been destroyed, तु indeed, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, सचराचरम् with moving and non-moving beings, सदेवर्षिगणम् with groups of gods and sages, सर्वम् all, विनश्येत् would be destroyed, तु indeed, न not, संशयः doubt.
explanation: Therefore, if righteousness is destroyed, then without a doubt, all three worlds, including all moving and non-moving beings, along with the groups of gods and sages, would also be destroyed.

shloka_text: स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल त्रैलोक्यस्याभिपालनात् । लक्ष्मणेन विना चाद्य जगत्स्वस्थं कुरुष्व ह ।। 7.106.11 ।।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ puruṣaśārdūla trailokyasyābhipālanāt | lakṣmaṇena vinā cādya jagatsvasthaṃ kuruṣva ha || 7.106.11 ||
translation: स that, त्वं you, पुरुषशार्दूल O tiger among men, त्रैलोक्यस्य of the three worlds, अभिपालनात् for the protection, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, विना without, च and, अद्य today, जगत् the world, स्वस्थं well, कुरुष्व make, ह indeed
explanation: O tiger among men, for the protection of the three worlds, you must now make the world stable even without Lakshmana.

shloka_text: तेषां तत्समवेतानां वाक्यं धर्मार्थसंहितम् । श्रुत्वा परिषदो मध्ये रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत् ।। 7.106.12 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ tatsamavetānāṃ vākyaṃ dharmārthasaṃhitam | śrutvā pariṣado madhye rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt || 7.106.12 ||
translation: तेषां of them, तत्समवेतानां who were assembled there, वाक्यं the words, धर्मार्थसंहितम् endowed with righteousness and purpose, श्रुत्वा having heard, परिषदो of the assembly, मध्ये in the midst, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Having heard the words full of righteousness and purpose from those assembled in the midst of the council, Rama spoke to Lakshmana.

shloka_text: विसर्जये त्वां सौमित्रे मा भूद्धर्मविपर्ययः । त्यागो वधो वा विहितः साधूनां तूभयं समम् ।। 7.106.13 ।।
transliteration: visarjaye tvāṃ saumitre mā bhūddharmaviparyayaḥ | tyāgo vadho vā vihitaḥ sādhūnāṃ tūbhayaṃ samam || 7.106.13 ||
translation: विसर्जये I shall abandon, त्वां you, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, मा do not, भूत् let there be, धर्मविपर्ययः a transgression of dharma, त्यागः abandonment, वधः killing, वा or, विहितः prescribed, साधूनां for the virtuous, तु but, उभयं both, समम् equal
explanation: O son of Sumitra, I shall abandon you, lest there be a transgression of dharma, for abandonment or killing is prescribed, and for the virtuous, both are considered equal.

shloka_text: रामेण भाषिते वाक्ये बाष्पव्याकुलितेन्द्रियः । लक्ष्मणस्त्वरितं प्रायात्स्वगृहं न विवेश ह ।। 7.106.14 ।।
transliteration: rāmeṇa bhāṣite vākye bāṣpavyākulitendriyaḥ | lakṣmaṇastvaritaṃ prāyātsvagṛhaṃ na viveśa ha || 7.106.14 ||
translation: रामेण by Rama, भाषिते having been spoken, वाक्ये the words, बाष्पव्याकुलितेन्द्रियः whose senses were agitated by tears, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, त्वरितं quickly, प्रायात् departed, स्वगृहं his own house, न not, विवेश entered, ह indeed
explanation: When these words were spoken by Rama, Lakshmana, whose senses were agitated by tears, quickly departed and indeed did not enter his own house.

shloka_text: स गत्वा सरयूतीरमुपस्पृश्य कृताञ्जलिः । निगृह्य सर्वस्रोतांसि निःश्वासं न मुमोच ह ।। 7.106.15 ।।
transliteration: sa gatvā sarayūtīramupaspṛśya kṛtāñjaliḥ | nigṛhya sarvasrotāṃsi niḥśvāsaṃ na mumoca ha || 7.106.15 ||
translation: सः he, गत्वा having gone, सरयूतीरम् to the bank of the Sarayu, उपस्पृश्य having touched water, कृताञ्जलिः having made an anjali, निगृह्य having restrained, सर्वस्रोतांसि all the streams (of his senses/life-breaths), निःश्वासं breath, न not, मुमोच released, ह indeed
explanation: Having gone to the bank of the Sarayu, he performed ritual purification, folded his hands in reverence, and restraining all his vital breaths, he indeed did not release a single exhalation.

shloka_text: अनिःश्वसन्तं युक्तं तं सशक्राः साप्सरोगणाः । देवाः सर्षिगणाः सर्वे पुष्पैरभ्यकिरंस्तदा ।। 7.106.16 ।।
transliteration: aniḥśvasantaṃ yuktaṃ taṃ saśakrāḥ sāpsarogaṇāḥ | devāḥ sarṣigaṇāḥ sarve puṣpairabhyakiraṃstadā || 7.106.16 ||
translation: अनिःश्वसन्तं not breathing, युक्तं absorbed, तं him, सशक्राः with Indra, साप्सरोगणाः with groups of Apsaras, देवाः gods, सर्षिगणाः with groups of sages, सर्वे all, पुष्पैरभ्यकिरन् showered with flowers, तदा then.
explanation: Then, all the gods, along with Indra, groups of Apsaras, and groups of sages, showered flowers upon him (Lakshmana), who was absorbed (in his divine form) and had ceased breathing.

shloka_text: अदृश्यं सर्वमनुजैः सशरीरं महाबलम् । प्रगृह्य लक्ष्मणं शक्रस्त्रिदिवं संविवेश ह ।। 7.106.17 ।।
transliteration: adṛśyaṃ sarvamanujaiḥ saśarīraṃ mahābalam | pragṛhya lakṣmaṇaṃ śakrastridivaṃ saṃviveśa ha || 7.106.17 ||
translation: अदृश्यं invisible, सर्वमनुजैः to all humans, सशरीरं with his body, महाबलम् the mighty one, प्रगृह्य taking, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, शक्रः Indra, त्रिदिवं to heaven, संविवेश entered, ह indeed.
explanation: Indeed, Indra took the mighty Lakshmana, who was invisible to all humans and still in his physical body, and entered heaven.

shloka_text: ततो विष्णोश्चतुर्भागमागतं सुरसत्तमाः । दृष्ट्वा प्रमुदिताः सर्वे ऽपूजयन् समहर्षयः ।। 7.106.18 ।।
transliteration: tato viṣṇoścaturbhāgamāgataṃ surasattamāḥ | dṛṣṭvā pramuditāḥ sarve 'pūjayan samaharṣayaḥ || 7.106.18 ||
translation: ततः then, विष्णोः of Vishnu, चतुर्भागम् the fourth part, आगतं arrived, सुरसत्तमाः the best of gods, दृष्ट्वा having seen, प्रमुदिताः greatly delighted, सर्वे all, अपूजयन् worshipped, समहर्षयः with the great sages.
explanation: Then, having seen the fourth part of Vishnu (Lakshmana) arrive, all the best of gods, along with the great sages, were greatly delighted and worshipped him. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षडुत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 106 ।। Thus ends the hundred and sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: विसृज्य लक्ष्मणं रामो दुःखशोकसमन्वितः । पुरोधसं मन्त्रिणश्च नैगमांश्चेदमब्रवीत् ।। 7.107.1 ।।
transliteration: visṛjya lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmo duḥkhaśokasamanvitaḥ | purodhasaṃ mantriṇaśca naigamāṃścedamabravīt || 7.107.1 ||
translation: विसृज्य having sent away, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, रामः Rama, दुःखशोकसमन्वितः filled with sorrow and grief, पुरोधसं to the chief priest, मन्त्रिणः to the ministers, च and, नैगमान् to the citizens, च and, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Having sent Lakshmana away, Rama, filled with sorrow and grief, spoke these words to his chief priest, ministers, and citizens.
comments: Bereft of Lakshmana, Rama resolves to install Bharata and retire to the forest -- but Bharata refuses kingship without him and asks that Kusha and Lava be enthroned, while the grieving citizens beg to follow wherever Rama goes -- consenting, Rama consecrates Kusha in Kosala and Lava in the north, endows them richly, and sends messengers to summon Shatrughna.

shloka_text: अद्य राज्ये ऽभिषेक्ष्यामि भरतं धर्मवत्सलम् । अयोध्यायाः पतिं वीरं ततो यास्याम्यहं वनम् ।। 7.107.2 ।।
transliteration: adya rājye 'bhiṣekṣyāmi bharataṃ dharmavatsalam | ayodhyāyāḥ patiṃ vīraṃ tato yāsyāmyahaṃ vanam || 7.107.2 ||
translation: अद्य today, राज्ये in the kingdom, अभिषेक्ष्यामि I shall anoint, भरतं Bharata, धर्मवत्सलम् devoted to dharma, अयोध्यायाः of Ayodhya, पतिं the lord, वीरं the brave one, ततः then, यास्यामि I shall go, अहं I, वनम् to the forest.
explanation: Rama declared, "Today I shall install the righteous and brave Bharata as the ruler of Ayodhya, and then I myself shall go to the forest."

shloka_text: प्रवेशयत सम्भारान्माभूत्कालस्य पर्ययः । अद्यैवाहं गमिष्यामि लक्ष्मणेन गतां गतिम् ।। 7.107.3 ।।
transliteration: praveśayata sambhārānmābhūtkālasya paryayaḥ | adyaivāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi lakṣmaṇena gatāṃ gatim || 7.107.3 ||
translation: प्रवेशयत bring in, सम्भारान् preparations, मा let not, भूत् happen, कालस्य of time, पर्ययः a lapse, अद्यैव today itself, अहं I, गमिष्यामि will go, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, गतां attained, गतिम् the path.
explanation: Bring in the preparations, let there be no delay, for today itself I will follow the path that Lakshmana has taken.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवेणोक्तं सर्वाः प्रकृतयो भृशम् । मूर्धभिः प्रणता भूमौ गतसत्त्वा इवाभवन् ।। 7.107.4 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā rāghaveṇoktaṃ sarvāḥ prakṛtayo bhṛśam | mūrdhabhiḥ praṇatā bhūmau gatasattvā ivābhavan || 7.107.4 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, राघवेण by Rama, उक्तं spoken, सर्वाः all, प्रकृतयः the subjects, भृशम् greatly, मूर्धभिः with their heads, प्रणताः bowed down, भूमौ on the ground, गतसत्त्वाः as if lifeless, इव as if, अभवन् became.
explanation: Having heard those words spoken by Rama, all the subjects greatly bowed their heads to the ground, as if they had lost their very life.

shloka_text: भरतश्च विसञ्ज्ञो ऽभूच्छ्रुत्वा रामस्य भाषितम् । राज्यं विगर्हयामास राघवं चेदमब्रवीत् ।। 7.107.5 ।।
transliteration: bharataśca visañjño 'bhūcchrutvā rāmasya bhāṣitam | rājyaṃ vigarhayāmāsa rāghavaṃ cedamabravīt || 7.107.5 ||
translation: भरतश्च Bharata also, विसञ्ज्ञः unconscious, अभूत् became, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामस्य of Rama, भाषितम् the words, राज्यं kingship, विगर्हयामास condemned, राघवं to Rama, च and, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Bharata also became unconscious upon hearing Rama's words, and condemning kingship, he spoke these words to Rama.

shloka_text: सत्येनाहं शपे राजन्स्वर्गलोके न चैव हि । न कामये यथा राज्यं त्वां विना रघुनन्दन ।। 7.107.6 ।।
transliteration: satyenāhaṃ śape rājansvargaloke na caiva hi | na kāmaye yathā rājyaṃ tvāṃ vinā raghunandana || 7.107.6 ||
translation: सत्येन by truth, अहं I, शपे swear, राजन् O King, स्वर्गलोके in the heavenly world, न not, च and, एव indeed, हि surely, न not, कामये desire, यथा just as, राज्यं kingship, त्वां you, विना without, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: O King, I swear by truth, and indeed by the heavenly world, that I do not desire kingship without you, O delight of the Raghus.

shloka_text: इमौ कुशलवौ राजन्नभिषिञ्च नराधिप । कोसलेषु कुशं वीरमुत्तरेषु तथा लवम् ।। 7.107.7 ।।
transliteration: imau kuśalavau rājannabhiṣiñca narādhipa | kosaleṣu kuśaṃ vīramuttareṣu tathā lavam || 7.107.7 ||
translation: इमौ these two, कुशलवौ Kusha and Lava, राजन् O King, अभिषिञ्च enthrone, नराधिप O lord of men, कोसलेषु in Kosala, कुशं Kusha, वीरम् the brave, उत्तरेषु in the northern regions, तथा and, लवम् Lava.
explanation: O King, O lord of men, enthrone these two, Kusha and Lava; Kusha, the brave, in Kosala, and similarly Lava in the northern regions.

shloka_text: शत्रुघ्नस्य तु गच्छन्तु दूतास्त्वरितविक्रमाः । इदं गमनमस्माकं स्वर्गायाख्यातु मा चिरम् ।। 7.107.8 ।।
transliteration: śatrughnasya tu gacchantu dūtāstvaritavikramāḥ | idaṃ gamanamasmākaṃ svargāyākhyātu mā ciram || 7.107.8 ||
translation: शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, तु and, गच्छन्तु let them go, दूताः messengers, त्वरितविक्रमाः swift-footed, इदं this, गमनम् departure, अस्माकं our, स्वर्गाय for heaven, आख्यातु let them announce, मा not, चिरम् long.
explanation: Let swift messengers go to Shatrughna and without delay inform him of our departure to heaven.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा भरतेनोक्तं दृष्ट्वा चापि ह्यधोमुखान् । पौरान्दुःखेन सन्तप्तान्वसिष्ठो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। 7.107.9 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā bharatenoktaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāpi hyadhomukhān | paurānduḥkhena santaptānvasiṣṭho vākyamabravīt || 7.107.9 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, भरतेन by Bharata, उक्तं spoken, दृष्ट्वा having seen, च and, अपि also, अधोमुखान् downcast, पौरान् citizens, दुःखेन by sorrow, सन्तप्तान् distressed, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having heard what Bharata said and seeing the citizens distressed and downcast with sorrow, Vasishtha spoke these words.

shloka_text: वत्स राम इमाः पश्य धरणीं प्रकृतीर्गताः । ज्ञात्वैषामीप्सितं कार्यं मा चैषां विप्रियं कृथाः ।। 7.107.10 ।।
transliteration: vatsa rāma imāḥ paśya dharaṇīṃ prakṛtīrgatāḥ | jñātvaiṣāmīpsitaṃ kāryaṃ mā caiṣāṃ vipriyaṃ kṛthāḥ || 7.107.10 ||
translation: वत्स dear son, राम Rama, इमाः these, पश्य behold, धरणीं to the ground, प्रकृतीः subjects, गताः fallen, ज्ञात्वा having known, एषां their, ईप्सितं desired, कार्यं action, मा not, च and, एषां their, विप्रियं displeasure, कृथाः cause.
explanation: Vasishtha said, "Dear Rama, behold these subjects fallen to the ground; understanding their desire, do not cause them any displeasure."

shloka_text: वसिष्ठस्य तु वाक्येन उत्थाप्य प्रकृतीजनम् । किं करोमीति काकुत्स्थः सर्वा वचनमब्रवीत् ।। 7.107.11 ।।
transliteration: vasiṣṭhasya tu vākyena utthāpya prakṛtījanam | kiṃ karomīti kākutsthaḥ sarvā vacanamabravīt || 7.107.11 ||
translation: वसिष्ठस्य of Vasishtha, तु and, वाक्येन by the words, उत्थाप्य having raised up, प्रकृतीजनम् the people, किं what, करोमि shall I do, इति thus, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), सर्वाः to all, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: And by the words of Vasishtha, Rama, having raised up the people, spoke to all, asking, "What shall I do?"

shloka_text: ततः सर्वाः प्रकृतयो रामं वचनमब्रुवन् । गच्छन्तमनुगच्छामो यत्र राम गमिष्यसि ।। 7.107.12 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayo rāmaṃ vacanamabruvan | gacchantamanugacchāmo yatra rāma gamiṣyasi || 7.107.12 ||
translation: ततः then, सर्वाः all, प्रकृतयः subjects, रामं to Rama, वचनम् words, अब्रुवन् spoke, गच्छन्तम् one who is going, अनुगच्छामः we will follow, यत्र where, राम Rama, गमिष्यसि you will go.
explanation: Then all the subjects spoke to Rama, saying, "We will follow you, wherever you, Rama, will go."

shloka_text: पौरेषु यदि ते प्रीतिर्यदि स्नेहो ह्यनुत्तमः । सपुत्रदाराः काकुत्स्थ समागच्छाम सत्पथम् ।। 7.107.13 ।।
transliteration: paureṣu yadi te prītiryadi sneho hyanuttamaḥ | saputradārāḥ kākutstha samāgacchāma satpatham || 7.107.13 ||
translation: पौरेषु towards the citizens, यदि if, ते your, प्रीतिः affection, यदि if, स्नेहः love, हि indeed, अनुत्तमः unsurpassed, सपुत्रदाराः with children and wives, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, समागच्छाम let us go together, सत्पथम् on the righteous path.
explanation: O Rama, if you truly have unsurpassed affection and love for your citizens, then let us all, with our children and wives, accompany you on your path.

shloka_text: तपोवनं वा दुर्गं वा नदीमम्भोनिधिं तथा । वयं ते यदि न त्याज्याः सर्वान्नो नय ईश्वर ।। 7.107.14 ।।
transliteration: tapovanaṃ vā durgaṃ vā nadīmambhonidhiṃ tathā | vayaṃ te yadi na tyājyāḥ sarvānno naya īśvara || 7.107.14 ||
translation: तपोवनम् to the hermitage, वा or, दुर्गम् to a fortress, वा or, नदीम् to a river, अम्भोनिधिम् to the ocean, तथा similarly, वयम् we, ते by you, यदि if, न not, त्याज्याः to be abandoned, सर्वान् all, नः us, नय lead, ईश्वर O Lord.
explanation: O Lord, if we are not to be abandoned by you, then lead all of us, whether to a hermitage, a fortress, a river, or the ocean.

shloka_text: एषा नः परमा प्रीतिरेष नः परमो वरः । हृद्गता नः सदा प्रीतिस्तवानुगमने नृप ।। 7.107.15 ।।
transliteration: eṣā naḥ paramā prītireṣa naḥ paramo varaḥ | hṛdgatā naḥ sadā prītistavānugamane nṛpa || 7.107.15 ||
translation: एषा this, नः our, परमा supreme, प्रीतिः affection, एषः this, नः our, परमः supreme, वरः boon, हृद्गता residing in the heart, नः our, सदा always, प्रीतिः affection, तव your, अनुगमने in following, नृप O King.
explanation: O King, this is our supreme affection and our greatest wish, for our hearts are always filled with love for following you.

shloka_text: पौराणां दृढभक्तिं च बाढमित्येव सो ऽब्रवीत् । स्वकृतान्तं चान्ववेक्ष्य तस्मिन्नहनि राघवः ।। 7.107.16 ।।
transliteration: paurāṇāṃ dṛḍhabhaktiṃ ca bāḍhamityeva so 'bravīt | svakṛtāntaṃ cānvavekṣya tasminnahani rāghavaḥ || 7.107.16 ||
translation: पौराणाम् of the citizens, दृढभक्तिम् firm devotion, च and, बाढम् certainly, इति thus, एव indeed, सः he, अब्रवीत् said, स्वकृतान्तम् his own destiny, च and, अन्ववेक्ष्य having considered, तस्मिन् on that, अहनि day, राघवः Rama.
explanation: Having observed the firm devotion of the citizens and considering his own destined end, Rama said, "Certainly, yes," on that very day.

shloka_text: कोसलेषु कुशं वीरमुत्तरेषु तथा लवम् । अभिषिच्य महात्मानावुभौ रामः कुशीलवौ ।। 7.107.17 ।।
transliteration: kosaleṣu kuśaṃ vīramuttareṣu tathā lavam | abhiṣicya mahātmānāvubhau rāmaḥ kuśīlavau || 7.107.17 ||
translation: कोसलेषु in Kosala, कुशम् Kusha, वीरम् the brave, उत्तरेषु in the northern regions, तथा similarly, लवम् Lava, अभिषिच्य having consecrated, महात्मानौ the two great-souled ones, उभौ both, रामः Rama, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava.
explanation: Rama, having consecrated both the brave and great-souled Kusha in Kosala and similarly Lava in the northern regions, completed his arrangements.

shloka_text: अभिषिक्तौ सुतावङ्के प्रतिष्ठाप्य पुरे ततः । परिष्वज्य महाबाहुर्मूर्ध्न्युपाघ्राय चासकृत् ।। 7.107.18 ।।
transliteration: abhiṣiktau sutāvaṅke pratiṣṭhāpya pure tataḥ | pariṣvajya mahābāhurmūrdhnyupāghrāya cāsakṛt || 7.107.18 ||
translation: अभिषिक्तौ having been consecrated, सुतौ sons, अङ्के on his lap, प्रतिष्ठाप्य having established, पुरे in the city, ततः then, परिष्वज्य having embraced, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, मूर्ध्नि on the head, उपाघ्राय having smelled, च and, असकृत् repeatedly.
explanation: Then, the mighty-armed Rama, having consecrated his two sons and established them in the city, repeatedly embraced them and kissed them on their heads.

shloka_text: रथानां तु सहस्राणि नागानामयुतानि च । दशायुतानि चाश्वानामेकैकस्य धनं ददौ ।। 7.107.19 ।।
transliteration: rathānāṃ tu sahasrāṇi nāgānāmayutāni ca | daśāyutāni cāśvānāmekaikasya dhanaṃ dadau || 7.107.19 ||
translation: रथानाम् of chariots, तु indeed, सहस्राणि thousands, नागानाम् of elephants, अयुतानि ten thousands, च and, दशायुतानि ten ten-thousands, च and, अश्वानाम् of horses, एकैकस्य to each one, धनम् wealth, ददौ he gave.
explanation: He gave to each of his sons thousands of chariots, ten thousands of elephants, and one hundred thousand horses as wealth.

shloka_text: बहुरत्नौ बहुधनौ हृष्टपुष्टजनावृतौ । स्वे पुरे प्रेषयामास भ्रातरौ तु कुशीलवौ ।। 7.107.20 ।।
transliteration: bahuratnau bahudhanau hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛtau | sve pure preṣayāmāsa bhrātarau tu kuśīlavau || 7.107.20 ||
translation: बहुरत्नौ having many jewels, बहुधनौ having much wealth, हृष्टपुष्टजनावृतौ surrounded by happy and well-nourished people, स्वे to their own, पुरे city, प्रेषयामास he sent, भ्रातरौ the two brothers, तु indeed, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava.
explanation: He then sent the two brothers, Kusha and Lava, to their respective cities, each endowed with many jewels, much wealth, and surrounded by happy and prosperous people.

shloka_text: अभिषिच्य सुतौ वीरौ प्रतिष्ठाप्य पुरे तदा । दूतान्सम्प्रेषयामास शत्रुघ्नाय महात्मने ।। 7.107.21 ।।
transliteration: abhiṣicya sutau vīrau pratiṣṭhāpya pure tadā | dūtānsampreṣayāmāsa śatrughnāya mahātmane || 7.107.21 ||
translation: अभिषिच्य having consecrated, सुतौ sons, वीरौ heroic, प्रतिष्ठाप्य having established, पुरे in the city, तदा then, दूतान् messengers, सम्प्रेषयामास he sent, शत्रुघ्नाय to Shatrughna, महात्मने the great-souled one.
explanation: After consecrating his heroic sons and establishing them in their cities, he then dispatched messengers to the great-souled Shatrughna. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 107 ।। Thus ends the hundred and seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ते दूता रामवाक्येन चोदिता लघुविक्रमाः । प्रजग्मुर्मधुरां शीघ्रं चक्रुर्वासं न चाध्वनि ।। 7.108.1 ।।
transliteration: te dūtā rāmavākyena coditā laghuvikramāḥ | prajagmurmadhurāṃ śīghraṃ cakrurvāsaṃ na cādhvani || 7.108.1 ||
translation: ते those, दूताः messengers, रामवाक्येन by Rama's command, चोदिताः urged, लघुविक्रमाः swift in action, प्रजग्मुः they went forth, मधुराम् to Mathura, शीघ्रम् quickly, चक्रुः they made, वासम् a stay, न not, च and, अध्वनि on the way.
explanation: Those messengers, urged by Rama's command and swift in their journey, quickly set forth for Mathura and did not make any halts on the way.
comments: The messengers reach Mathura and tell Shatrughna all -- Lakshmana's loss, Rama's vow, the enthroning of his sons, and Ayodhya emptied -- and Shatrughna, dividing his realm between Subahu and Shatrughati, returns to follow Rama -- the monkeys, bears and rakshasas led by Sugriva gather to accompany him, and Rama assents, but charges Vibhishana to go on ruling Lanka and Hanuman to live as long as his story is told.

shloka_text: ते तु त्रिभिरहोरात्रैः सम्प्राप्य मधुरामथ । शत्रुघ्नाय यथातत्त्वमाचख्युः सर्वमेव तत् ।। 7.108.2 ।।
transliteration: te tu tribhirahorātraiḥ samprāpya madhurāmatha | śatrughnāya yathātattvamācakhyuḥ sarvameva tat || 7.108.2 ||
translation: ते they, तु indeed, त्रिभिः by three, अहोरात्रैः days and nights, सम्प्राप्य having reached, मधुरामथ then Mathura, शत्रुघ्नाय to Shatrughna, यथातत्त्वम् as it truly happened, आचख्युः they narrated, सर्वम् all, एव indeed, तत् that
explanation: Having reached Mathura in three days and nights, they truthfully narrated all the events to Shatrughna.

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणस्य परित्यागं प्रतिज्ञां राघवस्य च । पुत्रयोरभिषेकं च पौरानुगमनं तथा ।। 7.108.3 ।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya parityāgaṃ pratijñāṃ rāghavasya ca | putrayorabhiṣekaṃ ca paurānugamanaṃ tathā || 7.108.3 ||
translation: लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, परित्यागम् the abandonment, प्रतिज्ञाम् the vow, राघवस्य of Rama, च and, पुत्रयोः of the two sons, अभिषेकम् the coronation, च and, पौरानुगमनम् the following by the citizens, तथा and also
explanation: They recounted Lakshmana's abandonment, Rama's vow, the coronation of his two sons, and the citizens' departure with him.

shloka_text: कुशस्य नगरी रम्या विन्ध्यपर्वतरोधसि । कुशावतीति नाम्ना सा कृता रामेण धीमता । श्रावस्तीति पुरी रम्या श्राविता च लवस्य ह ।। 7.108.4 ।।
transliteration: kuśasya nagarī ramyā vindhyaparvatarodhasi | kuśāvatīti nāmnā sā kṛtā rāmeṇa dhīmatā | śrāvastīti purī ramyā śrāvitā ca lavasya ha || 7.108.4 ||
translation: कुशस्य for Kusha, नगरी city, रम्या beautiful, विन्ध्यपर्वतरोधसि on the slope of the Vindhya mountain, कुशावतीति as Kushavati, नाम्ना by name, सा that, कृता was established, रामेण by Rama, धीमता by the wise one, श्रावस्तीति as Shravasti, पुरी city, रम्या beautiful, श्राविता was assigned, च and, लवस्य for Lava, ह indeed
explanation: The wise Rama established a beautiful city named Kushavati on the Vindhya mountain slopes for Kusha, and the beautiful city of Shravasti was assigned to Lava.

shloka_text: अयोध्यां विजनां कृत्वा राघवो भरतस्तथा । स्वर्गस्य गमनोद्योगं कृतवन्तौ महारथौ ।। 7.108.5 ।।
transliteration: ayodhyāṃ vijanāṃ kṛtvā rāghavo bharatastathā | svargasya gamanodyogaṃ kṛtavantau mahārathau || 7.108.5 ||
translation: अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, विजनाम् deserted, कृत्वा having made, राघवः Rama, भरतः Bharata, तथा and also, स्वर्गस्य to heaven, गमनोद्योगम् the preparation for going, कृतवन्तौ they both made, महारथौ the two great warriors
explanation: Having rendered Ayodhya deserted, Rama and Bharata, the two great warriors, prepared for their journey to heaven.

shloka_text: एवं सर्वं निवेद्याशु शत्रुघ्नाय महात्मने । विरेमुस्ते ततो दूतास्त्वर राजेति चाब्रुवन् ।। 7.108.6 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ sarvaṃ nivedyāśu śatrughnāya mahātmane | viremuste tato dūtāstvara rājeti cābruvan || 7.108.6 ||
translation: एवम् thus, सर्वम् all, निवेद्य having reported, आशु quickly, शत्रुघ्नाय to Shatrughna, महात्मने to the great-souled one, विरेमुः they stopped, ते those, ततः then, दूताः messengers, त्वर hasten!, राज O King!, इति thus, च and, अब्रुवन् they said
explanation: Having quickly reported all this to the great-souled Shatrughna, the messengers then stopped and urged him, "Hasten, O King!"

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा घोरसङ्काशं कुलक्षयमुपस्थितम् । प्रकृतीस्तु समानीय काञ्चनं च पुरोधसम् ।। 7.108.7 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā ghorasaṅkāśaṃ kulakṣayamupasthitam | prakṛtīstu samānīya kāñcanaṃ ca purodhasam || 7.108.7 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, घोरसङ्काशम् dreadful-looking, कुलक्षयम् destruction of the family, उपस्थितम् approaching, प्रकृतीः the subjects, तु indeed, सानीय having assembled, काञ्चनम् Kanchana, च and, पुरोधसम् the chief priest,
explanation: Having heard about the dreadful and imminent destruction of his lineage, Rama assembled his subjects and the chief priest Kanchana.

shloka_text: तेषां सर्वं यथावृत्तमब्रवीद्रघनन्दनः । आत्मनश्च विपर्यासं भविष्यं भ्रातृभिः सह ।। 7.108.8 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ sarvaṃ yathāvṛttamabravīdraghanandanaḥ | ātmanaśca viparyāsaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ saha || 7.108.8 ||
translation: तेषाम् to them, सर्वम् all, यथावृत्तम् as it happened, अब्रवीत् spoke, रघुनन्दनः Rama, आत्मनः of himself, च and, विपर्यासम् the reversal, भविष्यम् the future, भ्रातृभिः with his brothers, सह together,
explanation: Rama then recounted to them all that had transpired, including his own impending departure and the future of his brothers.

shloka_text: ततः पुत्रद्वयं वीरः सो ऽभ्यषिञ्चन्नराधिपः । सुबाहुर्मधुरां लेभे शत्रुघाती च वैदिशम् ।। 7.108.9 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ putradvayaṃ vīraḥ so 'bhyaṣiñcannarādhipaḥ | subāhurmadhurāṃ lebhe śatrughātī ca vaidiśam || 7.108.9 ||
translation: ततः then, पुत्रद्वयम् the two sons, वीरः the heroic, सः he, अभ्यषिञ्चत् consecrated, नराधिपः the king, सुबाहुः Subahu, मधुराम् Mathura, लेभे obtained, शत्रुघाती Shatrughati, च and, वैदिशम् Vaidisha,
explanation: Then, the heroic King Rama consecrated the two sons (of Shatrughna), with Subahu receiving Mathura and Shatrughati receiving Vaidisha.

shloka_text: द्विधा कृत्वा तु तां सेनां माधुरीं पुत्रयोर्द्वयोः । धनं च युक्तं कृत्वा वै स्थापयामास पार्थिवः ।। 7.108.10 ।।
transliteration: dvidhā kṛtvā tu tāṃ senāṃ mādhurīṃ putrayordvayoḥ | dhanaṃ ca yuktaṃ kṛtvā vai sthāpayāmāsa pārthivaḥ || 7.108.10 ||
translation: द्विधा into two parts, कृत्वा having divided, तु indeed, ताम् that, सेनाम् army, माधुरीम् of Mathura, पुत्रयोः for the two sons, द्वयोः both, धनम् wealth, च and, युक्तम् appropriate, कृत्वा having provided, वै indeed, स्थापयामास established, पार्थिवः the king,
explanation: The king (Rama) then divided the Mathura army into two parts for both sons and provided them with appropriate wealth, thus establishing them.

shloka_text: सुबाहुं मधुरायां च वैदेशे शत्रुघातिनम् । ययौ स्थाप्य तदा ऽयोध्यां रथेनैकेन राघवः ।। 7.108.11 ।।
transliteration: subāhuṃ madhurāyāṃ ca vaideśe śatrughātinam | yayau sthāpya tadā 'yodhyāṃ rathenaikena rāghavaḥ || 7.108.11 ||
translation: सुबाहुम् Subahu, मधुरायाम् in Mathura, च and, वैदेशे in Vaidisha, शत्रुघातिनम् Shatrughati, स्थाप्य having established, तदा then, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, रथेन by chariot, एकेन a single, राघवः Rama, ययौ went.
explanation: Having established Subahu in Mathura and Shatrughati in Vaidisha, Rama then returned to Ayodhya in a single chariot.

shloka_text: स ददर्श महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम् । सूक्ष्मक्षौमाम्बरधरं मुनिभिः सार्धमक्षयैः ।। 7.108.12 ।।
transliteration: sa dadarśa mahātmānaṃ jvalantamiva pāvakam | sūkṣmakṣaumāmbaradharaṃ munibhiḥ sārdhamakṣayaiḥ || 7.108.12 ||
translation: सः he, ददर्श saw, महात्मानम् the great soul, ज्वलन्तम् इव shining like, पावकम् fire, सूक्ष्मक्षौमाम्बरधरम् wearing fine silken garments, मुनिभिः with sages, सार्धम् together, अक्षयैः immortal.
explanation: He saw the great-souled one, shining like fire, clad in fine silken garments, accompanied by immortal sages.

shloka_text: सो ऽभिवाद्य ततो रामं प्राञ्जलिः प्रयतेन्द्रियः । उवाच वाक्यं धर्मज्ञं धर्ममेवानुचिन्तयन् ।। 7.108.13 ।।
transliteration: so 'bhivādya tato rāmaṃ prāñjaliḥ prayatendriyaḥ | uvāca vākyaṃ dharmajñaṃ dharmamevānucintayan || 7.108.13 ||
translation: सः he, अभिवाद्य having saluted, ततः then, रामम् Rama, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रयतेन्द्रियः with controlled senses, उवाच spoke, वाक्यम् words, धर्मज्ञम् to the knower of Dharma, धर्मम् एव only Dharma, अनुचिन्तयन् contemplating.
explanation: Then, having saluted Rama, the knower of Dharma, he spoke with folded hands and controlled senses, contemplating only righteousness.

shloka_text: कृत्वाभिषेकं सुतयोर्द्वयो राघवनन्दन । तवानुगमने राजन्विद्धि मां कृतनिश्चयम् ।। 7.108.14 ।।
transliteration: kṛtvābhiṣekaṃ sutayordvayo rāghavanandana | tavānugamane rājanviddhi māṃ kṛtaniścayam || 7.108.14 ||
translation: कृत्वा having performed, अभिषेकम् the consecration, सुतयोः of the two sons, द्वयोः both, राघवनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, तव your, अनुगमने in following, राजन् O King, विद्धि know, माम् me, कृतनिश्चयम् resolute.
explanation: O delight of the Raghus, O King, know that I am resolute in following you, having performed the consecration of both my sons.

shloka_text: न चान्यदपि वक्तव्यमतो वीर न शासनम् । विलोक्यमानमिच्छामि मद्विधेन विशेषतः ।। 7.108.15 ।।
transliteration: na cānyadapi vaktavyamato vīra na śāsanam | vilokyamānamicchāmi madvidhena viśeṣataḥ || 7.108.15 ||
translation: न च and not, अन्यत् अपि anything else even, वक्तव्यम् to be said, अतः therefore, वीर O hero, न not, शासनम् a command, विलोक्यमानम् being regarded, इच्छामि I wish, मद्विधेन by one like me, विशेषतः especially.
explanation: Therefore, O hero, nothing else is to be said, and I do not wish this to be regarded as a command, especially by one like me.

shloka_text: तस्य तां बुद्धिमक्लीबां विज्ञाय रघुनन्दनः । बाढमित्येव शत्रुघ्नं रामो वाक्यमुवाच ह ।। 7.108.16 ।।
transliteration: tasya tāṃ buddhimaklībāṃ vijñāya raghunandanaḥ | bāḍhamityeva śatrughnaṃ rāmo vākyamuvāca ha || 7.108.16 ||
translation: तस्य his, ताम् that, बुद्धिम् resolve, अकलीबाम् unwavering, विज्ञाय having understood, रघुनन्दनः the delight of the Raghus, बाढम् इति एव "So be it" thus only, शत्रुघ्नम् to Shatrughna, रामः Rama, वाक्यम् words, उवाच ह spoke indeed.
explanation: Having understood Shatrughna's unwavering resolve, Rama, the delight of the Raghus, simply said "So be it" to him.

shloka_text: तस्य वाक्यस्य वाक्यान्ते वानराः कामरूपिणः । ऋक्षराक्षससङ्घाश्च समापेतुरनेकशः ।। 7.108.17 ।।
transliteration: tasya vākyasya vākyānte vānarāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ | ṛkṣarākṣasasaṅghāśca samāpeturanekaśaḥ || 7.108.17 ||
translation: तस्य his, वाक्यस्य of speech, वाक्यान्ते at the end of the speech, वानराः monkeys, कामरूपिणः assuming any form at will, ऋक्षराक्षससङ्घाश्च and groups of bears and rakshasas, समापेतुर gathered, अनेकशः in large numbers.
explanation: At the conclusion of his speech, numerous monkeys capable of changing their forms at will, along with groups of bears and rakshasas, gathered in great numbers.

shloka_text: सुग्रीवं ते पुरस्कृत्य सर्व एव समागताः । तं रामं द्रष्टुमनसः स्वर्गायाभिमुखं स्थितम् ।। 7.108.18 ।।
transliteration: sugrīvaṃ te puraskṛtya sarva eva samāgatāḥ | taṃ rāmaṃ draṣṭumanasaḥ svargāyābhimukhaṃ sthitam || 7.108.18 ||
translation: सुग्रीवं Sugriva, ते they, पुरस्कृत्य having placed in front, सर्व all, एव indeed, समागताः gathered, तं that, रामं Rama, द्रष्टुमनसः with a mind to see, स्वर्गाया towards heaven, अभिमुखं facing, स्थितम् standing.
explanation: All of them gathered, making Sugriva their leader, with the intention of seeing Rama, who was standing facing towards heaven.

shloka_text: देवपुत्रा ऋषिसुता गन्धर्वाणां सुतास्तथा । रामक्षयं विदित्वा ते सर्व एव समागताः ।। 7.108.19 ।।
transliteration: devaputrā ṛṣisutā gandharvāṇāṃ sutāstathā | rāmakṣayaṃ viditvā te sarva eva samāgatāḥ || 7.108.19 ||
translation: देवपुत्राः sons of gods, ऋषिसुताः sons of sages, गन्धर्वाणां of Gandharvas, सुतास्तथा and sons, रामक्षयं Rama's departure, विदित्वा having known, ते they, सर्व all, एव indeed, समागताः gathered.
explanation: Having learned of Rama's impending departure, the sons of gods, sons of sages, and sons of Gandharvas all gathered there.

shloka_text: ते राममभिवाद्योचुः सर्वे वानरराक्षसाः । तवानुगमने राजन्सम्प्राप्ताः कृतनिश्चयाः ।। 7.108.20 ।।
transliteration: te rāmamabhivādyocuḥ sarve vānararākṣasāḥ | tavānugamane rājansamprāptāḥ kṛtaniścayāḥ || 7.108.20 ||
translation: ते they, रामम Rama, अभिवाद्य having saluted, ऊचुः said, सर्वे all, वानरराक्षसाः monkeys and rakshasas, तवानुगमने in following you, राजन् O King, सम्प्राप्ताः arrived, कृतनिश्चयाः having made a firm resolve.
explanation: All the monkeys and rakshasas, having saluted Rama, said, "O King, we have arrived here with a firm resolve to follow you."

shloka_text: यदि राम विनास्माभिर्गच्छेस्त्वं पुरुषोत्तम । यमदण्डमिवोद्यम्य त्वया स्म विनिपातिताः ।। 7.108.21 ।।
transliteration: yadi rāma vināsmābhirgacchestvaṃ puruṣottama | yamadaṇḍamivodyamya tvayā sma vinipātitāḥ || 7.108.21 ||
translation: यदि if, राम O Rama, विनास्माभिः without us, गच्छेस्त्वं you go, पुरुषोत्तम O best among men, यमदण्डमिव like the staff of Yama, उद्यम्य having raised, त्वया by you, स्म indeed, विनिपातिताः struck down.
explanation: "O Rama, best among men, if you depart without us, it would be as if we were struck down by you, like by the raised staff of Yama."

shloka_text: तैरेवमुक्तः काकुत्स्थो बाढमित्यब्रवीत् स्मयन् ।। 7.108.22 ।।
transliteration: tairevamuktaḥ kākutstho bāḍhamityabravīt smayan || 7.108.22 ||
translation: तैः by them, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), बाढम् certainly, इति thus, अब्रवीत् said, स्मयन् smiling
explanation: Smiling, Rama, thus addressed by them, replied, "Certainly."

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रामं सुग्रीवो ऽपि महाबलः । प्रणम्य विधिवद्वीरं विज्ञापयितुमुद्यतः ।। 7.108.23 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare rāmaṃ sugrīvo 'pi mahābalaḥ | praṇamya vidhivadvīraṃ vijñāpayitumudyataḥ || 7.108.23 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval (meanwhile), रामम् to Rama, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, अपि also, महाबलः the mighty one, प्रणम्य having bowed, विधिवत् properly, वीरम् to the hero, विज्ञापयितुम् to inform, उद्यतः ready (prepared)
explanation: Meanwhile, the mighty Sugriva also, having properly bowed to the hero Rama, prepared to make a submission.

shloka_text: अभिषिच्याङ्गदं वीरमागतो ऽस्मि नरेश्वर । तवानुगमने राजन्विद्धि मां कृतनिश्चयम् ।। 7.108.24 ।।
transliteration: abhiṣicyāṅgadaṃ vīramāgato 'smi nareśvara | tavānugamane rājanviddhi māṃ kṛtaniścayam || 7.108.24 ||
translation: अभिषिच्य having consecrated, अङ्गदम् Angada, वीरम् the hero, आगतः come, अस्मि I am, नरेश्वर O lord of men, तव your, अनुगमने in following, राजन् O king, विद्धि know, माम् me, कृतनिश्चयम् resolved (having made a firm decision)
explanation: O lord of men, I have come after consecrating the heroic Angada; O king, know me to be resolute in following you.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा रामो रमयतां वरः । वानरेन्द्रमथोवाचं मैत्रं तस्यानुचिन्तयन् ।। 7.108.25 ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rāmo ramayatāṃ varaḥ | vānarendramathovācaṃ maitraṃ tasyānucintayan || 7.108.25 ||
translation: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् word (speech), श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, रमयताम् among those who delight, वरः the best, वानरेन्द्रम् to the king of monkeys, अथ then, उवाच spoke, मैत्रम् friendship, तस्य his (Sugriva's), अनुचिन्तयन् contemplating (reflecting upon)
explanation: Having heard his words, Rama, the best among those who delight, then spoke to the king of monkeys, reflecting upon their friendship.

shloka_text: सखे शृणुष्व सुग्रीव न त्वया ऽहं विनाकृतः । गच्छेयं देवलोकं वा परमं वा पदं महत् ।। 7.108.26 ।।
transliteration: sakhe śṛṇuṣva sugrīva na tvayā 'haṃ vinākṛtaḥ | gaccheyaṃ devalokaṃ vā paramaṃ vā padaṃ mahat || 7.108.26 ||
translation: सखे O friend, शृणुष्व listen, सुग्रीव Sugriva, न not, त्वया by you, अहम् I, विनाकृतः separated from, गच्छेयम् would go, देवलोकम् to the world of gods, वा or, परमम् supreme, वा or, पदम् abode, महत् great
explanation: "O friend Sugriva, listen," said Rama, "I would not go to the world of gods or to any great supreme abode without you."

shloka_text: बिभीषणमथोवाच राक्षसेन्द्रं महायशाः । यावत्प्रजा धरिष्यन्ति तावत्त्वं वै बिभीषण । राक्षसेन्द्र महावीर्य लङ्कास्थस्त्वं धरिष्यसि ।। 7.108.27 ।।
transliteration: bibhīṣaṇamathovāca rākṣasendraṃ mahāyaśāḥ | yāvatprajā dhariṣyanti tāvattvaṃ vai bibhīṣaṇa | rākṣasendra mahāvīrya laṅkāsthastvaṃ dhariṣyasi || 7.108.27 ||
translation: बिभीषणम् to Vibhishana, अथ then, उवाच spoke, राक्षसेन्द्रम् to the king of Rakshasas, महायशाः the greatly renowned (Rama), यावत् as long as, प्रजाः people, धरिष्यन्ति will exist, तावत् so long, त्वं you, वै indeed, बिभीषण O Vibhishana, राक्षसेन्द्र O king of Rakshasas, महावीर्य O greatly valorous one, लङ्कास्थः residing in Lanka, त्वं you, धरिष्यसि will endure.
explanation: The greatly renowned Rama then spoke to Vibhishana, the king of Rakshasas, declaring that as long as people exist, Vibhishana, the greatly valorous king of Rakshasas residing in Lanka, would indeed endure and rule.

shloka_text: यावच्चन्द्रश्च सूर्यश्च यावत्तिष्ठति मेदिनी । यावच्च मत्कथा लोके तावद्राज्यं तवास्त्विह ।। 7.108.28 ।।
transliteration: yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca yāvattiṣṭhati medinī | yāvacca matkathā loke tāvadrājyaṃ tavāstviha || 7.108.28 ||
translation: यावत् as long as, च and, चन्द्रः the moon, च and, सूर्यः the sun, च and, यावत् as long as, तिष्ठति remains, मेदिनी the earth, यावत् as long as, च and, मत्कथा my story, लोके in the world, तावत् so long, राज्यं kingdom, तव your, अस्तु let it be, इह here.
explanation: Rama declared that Vibhishana's kingdom would endure as long as the moon and sun exist, as long as the earth remains, and as long as Rama's story is told in the world.

shloka_text: शासितस्त्वं सखित्वेन कार्यं ते मम शासनम् । प्रजाः संरक्ष धर्मेण नोत्तरं वक्तुमर्हसि ।। 7.108.29 ।।
transliteration: śāsitastvaṃ sakhitvena kāryaṃ te mama śāsanam | prajāḥ saṃrakṣa dharmeṇa nottaraṃ vaktumarhasi || 7.108.29 ||
translation: शासितः instructed, त्वं you, सखित्वेन as a friend, कार्यं to be done, ते by you, मम my, शासनम् command, प्रजाः subjects, संरक्ष protect, धर्मेण righteously, न not, उत्तरं a reply, वक्तुम् to speak, अर्हसि you ought.
explanation: Rama instructed Vibhishana as a friend that he must obey Rama's command to protect his subjects righteously, and he should not offer any counter-argument.

shloka_text: किञ्चान्यद्वक्तुमिच्छामि राक्षसेन्द्र महामते ।। 7.108.30 ।।
transliteration: kiñcānyadvaktumicchāmi rākṣasendra mahāmate || 7.108.30 ||
translation: किञ्च and something, अन्यत् else, वक्तुम् to speak, इच्छामि I wish, राक्षसेन्द्र O king of Rakshasas, महामते O greatly intelligent one.
explanation: Rama then added that he wished to speak something else to Vibhishana, the greatly intelligent king of Rakshasas.

shloka_text: आराधय जगन्नाथमिक्ष्वाकुकुलदैवतम् । आराधनीयमनिशं सर्वैर्दैवैः सवासवैः ।। 7.108.31 ।।
transliteration: ārādhaya jagannāthamikṣvākukuladaivatam | ārādhanīyamaniśaṃ sarvairdaivaiḥ savāsavaiḥ || 7.108.31 ||
translation: आराधय worship, जगन्नाथम् the lord of the world, इक्ष्वाकुकुलदैवतम् the deity of the Ikshvaku lineage, आराधनीयम् to be worshipped, अनिशं constantly, सर्वैः by all, दैवैः gods, सवासवैः with Vasava (Indra).
explanation: Rama further advised Vibhishana to constantly worship the Lord of the World, who is the deity of the Ikshvaku lineage and is worshipped by all gods, including Indra.

shloka_text: तथेति प्रतिजग्राह रामवाक्यं विभीषणः । राजा राक्षसमुख्यानां राघवाज्ञामनुस्मरन् ।। 7.108.32 ।।
transliteration: tatheti pratijagrāha rāmavākyaṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ | rājā rākṣasamukhyānāṃ rāghavājñāmanusmaran || 7.108.32 ||
translation: तथेति "So be it" thus, प्रतिजग्राह accepted, रामवाक्यं Rama's words, विभीषणः Vibhishana, राजा the king, राक्षसमुख्यानां of the chief Rakshasas, राघवाज्ञाम् Rama's command, अनुस्मरन् remembering.
explanation: King Vibhishana, remembering Rama's command, accepted Rama's words, saying "So be it."

shloka_text: तमेवमुक्त्वा काकुत्स्थो हनूमन्तमथाब्रवीत् । जीविते कृतबुद्धिस्त्वं मा प्रतिज्ञां विलोपय ।। 7.108.33 ।।
transliteration: tamevamuktvā kākutstho hanūmantamathābravīt | jīvite kṛtabuddhistvaṃ mā pratijñāṃ vilopaya || 7.108.33 ||
translation: तम् him, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, काकुत्स्थो Rama, हनूमन्तम् to Hanuman, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, जीविते in life, कृतबुद्धिस्त्वं you who have made up your mind, मा do not, प्रतिज्ञां your vow, विलोपय violate.
explanation: Having thus spoken to Vibhishana, Rama then addressed Hanuman, saying, "You who have resolved to live, do not violate your vow."

shloka_text: मत्कथाः प्रचरिष्यन्ति यावल्लोके हरीश्वर । तावद्रमस्व सुप्रीतो मद्वाक्यमनुपालयन् ।। 7.108.34 ।।
transliteration: matkathāḥ pracariṣyanti yāvalloke harīśvara | tāvadramasva suprīto madvākyamanupālayan || 7.108.34 ||
translation: मत्कथाः my stories, प्रचरिष्यन्ति will spread, यावत् as long as, लोके in the world, हरीश्वर O chief of monkeys, तावत् so long, रमस्व enjoy, सुप्रीतो very pleased, मद्वाक्यम् my words, अनुपालयन् obeying.
explanation: O chief of monkeys, as long as my stories are current in the world, you shall remain very pleased, obeying my command.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान्राघवेण महात्मना । वाक्यं विज्ञापयामास परं हर्षमवाप्य च ।। 7.108.35 ।।
transliteration: evamuktastu hanumānrāghaveṇa mahātmanā | vākyaṃ vijñāpayāmāsa paraṃ harṣamavāpya ca || 7.108.35 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तस्तु having been spoken to, हनुमान् Hanuman, राघवेण by Rama, महात्मना by the great-souled one, वाक्यं words, विज्ञापयामास submitted, परं great, हर्षम् joy, अवाप्य having obtained, च and.
explanation: Having been thus addressed by the great-souled Rama, Hanuman, filled with supreme joy, submitted his reply.

shloka_text: यावत्तव कथा लोके विचरिष्यति पावनी । तावत्स्थास्यामि मेदिन्यां तवाज्ञामनुपालयन् ।। 7.108.36 ।।
transliteration: yāvattava kathā loke vicariṣyati pāvanī | tāvatsthāsyāmi medinyāṃ tavājñāmanupālayan || 7.108.36 ||
translation: यावत् as long as, तव your, कथा story, लोके in the world, विचरिष्यति will spread, पावनी purifying, तावत् so long, स्थास्यामि I shall remain, मेदिन्यां on the earth, तवाज्ञाम् your command, अनुपालयन् obeying.
explanation: As long as your purifying story spreads throughout the world, I shall remain on earth, obeying your command.

shloka_text: जाम्बवन्तं तथोक्त्वा तु वृद्धं ब्रह्मसुतं तथा । मैन्दं च द्विविदं चैव पञ्च जाम्बवता सह ।
transliteration: jāmbavantaṃ tathoktvā tu vṛddhaṃ brahmasutaṃ tathā | maindaṃ ca dvividaṃ caiva pañca jāmbavatā saha |
translation: जाम्बवन्तं Jambavan, तथा thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, तु indeed, वृद्धं old, ब्रह्मसुतं son of Brahma, तथा and, मैन्दं Mainda, च and, द्विविदं Dvivida, च and, एव indeed, पञ्च five, जाम्बवता with Jambavan, सह together.
explanation: Having thus spoken to the aged Jambavan, the son of Brahma, and also to Mainda and Dvivida, making a total of five including Jambavan.

shloka_text: तानेवमुक्त्वा काकुत्स्थः सर्वांस्तानृक्षवानरान् । उवाच बाढं गच्छध्वं मया सार्धं यथेप्सितम् ।। 7.108.38 ।।
transliteration: tānevamuktvā kākutsthaḥ sarvāṃstānṛkṣavānarān | uvāca bāḍhaṃ gacchadhvaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ yathepsitam || 7.108.38 ||
translation: तान् to them, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, काकुत्स्थः Rama, descendant of Kakutstha, सर्वान् all, तान् those, ऋक्षवानरान् bears and monkeys, उवाच said, बाढं certainly, गच्छध्वं go, मया with me, सार्धं together, यथेप्सितम् as desired.
explanation: Having thus spoken to all those bears and monkeys, Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, told them, "Certainly, go with me as you desire.". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टोतरशततमः सर्गः ।। 108 ।। Thus ends the hundred and eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यां पृथुवक्षा महायशाः । रामः कमलपत्राक्षः पुरोधसमथाब्रवीत् ।। 7.109.1 ।।
transliteration: prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ pṛthuvakṣā mahāyaśāḥ | rāmaḥ kamalapatrākṣaḥ purodhasamathābravīt || 7.109.1 ||
translation: प्रभातायां when dawned, तु indeed, शर्वर्यां the night, पृथुवक्षाः broad-chested, महायशाः highly renowned, रामः Rama, कमलपत्राक्षः lotus-eyed, पुरोधसम् to the chief priest, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: When the night had dawned, the broad-chested, highly renowned, lotus-eyed Rama then spoke to his chief priest.
comments: At dawn, all rites performed by Vasishtha, Rama sets forth on his last journey -- silent and clad in fine garments, attended by Sri, Hri and Resolve, by his weapons and the Vedas in embodied form, by the sages, the palace women, his brothers, the ministers and all the people, and by the monkeys, bears and rakshasas -- and every living creature of Ayodhya follows, so that the city is left empty of all that breathes.

shloka_text: अग्निहोत्रं व्रजत्वग्रे दीप्यमानं सह द्विजैः । वाजपेयातपत्रं च शोभमानं महापथे ।। 7.109.2 ।।
transliteration: agnihotraṃ vrajatvagre dīpyamānaṃ saha dvijaiḥ | vājapeyātapatraṃ ca śobhamānaṃ mahāpathe || 7.109.2 ||
translation: अग्निहोत्रं the sacred fire, व्रजतु let it go, अग्रे in front, दीप्यमानं shining, सह with, द्विजैः Brahmins, वाजपेय Vajapeya, आतपत्रं umbrella, च and, शोभमानं splendid, महापथे on the great path.
explanation: He instructed that the shining sacred fire should go in front with the Brahmins, and the splendid Vajapeya umbrella should also be carried on the great path.

shloka_text: ततो वसिष्ठस्तेजस्वी सर्वं निरवशेषतः । चकार विधिवद्धर्मं महाप्रास्थानिकं विधिम् ।। 7.109.3 ।।
transliteration: tato vasiṣṭhastejasvī sarvaṃ niravaśeṣataḥ | cakāra vidhivaddharmaṃ mahāprāsthānikaṃ vidhim || 7.109.3 ||
translation: ततः then, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, तेजस्वी the lustrous, सर्वं all, निरवशेषतः completely, चकार performed, विधिवत् according to scriptural injunctions, धर्मं the ritual, महाप्रास्थानिकं of the great departure, विधिम् rite.
explanation: Then, the lustrous Vasishtha completely performed all the rituals for the great departure according to scriptural injunctions.

shloka_text: ततः सूक्ष्माम्बरधरो ब्रह्ममावर्तयन्परम् । कुशान्गृहीत्वा पाणिभ्यां प्रसज्य प्रययावथ ।। 7.109.4 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sūkṣmāmbaradharo brahmamāvartayanparam | kuśāngṛhītvā pāṇibhyāṃ prasajya prayayāvatha || 7.109.4 ||
translation: ततः then, सूक्ष्माम्बरधरः wearing fine garments, ब्रह्मम् the supreme Brahman (Vedas), आवर्तयन् meditating upon/reciting, परम् supreme, कुशान् Kusa grass, गृहीत्वा having taken, पाणिभ्याम् with both hands, प्रसज्य having spread/placed, प्रययाव went forth, अथ then
explanation: Then, wearing fine garments, meditating upon the supreme Brahman, and holding Kusa grass in his hands, he went forth.

shloka_text: अव्याहरन्क्वचित्किञ्चिन्निश्चेष्टो निःसुखः पथि । निर्जगाम गृहात्तस्माद्दीप्यमान इवांशुमान् ।। 7.109.5 ।।
transliteration: avyāharankvacitkiñcinniśceṣṭo niḥsukhaḥ pathi | nirjagāma gṛhāttasmāddīpyamāna ivāṃśumān || 7.109.5 ||
translation: अव्याहरन् not speaking, क्वचित् anywhere, किञ्चित् anything, निश्चेष्टः motionless/without activity, निःसुखः without joy/devoid of happiness, पथि on the path, निर्जगाम went out, गृहात् from the house, तस्मात् from that, दीप्यमानः shining, इव like, अंशुमान् the sun
explanation: Not speaking anything, motionless, and devoid of joy on the path, he departed from that house, shining like the sun.

shloka_text: रामस्य दक्षिणे पार्श्वे सपद्मा श्रीरपाश्रिता । सव्ये तु ह्रीर्महादेवी व्यवसायस्तथाग्रतः ।। 7.109.6 ।।
