transliteration: rāmasya dakṣiṇe pārśve sapadmā śrīrapāśritā | savye tu hrīrmahādevī vyavasāyastathāgrataḥ || 7.109.6 ||
translation: रामस्य of Rama, दक्षिणे on the right, पार्श्वे side, सपद्मा with a lotus, श्रीः Sri (Goddess of prosperity), अपाश्रिता took refuge/was present, सव्ये on the left, तु indeed, ह्रीः Hri (Modesty/Shame), महादेवी great goddess, व्यवसायः determination/resolve, तथा similarly, अग्रतः in front
explanation: On Rama's right side was Sri, the goddess of prosperity, holding a lotus; on his left was the great goddess Hri (Modesty); and in front of him was Determination.

shloka_text: शरा नानाविधाश्चापि धनुरायतमुत्तमम् । तथा ऽ ऽयुधानि ते सर्वे ययुः पुरुषविग्रहाः ।। 7.109.7 ।।
transliteration: śarā nānāvidhāścāpi dhanurāyatamuttamam | tathā ' 'yudhāni te sarve yayuḥ puruṣavigrahāḥ || 7.109.7 ||
translation: शराः arrows, नानाविधाः of various kinds, च and, अपि also, धनुः bow, आयतम् long/stretched, उत्तमम् excellent, तथा similarly, आयुधानि weapons, ते those, सर्वे all, ययुः went, पुरुषविग्रहाः in human form
explanation: Various kinds of arrows, an excellent long bow, and all other weapons followed him, having assumed human forms.

shloka_text: वेदा ब्राह्मणरूपेण गायत्री सर्वरक्षिणी । ओङ्कारो ऽथ वषट्कारः सर्वे राममनुव्रताः ।। 7.109.8 ।।
transliteration: vedā brāhmaṇarūpeṇa gāyatrī sarvarakṣiṇī | oṅkāro 'tha vaṣaṭkāraḥ sarve rāmamanuvratāḥ || 7.109.8 ||
translation: वेदाः the Vedas, ब्राह्मणरूपेण in the form of Brahmins, गायत्री Gayatri mantra, सर्वरक्षिणी protecting all, ओङ्कारः Omkara (the sacred syllable Om), अथ and, वषट्कारः Vasatkara (a ritual exclamation), सर्वे all, राममनुव्रताः followers of Rama/devoted to Rama
explanation: The Vedas in the form of Brahmins, the all-protecting Gayatri mantra, Omkara, and Vasatkara, all followed Rama with devotion.

shloka_text: ऋषयश्च महात्मानः सर्व एव महीसुराः । अन्वगच्छन्महात्मानं स्वर्गद्वारमपावृतम् ।। 7.109.9 ।।
transliteration: ṛṣayaśca mahātmānaḥ sarva eva mahīsurāḥ | anvagacchanmahātmānaṃ svargadvāramapāvṛtam || 7.109.9 ||
translation: ऋषयः sages, च and, महात्मानः great-souled ones, सर्व all, एव indeed, महीसुराः Brahmins, अन्वगच्छन् followed, महात्मानम् the great-souled one (Rama), स्वर्गद्वारम् to the gate of heaven, अपावृतम् which was open.
explanation: All the great-souled sages and Brahmins followed the great-souled Rama to the open gate of heaven.

shloka_text: तं यान्तमनुगच्छन्ति ह्यन्तःपुरचराः स्त्रियः । सवृद्धबालदासीकाः सवर्षवरकिङ्कराः ।। 7.109.10 ।।
transliteration: taṃ yāntamanugacchanti hyantaḥpuracarāḥ striyaḥ | savṛddhabāladāsīkāḥ savarṣavarakiṅkarāḥ || 7.109.10 ||
translation: तम् him, यान्तम् going, अनुगच्छन्ति followed, हि indeed, अन्तःपुरचराः women of the inner apartments, स्त्रियः women, सवृद्धबालदासीकाः with old and young maidservants, सवर्षवरकिङ्कराः with eunuchs and chief servants.
explanation: The women of the inner apartments, accompanied by their old and young maidservants, eunuchs, and chief servants, followed him as he went.

shloka_text: सान्तःपुरश्च भरतः शत्रुघ्नसहितो ययौ । रामं गतिमुपागम्य साग्निहोत्रमनुव्रतः ।। 7.109.11 ।।
transliteration: sāntaḥpuraśca bharataḥ śatrughnasahito yayau | rāmaṃ gatimupāgamya sāgnihotramanuvrataḥ || 7.109.11 ||
translation: सान्तःपुरः with his inner apartment (women), च and, भरतः Bharata, शत्रुघ्नसहितः accompanied by Shatrughna, ययौ went, रामम् Rama, गतिम् the path/destination, उपागम्य having approached, साग्निहोत्रम् with his sacred fire, अनुव्रतः following (Rama's) vow/path.
explanation: Bharata, accompanied by Shatrughna and the women of his inner apartment, went, following Rama's path and bringing his sacred fire with him.

shloka_text: ते च सर्वे महात्मानः साग्निहोत्राः समागताः । सपुत्रदाराः काकुत्स्थमनुजग्मुर्महामतिम् ।। 7.109.12 ।।
transliteration: te ca sarve mahātmānaḥ sāgnihotrāḥ samāgatāḥ | saputradārāḥ kākutsthamanujagmurmahāmatim || 7.109.12 ||
translation: ते they, च and, सर्वे all, महात्मानः great-souled ones, साग्निहोत्राः with their sacred fires, समागताः assembled, सपुत्रदाराः with their sons and wives, काकुत्स्थम् Kakutstha (Rama), अनुजग्मुः followed, महामतिम् the great-minded one.
explanation: All those great-souled individuals, having assembled with their sacred fires, sons, and wives, followed the great-minded Rama.

shloka_text: मन्त्रिणो भृत्यवर्गाश्च सपुत्रपशुबान्धवाः । सर्वे सहानुगा राममन्वगच्छन्प्रहृष्टवत् ।। 7.109.13 ।।
transliteration: mantriṇo bhṛtyavargāśca saputrapaśubāndhavāḥ | sarve sahānugā rāmamanvagacchanprahṛṣṭavat || 7.109.13 ||
translation: मन्त्रिणः ministers, भृत्यवर्गाः groups of servants, च and, सपुत्रपशुबान्धवाः with their sons, animals, and relatives, सर्वे all, सहानुगाः with their followers, रामम् Rama, अन्वगच्छन् followed, प्रहृष्टवत् joyfully.
explanation: All the ministers and groups of servants, along with their sons, animals, relatives, and followers, joyfully followed Rama.

shloka_text: ततः सर्वाः प्रकृतयो हृष्टपुष्टजनावृताः । गच्छन्तमन्वगछंस्तं राघवं गुणरञ्जिताः ।। 7.109.14 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayo hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛtāḥ | gacchantamanvagachaṃstaṃ rāghavaṃ guṇarañjitāḥ || 7.109.14 ||
translation: ततः then, सर्वाः all, प्रकृतयः the subjects, हृष्टपुष्टजनावृताः filled with joyful and well-nourished people, गच्छन्तम् going, अन्वगछन् followed, तम् him, राघवं Rama, गुणरञ्जिताः delighted by his virtues.
explanation: Then, all the subjects, filled with joyful and well-nourished people, who were charmed by Rama's virtues, followed him as he departed.

shloka_text: ततः सस्त्रीपुमांसस्ते सपक्षिपशुवाहनाः । राघवस्यानुगाः सर्वे हृष्टा विगतकल्मषाः ।। 7.109.15 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sastrīpumāṃsaste sapakṣipaśuvāhanāḥ | rāghavasyānugāḥ sarve hṛṣṭā vigatakalmaṣāḥ || 7.109.15 ||
translation: ततः then, सस्त्रीपुमांसः with women and men, ते they, सपक्षिपशुवाहनाः with birds, animals, and vehicles, राघवस्य of Rama, अनुगाः followers, सर्वे all, हृष्टाः joyful, विगतकल्मषाः free from sin.
explanation: Then, all of Rama's followers, including men, women, birds, animals, and those with vehicles, were joyful and purified of all sins.

shloka_text: स्नाताः प्रमुदिताः सर्वे हृष्टाः पुष्टाश्च वानराः । दृढं किलकिलाशब्दैः सर्वं राममनुव्रतम् ।। 7.109.16 ।।
transliteration: snātāḥ pramuditāḥ sarve hṛṣṭāḥ puṣṭāśca vānarāḥ | dṛḍhaṃ kilakilāśabdaiḥ sarvaṃ rāmamanuvratam || 7.109.16 ||
translation: स्नाताः bathed, प्रमुदिताः greatly delighted, सर्वे all, हृष्टाः joyful, पुष्टाः well-nourished, च and, वानराः monkeys, दृढं loudly, किलकिलाशब्दैः with shouts of joy, सर्वं all, राममनुव्रतम् devoted to Rama.
explanation: All the monkeys, bathed, greatly delighted, joyful, and well-nourished, loudly cheered with shouts of joy, all devoted to Rama.

shloka_text: न तत्र कश्चिद्दीनो वा व्रीडितो वा ऽपि दुःखितः । हृष्टं समुदितं सर्वं बभूव परमाद्भुतम् ।। 7.109.17 ।।
transliteration: na tatra kaściddīno vā vrīḍito vā 'pi duḥkhitaḥ | hṛṣṭaṃ samuditaṃ sarvaṃ babhūva paramādbhutam || 7.109.17 ||
translation: न not, तत्र there, कश्चित् anyone, दीनः miserable, वा or, व्रीडितः ashamed, वा or, अपि even, दुःखितः sorrowful, हृष्टं joyful, समुदितं prosperous, सर्वं all, बभूव was, परमाद्भुतम् extremely wonderful.
explanation: There was no one miserable, ashamed, or sorrowful; everything was joyful, prosperous, and extremely wonderful.

shloka_text: द्रष्टुकामो ऽथ निर्यान्तं रामं जानपदो जनः । यः प्राप्तः सो ऽपि दृष्ट्वैव स्वर्गायानुगतो मुदा ।। 7.109.18 ।।
transliteration: draṣṭukāmo 'tha niryāntaṃ rāmaṃ jānapado janaḥ | yaḥ prāptaḥ so 'pi dṛṣṭvaiva svargāyānugato mudā || 7.109.18 ||
translation: द्रष्टुकामः desirous of seeing, अथ then, निर्यान्तं departing, रामं Rama, जानपदः rural, जनः people, यः who, प्राप्तः arrived, सः he, अपि even, दृष्ट्वैव having seen immediately, स्वर्गाय to heaven, अनुगतः followed, मुदा with joy.
explanation: Then, any rural person who arrived, desirous of seeing Rama departing, immediately followed him to heaven with joy upon seeing him.

shloka_text: ऋक्षवानररक्षांसि जनाश्च पुरवासिनः । आगच्छन्परया भक्त्या पृष्ठतः सुसमाहिताः ।। 7.109.19 ।।
transliteration: ṛkṣavānararakṣāṃsi janāśca puravāsinaḥ | āgacchanparayā bhaktyā pṛṣṭhataḥ susamāhitāḥ || 7.109.19 ||
translation: ऋक्षवानररक्षांसि bears, monkeys, and rakshasas, जनाः people, च and, पुरवासिनः city-dwellers, आगच्छन् came, परया with supreme, भक्त्या devotion, पृष्ठतः from behind, सुसमाहिताः well-composed.
explanation: Bears, monkeys, rakshasas, and the city-dwellers, all well-composed, followed him from behind with supreme devotion.

shloka_text: यानि भूतानि नगरे ऽप्यन्तर्धानगतानि च । राघवं तान्यनुययुः स्वर्गाय समुपस्थितम् ।। 7.109.20 ।।
transliteration: yāni bhūtāni nagare 'pyantardhānagatāni ca | rāghavaṃ tānyanuyayuḥ svargāya samupasthitam || 7.109.20 ||
translation: यानि which, भूतानि beings, नगरे in the city, अपि even, अन्तर्धानगतानि invisible, च and, राघवं Rama, तानि those, अनुययुः followed, स्वर्गाय for heaven, समुपस्थितम् who was ready to depart.
explanation: Even the invisible beings residing in the city followed Rama, who was ready to depart for heaven.

shloka_text: यानि पश्यन्ति काकुत्स्थं स्थावराणि चराणि च । सर्वाणि रामगमने ह्यनुजग्मुर्हि तान्यपि ।। 7.109.21 ।।
transliteration: yāni paśyanti kākutsthaṃ sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca | sarvāṇi rāmagamane hyanujagmurhi tānyapi || 7.109.21 ||
translation: यानि which, पश्यन्ति see, काकुत्स्थं Kakutstha (Rama), स्थावराणि immobile beings, चराणि mobile beings, च and, सर्वाणि all, रामगमने at Rama's departure, हि indeed, अनुजग्मुः followed, हि indeed, तानि those, अपि even.
explanation: All beings, both immobile and mobile, that beheld Rama, indeed followed him at his departure.

shloka_text: नोच्छ्वसत्तदयोध्यायां सुसूक्ष्ममपि दृश्यते । तिर्यग्योनिगताश्चापि सर्वे राममनुव्रताः ।। 7.109.22 ।।
transliteration: nocchvasattadayodhyāyāṃ susūkṣmamapi dṛśyate | tiryagyonigatāścāpi sarve rāmamanuvratāḥ || 7.109.22 ||
translation: न not, उच्छ्वसत् breathing, तत् that, अयोध्यायां in Ayodhya, सुसूक्ष्मम् very subtle, अपि even, दृश्यते was seen, तिर्यग्योनिगताः born in lower species, च and, अपि even, सर्वे all, राममनुव्रताः devoted to Rama.
explanation: Not even the slightest breathing creature was seen in Ayodhya, as all beings, even those of lower species, were devoted followers of Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे नवाधिकशततमः सर्गः ।। 109 ।। Thus ends the hundred and ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: अध्यर्धयोजनं गत्वा नदीं पश्चान्मुखाश्रिताम् । सरयूं पुण्यसलिलां ददर्श रघुनन्दनः ।। 7.110.1 ।।
transliteration: adhyardhayojanaṃ gatvā nadīṃ paścānmukhāśritām | sarayūṃ puṇyasalilāṃ dadarśa raghunandanaḥ || 7.110.1 ||
translation: अध्यर्धयोजनं one and a half yojanas, गत्वा having gone, नदीं river, पश्चान्मुखाश्रिताम् flowing westward, सरयूं Sarayu, पुण्यसलिलां with sacred waters, ददर्श saw, रघुनन्दनः Rama.
explanation: Having traveled one and a half yojanas, Rama saw the sacred-watered Sarayu river, which flowed westward.
comments: Rama reaches the westward-flowing Sarayu, where Brahma descends with the gods and countless celestial chariots -- a heavenly voice welcomes him as Vishnu and bids him enter the form he wills, and Rama with his brothers passes into the effulgence of Vishnu -- at his request Brahma grants the followers the world of Santanika, the monkeys and bears resume their divine forms, and all who plunge into the Sarayu at Gopratara cast off their bodies and ascend to heaven, Rama returning to the highest heaven.

shloka_text: तां नदीमाकुलावर्तां सर्वत्रानुसरन्नृपः । आगतः सप्रजो रामस्तं देशं रघुनन्दनः ।। 7.110.2 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ nadīmākulāvartāṃ sarvatrānusarannṛpaḥ | āgataḥ saprajo rāmastaṃ deśaṃ raghunandanaḥ || 7.110.2 ||
translation: ताम् that, नदीम् river, आकुलावर्ताम् with agitated whirlpools, सर्वत्र everywhere, अनुसरन् following, नृपः the king, आगतः arrived, सप्रजः with his people, रामः Rama, तम् that, देशम् place, रघुनन्दनः the delight of the Raghus.
explanation: King Rama, the delight of the Raghus, arrived at that place with his people, following that river which had agitated whirlpools everywhere.

shloka_text: अथ तस्मिन्मुहूर्ते तु ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । सर्वैः परिवृतो देवैर्ऋषिभिश्च महात्मभिः ।। 7.110.3 ।।
transliteration: atha tasminmuhūrte tu brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | sarvaiḥ parivṛto devairṛṣibhiśca mahātmabhiḥ || 7.110.3 ||
translation: अथ then, तस्मिन् at that, मुहूर्ते moment, तु indeed, ब्रह्मा Brahma, लोकपितामहः the grandfather of the worlds, सर्वैः by all, परिवृतः surrounded, देवैः by gods, ऋषिभिः by sages, च and, महात्मभिः great-souled.
explanation: Then, at that very moment, Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds, arrived, surrounded by all the gods and great-souled sages.

shloka_text: आययौ यत्र काकुत्स्थः स्वर्गाय समुपस्थितः । विमानशतकोटीभिर्दिव्याभिरभिसंवृतः ।। 7.110.4 ।।
transliteration: āyayau yatra kākutsthaḥ svargāya samupasthitaḥ | vimānaśatakoṭībhirdivyābhirabhisaṃvṛtaḥ || 7.110.4 ||
translation: आययौ came, यत्र where, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), स्वर्गाय for heaven, समुपस्थितः was ready, विमानशतकोटीभिः by hundreds of crores of celestial chariots, दिव्याभिः divine, अभिसंवृतः surrounded.
explanation: Brahma came to where Rama was ready to ascend to heaven, surrounded by hundreds of crores of divine celestial chariots.

shloka_text: दिव्यतेजोवृतं व्योम ज्योतिर्भूतमनुत्तमम् । स्वयम्प्रभैः स्वतेजोभिः स्वर्गिभिः पुण्यकर्मभिः ।। 7.110.5 ।।
transliteration: divyatejovṛtaṃ vyoma jyotirbhūtamanuttamam | svayamprabhaiḥ svatejobhiḥ svargibhiḥ puṇyakarmabhiḥ || 7.110.5 ||
translation: दिव्यतेजोवृतम् covered with divine splendor, व्योम the sky, ज्योतिर्भूतम् became luminous, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, स्वयम्प्रभैः self-luminous, स्वतेजोभिः by their own radiance, स्वर्गिभिः by the dwellers of heaven, पुण्यकर्मभिः by those of meritorious deeds.
explanation: The sky became an unsurpassed, luminous expanse, covered with divine splendor, shining with the self-luminous radiance of the meritorious dwellers of heaven.

shloka_text: पुण्या वाता ववुश्चैव गन्धवन्तः सुखप्रदाः । पपात पुष्पवृष्टिश्च देवैर्मुक्ता महौघवत् ।। 7.110.6 ।।
transliteration: puṇyā vātā vavuścaiva gandhavantaḥ sukhapradāḥ | papāta puṣpavṛṣṭiśca devairmuktā mahaughavat || 7.110.6 ||
translation: पुण्याः sacred, वाताः winds, ववुः blew, च and, एव indeed, गन्धवन्तः fragrant, सुखप्रदाः bringing comfort, पपात fell, पुष्पवृष्टिः a shower of flowers, च and, देवैः by the gods, मुक्ता released, महौघवत् like a great flood.
explanation: Sacred, fragrant, and comforting winds blew, and a shower of flowers, released by the gods, fell like a great flood.

shloka_text: तस्मिंस्तूर्यशतैः कीर्णे गन्धर्वाप्सरसङ्कुले । सरयूसलिलं रामः पद्भ्यां समुपचक्रमे ।। 7.110.7 ।।
transliteration: tasmiṃstūryaśataiḥ kīrṇe gandharvāpsarasaṅkule | sarayūsalilaṃ rāmaḥ padbhyāṃ samupacakrame || 7.110.7 ||
translation: तस्मिन् in that (place/moment), तूर्यशतैः by hundreds of musical instruments, कीर्णे filled, गन्धर्वाप्सरसङ्कुले crowded with Gandharvas and Apsaras, सरयूसलिलम् the waters of Sarayu, रामः Rama, पद्भ्याम् with his feet, समुपचक्रमे approached.
explanation: In that place, filled with hundreds of musical instruments and crowded with Gandharvas and Apsaras, Rama approached the waters of the Sarayu river with his feet.

shloka_text: ततः पितामहो वाणीमन्तरिक्षादभाषत । आगच्छ विष्णो भद्रं ते दिष्ट्या प्राप्तो ऽसि राघव ।। 7.110.8 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pitāmaho vāṇīmantarikṣādabhāṣata | āgaccha viṣṇo bhadraṃ te diṣṭyā prāpto 'si rāghava || 7.110.8 ||
translation: ततः then, पितामहः the Grandfather (Brahma), वाणीम् a voice, अन्तरिक्षात् from the sky, अभाषत spoke, आगच्छ come, विष्णो O Vishnu, भद्रम् welfare, ते to you, दिष्ट्या fortunately, प्राप्तः असि you have arrived, राघव O Raghava.
explanation: Then, the Grandfather Brahma spoke a voice from the sky, saying, "Come, O Vishnu, may good fortune be with you; fortunately, you have arrived, O Raghava."

shloka_text: भ्रातृभिः सह देवाभैः प्रविशस्व स्विकां तनुम् । यामिच्छसि महाबाहो तां तनुं प्रविश स्विकाम् । वैष्णवीं तां महातेजस्तद्वाकाशं सनातनम् ।। 7.110.9 ।।
transliteration: bhrātṛbhiḥ saha devābhaiḥ praviśasva svikāṃ tanum | yāmicchasi mahābāho tāṃ tanuṃ praviśa svikām | vaiṣṇavīṃ tāṃ mahātejastadvākāśaṃ sanātanam || 7.110.9 ||
translation: भ्रातृभिः with your brothers, सह together, देवाभैः who resemble gods, प्रविशस्व enter, स्विकाम् your own, तनुम् body, याम् which, इच्छसि you desire, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, ताम् that, तनुम् body, प्रविश enter, स्विकाम् your own, वैष्णवीम् Vishnu's (form), ताम् that, महातेजः O greatly effulgent one, तत् that, वा or, आकाशम् the sky, सनातनम् eternal.
explanation: O mighty-armed and greatly effulgent one, enter your own desired form, whether it be with your god-like brothers into your own body, or into that Vaishnava form, or into the eternal sky.

shloka_text: त्वं हि लोकगतिर्देव न त्वां केचित्प्रजानते । ऋते मायां विशालाक्षीं तव पूर्वपरिग्रहाम् । त्वामचिन्त्यं महद्भूतमक्षयं सर्वसङ्ग्रहम् ।। 7.110.10 ।।
transliteration: tvaṃ hi lokagatirdeva na tvāṃ kecitprajānate | ṛte māyāṃ viśālākṣīṃ tava pūrvaparigrahām | tvāmacintyaṃ mahadbhūtamakṣayaṃ sarvasaṅgraham || 7.110.10 ||
translation: त्वम् you, हि indeed, लोकगतिः the refuge of the worlds, देव O God, न not, त्वाम् you, केचित् anyone, प्रजानते knows, ऋते except, मायाम् Maya, विशालाक्षीम् the wide-eyed one, तव your, पूर्वपरिग्रहाम् previously accepted, त्वाम् you, अचिन्त्यम् inconceivable, महद्भूतम् the great being, अक्षयम् imperishable, सर्वसङ्ग्रहम् the container of all.
explanation: O God, you are indeed the refuge of the worlds, and no one truly knows you, except for your previously accepted wide-eyed Maya, who knows you as the inconceivable, great, imperishable being, the container of all.

shloka_text: यामिच्छसि महातेजस्तां तनुं प्रविश स्वयम् ।। 7.110.11 ।। ां
transliteration: yāmicchasi mahātejastāṃ tanuṃ praviśa svayam || 7.110.11 || ्āṃ
translation: याम् which, इच्छसि you desire, महातेजः O greatly effulgent one, ताम् that, तनुम् body, प्रविश enter, स्वयम् yourself.
explanation: O greatly effulgent one, enter that form which you yourself desire.

shloka_text: विशालाक्षीं तव पूर्वपरिग्रहाम् । पितामहवचः श्रुत्वा विनिश्चित्य महामतिः । विवेश वैष्णवं तेजः सशरीरः सहानुजः ।। 7.110.12 ।।
transliteration: viśālākṣīṃ tava pūrvaparigrahām | pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā viniścitya mahāmatiḥ | viveśa vaiṣṇavaṃ tejaḥ saśarīraḥ sahānujaḥ || 7.110.12 ||
translation: विशालाक्षीं Visalakshi (Sita), तव your, पूर्वपरिग्रहाम् former wife, पितामहवचः grandfather's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, विनिश्चित्य having decided, महामतिः the great-minded one (Rama), विवेश entered, वैष्णवं Vishnu's, तेजः effulgence, सशरीरः with his body, सहानुजः with his younger brothers.
explanation: Having heard and understood the words of his grandfather Brahma regarding Visalakshi (Sita), the great-minded Rama, along with his body and younger brothers, entered into the divine effulgence of Vishnu.

shloka_text: ततो विष्णुमयं देवं पूजयन्ति स्म देवताः । साध्या मरुद्गणाश्चैव सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः ।। 7.110.13 ।।
transliteration: tato viṣṇumayaṃ devaṃ pūjayanti sma devatāḥ | sādhyā marudgaṇāścaiva sendrāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ || 7.110.13 ||
translation: ततो then, विष्णुमयं Vishnu-incarnate, देवं god, पूजयन्ति स्म worshipped, देवताः the gods, साध्या Sadhyas, मरुद्गणाश्चैव and the Maruts, सेन्द्राः with Indra, साग्निपुरोगमाः with Agni as their leader.
explanation: Then, the gods, including the Sadhyas, the Maruts, Indra, and those led by Agni, worshipped the deity who had become one with Vishnu.

shloka_text: ये च दिव्या ऋषिगणा गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्च याः । सुपर्णनागयक्षाश्च दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः ।। 7.110.14 ।।
transliteration: ye ca divyā ṛṣigaṇā gandharvāpsarasaśca yāḥ | suparṇanāgayakṣāśca daityadānavarākṣasāḥ || 7.110.14 ||
translation: ये च and those, दिव्या divine, ऋषिगणा groups of sages, गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्च and Gandharvas and Apsaras, याः who, सुपर्णनागयक्षाश्च and Suparnas, Nagas, and Yakshas, दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः Daityas, Danavas, and Rakshasas.
explanation: All the divine groups of sages, Gandharvas, Apsaras, Suparnas, Nagas, Yakshas, Daityas, Danavas, and Rakshasas were also present.

shloka_text: सर्वं पुष्टं प्रमुदितं सुसम्पूर्णमनोरथम् । साधु साध्विति तैर्देवैस्त्रिदिवं गतकल्मषम् ।। 7.110.15 ।।
transliteration: sarvaṃ puṣṭaṃ pramuditaṃ susampūrṇamanoratham | sādhu sādhviti tairdevaistridivaṃ gatakalmaṣam || 7.110.15 ||
translation: सर्वं all, पुष्टं nourished, प्रमुदितं greatly delighted, सुसम्पूर्णमनोरथम् with all desires completely fulfilled, साधु साध्विति saying "Excellent! Excellent!", तैर्देवैः by those gods, त्रिदिवं heaven, गतकल्मषम् free from sin.
explanation: All were nourished, greatly delighted, and had their desires completely fulfilled, as the gods exclaimed "Excellent! Excellent!" and heaven became free from all blemish.

shloka_text: अथ विष्णुर्महातेजाः पितामहमुवाच ह । एषां लोकं जनौघानां दातुमर्हसि सुव्रत ।। 7.110.16 ।।
transliteration: atha viṣṇurmahātejāḥ pitāmahamuvāca ha | eṣāṃ lokaṃ janaughānāṃ dātumarhasi suvrata || 7.110.16 ||
translation: अथ then, विष्णुः Vishnu, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent one, पितामहमुवाच ह indeed spoke to Brahma, एषां to these, लोकं world, जनौघानां of the multitudes of people, दातुमर्हसि you ought to give, सुव्रत O one of good vows.
explanation: Then, the greatly effulgent Vishnu addressed Brahma, the one of good vows, saying, "You ought to grant an abode to these multitudes of people."

shloka_text: इमे हि सर्वे स्नेहान्मामनुयाता यशस्विनः । भक्ता हि भजितव्याश्च त्यक्तात्मानश्च मत्कृते ।। 7.110.17 ।।
transliteration: ime hi sarve snehānmāmanuyātā yaśasvinaḥ | bhaktā hi bhajitavyāśca tyaktātmānaśca matkṛte || 7.110.17 ||
translation: इमे these, हि indeed, सर्वे all, स्नेहात् out of affection, माम् me, अनुयाताः have followed, यशस्विनः glorious ones, भक्ताः devotees, हि indeed, भजितव्याः to be honored, च and, त्यक्तात्मानः those who have given up their selves, च and, मत्कृते for my sake.
explanation: These glorious ones, all of whom have followed me out of affection, are indeed my devotees who have sacrificed their very selves for my sake and thus deserve to be honored.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा विष्णुवचनं ब्रह्मा लोकगुरुः प्रभुः । लोकान्सान्तानिकान्नाम यास्यन्तीमे समागताः ।। 7.110.18 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā viṣṇuvacanaṃ brahmā lokaguruḥ prabhuḥ | lokānsāntānikānnāma yāsyantīme samāgatāḥ || 7.110.18 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, विष्णुवचनम् Vishnu's words, ब्रह्मा Brahma, लोकगुरुः the preceptor of the worlds, प्रभुः the lord, लोकान् worlds, सान्तानिकान् named Santanika, नाम named, यास्यन्ति will go, इमे these, समागताः who have assembled.
explanation: Having heard those words of Vishnu, Lord Brahma, the preceptor of the worlds, declared that all these assembled beings would go to the worlds named Santanika.

shloka_text: यच्च तिर्यग्गतं किञ्चित्त्वामेवमनुचिन्तयत् । प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्यति भक्त्या वै तत्सन्ताने निवत्स्यति ।। 7.110.19 ।।
transliteration: yacca tiryaggataṃ kiñcittvāmevamanucintayat | prāṇāṃstyakṣyati bhaktyā vai tatsantāne nivatsyati || 7.110.19 ||
translation: यत् whatever, च and, तिर्यग्गतम् born as an animal, किञ्चित् anything, त्वाम् you, एवम् thus, अनुचिन्तयत् meditating upon, प्राणान् life, त्यक्ष्यति will abandon, भक्त्या with devotion, वै indeed, तत्सन्ताने in that Santanika world, निवत्स्यति will reside.
explanation: And whatever animal, meditating upon you in this manner, abandons its life with devotion, will indeed reside in that Santanika world.

shloka_text: सर्वैर्ब्रह्मगुणैर्युक्ते ब्रह्मलोकादनन्तरे ।। 7.110.20 ।।
transliteration: sarvairbrahmaguṇairyukte brahmalokādanantare || 7.110.20 ||
translation: सर्वैः with all, ब्रह्मगुणैः divine qualities, युक्ते endowed, ब्रह्मलोकात् from the world of Brahma, अनन्तरे next/not different.
explanation: This refers to the Santanika world, which is endowed with all divine qualities and is next to or not different from the world of Brahma.

shloka_text: वानराश्च स्विकां योनिमृक्षाश्चैव तथा ययुः । येभ्यो विनिस्सृताः सर्वे सुरेभ्यः सुरसम्भवाः ।। 7.110.21 ।।
transliteration: vānarāśca svikāṃ yonimṛkṣāścaiva tathā yayuḥ | yebhyo vinissṛtāḥ sarve surebhyaḥ surasambhavāḥ || 7.110.21 ||
translation: वानराः monkeys, च and, स्विकाम् their own, योनिम् origin/form, ऋक्षाः bears, च and, एव indeed, तथा similarly, ययुः went, येभ्यः from whom, विनिस्सृताः originated, सर्वे all, सुरेभ्यः from the gods, सुरसम्भवाः born of gods.
explanation: The monkeys and bears, who were all born of gods and had originated from them, returned to their respective divine forms.

shloka_text: तेषु प्रविविशे चैव सुग्रीवः सूर्यमण्डलम् । पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां स्वान्पितऽन्प्रतिपेदिरे ।। 7.110.22 ।।
transliteration: teṣu praviviśe caiva sugrīvaḥ sūryamaṇḍalam | paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ svānpita'npratipedire || 7.110.22 ||
translation: तेषु among them, प्रविविशे entered, चैव and indeed, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, सूर्यमण्डलम् the solar orb, पश्यतां while seeing, सर्वदेवानां of all the gods, स्वान् their own, पितऽन् ancestors, प्रतिपेदिरे attained,
explanation: Among them, Sugriva entered the solar orb, and all the gods, while watching, attained their own ancestors.

shloka_text: तथोक्तवति देवेशे गोप्रतारमुपागताः । भेजिरे सरयूं सर्वे हर्षपूर्णाश्रुविक्लवाः ।। 7.110.23 ।।
transliteration: tathoktavati deveśe gopratāramupāgatāḥ | bhejire sarayūṃ sarve harṣapūrṇāśruviklavāḥ || 7.110.23 ||
translation: तथा thus, उक्तवति having spoken, देवेशे by the lord of gods, गोप्रतारम् to Gopratara, उपागताः having arrived, भेजिरे resorted to, सरयूं the Sarayu river, सर्वे all, हर्षपूर्णाश्रुविक्लवाः overwhelmed with tears full of joy,
explanation: When the lord of gods had thus spoken, all those who had arrived at Gopratara, overwhelmed with tears of joy, entered the Sarayu river.

shloka_text: अवगाह्य जलं यो यः प्राणी ह्यासीत् प्रहृष्टवत् । मानुषं देहमुत्सृज्य विमानं सो ऽध्यरोहत ।। 7.110.24 ।।
transliteration: avagāhya jalaṃ yo yaḥ prāṇī hyāsīt prahṛṣṭavat | mānuṣaṃ dehamutsṛjya vimānaṃ so 'dhyarohata || 7.110.24 ||
translation: अवगाह्य having plunged into, जलं the water, यो यः whoever, प्राणी living being, ह्यासीत् indeed was, प्रहृष्टवत् greatly delighted, मानुषं human, देहम् body, उत्सृज्य having abandoned, विमानं a celestial chariot, सो he, ऽध्यरोहत ascended,
explanation: Whoever living being, greatly delighted, plunged into the water, abandoned their human body and ascended a celestial chariot.

shloka_text: तिर्यग्योनिगतानां च शतानि सरयूजलम् । सम्प्राप्य त्रिदिवं जग्मुः प्रभासुरवपूंषि च । दिव्या दिव्येन वपुषा देवा दीप्ता इवाभवन् ।। 7.110.25 ।।
transliteration: tiryagyonigatānāṃ ca śatāni sarayūjalam | samprāpya tridivaṃ jagmuḥ prabhāsuravapūṃṣi ca | divyā divyena vapuṣā devā dīptā ivābhavan || 7.110.25 ||
translation: तिर्यग्योनिगतानां of those born in animal wombs, च and, शतानि hundreds, सरयूजलम् the water of Sarayu, सम्प्राप्य having attained, त्रिदिवं heaven, जग्मुः went, प्रभासुरवपूंषि with radiant bodies, च and, दिव्या divine beings, दिव्येन with divine, वपुषा bodies, देवा gods, दीप्ता shining, इवाभवन् as if became,
explanation: And hundreds of animals, having attained the water of Sarayu, went to heaven with radiant bodies, becoming like shining gods with divine forms.

shloka_text: गत्वा तु सरयूतोयं स्थावराणि चराणि च । प्राप्य तत्तोयविक्लेदं देवलोकमुपागमन् ।। 7.110.26 ।।
transliteration: gatvā tu sarayūtoyaṃ sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca | prāpya tattoyavikledaṃ devalokamupāgaman || 7.110.26 ||
translation: गत्वा having gone, तु indeed, सरयूतोयम् to the water of Sarayu, स्थावराणि immobile beings, चराणि mobile beings, च and, प्राप्य having obtained, तत्तोयविक्लेदं the moistening by that water, देवलोकम् the world of gods, उपागमन् attained,
explanation: Indeed, having gone to the water of Sarayu, both immobile and mobile beings, by obtaining the moistening from that water, attained the world of gods.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्नपि समापन्ना ऋक्षवानरराक्षसाः । ते ऽपि स्वर्गं प्रविविशुर्देहान्निक्षिप्य चाम्भसि ।। 7.110.27 ।।
transliteration: tasminnapi samāpannā ṛkṣavānararākṣasāḥ | te 'pi svargaṃ praviviśurdehānnikṣipya cāmbhasi || 7.110.27 ||
translation: तस्मिन्नपि in that (place/time) also, समापन्नाः arrived, ऋक्षवानरराक्षसाः bears, monkeys, and rakshasas, ते they, अपि also, स्वर्गं heaven, प्रविविशुः entered, देहान् bodies, निक्षिप्य having cast off, च and, अम्भसि in water.
explanation: Even the bears, monkeys, and rakshasas who had gathered there, having cast off their bodies in the water, also entered heaven.

shloka_text: ततः समागतान्सर्वान्स्थाप्य लोकगुरुर्दिवि । जगाम त्रिदशैः सार्धं सदा हृष्टैर्दिवं महत् ।। 7.110.28 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ samāgatānsarvānsthāpya lokagururdivi | jagāma tridaśaiḥ sārdhaṃ sadā hṛṣṭairdivaṃ mahat || 7.110.28 ||
translation: ततः thereafter, समागतान् those who had gathered, सर्वान् all, स्थाप्य having established, लोकगुरुः the preceptor of the worlds (Rama), दिवि in heaven, जगाम went, त्रिदशैः with the gods, सार्धं together with, सदा always, हृष्टैः joyful, दिवं to heaven, महत् great.
explanation: Thereafter, the preceptor of the worlds, Rama, having established all those who had gathered in heaven, went to the great heaven along with the ever-joyful gods. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे दशाधिकशततमः सर्गः ।। 110 ।। Thus ends the hundred and tenth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एतावदेतदाख्यानं सोत्तरं ब्रह्मपूजितम् । रामायणमिति ख्यातं मुख्यं वाल्मीकीना कृतम् ।। 7.111.1 ।।
transliteration: etāvadetadākhyānaṃ sottaraṃ brahmapūjitam | rāmāyaṇamiti khyātaṃ mukhyaṃ vālmīkīnā kṛtam || 7.111.1 ||
translation: एतावत् this much, एतत् this, आख्यानं narrative, सोत्तरं with the Uttara Kanda, ब्रह्मपूजितम् revered by Brahma, रामायणम् Ramayana, इति thus, ख्यातं known, मुख्यं principal, वाल्मीकीना by Valmiki, कृतम् composed.
explanation: This is the complete narrative, including the Uttara Kanda, revered by Brahma, known as the Ramayana, and composed as the foremost work by Valmiki.
comments: The poem concludes: this is the whole Ramayana with its Uttara Kanda, composed by Valmiki and approved by Brahma, while Vishnu abides again in heaven -- and the closing phala-shruti proclaims the boundless merit of reciting or hearing it, which grants long life, sons, wealth, freedom from sin and the world of Vishnu, being the essence of the Gayatri and the equal of the Vedas.

shloka_text: ततः प्रतिष्ठितो विष्णुः स्वर्गलोके यथा पुरम् । येन व्याप्तमिदं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ।। 7.111.2 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pratiṣṭhito viṣṇuḥ svargaloke yathā puram | yena vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 7.111.2 ||
translation: ततः thereafter, प्रतिष्ठितः established, विष्णुः Vishnu, स्वर्गलोके in the heavenly realm, यथा as, पुरम् before, येन by whom, व्याप्तम् pervaded, इदं this, सर्वं all, त्रैलोक्यं three worlds, सचराचरम् with moving and non-moving beings.
explanation: Thereafter, Vishnu, by whom all these three worlds, with their moving and non-moving beings, are pervaded, resided in the heavenly realm as before.

shloka_text: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः । नित्यं शृण्वन्ति सन्तुष्टाः दिव्यं रामायणं दिवि ।। 7.111.3 ।।
transliteration: tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ | nityaṃ śṛṇvanti santuṣṭāḥ divyaṃ rāmāyaṇaṃ divi || 7.111.3 ||
translation: ततः then, देवाः gods, सगन्धर्वाः with Gandharvas, सिद्धाः Siddhas, च and, परमर्षयः great sages, नित्यं always, शृण्वन्ति listen, सन्तुष्टाः delighted, दिव्यं divine, रामायणं Ramayana, दिवि in heaven.
explanation: Then, the gods, along with the Gandharvas, Siddhas, and great sages, always listen to the divine Ramayana in heaven with great delight.

shloka_text: इदमाख्यानमायुष्यं सौभाग्यं पापनाशनम् । रामायणं वेदसमं श्राद्धेषु श्रावयेद्बुधः ।। 7.111.4 ।।
transliteration: idamākhyānamāyuṣyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ pāpanāśanam | rāmāyaṇaṃ vedasamaṃ śrāddheṣu śrāvayedbudhaḥ || 7.111.4 ||
translation: इदम् this, आख्यानम् narrative, आयुष्यम् promoting longevity, सौभाग्यम् good fortune, पापनाशनम् destroyer of sins, रामायणम् Ramayana, वेदसमम् equal to the Vedas, श्राद्धेषु in ancestral rites, श्रावयेत् should cause to be heard, बुधः a wise person.
explanation: A wise person should recite this narrative, the Ramayana, which promotes longevity, brings good fortune, destroys sins, and is equal to the Vedas, especially during ancestral rites.

shloka_text: अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमधनो लभते धनम् । सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्येत पदमप्यस्य यः पठेत् ।। 7.111.5 ।।
transliteration: aputro labhate putramadhano labhate dhanam | sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyeta padamapyasya yaḥ paṭhet || 7.111.5 ||
translation: अपुत्रः one without a son, लभते obtains, पुत्रम् a son, अधनः one without wealth, लभते obtains, धनम् wealth, सर्वपापैः from all sins, प्रमुच्येत is freed, पदम् a word, अपि even, अस्य of this, यः who, पठेत् reads.
explanation: One who reads even a single word of this (Ramayana) obtains a son if childless, wealth if poor, and is freed from all sins.

shloka_text: पापान्यपि च यः कुर्यादहन्यहनि मानवः । पठत्येकमपि श्लोकं पापात्स परिमुच्यते ।। 7.111.6 ।।
transliteration: pāpānyapi ca yaḥ kuryādahanyahani mānavaḥ | paṭhatyekamapi ślokaṃ pāpātsa parimucyate || 7.111.6 ||
translation: पापानि sins, अपि even, च and, यः who, कुर्यात् commits, अहन्यहनि day after day, मानवः a human being, पठति reads, एकम् one, अपि even, श्लोकम् verse, पापात् from sin, सः he, परिमुच्यते is completely freed.
explanation: Even a human being who commits sins daily, if he recites even one verse (from the Ramayana), is completely freed from those sins.

shloka_text: वाचकाय च दातव्यं वस्त्रं धेनुं हिरण्यकम् । वाचके परितुष्टे तु तुष्टाः स्युः सर्वदेवताः ।। 7.111.7 ।।
transliteration: vācakāya ca dātavyaṃ vastraṃ dhenuṃ hiraṇyakam | vācake parituṣṭe tu tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ || 7.111.7 ||
translation: वाचकाय to the reciter, च and, दातव्यम् should be given, वस्त्रम् clothes, धेनुम् a cow, हिरण्यकम् gold, वाचके when the reciter, परितुष्टे is completely pleased, तु indeed, तुष्टाः pleased, स्युः become, सर्वदेवताः all deities.
explanation: Clothes, a cow, and gold should be given to the reciter, for when the reciter is completely pleased, all deities become pleased.

shloka_text: एतदाख्यानमायुष्यं पठन्रामायणं नरः । सपुत्रपौत्रो लोके ऽस्मिन्प्रेत्य चेह महीयते ।। 7.111.8 ।।
transliteration: etadākhyānamāyuṣyaṃ paṭhanrāmāyaṇaṃ naraḥ | saputrapautro loke 'sminpretya ceha mahīyate || 7.111.8 ||
translation: एतत् this, आख्यानम् narrative, आयुष्यम् promoting longevity, पठन् reading, रामायणम् Ramayana, नरः a person, सपुत्रपौत्रः with sons and grandsons, लोके in the world, अस्मिन् this, प्रेत्य after death, च and, इह here, महीयते is honored.
explanation: A person who recites this life-giving narrative, the Ramayana, is honored in this world with sons and grandsons, and also after death.

shloka_text: अयोध्या ऽपि पुरी रम्या शून्या वर्षगणान्बहून् । ऋषभं प्राप्य राजानं निवासमुपयास्यति ।। 7.111.9 ।।
transliteration: ayodhyā 'pi purī ramyā śūnyā varṣagaṇānbahūn | ṛṣabhaṃ prāpya rājānaṃ nivāsamupayāsyati || 7.111.9 ||
translation: अयोध्या Ayodhya, अपि even, पुरी city, रम्या beautiful, शून्या empty, वर्षगणान् for many years, बहून् many, ऋषभम् Rishabha, प्राप्य having obtained, राजानम् as king, निवासम् habitation, उपयास्यति will attain.
explanation: The beautiful city of Ayodhya, which has been deserted for many years, will once again become inhabited when King Rishabha takes the throne.

shloka_text: एतदाख्यानमायुष्यं सभविष्यं सहोत्तरम् । कृतवान्प्रचेतसः पुत्रस्तद्ब्रह्माप्यन्वमन्यत ।। 7.111.10 ।।
transliteration: etadākhyānamāyuṣyaṃ sabhaviṣyaṃ sahottaram | kṛtavānpracetasaḥ putrastadbrahmāpyanvamanyata || 7.111.10 ||
translation: एतत् this, आख्यानम् narrative, आयुष्यम् life-giving, सभविष्यम् with the future (events), सहउत्तरम् with the Uttara Kanda, कृतवान् composed, प्रचेतसः of Prachetas, पुत्रः son, तत् that, ब्रह्मा Brahma, अपि even, अन्वमन्यत approved.
explanation: The son of Prachetas (Valmiki) composed this life-giving narrative, including its future events and the Uttara Kanda, and even Brahma himself approved of it.

shloka_text: अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य वाजपेयायुतस्य च । लभते श्रावणादेव सर्गस्यैकस्य मानवः ।। 7.111.11 ।।
transliteration: aśvamedhasahasrasya vājapeyāyutasya ca | labhate śrāvaṇādeva sargasyaikasya mānavaḥ || 7.111.11 ||
translation: अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य of a thousand Ashwamedha sacrifices, वाजपेयायुतस्य of ten thousand Vajapeya sacrifices, च and, लभते obtains, श्रावणात् from listening, एव merely, सर्गस्य of a canto, एकस्य of one, मानवः a person.
explanation: A person who merely listens to a single canto of this epic obtains the merit of performing a thousand Ashwamedha sacrifices and ten thousand Vajapeya sacrifices.

shloka_text: प्रयागादीनि तीर्थानि गङ्गाद्याः सरितस्तथा । नैमिशादीन्यरण्यानि कुरुक्षेत्रादिकान्यपि । गतानि तेन लोके ऽस्मिन्येन रामायणं श्रुतम् ।। 7.111.12 ।।
transliteration: prayāgādīni tīrthāni gaṅgādyāḥ saritastathā | naimiśādīnyaraṇyāni kurukṣetrādikānyapi | gatāni tena loke 'sminyena rāmāyaṇaṃ śrutam || 7.111.12 ||
translation: प्रयागादीनि Prayaga and others, तीर्थानि holy places, गङ्गाद्याः Ganga and others, सरितः rivers, तथा similarly, नैमिशादीनि Naimisha and others, अरण्यानि forests, कुरुक्षेत्रादीनि Kurukshetra and others, अपि also, गतानि visited, तेन by him, लोके in this world, अस्मिन् this, येन by whom, रामायणम् Ramayana, श्रुतम् heard.
explanation: In this world, whoever has listened to the Ramayana is considered to have visited holy places like Prayaga, rivers like Ganga, forests like Naimisha, and regions like Kurukshetra.

shloka_text: हेमभारं कुरुक्षेत्रे ग्रस्ते भानौ प्रयच्छति । यश्च रामायणं लोके शृणोति सदृशावुभौ ।। 7.111.13 ।।
transliteration: hemabhāraṃ kurukṣetre graste bhānau prayacchati | yaśca rāmāyaṇaṃ loke śṛṇoti sadṛśāvubhau || 7.111.13 ||
translation: हेमभारम् a load of gold, कुरुक्षेत्रे in Kurukshetra, ग्रस्ते when eclipsed, भानौ the sun, प्रयच्छति gives, यः who, च and, रामायणम् Ramayana, लोके in the world, शृणोति listens, सदृशौ equal, उभौ both.
explanation: One who donates a load of gold in Kurukshetra during a solar eclipse and one who listens to the Ramayana in this world are both considered equal in merit.

shloka_text: सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमायुक्तः शृणुते राघवीं कथाम् । सर्वपापात्प्रमुच्येत विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति ।। 7.111.14 ।।
transliteration: samyakchraddhāsamāyuktaḥ śṛṇute rāghavīṃ kathām | sarvapāpātpramucyeta viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 7.111.14 ||
translation: सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमायुक्तः endowed with complete faith, शृणुते listens, राघवीं relating to Raghava (Rama), कथाम् story, सर्वपापात् from all sins, प्रमुच्येत is liberated, विष्णुलोकं to the world of Vishnu, स he, गच्छति goes.
explanation: One who listens to the story of Rama with complete faith is liberated from all sins and attains the abode of Vishnu.

shloka_text: आदिकाव्यमिदं त्वार्षं पुरा वाल्मीकिना कृतम् । यः शृणोति सदा भक्त्या स गच्छेद्वैष्णवीं तनुम् ।। 7.111.15 ।।
transliteration: ādikāvyamidaṃ tvārṣaṃ purā vālmīkinā kṛtam | yaḥ śṛṇoti sadā bhaktyā sa gacchedvaiṣṇavīṃ tanum || 7.111.15 ||
translation: आदिकाव्यम् the first epic poem, इदं this, तु indeed, आर्षं composed by a Rishi, पुरा formerly, वाल्मीकिना by Valmiki, कृतम् composed, यः who, शृणोति listens, सदा always, भक्त्या with devotion, स he, गच्छेत् would attain, वैष्णवीं Vishnu-like, तनुम् body.
explanation: This ancient epic, composed by Valmiki, is the first poem, and whoever always listens to it with devotion will attain a divine form akin to Vishnu.

shloka_text: पुत्रदाराश्च वर्धन्ते सम्पदः सन्ततिस्तथा । सत्यमेतद्विदित्वा तु श्रोतव्यं नियतात्मभिः ।। 7.111.16 ।।
transliteration: putradārāśca vardhante sampadaḥ santatistathā | satyametadviditvā tu śrotavyaṃ niyatātmabhiḥ || 7.111.16 ||
translation: पुत्रदाराः sons and wives, च and, वर्धन्ते increase, सम्पदः wealth, सन्ततिः progeny, तथा and, सत्यम् truth, एतत् this, विदित्वा having known, तु indeed, श्रोतव्यं should be heard, नियतात्मभिः by those with controlled minds.
explanation: Sons, wives, wealth, and progeny all increase, and knowing this truth, those with self-controlled minds should indeed listen to it.

shloka_text: गायत्र्याश्च स्वरूपं तद्रामायणमनुत्तमम् ।। 7.111.17 ।।
transliteration: gāyatryāśca svarūpaṃ tadrāmāyaṇamanuttamam || 7.111.17 ||
translation: गायत्र्याः of Gayatri, च and, स्वरूपं the very form, तत् that, रामायणम् Ramayana, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.
explanation: That Ramayana is indeed the very essence of the Gayatri Mantra and is unsurpassed.

shloka_text: अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमधनो लभते धनम् । सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्येत पदमप्यस्य यः पठेत् ।। 7.111.18 ।।
transliteration: aputro labhate putramadhano labhate dhanam | sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyeta padamapyasya yaḥ paṭhet || 7.111.18 ||
translation: अपुत्रः one without a son, लभते obtains, पुत्रम् a son, अधनः one without wealth, लभते obtains, धनम् wealth, सर्वपापैः from all sins, प्रमुच्येत is liberated, पदम् a word/verse, अपि even, अस्य of this, यः who, पठेत् reads.
explanation: One without a son obtains a son, one without wealth obtains wealth, and whoever reads even a single verse of this (Ramayana) is liberated from all sins.

shloka_text: यः पठेच्छृणुयान्नित्यं चरितं राघवस्य ह । भक्त्या निष्कल्मषो भूत्वा दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुयात् ।। 7.111.19 ।।
transliteration: yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyānnityaṃ caritaṃ rāghavasya ha | bhaktyā niṣkalmaṣo bhūtvā dīrghamāyuravāpnuyāt || 7.111.19 ||
translation: यः who, पठेत् reads, शृणुयात् listens, नित्यम् daily, चरितम् the story, राघवस्य of Raghava, ह indeed, भक्त्या with devotion, निष्कल्मषः free from sin, भूत्वा having become, दीर्घम् long, आयुः life, अवाप्नुयात् attains.
explanation: One who daily reads or listens to the story of Raghava with devotion, becoming free from sin, attains a long life.

shloka_text: चिन्तयेद्राघवं नित्यं श्रेयः प्राप्तुं य इच्छति । श्रावयेदिदमाख्यानं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो दिने दिने ।। 7.111.20 ।।
transliteration: cintayedrāghavaṃ nityaṃ śreyaḥ prāptuṃ ya icchati | śrāvayedidamākhyānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dine dine || 7.111.20 ||
translation: चिन्तयेत् should meditate upon, राघवम् Raghava, नित्यम् daily, श्रेयः welfare, प्राप्तुम् to obtain, यः who, इच्छति desires, श्रावयेत् should narrate, इदम् this, आख्यानम् narrative, ब्राह्मणेभ्यः to Brahmins, दिने दिने daily.
explanation: One who desires to attain ultimate welfare should daily meditate upon Raghava and should narrate this story to Brahmins day by day.

shloka_text: यस्त्विदं रघुनाथस्य चरितं सकलं पठेत् । सो ऽसुक्षये विष्णुलोकं गच्छत्येव न संशयः ।। 7.111.21 ।।
transliteration: yastvidaṃ raghunāthasya caritaṃ sakalaṃ paṭhet | so 'sukṣaye viṣṇulokaṃ gacchatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 7.111.21 ||
translation: यः who, तु indeed, इदम् this, रघुनाथस्य of Raghunatha, चरितम् story, सकलम् entire, पठेत् reads, सः he, असुक्षये at the end of life, विष्णुलोकम् to the world of Vishnu, गच्छति goes, एव certainly, न no, संशयः doubt.
explanation: One who reads this entire story of Raghunatha certainly goes to the world of Vishnu at the end of life; there is no doubt about it.

shloka_text: पिता पितामहस्तस्य तथैव प्रपितामहः । तत्पिता तत्पिता चैव विष्णुं यान्ति न संशयः ।। 7.111.22 ।।
transliteration: pitā pitāmahastasya tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ | tatpitā tatpitā caiva viṣṇuṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ || 7.111.22 ||
translation: पिता father, पितामहः grandfather, तस्य his, तथैव similarly, प्रपितामहः great-grandfather, तत्पिता his father (great-great-grandfather), तत्पिता his father (great-great-great-grandfather), च and, एव certainly, विष्णुम् to Vishnu, यान्ति go, न no, संशयः doubt.
explanation: His father, grandfather, and similarly his great-grandfather, great-great-grandfather, and great-great-great-grandfather all certainly go to Vishnu; there is no doubt about it.

shloka_text: चतुर्वर्गप्रदं नित्यं चरितं राघवस्य तु । तस्माद्यत्नवता नित्यं श्रोतव्यं परमं सदा ।। 7.111.23 ।।
transliteration: caturvargapradaṃ nityaṃ caritaṃ rāghavasya tu | tasmādyatnavatā nityaṃ śrotavyaṃ paramaṃ sadā || 7.111.23 ||
translation: चतुर्वर्गप्रदम् bestower of the four aims of life, नित्यम् always, चरितम् the story, राघवस्य of Raghava, तु indeed, तस्मात् therefore, यत्नवता by one who is diligent, नित्यम् always, श्रोतव्यम् should be heard, परमम् supreme, सदा always.
explanation: The story of Raghava is always the bestower of the four aims of life; therefore, it should always be heard with supreme diligence.

shloka_text: शृण्वन्रामायणं भक्त्या यः पादं पदमेव वा । स याति ब्रह्मणः स्थानं ब्रह्मणा पूज्यते सदा ।। 7.111.24 ।।
transliteration: śṛṇvanrāmāyaṇaṃ bhaktyā yaḥ pādaṃ padameva vā | sa yāti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ brahmaṇā pūjyate sadā || 7.111.24 ||
translation: शृण्वन् one who listens, रामायणम् Ramayana, भक्त्या with devotion, यः who, पादम् a quarter (of a verse), पदम् a word, एव even, वा or, सः he, याति attains, ब्रह्मणः of Brahma, स्थानम् the abode, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, पूज्यते is worshipped, सदा always.
explanation: Whoever listens to even a quarter of a verse or a single word of the Ramayana with devotion attains the abode of Brahma and is always worshipped by Brahma himself.

shloka_text: एवमेतत्पुरावृत्तमाख्यानं भद्रमस्तु वः । प्रव्याहरत विस्रब्धं बलं विष्णोः प्रवर्धताम् ।। 7.111.25 ।।
transliteration: evametatpurāvṛttamākhyānaṃ bhadramastu vaḥ | pravyāharata visrabdhaṃ balaṃ viṣṇoḥ pravardhatām || 7.111.25 ||
translation: एवम् thus, एतत् this, पुरावृत्तम् ancient, आख्यानम् narrative, भद्रम् welfare, अस्तु let there be, वः to you, प्रव्याहरत proclaim, विस्रब्धम् confidently, बलम् the strength, विष्णोः of Vishnu, प्रवर्धताम् let it increase.
explanation: Thus is this ancient narrative; may welfare be to you; proclaim it confidently, and may the strength of Vishnu increase. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे श्रीमद्वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये चतुर्विंशत्सहस्रिकायां संहितायां श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकादशोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 111 ।। Thus ends the hundred and eleventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki. ।। इत्युत्तरकाण्डः समाप्तः ।। Thus the Uttara Kanda is concluded. ।। इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्रामायणं सम्पूर्णम् ।। Thus the glorious Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki, is complete. ।। श्रीसीतारामचन्द्रार्पणमस्तु ।। May this work be an offering unto the glorious Sita and Ramachandra.
